# Decisions

Owner decisions that constrain future work, newest first. Significant architecture
decisions get an ADR in `docs/adr/`.

## Decisions

### 2026-10-30 — Choices made during the hardening pass (agent proposal, owner to confirm)

Taken by the agents while fixing the audit findings of 2026-10-30; the owner did not decide
them explicitly. Each is in the code; reverting one is a code change.

| # | Choice | Why |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Chat folder slugs transliterate Cyrillic to Latin and drop accents (`textnorm.transliterate`); a slug without letters falls back to `chat` and is never used to match a library name | Russian chats got the unreadable `chat_<id>`; a shared fallback could select the wrong chat |
| 2 | `export-json` writes to `<root>/_exports/<chat folder>.json` and leaves sender names and `raw` out unless `--names` | an export is the copy most likely to be shared (Ley 18.331); inside the chat folder it survived trims and mixed with service files |
| 3 | Control commands run at most once: the service claims a command file by renaming it before running it; a claim left by a crash is answered "interrupted", never re-run | a repeated destructive `trim` is worse than a lost command the user can resend |
| 4 | Text typed by a person (library names, titles, `--chat`) is compared through `textnorm.fold` (NFC, casefold, collapsed spaces); Telegram title refs are compared after NFC only, as the spec asks for an exact title | composed and decomposed accents and letter case named different chats |
| 5 | A disk-space stop of a backfill is persisted (`floor_id = oldest_done_id`, `floor_reason = "disk"`, `backfill.done = true`) and never resumed automatically; `backfill --deeper` resumes it | spec §8.2 step 5: an automatic resume would fetch and delete forever |
| 6 | Late live messages (`msg_id ≤ last_id`, not stored yet) are merged into their month instead of being dropped; beyond 20,000 queued events the worker catches up from Telegram and asks for a recheck | no silent loss, bounded memory |

### 2026-10-29 — ChatImport on its own branch of this repository

ChatImport is developed on branch `chatimport`, cut from `main` (ChatRadar) and stripped of
ChatRadar code. It is a separate uv project named `chatimport` on Python 3.14. The two lines
are meant to become one product later (`docs/architecture.md` §15); until then this branch
neither merges into nor changes `main`. Rule modules, agents and skills on this branch
describe ChatImport only.

### 2026-10-29 — Spec decisions (spec v1.2, §18)

| # | Question | Decision |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Sender names | stored: `sender_name` and `sender_username`, on by default |
| 2 | What is tracked | only groups and channels from the `chats.toml` library (links, @usernames, titles); no private dialogs |
| 3 | Recheck of edits | yes: daily over the last 7 days, plus on start after a long pause |
| 4 | Output path | the personal laptop's Desktop for now; changed by one command or from the tray, with data moved |
| 5 | Splitting month files | yes: month → parts `YYYY-MM_NNN.jsonl` of 20 MB; the part is the unit of accounting and trimming |

### 2026-10-19 — AI assistant rule system, Claude Code first

Rules in `.ai/` shared by every assistant; `CLAUDE.md` imports them, `AGENTS.md` and
`.codex/` are generated, `GEMINI.md` imports `AGENTS.md`. Same layout as the owner's other
repositories.

### 2026-10-19 — Publishing without pull requests

Task branch → green `just check` → `git merge --ff-only` → push, only when the owner asked
in the current task. On this line of work the target branch is `chatimport`.

### 2026-10-19 — MIT license

The repository is public under MIT.

### 2026-10-19 — English in the repository

Everything tracked by git is English; reports to the owner are in Russian.

### 2026-11-02 — Combined archive file

One extra file holds every chat's messages sorted by time. It is **rebuilt from the stored
parts** (streamed k-way merge, atomic replace into `<root>/_exports/`), never appended to:
JSON cannot be appended to, and old history arrives after new messages. It is rebuilt on a
timer and on demand, and only when some chat changed since the last build. Sender names and
`raw` are left out unless the owner enables them (same rule as `export-json`). Per-chat
files stay the source of truth; the combined file is a derived copy. Like `export-json` it
reads parts without the instance lock, the same narrow exception to the one-writer rule.

### 2026-11-02 — API keys are the user's own

The application never ships `api_id`/`api_hash`; each user creates their own at
my.telegram.org. The window carries a step-by-step guide instead.

## Open questions

- Variant A or B for the ChatRadar integration (`docs/architecture.md` §15).
- Whether to package a single `.exe` with PyInstaller.
- Telegram terms since February 2026 for any use beyond a personal archive.
- The six choices of 2026-10-30 above: confirm or change.
- Whether `export-json` may keep writing into `<root>/_exports/` while the service runs (it
  reads parts and writes its own file without the instance lock, a narrow exception to the
  one-writer rule in `.ai/project/12-domain-rules.md`).

# ChatImport — Vision

A quiet background service that keeps a complete, machine-readable local archive of the
Telegram groups and channels the owner cares about, so later programs (ChatRadar first) can
work with that history without ever touching Telegram themselves.

## What it is for

- The full text history of about eight topical chats, on the owner's own disk, as JSONL.
- New messages land within seconds, but are written in small batches.
- Control is simple and physical: delete a folder to refetch it, run `trim` to drop old
  history, edit `chats.toml` to change what is tracked.
- It never lets itself fill the disk.
- Media (voice, round videos, photos, documents) can be switched on later without changing
  the format.

## What it is not

- Not a reader of Telegram Desktop's local database; it is its own client.
- Not an analyser: search, threads, digests and answers belong to ChatRadar.
- Not a publisher: nothing leaves the owner's machine.
- Not a collector of private dialogs: only the chats in the library.

## Where it goes

ChatImport and ChatRadar are developed on separate branches of one repository and are meant
to become one product: ChatImport's folder becomes a raw store for ChatRadar, or its
listener moves into ChatRadar as `chatradar listen` (`docs/architecture.md` §15).

# ChatImport

A local background service that keeps the full text history of chosen Telegram groups and
channels on your disk as JSONL. It backfills each chat once, then appends new messages in
small batches, rechecks the last 7 days daily for edits and deletions, and never lets itself
fill the disk.

> **Status: the service is implemented (stages 0.1–0.7) and hardened, but has not yet run
> against a real Telegram account.** Everything is tested against a scripted fake of
> Telegram (3155 tests, 100 % line and branch coverage). The next step is the owner's live
> check: `login`, one small chat, then all of them. Plan: [docs/ROADMAP.md](docs/ROADMAP.md).
> Design: [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md).
>
> This is branch `chatimport` of the ChatRadar repository: a parallel line of work that will
> later merge with ChatRadar (on `main`).

## How it works

- Tracks **only** the groups and channels listed in `chats.toml` (links, @usernames, ids or
  exact titles). Private dialogs are never read; the service never joins a chat and never
  sends anything.
- Writes `ChatImport/<chat>_<chat_id>/YYYY-MM_NNN.jsonl` (the Desktop by default): one JSON
  object per line, month files split into 20 MB parts. Folder names are ASCII (Cyrillic
  titles are transliterated).
- Delete a chat folder → it is fetched again. `chatimport trim 50` → the oldest half of
  every chat is removed. Under 15 GB free → the oldest parts are removed automatically and
  history downloads stop until `chatimport backfill --deeper`.
- Runs as its own session of your Telegram account (Telethon); Telegram Desktop may stay
  closed. History is downloaded one chat at a time, with pauses.

## Quick start

Requirements: [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) (it installs Python 3.14), git,
[just](https://just.systems/) for development.

1. `uv sync`
2. Copy [config.example.toml](config.example.toml) to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\ChatImport\config.toml`
   and set `api_id` and `api_hash` from <https://my.telegram.org> (API development tools).

```bash
uv run chatimport login                       # phone, code, 2FA password; once
uv run chatimport dialogs                     # your groups and channels with chat_id
uv run chatimport chats add https://t.me/example_group --name example
uv run chatimport chats list                  # does every entry resolve?
uv run chatimport run --once --chat example   # fetch one chat and exit
uv run chatimport tray                        # normal operation, tray icon
uv run chatimport status                      # what the service is doing
```

Other commands: `run` (console mode), `pause`/`resume`, `recheck`, `trim 25|50|75`,
`backfill --deeper`, `check [--repair]`, `export-json --chat X`, `set-root <path> --move`.
`uv run chatimport --help` lists them; details in
[.ai/project/14-command-reference.md](.ai/project/14-command-reference.md). Autostart on
Windows: Task Scheduler at logon running `.venv\Scripts\pythonw.exe -m chatimport tray`
([docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md) §14).

## Where things live (Windows)

| What | Where |
|---|---|
| Chat data | `<Desktop>\ChatImport\` (change with `chatimport set-root <path> --move`, `--root`, `CHATIMPORT_ROOT` or `output.root_dir`) |
| Config and library | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\ChatImport\config.toml`, `chats.toml` |
| Telegram session | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\ChatImport\session\chatimport.session` |
| Log | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\ChatImport\logs\chatimport.log` (rotating) |
| Exports | `<data root>\_exports\<chat folder>.json` |
| Icon | `src/chatimport/assets/icon.png` (tray, README) and `icon.ico` (shortcuts, future executable) |

The real config and library never reach git; the repository holds only the templates.

## Privacy

- The Telegram session file is full access to your account; it stays in the application
  data folder. If it leaks, terminate it in Telegram → Settings → Devices.
- Sender names are personal data: the archive is for your own local use.
  `export-json` leaves names out unless you pass `--names`.
- If your Desktop syncs to OneDrive, the archive leaves the machine: `run`, `status` and the
  tray warn about it; move the data with `chatimport set-root`.
- Logs carry ids and counts, never message text, names or invite links.

See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## Development

```bash
just setup        # uv sync + pre-commit hook
just doctor       # read-only toolchain check
just check        # lint, pyright strict, tests, rules sync, language
```

"""Repository language policy: everything tracked by git is English.

Fails on any Cyrillic character in a tracked or new (not ignored) text file, except under
``ALLOWED_PREFIXES``: data that is Russian or Spanish by nature (anonymized test fixtures).
Code that reads that data stays English.

Usage: uv run python scripts/check_language.py
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent

ALLOWED_PREFIXES: tuple[str, ...] = ("tests/fixtures/", "src/chatimport/gui/locales/")
BINARY_SUFFIXES = frozenset(
    {".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".gif", ".ico", ".pdf", ".zip", ".gz", ".woff", ".woff2", ".db"}
)
CYRILLIC = re.compile("[\u0400-\u052f\u1c80-\u1c8f\u2de0-\u2dff\ua640-\ua69f]")


def candidate_files(root: Path) -> list[str]:
    output = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "ls-files", "-z", "--cached", "--others", "--exclude-standard"],  # noqa: S607
        cwd=root,
        capture_output=True,
        check=True,
    ).stdout.decode("utf-8")
    return sorted({f for f in output.split("\0") if f})


def is_checked(path: str) -> bool:
    return (
        not path.startswith(ALLOWED_PREFIXES) and Path(path).suffix.lower() not in BINARY_SUFFIXES
    )


def find_hits(root: Path, files: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    hits: list[str] = []
    for rel in filter(is_checked, files):
        try:
            text = (root / rel).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        except UnicodeDecodeError, FileNotFoundError, IsADirectoryError, PermissionError:
            continue
        hits += [
            f"{rel}:{number}"
            for number, line in enumerate(text.split(chr(10)), start=1)
            if CYRILLIC.search(line)
        ]
    return hits


def main(root: Path = ROOT) -> int:
    files = candidate_files(root)
    hits = find_hits(root, files)
    if hits:
        listing = "\n  ".join(hits[:50])
        more = f"\n  ... and {len(hits) - 50} more" if len(hits) > 50 else ""
        sys.stderr.write(f"ERR non-English (Cyrillic) text in tracked files:\n  {listing}{more}\n")
        return 1
    sys.stdout.write(f"ok  language: {len(files)} files, English only\n")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Read-only toolchain check: is this machine ready to develop ChatImport?

Usage: python scripts/doctor.py   (stdlib only, runs before `uv sync`)
Exit code 1 when a required tool is missing; optional tools only warn.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Check:
    name: str
    command: tuple[str, ...]
    required: bool
    hint: str


CHECKS: tuple[Check, ...] = (
    Check("git", ("git", "--version"), True, "https://git-scm.com/downloads"),
    Check("uv", ("uv", "--version"), True, "winget install astral-sh.uv"),
    Check(
        "python 3.14 (uv)",
        ("uv", "python", "find", "3.14"),
        True,
        "uv python install 3.14",
    ),
    Check("just", ("just", "--version"), True, "winget install Casey.Just"),
    Check("gh (GitHub CLI)", ("gh", "--version"), False, "winget install GitHub.cli"),
)


def run(command: tuple[str, ...]) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    if shutil.which(command[0]) is None:
        return False, "not found on PATH"
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(  # noqa: S603 — fixed argv from CHECKS, no shell
            command, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30, check=False
        )
    except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as error:
        return False, str(error)
    output = (result.stdout or result.stderr).strip().splitlines()
    return result.returncode == 0, output[0] if output else ""


def repo_state() -> list[tuple[bool, bool, str, str]]:
    """(ok, required, name, detail) for things that live in the clone, not on PATH."""
    hook = ROOT / ".git" / "hooks" / "pre-commit"
    return [
        (
            (ROOT / ".venv").is_dir(),
            True,
            ".venv",
            "present" if (ROOT / ".venv").is_dir() else "run: uv sync",
        ),
        (
            hook.is_file(),
            True,
            "pre-commit hook",
            "installed" if hook.is_file() else "run: uv run pre-commit install",
        ),
    ]


def main() -> int:
    failed = False
    rows: list[tuple[bool, bool, str, str]] = []
    for check in CHECKS:
        ok, detail = run(check.command)
        rows.append((ok, check.required, check.name, detail if ok else f"{detail} -> {check.hint}"))
    rows += repo_state()
    for ok, required, name, detail in rows:
        mark = "ok  " if ok else ("ERR " if required else "warn")
        failed |= required and not ok
        sys.stdout.write(f"{mark} {name:<18} {detail}\n")
    sys.stdout.write("\nready to develop\n" if not failed else "\nfix the ERR lines above\n")
    return 1 if failed else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Keep every AI assistant on one rule set.

Sources of truth:
    .ai/universal/*.md, .ai/project/*.md   rule modules (CLAUDE.md imports them natively)
    .claude/agents/*.md                     project subagents
    .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md          project skills
Generated here (never edit by hand):
    AGENTS.md                               rule modules assembled for Codex and other tools
    .codex/agents/<name>.toml               Codex mirror of .claude/agents
    .codex/skills/<name>/SKILL.md           Codex mirror of .claude/skills

Usage: uv run python scripts/sync_agents.py [--check]
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import re
import sys
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
# Codex reads at most 32 KiB of project instructions; failing here names the problem
# instead of letting rules be truncated silently.
BUDGET_KIB = 30.0
TIER_MARKER = "tier: extended"
ESSENCE_PREFIX = "> **Essence.**"
GROUPS = ("universal", "project")
GENERATED_DIRS = (".codex/agents", ".codex/skills")
SYNC_COMMAND = "just agents"

BANNER = f"""<!--
GENERATED FILE - DO NOT EDIT.
Source of truth: .ai/universal/*.md and .ai/project/*.md.
Edit a module, then run: {SYNC_COMMAND}
-->

# ChatImport - working notes for Codex and other AI assistants

This file is the entry point for Codex and any tool that reads AGENTS.md. It is assembled
from the shared rule modules in `.ai/`, so every assistant follows identical rules. Later
sections override earlier ones; an explicit owner instruction in the current conversation
overrides everything. Start every task with the orientation ritual in the progress module."""

EXTENDED_INDEX_HEADER = (
    "<!-- module index: extended -->\n\n"
    "# Modules loaded on demand\n\n"
    "These rules bind exactly like the inlined ones; only their full text lives\n"
    "outside this file, to stay within the instruction budget. Read the file itself\n"
    "when a task touches it — that is an obligation, not a suggestion.\n"
)

_FRONTMATTER = re.compile(r"\A---\n(.*?)\n---\n(.*)\Z", re.DOTALL)


_SAFE_NAME = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*")


class SyncError(RuntimeError):
    pass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Module:
    path: str
    body: str

    @property
    def is_extended(self) -> bool:
        return any(TIER_MARKER in line for line in self.body.splitlines()[:5])

    @property
    def title(self) -> str:
        for line in self.body.splitlines():
            if line.startswith("# "):
                return line[2:].strip()
        return "(untitled module)"

    @property
    def essence(self) -> str | None:
        for line in self.body.splitlines():
            stripped = line.strip()
            if stripped.startswith(ESSENCE_PREFIX):
                return stripped[len(ESSENCE_PREFIX) :].strip()
        return None


def read(path: Path) -> str:
    return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").replace("\r\n", "\n")


def collect_modules(root: Path) -> list[Module]:
    modules: list[Module] = []
    for group in GROUPS:
        directory = root / ".ai" / group
        if not directory.is_dir():
            raise SyncError(f"missing module directory: {directory}")
        for path in sorted(directory.glob("*.md"), key=lambda p: p.name):
            modules.append(Module(f".ai/{group}/{path.name}", read(path).strip()))
    if not modules:
        raise SyncError("no rule modules found under .ai/")
    return modules


def render_agents_md(modules: list[Module]) -> str:
    sections = [BANNER]
    sections += [f"<!-- module: {m.path} -->\n\n{m.body}" for m in modules if not m.is_extended]
    extended = [m for m in modules if m.is_extended]
    if extended:
        index = EXTENDED_INDEX_HEADER
        for m in extended:
            index += f"\n## {m.title}\n\nFile: `{m.path}`\n"
            if m.essence:
                index += f"\n{m.essence}\n"
        sections.append(index.rstrip())
    return "\n\n---\n\n".join(sections) + "\n"


def parse_frontmatter(text: str, name: str) -> tuple[dict[str, str], str]:
    match = _FRONTMATTER.match(text)
    if not match:
        raise SyncError(f"{name}: missing --- frontmatter ---")
    meta: dict[str, str] = {}
    for line in match.group(1).splitlines():
        key, sep, value = line.partition(":")
        if sep:
            meta[key.strip()] = value.strip()
    for key in ("name", "description"):
        if not meta.get(key):
            raise SyncError(f"{name}: frontmatter needs `{key}`")
    return meta, match.group(2).strip()


def render_codex_agent(source_name: str, text: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    meta, body = parse_frontmatter(text, source_name)
    if not _SAFE_NAME.fullmatch(meta["name"]):
        raise SyncError(f"{source_name}: agent name {meta['name']!r} is not a safe file name")
    if "'''" in body:
        raise SyncError(f"{source_name}: body must not contain '''")
    content = "\n".join(
        [
            f"# GENERATED from .claude/agents/{source_name} by {SYNC_COMMAND} - do not edit.",
            f"name = {json.dumps(meta['name'], ensure_ascii=False)}",
            f"description = {json.dumps(meta['description'], ensure_ascii=False)}",
            f"model_reasoning_effort = {json.dumps(meta.get('effort', 'high'))}",
            "developer_instructions = '''",
            body,
            "'''",
            "",
        ]
    )
    return f".codex/agents/{meta['name']}.toml", content


def render_codex_skill(skill: str, text: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    parse_frontmatter(text, f"{skill}/SKILL.md")
    marker = f"# GENERATED from .claude/skills/{skill}/SKILL.md by {SYNC_COMMAND} - do not edit.\n"
    return f".codex/skills/{skill}/SKILL.md", text.replace("---\n", "---\n" + marker, 1)


def build_outputs(root: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    outputs = {"AGENTS.md": render_agents_md(collect_modules(root))}
    for path in sorted((root / ".claude" / "agents").glob("*.md")):
        target, content = render_codex_agent(path.name, read(path))
        if target in outputs:
            raise SyncError(f"{path.name}: another agent already uses the name for {target}")
        outputs[target] = content
    skills_root = root / ".claude" / "skills"
    skill_dirs = (
        sorted(p for p in skills_root.iterdir() if p.is_dir()) if skills_root.is_dir() else []
    )
    for skill_dir in skill_dirs:
        skill_file = skill_dir / "SKILL.md"
        if not skill_file.is_file():
            raise SyncError(f"{skill_dir.name}: SKILL.md is missing")
        target, content = render_codex_skill(skill_dir.name, read(skill_file))
        outputs[target] = content
    return outputs


def size_kib(text: str) -> float:
    return len(text.encode("utf-8")) / 1024


def plan(root: Path, outputs: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
    """Return (paths whose content differs, generated paths that no longer have a source)."""
    changed = [
        rel
        for rel, content in outputs.items()
        if not (root / rel).is_file() or read(root / rel) != content
    ]
    existing = [
        p.relative_to(root).as_posix()
        for directory in GENERATED_DIRS
        if (root / directory).is_dir()
        for p in (root / directory).rglob("*")
        if p.is_file()
    ]
    stale = sorted(rel for rel in existing if rel not in outputs)
    return changed, stale


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None, root: Path = ROOT) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Regenerate or verify AGENTS.md and .codex/.")
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true", help="fail instead of rewriting")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    try:
        outputs = build_outputs(root)
    except SyncError as error:
        sys.stderr.write(f"ERR {error}\n")
        return 1

    kib = size_kib(outputs["AGENTS.md"])
    if kib > BUDGET_KIB:
        sys.stderr.write(
            f"ERR AGENTS.md would be {kib:.1f} KiB; the budget is {BUDGET_KIB:.0f} KiB. "
            "Tighten a module, or mark a situational one `<!-- tier: extended -->` "
            "with a `> **Essence.**` line.\n"
        )
        return 1

    changed, stale = plan(root, outputs)
    summary = f"AGENTS.md {kib:.1f} of {BUDGET_KIB:.0f} KiB, {len(outputs) - 1} mirrored files"
    if args.check:
        if changed or stale:
            listing = "\n  ".join([*changed, *stale])
            sys.stderr.write(
                f"ERR assistant files are out of sync. Run: {SYNC_COMMAND}\n  {listing}\n"
            )
            return 1
        sys.stdout.write(f"ok  assistants in sync ({summary})\n")
        return 0

    for rel in stale:
        (root / rel).unlink()
    for rel in changed:
        target = root / rel
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        target.write_text(outputs[rel], encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    sys.stdout.write(f"ok  synced {len(changed)}, removed {len(stale)} ({summary})\n")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

# Security

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue. Use a
[private report](https://github.com/dimbo1324/chatradar/security/advisories/new).
Expect an answer within a few days.

## What counts as a secret here

| What | Where it lives | Why it matters |
|---|---|---|
| `chatimport.session` (Telethon) | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\ChatImport\session\` | **full access to the Telegram account** |
| `api_id` / `api_hash` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\ChatImport\config.toml` | identify your application to Telegram |
| `chats.toml` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\ChatImport\` | which private groups you are in |
| the `ChatImport` folder | the Desktop by default | messages and sender names of chat members |
| `chatimport.log` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\ChatImport\logs\` | ids and counts only; never message text, names or invite links |
| exports | `<data root>\_exports\` | sender names only when exported with `--names` |

Protection: `.gitignore`, the pre-commit hook `forbid-secrets`, gitleaks locally and in CI,
and deny rules for AI assistants in `.claude/settings.json`.

If a session leaked: Telegram → Settings → Devices → terminate the session, then run
`chatimport login` again.

If the Desktop syncs to OneDrive, the archive leaves the machine: `run`, `status` and the
tray warn about it; move the data with `chatimport set-root <path> --move` or set
`output.root_dir` outside it.

Invite links in `chats.toml` are join tokens: the service shows them masked everywhere
else. Downloaded media with a risky extension get `.bin` appended and, on Windows, the
Mark-of-the-Web. On Linux and macOS the session, config and application folders are
owner-only.

"""ChatImport: local, reactive export of chosen Telegram groups and channels to JSONL."""

from importlib.metadata import PackageNotFoundError, version

try:
    __version__ = version("chatimport")
except PackageNotFoundError:  # pragma: no cover — running from sources without install
    __version__ = "0.0.0"

__all__ = ["__version__"]

"""Application wiring (spec §8.1): runs the service, follows the library and executes commands."""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import contextlib
import functools
import logging
import os
from dataclasses import replace
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, Final

from chatimport.commands import CommandResult, Handler, ServiceCommands, finish
from chatimport.config import load_config
from chatimport.config_edit import set_output_root
from chatimport.context import ServiceContext, build_gateway, load_context
from chatimport.control import COMMANDS, ControlServer, acquire_instance_lock
from chatimport.library import Library, LibraryChange, LibraryError, LibraryWatcher, load_library
from chatimport.paths import ROOT_ENV, normalize_root
from chatimport.ports import ChatImportError, SessionRevoked
from chatimport.resolution import (
    LIBRARY_ERROR,
    ActiveChats,
    ErrorBook,
    ResolvedEntry,
    resolve_entries,
    resolve_library,
    select_for_once,
    tracked_chat,
)
from chatimport.runtime import BackfillSlots, Level, SystemClock, SystemDiskUsage
from chatimport.service_runtime import ServiceRuntime, make_worker
from chatimport.setroot import move_root, validate_new_root
from chatimport.supervisor import Supervisor

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Awaitable, Iterable
    from pathlib import Path

    from chatimport.commands import SetRootArgs
    from chatimport.library import ChatEntry
    from chatimport.ports import ChatEvent, Clock, DiskUsage, TelegramGateway
    from chatimport.runtime import Notifier

__all__ = [
    "ChatImportApp",
    "ServiceContext",
    "build_gateway",
    "load_context",
    "resolve_entries",
    "resolve_library",
    "tracked_chat",
]

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

_RETRY_UNRESOLVED_SECONDS: Final = 600


class ChatImportApp:
    def __init__(
        self,
        ctx: ServiceContext,
        *,
        notifier: Notifier,
        gateway: TelegramGateway | None = None,
        clock: Clock | None = None,
        disk: DiskUsage | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._ctx = ctx
        self._config = ctx.config
        self._notifier = notifier
        self._clock: Clock = clock or SystemClock()
        self._disk: DiskUsage = disk or SystemDiskUsage()
        self._gateway = gateway
        self._service_state = "stopped"
        self._shutdown = asyncio.Event()
        self._early_shutdown = False
        self._loop: asyncio.AbstractEventLoop | None = None
        self._rt: ServiceRuntime | None = None
        self._core_watch: asyncio.Task[None] | None = None
        self._watcher = LibraryWatcher(ctx.library_file)
        self._errors = ErrorBook()
        self._chats = ActiveChats(self._errors)
        self._reconfig = asyncio.Lock()
        self._commands = ServiceCommands(self)

    @property
    def ctx(self) -> ServiceContext:
        return self._ctx

    @property
    def clock(self) -> Clock:
        return self._clock

    def runtime(self) -> ServiceRuntime:
        if self._rt is None:
            raise ChatImportError("the service is not running or is restarting")
        return self._rt

    def _runtime(self) -> ServiceRuntime:
        return self.runtime()

    def reload_config(self) -> None:
        config = load_config(self._ctx.paths.config_file)
        self._config = config
        self._ctx = replace(self._ctx, config=config)
        if self._rt is not None:
            self._rt.config = config

    def request_shutdown(self) -> None:
        self._early_shutdown = True
        loop = self._loop
        if loop is not None:
            with contextlib.suppress(RuntimeError):
                loop.call_soon_threadsafe(self._shutdown.set)

    def build_handlers(self) -> dict[str, Handler]:
        return {name: functools.partial(self.execute, name) for name in COMMANDS}

    async def execute(self, command: str, args: dict[str, Any]) -> CommandResult:
        return await self._commands.execute(command, args)

    async def run(self) -> None:
        lock = acquire_instance_lock(self._ctx.paths.lock_file)
        try:
            await self._serve()
        finally:
            lock.release()

    async def run_once(self, chat: str | None = None) -> None:
        gateway = self._gateway or build_gateway(self._ctx, self._clock)
        lock = acquire_instance_lock(self._ctx.paths.lock_file)
        try:
            await gateway.connect()
            library = load_library(self._ctx.library_file)
            if chat is None:
                results = await resolve_library(gateway, library)
            else:
                results = await select_for_once(gateway, library, chat)
            await self._sync_each(gateway, results)
        finally:
            with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
                await gateway.disconnect()
            lock.release()

    async def _sync_each(self, gateway: TelegramGateway, results: list[ResolvedEntry]) -> None:
        """Sync every resolved chat in turn; one failing chat does not stop the others."""
        slots = BackfillSlots(self._config.backfill.max_parallel_chats)
        failed: list[int] = []
        first = True
        for item in results:
            if not item.found:
                log.warning("library entry not resolved: %s", item.resolved.status.value)
                continue
            if not first:
                await self._clock.sleep(self._config.backfill.pause_between_chats_sec)
            first = False
            worker = make_worker(
                tracked_chat(*item),
                root=self._ctx.root,
                gateway=gateway,
                config=self._config,
                clock=self._clock,
                notifier=self._notifier,
                slots=slots,
            )
            try:
                await worker.sync_once()
            except SessionRevoked:
                raise
            except Exception:
                log.exception("chat sync failed", extra={"chat_id": worker.chat_id})
                failed.append(worker.chat_id)
        if failed:
            raise ChatImportError(f"sync failed for chats {', '.join(map(str, failed))}")

    async def _serve(self) -> None:
        self._loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
        if self._early_shutdown:
            self._shutdown.set()
        gateway = self._gateway or build_gateway(self._ctx, self._clock)
        self._gateway = gateway
        core = Supervisor(self._clock, self._notifier)
        self._service_state = "starting"
        try:
            await gateway.connect()
            gateway.add_event_handler(self._on_event)
            library = self._load_initial_library()
            self._absorb(await resolve_library(gateway, library))
            self._service_state = "running"
            self._start_runtime(self._ctx.root, gateway)
            server = ControlServer(
                self._ctx.paths.control_dir, self.build_handlers(), clock=self._clock
            )
            core.spawn("control", server.run)
            core.spawn("library", self._library_loop)
            self._core_watch = asyncio.create_task(self._watch_fatal(core))
            log.info("service running", extra={"chats": len(self._chats)})
            await self._shutdown.wait()
        finally:
            await self._teardown(core)
            with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
                await gateway.disconnect()

    async def _teardown(self, core: Supervisor) -> None:
        """Every step runs even when an earlier one fails: the gateway must disconnect and the
        lock must be released however the shutdown goes."""
        self._service_state = "stopping"
        await self._teardown_step("control tasks", core.stop_all())
        if self._core_watch is not None:
            self._core_watch.cancel()
        rt = await self._teardown_step("runtime", self._stop_runtime())
        self._service_state = "stopped"
        if rt is not None:
            await self._teardown_step("final status", rt.status.write())
        log.info("service stopped")

    @staticmethod
    async def _teardown_step[T](name: str, step: Awaitable[T]) -> T | None:
        try:
            return await step
        except Exception:
            log.exception("shutdown step failed: %s", name)
            return None

    async def _watch_fatal(self, supervisor: Supervisor) -> None:
        await supervisor.wait_fatal()
        log.error("fatal task failure, shutting down")
        self._shutdown.set()

    async def _on_event(self, event: ChatEvent) -> None:
        rt = self._rt
        if rt is not None:
            await rt.router.handle(event)

    def _load_initial_library(self) -> Library:
        try:
            return self._watcher.load_initial()
        except LibraryError as error:
            self._errors.set(LIBRARY_ERROR, str(error))
            self._notifier.notify(Level.ERROR, "Library", "chats.toml is invalid; fix the file")
            return Library()

    def _absorb(self, results: list[ResolvedEntry]) -> list[ResolvedEntry]:
        absorbed = self._chats.absorb(results)
        if absorbed.failed:
            self._notifier.notify(
                Level.WARNING,
                "Library",
                f"{absorbed.failed} of {absorbed.total} chats could not be resolved",
            )
        return absorbed.found

    def _start_runtime(self, root: Path, gateway: TelegramGateway) -> None:
        rt = ServiceRuntime(
            root,
            config=self._config,
            gateway=gateway,
            clock=self._clock,
            notifier=self._notifier,
            disk=self._disk,
            errors=self._errors,
            service_state=lambda: self._service_state,
        )
        self._rt = rt
        rt.start(self._chats.entries(), on_fatal=self._shutdown.set)

    async def _stop_runtime(self) -> ServiceRuntime | None:
        rt = self._rt
        if rt is None:
            return None
        self._rt = None
        await rt.stop()
        return rt

    async def _library_loop(self) -> None:
        interval = self._config.library.reload_check_seconds
        waited = 0
        while True:
            await self._clock.sleep(interval)
            waited += interval
            change = self._watcher.check()
            if self._watcher.last_error is not None:
                self._errors.set(LIBRARY_ERROR, self._watcher.last_error)
            else:
                self._errors.clear(LIBRARY_ERROR)
            async with self._reconfig:
                rt = self.runtime()
                if change is not None:
                    await self._apply_change(rt, change)
                if waited >= _RETRY_UNRESOLVED_SECONDS and self._chats.has_unresolved:
                    waited = 0
                    await self._start_entries(
                        rt, self._chats.retry_candidates(self._watcher.current)
                    )

    async def _apply_change(self, rt: ServiceRuntime, change: LibraryChange) -> None:
        for entry in (*change.removed, *change.disabled):
            chat_id = self._chats.release(entry)
            if chat_id is not None:
                await rt.remove(chat_id)
        await self._start_entries(rt, (*change.added, *change.enabled))
        log.info(
            "library change applied",
            extra={
                "added": len(change.added),
                "removed": len(change.removed),
                "disabled": len(change.disabled),
                "enabled": len(change.enabled),
            },
        )

    async def _start_entries(self, rt: ServiceRuntime, entries: Iterable[ChatEntry]) -> None:
        pending = tuple(entries)
        if not pending:
            return
        rt.add(self._absorb(await resolve_entries(rt.gateway, pending)))

    async def change_root(self, args: SetRootArgs) -> CommandResult:
        new = normalize_root(args.path)
        async with self._reconfig:
            gateway = self.runtime().gateway
            old = self._ctx.root
            if new == old:
                return CommandResult(True, "the folder is unchanged")
            warnings = await asyncio.to_thread(
                validate_new_root, new, old, app_base=self._ctx.paths.base, move=args.move
            )
            await self._stop_runtime()
            moving = asyncio.ensure_future(move_root(old, new, move=args.move))
            try:
                await finish(moving)
            except asyncio.CancelledError:
                if not moving.cancelled() and moving.exception() is None:
                    self._remember_root_on_stop(new)
                raise
            except Exception:
                self._start_runtime(old, gateway)
                raise
            try:
                set_output_root(self._ctx.paths.config_file, new)
            except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
                self._adopt_root(new, gateway)
                raise ChatImportError(
                    f"data is now in {new} but config.toml was not updated: {error}"
                ) from error
            self._adopt_root(new, gateway)
        if os.environ.get(ROOT_ENV):
            warnings.append(f"{ROOT_ENV} is set and overrides the saved folder on restart")
        if not args.move:
            warnings.append("the data was not moved; chats are fetched again into the new folder")
        return CommandResult(
            True, "; ".join([f"output folder is now {new}", *warnings]), {"path": str(new)}
        )

    def _remember_root_on_stop(self, new: Path) -> None:
        """The service is stopping, but the move finished: keep the data findable."""
        self._ctx = replace(self._ctx, root=new)
        try:
            set_output_root(self._ctx.paths.config_file, new)
        except OSError, ValueError:
            log.exception("config.toml was not updated after the data folder moved")

    def _adopt_root(self, new: Path, gateway: TelegramGateway) -> None:
        self._ctx = replace(self._ctx, root=new)
        self._start_runtime(new, gateway)

"""Start ChatImport at logon: one Task Scheduler task for the current user (Windows only).

The task needs no administrator rights: it runs in the owner's own session, one minute after
logon, with no execution time limit and also on battery. Other platforms report "unsupported".
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import contextlib
import getpass
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import StrEnum
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Final, Literal
from xml.sax.saxutils import escape

from chatimport.ports import ChatImportError

TASK_NAME: Final = "ChatImport"
LOGON_DELAY: Final = "PT1M"
MODULE_ARGUMENTS: Final = "-m chatimport window --hidden"
_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: Final = 30
_COMMAND_RE: Final = re.compile(r"<Command>(.*?)</Command>", re.DOTALL)
_ARGUMENTS_RE: Final = re.compile(r"<Arguments>(.*?)</Arguments>", re.DOTALL)
_SETTINGS_RE: Final = re.compile(r"<Settings>(.*?)</Settings>", re.DOTALL)
_DISABLED_RE: Final = re.compile(r"<Enabled>\s*false\s*</Enabled>")
_CREATE_NO_WINDOW: Final = 0x08000000
_NOT_FOUND_MARKERS: Final = ("0x80070002", "cannot find", "not exist")

type FailureReason = Literal["unsupported", "denied", "failed"]


class AutostartError(ChatImportError):
    """The task could not be read, created or removed; `reason` is for the interface."""

    def __init__(self, reason: FailureReason, message: str) -> None:
        super().__init__(message)
        self.reason: FailureReason = reason


class AutostartState(StrEnum):
    ENABLED = "enabled"
    DISABLED = "disabled"
    ABSENT = "absent"
    UNSUPPORTED = "unsupported"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class AutostartStatus:
    state: AutostartState
    command: str | None = None
    current: bool = True

    @property
    def enabled(self) -> bool:
        return self.state is AutostartState.ENABLED

    @property
    def supported(self) -> bool:
        return self.state is not AutostartState.UNSUPPORTED


def supported() -> bool:
    return sys.platform == "win32"


def launcher(executable: str | None = None) -> str:
    """`pythonw.exe` next to the running interpreter (no console window), else the interpreter."""
    python = Path(executable or sys.executable)
    windowless = python.with_name("pythonw.exe")
    return str(windowless if windowless.is_file() else python)


def task_command(executable: str | None = None) -> tuple[str, str]:
    """The program and its arguments the task runs."""
    return launcher(executable), MODULE_ARGUMENTS


def build_task_xml(program: str, arguments: str, user: str) -> str:
    owner = escape(user)
    return f"""<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?>
<Task version="1.2" xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/windows/2004/02/mit/task">
  <RegistrationInfo>
    <Description>Starts the ChatImport archive window when you log on.</Description>
  </RegistrationInfo>
  <Triggers>
    <LogonTrigger>
      <Enabled>true</Enabled>
      <UserId>{owner}</UserId>
      <Delay>{LOGON_DELAY}</Delay>
    </LogonTrigger>
  </Triggers>
  <Principals>
    <Principal id="Author">
      <UserId>{owner}</UserId>
      <LogonType>InteractiveToken</LogonType>
      <RunLevel>LeastPrivilege</RunLevel>
    </Principal>
  </Principals>
  <Settings>
    <MultipleInstancesPolicy>IgnoreNew</MultipleInstancesPolicy>
    <DisallowStartIfOnBatteries>false</DisallowStartIfOnBatteries>
    <StopIfGoingOnBatteries>false</StopIfGoingOnBatteries>
    <AllowHardTerminate>true</AllowHardTerminate>
    <StartWhenAvailable>false</StartWhenAvailable>
    <RunOnlyIfNetworkAvailable>false</RunOnlyIfNetworkAvailable>
    <AllowStartOnDemand>true</AllowStartOnDemand>
    <Enabled>true</Enabled>
    <Hidden>false</Hidden>
    <ExecutionTimeLimit>PT0S</ExecutionTimeLimit>
    <Priority>7</Priority>
  </Settings>
  <Actions Context="Author">
    <Exec>
      <Command>{escape(f'"{program}"')}</Command>
      <Arguments>{escape(arguments)}</Arguments>
    </Exec>
  </Actions>
</Task>
"""


def _current_user() -> str:
    domain = os.environ.get("USERDOMAIN", "")
    name = getpass.getuser()
    return f"{domain}\\{name}" if domain else name


def _schtasks(*args: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes]:
    try:
        return subprocess.run(  # noqa: S603 - fixed argv, no shell, task name is ours
            ["schtasks", *args],  # noqa: S607 - resolved from the system path on Windows
            capture_output=True,
            check=False,
            timeout=_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
            creationflags=_CREATE_NO_WINDOW,
        )
    except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as error:
        raise AutostartError("failed", f"schtasks did not run: {type(error).__name__}") from error


def _text(raw: bytes) -> str:
    for encoding in ("utf-8-sig", "utf-16"):
        with contextlib.suppress(UnicodeError):
            return raw.decode(encoding)
    return raw.decode("cp1252", errors="replace")


def _failure(result: subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes]) -> AutostartError:
    detail = _text(result.stderr or result.stdout).strip()
    lowered = detail.lower()
    reason: FailureReason = "denied" if "access is denied" in lowered else "failed"
    return AutostartError(reason, f"schtasks exit code {result.returncode}: {detail[:200]}")


def _is_absent(result: subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes]) -> bool:
    detail = _text(result.stderr or result.stdout).lower()
    if any(marker in detail for marker in _NOT_FOUND_MARKERS):
        return True
    return result.returncode == 1 and "denied" not in detail


def status(task_name: str = TASK_NAME, *, executable: str | None = None) -> AutostartStatus:
    """The current state of the task; `current` is False when it points somewhere else."""
    if not supported():
        return AutostartStatus(AutostartState.UNSUPPORTED)
    result = _schtasks("/Query", "/TN", task_name, "/XML")
    if result.returncode != 0:
        if _is_absent(result):
            return AutostartStatus(AutostartState.ABSENT)
        raise _failure(result)
    xml = _text(result.stdout)
    command = _COMMAND_RE.search(xml)
    arguments = _ARGUMENTS_RE.search(xml)
    program = (command.group(1).strip().strip('"') if command else "").replace("&amp;", "&")
    args = (arguments.group(1).strip() if arguments else "").replace("&amp;", "&")
    expected_program, expected_args = task_command(executable)
    current = Path(program).resolve() == Path(expected_program).resolve() and (
        args == expected_args
    )
    settings = _SETTINGS_RE.search(xml)
    off = settings is not None and _DISABLED_RE.search(settings.group(1)) is not None
    state = AutostartState.DISABLED if off else AutostartState.ENABLED
    return AutostartStatus(state, f"{program} {args}".strip(), current)


def enable(task_name: str = TASK_NAME, *, executable: str | None = None) -> AutostartStatus:
    """Create or replace the task."""
    if not supported():
        raise AutostartError("unsupported", "autostart is available on Windows only")
    program, arguments = task_command(executable)
    xml = build_task_xml(program, arguments, _current_user())
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="chatimport-task-") as folder:
        definition = Path(folder) / "task.xml"
        definition.write_bytes(b"\xff\xfe" + xml.encode("utf-16-le"))
        result = _schtasks("/Create", "/TN", task_name, "/XML", str(definition), "/F")
    if result.returncode != 0:
        raise _failure(result)
    return status(task_name, executable=executable)


def disable(task_name: str = TASK_NAME) -> AutostartStatus:
    """Delete the task; deleting a task that does not exist succeeds."""
    if not supported():
        raise AutostartError("unsupported", "autostart is available on Windows only")
    if status(task_name).state is AutostartState.ABSENT:
        return AutostartStatus(AutostartState.ABSENT)
    result = _schtasks("/Delete", "/TN", task_name, "/F")
    if result.returncode != 0:
        raise _failure(result)
    return AutostartStatus(AutostartState.ABSENT)

"""CLI entry point. Commands are thin wrappers; logic lives in the service modules.

The commands live in `cli_chats`, `cli_service` and `cli_data`; importing them registers them
on `app`.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import io
import os
import sys
from typing import Annotated

import typer

from chatimport import __version__, cli_chats, cli_data, cli_service
from chatimport.cli_support import app
from chatimport.cli_support import instance_lock as _instance_lock

__all__ = ["_instance_lock", "app", "cli_chats", "cli_data", "cli_service", "main", "run"]

ENCODING_ENV = "PYTHONIOENCODING"


def _version_callback(value: bool) -> None:
    if value:
        typer.echo(__version__)
        raise typer.Exit


@app.callback()
def main(
    context: typer.Context,
    version: Annotated[
        bool,
        typer.Option("--version", callback=_version_callback, is_eager=True, help="Version."),
    ] = False,
    root: Annotated[
        str | None,
        typer.Option("--root", help="Output folder for this run (overrides config and env)."),
    ] = None,
) -> None:
    """Export Telegram chats to local JSONL files."""
    context.obj = root


def _use_utf8_streams() -> None:
    """UTF-8 stdout/stderr even on cp1252 consoles, so Rich help cannot crash; an explicit
    `PYTHONIOENCODING` (for example cp866 for a PowerShell 5.1 pipe) is the user's choice."""
    if os.environ.get(ENCODING_ENV):
        return
    for stream in (sys.stdout, sys.stderr):
        if isinstance(stream, io.TextIOWrapper) and stream.encoding.lower() != "utf-8":
            stream.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")


def run() -> None:
    """`chatimport` entry point."""
    _use_utf8_streams()
    app()

"""CLI commands for the account and the chat library: login, dialogs and `chats`."""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import logging
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Annotated

import typer

from chatimport.cli_support import (
    app,
    chats_app,
    handled,
    instance_lock,
    library_file,
    load,
    require_telegram,
    table,
)
from chatimport.library import Library, add_entry, load_library, set_enabled
from chatimport.ports import ResolveStatus
from chatimport.runtime import SystemClock
from chatimport.storage.layout import find_chat_folder
from chatimport.storage.state import StateUnreadable, load_state

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Callable, Sequence
    from pathlib import Path

    from chatimport.library import ChatEntry
    from chatimport.ports import ResolvedChat

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

LIBRARY_HEADER = ("NAME", "REF", "STATUS", "CHAT_ID", "TITLE", "RECORDS")


def records_on_disk(root: Path, chat_id: int) -> int | None:
    """Stored records of one chat; None when nothing is stored or the state cannot be read."""
    folder = find_chat_folder(root, chat_id)
    if folder is None:
        return None
    try:
        state = load_state(folder)
    except StateUnreadable:
        log.warning("state.json is unreadable right now", extra={"chat_id": chat_id})
        return None
    return None if state is None else state.total_records


def library_rows(
    library: Library,
    resolved: Sequence[tuple[ChatEntry, ResolvedChat]],
    records_of: Callable[[int], int | None],
) -> list[tuple[str, ...]]:
    """One row per library entry; entries that were not resolved are shown as disabled."""
    rows: list[tuple[str, ...]] = []
    for entry, chat in resolved:
        status = chat.status.value if entry.enabled else "disabled"
        found = chat.status is ResolveStatus.FOUND and chat.chat_id is not None
        records = records_of(chat.chat_id) if found and chat.chat_id else None
        rows.append(
            (
                entry.name or entry.ref,
                entry.ref,
                status,
                "" if chat.chat_id is None else str(chat.chat_id),
                chat.title or "",
                "" if records is None else str(records),
            )
        )
    listed = {entry.key for entry, _ in resolved}
    rows.extend(
        (entry.name or entry.ref, entry.ref, "disabled", "", "", "")
        for entry in library.entries
        if entry.key not in listed
    )
    return rows

@app.command()

def _check_pct(value: int) -> int:
    if value not in TRIM_CHOICES:
        raise typer.BadParameter(f"must be one of {', '.join(map(str, TRIM_CHOICES))}")
    return value


def _echo_trim(report: TrimReport) -> None:
    typer.echo(
        f"Deleted {len(report.deleted_parts)} parts, {report.trimmed_records} records, "
        f"freed {report.freed_bytes / MB:.1f} MB"
    )


@app.command()
def trim(
    context: typer.Context,
    pct: Annotated[
        int, typer.Argument(callback=_check_pct, help="Share of the oldest history: 25, 50 or 75.")
    ],
    chat: ChatOption = None,
    yes: YesOption = False,
) -> None:
    """Delete the oldest share of the stored history."""
    from chatimport.offline import offline_trim, resolve_chat_selector

    with handled():
        ctx = load(context)
        scope = chat or "every chat"
        confirm(f"Delete the oldest {pct}% of the history of {scope}? This cannot be undone", yes)
        if running(ctx):
            result = send(ctx, "trim", {"pct": pct, "chat": chat})
            typer.echo(result.message or "Trim done")
            return
        with instance_lock(ctx):
            chat_id = None if chat is None else resolve_chat_selector(ctx, chat)
            _echo_trim(asyncio.run(offline_trim(ctx, pct, chat_id)))


@app.command()
def backfill(

        bool, typer.Option("--deeper", help="Lower the history floor and fetch older messages.")
    ] = False,
    chat: ChatOption = None,

    """Fetch older history than the current floor."""
    from chatimport.offline import lower_floor, resolve_chat_selector

    with handled():

        ctx = load(context)
        if running(ctx):

            lowered = lower_floor(ctx.root, chat_id)
        typer.echo(

        )


@app.command()
def check(
    context: typer.Context,
    repair: Annotated[bool, typer.Option("--repair", help="Fix what can be fixed.")] = False,
) -> None:
    """Check the integrity of the stored files and state.json."""
    from chatimport.integrity import check_root

    with handled():
        ctx = load(context)
        if running(ctx):
            typer.echo(send(ctx, "check", {"repair": repair}).message or "Check done")
            return
        with instance_lock(ctx):
            issues = check_root(ctx.root, repair=repair, now=datetime.now(UTC))
        for issue in issues:
            where = issue.folder if issue.chat_id is None else f"{issue.chat_id} {issue.folder}"
            typer.echo(f"[{issue.severity}] {where}: {issue.message}")
        if not issues:
            typer.echo("No problems found")
        if any(issue.severity == "error" for issue in issues):
            raise typer.Exit(EXIT_ERROR)

@app.command("export-all")

@app.command("set-root")
def set_root(
    context: typer.Context,
    path: Annotated[str, typer.Argument(help="New output folder.")],
    move: Annotated[bool, typer.Option("--move", help="Move the existing data there.")] = False,
    yes: YesOption = False,
) -> None:
    """Change the output folder."""
    from chatimport.config_edit import set_output_root
    from chatimport.setroot import move_root, validate_new_root

    with handled():
        ctx = load(context)
        new = normalize_root(path)
        for warning in validate_new_root(new, ctx.root, app_base=ctx.paths.base, move=move):
            warn(warning)
        if not move:
            confirm(
                f"Without --move the data in {ctx.root} stays there and chats are refetched "
                f"into {new}. Continue",
                yes,
            )
        if running(ctx):
            result = send(ctx, "set_root", {"path": str(new), "move": move})
            typer.echo(result.message or f"Output folder is now {new}")
            return
        with instance_lock(ctx):
            if move:
                asyncio.run(move_root(ctx.root, new, move=True))
            set_output_root(ctx.paths.config_file, new)
        typer.echo(f"Output folder is now {new}")


def _when(text: str, option: str, *, whole_day: bool) -> datetime:
    value = text.strip()
    try:
        moment = datetime.fromisoformat(value)
    except ValueError:
        fail(
            f"{option} must be a date like 2026-10-31 or a moment like 2026-10-31T12:00:00Z",
            EXIT_NOT_CONFIGURED,
        )
    moment = moment.replace(tzinfo=UTC) if moment.tzinfo is None else moment.astimezone(UTC)
    if whole_day and len(value) <= _DATE_ONLY_LENGTH:
        moment += timedelta(days=1)
    return moment


def _one_line(text: str) -> str:
    return "\\n".join(text.splitlines())


def _hit_line(hit: SearchHit) -> str:
    from chatimport.records import format_dt

    return (
        f"{_one_line(hit.chat_title)} | {format_dt(hit.date)} | {hit.link or '-'} | "
        f"{_one_line(hit.text)}"
    )


@app.command()
def search(
    context: typer.Context,
    text: Annotated[str, typer.Argument(help="Text to find; case, accents and yo do not matter.")],
    chat: ChatOption = None,
    since: Annotated[
        str | None, typer.Option("--since", help="Only messages from this UTC date or moment.")
    ] = None,
    until: Annotated[
        str | None,
        typer.Option(
            "--until",
            help="Only messages before this UTC moment; a plain date includes that whole day.",
        ),
    ] = None,
    limit: Annotated[
        int,
        typer.Option("--limit", min=1, max=SEARCH_MAX_LIMIT, help="How many matches to print."),
    ] = SEARCH_DEFAULT_LIMIT,
) -> None:
    """Search every stored message (newest first); reads the index, works while the service runs."""
    from chatimport.offline import resolve_chat_selector
    from chatimport.search_index import open_reader
    from chatimport.search_types import IndexState, SearchQuery

    with handled():
        since_at = None if since is None else _when(since, "--since", whole_day=False)
        until_at = None if until is None else _when(until, "--until", whole_day=True)
        ctx = load(context)
        chat_ids = None if chat is None else frozenset({resolve_chat_selector(ctx, chat)})
        backend = open_reader(ctx.root)
        if backend is None:
            if not ctx.config.search.enabled:
                fail("search is turned off: set enabled = true in the [search] section")
            fail(
                "there is no search index yet: start the service (`chatimport run` or "
                "`chatimport window`) and give it a moment to build one"
            )
        try:
            status = backend.status()
            if status.state is IndexState.BUILDING:
                warn(
                    f"the index is still being built ({status.indexed} of {status.total} "
                    "messages); results may be incomplete"
                )
            page = backend.search(SearchQuery(text, chat_ids, since_at, until_at, limit))
        finally:
            backend.close()
        for hit in page.hits:
            typer.echo(_hit_line(hit))
        typer.echo(f"{len(page.hits)} of {page.total} matches" if page.total else "No matches")

"""CLI commands that run or steer the service: run, tray, window, status, pause, resume, recheck."""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
from typing import Annotated

    ChatOption,

@app.command("run")
def run_service(
    context: typer.Context,
    once: Annotated[bool, typer.Option("--once", help="Backfill or catch up, then exit.")] = False,
    chat: ChatOption = None,
) -> None:
    """Run the service in this console."""
    from chatimport.app import ChatImportApp
    from chatimport.runtime import LogNotifier

    with handled():
        ctx = load(context)
        require_telegram(ctx)
        refuse_second_instance(ctx)
        configure_logging(ctx.paths.log_dir, console=True)
        warn_if_cloud_synced(ctx.root)
        service = ChatImportApp(ctx, notifier=LogNotifier())
        if once:
            asyncio.run(service.run_once(chat))
        else:
            asyncio.run(service.run())


@app.command()
def window(
    context: typer.Context,
    hidden: Annotated[
        bool, typer.Option("--hidden", help="Start in the tray without opening the window.")
    ] = False,
) -> None:
    """Run the service with the desktop window (and a tray icon).

    The window opens without Telegram credentials: it asks for them in Settings.
    """
    from chatimport.gui.launch import run_gui

    with handled():
        ctx = load(context)
        refuse_second_instance(ctx)
        code = run_gui(ctx, start_hidden=hidden)
    if code:
        raise typer.Exit(code)


@app.command()
def status(context: typer.Context) -> None:
    """Show the service status."""
    with handled():
        ctx = load(context)
        warn_if_cloud_synced(ctx.root)
        if running(ctx):
            data = send(ctx, "status").data
        else:
            if not (ctx.root / STATUS_FILE).is_file():
                fail("the service is not running and there is no status snapshot yet")
            snapshot = read_snapshot(ctx.root)
            if snapshot is None:
                fail(f"the status snapshot {ctx.root / STATUS_FILE} is unreadable")
            data = {**snapshot, "service": "stopped"}
            typer.echo(f"The service is not running (last snapshot {data.get('updated_at')}).")
        for line in [*format_status_lines(data), *format_chat_lines(data)]:
            typer.echo(line)

"""The Typer apps and the helpers every CLI command module shares."""

from __future__ import annotations

from contextlib import contextmanager
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Annotated, Any, Final, NoReturn

import typer
from rich.cells import cell_len

from chatimport.config import MIB, ConfigError
from chatimport.control import (
    AlreadyRunning,
    CommandResult,
    acquire_instance_lock,
    send_command,
    service_running,
)
from chatimport.library import LibraryError
from chatimport.paths import cloud_sync_warning, library_path

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Generator
    from pathlib import Path

    from chatimport.app import ServiceContext

TRIM_CHOICES: Final = ALLOWED_PERCENTS
MB: Final = MIB
EXIT_ERROR: Final = 1
EXIT_NOT_CONFIGURED: Final = 2

app = typer.Typer(
    name="chatimport",
    no_args_is_help=True,
    help="ChatImport — local export of Telegram chats to JSONL.",
)
chats_app = typer.Typer(no_args_is_help=True, help="Manage the chat library.")
app.add_typer(chats_app, name="chats")

ChatOption = Annotated[
    str | None,
    typer.Option("--chat", help="Chat name, @username, link or numeric id."),
]
YesOption = Annotated[bool, typer.Option("--yes", help="Do not ask for confirmation.")]


@contextmanager
def handled() -> Generator[None]:
    try:
        yield
    except (AlreadyRunning, ChatImportError, ConfigError, LibraryError, TimeoutError) as exc:
        fail(str(exc))
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        typer.secho("interrupted", err=True)
        raise typer.Exit(EXIT_ERROR) from None


def fail(message: str, code: int = EXIT_ERROR) -> NoReturn:
    typer.secho(message, fg=typer.colors.RED, err=True)
    raise typer.Exit(code)


def warn(message: str) -> None:
    typer.secho(f"warning: {message}", fg=typer.colors.YELLOW, err=True)


def warn_if_cloud_synced(root: Path) -> None:
    warning = cloud_sync_warning(root)
    if warning is not None:
        warn(warning)


def load(context: typer.Context) -> ServiceContext:
    from chatimport.app import load_context

    root: str | None = context.obj
    return load_context(root)


def require_telegram(ctx: ServiceContext) -> None:
    if not ctx.config.telegram.is_configured:
        fail(
            f"Telegram api_id and api_hash are not set; edit {ctx.paths.config_file}",
            EXIT_NOT_CONFIGURED,
        )


@contextmanager
def instance_lock(ctx: ServiceContext) -> Generator[None]:
    lock = acquire_instance_lock(ctx.paths.lock_file)
    try:
        yield
    finally:
        lock.release()


def running(ctx: ServiceContext) -> bool:
    return service_running(ctx.paths.lock_file)


def refuse_second_instance(ctx: ServiceContext) -> None:
    if running(ctx):
        raise AlreadyRunning("another ChatImport instance is already running")


def send(ctx: ServiceContext, command: str, args: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> CommandResult:
    result = send_command(ctx.paths.control_dir, command, args)
    if not result.ok:
        fail(result.message or f"{command} failed")
    return result


def confirm(question: str, yes: bool) -> None:
    if not yes and not typer.confirm(question, default=False):
        fail("aborted")


def need_service(ctx: ServiceContext, what: str) -> None:
    if not running(ctx):
        fail(f"{what} needs the service: start it with `chatimport window` or `chatimport run`")


def library_file(ctx: ServiceContext) -> Path:
    return library_path(ctx.config.library.file, ctx.paths)


def table(rows: list[tuple[str, ...]]) -> None:
    """Columns padded by terminal cells, so emoji, wide letters and combining accents in titles
    do not shift the columns after them."""
    widths = [max(cell_len(row[i]) for row in rows) for i in range(len(rows[0]))]
    for row in rows:
        cells = (
            cell + " " * (width - cell_len(cell)) for cell, width in zip(row, widths, strict=True)
        )
        typer.echo("  ".join(cells).rstrip())

@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)

    ok: bool
    message: str = ""
    data: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict[str, Any])


type Handler = Callable[[dict[str, Any]], Awaitable[CommandResult]]
type ChatSelector = int | str | None


async def finish[T](task: asyncio.Future[T]) -> T:
    """Await `task`; if the caller is cancelled, wait for `task` to finish first and then
    re-raise. Work in a thread cannot be stopped, so locks and restarts must wait for it."""
    cancelled = False
    while not task.done():
        try:
            await asyncio.wait({task})
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            cancelled = True
    if cancelled:
        if not task.cancelled():
            task.exception()
        raise asyncio.CancelledError
    return task.result()


async def in_thread[**P, T](func: Callable[P, T], *args: P.args, **kwargs: P.kwargs) -> T:
    return await finish(asyncio.ensure_future(asyncio.to_thread(func, *args, **kwargs)))


def _whole_number(args: Mapping[str, Any], name: str) -> int | None:
    value = args.get(name)
    if value is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, str):
        with contextlib.suppress(ValueError):
            return int(value.strip())
    raise ChatImportError(f"{name} must be a whole number")


def _chat(args: Mapping[str, Any]) -> ChatSelector:
    value = args.get("chat")
    if value is None or value == "":
        return None
    if isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool):
        return value
    return str(value)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class NoArgs:

    def parse(cls, args: Mapping[str, Any]) -> Self:
        return cls()


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ChatArgs:
    chat: ChatSelector = None

    @classmethod
    def parse(cls, args: Mapping[str, Any]) -> Self:
        return cls(_chat(args))


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class TrimArgs:
    pct: int
    chat: ChatSelector = None

    @classmethod
    def parse(cls, args: Mapping[str, Any]) -> Self:
        pct = _whole_number(args, "pct")
        if pct is None:
            raise ChatImportError("pct is required")
        return cls(pct, _chat(args))


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class RecheckArgs:
    days: int | None = None
    chat: ChatSelector = None

    @classmethod
    def parse(cls, args: Mapping[str, Any]) -> Self:
        days = _whole_number(args, "days")
        if days is not None and days < 1:
            raise ChatImportError("days must be at least 1")
        return cls(days, _chat(args))


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class CheckArgs:
    repair: bool = False

    @classmethod
    def parse(cls, args: Mapping[str, Any]) -> Self:
        return cls(bool(args.get("repair", False)))


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ExportAllArgs:
    format: str | None = None
    names: bool | None = None

    @classmethod
    def parse(cls, args: Mapping[str, Any]) -> Self:
        fmt = args.get("format")
        if fmt is not None and fmt not in MERGED_FORMATS:
            raise ChatImportError(f"format must be one of {', '.join(MERGED_FORMATS)}")
        names = args.get("names")
        return cls(fmt, None if names is None else bool(names))


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SetRootArgs:
    path: str
    move: bool = False

    @classmethod
    def parse(cls, args: Mapping[str, Any]) -> Self:
        raw = args.get("path")
        if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.strip():
            raise ChatImportError("path is required")
        return cls(raw.strip(), bool(args.get("move", False)))


class ServiceHost(Protocol):
    """What the commands need from the running application."""

    @property
    def ctx(self) -> ServiceContext: ...

    @property
    def clock(self) -> Clock: ...

    def runtime(self) -> ServiceRuntime: ...

    def reload_config(self) -> None: ...

    def request_shutdown(self) -> None: ...

    async def change_root(self, args: SetRootArgs) -> CommandResult: ...


type _Method[A] = Callable[[ServiceCommands, A], Awaitable[CommandResult]]
type _Runner = Callable[[ServiceCommands, Mapping[str, Any]], Awaitable[CommandResult]]

_REGISTRY: dict[str, _Runner] = {}


def _command[A](
    name: str, parse: Callable[[Mapping[str, Any]], A]
) -> Callable[[_Method[A]], _Method[A]]:
    def register(method: _Method[A]) -> _Method[A]:
        async def run(commands: ServiceCommands, raw: Mapping[str, Any]) -> CommandResult:
            return await method(commands, parse(raw))

        _REGISTRY[name] = run
        return method

    return register


def _no_lock() -> AbstractAsyncContextManager[None]:
    return contextlib.nullcontext()


class ServiceCommands:
    def __init__(self, host: ServiceHost) -> None:
        self._host = host

    async def execute(self, name: str, args: Mapping[str, Any]) -> CommandResult:
        runner = _REGISTRY.get(name)
        if runner is None:
            return CommandResult(False, f"unknown command: {name!r}")
        try:
            return await runner(self, args)
        except ChatImportError as error:
            log.info("command %s refused: %s", name, error)
            return CommandResult(False, f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")
        except Exception as error:
            log.exception("command %s failed", name)
            return CommandResult(False, f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")

    def _chat_id(self, chat: ChatSelector) -> int | None:
        if chat is None or isinstance(chat, int):
            return chat
        return resolve_chat_selector(self._host.ctx, chat)

    def _targets(self, chat: ChatSelector) -> list[ChatController]:
        rt = self._host.runtime()
        chat_id = self._chat_id(chat)
        if chat_id is None:
            return rt.registry.all()
        controller = rt.registry.get(chat_id)
        if controller is None:
            raise ChatImportError("that chat is not tracked by the running service")
        return [controller]

    @_command("trim", TrimArgs.parse)
    async def trim(self, args: TrimArgs) -> CommandResult:
        rt = self._host.runtime()
        report = await rt.trimmer.trim_percent(args.pct, self._chat_id(args.chat))
        return CommandResult(
            True,
            f"trimmed {report.trimmed_records} records, freed {report.freed_bytes} bytes, "
            f"deleted {len(report.deleted_parts)} parts",
            {
                "records": report.trimmed_records,
                "bytes": report.freed_bytes,
                "parts": len(report.deleted_parts),
                "per_chat": {str(chat): count for chat, count in report.per_chat.items()},
            },
        )

    @_command("pause", ChatArgs.parse)
    async def pause(self, args: ChatArgs) -> CommandResult:
        targets = self._targets(args.chat)
        for controller in targets:
            controller.pause()
        return CommandResult(True, f"paused {len(targets)} chats")

    @_command("resume", ChatArgs.parse)
    async def resume(self, args: ChatArgs) -> CommandResult:
        targets = self._targets(args.chat)
        for controller in targets:
            controller.resume()
        return CommandResult(True, f"resumed {len(targets)} chats")

    @_command("recheck", RecheckArgs.parse)
    async def recheck(self, args: RecheckArgs) -> CommandResult:
        rt = self._host.runtime()
        count = await rt.scheduler.trigger_now(args.days, self._chat_id(args.chat))
        return CommandResult(True, f"recheck requested for {count} chats", {"chats": count})

    @_command("status", NoArgs.parse)
    async def status(self, args: NoArgs) -> CommandResult:
        data = self._host.runtime().status.build()
        return CommandResult(True, format_status_lines(data)[0], data)

    @_command("reload_config", NoArgs.parse)
    async def reload_config(self, args: NoArgs) -> CommandResult:
        self._host.reload_config()
        return CommandResult(True, "config reloaded; new chats use it, a restart applies the rest")

    @_command("set_root", SetRootArgs.parse)
    async def set_root(self, args: SetRootArgs) -> CommandResult:
        return await self._host.change_root(args)

    @_command("export_all", ExportAllArgs.parse)
    async def export_all(self, args: ExportAllArgs) -> CommandResult:
        result = await self._host.runtime().merged.build(args.format, args.names, force=True)
        return CommandResult(
            True, f"wrote {result.path} ({result.records} records)", result.to_dict()
        )

    @_command("shutdown", NoArgs.parse)
    async def shutdown(self, args: NoArgs) -> CommandResult:
        self._host.request_shutdown()
        return CommandResult(True, "shutting down")

    @_command("refetch", ChatArgs.parse)
    async def refetch(self, args: ChatArgs) -> CommandResult:
        targets = self._targets(args.chat)
        for controller in targets:
            controller.request_refetch()
        return CommandResult(True, f"refetch requested for {len(targets)} chats")

    @_command("deeper", ChatArgs.parse)
    async def deeper(self, args: ChatArgs) -> CommandResult:
        targets = self._targets(args.chat)
        now = self._host.clock.now()
        lowered = 0
        for controller in targets:
            async with controller.lock:
                try:
                    if await in_thread(lower_floor_state, controller.folder, now):
                        lowered += 1
                except StateUnreadable:
                    log.warning(
                        "state unreadable; floor kept", extra={"chat_id": controller.chat_id}
                    )
            controller.resume_backfill()
        return CommandResult(True, f"lowered the floor of {lowered} chats", {"chats": lowered})

    @_command("check", CheckArgs.parse)
    async def check(self, args: CheckArgs) -> CommandResult:
        rt = self._host.runtime()
        by_folder = {controller.folder.name: controller for controller in rt.registry.all()}
        now = self._host.clock.now()
        issues: list[CheckIssue] = []
        for folder in list(iter_chat_folders(rt.root)):
            controller = by_folder.get(folder.name)
            async with controller.lock if controller is not None else _no_lock():
                found = await in_thread(check_folder, folder, repair=args.repair, now=now)
            issues.extend(sorted(found, key=lambda issue: _SEVERITY_RANK.get(issue.severity, 3)))
        rows = [
            {
                "chat_id": issue.chat_id,
                "folder": issue.folder,
                "severity": issue.severity,
                "message": issue.message,
            }
            for issue in issues
        ]
        lines = [f"{row['severity']} {row['folder']}: {row['message']}" for row in rows]
        summary = f"{len(rows)} issue(s) found" if rows else "no issues found"
        return CommandResult(
            True, "\n".join([summary, *lines]), {"count": len(rows), "issues": rows}
        )


COMMANDS: Final = MappingProxyType(_REGISTRY)
COMMAND_NAMES: Final = tuple(_REGISTRY)

"""Typed configuration loaded from `config.toml`; an empty or missing file gives all defaults."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import tomllib
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, Final, get_type_hints

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pathlib import Path


MIB: Final = 1024 * 1024
GIB: Final = 1024 * MIB

MERGED_FORMATS: Final = ("json", "jsonl")

_DAILY_AT = re.compile(r"(?P<hour>[0-9]{1,2}):(?P<minute>[0-9]{2})")


class ConfigError(ValueError):
    """The configuration file is unreadable or holds an invalid value."""


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)

    api_id: int = 0
