@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Config:
    telegram: TelegramConfig = field(default_factory=TelegramConfig)
    output: OutputConfig = field(default_factory=OutputConfig)
    library: LibraryConfig = field(default_factory=LibraryConfig)
    recheck: RecheckConfig = field(default_factory=RecheckConfig)
    live: LiveConfig = field(default_factory=LiveConfig)
    backfill: BackfillConfig = field(default_factory=BackfillConfig)
    disk: DiskConfig = field(default_factory=DiskConfig)
    watch: WatchConfig = field(default_factory=WatchConfig)
    media: MediaConfig = field(default_factory=MediaConfig)
    events: EventsConfig = field(default_factory=EventsConfig)
    merged: MergedConfig = field(default_factory=MergedConfig)
    search: SearchConfig = field(default_factory=SearchConfig)


def _build[T](cls: type[T], raw: dict[str, Any], section: str) -> T:
    hints = get_type_hints(cls)
    unknown = sorted(set(raw) - set(hints))
    if unknown:
        raise ConfigError(f"[{section}] unknown keys: {', '.join(unknown)}")
    values: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for name, value in raw.items():
        expected = hints[name]
        if expected == tuple[str, ...]:
            items: list[Any] = value if isinstance(value, list) else []  # pyright: ignore[reportUnknownVariableType]
            if not isinstance(value, list) or not all(isinstance(v, str) for v in items):
                raise ConfigError(f"[{section}] {name} must be a list of strings")
            value = tuple(items)
        elif expected is float and isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool):
            value = float(value)
        elif not isinstance(value, expected) or (expected is int and isinstance(value, bool)):
            raise ConfigError(f"[{section}] {name} must be {expected.__name__}")
        values[name] = value
    return cls(**values)


_SECTIONS: dict[str, type[Any]] = {
    "telegram": TelegramConfig,
    "output": OutputConfig,
    "library": LibraryConfig,
    "recheck": RecheckConfig,
    "live": LiveConfig,
    "backfill": BackfillConfig,
    "disk": DiskConfig,
    "watch": WatchConfig,
    "media": MediaConfig,
    "events": EventsConfig,
    "merged": MergedConfig,
    "search": SearchConfig,
}


def parse_config(data: dict[str, Any]) -> Config:
    unknown = sorted(set(data) - set(_SECTIONS))
    if unknown:
        raise ConfigError(f"unknown sections: {', '.join(unknown)}")
    sections: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for name, cls in _SECTIONS.items():
        raw = data.get(name, {})
        if not isinstance(raw, dict):
            raise ConfigError(f"[{name}] must be a table")
        sections[name] = _build(cls, raw, name)  # pyright: ignore[reportUnknownArgumentType]
    config = Config(**sections)
    _validate(config)
    return config


def _validate(config: Config) -> None:
    if config.output.max_chunk_mb < 1:
        raise ConfigError("[output] max_chunk_mb must be at least 1")
    if config.live.flush_every_messages < 1 or config.live.flush_every_seconds < 1:
        raise ConfigError("[live] flush thresholds must be at least 1")
    if config.disk.high_watermark_gb <= config.disk.low_watermark_gb:
        raise ConfigError("[disk] high_watermark_gb must exceed low_watermark_gb")
    if config.watch.confirm_checks < 1:
        raise ConfigError("[watch] confirm_checks must be at least 1")
    if config.backfill.batch_size < 1 or config.backfill.max_parallel_chats < 1:
        raise ConfigError("[backfill] batch_size and max_parallel_chats must be at least 1")
    if config.recheck.days < 1:
        raise ConfigError("[recheck] days must be at least 1")
    match = _DAILY_AT.fullmatch(config.recheck.daily_at)
    if match is None or int(match["hour"]) > 23 or int(match["minute"]) > 59:
        raise ConfigError("[recheck] daily_at must look like HH:MM")
    intervals = {
        "[library] reload_check_seconds": config.library.reload_check_seconds,
        "[watch] check_every_seconds": config.watch.check_every_seconds,
        "[disk] check_every_minutes": config.disk.check_every_minutes,
        "[live] reconcile_every_minutes": config.live.reconcile_every_minutes,
        "[merged] every_minutes": config.merged.every_minutes,
        "[search] interval_seconds": config.search.interval_seconds,
    }
    for name, value in intervals.items():
        if value < 1:
            raise ConfigError(f"{name} must be at least 1")
    if config.merged.format not in MERGED_FORMATS:
        raise ConfigError('[merged] format must be "json" or "jsonl"')
    if config.backfill.pause_between_requests_sec < 0 or config.recheck.pause_between_chats_sec < 0:
        raise ConfigError("pauses must not be negative")
    if config.backfill.pause_between_chats_sec < 0:
        raise ConfigError("[backfill] pause_between_chats_sec must not be negative")


def load_config(path: Path) -> Config:
    """Read `config.toml`; a missing file means defaults."""
    if not path.exists():
        return Config()
    try:
        data = tomllib.loads(path.read_bytes().decode("utf-8-sig"))
    except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError, tomllib.TOMLDecodeError) as error:
        raise ConfigError(f"cannot read {path}: {error}") from error
    return parse_config(data)

"""Safe, comment-preserving edit of `config.toml`."""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
import re
import tomllib
from collections.abc import Mapping, Sequence
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Final

from chatimport.config import ConfigError, parse_config
from chatimport.storage.fileio import PRIVATE_FILE_MODE
from chatimport.toml_edit import TomlDocument, toml_string, write_validated

type ConfigValue = str | int | float | bool | Sequence[str]

_NAME_RE: Final = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*")


def _read(path: Path) -> str:
    if not path.exists():
        return ""
    try:
        return path.read_bytes().decode("utf-8-sig")
    except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError) as error:
        raise ConfigError(f"cannot read {path}: {error}") from error


def _literal(value: ConfigValue) -> str:
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "true" if value else "false"
    if isinstance(value, int):
        return str(value)
    if isinstance(value, float):
        if not math.isfinite(value):
            raise ConfigError("a number must be finite")
        return repr(value)
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return toml_string(value)
    return "[" + ", ".join(toml_string(item) for item in value) + "]"


def _header(section: str) -> re.Pattern[str]:
    if _NAME_RE.fullmatch(section) is None:
        raise ConfigError(f"invalid section name: {section!r}")
    return re.compile(rf"^\s*\[\s*{section}\s*\]\s*(#.*)?$")


def _edited(text: str, changes: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, ConfigValue]]) -> str:
    document = TomlDocument(text)
    for section, values in changes.items():
        if not values:
            continue
        literals = {key: _literal(value) for key, value in values.items()}
        for key in literals:
            if _NAME_RE.fullmatch(key) is None:
                raise ConfigError(f"invalid key name: {key!r}")
        tables = document.find_tables(_header(section))
        if not tables:
            document.append_block([f"[{section}]"])
            tables = document.find_tables(_header(section))
        for key, literal in literals.items():
            document.set_value(tables[0], key, literal)
    return document.text()


def _validate(path: Path, text: str) -> None:
    try:
        data = tomllib.loads(text)
    except tomllib.TOMLDecodeError as error:
        raise ConfigError(f"cannot update {path}: {error}") from error
    parse_config(data)


def update_config(
    config_file: Path | str, changes: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, ConfigValue]]
) -> None:
    """Set keys in sections of `config.toml`, keeping comments and every other setting.

    The result is parsed with `parse_config` before the atomic write, so an invalid value
    raises `ConfigError` and leaves the file as it was. The file holds the Telegram api_hash,
    so on POSIX it is written owner-only.
    """
    path = Path(config_file)
    write_validated(
        path,
        _edited(_read(path), changes),
        lambda text: _validate(path, text),
        mode=PRIVATE_FILE_MODE,
    )


def set_output_root(config_file: Path | str, root: Path | str) -> None:
    """Set `[output] root_dir`."""
    update_config(config_file, {"output": {"root_dir": str(root)}})

"""What the service needs to start: the loaded configuration, the folders and the gateway."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from chatimport.config import Config, load_config
from chatimport.paths import AppPaths, app_paths, library_path, resolve_root
from chatimport.ports import ChatImportError
from chatimport.telegram.client import TelethonGateway

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pathlib import Path

    from chatimport.ports import Clock


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ServiceContext:
    config: Config
    paths: AppPaths
    root: Path
    library_file: Path


def load_context(root_override: str | None = None, base: Path | None = None) -> ServiceContext:
    paths = app_paths(base)
    config = load_config(paths.config_file)
    root = resolve_root(root_override, config.output.root_dir)
    library_file = library_path(config.library.file, paths)
    paths.ensure()
    return ServiceContext(config=config, paths=paths, root=root, library_file=library_file)


def build_gateway(ctx: ServiceContext, clock: Clock) -> TelethonGateway:
    if not ctx.config.telegram.is_configured:
        raise ChatImportError("telegram api_id and api_hash are not set in config.toml")
    return TelethonGateway(
        ctx.config.telegram,
        ctx.paths.session_file,
        include_sender_names=ctx.config.output.include_sender_names,
        include_raw=ctx.config.output.include_raw,
        clock=clock,
    )

"""File-based command queue between the CLI/tray and the running service (spec §9.3).

Everything lives in the control folder; there are no network ports. The server claims a
command file by renaming it before running it, so every command runs at most once: a file it
cannot claim waits for the next poll, and a claim left by a crash is answered, never re-run.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import contextlib
import json
import logging
import time
import uuid
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, Final, cast

from filelock import FileLock, Timeout

from chatimport.commands import COMMAND_NAMES, CommandResult, Handler
from chatimport.ports import ChatImportError
from chatimport.storage.fileio import atomic_write_bytes

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Mapping
    from pathlib import Path

    from chatimport.ports import Clock

__all__ = [
    "COMMANDS",
    "RESULT_SUFFIX",
    "AlreadyRunning",
    "CommandResult",
    "ControlServer",
    "Handler",
    "acquire_instance_lock",
    "send_command",
    "service_running",
]

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

COMMANDS: Final = COMMAND_NAMES
RESULT_SUFFIX = ".result.json"
CLAIM_SUFFIX: Final = ".claimed"
STALE_RESULT_SECONDS = 600
POLL_SECONDS = 1.0
MAX_COMMAND_BYTES: Final = 64 * 1024
DEFAULT_TIMEOUT: Final = 30.0
COMMAND_TIMEOUTS: Final[dict[str, float]] = {
    "set_root": 3600.0,
    "check": 600.0,
    "trim": 600.0,
    "deeper": 600.0,
    "recheck": 600.0,
    "export_all": 600.0,
}


class AlreadyRunning(ChatImportError):
    """Another ChatImport service instance holds the lock."""


class _BadCommand(ValueError):
    pass


def _write_json_atomic(path: Path, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    atomic_write_bytes(path, json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False).encode(), unique=True)


def _read_object(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    value: object = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise _BadCommand("not a JSON object")
    return cast("dict[str, Any]", value)


def _is_command_file(path: Path) -> bool:
    return (
        path.suffix == ".json"
        and not path.name.startswith(".")
        and not path.name.endswith(RESULT_SUFFIX)
        and path.is_file()
    )


def _claim(path: Path, stem: str) -> Path | None:
    """Rename the command file aside; None when it is busy (it is retried on the next poll)."""
    claimed = path.with_name(f".{stem}{CLAIM_SUFFIX}")
    try:
        path.replace(claimed)
    except OSError:
        log.warning("command file busy; retried on the next poll", extra={"file": path.name})
        return None
    return claimed


def _load_request(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if path.stat().st_size > MAX_COMMAND_BYTES:
        raise _BadCommand("command file too large")
    return _read_object(path)


def _args_of(request: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    raw_args: object = request.get("args") or {}
    if not isinstance(raw_args, dict):
        raise _BadCommand("args is not an object")
    return cast("dict[str, Any]", raw_args)


class ControlServer:
    def __init__(self, control_dir: Path, handlers: Mapping[str, Handler], *, clock: Clock) -> None:
        self._dir = control_dir
        self._handlers = handlers
        self._clock = clock

    async def run(self) -> None:
        self._dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.answer_interrupted()
        while True:
            try:
                await self.process_pending()
            except Exception:
                log.exception("control folder scan failed")
            await self._clock.sleep(POLL_SECONDS)

    def answer_interrupted(self) -> int:
        """Answer every claim a previous run left behind and drop it, without running it."""
        count = 0
        for path in self._dir.glob(f".*{CLAIM_SUFFIX}"):
            stem = path.name.removeprefix(".").removesuffix(CLAIM_SUFFIX)
            result = CommandResult(False, "interrupted by a service stop; not run again")
            self._finish(path, stem, stem, result)
            count += 1
        return count

    async def process_pending(self) -> int:
        self._drop_stale_results()
        files: list[tuple[int, str, Path]] = []
        for path in self._dir.iterdir():
            if _is_command_file(path):
                with contextlib.suppress(OSError):
                    files.append((path.stat().st_mtime_ns, path.name, path))
        files.sort()
        for _, _, path in files:
            await self._process(path)
        return len(files)

    async def _process(self, path: Path) -> None:
        stem = path.name.removesuffix(".json")
        claimed = _claim(path, stem)
        if claimed is None:
            return
        request_id = stem
        try:
            request = _load_request(claimed)
            request_id = str(request.get("id", stem))
            command = str(request.get("command", ""))
            args = _args_of(request)
        except Exception as exc:
            result = CommandResult(False, f"invalid command file: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
        else:
            result = await self._dispatch(command, args)
        self._finish(claimed, stem, request_id, result)

    def _finish(self, claimed: Path, stem: str, request_id: str, result: CommandResult) -> None:
        payload: dict[str, Any] = {
            "id": request_id,
            "ok": result.ok,
            "message": result.message,
            "data": result.data,
        }
        target = self._dir / f"{stem}{RESULT_SUFFIX}"
        try:
            try:
                _write_json_atomic(target, payload)
            except TypeError, ValueError:
                log.exception("command result is not JSON", extra={"file": claimed.name})
                payload.update(ok=False, message="the result could not be encoded", data={})
                _write_json_atomic(target, payload)
        except OSError:
            log.exception("could not write a command result", extra={"file": claimed.name})
        try:
            claimed.unlink()
        except FileNotFoundError:
            pass
        except OSError:
            log.warning("could not delete a claimed command file", extra={"file": claimed.name})

    async def _dispatch(self, command: str, args: dict[str, Any]) -> CommandResult:
        handler = self._handlers.get(command)
        if handler is None:
            return CommandResult(False, f"unknown command: {command!r}")
        try:
            return await handler(args)
        except Exception as exc:
            log.exception("command %s failed", command)
            return CommandResult(False, f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")

    def _drop_stale_results(self) -> None:
        now = self._clock.now().timestamp()
        for path in self._dir.glob(f"*{RESULT_SUFFIX}"):
            with contextlib.suppress(OSError):
                if now - path.stat().st_mtime > STALE_RESULT_SECONDS:
                    path.unlink()


def send_command(
    control_dir: Path,
    command: str,
    args: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    *,
    timeout: float | None = None,
    poll: float = 0.25,
) -> CommandResult:
    """Queue a command and wait for its answer. Without `timeout`, long commands (trim,
    check, set_root, ...) get a longer wait than quick ones."""
    if timeout is None:
        timeout = COMMAND_TIMEOUTS.get(command, DEFAULT_TIMEOUT)
    control_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    request_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
    stem = f"{command}-{request_id}"
    command_path = control_dir / f"{stem}.json"
    result_path = control_dir / f"{stem}{RESULT_SUFFIX}"
    _write_json_atomic(command_path, {"id": request_id, "command": command, "args": args or {}})
    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
    while True:
        if result_path.exists():
            try:
                payload = _read_object(result_path)
            except OSError, ValueError:
                payload = None
            if payload is not None:
                with contextlib.suppress(OSError):
                    result_path.unlink()
                data: object = payload.get("data") or {}
                return CommandResult(
                    bool(payload.get("ok", False)),
                    str(payload.get("message", "")),
                    cast("dict[str, Any]", data) if isinstance(data, dict) else {},
                )
        if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
            raise TimeoutError(_timeout_message(command, command_path, timeout))
        time.sleep(poll)


def _timeout_message(command: str, command_path: Path, timeout: float) -> str:
    try:
        command_path.unlink()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return (
            f"no answer to {command!r} within {timeout:g} s; the service took the command "
            "and may still be running it; do not repeat it, check the status later"
        )
    except OSError:
        pass
    return (
        f"no answer to {command!r} within {timeout:g} s; the ChatImport service may not be running"
    )


def service_running(lock_file: Path) -> bool:
    lock_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    lock = FileLock(str(lock_file))
    try:
        lock.acquire(timeout=0)
    except Timeout:
        return True
    lock.release()
    return False


def acquire_instance_lock(lock_file: Path) -> FileLock:
    lock_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    lock = FileLock(str(lock_file))
    try:
        lock.acquire(timeout=0)
    except Timeout as exc:
        raise AlreadyRunning("another ChatImport instance is already running") from exc
    return lock

"""`chatimport export-json`: one classic JSON array with every record of a chat (spec §9.1).

The default target is `<root>/_exports/<chat folder>.json`: outside the chat folder, so the
export never mixes with the service's files, and skipped as a service folder by everything
that walks the chats. `include_names=False` blanks sender names and drops the raw Telegram
object, for an export that is meant to be shared.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, Final

from chatimport.records import KIND_MESSAGE, escape_line_breaks
from chatimport.storage.fileio import atomic_writer
from chatimport.storage.layout import SERVICE_PREFIX
from chatimport.storage.reader import iter_records

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pathlib import Path

    from chatimport.records import Record

EXPORTS_DIR: Final = f"{SERVICE_PREFIX}exports"
_NAME_FIELDS: Final = ("sender_name", "sender_username")


def default_export_path(folder: Path) -> Path:
    return folder.parent / EXPORTS_DIR / f"{folder.name}.json"


def export_dict(record: Record, *, include_names: bool) -> dict[str, Any]:
    data = record.to_dict()
    if not include_names and data.get("kind") == KIND_MESSAGE:
        data.update(dict.fromkeys(_NAME_FIELDS))
        data.pop("raw", None)
    return data


def export_chat_json(folder: Path, out: Path | None = None, *, include_names: bool = True) -> Path:
    """Stream the records in order into `out` (default `default_export_path(folder)`)."""
    target = out if out is not None else default_export_path(folder)
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with atomic_writer(target, unique=True) as handle:
        handle.write(b"[")
        first = True
        for record in iter_records(folder):
            handle.write(b"\n" if first else b",\n")
            text = json.dumps(export_dict(record, include_names=include_names), ensure_ascii=False)
            handle.write(escape_line_breaks(text).encode("utf-8"))
            first = False
        handle.write(b"]\n" if first else b"\n]\n")
    return target

"""Telegram FloodWait handling: wait as long as asked, then repeat the operation."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Final

from chatimport.ports import FloodWait
from chatimport.runtime import Level

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Awaitable, Callable

    from chatimport.ports import Clock
    from chatimport.runtime import Notifier

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

LONG_FLOOD_SECONDS: Final = 600


async def retry_on_flood[T](
    operation: Callable[[], Awaitable[T]],
    *,
    clock: Clock,
    on_wait: Callable[[int], None],
) -> T:
    """Run `operation` until it ends without a FloodWait; `on_wait` hears every wait first."""
    while True:
        try:
            return await operation()
        except FloodWait as wait:
            on_wait(wait.seconds)
            await clock.sleep(wait.seconds)


class FloodReporter:
    """Logs every FloodWait of a chat; tells the owner about waits over ten minutes."""

    def __init__(self, chat_id: int, title: str, notifier: Notifier) -> None:
        self._chat_id = chat_id
        self._title = title
        self._notifier = notifier

    def __call__(self, seconds: int) -> None:
        log.warning("FloodWait %s s in chat %s", seconds, self._chat_id)
        if seconds > LONG_FLOOD_SECONDS:
            self._notifier.notify(
                Level.WARNING, self._title, f"Telegram asked to wait {seconds} s; this chat sleeps"
            )

"""Automatic disk guard (spec §8.5) and the media download gate.

When free space falls below the low watermark, every unfinished history download is stopped
for good (spec §8.2.5): the floor moves up to where it got, `floor_reason = "disk"`, and the
backfill counts as done, so a restart does not refill the disk. `backfill --deeper` resumes it.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from dataclasses import replace
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Final, Protocol

from chatimport.config import GIB
from chatimport.runtime import Level
from chatimport.storage.state import StateUnreadable, load_state, save_state

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pathlib import Path

    from chatimport.config import DiskConfig
    from chatimport.ports import Clock, DiskUsage
    from chatimport.runtime import ChatController, ChatRegistry, Notifier
    from chatimport.storage.state import ChatState
    from chatimport.trim import Trimmer

__all__ = ["FLOOR_REASON_DISK", "GIB", "TITLE", "DiskGuard", "MediaDiskGate"]

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

TITLE: Final = "Disk space"
FLOOR_REASON_DISK: Final = "disk"


def _stopped(state: ChatState) -> ChatState:
    floor = state.backfill.oldest_done_id or min(
        (info.first_id for info in state.chunks.values() if info.first_id), default=0
    )
    return replace(
        state,
        floor_id=max(state.floor_id, floor),
        floor_reason=FLOOR_REASON_DISK,
        backfill=replace(state.backfill, done=True),
    )


class DiskGuard:
    def __init__(
        self,
        root: Path,
        registry: ChatRegistry,
        trimmer: Trimmer,
        config: DiskConfig,
        *,
        clock: Clock,
        disk: DiskUsage,
        notifier: Notifier,
    ) -> None:
        self._root = root
        self._registry = registry
        self._trimmer = trimmer
        self._config = config
        self._clock = clock
        self._disk = disk
        self._notifier = notifier

    async def run(self) -> None:
        while True:
            try:
                await self.check_once()
            except Exception:
                log.exception("disk guard check failed")
            await self._clock.sleep(self._config.check_every_minutes * 60)

    async def check_once(self) -> bool:
        """True when free space was below the low watermark and trimming was attempted."""
        start_free = self._disk.free_bytes(self._root)
        if start_free >= self._config.low_bytes:
            return False
        stopped = 0
        for controller in self._registry.all():
            controller.pause_backfill()
            if await self._stop_backfill(controller):
                stopped += 1
        if stopped:
            self._notifier.notify(
                Level.WARNING,
                TITLE,
                f"history download stopped in {stopped} chat(s) for lack of space; "
                "`chatimport backfill --deeper` continues it",
            )

        deleted = 0
        free = start_free
        exhausted = False
        while free < self._config.high_bytes:
            part = await self._trimmer.delete_oldest_part(self._config.protect_recent_days)
            if part is None:
                exhausted = True
                break
            deleted += 1
            free = self._disk.free_bytes(self._root)

        if exhausted:
            self._notifier.notify(
                Level.WARNING, TITLE, "space is low, everything allowed is already deleted"
            )
        if deleted:
            freed_gb = max(0, free - start_free) / GIB
            self._notifier.notify(
                Level.INFO, TITLE, f"freed {freed_gb:.1f} GB: deleted {deleted} parts"
            )
        log.info("disk guard ran", extra={"parts": deleted, "exhausted": exhausted})
        return True

    async def _stop_backfill(self, controller: ChatController) -> bool:
        """Persist the stop of an unfinished history download; True when one was stopped."""
        async with controller.lock:
            folder = controller.folder
            try:
                state = load_state(folder) if folder.is_dir() else None
            except StateUnreadable:
                log.warning("cannot stop the backfill now", extra={"chat_id": controller.chat_id})
                return False
            if state is None or state.backfill.done:
                return False
            stopped = replace(_stopped(state), updated_at=self._clock.now())
            save_state(folder, stopped)
        log.warning(
            "backfill stopped for lack of space",
            extra={"chat_id": controller.chat_id, "floor_id": stopped.floor_id},
        )
        return True


class Pausable(Protocol):
    def pause(self) -> None: ...

    def resume(self) -> None: ...


class MediaDiskGate:
    """Pauses media downloads below the low watermark and resumes them at the high one."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        root: Path,
        downloader: Pausable,
        config: DiskConfig,
        *,
        disk: DiskUsage,
        clock: Clock,
    ) -> None:
        self._root = root
        self._downloader = downloader
        self._config = config
        self._disk = disk
        self._clock = clock

    def check_once(self) -> None:
        free = self._disk.free_bytes(self._root)
        if free < self._config.low_bytes:
            self._downloader.pause()
        elif free >= self._config.high_bytes:
            self._downloader.resume()

    async def run(self) -> None:
        while True:
            self.check_once()
            await self._clock.sleep(self._config.check_every_minutes * 60)

"""Folder-deletion watcher (spec §8.4): refetch a deleted chat, recover a damaged one.

Explorer deletes a large folder gradually, so neither a missing folder nor a mismatch between
`state.json` and the parts is acted on at once: the same picture must be seen on
`confirm_checks` consecutive checks. A state that cannot be read right now is left alone.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Final

from chatimport.runtime import Level
from chatimport.storage.layout import list_parts
from chatimport.storage.recover import recover_chat
from chatimport.storage.state import StateUnreadable, load_state

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pathlib import Path

    from chatimport.config import WatchConfig
    from chatimport.ports import Clock
    from chatimport.runtime import ChatController, ChatRegistry, Notifier

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

TITLE: Final = "Folder watch"

type _Signature = tuple[frozenset[str] | None, frozenset[str]]


class FolderWatcher:
    def __init__(
        self,
        root: Path,
        registry: ChatRegistry,
        config: WatchConfig,
        *,
        clock: Clock,
        notifier: Notifier,
    ) -> None:
        self._root = root
        self._registry = registry
        self._config = config
        self._clock = clock
        self._notifier = notifier
        self._root_seen = False
        self._root_misses = 0
        self._seen: set[int] = set()
        self._misses: dict[int, int] = {}
        self._refetching: set[int] = set()
        self._mismatch: dict[int, tuple[_Signature, int]] = {}

    async def run(self) -> None:
        while True:
            try:
                await self.check_once()
            except Exception:
                log.exception("folder watcher check failed")
            await self._clock.sleep(self._config.check_every_seconds)

    async def check_once(self) -> None:
        if self._root.is_dir():
            self._root_seen = True
            self._root_misses = 0
        elif self._root_seen:
            self._root_misses += 1
            if self._root_misses >= self._config.confirm_checks:
                self._refetch_all()
            return
        else:
            return

        for controller in self._registry.all():
            await self._check_chat(controller)

    def _refetch_all(self) -> None:
        self._root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self._root_misses = 0
        for controller in self._registry.all():
            self._request_refetch(controller)
        self._notifier.notify(Level.WARNING, TITLE, "data folder was deleted, fetching again")

    def _request_refetch(self, controller: ChatController) -> None:
        chat_id = controller.chat_id
        self._misses[chat_id] = 0
        self._refetching.add(chat_id)
        controller.request_refetch()
        log.warning("chat folder deleted, refetch requested", extra={"chat_id": chat_id})

    async def _check_chat(self, controller: ChatController) -> None:
        chat_id = controller.chat_id
        folder = controller.folder
        if not folder.is_dir():
            if chat_id not in self._seen or chat_id in self._refetching:
                return
            misses = self._misses.get(chat_id, 0) + 1
            self._misses[chat_id] = misses
            if misses >= self._config.confirm_checks:
                self._request_refetch(controller)
                self._notifier.notify(
                    Level.WARNING, TITLE, f"folder of chat {chat_id} was deleted, fetching again"
                )
            return

        self._seen.add(chat_id)
        self._misses[chat_id] = 0
        self._refetching.discard(chat_id)
        async with controller.lock:
            if not folder.is_dir():
                return
            try:
                state = load_state(folder)
            except StateUnreadable:
                log.warning("state.json unreadable, check skipped", extra={"chat_id": chat_id})
                return
            parts = frozenset(p.stem for p in list_parts(folder))
            if (state is None and not parts) or (
                state is not None and frozenset(state.chunks) == parts
            ):
                self._mismatch.pop(chat_id, None)
                return
            if not self._mismatch_confirmed(
                chat_id, (None if state is None else frozenset(state.chunks), parts)
            ):
                return
            recover_chat(
                folder,
                now=self._clock.now(),
                fallback_chat_id=chat_id,
                fallback_title=controller.status().title,
            )
            log.warning("chat folder recovered after manual changes", extra={"chat_id": chat_id})

    def _mismatch_confirmed(self, chat_id: int, signature: _Signature) -> bool:
        previous, count = self._mismatch.get(chat_id, (signature, 0))
        count = count + 1 if previous == signature else 1
        if count < self._config.confirm_checks:
            self._mismatch[chat_id] = (signature, count)
            return False
        self._mismatch.pop(chat_id, None)
        return True

"""`GuiContext`: everything a window page needs, and the bridge it talks to the service through."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, Protocol

from chatimport.gui.kit import UiKit

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from concurrent.futures import Future

    from PySide6.QtCore import SignalInstance

    from chatimport.commands import CommandResult
    from chatimport.context import ServiceContext
    from chatimport.gui.i18n import LanguageManager
    from chatimport.gui.settings import GuiSettingsStore
    from chatimport.gui.theme import ThemeManager
    from chatimport.gui.zoom import ZoomManager


class ServiceBridge(Protocol):
    """The window's only door to the service (implemented by the service host).

    `execute` is thread-safe and returns at once; the result arrives on the future.
    `snapshot` is a Qt signal carrying the status dict, always emitted on the main thread.
    """

    snapshot: SignalInstance

    @property
    def last_snapshot(self) -> dict[str, Any] | None: ...

    def execute(
        self, command: str, args: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    ) -> Future[CommandResult]: ...


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class GuiContext:
    service: ServiceContext
    theme: ThemeManager
    language: LanguageManager
    zoom: ZoomManager
    settings: GuiSettingsStore
    bridge: ServiceBridge

    @property
    def current(self) -> ServiceContext:
        """The service context as it is now (`service` is frozen at window start)."""
        live = getattr(self.bridge, "context", None)
        return live if live is not None else self.service

    @property
    def kit(self) -> UiKit:
        return UiKit(theme=self.theme, language=self.language, zoom=self.zoom)

"""Pure display formatting: ages, freshness, exact moments, sizes and counts.

No Qt and no clock here: every function takes its inputs, so each is table-testable. Words and
separators come from the string catalogue (`time.*`, `bytes.*`, `format.*`), never from this file.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta, tzinfo
from enum import StrEnum
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Final

from chatimport.gui.strings import translate, translate_plural

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from chatimport.gui.strings import Language

JUST_NOW_BELOW: Final = 5
DAY: Final = 86_400

_UNITS: Final[tuple[tuple[str, int], ...]] = (
    ("y", 365 * DAY),
    ("mo", 30 * DAY),
    ("wk", 7 * DAY),
    ("d", DAY),
    ("h", 3_600),
    ("min", 60),
    ("s", 1),
)
_BYTE_UNITS: Final = ("b", "kb", "mb", "gb", "tb")


def _split_age(total: int) -> list[tuple[str, int]]:
    for index, (name, size) in enumerate(_UNITS):
        if total < size:
            continue
        head = total // size
        parts = [(name, head)]
        if index + 1 < len(_UNITS):
            next_name, next_size = _UNITS[index + 1]
            # 360-364 days after a year would read "12 mo": cap at the 11 that fit a year.
            tail = min((total - head * size) // next_size, size // next_size - 1)
            if tail > 0:
                parts.append((next_name, tail))
        return parts
    return [("s", 0)]


def humanize_age(seconds: float | None, language: Language) -> str:
    """The two largest units of a duration: `42 s`, `12 min 5 s`, `2 d 4 h`, `1 y 3 mo`.

    Below five seconds the "just now" phrase; `None` and negative values read as unknown.
    """
    if seconds is None or math.isnan(seconds) or seconds < 0:
        return translate(language, "time.unknown")
    total = int(seconds)
    if total < JUST_NOW_BELOW:
        return translate(language, "time.just_now")
    return " ".join(
        f"{value} {translate(language, f'time.{name}')}" for name, value in _split_age(total)
    )


def format_ago(seconds: float | None, language: Language) -> str:
    """`humanize_age` with the "ago" wording; "just now" and "unknown" stay as they are."""
    if seconds is None or math.isnan(seconds) or seconds < JUST_NOW_BELOW:
        return humanize_age(seconds, language)
    return translate(language, "time.ago", age=humanize_age(seconds, language))


class Freshness(StrEnum):
    FRESH = "fresh"
    RECENT = "recent"
    STALE = "stale"
    DORMANT = "dormant"
    UNKNOWN = "unknown"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class FreshnessThresholds:
    """Ages in seconds below which a chat counts as fresh, recent and stale; older is dormant."""

    fresh_below: int = 300
    recent_below: int = 3_600
    stale_below: int = DAY

    def is_ordered(self) -> bool:
        return 0 < self.fresh_below <= self.recent_below <= self.stale_below


def classify(seconds: float | None, thresholds: FreshnessThresholds) -> Freshness:
    if seconds is None or math.isnan(seconds) or seconds < 0:
        return Freshness.UNKNOWN
    if seconds < thresholds.fresh_below:
        return Freshness.FRESH
    if seconds < thresholds.recent_below:
        return Freshness.RECENT
    if seconds < thresholds.stale_below:
        return Freshness.STALE
    return Freshness.DORMANT


def zone_label(offset: timedelta | None) -> str:
    if offset is None or offset == timedelta(0):
        return "UTC"
    minutes = int(offset.total_seconds() // 60)
    sign = "+" if minutes >= 0 else "-"
    hours, rest = divmod(abs(minutes), 60)
    return f"UTC{sign}{hours:02d}:{rest:02d}"


def format_exact(moment: datetime, tz: tzinfo | None = None) -> str:
    """`2026-10-31 20:42:10 UTC+03:00`: the full instant to the second with its zone.

    A naive datetime is read as UTC; `tz=None` renders in the machine's local zone.
    """
    aware = moment if moment.tzinfo is not None else moment.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
    local = aware.astimezone(tz) if tz is not None else aware.astimezone()
    return f"{local:%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S} {zone_label(local.utcoffset())}"


def _group_digits(text: str, separator: str) -> str:
    groups: list[str] = []
    while len(text) > 3:
        groups.insert(0, text[-3:])
        text = text[:-3]
    groups.insert(0, text)
    return separator.join(groups)


def format_count(n: int, language: Language) -> str:
    """Thousands-grouped integer with the language's separator (a no-break space in Russian)."""
    separator = translate(language, "format.thousands")
    sign = "-" if n < 0 else ""
    return sign + _group_digits(str(abs(n)), separator)


def format_bytes(size: float, language: Language) -> str:
    """`512 B`, `1.5 MB`, `12 GB` with binary steps; one decimal below ten."""
    value = max(float(size), 0.0)
    index = 0
    while value >= 1024 and index < len(_BYTE_UNITS) - 1:
        value /= 1024
        index += 1
    unit = translate(language, f"bytes.{_BYTE_UNITS[index]}")
    if index == 0:
        return f"{int(value)} {unit}"
    decimal = translate(language, "format.decimal")
    number = f"{value:.1f}" if value < 10 else f"{value:.0f}"
    return f"{number.replace('.', decimal)} {unit}"


def format_percent(fraction: float, language: Language) -> str:
    clamped = min(max(fraction, 0.0), 1.0)
    return translate(language, "format.percent", value=round(clamped * 100))


def count_phrase(n: int, key: str, language: Language) -> str:
    """`3 chats` or its Russian form: a plural catalogue entry with the grouped count as `{n}`."""
    return translate_plural(language, n, key, n=format_count(n, language))

"""Runtime language switching: `tr(key, **params)` and `plural(n, key)` read the live language.

`LanguageManager.changed` fires after the switch, and every widget retranslates itself from it,
so the window never needs a restart. The catalogue itself lives in `strings` (Qt-free).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from PySide6.QtCore import QObject, Signal

from chatimport.gui import strings
from chatimport.gui.strings import (
    LANGUAGES,
    Language,
    LocaleDriftError,
    check_drift,
    register_strings,
)

__all__ = [
    "LANGUAGES",
    "Language",
    "LanguageManager",
    "LocaleDriftError",
    "check_drift",
    "plural",
    "register_strings",
    "tr",
]


def tr(key: str, **params: object) -> str:
    return strings.translate(strings.current_language(), key, **params)


def plural(count: int, key: str, **params: object) -> str:
    """The plural form of `key` for `count`; `{n}` in the text is the count itself."""
    return strings.translate_plural(strings.current_language(), count, key, **params)


class LanguageManager(QObject):
    changed = Signal(str)

    def __init__(self, language: Language = "en") -> None:
        super().__init__()
        strings.set_current_language(language)
        check_drift()

    @property
    def current(self) -> Language:
        return strings.current_language()

    def set_language(self, language: Language) -> None:
        if language == strings.current_language() or language not in LANGUAGES:
            return
        strings.set_current_language(language)
        self.changed.emit(language)

def _svg(path: str, color: str, weight: float) -> bytes:
    return (
        '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" '
        f'stroke="{color}" stroke-width="{weight}" stroke-linecap="round" '
        f'stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="{path}"/></svg>'
    ).encode()


def _pixel_density() -> int:
    screen = QGuiApplication.primaryScreen()
    return max(2, math.ceil(screen.devicePixelRatio())) if screen else 2


@lru_cache(maxsize=1024)
def _cached_pixmap(name: str, color: str, size: int, weight: float, density: int) -> QPixmap:
    renderer = QSvgRenderer(QByteArray(_svg(ICON_PATHS[name], color, weight)))
    pixmap = QPixmap(size * density, size * density)
    pixmap.fill(Qt.GlobalColor.transparent)
    painter = QPainter(pixmap)
    renderer.render(painter, QRectF(0, 0, size * density, size * density))
    painter.end()
    pixmap.setDevicePixelRatio(density)
    return pixmap


def icon_pixmap(name: str, color: str, size: int = 16, weight: float = DEFAULT_WEIGHT) -> QPixmap:
    return _cached_pixmap(name, color, max(size, 1), weight, _pixel_density())


def icon(
    name: str,
    color: str,
    size: int = 16,
    *,
    weight: float = DEFAULT_WEIGHT,
    disabled_color: str | None = None,
    active_color: str | None = None,
) -> QIcon:
    """A coloured icon; optional colours cover the disabled and hovered (active) modes."""
    result = QIcon()
    result.addPixmap(icon_pixmap(name, color, size, weight), QIcon.Mode.Normal)
    if disabled_color is not None:
        result.addPixmap(icon_pixmap(name, disabled_color, size, weight), QIcon.Mode.Disabled)
    if active_color is not None:
        result.addPixmap(icon_pixmap(name, active_color, size, weight), QIcon.Mode.Active)
    return result

"""Small painted schemes for the API key guide: simplified sketches, not screenshots.

Every scheme is drawn in a fixed 240 x 96 box and scaled to the widget, so the sketches follow
the theme colours and the zoom. The words in them copy what my.telegram.org shows (it is
English only), so they are not translated.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Final

from PySide6.QtCore import QPointF, QRectF, Qt
from PySide6.QtGui import QColor, QFont, QPainter, QPen
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QSizePolicy, QWidget

from chatimport.gui.icons import icon_pixmap
from chatimport.gui.widgets.base import bind_kit

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from PySide6.QtGui import QPaintEvent

    from chatimport.gui.kit import UiKit
    from chatimport.gui.tokens import Palette

BOX_WIDTH: Final = 240
BOX_HEIGHT: Final = 96
KINDS: Final = ("site", "phone", "code", "tools", "form", "create", "keys")

    ("App title", "My archive"),
    ("Short name", "myarchive1"),
    ("Platform", "Desktop"),

def _text(painter: QPainter, rect: QRectF, text: str, color: str, *, bold: bool = False) -> None:
    font = QFont(painter.font())
    font.setPixelSize(11)
    font.setBold(bold)
    painter.setFont(font)
    painter.setPen(QColor(color))
    flags = Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft
    painter.drawText(rect, flags, text)


def _box(
    painter: QPainter,
    rect: QRectF,
    fill: str,
    border: str,
    radius: float = 5,
    width: float = 1,
) -> None:
    painter.setBrush(QColor(fill))
    pen = QPen(QColor(border))
    pen.setWidthF(width)
    painter.setPen(pen)
    painter.drawRoundedRect(rect, radius, radius)


def _field(
    painter: QPainter, palette: Palette, rect: QRectF, text: str, *, active: bool = False
) -> None:
    _box(
        painter,
        rect,
        palette.surface,
        palette.accent if active else palette.border_strong,
        4,
        1.6 if active else 1,
    )
    _text(painter, rect.adjusted(7, 0, -4, 0), text, palette.fg if text else palette.fg_faint)


def _button(painter: QPainter, palette: Palette, rect: QRectF, text: str) -> None:
    _box(painter, rect, palette.accent, palette.accent, 5)
    painter.setPen(QColor(palette.fg_on_accent))
    font = QFont(painter.font())
    font.setPixelSize(11)
    font.setBold(True)
    painter.setFont(font)
    painter.drawText(rect, Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter, text)


def _site(painter: QPainter, palette: Palette) -> None:
    _box(painter, QRectF(14, 12, 212, 72), palette.surface, palette.border_strong, 6)
    painter.setPen(Qt.PenStyle.NoPen)
    for index, color in enumerate((palette.danger, palette.warning, palette.success)):
        painter.setBrush(QColor(color))
        painter.drawEllipse(QPointF(26 + index * 11, 24), 3, 3)
    _box(painter, QRectF(70, 17, 148, 14), palette.surface_sunken, palette.border, 7)
    painter.drawPixmap(QPointF(76, 19), icon_pixmap("lock", palette.success, 10))
    _text(painter, QRectF(90, 17, 126, 14), "my.telegram.org", palette.fg)
    _box(painter, QRectF(28, 44, 100, 8), palette.surface_sunken, palette.surface_sunken, 3)
    _box(painter, QRectF(28, 58, 160, 8), palette.surface_sunken, palette.surface_sunken, 3)


def _phone(painter: QPainter, palette: Palette) -> None:
    _text(painter, QRectF(30, 8, 180, 16), "Your Phone Number", palette.fg_muted)
    _field(painter, palette, QRectF(30, 28, 180, 24), "+598 99 123 456", active=True)
    _button(painter, palette, QRectF(30, 62, 82, 22), "Next")

def _tools(painter: QPainter, palette: Palette) -> None:
    items = ("Log out", "API development tools", "Delete account")
    for index, label in enumerate(items):
        row = QRectF(30, 10 + index * 25, 180, 22)

            painter, row.adjusted(8, 0, -4, 0), label, palette.accent_fg if chosen else palette.fg
        )


def _form(painter: QPainter, palette: Palette) -> None:

_DRAWERS: Final = {
    "site": _site,
    "phone": _phone,
    "code": _code,
    "tools": _tools,
    "form": _form,
    "create": _create,
    "keys": _keys,

class SchemeArt(QWidget):
    def __init__(self, kit: UiKit, kind: str, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        if kind not in KINDS:
            raise ValueError(f"unknown scheme: {kind}")
        self.kit = kit
        self.kind = kind
        self.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Policy.Fixed, QSizePolicy.Policy.Fixed)
        self.setAttribute(Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_NoSystemBackground)
        bind_kit(kit, theme=self.update, zoom=self._resize)
        self._resize()

    def _resize(self) -> None:
        self.setFixedSize(self.kit.px(BOX_WIDTH), self.kit.px(BOX_HEIGHT))
        self.update()

    def paintEvent(self, event: QPaintEvent) -> None:
        palette = self.kit.palette
        painter = QPainter(self)
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing)
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.TextAntialiasing)
        painter.scale(self.width() / BOX_WIDTH, self.height() / BOX_HEIGHT)
        _box(
            painter,
            QRectF(0.5, 0.5, BOX_WIDTH - 1, BOX_HEIGHT - 1),
            palette.surface_sunken,
            palette.border,
            8,
        )
        _DRAWERS[self.kind](painter, palette)
        painter.end()

"""Pure checks for the two Telegram API credentials; an error is a translatable string key."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from typing import Final

API_HASH_LENGTH: Final = 32
API_ID_ERROR: Final = "settings.tg.err.api_id"
API_HASH_ERROR: Final = "settings.tg.err.api_hash"
_HASH: Final = re.compile(rf"[0-9a-fA-F]{{{API_HASH_LENGTH}}}")


def validate_api_id(text: str) -> str | None:
    """None for a positive whole number written with ASCII digits, else the error key."""
    value = text.strip()
    if value.isascii() and value.isdigit() and int(value) > 0:
        return None
    return API_ID_ERROR


def validate_api_hash(text: str) -> str | None:
    """None for exactly 32 hexadecimal characters, else the error key."""
    return None if _HASH.fullmatch(text.strip()) else API_HASH_ERROR

"""`UiKit`: the three managers every widget listens to, and the factory that wires persistence."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from chatimport.gui.i18n import LanguageManager
from chatimport.gui.theme import ThemeManager
from chatimport.gui.zoom import ZoomManager, screen_auto_factor

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication

    from chatimport.gui.settings import GuiSettingsStore
    from chatimport.gui.tokens import Palette


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class UiKit:
    theme: ThemeManager
    language: LanguageManager
    zoom: ZoomManager

    @property
    def palette(self) -> Palette:
        return self.theme.palette

    def px(self, pixels: float) -> int:
        return self.zoom.scaled(pixels)


def build_kit(store: GuiSettingsStore, app: QApplication | None) -> UiKit:
    """Managers from the stored preferences; every later change is written back to `store`."""
    settings = store.settings
    zoom = ZoomManager(settings.zoom, screen_auto_factor() if app is not None else 1.0)
    theme = ThemeManager(zoom, settings.theme, app=app)
    language = LanguageManager(settings.language)

    def save_zoom(_factor: float) -> None:
        store.update(zoom=zoom.stored)

    def save_theme() -> None:
        store.update(theme=theme.preference)

    def save_language(name: str) -> None:
        store.update(language=name)

    zoom.changed.connect(save_zoom)
    theme.changed.connect(save_theme)
    language.changed.connect(save_language)
    return UiKit(theme=theme, language=language, zoom=zoom)

"""`run_gui`: build the application, the service host and the window, and run the Qt loop."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import sys
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Final

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt, QTimer
from PySide6.QtGui import QGuiApplication, QIcon
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication, QMessageBox

from chatimport.assets import ICON_ICO
from chatimport.gui.context import GuiContext
from chatimport.gui.i18n import tr
from chatimport.gui.kit import build_kit
from chatimport.gui.main_window import MainWindow
from chatimport.gui.notifier import QtNotifier
from chatimport.gui.pages import build_pages
from chatimport.gui.service_host import AppFactory, ServiceHost, default_app_factory
from chatimport.gui.settings import GuiSettingsStore
from chatimport.gui.tray import QtTray
from chatimport.logging_setup import configure_logging
from chatimport.paths import cloud_sync_warning

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from chatimport.context import ServiceContext

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

APP_NAME: Final = "ChatImport"
APP_USER_MODEL_ID: Final = "ChatImport.Desktop"
SETTINGS_FILE: Final = "gui.json"
EXIT_ALREADY_RUNNING: Final = 1


def _set_app_user_model_id() -> None:
    if sys.platform == "win32":
        import ctypes

        try:
            ctypes.windll.shell32.SetCurrentProcessExplicitAppUserModelID(APP_USER_MODEL_ID)
        except AttributeError, OSError:
            log.warning("could not set the application user model id")


def _application() -> QApplication:
    existing = QApplication.instance()
    if isinstance(existing, QApplication):
        return existing
    QGuiApplication.setHighDpiScaleFactorRoundingPolicy(
        Qt.HighDpiScaleFactorRoundingPolicy.PassThrough
    )
    return QApplication(sys.argv[:1])


def run_gui(
    ctx: ServiceContext,
    *,
    start_hidden: bool = False,
    app_factory: AppFactory = default_app_factory,
) -> int:
    """Run the window together with the service until the owner quits; the exit code."""
    configure_logging(ctx.paths.log_dir, console=False)
    _set_app_user_model_id()
    app = _application()
    app.setApplicationName(APP_NAME)
    app.setOrganizationName(APP_NAME)
    app.setQuitOnLastWindowClosed(False)
    app.setWindowIcon(QIcon(str(ICON_ICO)))
    store = GuiSettingsStore(ctx.paths.base / SETTINGS_FILE)
    kit = build_kit(store, app)
    notifier = QtNotifier()
    host = ServiceHost(ctx, notifier, app_factory=app_factory)
    gui = GuiContext(
        service=ctx,
        theme=kit.theme,
        language=kit.language,
        zoom=kit.zoom,
        settings=store,
        bridge=host,  # pyright: ignore[reportArgumentType],
    )
    window = MainWindow(gui, build_pages(gui), notifier)
    tray = QtTray(kit)
    window.attach_tray(tray)
    outcome = {"code": 0}

    def on_already_running() -> None:
        outcome["code"] = EXIT_ALREADY_RUNNING
        window.hide()
        tray.hide()
        QMessageBox.warning(None, tr("shell.dialog.running_title"), tr("shell.dialog.running_text"))
        app.quit()

    host.already_running.connect(on_already_running)
    host.failed.connect(window.note_failure)
    tray.open_requested.connect(window.show_window)
    tray.toggle_pause_requested.connect(window.toggle_pause)
    tray.recheck_requested.connect(lambda: window.run_command("recheck"))
    tray.quit_requested.connect(window.request_quit)
    tray.show()
    host.start()
    if start_hidden or store.settings.start_hidden:
        if not tray.visible:
            window.show_window()
    else:
        window.show_window()
    QTimer.singleShot(0, window.offer_setup_wizard)
    warning = cloud_sync_warning(ctx.root)
    if warning is not None:
        QTimer.singleShot(0, lambda: window.toasts.push("warning", tr("shell.notice.cloud")))
    try:
        app.exec()
    finally:
        tray.hide()
        host.shutdown()
    return outcome["code"]

"""Telegram sign-in inside the window: a modal dialog over `telegram.client.login`.

`login` is a coroutine that asks for the phone, the code and the 2FA password through plain
callables. Here they run on a worker thread with its own event loop; each callable tells the
dialog (a queued signal) which step to show and then blocks on a queue until the dialog
answers, or until the owner cancels, which unblocks it with an exception. The phone, the code
and the password live only in the dialog's own widgets and in that queue: they are never
logged, stored or echoed, and every field is cleared when the dialog closes.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import logging
import queue
import re
import threading
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Final

from PySide6.QtCore import QObject, Qt, Signal, Slot
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QDialog, QHBoxLayout, QLineEdit, QVBoxLayout, QWidget

from chatimport.config import ConfigError, load_config
from chatimport.control import AlreadyRunning, acquire_instance_lock
from chatimport.gui.i18n import tr
from chatimport.gui.tokens import SPACE
from chatimport.gui.widgets.base import Tone, bind_kit
from chatimport.gui.widgets.button import Button
from chatimport.gui.widgets.callout import Callout
from chatimport.gui.widgets.chip import Chip
from chatimport.gui.widgets.labels import make_label
from chatimport.gui.widgets.progress import BusyStripe

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pathlib import Path

    from chatimport.config import TelegramConfig
    from chatimport.gui.context import GuiContext
    from chatimport.gui.pages.settings_support import LoginFunc, ServiceControl, SettingsHooks

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

DIALOG_WIDTH: Final = 460
PHONE_PATTERN: Final = re.compile(r"\+?[0-9 ()\-]{6,24}")
MIN_PHONE_DIGITS: Final = 7
STEPS: Final = ("phone", "code", "password", "done")

_FAILURES: Final[dict[str, str]] = {
    "PhoneNumberInvalidError": "invalid_phone",
    "PhoneNumberBannedError": "banned",
    "PhoneNumberFloodError": "flood",
    "PhoneNumberUnoccupiedError": "invalid_phone",
    "FloodWaitError": "flood",
    "FloodWait": "flood",
    "PhoneCodeInvalidError": "wrong_code",
    "PhoneCodeExpiredError": "wrong_code",
    "PhoneCodeEmptyError": "wrong_code",
    "PasswordHashInvalidError": "wrong_password",
    "ApiIdInvalidError": "api",
    "ApiIdPublishedFloodError": "api",
    "RuntimeError": "too_many",
    "ConnectionError": "network",
    "OSError": "network",
    "TimeoutError": "network",
    "RPCTimeoutError": "network",
    "AlreadyRunning": "busy",
    "ChatImportError": "generic",
}


class LoginCancelled(Exception):
    """The owner cancelled; raised inside the prompt so `login` unwinds and disconnects."""


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Failure:
    kind: str
    seconds: int | None = None


def classify_failure(error: BaseException) -> Failure:
    """Map a login failure to a message key by exception class name, following `__cause__`."""
    seen: BaseException | None = error
    while seen is not None:
        if isinstance(seen, LoginCancelled):
            return Failure("cancelled")
        for cls in type(seen).__mro__:
            kind = _FAILURES.get(cls.__name__)
            if kind is not None and cls.__name__ != "ChatImportError":
                seconds = getattr(seen, "seconds", None)
                return Failure(kind, seconds if isinstance(seconds, int) else None)
        seen = seen.__cause__
    return Failure("generic")


class LoginSession(QObject):
    """One login attempt on its own thread; talks to the dialog through signals and a queue."""

    prompted = Signal(str, int)
    finished = Signal(str, str, int)

    def __init__(
        self,
        config: TelegramConfig,
        session_path: Path,
        lock_file: Path,
        login: LoginFunc,
        phone: str,
        parent: QObject | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._config = config
        self._session_path = session_path
        self._lock_file = lock_file
        self._login = login
        self._phone = phone
        self._answers: queue.Queue[str | None] = queue.Queue()
        self._attempts: dict[str, int] = {}
        self._cancelled = threading.Event()
        self._thread = threading.Thread(target=self._run, name="chatimport-login", daemon=True)

    @property
    def running(self) -> bool:
        return self._thread.is_alive()

    def start(self) -> None:
        self._thread.start()

    def answer(self, text: str) -> None:
        self._answers.put(text)

    def cancel(self) -> None:
        self._cancelled.set()
        self._answers.put(None)

    def _ask(self, kind: str) -> str:
        if kind == "phone" and self._phone:
            phone, self._phone = self._phone, ""
            return phone
        if self._cancelled.is_set():
            raise LoginCancelled
        attempt = self._attempts.get(kind, 0) + 1
        self._attempts[kind] = attempt
        self.prompted.emit(kind, attempt)
        answer = self._answers.get()
        if answer is None or self._cancelled.is_set():
            raise LoginCancelled
        return answer

    def _run(self) -> None:
        handle, failure = "", Failure("")
        try:
            lock = acquire_instance_lock(self._lock_file)
        except AlreadyRunning as error:
            self.finished.emit("", classify_failure(error).kind, 0)
            return
        try:
            handle = asyncio.run(self._login_coroutine())
        except BaseException as error:
            failure = classify_failure(error)
            if failure.kind != "cancelled":
                log.warning("sign-in failed: %s", type(error).__name__)
        finally:
            lock.release()
            self._phone = ""
        self.finished.emit(handle, failure.kind, failure.seconds or 0)

    async def _login_coroutine(self) -> str:
        return await self._login(
            self._config,
            self._session_path,
            prompt_phone=lambda: self._ask("phone"),
            prompt_code=lambda: self._ask("code"),
            prompt_password=<REDACTED> self._ask("password"),
        )


class LoginDialog(QDialog):
    """Phone -> code -> (password) -> done. Modal; closing it mid-request cancels cleanly."""

    signed_in = Signal(str)

    def __init__(
        self,
        gui: GuiContext,
        hooks: SettingsHooks,
        control: ServiceControl | None,
        parent: QWidget | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.gui = gui
        self._hooks = hooks
        self._control = control
        self._session: LoginSession | None = None
        self._stage = "stopping"
        self._closing = False
        self._signed_in = False
        self._was_running = control is not None and control.is_alive
        self._step = "phone"
        kit = gui.kit
        self.setModal(True)
        self.setMinimumWidth(kit.px(DIALOG_WIDTH))

        self._chips = {name: Chip(kit, "", "muted") for name in STEPS}
        self._heading = make_label("", "section", wrap=True)
        self._explain = make_label("", "muted", wrap=True)
        self._input = QLineEdit()
        self._input.returnPressed.connect(self._submit)
        self._problem = Callout(kit, "danger", "")
        self._problem.hide()
        self._busy = BusyStripe(kit)
        self._cancel = Button(kit)
        self._cancel.clicked.connect(self.reject)
        self._next = Button(kit, variant="primary", icon_name="send")
        self._next.clicked.connect(self._submit)

        chips = QHBoxLayout()
        chips.setSpacing(kit.px(SPACE[3]))
        for chip in self._chips.values():
            chips.addWidget(chip)
        chips.addStretch(1)
        buttons = QHBoxLayout()
        buttons.addStretch(1)
        buttons.addWidget(self._cancel)
        buttons.addWidget(self._next)
        column = QVBoxLayout(self)
        gap = kit.px(SPACE[6])
        column.setContentsMargins(gap, gap, gap, gap)
        column.setSpacing(gap)
        column.addLayout(chips)
        column.addWidget(self._heading)
        column.addWidget(self._explain)
        column.addWidget(self._input)
        column.addWidget(self._problem)
        column.addWidget(self._busy)
        column.addLayout(buttons)
        bind_kit(kit, language=self._retranslate)
        self._config = self._load_config()
        self._render()
        self._begin()

    @property
    def stage(self) -> str:
        return self._stage

    def _load_config(self) -> TelegramConfig:
        try:
            return load_config(self.gui.service.paths.config_file).telegram
        except ConfigError:
            return self.gui.service.config.telegram

    def _begin(self) -> None:
        if self._control is not None and self._was_running:
            self._stage = "stopping"
            self._render()
            self._control.stop_service(self._service_stopped)
        else:
            self._service_stopped()

    def _service_stopped(self) -> None:
        if self._closing:
            self._finish_closing()
            return
        self._enter("phone")

    def _enter(self, stage: str, attempt: int = 1) -> None:
        self._stage = stage
        self._step = stage
        self._input.clear()
        self._render()
        if attempt > 1:
            self._show_problem(f"settings.login.again.{stage}")
        self._input.setFocus()

    def _retranslate(self) -> None:
        self._render()

    def _render(self) -> None:
        stage = self._stage
        reached = STEPS.index(self._step)
        for index, (name, chip) in enumerate(self._chips.items()):
            chip.set_text(tr(f"settings.login.step.{name}"))
            tone: Tone = "success" if index < reached else "info" if index == reached else "muted"
            if stage == "done":
                tone = "success"
            chip.set_tone(tone)
        self.setWindowTitle(tr("settings.login.title"))
        waiting = stage in ("stopping", "working", "cancelling")
        self._heading.setText(tr(f"settings.login.heading.{stage}"))
        self._explain.setText(tr(f"settings.login.text.{stage}"))
        self._input.setVisible(stage in ("phone", "code", "password"))
        self._input.setEnabled(not waiting)
        self._input.setEchoMode(
            QLineEdit.EchoMode.Password if stage == "password" else QLineEdit.EchoMode.Normal
        )
        self._input.setPlaceholderText(tr(f"settings.login.placeholder.{stage}"))
        self._input.setAccessibleName(tr(f"settings.login.heading.{stage}"))
        self._busy.set_active(waiting)
        self._next.setVisible(stage != "done")
        self._next.setEnabled(not waiting)
        self._next.setText(tr("settings.login.next"))
        self._cancel.setText(tr("common.close") if stage == "done" else tr("common.cancel"))
        self._cancel.setEnabled(stage != "cancelling")
        if stage in ("done",):
            self._problem.hide()

    def _show_problem(self, key: str, **params: object) -> None:
        self._problem.set_body(tr(key, **params))
        self._problem.show()
        self.adjustSize()

    def _valid_phone(self, text: str) -> bool:
        digits = sum(char.isdigit() for char in text)
        return PHONE_PATTERN.fullmatch(text) is not None and digits >= MIN_PHONE_DIGITS

    def _submit(self) -> None:
        stage = self._stage
        text = self._input.text().strip()
        if stage not in ("phone", "code", "password") or not text:
            return
        self._problem.hide()
        if stage == "phone":
            if not self._valid_phone(text):
                self._show_problem("settings.login.err.phone_format")
                return
            self._start_session(text)
        elif self._session is not None:
            self._session.answer(text)
        self._stage = "working"
        self._input.clear()
        self._render()

    def _start_session(self, phone: str) -> None:
        ctx = self.gui.service
        session = LoginSession(
            self._config,
            ctx.paths.session_file,
            ctx.paths.lock_file,
            self._hooks.login,
            phone,
            self,
        )
        session.prompted.connect(self._on_prompt, Qt.ConnectionType.QueuedConnection)
        session.finished.connect(self._on_finished, Qt.ConnectionType.QueuedConnection)
        self._session = session
        session.start()

    @Slot(str, int)
    def _on_prompt(self, kind: str, attempt: int) -> None:
        if self._closing:
            return
        self._enter(kind, attempt)

    @Slot(str, str, int)
    def _on_finished(self, handle: str, failure: str, seconds: int) -> None:
        self._session = None
        self._input.clear()
        if self._closing:
            self._finish_closing()
            return
        if failure:
            self._enter("phone")
            self._show_problem(f"settings.login.err.{failure}", seconds=seconds)
            return
        self._signed_in = True
        self._enter("done")
        self._explain.setText(tr("settings.login.text.done", handle=handle))
        self.signed_in.emit(handle)
        if self._control is not None:
            self._control.start_service()

    def reject(self) -> None:
        if self._stage == "done":
            self.accept()
            return
        self._closing = True
        if self._session is not None and self._session.running:
            self._stage = "cancelling"
            self._render()
            self._session.cancel()
            return
        if self._stage == "stopping":
            self._render()
            return
        self._finish_closing()

    def _finish_closing(self) -> None:
        self._input.clear()
        if self._control is not None and self._was_running and not self._signed_in:
            self._control.start_service()
        QDialog.reject(self)

    def done(self, result: int) -> None:
        self._input.clear()
        super().done(result)

"""`MainWindow`: sidebar, top bar, page stack, status bar and toasts, wired to the service."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, Final

from PySide6.QtCore import QRect, Qt, Signal, Slot
from PySide6.QtGui import QCloseEvent, QGuiApplication, QKeySequence, QShortcut
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QApplication,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QMainWindow,
    QStackedWidget,
    QVBoxLayout,
    QWidget,
)

from chatimport import __version__
from chatimport.gui.i18n import plural, register_strings, tr
from chatimport.gui.locales import shell as shell_strings
from chatimport.gui.pages import PAGE_KEYS
from chatimport.gui.settings import WindowGeometry
from chatimport.gui.setup_wizard import SetupWizard
from chatimport.gui.shell_state import chats_of, service_state
from chatimport.gui.shell_widgets import DownloadIndicator, ServiceChip
from chatimport.gui.widgets.button import Button
from chatimport.gui.widgets.callout import Callout
from chatimport.gui.widgets.sidebar import NavEntry, NavSection, Sidebar
from chatimport.gui.widgets.status_bar import StatusBar
from chatimport.gui.widgets.toast import ToastHost
from chatimport.gui.widgets.top_bar import TopBar
from chatimport.gui.zoom import install_zoom_inputs
from chatimport.runtime import Level

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from concurrent.futures import Future

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

register_strings("shell", shell_strings.EN, shell_strings.RU)

MIN_SIZE: Final = (960, 620)
DEFAULT_SIZE: Final = (1180, 760)
RESTORABLE_PAGES: Final = ("overview", "chats")
LEVEL_TONES: Final[dict[Level, Tone]] = {
    Level.INFO: "info",
    Level.WARNING: "warning",
    Level.ERROR: "danger",
}
SECTIONS: Final = (
    NavSection(
        "nav.section.archive",
        (
            NavEntry("overview", "nav.overview", "home"),
            NavEntry("chats", "nav.chats", "chats"),
            NavEntry("search", "nav.search", "search"),
