        dialog = LibraryDialog(self.gui, self.window())
        dialog.set_errors(self._snapshot.errors)
        dialog.exec()

    def _on_clicked(self, index: QModelIndex) -> None:
        if index.column() != Column.LAST_MESSAGE:
            return
        absolute = not self.model.absolute_time
        self.model.set_absolute_time(absolute)
        self.gui.settings.update(chats_absolute_time=absolute)

    def _on_context_menu(self, position: QPoint) -> None:
        index = self.table.indexAt(position)
        if not index.isValid():
            return
        selection = self.table.selectionModel()
        if not selection.isRowSelected(index.row(), QModelIndex()):
            selection.select(
                index,
                QItemSelectionModel.SelectionFlag.ClearAndSelect
                | QItemSelectionModel.SelectionFlag.Rows,
            )
        menu = self.chat_actions.build_menu(self.selected_rows(), self.table)
        menu.exec(self.table.viewport().mapToGlobal(position))

        menu = self.chat_actions.build_menu(self.selected_rows(), self)
        menu.exec(self.more_button.mapToGlobal(QPoint(0, self.more_button.height())))

    def _on_query(self, text: str) -> None:
        self.proxy.set_query(text)
        self._sync_stack()

    def _on_filter(self, position: int) -> None:
        mode = self.filter.itemData(position)
        if isinstance(mode, str):
            self.proxy.set_mode(FilterMode(mode))
            self._sync_stack()
            self._sync_count()

    def _on_second(self) -> None:
        self.model.tick()
        self.proxy.refresh_time()
        self._sync_count()

    def _on_frame(self, phase: float) -> None:
        self.delegate.phase = phase
        self.table.viewport().update()

    def _update_animation(self) -> None:
        running = any(row.backfill.state.value == "running" for row in self._snapshot.chats)
        if running and not self._animating:
            self._ticker.acquire_animation()
        elif not running and self._animating:
            self._ticker.release_animation()
        self._animating = running

    def _sync_selection(self) -> None:
        rows = self.selected_rows()
        have = bool(rows)
        if have:
            self.selection_label.setText(plural(len(rows), "chats.selection.count"))
        else:
            self.selection_label.setText(tr("chats.selection.none"))
        any_paused = any(row.is_paused for row in rows)
        self.pause_button.setEnabled(have and not all(row.is_paused for row in rows))
        self.resume_button.setEnabled(have and any_paused)
        self.recheck_button.setEnabled(have)
        self.deeper_button.setEnabled(have)
        self.more_button.setEnabled(have)

    def _sync_stack(self) -> None:
        if self.model.rowCount() == 0:
            self.stack.setCurrentWidget(self.empty)
        elif self.proxy.rowCount() == 0:
            self.stack.setCurrentWidget(self.no_matches)
        else:
            self.stack.setCurrentWidget(self.table)

    def _sync_count(self) -> None:
        shown, total = self.proxy.rowCount(), self.model.rowCount()
        language = current_language()
        text = plural(total, "count.chats")
        if shown != total:
            text = f"{format_count(shown, language)} / {text}"
        self.count.setText(text)

    def _retranslate(self) -> None:
        current = self.proxy.mode.value
        self.filter.blockSignals(True)
        self.filter.clear()
        for mode in FILTER_ORDER:
            self.filter.addItem(tr(f"chats.filter.{mode.value}"), mode.value)
        self.filter.setCurrentIndex(self.filter.findData(current))
        self.filter.blockSignals(False)
        self.filter.setAccessibleName(tr("chats.filter.label"))
        self.library.setText(tr("chats.library"))
        self.library.setToolTip(tr("chats.library_tip"))
        self.library_action.setText(tr("chats.empty.action"))
        self.pause_button.setText(tr("chats.act.pause"))
        self.resume_button.setText(tr("chats.act.resume"))
        self.recheck_button.setText(tr("chats.act.recheck"))
        self.deeper_button.setText(tr("chats.act.deeper"))
        self.more_button.set_tooltip(tr("chats.act.more"))
        self.empty.set_texts(tr("chats.empty.title"), tr("chats.empty.text"))
        self.no_matches.set_texts(tr("empty.search.title"), tr("empty.search.text"))
        self.model.retranslate()
        self._sync_selection()
        self._sync_count()
        self._rebuild_legend()
        self.table.viewport().update()

    def _restyle(self) -> None:
        kit = self.gui.kit
        pad = kit.px(PAGE_PADDING)
        self._column.setContentsMargins(pad, kit.px(SPACE[6]), pad, kit.px(SPACE[5]))
        self._column.setSpacing(kit.px(SPACE[4]))
        self.table.verticalHeader().setDefaultSectionSize(kit.px(ROW_HEIGHT))
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        header.setMinimumSectionSize(kit.px(CHAT_MIN_WIDTH))
        for column, width in COLUMN_WIDTHS.items():
            self.table.setColumnWidth(column, kit.px(width))
        self.table.horizontalHeader().setSectionResizeMode(
            Column.CHAT, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch
        )

    def _rebuild_legend(self) -> None:
        clear_layout(self.legend)
        palette = self.gui.theme.palette
        thresholds = self.gui.settings.settings.freshness
        language = current_language()
        self.legend.addWidget(make_label(tr("chats.legend.age"), "caption"))
        steps = (
            (Freshness.FRESH, f"< {humanize_age(thresholds.fresh_below, language)}"),
            (Freshness.RECENT, f"< {humanize_age(thresholds.recent_below, language)}"),
            (Freshness.STALE, f"< {humanize_age(thresholds.stale_below, language)}"),
            (Freshness.DORMANT, tr("chats.legend.older")),
        )
        for level, bound in steps:
            label = make_label(f"● {tr(f'freshness.{level.value}')} {bound}", "caption")
            label.setStyleSheet(f"color: {freshness_color(palette, level)};")
            self.legend.addWidget(label)
        self.legend.addStretch(1)

"""What the owner can do with selected chats: commands to the service, folder and export.

Commands go through the bridge and come back as toasts built from translation keys; the text of
an exception never reaches the screen. Destructive ones (refetch, trim) ask first.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, Final

from PySide6.QtCore import QObject, QUrl
from PySide6.QtGui import QAction, QDesktopServices
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QMenu, QMessageBox

from chatimport.export import export_chat_json
from chatimport.gui.i18n import plural, tr
from chatimport.gui.icons import icon
from chatimport.gui.locales import chats as _chat_strings
from chatimport.gui.pages.support import MainThreadRunner, notify
from chatimport.gui.tokens import LAYOUT
from chatimport.storage.layout import find_chat_folder

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Sequence
    from concurrent.futures import Future
    from pathlib import Path

    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QWidget

    from chatimport.commands import CommandResult
    from chatimport.gui.context import GuiContext
    from chatimport.gui.models.snapshot import ChatRow

_ = _chat_strings
TRIM_STEPS: Final = (25, 50, 75)


class ChatActions(QObject):
    """Stateless apart from the runner; `rows` is always the current selection."""

    def __init__(self, gui: GuiContext, page: QWidget) -> None:
        super().__init__(page)
        self._gui = gui
        self._page = page
        self._runner = MainThreadRunner(self)

    def pause(self, rows: Sequence[ChatRow]) -> None:
        self._send("pause", [r for r in rows if not r.is_paused] or list(rows))

    def resume(self, rows: Sequence[ChatRow]) -> None:
        self._send("resume", [r for r in rows if r.is_paused] or list(rows))

    def recheck(self, rows: Sequence[ChatRow]) -> None:
        self._send("recheck", rows)

    def deeper(self, rows: Sequence[ChatRow]) -> None:
        self._send("deeper", rows)

    def refetch(self, rows: Sequence[ChatRow]) -> None:
        text = plural(len(rows), "chats.confirm.refetch.text")
        if self._confirm(tr("chats.confirm.refetch.title"), text, tr("chats.confirm.refetch.yes")):
            self._send("refetch", rows)

    def trim(self, rows: Sequence[ChatRow], pct: int) -> None:
        text = plural(len(rows), "chats.confirm.trim.text", pct=pct)
        title = tr("chats.confirm.trim.title", pct=pct)
        if self._confirm(title, text, tr("chats.confirm.trim.yes")):
            self._send("trim", rows, {"pct": pct})

    def open_folder(self, row: ChatRow) -> None:
        root = self._gui.current.root
        self._runner.submit(lambda: find_chat_folder(root, row.chat_id), self._opened)

    def export(self, row: ChatRow) -> None:
        root = self._gui.current.root

        def work() -> Path | None:
            folder = find_chat_folder(root, row.chat_id)
            return None if folder is None else export_chat_json(folder, include_names=False)

        self._runner.submit(work, self._exported)

    def build_menu(self, rows: Sequence[ChatRow], parent: QWidget | None = None) -> QMenu:
        menu = QMenu(parent or self._page)
        single = len(rows) == 1
        have = bool(rows)
        self._add(menu, "pause", tr("chats.act.pause"), have, lambda: self.pause(rows))
        self._add(menu, "play", tr("chats.act.resume"), have, lambda: self.resume(rows))
        self._add(menu, "refresh", tr("chats.act.recheck"), have, lambda: self.recheck(rows))
        self._add(menu, "download", tr("chats.act.deeper"), have, lambda: self.deeper(rows))
        menu.addSeparator()
        self._add(menu, "refresh", tr("chats.act.refetch"), have, lambda: self.refetch(rows))
        trim = menu.addMenu(
            icon("trash", self._gui.theme.palette.fg_secondary, self._icon_px()),
            tr("chats.act.trim"),
        )
        trim.setEnabled(have)
        for pct in TRIM_STEPS:
            action = trim.addAction(tr("chats.act.trim_pct", pct=pct))
            action.triggered.connect(lambda _=False, p=pct: self.trim(rows, p))
        menu.addSeparator()
        self._add(
            menu, "folder-open", tr("chats.act.open"), single, lambda: self.open_folder(rows[0])
        )
        self._add(menu, "upload", tr("chats.act.export"), single, lambda: self.export(rows[0]))
        return menu

    def _icon_px(self) -> int:
        return self._gui.zoom.scaled(LAYOUT["icon_md"])

    def _add(self, menu: QMenu, icon_name: str, text: str, enabled: bool, call: Any) -> None:
        action = QAction(
            icon(icon_name, self._gui.theme.palette.fg_secondary, self._icon_px()), text, menu
        )
        action.setEnabled(enabled)
        action.triggered.connect(lambda _=False: call())
        menu.addAction(action)

    def _confirm(self, title: str, text: str, accept: str) -> bool:
        box = QMessageBox(self._page)
        box.setIcon(QMessageBox.Icon.Warning)
        box.setWindowTitle(title)
        box.setText(title)
        box.setInformativeText(text)
        yes = box.addButton(accept, QMessageBox.ButtonRole.AcceptRole)
        cancel = box.addButton(tr("common.cancel"), QMessageBox.ButtonRole.RejectRole)
        box.setDefaultButton(cancel)
        box.exec()
        return box.clickedButton() is yes

    def _send(
        self, command: str, rows: Sequence[ChatRow], extra: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    ) -> None:
        if not rows:
            return
        pending = {"left": len(rows), "ok": 0, "unavailable": False}

        def finished(done: Future[CommandResult]) -> None:
            pending["left"] -= 1
            try:
                if done.result().ok:
                    pending["ok"] += 1
            except Exception:
                pending["unavailable"] = True
            if pending["left"]:
                return
            if pending["ok"]:
                notify(self._page, "success", plural(pending["ok"], f"chats.toast.{command}"))
            elif pending["unavailable"]:
                notify(self._page, "warning", tr("error.service_unavailable"))
            else:
                notify(self._page, "danger", tr("chats.toast.failed"))

        for row in rows:
            future = self._gui.bridge.execute(command, {"chat": row.chat_id, **(extra or {})})
            self._runner.watch(future, finished)

    def _opened(self, done: Future[Path | None]) -> None:
        folder = done.exception() or done.result()
        if isinstance(folder, BaseException) or folder is None:
            notify(self._page, "warning", tr("chats.toast.no_folder"))
            return
        QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl.fromLocalFile(str(folder)))

    def _exported(self, done: Future[Path | None]) -> None:
        result = done.exception() or done.result()
        if isinstance(result, BaseException):
            notify(self._page, "danger", tr("chats.toast.export_failed"))
        elif result is None:
            notify(self._page, "warning", tr("chats.toast.no_folder"))
        else:
            notify(self._page, "success", tr("chats.toast.export_ok", path=str(result)))

"""Paints the chats table cells: titles with ids, pills, the live progress bar, the age."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from PySide6.QtCore import QModelIndex, QRect, Qt
from PySide6.QtGui import QColor, QFontMetrics, QPainter
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QStyle, QStyledItemDelegate, QStyleOptionViewItem

from chatimport.gui.format import format_count, format_percent
from chatimport.gui.models.chats_model import ROW_ROLE, ChatsTableModel, Column
from chatimport.gui.models.presentation import (
    history_chip,
    history_detail,
    span_text,
    status_chip,
)
from chatimport.gui.pages.paint import (
    BAR_HEIGHT,
    chip_height,
    draw_bar,
    draw_chip,
    draw_dot,
    token_font,
)
from chatimport.gui.strings import current_language
from chatimport.gui.theme import freshness_color
from chatimport.gui.tokens import SPACE
from chatimport.runtime import BackfillState

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from PySide6.QtCore import QPersistentModelIndex

    from chatimport.gui.kit import UiKit
    from chatimport.gui.models.snapshot import ChatRow

type _Index = QModelIndex | QPersistentModelIndex


class ChatsDelegate(QStyledItemDelegate):
    def __init__(self, kit: UiKit, model: ChatsTableModel) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.kit = kit
        self._model = model
        self.phase = 0.0

    def _row(self, index: _Index) -> ChatRow | None:
        value = index.data(ROW_ROLE)
        return value if hasattr(value, "chat_id") else None

    def paint(self, painter: QPainter, option: QStyleOptionViewItem, index: _Index) -> None:
        row = self._row(index)
        if row is None:
            super().paint(painter, option, index)
            return
        background = QStyleOptionViewItem(option)
        self.initStyleOption(background, index)
        background.text = ""
        background.features &= ~QStyleOptionViewItem.ViewItemFeature.HasDisplay
        style = option.widget.style() if option.widget else None
        if style is not None:
            style.drawControl(
                QStyle.ControlElement.CE_ItemViewItem, background, painter, option.widget
            )
        pad = self.kit.px(SPACE[4])
        area = option.rect.adjusted(pad, 0, -pad, 0)
        painter.save()
        painter.setClipRect(option.rect)
        column = Column(index.column())
        if column is Column.CHAT:
            self._paint_chat(painter, option, area, row)
        elif column is Column.STATUS:
            self._paint_status(painter, option, area, row)
        elif column is Column.HISTORY:
            self._paint_history(painter, option, area, row)
        elif column is Column.LAST_MESSAGE:
            self._paint_last(painter, option, area, row, str(index.data()))
        else:
            self._paint_plain(painter, option, area, row, column)
        painter.restore()

    def _paint_chat(
        self, painter: QPainter, option: QStyleOptionViewItem, area: QRect, row: ChatRow
    ) -> None:
        palette = self.kit.palette
        if row.has_problem:
            tone = palette.danger if not row.has_access or row.error else palette.warning
            strip = QRect(
                option.rect.left(), option.rect.top() + 6, self.kit.px(3), option.rect.height() - 12
            )
            painter.setPen(Qt.PenStyle.NoPen)
            painter.setBrush(QColor(tone))
            painter.drawRoundedRect(strip, 1.5, 1.5)
        title_font = token_font(option.font, self.kit, "base", "medium")
        id_font = token_font(option.font, self.kit, "xs")
        title_h = QFontMetrics(title_font).height()
        id_h = QFontMetrics(id_font).height()
        top = area.top() + (area.height() - title_h - id_h) // 2
        title_rect = QRect(area.left(), top, area.width(), title_h)
        id_rect = QRect(area.left(), top + title_h, area.width(), id_h)
        painter.setFont(title_font)
        painter.setPen(QColor(palette.fg))
        painter.drawText(
            title_rect,
            int(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter),
            QFontMetrics(title_font).elidedText(
                row.title, Qt.TextElideMode.ElideRight, area.width()
            ),
        )
        painter.setFont(id_font)
        painter.setPen(QColor(palette.fg_muted))
        painter.drawText(
            id_rect,
            int(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter),
            str(row.chat_id),
        )

    def _paint_status(
        self, painter: QPainter, option: QStyleOptionViewItem, area: QRect, row: ChatRow
    ) -> None:
        spec = status_chip(row, current_language())
        top = area.top() + (area.height() - chip_height(self.kit)) // 2
        draw_chip(painter, self.kit, spec, area.left(), top, option.font)

    def _paint_history(
        self, painter: QPainter, option: QStyleOptionViewItem, area: QRect, row: ChatRow
    ) -> None:
        language = current_language()
        info = row.backfill
        spec = history_chip(row, language)
        height = chip_height(self.kit)
        running = info.state is BackfillState.RUNNING
        gap = self.kit.px(SPACE[2])
        block = height + (gap + self.kit.px(BAR_HEIGHT) if running else 0)
        top = area.top() + (area.height() - block) // 2
        width = draw_chip(painter, self.kit, spec, area.left(), top, option.font)
        small = token_font(option.font, self.kit, "xs")
        painter.setFont(small)
        painter.setPen(QColor(self.kit.palette.fg_muted))
        detail = history_detail(row, self._model.now(), language)
        left = area.left() + width + self.kit.px(SPACE[3])
        if detail:
            painter.drawText(
                QRect(left, top, max(area.right() - left, 0), height),
                int(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter),
                QFontMetrics(small).elidedText(
                    detail, Qt.TextElideMode.ElideRight, area.right() - left
                ),
            )
        if running:
            if info.progress is not None:
                percent = format_percent(info.progress, language)
                painter.drawText(
                    QRect(left, top, max(area.right() - left, 0), height),
                    int(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter),
                    percent,
                )
            bar = QRect(area.left(), top + height + gap, area.width(), self.kit.px(BAR_HEIGHT))
            draw_bar(painter, self.kit, bar, info.progress, self.kit.palette.live, self.phase)

    def _paint_last(
        self,
        painter: QPainter,
        option: QStyleOptionViewItem,
        area: QRect,
        row: ChatRow,
        text: str,
    ) -> None:
        palette = self.kit.palette
        color = freshness_color(palette, self._model.freshness(row))
        left = area.left()
        left += draw_dot(painter, self.kit, color, left, area.center().y()) + self.kit.px(SPACE[3])
        painter.setFont(token_font(option.font, self.kit, "base", "medium"))
        painter.setPen(QColor(color))
        metrics = painter.fontMetrics()
        painter.drawText(
            QRect(left, area.top(), max(area.right() - left, 0), area.height()),
            int(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter),
            metrics.elidedText(text, Qt.TextElideMode.ElideRight, max(area.right() - left, 0)),
        )

    def _paint_plain(
        self,
        painter: QPainter,
        option: QStyleOptionViewItem,
        area: QRect,
        row: ChatRow,
        column: Column,
    ) -> None:
        palette = self.kit.palette
        language = current_language()
        if column is Column.MESSAGES:
            text = format_count(row.records, language)
            flags, color = Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight, palette.fg
            painter.setFont(token_font(option.font, self.kit, "base"))
        else:
            text = span_text(row)
            flags, color = Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft, palette.fg_secondary
            painter.setFont(token_font(option.font, self.kit, "sm"))
        painter.setPen(QColor(color))
        painter.drawText(area, int(flags | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter), text)

"""The Data page: storage, clean-up, integrity, the data folder and export, in one column."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from PySide6.QtWidgets import QHBoxLayout, QScrollArea, QVBoxLayout, QWidget

from chatimport.gui.i18n import tr
from chatimport.gui.locales import data as _data_strings
from chatimport.gui.pages.data_cleanup import CleanupCard
from chatimport.gui.pages.data_common import DataEnv
from chatimport.gui.pages.data_export import ExportCard
from chatimport.gui.pages.data_folder import FolderCard
from chatimport.gui.pages.data_integrity import IntegrityCard
from chatimport.gui.pages.data_merged import MergedCard
from chatimport.gui.pages.data_storage import StorageCard
from chatimport.gui.tokens import LAYOUT, SPACE
from chatimport.gui.widgets.base import bind_kit
from chatimport.usage import ArchiveUsage, archive_usage

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from concurrent.futures import Future

    from PySide6.QtGui import QShowEvent

    from chatimport.gui.context import GuiContext

_ = _data_strings


class DataPage(QWidget):
    title_key = "nav.data"
    subtitle_key = "data.subtitle"

    def __init__(self, gui: GuiContext, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.gui = gui
        self._computed = False
        self._calculating = False
        self._again = False
        self.env = DataEnv(gui, self)
        self.storage = StorageCard(self.env)
        self.cleanup = CleanupCard(self.env)
        self.integrity = IntegrityCard(self.env)
        self.folder = FolderCard(self.env)
        self.export = ExportCard(self.env)
        self.merged = MergedCard(self.env)

        content = QWidget()
        content.setObjectName("DataContent")
        self._content = content
        self._stack = QVBoxLayout(content)
        cards = (self.storage, self.cleanup, self.integrity, self.folder, self.export, self.merged)
        for card in cards:
            self._stack.addWidget(card)
        self._stack.addStretch(1)
        wrap = QHBoxLayout()
        wrap.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        wrap.addStretch(1)
        wrap.addWidget(content, 100)
        wrap.addStretch(1)
        host = QWidget()
        host.setLayout(wrap)
        self._scroll = QScrollArea()
        self._scroll.setWidgetResizable(True)
        self._scroll.setWidget(host)
        outer = QVBoxLayout(self)
        outer.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        outer.addWidget(self._scroll)

        self.env.request_usage.connect(self.calculate)
        bind_kit(gui.kit, zoom=self._restyle)
        self._restyle()

    def calculate(self) -> None:
        """Compute the sizes on a worker thread; a request during a run repeats it once."""
        if self._calculating:
            self._again = True
            return
        self._calculating = True
        self._computed = True
        self.storage.set_busy(True)
        root = self.env.root
        self.env.runner.submit(lambda: archive_usage(root), self._calculated)

    def showEvent(self, event: QShowEvent) -> None:
        super().showEvent(event)
        if not self._computed:
            self.calculate()

    def _calculated(self, done: Future[ArchiveUsage]) -> None:
        self._calculating = False
        self.storage.set_busy(False)
        if done.exception() is None:
            self.env.set_usage(done.result())
        else:
            self.env.toast("danger", tr("data.storage.failed"))
        if self._again:
            self._again = False
            self.calculate()

    def _restyle(self) -> None:
        px = self.gui.kit.px
        self._content.setMaximumWidth(px(LAYOUT["content_max"]))
        pad = px(SPACE[8])
        self._stack.setContentsMargins(pad, px(SPACE[7]), pad, px(SPACE[8]))
        self._stack.setSpacing(px(SPACE[6]))

"""The Cleanup card: preview what removing the oldest 25/50/75 % would do, then do it."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any

class CleanupCard(Section):
    def __init__(self, env: DataEnv, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(env, "cleanup", "trash", parent=parent)
        kit = self.kit
        self._preview: TrimPreview | None = None
        self._busy = False
        self.chat = ChatSelector(allow_all=True)
        self.share = Segmented(kit, self._options(), str(ALLOWED_PERCENTS[1]), compact=True)
        self.preview_button = Button(kit, "", icon_name="search")
        self.run_button = Button(kit, "", variant="danger", icon_name="trash")
        self.run_button.setEnabled(False)
        self._chat_field = FieldRow(kit, "", self.chat)
        self._share_field = FieldRow(kit, "", self.share)
        row = toolbar(kit)
        row.addWidget(self._chat_field, 1)
        row.addWidget(self._share_field)
        actions = toolbar(kit)
        actions.addStretch(1)
        actions.addWidget(self.preview_button)
        actions.addWidget(self.run_button)
        self.hint = make_label("", "muted", wrap=True)
        self.summary = make_label("", None, wrap=True)
        self.note = Callout(kit, "info", "")
        self.model = PreviewModel()
        self.table = QTableView()
        self.table.setModel(self.model)
        configure_table(self.table, kit)
        prepare_table(self.table)
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        header.setStretchLastSection(False)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(PreviewColumn.CHAT, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch)
        for number in (PreviewColumn.RECORDS, PreviewColumn.SIZE, PreviewColumn.OLDEST):
            header.setSectionResizeMode(number, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        self.table.hide()
        self.content.addLayout(row)
        self.content.addLayout(actions)
        self.content.addWidget(self.summary)
        self.content.addWidget(self.hint)
        self.content.addWidget(self.table)
        self.content.addWidget(self.note)
        self.chat.currentIndexChanged.connect(self._invalidate)
        self.share.selected.connect(self._invalidate)
        self.preview_button.clicked.connect(self.preview)
        self.run_button.clicked.connect(self.run)
        env.usage_changed.connect(lambda: self.chat.set_chats(env.chats()))
        bind_kit(kit, zoom=self._apply_sizes)
        self._apply_sizes()
        self.retranslate()

    def _options(self) -> list[SegmentOption]:
        return [SegmentOption(str(pct), f"{pct}%") for pct in ALLOWED_PERCENTS]

    def selected_pct(self) -> int:
        return int(self.share.value)

    def retranslate(self) -> None:
        self._chat_field.set_caption(tr("data.cleanup.chat"))
        self._share_field.set_caption(tr("data.cleanup.share"))
        self.preview_button.setText(tr("data.cleanup.preview"))
        self.run_button.setText(tr("data.cleanup.run"))
        self.hint.setText(tr("data.cleanup.hint"))
        self.note.set_body(tr("data.cleanup.size_note"))
        self.chat.rebuild()
        self.model.retranslate()
        self._render_summary()

    def _apply_sizes(self) -> None:
        fit_table(self.table, self.kit, self.model.rowCount())

    def _invalidate(self, *_args: object) -> None:
        if self._preview is None:
            return
        self._preview = None
        self.model.set_preview(())
        self.run_button.setEnabled(False)
        self._show_table(False)
        self._render_summary()

    def _show_table(self, shown: bool) -> None:
        self.table.setVisible(shown)
        self.hint.setVisible(not shown)

    def _set_busy(self, busy: bool) -> None:
        self._busy = busy
        self.set_busy(busy)
        self.preview_button.setEnabled(not busy)
        self.run_button.setEnabled(not busy and self._can_run())

    def _can_run(self) -> bool:
        return self._preview is not None and self._preview.records_deleted > 0

    def preview(self) -> None:
        if self._busy:
            return
        root, pct, chat_id = self.env.root, self.selected_pct(), self.chat.chat_id()
        self._set_busy(True)
        self.env.runner.submit(lambda: preview_percent(root, pct, chat_id), self._previewed)

    def _previewed(self, done: Future[TrimPreview]) -> None:
        self._set_busy(False)
        if done.exception() is not None:
            self.env.toast("danger", tr("data.failed"))
            return
        self._preview = done.result()
        self.model.set_preview(self._preview.chats)
        self._show_table(True)
        fit_table(self.table, self.kit, self.model.rowCount())
        self.run_button.setEnabled(self._can_run())
        self._render_summary()

    def _render_summary(self) -> None:
        preview = self._preview
        self.summary.setVisible(preview is not None)
        if preview is None:
            return
        if preview.records_deleted == 0:
            self.summary.setText(tr("data.cleanup.summary_none"))
            return
        size = format_bytes(preview.bytes_freed, current_language())
        self.summary.setText(plural(preview.records_deleted, "data.cleanup.summary", size=size))

    def _scope(self) -> str:
        return (
            tr("data.cleanup.confirm.scope_all")
            if self.chat.chat_id() is None
            else (self.chat.title())
        )

    def run(self) -> None:
        preview = self._preview
        if self._busy or preview is None or preview.records_deleted == 0:
            return
        pct = preview.pct
        size = format_bytes(preview.bytes_freed, current_language())
        text = plural(
            preview.records_deleted, "data.cleanup.confirm.text", size=size, scope=self._scope()
        )
        if not self.env.confirm(
            tr("data.cleanup.confirm.title", pct=pct), text, tr("data.cleanup.confirm.yes")
        ):
            return
        args: dict[str, Any] = {"pct": pct}
        chat_id = self.chat.chat_id()
        if chat_id is not None:
            args["chat"] = chat_id
        self._set_busy(True)
        self.env.runner.watch(self.env.gui.bridge.execute("trim", args), self._trimmed)

    def _trimmed(self, done: Future[CommandResult]) -> None:
        self._set_busy(False)
        try:
            result = done.result()
        except Exception:
            self.env.unavailable()
            return
        if not result.ok:
            self.env.toast("danger", tr("data.cleanup.toast.failed"))
            return
        records = result.data.get("records")
        freed = result.data.get("bytes")
        count = records if isinstance(records, int) else 0
        size = format_bytes(freed if isinstance(freed, int) else 0, current_language())
        self.env.toast("success", plural(count, "data.cleanup.toast.ok", size=size))
        self._invalidate()
        self.env.request_usage.emit()

class DataEnv(QObject):
    """What every card shares: the data root, latest usage, runner, toasts and confirmations."""

    usage_changed = Signal()
    root_changed = Signal()
    request_usage = Signal()

    def __init__(self, gui: GuiContext, page: QWidget) -> None:
        super().__init__(page)
        self.gui = gui
        self.page = page
        self.runner = MainThreadRunner(self)
        self.root: Path = gui.current.root
        self.usage: ArchiveUsage | None = None

    def set_usage(self, usage: ArchiveUsage) -> None:
        self.usage = usage
        self.usage_changed.emit()

    def set_root(self, root: Path) -> None:
        self.root = root
        self.usage = None
        self.root_changed.emit()
        self.request_usage.emit()

    def chats(self) -> list[tuple[int, str]]:
        """(chat id, title) of every readable chat in the latest usage, by title."""
        if self.usage is None:
            return []
        pairs = [
            (chat.chat_id, chat.title or str(chat.chat_id))
            for chat in self.usage.chats
            if chat.chat_id is not None
        ]
        return sorted(pairs, key=lambda pair: pair[1].casefold())

    def toast(self, tone: Tone, message: str) -> None:
        notify(self.page, tone, message)

    def unavailable(self) -> None:
        self.toast("warning", tr("data.unavailable"))

    def confirm(self, title: str, text: str, accept: str, *, danger: bool = True) -> bool:
        box = QMessageBox(self.page)
        box.setIcon(QMessageBox.Icon.Warning if danger else QMessageBox.Icon.Question)
        box.setWindowTitle(title)
        box.setText(title)
        box.setInformativeText(text)
        yes = box.addButton(accept, QMessageBox.ButtonRole.AcceptRole)
        cancel = box.addButton(tr("common.cancel"), QMessageBox.ButtonRole.RejectRole)
        box.setDefaultButton(cancel)
        box.exec()
        return box.clickedButton() is yes

    def open_folder(self, folder: Path) -> None:
        if not QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl.fromLocalFile(str(folder))):
            self.toast("warning", tr("data.folder.toast.opened_failed"))


class ChatSelector(QComboBox):
    """A combo box of chats; with `allow_all` the first entry means "every chat" (id None)."""

    def __init__(self, *, allow_all: bool) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self._allow_all = allow_all
        self._chats: list[tuple[int, str]] = []
        self.setMinimumContentsLength(12)
        self.setSizeAdjustPolicy(QComboBox.SizeAdjustPolicy.AdjustToMinimumContentsLengthWithIcon)

    def set_chats(self, chats: list[tuple[int, str]]) -> None:
        current = self.chat_id()
        self._chats = chats
        self.rebuild(current)

    def rebuild(self, keep: int | None = None) -> None:
        wanted = self.chat_id() if keep is None else keep
        self.blockSignals(True)
        self.clear()
        if self._allow_all:
            self.addItem(tr("data.all_chats"), None)
        for chat_id, title in self._chats:
            self.addItem(title, chat_id)
        index = self.findData(wanted)
        self.setCurrentIndex(max(index, 0))
        self.setEnabled(self.count() > 0)
        self.blockSignals(False)
        self.currentIndexChanged.emit(self.currentIndex())

    def chat_id(self) -> int | None:
        data = self.currentData()
        return data if isinstance(data, int) else None

    def title(self) -> str:
        return self.currentText()


class FieldRow(QWidget):
    """A small caption above a control, so toolbars of cards line up."""

    def __init__(self, kit: UiKit, caption: str, control: QWidget) -> None:
        super().__init__()

        self._caption = make_label(caption, "caption")

        self._column.addWidget(self._caption)
        self._column.addWidget(control)
        bind_kit(kit, zoom=self._restyle)
        self._restyle()

    def set_caption(self, text: str) -> None:
        self._caption.setText(text)

    def _restyle(self) -> None:
        self._column.setSpacing(self._kit.px(SPACE[2]))


def toolbar(kit: UiKit) -> QHBoxLayout:
    row = QHBoxLayout()
    row.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
    row.setSpacing(kit.px(SPACE[4]))
    return row


def fit_table(view: QTableView, kit: UiKit, rows: int) -> None:
    """Size a table to its rows (up to `TABLE_MAX_ROWS`) so the cards stay compact."""
    shown = min(max(rows, 1), TABLE_MAX_ROWS)
    row_height = view.verticalHeader().defaultSectionSize()
    frame = 2 * view.frameWidth() + kit.px(2)
    view.setFixedHeight(view.horizontalHeader().height() + shown * row_height + frame)


def prepare_table(view: QTableView) -> None:
    view.setSelectionMode(QAbstractItemView.SelectionMode.NoSelection)
    view.setFocusPolicy(Qt.FocusPolicy.NoFocus)
    view.setWordWrap(False)
    view.setHorizontalScrollMode(QAbstractItemView.ScrollMode.ScrollPerPixel)
    view.setTextElideMode(Qt.TextElideMode.ElideRight)


class _CellDelegate(QStyledItemDelegate):
    def __init__(self, kit: UiKit) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.kit = kit

    def paint_background(
        self, painter: QPainter, option: QStyleOptionViewItem, index: _Index
    ) -> QRect:
        background = QStyleOptionViewItem(option)
        self.initStyleOption(background, index)
        background.text = ""
        background.features &= ~QStyleOptionViewItem.ViewItemFeature.HasDisplay
        style = option.widget.style() if option.widget else None
        if style is not None:
            style.drawControl(
                QStyle.ControlElement.CE_ItemViewItem, background, painter, option.widget
            )
        pad = self.kit.px(SPACE[4])
        return option.rect.adjusted(pad, 0, -pad, 0)


class ShareBarDelegate(_CellDelegate):
    """The proportional bar of a chat: its length is relative to the largest chat, the media part
    of it is drawn in the accent-soft colour next to the messages part."""

    def paint(self, painter: QPainter, option: QStyleOptionViewItem, index: _Index) -> None:
        if index.column() != UsageColumn.SHARE:
            super().paint(painter, option, index)
            return
        area = self.paint_background(painter, option, index)
        share = index.data(SHARE_ROLE)
        media = index.data(MEDIA_SHARE_ROLE)
        if not isinstance(share, float) or not isinstance(media, float):
            return
        palette = self.kit.palette
        height = self.kit.px(SPACE[3])
        track = QRectF(area.left(), area.center().y() - height / 2, area.width(), height)
        painter.save()
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing)
        painter.setPen(Qt.PenStyle.NoPen)
        painter.setBrush(QColor(palette.surface_active))
        painter.drawRoundedRect(track, height / 2, height / 2)
        total = max(track.width() * share, min(track.width(), float(height)))
        messages = total * (1 - media)
        painter.setClipRect(QRectF(track.left(), track.top(), total, height))
        painter.setBrush(QColor(palette.accent))
        painter.drawRoundedRect(
            QRectF(track.left(), track.top(), total, height), height / 2, height / 2
        )
        if media > 0:
            painter.setBrush(QColor(palette.live))
            painter.drawRect(QRectF(track.left() + messages, track.top(), total - messages, height))
        painter.restore()


class SeverityDelegate(_CellDelegate):
    def paint(self, painter: QPainter, option: QStyleOptionViewItem, index: _Index) -> None:
        if index.column() != IssueColumn.SEVERITY:
            super().paint(painter, option, index)
            return
        area = self.paint_background(painter, option, index)
        tone = index.data(TONE_ROLE)
        if tone not in SEVERITY_ICONS:
            return
        spec = ChipSpec(str(index.data()), tone, SEVERITY_ICONS[tone])
        top = area.top() + (area.height() - chip_height(self.kit)) // 2
        painter.save()
        painter.setClipRect(option.rect)
        draw_chip(painter, self.kit, spec, area.left(), top, option.font)
        painter.restore()


ZERO_WIDTH_SPACE: Final = chr(0x200B)


def breakable(path: str) -> str:
    """The path with a zero-width break after each separator, so a wrapping label can wrap it."""
    for separator in ("\\", "/"):
        path = path.replace(separator, separator + ZERO_WIDTH_SPACE)
    return path

"""The Export card: one chat as a JSON file, names left out unless asked."""

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QFileDialog, QFrame, QHBoxLayout

from chatimport.export import EXPORTS_DIR, export_chat_json

        head.addWidget(self.run_button, 0, Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignBottom)
        self.content.addLayout(head)
        self.content.addWidget(self.names)
        self.content.addWidget(self.names_warning)
        self.content.addWidget(self._dest_caption)
        self.content.addLayout(dest)
        self.content.addWidget(self._dest_hint)
        self.content.addWidget(self.empty)
        self.content.addWidget(self.done_row)
        self.names.toggled.connect(self.names_warning.setVisible)
        self.browse.clicked.connect(self._browse)
        self.reset.clicked.connect(self._reset)
        self.run_button.clicked.connect(self.export)
        self.open_button.clicked.connect(self._open)
        env.usage_changed.connect(self._on_usage)
        env.root_changed.connect(self._render_destination)
        bind_kit(kit, zoom=self._apply_sizes)
        self._apply_sizes()
        self.retranslate()

    def _apply_sizes(self) -> None:
        px = self.kit.px
        self._dest_row.setContentsMargins(px(SPACE[4]), px(SPACE[2]), px(SPACE[4]), px(SPACE[2]))

    def retranslate(self) -> None:
        self._chat_field.set_caption(tr("data.export.chat"))
        self.names.set_texts(tr("data.export.names"), tr("data.export.names_hint"))
        self.names_warning.set_body(tr("data.export.names_warning"))
        self._dest_caption.setText(tr("data.export.destination"))
        self.browse.setText(tr("data.export.browse"))
        self.open_button.setText(tr("data.export.open"))
        self.empty.setText(tr("data.export.no_chat"))
        self._set_busy(self._busy)
        self.chat.rebuild()
        self._render_destination()
        if self._last is not None:
            self.done_row.set_body(tr("data.export.done", path=breakable(str(self._last))))

    def _on_usage(self) -> None:
        self.chat.set_chats(self.env.chats())
        self.empty.setVisible(self.chat.count() == 0)
        self.run_button.setEnabled(self.chat.count() > 0 and not self._busy)

    def _render_destination(self) -> None:
        shown = self._destination or self.env.root / EXPORTS_DIR
        self.dest_label.setText(str(shown))
        self.dest_label.setToolTip(str(shown))
        self._dest_hint.setVisible(self._destination is None)
        self._dest_hint.setText(tr("data.export.default_dest"))
        self.reset.setVisible(self._destination is not None)
        self.reset.setToolTip(tr("data.export.default_dest"))

    def _browse(self) -> None:
        start = str(self._destination or self.env.root)
        picked = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(self, tr("data.export.pick"), start)
        if picked:
            self._destination = Path(picked)
            self._render_destination()

    def _reset(self) -> None:
        self._destination = None
        self._render_destination()

    def _set_busy(self, busy: bool) -> None:
        self._busy = busy
        self.set_busy(busy)
        self.run_button.setText(tr("data.export.running" if busy else "data.export.run"))
        self.run_button.setEnabled(not busy and self.chat.count() > 0)

    def export(self) -> None:
        chat_id = self.chat.chat_id()
        if self._busy or chat_id is None:
            return
        root, names, destination = self.env.root, self.names.is_checked(), self._destination
        self.done_row.hide()
        self._set_busy(True)

        def work() -> Path | None:
            folder = find_chat_folder(root, chat_id)
            if folder is None:
                return None
            out = None if destination is None else destination / f"{folder.name}.json"
            return export_chat_json(folder, out, include_names=names)

        self.env.runner.submit(work, self._exported)

    def _exported(self, done: Future[Path | None]) -> None:
        self._set_busy(False)
        if done.exception() is not None:
            self.env.toast("danger", tr("data.export.toast.failed"))
            return
        path = done.result()
        if path is None:
            self.env.toast("warning", tr("data.export.toast.no_folder"))
            return
        self._last = path
        self.done_row.set_body(tr("data.export.done", path=breakable(str(path))))
        self.done_row.show()
        self.env.toast("success", tr("data.export.toast.ok", path=str(path)))

    def _open(self) -> None:
        if self._last is not None:
            self.env.open_folder(self._last.parent)

"""The Data folder card: where the archive is, cloud-sync warning, and changing the folder."""

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from PySide6.QtGui import QGuiApplication
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QDialog, QFrame, QHBoxLayout

from chatimport.gui.i18n import tr
from chatimport.gui.locales import data as _data_strings
from chatimport.gui.pages.data_common import toolbar
from chatimport.gui.pages.data_folder_dialog import FolderDialog
from chatimport.gui.pages.data_section import Section
from chatimport.gui.tokens import SPACE
from chatimport.gui.widgets.base import bind_kit, set_role
from chatimport.gui.widgets.button import Button, IconButton
from chatimport.gui.widgets.callout import Callout
from chatimport.gui.widgets.labels import ElidedLabel, make_label
from chatimport.paths import is_cloud_synced

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from concurrent.futures import Future

    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QWidget

    from chatimport.commands import CommandResult
    from chatimport.gui.pages.data_common import DataEnv

_ = _data_strings


class FolderCard(Section):
    def __init__(self, env: DataEnv, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(env, "folder", "folder", parent=parent)
        kit = self.kit
        self._busy = False
        self._caption = make_label("", "caption")
        self.path_label = ElidedLabel("", "mono")
        self.path_label.setObjectName("DataFolderPath")
        self.copy_button = IconButton(kit, "copy", "", variant="secondary")
        self.open_button = IconButton(kit, "folder-open", "", variant="secondary")
        self.change_button = Button(kit, "", icon_name="sliders")
        self.missing = make_label("", "muted")
        self.cloud = Callout(kit, "warning", "")
        self._path_box = QFrame()
        set_role(self._path_box, "surface-sunken")
        self._path_row = QHBoxLayout(self._path_box)
        self._path_row.setSpacing(kit.px(SPACE[3]))
        self._path_row.addWidget(self.path_label, 1)
        self._path_row.addWidget(self.copy_button)
        self._path_row.addWidget(self.open_button)
        row = toolbar(kit)
        row.addWidget(self._path_box, 1)
        row.addWidget(self.change_button)
        self.content.addWidget(self._caption)
        self.content.addLayout(row)
        self.content.addWidget(self.missing)
        self.content.addWidget(self.cloud)
        self.copy_button.clicked.connect(self._copy)
        self.open_button.clicked.connect(lambda: env.open_folder(env.root))
        self.change_button.clicked.connect(self.change)
        env.root_changed.connect(self._render)
        bind_kit(kit, zoom=self._apply_sizes)
        self._apply_sizes()
        self.retranslate()

    def _apply_sizes(self) -> None:
        px = self.kit.px
        pad = px(SPACE[4])
        self._path_row.setContentsMargins(pad, px(SPACE[2]), px(SPACE[2]), px(SPACE[2]))

    def retranslate(self) -> None:
        self._caption.setText(tr("data.folder.current"))
        self.copy_button.set_tooltip(tr("data.folder.copy"))
        self.open_button.set_tooltip(tr("data.folder.open"))
        self._set_busy(self._busy)
        self.cloud.set_body(tr("data.folder.cloud"))
        self.missing.setText(tr("data.folder.missing"))
        self._render()

    def _render(self) -> None:
        root = self.env.root
        self.path_label.setText(str(root))
        self.path_label.setToolTip(str(root))
        self.missing.setVisible(not root.is_dir())
        self.cloud.setVisible(is_cloud_synced(root))

    def _copy(self) -> None:
        QGuiApplication.clipboard().setText(str(self.env.root))
        self.env.toast("info", tr("data.folder.copied"))

    def _set_busy(self, busy: bool) -> None:
        self._busy = busy
        self.set_busy(busy)
        self.change_button.setEnabled(not busy)
        self.change_button.setText(tr("data.folder.working" if busy else "data.folder.change"))

    def change(self) -> None:
        if self._busy:
            return
        dialog = FolderDialog(self.env.gui, self.env.root, self.window())
        if dialog.exec() != QDialog.DialogCode.Accepted or dialog.chosen_path is None:
            return
        target, move = dialog.chosen_path, dialog.move_data
        key = "data.folder.confirm.move" if move else "data.folder.confirm.fresh"
        text = tr(key, old=str(self.env.root), new=str(target))
        if not self.env.confirm(
            tr("data.folder.confirm.title"), text, tr("data.folder.confirm.yes"), danger=False
        ):
            return
        self._set_busy(True)
        future = self.env.gui.bridge.execute("set_root", {"path": str(target), "move": move})
        self.env.runner.watch(future, self._changed)

    def _changed(self, done: Future[CommandResult]) -> None:
        self._set_busy(False)
        try:
            result = done.result()
        except Exception:
            self.env.unavailable()
            return
        if not result.ok:
            self.env.toast("danger", tr("data.folder.toast.failed"))
            return
        raw = result.data.get("path")
        new_root = Path(raw) if isinstance(raw, str) else self.env.root
        self.env.set_root(new_root)
        self.env.toast("success", tr("data.folder.toast.ok", path=str(new_root)))

"""The "Change folder" dialog: pick a folder, see at once whether it can be used."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Final

from PySide6.QtWidgets import QCheckBox, QDialog, QFileDialog, QHBoxLayout, QLineEdit, QVBoxLayout

from chatimport.gui.i18n import tr
from chatimport.gui.locales import data as _data_strings
from chatimport.gui.pages.data_common import breakable
from chatimport.gui.tokens import SPACE
from chatimport.gui.widgets.base import bind_kit
from chatimport.gui.widgets.button import Button
from chatimport.gui.widgets.callout import Callout
from chatimport.gui.widgets.labels import make_label
from chatimport.paths import is_cloud_synced, normalize_root
from chatimport.ports import ChatImportError
from chatimport.setroot import validate_new_root

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pathlib import Path

    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QWidget

    from chatimport.gui.context import GuiContext

_ = _data_strings
DIALOG_WIDTH: Final = 560


class FolderDialog(QDialog):
    """`chosen_path` and `move` are valid after `exec()` returned Accepted.

    Validation (`setroot.validate_new_root`) runs when the path is committed, not per keystroke:
    it creates the folder and writes a probe file there, as `set-root` itself does.
    """

    def __init__(self, gui: GuiContext, current: Path, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.gui = gui
        self._current = current
        self.chosen_path: Path | None = None
        kit = gui.kit
        self.setMinimumWidth(kit.px(DIALOG_WIDTH))
        self._lede = make_label("", "muted", wrap=True)
        self._path_label = make_label("", "caption")
        self.path = QLineEdit()
        self.path.setProperty("role", "mono")
        self.browse = Button(kit, "", icon_name="folder-open")
        self.move_box = QCheckBox()
        self.move_box.setChecked(True)
        self._move_hint = make_label("", "muted", wrap=True)
        self.verdict = Callout(kit, "info", "")
        self.verdict.hide()
        self.apply = Button(kit, "", variant="primary")
        self.apply.setEnabled(False)
        self.cancel = Button(kit, "")
        field = QHBoxLayout()
        field.setSpacing(kit.px(SPACE[3]))
        field.addWidget(self.path, 1)
        field.addWidget(self.browse)
        footer = QHBoxLayout()
        footer.addStretch(1)
        footer.setSpacing(kit.px(SPACE[3]))
        footer.addWidget(self.cancel)
        footer.addWidget(self.apply)
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        gap = kit.px(SPACE[5])
        layout.setContentsMargins(gap, gap, gap, gap)
        layout.setSpacing(gap)
        layout.addWidget(self._lede)
        layout.addWidget(self._path_label)
        layout.addLayout(field)
        layout.addWidget(self.move_box)
        layout.addWidget(self._move_hint)
        layout.addWidget(self.verdict)
        layout.addLayout(footer)
        self.browse.clicked.connect(self._browse)
        self.path.editingFinished.connect(self.validate)
        self.move_box.toggled.connect(self._on_move_toggled)
        self.apply.clicked.connect(self.accept)
        self.cancel.clicked.connect(self.reject)
        bind_kit(kit, language=self._retranslate)
        self._retranslate()

    @property
    def move_data(self) -> bool:
        return self.move_box.isChecked()

    def _retranslate(self) -> None:
        self.setWindowTitle(tr("data.folder.dialog.title"))
        self._lede.setText(tr("data.folder.dialog.lede"))
        self._path_label.setText(tr("data.folder.dialog.path"))
        self.path.setAccessibleName(tr("data.folder.dialog.path"))
        self.browse.setText(tr("data.folder.dialog.browse"))
        self.move_box.setText(tr("data.folder.dialog.move"))
        self._move_hint.setText(tr("data.folder.dialog.move_hint"))
        self.apply.setText(tr("data.folder.dialog.apply"))
        self.cancel.setText(tr("common.cancel"))
        if self.path.text().strip():
            self.validate()

    def _on_move_toggled(self, _checked: bool) -> None:
        self.validate()

    def _browse(self) -> None:
        start = self.path.text().strip() or str(self._current.parent)
        picked = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(self, tr("data.folder.dialog.pick"), start)
        if picked:
            self.path.setText(picked)
            self.validate()

    def validate(self) -> bool:
        text = self.path.text().strip()
        self.chosen_path = None
        self.apply.setEnabled(False)
        if not text:
            self.verdict.hide()
            return False
        target = normalize_root(text)
        try:
            validate_new_root(
                target,
                self._current,
                app_base=self.gui.service.paths.base,
                move=self.move_data,
            )
        except (ChatImportError, OSError) as error:
            self.verdict.set_tone("danger")
            self.verdict.set_body(tr("data.folder.dialog.invalid", detail=str(error)))
            self.verdict.show()
            return False
        self.chosen_path = target
        cloud = is_cloud_synced(target)
        self.verdict.set_tone("warning" if cloud else "success")
        lines = [tr("data.folder.dialog.valid", path=breakable(str(target)))]
        if cloud:
            lines.append(tr("data.folder.cloud"))
        self.verdict.set_body("\n".join(lines))
        self.verdict.show()
        self.apply.setEnabled(True)
        return True

"""The Integrity card: run the `check` command, list what it found, repair on request."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from PySide6.QtWidgets import QHeaderView, QTableView

from chatimport.gui.i18n import plural, tr
from chatimport.gui.locales import data as _data_strings
from chatimport.gui.models.data_models import IssueColumn, IssueRow, IssuesModel, parse_issues
from chatimport.gui.pages.data_common import SeverityDelegate, fit_table, prepare_table, toolbar
from chatimport.gui.pages.data_section import Section
from chatimport.gui.tokens import SPACE
from chatimport.gui.widgets.base import bind_kit
from chatimport.gui.widgets.button import Button
from chatimport.gui.widgets.callout import Callout
from chatimport.gui.widgets.chip import Chip
from chatimport.gui.widgets.labels import make_label
from chatimport.gui.widgets.table import configure_table
from chatimport.integrity import ERROR, INFO, WARNING

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from concurrent.futures import Future

    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QWidget

    from chatimport.commands import CommandResult
    from chatimport.gui.pages.data_common import DataEnv
    from chatimport.gui.widgets.base import Tone

_ = _data_strings
SEVERITY_COUNTS: tuple[tuple[str, Tone], ...] = (
    (ERROR, "danger"),
    (WARNING, "warning"),
    (INFO, "info"),
)
SEVERITY_WIDTH = 120
FOLDER_WIDTH = 240


class IntegrityCard(Section):
    def __init__(self, env: DataEnv, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(env, "integrity", "shield-check", parent=parent)
        kit = self.kit
        self._busy = False
        self._rows: list[IssueRow] | None = None
        self.run_button = Button(kit, "", variant="primary", icon_name="shield-check")
        self.repair_button = Button(kit, "", icon_name="refresh")
        self.repair_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.chips = {
            severity: Chip(kit, "", tone, icon_name=icon)
            for (severity, tone), icon in zip(
                SEVERITY_COUNTS, ("x-circle", "alert", "info"), strict=True
            )
        }
        row = toolbar(kit)
        row.addWidget(self.run_button)
        row.addWidget(self.repair_button)
        row.addSpacing(kit.px(SPACE[4]))
        for chip in self.chips.values():
            row.addWidget(chip)
            chip.hide()
        row.addStretch(1)
        self.hint = make_label("", "muted", wrap=True)
        self.ok = Callout(kit, "success", "")
        self.ok.hide()
        self.model = IssuesModel()
        self.table = QTableView()
        self.table.setModel(self.model)
        configure_table(self.table, kit)
        prepare_table(self.table)
        self.delegate = SeverityDelegate(kit)
        self.table.setItemDelegate(self.delegate)
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        header.setStretchLastSection(True)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(IssueColumn.SEVERITY, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Fixed)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(IssueColumn.FOLDER, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Fixed)
        self.table.hide()
        self.content.addLayout(row)
        self.content.addWidget(self.hint)
        self.content.addWidget(self.table)
        self.content.addWidget(self.ok)
        self.run_button.clicked.connect(self.run_check)
        self.repair_button.clicked.connect(self.repair)
        bind_kit(kit, zoom=self._apply_sizes)
        self._apply_sizes()
        self.retranslate()

    def retranslate(self) -> None:
        self._sync_buttons()
        self.hint.setText(tr("data.integrity.hint"))
        self.ok.set_title(tr("data.integrity.ok_title"))
        self.ok.set_body(tr("data.integrity.ok_text"))
        self.model.retranslate()
        self._render()

    def _apply_sizes(self) -> None:
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        header.resizeSection(IssueColumn.SEVERITY, self.kit.px(SEVERITY_WIDTH))
        header.resizeSection(IssueColumn.FOLDER, self.kit.px(FOLDER_WIDTH))
        fit_table(self.table, self.kit, self.model.rowCount())

    def _sync_buttons(self) -> None:
        self.run_button.setText(
            tr("data.integrity.running" if self._busy else "data.integrity.run")
        )
        self.run_button.setEnabled(not self._busy)
        has_issues = bool(self._rows)
        self.repair_button.setText(tr("data.integrity.repair"))
        self.repair_button.setEnabled(has_issues and not self._busy)

    def _set_busy(self, busy: bool) -> None:
        self._busy = busy
        self.set_busy(busy)
        self._sync_buttons()

    def run_check(self) -> None:
        self._send(repair=False)

    def repair(self) -> None:
        if not self._rows or self._busy:
            return
        if self.env.confirm(
            tr("data.integrity.repair.title"),
            tr("data.integrity.repair.text"),
            tr("data.integrity.repair.yes"),
            danger=False,
        ):
            self._send(repair=True)

    def _send(self, *, repair: bool) -> None:
        if self._busy:
            return
        self._set_busy(True)
        future = self.env.gui.bridge.execute("check", {"repair": repair})
        self.env.runner.watch(future, lambda done: self._checked(done, repair=repair))

    def _checked(self, done: Future[CommandResult], *, repair: bool) -> None:
        self._set_busy(False)
        try:
            result = done.result()
        except Exception:
            self.env.unavailable()
            return
        if not result.ok:
            self.env.toast("danger", tr("data.integrity.toast.failed"))
            return
        self._rows = parse_issues(result.data)
        self.model.set_issues(self._rows)
        self._sync_buttons()
        self._render()
        if repair:
            self.env.toast("success", tr("data.integrity.toast.repaired"))
            self.env.request_usage.emit()

    def _render(self) -> None:
        rows = self._rows
        for severity, chip in self.chips.items():
            count = sum(1 for row in rows or () if row.severity == severity)
            chip.setVisible(count > 0)
            chip.set_text(plural(count, f"data.integrity.count.{severity}"))
        self.hint.setVisible(rows is None)
        self.table.setVisible(bool(rows))
        self.ok.setVisible(rows is not None and not rows)
        fit_table(self.table, self.kit, self.model.rowCount())

"""The Combined file card: one file with every chat, kept current in the background."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any

from PySide6.QtGui import QGuiApplication
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QFrame, QHBoxLayout

from chatimport.config import Config, ConfigError, MergedConfig, load_config
from chatimport.config_edit import update_config
from chatimport.gui.format import format_ago, format_bytes, format_count, format_exact
from chatimport.gui.i18n import tr
from chatimport.gui.locales import data as _data_strings
from chatimport.gui.locales import data_merged as _merged_strings
from chatimport.gui.pages.data_common import FieldRow, toolbar
from chatimport.gui.pages.data_section import Section
from chatimport.gui.strings import current_language, translate_plural

class MergedCard(Section):

        kit = self.kit
        self._busy = False
        self._translated = False
        self._loading = False
        self._building_remotely = False
        self._result: MergedResult | None = None
        self._config = MergedConfig()
        self.enabled = SwitchRow(kit, "", "", checked=False)
        self.format = Segmented(kit, self._format_options(), "json", compact=True)
        self.names = SwitchRow(kit, "", "", checked=False)
        self.names_warning = Callout(kit, "warning", "")
        self.names_warning.hide()
        self._state_caption = make_label("", "caption")
        self.state_label = make_label("", "body")
        self._last_caption = make_label("", "caption")
        self.last_label = make_label("", "body")
        self._size_caption = make_label("", "caption")
        self.size_label = make_label("", "body")
        self._path_caption = make_label("", "caption")
        self.path_label = ElidedLabel("", "mono")
        self.copy_button = IconButton(kit, "copy", "", variant="secondary")
        self.show_button = IconButton(kit, "folder-open", "", variant="secondary")
        self.build_button = Button(kit, "", variant="primary", icon_name="refresh")
        self._path_box = QFrame()
        set_role(self._path_box, "surface-sunken")
        self._path_row = QHBoxLayout(self._path_box)
        self._path_row.setSpacing(kit.px(SPACE[3]))
        self._path_row.addWidget(self.path_label, 1)
        self._path_row.addWidget(self.copy_button)
        self._path_row.addWidget(self.show_button)
        footer = toolbar(kit)
        footer.addStretch(1)
        footer.addWidget(self.build_button)
        self._format_field = FieldRow(kit, "", self.format)
        format_row = toolbar(kit)
        format_row.addWidget(self._format_field)
        format_row.addStretch(1)
        self.content.addWidget(self.enabled)
        self.content.addLayout(format_row)
        self.content.addWidget(self.names)
        self.content.addWidget(self.names_warning)
        for caption, value in (
            (self._state_caption, self.state_label),
            (self._last_caption, self.last_label),
            (self._size_caption, self.size_label),
        ):
            self.content.addWidget(caption)
            self.content.addWidget(value)
        self.content.addWidget(self._path_caption)
        self.content.addWidget(self._path_box)
        self.content.addLayout(footer)
        self.enabled.toggled.connect(self._save)
        self.format.selected.connect(self._save)
        self.names.toggled.connect(self._on_names)
        self.copy_button.clicked.connect(self._copy)
        self.show_button.clicked.connect(self._show)
        self.build_button.clicked.connect(self.build)
        env.root_changed.connect(self.refresh)
        env.gui.bridge.snapshot.connect(self._on_snapshot)
        bind_kit(kit, zoom=self._apply_sizes)
        self._apply_sizes()
        self.retranslate()
        self.refresh()

    def _apply_sizes(self) -> None:
        px = self.kit.px
        pad = px(SPACE[4])
        self._path_row.setContentsMargins(pad, px(SPACE[2]), px(SPACE[2]), px(SPACE[2]))

    def _format_options(self) -> list[SegmentOption]:
        return [
            SegmentOption("json", tr("data.merged.format.json"), tooltip=self._tip("json")),
            SegmentOption("jsonl", tr("data.merged.format.jsonl"), tooltip=self._tip("jsonl")),
        ]

    @staticmethod
    def _tip(name: str) -> str:
        return tr(f"data.merged.format.{name}_tip")

    def retranslate(self) -> None:
        self.enabled.set_texts(tr("data.merged.enabled"), tr("data.merged.enabled_hint"))
        self._format_field.set_caption(tr("data.merged.format"))
        if self._translated:
            self.format.set_options(self._format_options())
        self._translated = True
        self.names.set_texts(tr("data.merged.names"), tr("data.merged.names_hint"))
        self.names_warning.set_body(tr("data.merged.names_warning"))
        self._state_caption.setText(tr("data.merged.state"))
        self._last_caption.setText(tr("data.merged.last"))
        self._size_caption.setText(tr("data.merged.size"))
        self._path_caption.setText(tr("data.merged.path"))
        self.copy_button.set_tooltip(tr("data.merged.copy"))
        self.show_button.set_tooltip(tr("data.merged.show"))
        self._set_busy(self._busy)
        self._render()

    @property
    def config_file(self) -> Path:
        return self.env.gui.current.paths.config_file

    def _load_config(self) -> MergedConfig:
        try:
            return load_config(self.config_file).merged
        except ConfigError:
            log.warning("config.toml is invalid; the combined file card shows defaults")
            return Config().merged

    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Re-read the saved settings and the last build from disk."""
        self._config = self._load_config()
        self._result = last_result(self.env.root)
        self._loading = True
        self.enabled.set_checked(self._config.enabled)
        self.format.set_value(self._config.format)
        self.names.set_checked(self._config.include_names)
        self._loading = False
        self.names_warning.setVisible(self._config.include_names)
        self._render()

    def _render(self) -> None:
        language = current_language()
        if self._busy or self._building_remotely:
            state = "building"
        else:
            state = "on" if self._config.enabled else "off"
        self.state_label.setText(tr(f"data.merged.state.{state}"))
        result = self._result
        if result is None:
            self.last_label.setText(tr("data.merged.last.never"))
            self.last_label.setToolTip("")
            self.size_label.setText("-")
            target = merged_path(self.env.root, self._config.format)
        else:
            moment = format_exact(result.built_at)
            age = max((datetime.now(UTC) - result.built_at).total_seconds(), 0.0)
            self.last_label.setText(
                tr("data.merged.last.value", moment=moment, ago=format_ago(age, language))
            )
            self.last_label.setToolTip(moment)
            self.size_label.setText(
                tr(
                    "data.merged.size.value",
                    records=translate_plural(
                        language,
                        result.records,
                        "data.merged.records",
                        n=format_count(result.records, language),
                    ),
                    size=format_bytes(result.bytes, language),
                )
            )
            target = result.path
        self.path_label.setText(str(target))
        self.path_label.setToolTip(str(target))
        has_file = result is not None
        self.copy_button.setEnabled(has_file)
        self.show_button.setEnabled(has_file)

    def _on_names(self, checked: bool) -> None:
        self.names_warning.setVisible(checked)
        self._save()

    def _save(self, *_: object) -> None:
        if self._loading:
            return
        changes = {
            "merged": {
                "enabled": self.enabled.is_checked(),
                "format": self.format.value,
                "include_names": self.names.is_checked(),
            }
        }
        try:
            update_config(self.config_file, changes)
        except ConfigError, OSError:
            log.exception("config.toml could not be updated for the combined file")
            self.env.toast("danger", tr("data.merged.save_failed"))
            self.refresh()
            return
        self._config = self._load_config()
        self._render()
        future = self.env.gui.bridge.execute("reload_config")
        self.env.runner.watch(future, self._reloaded)

    def _reloaded(self, done: Future[CommandResult]) -> None:
        ok = done.exception() is None and done.result().ok
        self.env.toast(
            "success" if ok else "info",
            tr("data.merged.saved" if ok else "data.merged.saved_later"),
        )

    def _on_snapshot(self, snapshot: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        merged: dict[str, Any] = snapshot.get("merged") or {}
        building = bool(merged.get("building"))
        built = merged.get("last_built_at")
        known = format_dt(self._result.built_at) if self._result is not None else None
        self._building_remotely = building
        if built is not None and built != known and not self._busy:
            self._result = last_result(self.env.root)
        self._render()

    def _set_busy(self, busy: bool) -> None:
        self._busy = busy
        self.set_busy(busy)
        self.build_button.setText(tr("data.merged.building" if busy else "data.merged.build"))
        self.build_button.setEnabled(not busy)

    def build(self) -> None:
        if self._busy:
            return
        self._set_busy(True)
        self._render()
        args = {"format": self.format.value, "names": self.names.is_checked()}
        future = self.env.gui.bridge.execute("export_all", args)
        self.env.runner.watch(future, self._built)

    def _built(self, done: Future[CommandResult]) -> None:
        self._set_busy(False)
        self._result = last_result(self.env.root)
        self._render()
        if done.exception() is not None:
            self.env.unavailable()
            return
        result = done.result()
        if not result.ok:
            self.env.toast("danger", tr("data.merged.toast.failed"))
            return
        records = int(result.data.get("records", 0))
        language = current_language()
        phrase = translate_plural(
            language, records, "data.merged.records", n=format_count(records, language)
        )
        self.env.toast("success", tr("data.merged.toast.ok", records=phrase))

    def _copy(self) -> None:
        if self._result is not None:
            QGuiApplication.clipboard().setText(str(self._result.path))
            self.env.toast("info", tr("data.merged.copied"))

    def _show(self) -> None:
        if self._result is not None:
            self.env.open_folder(self._result.path.parent)

"""The base of every card on the Data page: an icon, a title, a lede and a busy stripe."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from PySide6.QtCore import QSize, Qt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QHBoxLayout, QLabel, QVBoxLayout

from chatimport.gui.i18n import tr

    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QLayout, QWidget

    from chatimport.gui.pages.data_common import DataEnv


class Section(Card):
    """A card with a header (icon, title, lede, trailing buttons) and a stripe that runs while busy.

    Subclasses fill `content` and implement `retranslate`; the title and lede keys are
    `data.<name>.title` and `data.<name>.lede`.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        env: DataEnv,
        name: str,
        icon_name: str,
        *,
        trailing: QLayout | None = None,
        parent: QWidget | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(env.gui.kit, parent=parent)
        self.env = env
        self.kit = env.gui.kit
        self._name = name
        self._icon_name = icon_name
        self._icon = QLabel()
        self._icon.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        self._title = QLabel()
        set_role(self._title, "section")
        self._lede = QLabel()
        set_role(self._lede, "muted")
        self._lede.setWordWrap(True)
        texts = QVBoxLayout()
        texts.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        texts.setSpacing(self.kit.px(SPACE[1]))
        title_row = QHBoxLayout()
        title_row.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        title_row.setSpacing(self.kit.px(SPACE[3]))
        title_row.addWidget(self._icon)
        title_row.addWidget(self._title, 1)
        texts.addLayout(title_row)
        texts.addWidget(self._lede)
        head = QHBoxLayout()
        head.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        head.addLayout(texts, 1)
        if trailing is not None:
            head.addLayout(trailing)
            head.setAlignment(trailing, Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignTop)
        self.stripe = BusyStripe(self.kit)
        self.body.addLayout(head)
        self.body.addWidget(self.stripe)
        self.content = QVBoxLayout()
        self.content.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        self.body.addLayout(self.content)
        bind_kit(self.kit, theme=self._paint_icon, zoom=self._paint_icon, language=self._retitle)
        self._paint_icon()
        self._set_title()

    def set_busy(self, busy: bool) -> None:
        self.stripe.set_active(busy)

    def retranslate(self) -> None:
        """Re-set the texts that depend on the language; subclasses also call it once when built."""

    def _set_title(self) -> None:
        self._title.setText(tr(f"data.{self._name}.title"))
        self._lede.setText(tr(f"data.{self._name}.lede"))
        self.setAccessibleName(self._title.text())

    def _retitle(self) -> None:
        self._set_title()
        self.retranslate()

    def _paint_icon(self) -> None:
        size = self.kit.px(LAYOUT["icon_lg"])
        self._icon.setFixedSize(QSize(size, size))
        self._icon.setPixmap(icon_pixmap(self._icon_name, self.kit.palette.accent, size))

"""The Storage card: archive, media and free disk, and the size of every chat."""

from __future__ import annotations
