LOW_DISK_WARNING_FACTOR: Final = 1.5
COLUMNS: Final = 4
SHARE_WIDTH: Final = 150
NUMBER_WIDTHS: Final = {UsageColumn.SIZE: 80, UsageColumn.MESSAGES: 128, UsageColumn.PARTS: 64}


def free_disk_tone(free_bytes: int | None, low_bytes: int) -> Tone:
    if free_bytes is None or low_bytes <= 0:
        return "neutral"
    if free_bytes < low_bytes:
        return "danger"
    return "warning" if free_bytes < low_bytes * LOW_DISK_WARNING_FACTOR else "success"


class StorageCard(Section):
    def __init__(self, env: DataEnv, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        self.calculate = Button(env.gui.kit, "", icon_name="refresh")
        trailing = QHBoxLayout()
        trailing.addWidget(self.calculate)
        super().__init__(env, "storage", "disk", trailing=trailing, parent=parent)
        kit = self.kit
        self._busy = False
        self.calculate.clicked.connect(env.request_usage)
        self.cards = {
            "archive": StatCard(kit, "", icon_name="package"),
            "media": StatCard(kit, "", icon_name="download"),
            "free": StatCard(kit, "", icon_name="disk"),
            "chats": StatCard(kit, "", icon_name="chats"),
        }
        self._grid = QGridLayout()
        for position, card in enumerate(self.cards.values()):
            self._grid.addWidget(card, 0, position)
            self._grid.setColumnStretch(position, 1)
        self.model = UsageModel()
        self.table = QTableView()
        self.table.setModel(self.model)
        configure_table(self.table, kit)
        prepare_table(self.table)
        self.table.setItemDelegate(ShareBarDelegate(kit))
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        header.setStretchLastSection(False)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(UsageColumn.CHAT, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch)
        for number in (UsageColumn.SIZE, UsageColumn.MESSAGES, UsageColumn.PARTS):
            header.setSectionResizeMode(number, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Fixed)
        self.empty = EmptyState(kit, "chats", "", "")
        self._legend_messages = make_label("", "caption")
        self._legend_media = make_label("", "caption")
        self._legend = QHBoxLayout()
        self._legend.addWidget(Dot(kit, "accent"))
        self._legend.addWidget(self._legend_messages)
        self._legend.addWidget(Dot(kit, "live"))
        self._legend.addWidget(self._legend_media)
        self._legend.addStretch(1)
        self.content.addLayout(self._grid)
        self.content.addWidget(self.table)
        self.content.addWidget(self.empty)
        self.content.addLayout(self._legend)
        env.usage_changed.connect(self._render)
        bind_kit(kit, zoom=self._apply_sizes)
        self._apply_sizes()
        self.retranslate()

    def set_busy(self, busy: bool) -> None:
        super().set_busy(busy)
        self._busy = busy
        self.calculate.setEnabled(not busy)
        self.calculate.setText(tr("data.storage.calculating" if busy else "data.storage.calculate"))

    def retranslate(self) -> None:
        self.set_busy(self._busy)
        self.model.retranslate()
        self._legend_messages.setText(tr("data.storage.legend.messages"))
        self._legend_media.setText(tr("data.storage.legend.media"))
        self.empty.set_texts(tr("data.storage.empty"), tr("data.storage.empty_text"))
        self._render()

    def _apply_sizes(self) -> None:
        px = self.kit.px
        self._grid.setSpacing(px(SPACE[4]))
        self._legend.setSpacing(px(SPACE[3]))
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        header.resizeSection(UsageColumn.SHARE, px(SHARE_WIDTH))
        for number in (UsageColumn.SIZE, UsageColumn.MESSAGES, UsageColumn.PARTS):
            header.resizeSection(number, px(NUMBER_WIDTHS[number]))
        header.setSectionResizeMode(UsageColumn.SHARE, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Fixed)
        self.table.setAlternatingRowColors(False)
        fit_table(self.table, self.kit, self.model.rowCount())

    def _show_table(self, shown: bool) -> None:
        self.table.setVisible(shown)
        self.empty.setVisible(not shown)

    def _render(self) -> None:
        usage = self.env.usage
        language = current_language()
        cards = self.cards
        cards["archive"].set_label(tr("data.storage.stat.archive"))
        cards["media"].set_label(tr("data.storage.stat.media"))
        cards["media"].set_hint(tr("data.storage.stat.media_hint"))
        cards["free"].set_label(tr("data.storage.stat.free"))
        cards["chats"].set_label(tr("data.storage.stat.chats"))
        if usage is None:
            for card in cards.values():
                card.set_value("-")
            cards["archive"].set_hint("")
            cards["free"].set_hint("")
            cards["chats"].set_hint("")
            self.model.set_usage(())
            self._show_table(False)
            return
        self._render_totals(usage, language)
        self.model.set_usage(usage.chats)
        self._show_table(bool(usage.chats))
        fit_table(self.table, self.kit, self.model.rowCount())

    def _render_totals(self, usage: ArchiveUsage, language: Language) -> None:
        cards = self.cards
        cards["archive"].set_value(format_bytes(usage.total_bytes, language))
        cards["archive"].set_hint(
            tr(
                "data.storage.stat.archive_hint",
                jsonl=format_bytes(usage.jsonl_total, language),
                service=format_bytes(usage.service_files_total, language),
            )
        )
        cards["media"].set_value(format_bytes(usage.media_total, language))
        low_bytes = self.env.gui.service.config.disk.low_watermark_gb * GIB
        if usage.free_bytes is None:
            cards["free"].set_value(tr("data.storage.stat.free_unknown"))
            cards["free"].set_hint("")
        else:
            cards["free"].set_value(format_bytes(usage.free_bytes, language))
            cards["free"].set_hint(
                tr("data.storage.stat.free_hint", limit=format_bytes(low_bytes, language))
            )
        cards["free"].set_tone(free_disk_tone(usage.free_bytes, low_bytes))
        cards["chats"].set_value(format_count(len(usage.chats), language))
        records = sum(chat.records or 0 for chat in usage.chats)
        cards["chats"].set_hint(plural(records, "data.storage.stat.chats_hint"))

"""The chat library dialog: list, enable switches and "add a chat", over `chats.toml`.

The file is edited through `library.add_entry` / `set_enabled` (the same code as the CLI), and
the running service rereads it within about 10 seconds. Invite links are shown masked.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QDialog,
    QFrame,
    QHBoxLayout,

from chatimport.gui.i18n import tr

class _EntryRow(QFrame):

class LibraryDialog(QDialog):
    def __init__(self, gui: GuiContext, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.gui = gui
        self._errors: Sequence[ServiceError] = ()
        self.setMinimumWidth(gui.zoom.scaled(DIALOG_WIDTH))
        self._lede = make_label("", "muted", wrap=True)
        self._list_host = QWidget()
        self._list = QVBoxLayout(self._list_host)
        self._list.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        self._list.setSpacing(gui.zoom.scaled(SPACE[2]))
        self._scroll = QScrollArea()
        self._scroll.setWidgetResizable(True)
        self._scroll.setWidget(self._list_host)
        self._scroll.setMinimumHeight(gui.zoom.scaled(LIST_HEIGHT))
        self._add_title = make_label("", "section")
        self._ref = QLineEdit()
        self._name = QLineEdit()
        self._add = Button(gui.kit, "", variant="primary", icon_name="plus")
        self._add.clicked.connect(self._on_add)
        self._ref.returnPressed.connect(self._on_add)
        self._problem = Callout(gui.kit, "danger", "")
        self._problem.hide()
        self._close = Button(gui.kit, "")
        self._close.clicked.connect(self.accept)
        form = QHBoxLayout()
        form.addWidget(self._ref, 3)
        form.addWidget(self._name, 2)
        form.addWidget(self._add)
        footer = QHBoxLayout()
        footer.addStretch(1)
        footer.addWidget(self._close)
        column = QVBoxLayout(self)
        gap = gui.zoom.scaled(SPACE[5])
        column.setContentsMargins(gap, gap, gap, gap)
        column.setSpacing(gap)
        column.addWidget(self._lede)
        column.addWidget(self._scroll, 1)
        column.addWidget(self._add_title)
        column.addLayout(form)
        column.addWidget(self._problem)
        column.addLayout(footer)
        bind_kit(gui.kit, language=self._retranslate)
        self._retranslate()
        self.reload()

    def set_errors(self, errors: Sequence[ServiceError]) -> None:
        self._errors = errors
        self.reload()

    def _retranslate(self) -> None:
        self.setWindowTitle(tr("chats.lib.title"))
        self._lede.setText(tr("chats.lib.lede"))
        self._add_title.setText(tr("chats.lib.add_title"))
        self._ref.setPlaceholderText(tr("chats.lib.ref"))
        self._ref.setAccessibleName(tr("chats.lib.ref"))
        self._name.setPlaceholderText(tr("chats.lib.name"))
        self._name.setAccessibleName(tr("chats.lib.name"))
        self._add.setText(tr("chats.lib.add"))
        self._close.setText(tr("common.close"))
        self.reload()

    def reload(self) -> None:
        clear_layout(self._list)
        try:
            entries = load_library(self.gui.service.library_file).entries
        except LibraryError as error:
            self._show_problem(tr("chats.lib.error_read", detail=str(error)))
            return
        failed = {error.source for error in self._errors if error.is_resolve}
        if not entries:
            empty = make_label(tr("chats.lib.empty"), "muted")
            empty.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
            self._list.addWidget(empty)
        for entry in entries:
            self._list.addWidget(_EntryRow(self, entry, resolve_error_key(entry) in failed))
        self._list.addStretch(1)

    def toggle(self, entry: ChatEntry, enabled: bool) -> None:
        try:
            set_enabled(self.gui.service.library_file, entry.key, enabled)
        except LibraryError as error:
            self._show_problem(tr("chats.lib.error_toggle", detail=str(error)))
            self.reload()
            return
        self._problem.hide()

    def _on_add(self) -> None:
        ref = self._ref.text()
        name = self._name.text() or None
        try:
            add_entry(self.gui.service.library_file, ref, name)
        except LibraryError as error:
            self._show_problem(tr("chats.lib.error_add", detail=str(error)))
            return
        self._ref.clear()
        self._name.clear()
        self._problem.hide()
        self._show_message("success", tr("chats.lib.added"))
        self.reload()

    def _show_problem(self, text: str) -> None:
        self._show_message("danger", text)

    def _show_message(self, tone: Tone, text: str) -> None:
        self._problem.set_tone(tone)
        self._problem.set_body(text)
        self._problem.show()

PATH_MAX_WIDTH: Final = 520
(LOADING, MISSING, EMPTY, NO_MATCHES, TABLE) = range(5)


class LogPage(QWidget):
    title_key = "nav.log"
    subtitle_key = "log.subtitle"

    def __init__(self, gui: GuiContext, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.gui = gui
        kit = gui.kit
        self._follow = True
        self._wrap = False
        self._programmatic = False
        self._end_pending = False
        self._row_heights_set = False
        self._loggers: set[str] = set()
        self._started = False
        self.source = LogSource(gui.service.paths.log_dir, self)
        self.model = LogModel(current_language())
        self.proxy = LogFilterProxy(self.model)

        self.search = SearchField(kit)
        self.search.setMinimumWidth(kit.px(160))
        self.levels = Segmented(kit, self._level_options(), "all", compact=True)
        self.copy_button = IconButton(kit, "copy", "")
        self.clear_button = IconButton(kit, "trash", "")
        self.open_button = IconButton(kit, "folder-open", "")
        top = QHBoxLayout()
        top.setSpacing(kit.px(SPACE[4]))
        top.addWidget(self.search, 1)
        top.addWidget(self.levels)

        self.sources = QComboBox()
        self.sources.setSizeAdjustPolicy(QComboBox.SizeAdjustPolicy.AdjustToContents)
        self.follow_switch = InlineSwitch(kit, checked=True)
        self.wrap_switch = InlineSwitch(kit)
        self.traceback_switch = InlineSwitch(kit, checked=True)
        options = QHBoxLayout()
        options.setSpacing(kit.px(SPACE[4]))
        options.addWidget(self.sources)
        for switch in (self.follow_switch, self.wrap_switch, self.traceback_switch):
            options.addWidget(switch)
        options.addStretch(1)

        self.table = QTableView()
        self.table.setModel(self.proxy)
        configure_table(self.table, kit)
        self.table.setSelectionMode(QAbstractItemView.SelectionMode.ExtendedSelection)
        self.table.setWordWrap(False)
        self.table.setHorizontalScrollMode(QAbstractItemView.ScrollMode.ScrollPerPixel)
        self.table.setTextElideMode(Qt.TextElideMode.ElideRight)
        self.table.verticalHeader().setSectionResizeMode(QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Fixed)
        self.table.setAccessibleName(tr("nav.log"))
        self.delegate = LogDelegate(kit)
        self.table.setItemDelegate(self.delegate)
        self.jump = Button(kit, "", variant="primary", size="sm", icon_name="arrow-down")
        self.table_host = FloatingHost(kit, self.table, self.jump)
        self.detail = DetailPane(kit)

        self.loading = EmptyState(kit, "log", "", "")
        self.missing_path = ElidedLabel("", "mono", mode=Qt.TextElideMode.ElideMiddle)
        self.missing = EmptyState(kit, "log", "", "", action=self.missing_path)
        self.empty = EmptyState(kit, "log", "", "")
        self.no_matches = EmptyState(kit, "search", "", "")
        self.stack = QStackedWidget()
        for widget in (self.loading, self.missing, self.empty, self.no_matches, self.table_host):
            self.stack.addWidget(widget)
        self.splitter = QSplitter(Qt.Orientation.Vertical)
        self.splitter.setChildrenCollapsible(False)
        self.splitter.addWidget(self.stack)
        self.splitter.addWidget(self.detail)
        self.splitter.setStretchFactor(0, 4)
        self.splitter.setStretchFactor(1, 1)

        self.lines_chip = Chip(kit, "", "neutral", icon_name="log")
        self.warnings_chip = Chip(kit, "", "warning", icon_name="alert")
        self.errors_chip = Chip(kit, "", "danger", icon_name="x-circle")
        self.older_button = Button(kit, "", size="sm", icon_name="arrow-up")
        footer = QHBoxLayout()
        footer.setSpacing(kit.px(SPACE[3]))
        for chip in (self.lines_chip, self.warnings_chip, self.errors_chip):
            footer.addWidget(chip)
        footer.addStretch(1)
        for button in (self.copy_button, self.clear_button, self.open_button):
            footer.addWidget(button)
        footer.addWidget(self.older_button)

        self._column = QVBoxLayout(self)
        self._column.addLayout(top)
        self._column.addLayout(options)
        self._column.addWidget(self.splitter, 1)
        self._column.addLayout(footer)

        self._resize_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._resize_timer.setSingleShot(True)
        self._resize_timer.setInterval(RESIZE_DEBOUNCE_MS)
        self._resize_timer.timeout.connect(self._on_width_settled)
        self._connect()
        bind_kit(kit, zoom=self._restyle, language=self._retranslate)
        self._restyle()
        self._retranslate()
        self._sync_all()

    def _connect(self) -> None:
        self.search.query_changed.connect(self._on_query)
        self.levels.selected.connect(self._on_level)
        self.sources.currentIndexChanged.connect(self._on_source)
        self.follow_switch.toggled.connect(self._on_follow_toggled)
        self.wrap_switch.toggled.connect(self._on_wrap_toggled)
        self.traceback_switch.toggled.connect(self.proxy.set_show_tracebacks)
        self.copy_button.clicked.connect(self.copy_lines)
        self.clear_button.clicked.connect(self.clear_view)
        self.open_button.clicked.connect(self._show_open_menu)
        self.older_button.clicked.connect(self.source.load_older)
        self.jump.clicked.connect(self.jump_to_end)
        bar = self.table.verticalScrollBar()
        bar.valueChanged.connect(self._on_scrolled)
        bar.valueChanged.connect(self._fit_rows)
        self.table.horizontalHeader().sectionResized.connect(self._on_section_resized)
        self.table.selectionModel().currentRowChanged.connect(self._on_current)
        self.table.selectionModel().selectionChanged.connect(self._on_current)
        for signal in (
            self.proxy.rowsInserted,
            self.proxy.rowsRemoved,
            self.proxy.modelReset,
            self.proxy.layoutChanged,
        ):
            signal.connect(self._sync_all)
        self.model.rowsInserted.connect(self._on_rows_added)
        self.source.loaded.connect(self._on_loaded)
        self.source.appended.connect(self._on_appended)
        self.source.older.connect(self._on_older)
        self.source.exists_changed.connect(self._on_source_state)
        self.source.busy_changed.connect(self._on_source_state)
        self.source.rotated.connect(lambda: notify(self, "info", tr("log.toast.rotated")))
        self.source.failed.connect(lambda: notify(self, "danger", tr("log.toast.load_failed")))
        QShortcut(QKeySequence(Qt.Key.Key_Home), self.table, self.scroll_home)
        QShortcut(QKeySequence(Qt.Key.Key_End), self.table, self.jump_to_end)
        QShortcut(QKeySequence.StandardKey.Copy, self.table, self.copy_lines)

    def _on_section_resized(self, _section: int, _old: int, _new: int) -> None:
        self._resize_timer.start()

    def _on_source_state(self, _flag: bool) -> None:
        self._sync_all()

    def focus_search(self) -> None:
        self.search.setFocus(Qt.FocusReason.ShortcutFocusReason)
        self.search.selectAll()

    def showEvent(self, event: object) -> None:
        super().showEvent(event)  # pyright: ignore[reportArgumentType]
        if not self._started:
            self._started = True
            self.source.start()
        self.source.set_following(True)

    def hideEvent(self, event: object) -> None:
        super().hideEvent(event)  # pyright: ignore[reportArgumentType]
        self.source.set_following(False)

    def _level_options(self) -> list[SegmentOption]:
        return [
            SegmentOption(name, tr(f"log.filter.{name}"), tooltip=tr(f"log.filter.{name}_tip"))
            for name, _level in LEVEL_FILTERS
        ]

    def _on_query(self, text: str) -> None:
        self.proxy.set_query(text)

    def _on_level(self, name: str) -> None:
        self.proxy.set_level(dict(LEVEL_FILTERS)[name])

    def _on_source(self, position: int) -> None:
        prefix = self.sources.itemData(position)
        self.proxy.set_logger_prefix(prefix if isinstance(prefix, str) else "")

    def _on_loaded(self, records: list[LogRecord], _has_older: bool) -> None:
        self.model.clear()
        self._loggers.clear()
        self.model.append(records)
        self._refresh_sources(records)
        self._schedule_end()

    def _on_appended(self, records: list[LogRecord]) -> None:
        self.model.append(records)
        self._refresh_sources(records)

    def _on_rows_added(self) -> None:
        if self._follow:
            self._schedule_end()
        else:
            self._fit_rows()

    def _on_older(self, records: list[LogRecord], exhausted: bool) -> None:
        anchor = self._top_anchor()
        inserted = self.model.prepend(records)
        self._refresh_sources(records)
        if self._follow:
            self._schedule_end()
        else:
            self._restore_anchor(anchor)
        if records and inserted < len(records):
            notify(
                self,
                "warning",
                tr(
                    "log.toast.older_capped",
                    limit=format_count(self.model.limit, current_language()),
                ),
            )
        elif inserted:
            notify(self, "success", plural(inserted, "log.toast.older"))
        elif exhausted:
            notify(self, "info", tr("log.toast.older_none"))
        self._sync_all()

    def _top_anchor(self) -> QPersistentModelIndex | None:
        row = self.table.rowAt(0)
        if row < 0:
            return None
        return QPersistentModelIndex(self.proxy.mapToSource(self.proxy.index(row, 0)))

    def _restore_anchor(self, anchor: QPersistentModelIndex | None) -> None:
        if anchor is None or not anchor.isValid():
            return
        index = self.proxy.mapFromSource(self.model.index(anchor.row(), 0))
        if index.isValid():
            self._programmatic = True
            self.table.scrollTo(index, QAbstractItemView.ScrollHint.PositionAtTop)
            self._programmatic = False

    def _refresh_sources(self, records: list[LogRecord]) -> None:
        fresh = {record.logger for record in records} - self._loggers
        if not fresh:
            return
        self._loggers |= fresh
        current = self.sources.currentData()
        self.sources.blockSignals(True)
        self.sources.clear()
        self.sources.addItem(tr("log.source.all"), "")
        for name in sorted(self._loggers):
            self.sources.addItem(name, name)
        self.sources.setCurrentIndex(max(self.sources.findData(current), 0))
        self.sources.blockSignals(False)

    def _on_current(self) -> None:
        selection = self.table.selectionModel()
        index = self.table.currentIndex()
        shown = index.isValid() and selection.hasSelection()
        self.detail.show_record(self.proxy.record_at(index.row()) if shown else None)

    def _schedule_end(self) -> None:
        if not self._end_pending:
            self._end_pending = True
            QTimer.singleShot(0, self._do_end)

    def _do_end(self) -> None:
        self._end_pending = False
        if self._follow:
            self._fit_rows()
            self._scroll_end()

    def _scroll_end(self) -> None:
        self._programmatic = True
        self.table.scrollToBottom()
        self._programmatic = False

    def _on_scrolled(self, value: int) -> None:
        if self._programmatic:
            return
        at_end = value >= self.table.verticalScrollBar().maximum() - END_SLACK
        if at_end != self._follow:
            self._set_follow(at_end)

    def _on_follow_toggled(self, follow: bool) -> None:
        self._follow = follow
        if follow:
            self._schedule_end()
        self._sync_jump()

    def _set_follow(self, follow: bool) -> None:
        self._follow = follow
        self.follow_switch.switch.blockSignals(True)
        self.follow_switch.set_checked(follow)
        self.follow_switch.switch.blockSignals(False)
        self._sync_jump()

    def jump_to_end(self) -> None:
        self._set_follow(True)
        self._schedule_end()

    def scroll_home(self) -> None:
        self._set_follow(False)
        self._programmatic = True
        self.table.scrollToTop()
        self._programmatic = False

    def _on_wrap_toggled(self, wrap: bool) -> None:
        self._wrap = wrap
        self.delegate.wrap = wrap
        self.detail.set_wrap(wrap)
        self._on_width_settled()

    def _on_width_settled(self) -> None:
        self.delegate.message_width = self.table.columnWidth(Column.MESSAGE)
        self._reset_row_heights()
        self._fit_rows()
        if self._follow:
            self._schedule_end()

    def _reset_row_heights(self) -> None:
        if not self._row_heights_set:
            return
        self._row_heights_set = False
        height = self.table.verticalHeader().defaultSectionSize()
        for row in range(self.proxy.rowCount()):
            self.table.setRowHeight(row, height)

    def _fit_rows(self) -> None:
        if not self._wrap:
            return
        count = self.proxy.rowCount()
        if count == 0:
            return
        first = max(self.table.rowAt(0), 0)
        last = self.table.rowAt(self.table.viewport().height() - 1)
        last = count - 1 if last < 0 else last
        minimum = self.table.verticalHeader().defaultSectionSize()
        font = self.table.font()
        for row in range(max(first - FIT_MARGIN, 0), min(last + FIT_MARGIN, count - 1) + 1):
            height = self.delegate.row_height(self.proxy.record_at(row), font, minimum)
            if self.table.rowHeight(row) != height:
                self.table.setRowHeight(row, height)
                self._row_heights_set = True

    def copy_lines(self) -> None:
        rows = sorted(index.row() for index in self.table.selectionModel().selectedRows())
        if not rows:
            rows = list(range(self.proxy.rowCount()))
        if not rows:
            return
        text = "\n".join(self.proxy.record_at(row).as_text() for row in rows)
        QGuiApplication.clipboard().setText(text)
        notify(self, "success", plural(len(rows), "log.toast.copied"))

    def clear_view(self) -> None:
        self.source.forget_older()
        self.model.clear()
        self.detail.show_record(None)
        self._sync_all()
        notify(self, "info", tr("log.toast.cleared"))

    def _show_open_menu(self) -> None:
        menu = QMenu(self)
        menu.addAction(
            icon("file", self.gui.kit.palette.fg_secondary, self.gui.kit.px(LAYOUT["icon_md"])),
            tr("log.open_file"),
            self.open_file,
        )
        menu.addAction(
            icon(
                "folder-open", self.gui.kit.palette.fg_secondary, self.gui.kit.px(LAYOUT["icon_md"])
            ),
            tr("log.open_folder"),
            self.open_folder,
        )
        menu.exec(self.open_button.mapToGlobal(QPoint(0, self.open_button.height())))

    def open_file(self) -> None:
        self._open(self.source.tail.path)

    def open_folder(self) -> None:
        self._open(self.source.tail.path.parent)

    def _open(self, path: object) -> None:
        target = QUrl.fromLocalFile(str(path))
        if not QDesktopServices.openUrl(target):
            notify(self, "warning", tr("log.toast.open_failed"))

    def _sync_all(self) -> None:
        self._sync_stack()
        self._sync_summary()
        self._sync_jump()
        self.older_button.setEnabled(self.source.has_older and not self.source.busy)
        self.older_button.setText(tr("log.older_busy" if self.source.busy else "log.older"))

    def _sync_stack(self) -> None:
        if not self.source.ready:
            index = LOADING
        elif self.model.rowCount() == 0:
            index = EMPTY if self.source.exists else MISSING
        elif self.proxy.rowCount() == 0:
            index = NO_MATCHES
        else:
            index = TABLE
        self.stack.setCurrentIndex(index)
        self.detail.setVisible(index == TABLE)

    def _sync_summary(self) -> None:
        language = current_language()
        shown, total = self.proxy.rowCount(), self.model.rowCount()
        if shown != total:
            text = tr(
                "log.summary.shown",
                shown=format_count(shown, language),
                total=format_count(total, language),
            )
        else:
            text = plural(total, "log.summary.lines")
        self.lines_chip.set_text(text)
        warnings, errors = self.model.warnings, self.model.errors
        self.warnings_chip.set_text(plural(warnings, "log.summary.warnings"))
        self.warnings_chip.set_tone("warning" if warnings else "muted")
        self.errors_chip.set_text(plural(errors, "log.summary.errors"))
        self.errors_chip.set_tone("danger" if errors else "muted")

    def _sync_jump(self) -> None:
        show = not self._follow and self.proxy.rowCount() > 0
        self.jump.setVisible(show)
        if show:
            self.table_host.place()

    def _retranslate(self) -> None:
        self.model.set_language(current_language())
        self.levels.set_options(self._level_options())
        self.levels.set_label("")
        self.levels.setAccessibleName(tr("log.filter.label"))
        current = self.sources.currentData()
        self.sources.blockSignals(True)
        if self.sources.count():
            self.sources.setItemText(0, tr("log.source.all"))
        self.sources.setCurrentIndex(max(self.sources.findData(current), 0))
        self.sources.blockSignals(False)
        self.sources.setAccessibleName(tr("log.source.label"))
        self.follow_switch.set_text(tr("log.follow"), tr("log.follow_tip"))
        self.wrap_switch.set_text(tr("log.wrap"), tr("log.wrap_tip"))
        self.traceback_switch.set_text(tr("log.tracebacks"), tr("log.tracebacks_tip"))
        self.jump.setText(tr("log.jump"))
        for button, key in (
            (self.copy_button, "log.copy"),
            (self.clear_button, "log.clear"),
            (self.open_button, "log.open_menu"),
        ):
            button.set_tooltip(tr(key))
        self.older_button.setToolTip(tr("log.older_tip"))
        self.loading.set_texts(tr("log.empty.loading"))
        self.missing.set_texts(tr("log.empty.missing.title"), tr("log.empty.missing.text"))
        self.missing_path.setText(str(self.source.tail.path))
        self.empty.set_texts(tr("log.empty.empty.title"), tr("log.empty.empty.text"))
        self.no_matches.set_texts(tr("empty.search.title"), tr("empty.search.text"))
        self._sync_all()
        self.table.viewport().update()

    def _restyle(self) -> None:
        kit = self.gui.kit
        pad = kit.px(PAGE_PADDING)
        self._column.setContentsMargins(pad, kit.px(SPACE[6]), pad, kit.px(SPACE[5]))
        self._column.setSpacing(kit.px(SPACE[4]))
        self.table.verticalHeader().setDefaultSectionSize(kit.px(ROW_HEIGHT))
        self.sources.setMinimumWidth(kit.px(SOURCE_MIN_WIDTH))
        self.detail.setMinimumHeight(kit.px(DETAIL_MIN_HEIGHT))
        self.missing_path.setMinimumWidth(kit.px(PATH_MIN_WIDTH))
        self.missing_path.setMaximumWidth(kit.px(PATH_MAX_WIDTH))
        self._row_heights_set = True
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        for column, width in COLUMN_WIDTHS.items():
            header.setSectionResizeMode(column, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Interactive)
            self.table.setColumnWidth(column, kit.px(width))
        self._resize_timer.start()

"""Paints the log table: level pills, tinted warning and error rows, monospace text."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Final

from PySide6.QtCore import QModelIndex, QRect, Qt
from PySide6.QtGui import QColor, QFont, QFontMetrics, QPainter
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QStyle, QStyledItemDelegate, QStyleOptionViewItem

from chatimport.gui.models.log_model import RECORD_ROLE, Column
from chatimport.gui.models.log_parser import Level, LogRecord
from chatimport.gui.models.presentation import ChipSpec
from chatimport.gui.pages.paint import chip_height, draw_chip, token_font
from chatimport.gui.strings import current_language, translate
from chatimport.gui.tokens import FONT_MONO, SPACE

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from PySide6.QtCore import QPersistentModelIndex

    from chatimport.gui.kit import UiKit
    from chatimport.gui.widgets.base import Tone

type _Index = QModelIndex | QPersistentModelIndex

LEVEL_CHIPS: Final[dict[Level, tuple[Tone, str]]] = {
    Level.DEBUG: ("muted", "hash"),
    Level.INFO: ("info", "info"),
    Level.WARNING: ("warning", "alert"),
    Level.ERROR: ("danger", "x-circle"),
    Level.CRITICAL: ("danger", "ban"),
}
WRAP_FLAGS: Final = int(Qt.TextFlag.TextWordWrap | Qt.TextFlag.TextWrapAnywhere)
STRIP_WIDTH: Final = 3
TINT_ALPHA: Final = 150


def mono_font(base: QFont, kit: UiKit, size: str = "sm") -> QFont:
    font = token_font(base, kit, size)
    font.setFamilies(list(FONT_MONO))
    font.setStyleHint(QFont.StyleHint.Monospace)
    return font


class LogDelegate(QStyledItemDelegate):
    def __init__(self, kit: UiKit) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.kit = kit
        self.wrap = False
        self.message_width = 400

    def _pad(self) -> int:
        return self.kit.px(SPACE[4])

    def _record(self, index: _Index) -> LogRecord | None:
        value = index.data(RECORD_ROLE)
        return value if isinstance(value, LogRecord) else None

    def _tint(self, record: LogRecord) -> str | None:
        palette = self.kit.palette
        if record.level >= Level.ERROR:
            return palette.danger_soft
        if record.level is Level.WARNING:
            return palette.warning_soft
        return None

    def wrapped_height(self, record: LogRecord, font: QFont, width: int) -> int:
        area = QRect(0, 0, max(width, 1), 100_000)
        return QFontMetrics(font).boundingRect(area, WRAP_FLAGS, record.message).height()

    def row_height(self, record: LogRecord, font: QFont, minimum: int) -> int:
        """Height of a wrapped row: the message laid out in the message column."""
        usable = self.message_width - 2 * self._pad()
        text = self.wrapped_height(record, mono_font(font, self.kit), usable)
        return max(minimum, text + 2 * self.kit.px(SPACE[3]))

    def paint(self, painter: QPainter, option: QStyleOptionViewItem, index: _Index) -> None:
        record = self._record(index)
        if record is None:
            super().paint(painter, option, index)
            return
        tint = self._tint(record)
        if tint is not None and not option.state & QStyle.StateFlag.State_Selected:
            wash = QColor(tint)
            wash.setAlpha(TINT_ALPHA)
            painter.fillRect(option.rect, wash)
        background = QStyleOptionViewItem(option)
        self.initStyleOption(background, index)
        background.text = ""
        background.features &= ~QStyleOptionViewItem.ViewItemFeature.HasDisplay
        style = option.widget.style() if option.widget else None
        if style is not None:
            style.drawControl(
                QStyle.ControlElement.CE_ItemViewItem, background, painter, option.widget
            )
        pad = self._pad()
        area = option.rect.adjusted(pad, 0, -pad, 0)
        painter.save()
        painter.setClipRect(option.rect)
        column = Column(index.column())
        if column is Column.TIME:
            self._paint_time(painter, option, area, record, str(index.data()))
        elif column is Column.LEVEL:
            self._paint_level(painter, option, area, record)
        elif column is Column.SOURCE:
            self._paint_text(painter, option, area, record.source, self.kit.palette.fg_secondary)
        else:
            self._paint_message(painter, option, area, record)
        painter.restore()

    def _row_top(self, area: QRect, height: int) -> int:
        return (
            area.top() + self.kit.px(SPACE[3])
            if self.wrap
            else area.top() + (area.height() - height) // 2
        )

    def _paint_time(
        self,
        painter: QPainter,
        option: QStyleOptionViewItem,
        area: QRect,
        record: LogRecord,
        text: str,
    ) -> None:
        if record.level >= Level.WARNING:
            tone = (
                self.kit.palette.danger if record.level >= Level.ERROR else self.kit.palette.warning
            )
            strip = QRect(
                option.rect.left(),
                option.rect.top(),
                self.kit.px(STRIP_WIDTH),
                option.rect.height(),
            )
            painter.fillRect(strip, QColor(tone))
        self._paint_text(painter, option, area, text, self.kit.palette.fg_muted)

    def _paint_text(
        self, painter: QPainter, option: QStyleOptionViewItem, area: QRect, text: str, color: str
    ) -> None:
        font = mono_font(option.font, self.kit)
        painter.setFont(font)
        painter.setPen(QColor(color))
        metrics = QFontMetrics(font)
        top = self._row_top(area, metrics.height())
        painter.drawText(
            QRect(area.left(), top, area.width(), metrics.height()),
            int(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter),
            metrics.elidedText(text, Qt.TextElideMode.ElideRight, area.width()),
        )

    def _paint_level(
        self, painter: QPainter, option: QStyleOptionViewItem, area: QRect, record: LogRecord
    ) -> None:
        tone, icon = LEVEL_CHIPS[record.level]
        text = translate(current_language(), f"log.level.{record.level.name.lower()}")
        height = chip_height(self.kit)
        top = self._row_top(area, height)
        draw_chip(painter, self.kit, ChipSpec(text, tone, icon), area.left(), top, option.font)

    def _paint_message(
        self, painter: QPainter, option: QStyleOptionViewItem, area: QRect, record: LogRecord
    ) -> None:
        palette = self.kit.palette
        font = mono_font(option.font, self.kit)
        color = palette.fg_muted if record.level is Level.DEBUG else palette.fg
        painter.setFont(font)
        painter.setPen(QColor(color))
        metrics = QFontMetrics(font)
        if self.wrap:
            rect = QRect(area.left(), area.top() + self.kit.px(SPACE[3]), area.width(), 100_000)
            painter.drawText(rect, WRAP_FLAGS | int(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignTop), record.message)
            return
        tag = ""
        if record.has_traceback:
            tag = f"{translate(current_language(), 'log.traceback')} +{record.line_count - 1}"
        small = token_font(option.font, self.kit, "xs")
        tag_width = QFontMetrics(small).horizontalAdvance(tag) + self._pad() if tag else 0
        top = self._row_top(area, metrics.height())
        text_width = max(area.width() - tag_width, 0)
        painter.drawText(
            QRect(area.left(), top, text_width, metrics.height()),
            int(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter),
            metrics.elidedText(record.message, Qt.TextElideMode.ElideRight, text_width),
        )
        if tag:
            painter.setFont(small)
            painter.setPen(QColor(palette.fg_muted))
            painter.drawText(
                QRect(area.left(), area.top(), area.width(), area.height()),
                int(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter),
                tag,
            )

"""Small pieces of the Log page: a labelled switch, the detail pane and a floating-button host."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from PySide6.QtCore import QEvent, Qt, Signal
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QHBoxLayout, QLabel, QPlainTextEdit, QWidget

from chatimport.gui.i18n import tr
from chatimport.gui.pages.log_delegate import mono_font

if TYPE_CHECKING:

    from chatimport.gui.kit import UiKit
    from chatimport.gui.models.log_parser import LogRecord
    from chatimport.gui.widgets.button import Button


class InlineSwitch(QWidget):
    """A switch with its label beside it; clicking the label toggles too."""

    toggled = Signal(bool)

    def __init__(self, kit: UiKit, text: str = "", *, checked: bool = False) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.switch = Switch(kit, checked=checked)
        self._label = QLabel(text)
        self._row = QHBoxLayout(self)
        self._row.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        self._row.addWidget(self.switch)
        self._row.addWidget(self._label)
        self._label.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor)
        self._label.installEventFilter(self)
        self.switch.toggled.connect(self.toggled)
        self.switch.setAccessibleName(text)
        bind_kit(kit, zoom=lambda: self._row.setSpacing(kit.px(SPACE[3])))
        self._row.setSpacing(kit.px(SPACE[3]))

    def is_checked(self) -> bool:
        return self.switch.isChecked()

    def set_checked(self, checked: bool) -> None:
        self.switch.setChecked(checked)

    def set_text(self, text: str, tip: str = "") -> None:
        self._label.setText(text)
        self.switch.setAccessibleName(text)
        self.setToolTip(tip)

    def eventFilter(self, watched: object, event: QEvent) -> bool:
        if watched is self._label and event.type() == QEvent.Type.MouseButtonRelease:
            mouse: QMouseEvent = event  # pyright: ignore[reportAssignmentType]
            if mouse.button() == Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton:
                self.switch.toggle()
                return True
        return super().eventFilter(watched, event)  # pyright: ignore[reportArgumentType]


class DetailPane(QPlainTextEdit):
    """The whole selected record, traceback included: selectable, monospace, optionally wrapped."""

    def __init__(self, kit: UiKit) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.kit = kit
        self.setReadOnly(True)
        self.setLineWrapMode(QPlainTextEdit.LineWrapMode.NoWrap)
        self.setAccessibleName(tr("log.detail.label"))
        bind_kit(kit, zoom=self._restyle, language=self._retranslate)
        self._restyle()
        self._retranslate()

    def show_record(self, record: LogRecord | None) -> None:
        self.setPlainText("" if record is None else record.as_text())

    def set_wrap(self, wrap: bool) -> None:
        mode = (
            QPlainTextEdit.LineWrapMode.WidgetWidth if wrap else QPlainTextEdit.LineWrapMode.NoWrap
        )
        self.setLineWrapMode(mode)

    def _restyle(self) -> None:
        self.setFont(mono_font(self.font(), self.kit))

    def _retranslate(self) -> None:
        self.setPlaceholderText(tr("log.detail.empty"))
        self.setAccessibleName(tr("log.detail.label"))


class FloatingHost(QWidget):
    """Holds a child and keeps a pill button pinned to its bottom-right corner."""

    def __init__(self, kit: UiKit, child: QWidget, floating: Button) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.kit = kit
        self._floating = floating
        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        layout.addWidget(child)
        floating.setParent(self)
        floating.raise_()
        floating.hide()

    def place(self) -> None:
        margin = self.kit.px(SPACE[6])
        self._floating.adjustSize()
        self._floating.move(
            self.width() - self._floating.width() - margin,
            self.height() - self._floating.height() - margin,
        )
        self._floating.raise_()

    def resizeEvent(self, event: QResizeEvent) -> None:
        super().resizeEvent(event)
        self.place()

"""The Overview page: what the archive holds, what runs now, and what changed lately."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, Final

from PySide6.QtWidgets import QGridLayout, QHBoxLayout, QScrollArea, QVBoxLayout, QWidget

from chatimport.config import GIB
from chatimport.gui.format import (
    Freshness,
    classify,
    count_phrase,
    format_ago,
    format_bytes,
    format_count,
    humanize_age,
)
from chatimport.gui.i18n import plural, tr
from chatimport.gui.locales import overview as _overview_strings
from chatimport.gui.models.feed import EventFeed
from chatimport.gui.models.presentation import age_seconds, status_kind
from chatimport.gui.models.snapshot import SnapshotView, parse_snapshot
from chatimport.gui.models.ticker import shared_ticker
from chatimport.gui.pages.overview_feed import FeedList
from chatimport.gui.pages.support import clear_layout
from chatimport.gui.strings import current_language

    from datetime import datetime

    from chatimport.gui.models.snapshot import ChatRow

_ = _overview_strings
COLUMNS: Final = 3
LOW_DISK_WARNING_FACTOR: Final = 1.5
MAX_ERROR_CALLOUTS: Final = 3
ERROR_CHARS: Final = 200

_FRESHNESS_TONE: Final[dict[Freshness, Tone]] = {
    Freshness.FRESH: "live",
    Freshness.RECENT: "neutral",
    Freshness.STALE: "warning",
    Freshness.DORMANT: "muted",
    Freshness.UNKNOWN: "neutral",
}
_SERVICE_TONE: Final[dict[str, Tone]] = {
    "running": "live",
    "starting": "info",
    "stopping": "warning",
    "stopped": "muted",
}

    def __init__(self, gui: GuiContext, label: str) -> None:
        super().__init__(gui.kit, label, icon_name="download")
        self.stripe = BusyStripe(gui.kit)
        self._column.addWidget(self.stripe)

    def set_busy(self, busy: bool) -> None:

class OverviewPage(QWidget):
    title_key = "nav.overview"
    subtitle_key = "overview.subtitle"

    def __init__(self, gui: GuiContext, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.gui = gui
        kit = gui.kit
        self._ticker = shared_ticker()
        self._view = SnapshotView()
        self._feed = EventFeed()
        self._seen = False
        self._baseline_records = 0
        self._running_since: datetime | None = None
        self._callout_signature: tuple[object, ...] = ()
        self._cloud_warned = cloud_sync_warning(gui.service.root) is not None

        self.backfill_card = BackfillCard(gui, "")
        self.cards: dict[str, StatCard] = {
            "chats": StatCard(kit, "", icon_name="chats"),
            "messages": StatCard(kit, "", icon_name="hash"),
            "disk": StatCard(kit, "", icon_name="disk"),
            "backfill": self.backfill_card,
            "quiet": StatCard(kit, "", icon_name="clock"),
            "service": StatCard(kit, "", icon_name="activity"),
        }
        self._grid = QGridLayout()
        for position, card in enumerate(self.cards.values()):
            self._grid.addWidget(card, position // COLUMNS, position % COLUMNS)
        for column in range(COLUMNS):
            self._grid.setColumnStretch(column, 1)
        self._callouts = QVBoxLayout()
        self.feed_list = FeedList(kit)

        content = QWidget()
        content.setObjectName("OverviewContent")
        self._content = content
        self._stack = QVBoxLayout(content)
        self._stack.addLayout(self._callouts)
        self._stack.addLayout(self._grid)
        self._stack.addWidget(self.feed_list)
        self._stack.addStretch(1)
        wrap = QHBoxLayout()
        wrap.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        wrap.addStretch(1)
        wrap.addWidget(content, 100)
        wrap.addStretch(1)
        host = QWidget()
        host.setLayout(wrap)
        self._scroll = QScrollArea()
        self._scroll.setWidgetResizable(True)
        self._scroll.setWidget(host)
        outer = QVBoxLayout(self)
        outer.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        outer.addWidget(self._scroll)

        self._ticker.second.connect(self._on_second)
        gui.bridge.snapshot.connect(self.set_snapshot)
        bind_kit(kit, zoom=self._restyle, language=self._refresh_all)
        self._restyle()
        last = gui.bridge.last_snapshot
        if last is not None:
            self.set_snapshot(last)
        else:
            self._refresh_all()

    def set_snapshot(self, raw: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        view = parse_snapshot(raw)
        now = self._ticker.now()
        if not self._seen:
            self._seen = True
            self._baseline_records = sum(row.records for row in view.chats)
        self._view = view
        if view.service == "running":
            self._running_since = self._running_since or now
        else:
            self._running_since = None
        self._feed.observe(view, now)
        self._refresh_all()

    def _on_second(self) -> None:
        now = self._ticker.now()
        self._refresh_cards(now)
        self.feed_list.refresh_time(now)

    def _refresh_all(self) -> None:
        now = self._ticker.now()
        self._refresh_cards(now)
        self._refresh_callouts()
        self.feed_list.set_events(self._feed.events, now)

    def _restyle(self) -> None:
        px = self.gui.kit.px
        self._content.setMaximumWidth(px(LAYOUT["content_max"]))
        pad = px(SPACE[8])
        self._stack.setContentsMargins(pad, px(SPACE[7]), pad, px(SPACE[8]))
        self._stack.setSpacing(px(SPACE[6]))
        self._grid.setSpacing(px(SPACE[5]))
        self._callouts.setSpacing(px(SPACE[4]))

    def _title_of(self, chat_id: int) -> str:
        row = self._view.chat(chat_id)
        return row.title if row is not None else str(chat_id)

    def _quietest(self, now: datetime) -> tuple[ChatRow, float] | None:
        best: tuple[ChatRow, float] | None = None
        for row in self._view.chats:
            age = age_seconds(row, now)
            if age is not None and (best is None or age > best[1]):
                best = (row, age)
        return best

    def _refresh_cards(self, now: datetime) -> None:
        view = self._view
        language = current_language()
        rows = view.chats
        live = sum(1 for row in rows if status_kind(row) == "live")
        self.cards["chats"].set_label(tr("overview.stat.chats"))
        self.cards["chats"].set_value(format_count(len(rows), language))
        self.cards["chats"].set_hint(tr("overview.stat.chats_hint", live=live))
        self.cards["chats"].set_tone("live" if live else "neutral")

        total = sum(row.records for row in rows)
        fresh = max(total - self._baseline_records, 0)
        self.cards["messages"].set_label(tr("overview.stat.messages"))
        self.cards["messages"].set_value(format_count(total, language))
        self.cards["messages"].set_hint(
            count_phrase(fresh, "overview.stat.messages_new", language)
            if fresh
            else tr("overview.stat.messages_none")
        )

        self._refresh_disk()
        self._refresh_backfill()
        self._refresh_quiet(now)
        self._refresh_service(now)

    def _refresh_disk(self) -> None:
        view = self._view
        card = self.cards["disk"]
        language = current_language()
        card.set_label(tr("overview.stat.disk"))
        if view.free_gb is None:
            card.set_value(tr("overview.stat.disk_unknown"))
            card.set_hint("")
            card.set_tone("neutral")
            return
        card.set_value(format_bytes(view.free_gb * GIB, language))
        card.set_hint(tr("overview.stat.disk_hint", size=format_bytes(view.total_bytes, language)))
        card.set_tone(self._disk_tone())

    def _disk_tone(self) -> Tone:
        free, low = self._view.free_gb, self._view.low_watermark_gb
        if free is None or not low:
            return "neutral"
        if free < low:
            return "danger"
        return "warning" if free < low * LOW_DISK_WARNING_FACTOR else "neutral"

    def _refresh_backfill(self) -> None:
        view = self._view
        card = self.backfill_card
        active = list(view.backfill.active)
        waiting = len(view.backfill.waiting)
        card.set_label(tr("overview.stat.backfill"))
        if active:
            title = self._title_of(active[0])
            card.set_value(tr("overview.backfill.running"))
            card.set_hint(
                tr("overview.backfill.hint_waiting", title=title, n=waiting)
                if waiting
                else tr("overview.backfill.hint_running", title=title)
            )
            card.set_tone("live")
            card.set_busy(True)
            return
        card.set_busy(False)
        if waiting:
            card.set_value(plural(waiting, "overview.backfill.waiting"))
            card.set_hint("")
            card.set_tone("neutral")
        elif view.chats and all(
            row.backfill.state in (BackfillState.DONE, BackfillState.NO_ACCESS)
            for row in view.chats
        ):
            card.set_value(tr("overview.backfill.done"))
            card.set_hint(tr("overview.backfill.hint_done"))
            card.set_tone("success")
        else:
            card.set_value(tr("overview.backfill.idle"))
            card.set_hint(tr("overview.backfill.hint_idle"))
            card.set_tone("neutral")

    def _refresh_quiet(self, now: datetime) -> None:
        card = self.cards["quiet"]
        language = current_language()
        card.set_label(tr("overview.stat.quiet"))
        best = self._quietest(now)
        if best is None:
            card.set_value(tr("overview.quiet.none"))
            card.set_hint(tr("overview.quiet.hint_none"))
            card.set_tone("neutral")
            return
        row, age = best
        thresholds = self.gui.settings.settings.thresholds_for(row.chat_id)
        card.set_value(humanize_age(age, language))
        card.set_hint(row.title)
        card.set_tone(_FRESHNESS_TONE[classify(age, thresholds)])

    def _refresh_service(self, now: datetime) -> None:
        view = self._view
        card = self.cards["service"]
        language = current_language()
        state = view.service if view.service in _SERVICE_TONE else "stopped"
        card.set_label(tr("overview.stat.service"))
        card.set_value(tr(f"overview.service.{state}"))
        card.set_tone(_SERVICE_TONE[state])
        updated = (
            format_ago(max((now - view.updated_at).total_seconds(), 0.0), language)
            if view.updated_at
            else tr("time.unknown")
        )
        if self._running_since is not None:
            up = humanize_age((now - self._running_since).total_seconds(), language)
            card.set_hint(tr("overview.service.hint", up=up, updated=updated))
        else:
            card.set_hint(tr("overview.service.hint_stopped", updated=updated))

    def _refresh_callouts(self) -> None:
        wanted = self._callout_specs()
        signature = (current_language(), *wanted)
        if signature == self._callout_signature:
            return
        self._callout_signature = signature
        clear_layout(self._callouts)
        for tone, title, body in wanted:
            self._callouts.addWidget(Callout(self.gui.kit, tone, body, title=title))

    def _callout_specs(self) -> list[tuple[Tone, str, str]]:
        view = self._view
        language = current_language()
        specs: list[tuple[Tone, str, str]] = []
        plain = [error for error in view.errors if not error.is_resolve]
        for error in plain[:MAX_ERROR_CALLOUTS]:
            body = f"{error.source}: {error.message}"[:ERROR_CHARS]
            specs.append(("danger", tr("overview.callout.errors"), body))
        missing = len(view.errors) - len(plain)
        if missing:
            specs.append(
                (
                    "warning",
                    plural(missing, "overview.callout.join.title"),
                    tr("overview.callout.join.text"),
                )
            )
        if self._cloud_warned:
            specs.append(
                (
                    "warning",
                    tr("overview.callout.cloud.title"),
                    tr("overview.callout.cloud.text"),
                )
            )
        if view.free_gb is not None and view.low_watermark_gb and self._disk_tone() != "neutral":
            specs.append(
                (
                    self._disk_tone(),
                    tr("overview.callout.disk.title"),
                    tr(
                        "overview.callout.disk.text",
                        free=format_bytes(view.free_gb * GIB, language),
                        limit=format_bytes(view.low_watermark_gb * GIB, language),
                    ),
                )
            )
        return specs

"""The Overview's "recent events" card: newest first, relative times that keep counting."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QFrame, QHBoxLayout, QLabel, QVBoxLayout, QWidget

from chatimport.gui.format import format_ago
from chatimport.gui.i18n import tr
from chatimport.gui.icons import icon_pixmap
from chatimport.gui.locales import overview as _overview_strings
from chatimport.gui.strings import current_language
from chatimport.gui.stylesheet import tone_colors
from chatimport.gui.tokens import LAYOUT, SPACE
from chatimport.gui.widgets.base import bind_kit
from chatimport.gui.widgets.card import Card

    from collections.abc import Sequence
    from datetime import datetime

    from chatimport.gui.kit import UiKit

class FeedRow(QFrame):
    def __init__(self, kit: UiKit, event: FeedEvent) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.kit = kit
        self.item = event
        self._icon = QLabel()
        self._text = ElidedLabel()
        self._when = QLabel()
        self._when.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter)
        self._when.setProperty("role", "muted")
        self._row = QHBoxLayout(self)
        self._row.addWidget(self._icon)
        self._row.addWidget(self._text, 1)
        self._row.addWidget(self._when)
        bind_kit(kit, theme=self._restyle, zoom=self._restyle, language=self.retranslate)
        self._restyle()
        self.retranslate()

    def retranslate(self) -> None:
        self._text.setText(tr(f"overview.{self.item.key}", title=self.item.title))
        self.setAccessibleName(self._text.full_text())

    def refresh_time(self, now: datetime) -> None:
        age = max((now - self.item.at).total_seconds(), 0.0)
        self._when.setText(format_ago(age, current_language()))

    def _restyle(self) -> None:
        px = self.kit.px
        self._row.setContentsMargins(0, px(SPACE[2]), 0, px(SPACE[2]))
        self._row.setSpacing(px(SPACE[4]))
        color = tone_colors(self.kit.palette, self.item.tone)[2]
        self._icon.setPixmap(icon_pixmap(self.item.icon, color, px(LAYOUT["icon_md"])))
        self._icon.setFixedWidth(px(LAYOUT["icon_md"]))


class FeedList(Card):
    def __init__(self, kit: UiKit, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(kit, parent=parent)
        self._title = make_label("", "section")
        self._rows_host = QWidget()
        self._rows = QVBoxLayout(self._rows_host)
        self._rows.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        self._rows.setSpacing(0)
        self._empty = EmptyState(kit, "activity", "", "")
        self.body.addWidget(self._title)
        self.body.addWidget(self._rows_host)
        self.body.addWidget(self._empty)
        self._widgets: list[FeedRow] = []
        bind_kit(kit, language=self._retranslate)
        self._retranslate()

    def set_events(self, events: Sequence[FeedEvent], now: datetime) -> None:
        known = {id(row.item) for row in self._widgets}
        if known == {id(event) for event in events} and len(known) == len(self._widgets):
            self.refresh_time(now)
            return
        for row in self._widgets:
            self._rows.removeWidget(row)
            row.setParent(None)
            row.deleteLater()
        self._widgets = [FeedRow(self.kit, event) for event in events]
        for row in self._widgets:
            self._rows.addWidget(row)
        self._empty.setVisible(not events)
        self._rows_host.setVisible(bool(events))
        self.refresh_time(now)

    def refresh_time(self, now: datetime) -> None:
        for row in self._widgets:
            row.refresh_time(now)

    def _retranslate(self) -> None:
        self._title.setText(tr("overview.feed.title"))
        self._empty.set_texts(tr("overview.feed.empty.title"), tr("overview.feed.empty.text"))

"""Hand-painting helpers for table cells: pills, thin progress bars, text in a token font."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Final

from PySide6.QtCore import QPointF, QRectF, Qt
from PySide6.QtGui import QColor, QFont, QFontMetrics, QLinearGradient, QPainter, QPainterPath

from chatimport.gui.icons import icon_pixmap
from chatimport.gui.stylesheet import tone_colors
from chatimport.gui.tokens import LAYOUT, SPACE, TEXT, WEIGHT

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from PySide6.QtCore import QRect

    from chatimport.gui.kit import UiKit
    from chatimport.gui.models.presentation import ChipSpec

BAR_HEIGHT: Final = 4
SHEEN_SHARE: Final = 0.35
INDETERMINATE_SHARE: Final = 0.38


def token_font(base: QFont, kit: UiKit, size: str, weight: str = "normal") -> QFont:
    font = QFont(base)
    font.setPixelSize(kit.px(TEXT[size]))
    font.setWeight(QFont.Weight(WEIGHT[weight]))
    return font


def chip_height(kit: UiKit) -> int:
    return kit.px(LAYOUT["icon_lg"] + 2)


def chip_width(kit: UiKit, spec: ChipSpec, font: QFont) -> int:
    pad = kit.px(SPACE[4])
    icon_size = kit.px(LAYOUT["icon_sm"])
    gap = kit.px(SPACE[2] + 1)
    return pad * 2 + icon_size + gap + QFontMetrics(font).horizontalAdvance(spec.text)


def draw_chip(
    painter: QPainter, kit: UiKit, spec: ChipSpec, left: int, top: int, base_font: QFont
) -> int:
    """Draw the pill with its top-left at (`left`, `top`); returns its width."""
    font = token_font(base_font, kit, "xs", "medium")
    width = chip_width(kit, spec, font)
    height = chip_height(kit)
    background, border, foreground = tone_colors(kit.palette, spec.tone)
    painter.save()
    painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing)
    rect = QRectF(left + 0.5, top + 0.5, width - 1, height - 1)
    painter.setBrush(QColor(background))
    painter.setPen(QColor(border))
    painter.drawRoundedRect(rect, height / 2, height / 2)
    pad = kit.px(SPACE[4])
    size = kit.px(LAYOUT["icon_sm"])
    pixmap = icon_pixmap(spec.icon, foreground, size)
    painter.drawPixmap(QPointF(left + pad, top + (height - size) / 2), pixmap)
    painter.setFont(font)
    painter.setPen(QColor(foreground))
    text_left = left + pad + size + kit.px(SPACE[2] + 1)
    painter.drawText(
        QRectF(text_left, top, width, height),
        int(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter),
        spec.text,
    )
    painter.restore()
    return width


def draw_bar(
    painter: QPainter,
    kit: UiKit,
    rect: QRect,
    fraction: float | None,
    color: str,
    phase: float,
) -> None:
    """A thin rounded bar; a moving sheen shows it is alive, `None` sweeps a block instead."""
    painter.save()
    painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing)
    bounds = QRectF(rect)
    radius = bounds.height() / 2
    clip = QPainterPath()
    clip.addRoundedRect(bounds, radius, radius)
    painter.setClipPath(clip)
    painter.fillRect(bounds, QColor(kit.palette.surface_active))
    fill = QColor(color)
    if fraction is None:
        width = bounds.width() * INDETERMINATE_SHARE
        left = bounds.left() - width + (bounds.width() + width) * phase
        painter.fillRect(QRectF(left, bounds.top(), width, bounds.height()), fill)
    else:
        filled = QRectF(bounds.left(), bounds.top(), bounds.width() * fraction, bounds.height())
        painter.fillRect(filled, fill)
        sheen_width = max(filled.width() * SHEEN_SHARE, bounds.height() * 4)
        left = filled.left() - sheen_width + (filled.width() + sheen_width) * phase
        gradient = QLinearGradient(left, 0, left + sheen_width, 0)
        clear, light = QColor(255, 255, 255, 0), QColor(255, 255, 255, 110)
        gradient.setColorAt(0.0, clear)
        gradient.setColorAt(0.5, light)
        gradient.setColorAt(1.0, clear)
        painter.setClipRect(filled, Qt.ClipOperation.IntersectClip)
        painter.fillRect(QRectF(left, bounds.top(), sheen_width, bounds.height()), gradient)
    painter.restore()


def draw_dot(painter: QPainter, kit: UiKit, color: str, left: int, center_y: int) -> int:
    side = kit.px(7)
    painter.save()
    painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing)
    painter.setPen(Qt.PenStyle.NoPen)
    painter.setBrush(QColor(color))
    painter.drawEllipse(QRectF(left, center_y - side / 2, side, side))
    painter.restore()
    return side

class PlaceholderPage(QWidget):
