"""The Search page: type-ahead substring search over every stored message.

The index lives behind `SearchBackend` and is touched only by `SearchWorker`'s thread. Each
typed query gets a sequence number; an answer that arrives for an older number is dropped, so
the list always belongs to the latest text. The window never waits for the index.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from dataclasses import replace
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Final

from PySide6.QtCore import QModelIndex, Qt, QTimer
from PySide6.QtGui import QKeySequence, QShortcut
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QHBoxLayout,
    QLabel,
    QSplitter,
    QStackedWidget,
    QVBoxLayout,
    QWidget,
)

from chatimport.gui.format import format_count
from chatimport.gui.i18n import plural, tr
from chatimport.gui.locales import search as _search_strings
from chatimport.gui.models.search_model import SearchResultsModel
from chatimport.gui.models.search_spans import fold_needle
from chatimport.gui.pages import search_actions as actions
from chatimport.gui.pages.search_context import ContextController, ContextPanel
from chatimport.gui.pages.search_delegate import SearchDelegate, utc_now
from chatimport.gui.pages.search_filters import ChatFilter, StatusStrip
from chatimport.gui.pages.search_parts import (
    QueryField,
    ResultsView,
    Skeleton,
    notice_keys,
)
from chatimport.gui.pages.search_worker import BackendFactory, SearchWorker, default_backend_factory
from chatimport.gui.pages.support import MainThreadRunner
from chatimport.gui.strings import current_language
from chatimport.gui.tokens import SPACE
from chatimport.gui.widgets.base import bind_kit, set_role
from chatimport.gui.widgets.button import IconButton
from chatimport.gui.widgets.empty_state import EmptyState
from chatimport.gui.widgets.progress import BusyStripe
from chatimport.gui.widgets.segmented import Segmented, SegmentOption
from chatimport.search_types import DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE, MIN_INDEXED_LENGTH, IndexState, SearchQuery

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Callable
    from concurrent.futures import Future

    from PySide6.QtGui import QKeyEvent

    from chatimport.gui.context import GuiContext
    from chatimport.search_types import (
        ChatChoice,
        IndexStatus,
        SearchBackend,
        SearchHit,
    )
    from chatimport.search_types import SearchPage as Page

_ = _search_strings
log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

DEBOUNCE_MS: Final = 120
POLL_MS: Final = 3000
PAGE_PADDING: Final = SPACE[8]
PERIODS: Final = ("any", "today", "week", "month", "year")
PERIOD_DAYS: Final = {"week": 7, "month": 30, "year": 365}
NOTICE, LOADING, RESULTS = range(3)

type StatusReply = tuple[IndexStatus, tuple[ChatChoice, ...]] | None


def _read_status(backend: SearchBackend | None) -> StatusReply:
    return None if backend is None else (backend.status(), backend.chats())


class SearchPage(QWidget):
    title_key = "nav.search"
    subtitle_key = "find.subtitle"

    def __init__(
        self,
        gui: GuiContext,
        parent: QWidget | None = None,
        *,
        backend_factory: BackendFactory = default_backend_factory,
        clock: Callable[[], datetime] = utc_now,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.gui = gui
        self._clock = clock
        kit = gui.kit
        self._worker = SearchWorker(lambda: gui.current.root, backend_factory)
        self._runner = MainThreadRunner(self)
        self._seq = 0
        self._query: SearchQuery | None = None
        self._state: IndexState | None = None
        self._no_backend = False
        self._status: IndexStatus | None = None
        self._chats: tuple[ChatChoice, ...] = ()
        self._period = "any"
        self._built = False
        self._advance_after_fetch = False
        self._last_snapshot_value: object = None

        self.model = SearchResultsModel()
        self.delegate = SearchDelegate(kit, clock)
        self.field = QueryField(kit)
        self.field.setMinimumWidth(kit.px(220))
        self.busy = BusyStripe(kit)
        self.chat_filter = ChatFilter(kit, self)
        self.period = Segmented(kit, self._period_options(), "any", compact=True)
        top = QHBoxLayout()
        top.addWidget(self.field, 1)
        top.addWidget(self.chat_filter.button)
        top.addWidget(self.period)

        self.count = QLabel()
        set_role(self.count, "title")
        self.hint = QLabel()
        set_role(self.hint, "muted")
        self.hint.hide()
        self.previous_button = IconButton(kit, "arrow-up", "", size="sm")
        self.next_button = IconButton(kit, "arrow-down", "", size="sm")
        self.strip = StatusStrip(kit)
        info = QHBoxLayout()
        info.addWidget(self.count)
        info.addWidget(self.previous_button)
        info.addWidget(self.next_button)
        info.addWidget(self.hint, 1)
        info.addStretch(1)
        info.addWidget(self.strip)

        self.notice = EmptyState(kit, "search", "", "")
        self.skeleton = Skeleton(kit)
        self.results = ResultsView()
        self.results.setModel(self.model)
        self.results.use_delegate(self.delegate)
        self.results.setAccessibleName(tr("nav.search"))
        self.stack = QStackedWidget()
        for widget in (self.notice, self.skeleton, self.results):
            self.stack.addWidget(widget)
        self.context = ContextPanel(kit)
        self.context.hide()
        self.ctx = ContextController(self.context, self._worker, self._runner, self._needle)
        self.splitter = QSplitter(Qt.Orientation.Horizontal)
        self.splitter.setChildrenCollapsible(False)
        self.splitter.addWidget(self.stack)
        self.splitter.addWidget(self.context)
        self.splitter.setStretchFactor(0, 3)
        self.splitter.setStretchFactor(1, 2)

        self._column = QVBoxLayout(self)
        self._column.addLayout(top)
        self._column.addWidget(self.busy)
        self._column.addLayout(info)
        self._column.addWidget(self.splitter, 1)

        self._debounce = QTimer(self)
        self._debounce.setSingleShot(True)
        self._debounce.setInterval(DEBOUNCE_MS)
        self._poll = QTimer(self)
        self._poll.setInterval(POLL_MS)
        self._connect()
        bind_kit(kit, zoom=self._restyle, language=self._retranslate)
        kit.theme.changed.connect(self.results.viewport().update)
        self.destroyed.connect(self._worker.close)
        self._restyle()
        self._retranslate()
        self._built = True

    def _connect(self) -> None:
        self.field.textChanged.connect(self._on_text)
        self.field.next_requested.connect(self.select_next)
        self.field.previous_requested.connect(self.select_previous)
        self._debounce.timeout.connect(self.run_query)
        self._poll.timeout.connect(self.refresh_status)
        self.period.selected.connect(self._on_period)
        self.chat_filter.changed.connect(self._requery)
        self.next_button.clicked.connect(self.select_next)
        self.previous_button.clicked.connect(self.select_previous)
        self.model.more_requested.connect(self._fetch_more)
        self.results.activated.connect(self._on_activated)
        self.results.doubleClicked.connect(self._on_activated)
        self.results.selectionModel().currentChanged.connect(self._on_current)
        self.context.close_requested.connect(self.close_context)
        self.context.open_requested.connect(self.open_in_telegram)
        self.context.copy_link_requested.connect(self.copy_link)
        self.context.copy_text_requested.connect(self.copy_text)
        self.gui.bridge.snapshot.connect(self._on_snapshot)
        QShortcut(QKeySequence.StandardKey.Copy, self.results, self.copy_text)

    def _needle(self) -> str:
        return self.model.needle

    def focus_search(self) -> None:
        self.field.setFocus(Qt.FocusReason.ShortcutFocusReason)
        self.field.selectAll()

    def keyPressEvent(self, event: QKeyEvent) -> None:
        if event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_Escape and self.ctx.is_open:
            self.close_context()
            event.accept()
            return
        super().keyPressEvent(event)

    def showEvent(self, event: object) -> None:
        super().showEvent(event)  # pyright: ignore[reportArgumentType]
        self.refresh_status()

    def hideEvent(self, event: object) -> None:
        super().hideEvent(event)  # pyright: ignore[reportArgumentType]
        self._poll.stop()

    @property
    def state(self) -> IndexState | None:
        return self._state

    @property
    def since(self) -> datetime | None:
        now = self._clock()
        if self._period == "today":
            local = now.astimezone()
            return local.replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0).astimezone(UTC)
        days = PERIOD_DAYS.get(self._period)
        return now - timedelta(days=days) if days is not None else None

    def _period_options(self) -> list[SegmentOption]:
        return [SegmentOption(name, tr(f"find.period.{name}")) for name in PERIODS]

    def _on_text(self, text: str) -> None:
        if not fold_needle(text):
            self._debounce.stop()
            self.run_query()
            return
        self._debounce.start()

    def _on_period(self, name: str) -> None:
        self._period = name
        self._requery()

    def _requery(self) -> None:
        if fold_needle(self.field.text()):
            self._debounce.start()

    def _blocked(self) -> bool:
        return self._no_backend or self._state in (IndexState.DISABLED, IndexState.MISSING)

    def run_query(self) -> None:
        """Start a search for the text now in the box (the debounce timer calls this)."""
        self._debounce.stop()
        self._seq += 1
        self._advance_after_fetch = False
        text = self.field.text()
        needle = fold_needle(text)
        if not needle:
            self._query = None
            self.model.clear()
            self._set_busy(False)
            self._show_notice()
            self._sync_count()
            return
        query = SearchQuery(
            text=text,
            chat_ids=self.chat_filter.selected or None,
            since=self.since,
            limit=DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE,
        )
        self._query = query
        self.delegate.needle = text
        if self._blocked():
            self.model.clear()
            self._set_busy(False)
            self._show_notice()
            self._sync_count()
            return
        self._set_busy(True)
        if self.model.loaded == 0:
            self.stack.setCurrentIndex(LOADING)
        seq = self._seq
        future = self._worker.run(
            lambda backend: None if backend is None else backend.search(query)
        )
        self._runner.watch(future, lambda done: self._on_first_page(seq, done))

    def _on_first_page(self, seq: int, done: Future[Page | None]) -> None:
        if seq != self._seq:
            return
        self._set_busy(False)
        try:
            page = done.result()
        except Exception as error:
            log.warning("search failed: %s", type(error).__name__)
            self.model.clear()
            self._show_notice(error=True)
            self._sync_count()
            return
        if page is None:
            self._no_backend = True
            self.model.clear()
            self._show_notice()
            self._sync_count()
            self.refresh_status()
            return
        self._no_backend = False
        self.delegate.needle = page.query.text
        self.model.reset(page)
        self.results.doItemsLayout()
        if page.total == 0:
            self._show_notice()
        else:
            self.stack.setCurrentIndex(RESULTS)
        self._sync_count()

    def _fail_more(self) -> None:
        self._advance_after_fetch = False
        self.model.fetch_failed()

    def _fetch_more(self, offset: int) -> None:
        query = self._query
        if query is None:
            self._fail_more()
            return
        more = replace(query, offset=offset)
        seq = self._seq
        future = self._worker.run(lambda backend: None if backend is None else backend.search(more))
        self._runner.watch(future, lambda done: self._on_more_page(seq, done))

    def _on_more_page(self, seq: int, done: Future[Page | None]) -> None:
        if seq != self._seq:
            return
        try:
            page = done.result()
        except Exception as error:
            log.warning("loading more results failed: %s", type(error).__name__)
            self._fail_more()
            return
        before = self.model.loaded
        if page is None or not self.model.append(page):
            self._fail_more()
            return
        self._sync_count()
        if self._advance_after_fetch:
            self._advance_after_fetch = False
            if self.model.loaded > before:
                self._select_row(before)

    def _set_busy(self, busy: bool) -> None:
        self.busy.set_active(busy)

    def _show_notice(self, *, error: bool = False) -> None:
        missing = self._no_backend or self._state is IndexState.MISSING
        searching = bool(fold_needle(self.field.text()))
        icon, title, body = notice_keys(error, missing, self._state, searching)
        self.notice.set_icon(icon)
        self.notice.set_texts(tr(title), tr(body))
        self.stack.setCurrentIndex(NOTICE)

    def _sync_count(self) -> None:
        total = self.model.total
        language = current_language()
        if self._query is None or self._blocked():
            self.count.setText("")
        elif total == 0:
            self.count.setText(tr("find.count.none"))
        else:
            self.count.setText(plural(total, "find.count", n=format_count(total, language)))
        shown = self.model.loaded
        partial = 0 < shown < total
        loaded = tr("find.count.partial", shown=format_count(shown, language))
        self.count.setToolTip(loaded if partial else "")
        short = 0 < len(fold_needle(self.field.text())) < MIN_INDEXED_LENGTH
        self.hint.setText(tr("find.state.short.text") if short else "")
        self.hint.setVisible(short)
        self.previous_button.setVisible(shown > 0)
        self.next_button.setVisible(shown > 0)

    def select_next(self) -> None:
        self._step(1)

    def select_previous(self) -> None:
        self._step(-1)

    def _step(self, delta: int) -> None:
        current = self.results.currentIndex()
        row = (
            current.row() + delta
            if current.isValid()
            else (0 if delta > 0 else self.model.loaded - 1)
        )
        if row >= self.model.loaded:
            if self.model.canFetchMore():
                self._advance_after_fetch = True
                self.model.fetchMore()
            return
        if row >= 0:
            self._select_row(row)

    def _select_row(self, row: int) -> None:
        index = self.model.index(row, 0)
        if index.isValid():
            self.results.setCurrentIndex(index)
            self.results.scrollTo(index)

    def selected_hit(self) -> SearchHit | None:
        index = self.results.currentIndex()
        return self.model.hit_at(index.row()) if index.isValid() else None

    def _on_current(self, current: QModelIndex, _previous: QModelIndex) -> None:
        hit = self.model.hit_at(current.row()) if current.isValid() else None
        if hit is not None and self.ctx.is_open:
            self.ctx.load(hit)

    def _on_activated(self, index: QModelIndex) -> None:
        if index.isValid():
            self.open_context()

    def open_context(self) -> None:
        hit = self.selected_hit()
        if hit is not None and self.ctx.open(hit):
            total = max(self.splitter.width(), 1)
            self.splitter.setSizes([total * 3 // 5, total * 2 // 5])

    def close_context(self) -> None:
        self.ctx.close()
        self.results.setFocus(Qt.FocusReason.OtherFocusReason)

    def _target_hit(self) -> SearchHit | None:
        return self.ctx.target() or self.selected_hit()

    def copy_text(self) -> None:
        hit = self._target_hit()
        if hit is not None:
            actions.copy_text(self, hit)

    def copy_link(self) -> None:
        hit = self._target_hit()
        if hit is not None:
            actions.copy_link(self, hit)

    def open_in_telegram(self) -> None:
        hit = self._target_hit()
        if hit is not None:
            actions.open_link(self, hit)

    def refresh_status(self) -> None:
        future = self._worker.run(_read_status)
        self._runner.watch(future, self._on_status)

    def _on_snapshot(self, snapshot: dict[str, object]) -> None:
        value = snapshot.get("search")
        if value == self._last_snapshot_value:
            return
        self._last_snapshot_value = value
        self.refresh_status()

    def _on_status(self, done: Future[StatusReply]) -> None:
        try:
            reply = done.result()
        except Exception as error:
            log.warning("reading the search status failed: %s", type(error).__name__)
            return
        before = self._state
        if reply is None:
            self._no_backend = True
            self._status = None
            self._state = IndexState.MISSING
            self._chats = ()
        else:
            self._no_backend = False
            self._status, self._chats = reply
            self._state = self._status.state
        self._sync_status()
        self.chat_filter.set_chats(self._chats)
        wants = self._state in (IndexState.BUILDING, IndexState.READY)
        if wants and before not in (None, self._state) and fold_needle(self.field.text()):
            self.run_query()
        elif self.stack.currentIndex() == NOTICE:
            self._show_notice()
            self._sync_count()

    def _sync_status(self) -> None:
        changing = self.strip.show_state(self._state, self._status)
        if changing and self.isVisible():
            self._poll.start()
        else:
            self._poll.stop()

    def _retranslate(self) -> None:
        if self._built:
            self.period.set_options(self._period_options(), self._period)
        self.previous_button.set_tooltip(tr("find.previous"))
        self.next_button.set_tooltip(tr("find.next"))
        self.results.setAccessibleName(tr("nav.search"))
        self.model.layoutChanged.emit()
        self._sync_status()
        self.chat_filter.retranslate()
        self._sync_count()
        if self.stack.currentIndex() == NOTICE:
            self._show_notice()

    def _restyle(self) -> None:
        kit = self.gui.kit
        pad = kit.px(PAGE_PADDING)
        self._column.setContentsMargins(pad, kit.px(SPACE[6]), pad, kit.px(SPACE[5]))
        self._column.setSpacing(kit.px(SPACE[4]))
        self.chat_filter.button.setMinimumWidth(kit.px(150))
        self.results.sync_width()

"""What can be done with a found message: copy its text or link, open it in Telegram."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from PySide6.QtCore import QUrl
from PySide6.QtGui import QDesktopServices, QGuiApplication

from chatimport.gui.i18n import tr
from chatimport.gui.pages.support import notify

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QWidget

    from chatimport.search_types import SearchHit


def copy_text(widget: QWidget, hit: SearchHit) -> None:
    QGuiApplication.clipboard().setText(hit.text)
    notify(widget, "success", tr("find.toast.text_copied"))


def copy_link(widget: QWidget, hit: SearchHit) -> None:
    if hit.link is not None:
        QGuiApplication.clipboard().setText(hit.link)
        notify(widget, "success", tr("find.toast.link_copied"))


def open_link(widget: QWidget, hit: SearchHit) -> None:
    if hit.link is not None and not QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl(hit.link)):
        notify(widget, "danger", tr("find.toast.open_failed"))

"""The context drawer of the Search page: the messages around a result and the actions on it."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Final

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt, Signal
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QFrame, QHBoxLayout, QLabel, QScrollArea, QVBoxLayout, QWidget

from chatimport.gui.format import format_exact
from chatimport.gui.i18n import tr
from chatimport.gui.models.search_spans import find_spans, highlight_html
from chatimport.gui.pages.support import clear_layout
from chatimport.gui.tokens import RADIUS, SPACE, TEXT
from chatimport.gui.widgets.base import bind_kit
from chatimport.gui.widgets.button import Button, IconButton
from chatimport.gui.widgets.labels import ElidedLabel, make_label

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Callable
    from concurrent.futures import Future

    from chatimport.gui.kit import UiKit
    from chatimport.gui.pages.search_worker import SearchWorker
    from chatimport.gui.pages.support import MainThreadRunner

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

CONTEXT_BEFORE: Final = 3
CONTEXT_AFTER: Final = 3


class ContextPanel(QFrame):
    close_requested = Signal()
    open_requested = Signal()
    copy_link_requested = Signal()
    copy_text_requested = Signal()

    def __init__(self, kit: UiKit, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.kit = kit
        self.setObjectName("ContextPanel")
        self._hit: SearchHit | None = None
        self._rows: list[tuple[QFrame, bool]] = []
        self._title = make_label("", "title")
        self._subtitle = ElidedLabel("")
        self.close_button = IconButton(kit, "x", "")
        head = QHBoxLayout()
        head.addWidget(self._title, 1)
        head.addWidget(self.close_button)

        self._rows_layout = QVBoxLayout()
        self._rows_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        self._note = make_label("", "muted", wrap=True)
        holder = QWidget()
        column = QVBoxLayout(holder)
        column.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        column.addWidget(self._note)
        column.addLayout(self._rows_layout)
        column.addStretch(1)
        self._scroll = QScrollArea()
        self._scroll.setWidgetResizable(True)
        self._scroll.setFrameShape(QFrame.Shape.NoFrame)
        self._scroll.setWidget(holder)
        self._holder = holder

        self.open_button = Button(kit, "", variant="primary", size="sm", icon_name="external")
        self.link_button = Button(kit, "", size="sm", icon_name="copy")
        self.text_button = Button(kit, "", size="sm", icon_name="copy")
        actions = QHBoxLayout()
        for button in (self.open_button, self.link_button, self.text_button):
            actions.addWidget(button)
        actions.addStretch(1)

        self._column = QVBoxLayout(self)
        self._column.addLayout(head)
        self._column.addWidget(self._subtitle)
        self._column.addWidget(self._scroll, 1)
        self._column.addLayout(actions)

        self.close_button.clicked.connect(self.close_requested)
        self.open_button.clicked.connect(self.open_requested)
        self.link_button.clicked.connect(self.copy_link_requested)
        self.text_button.clicked.connect(self.copy_text_requested)
        bind_kit(kit, theme=self._restyle, zoom=self._restyle, language=self._retranslate)
        self._restyle()
        self._retranslate()
        self._sync_buttons()

    @property
    def hit(self) -> SearchHit | None:
        return self._hit

    @property
    def message_count(self) -> int:
        return len(self._rows)

    @property
    def note(self) -> str:
        return self._note.text()

    def show_loading(self, hit: SearchHit) -> None:
        self._begin(hit)
        self._note.setText(tr("find.ctx.loading"))

    def show_messages(
        self, hit: SearchHit, messages: tuple[ContextMessage, ...], needle: str
    ) -> None:
        self._begin(hit)
        if not messages:
            self._note.setText(tr("find.ctx.missing"))
            return
        self._note.setText("")
        for message in messages:
            self._add_row(message, needle)
        self._restyle()

    def _begin(self, hit: SearchHit) -> None:
        self._hit = hit
        clear_layout(self._rows_layout)
        self._rows.clear()
        self._subtitle.setText(hit.chat_title)
        self._subtitle.setToolTip(hit.chat_title)
        self._sync_buttons()

    def _add_row(self, message: ContextMessage, needle: str) -> None:
        row = QFrame()
        row.setObjectName("ContextRow")
        meta = f"{format_exact(message.date)}"
        if message.edited:
            meta = f"{meta} · {tr('find.edited')}"
        if message.is_target:
            meta = f"{tr('find.ctx.target')} · {meta}"
        head = QLabel(meta)
        body = QLabel()
        body.setTextFormat(Qt.TextFormat.RichText)
        body.setWordWrap(True)
        body.setTextInteractionFlags(Qt.TextInteractionFlag.TextSelectableByMouse)
        spans = find_spans(message.text, needle) if message.is_target else []
        body.setText(highlight_html(message.text, spans, self._tint()))
        layout = QVBoxLayout(row)
        layout.addWidget(head)
        layout.addWidget(body)
        row.setProperty("target", message.is_target)
        self._rows_layout.addWidget(row)
        self._rows.append((row, message.is_target))

    def _tint(self) -> str:
        return self.kit.palette.accent_soft_border

    def _sync_buttons(self) -> None:
        hit = self._hit
        self.open_button.setEnabled(hit is not None and hit.link is not None)
        self.link_button.setEnabled(hit is not None and hit.link is not None)
        self.text_button.setEnabled(hit is not None)
        self.open_button.setToolTip(
            "" if self.open_button.isEnabled() else tr("find.ctx.open_none")
        )

    def _retranslate(self) -> None:
        self._title.setText(tr("find.ctx.title"))
        self.close_button.set_tooltip(tr("find.ctx.close"))
        self.open_button.setText(tr("find.ctx.open"))
        self.link_button.setText(tr("find.ctx.copy_link"))
        self.text_button.setText(tr("find.ctx.copy_text"))
        self.setAccessibleName(tr("find.ctx.title"))
        self._sync_buttons()

    def _restyle(self) -> None:
        palette = self.kit.palette
        px = self.kit.px
        self._column.setContentsMargins(px(SPACE[5]), px(SPACE[5]), px(SPACE[5]), px(SPACE[5]))
        self._column.setSpacing(px(SPACE[4]))
        self._rows_layout.setSpacing(px(SPACE[3]))
        self.setStyleSheet(
            f"#ContextPanel {{ background: {palette.surface};"
            f" border-left: 1px solid {palette.border}; }}"
        )
        self._holder.setStyleSheet(f"background: {palette.surface};")
        for row, target in self._rows:
            fill = palette.accent_soft if target else palette.surface_sunken
            edge = palette.accent if target else palette.border
            row.setStyleSheet(
                f"#ContextRow {{ background: {fill}; border: 1px solid {edge};"
                f" border-radius: {px(RADIUS['md'])}px; }}"
                f"#ContextRow QLabel {{ background: transparent; color: {palette.fg};"
                f" font-size: {px(TEXT['base'])}px; }}"
            )
            labels = row.findChildren(QLabel)
            if labels:
                labels[0].setStyleSheet(
                    f"color: {palette.fg_muted}; font-size: {px(TEXT['xs'])}px;"
                    " background: transparent;"
                )
            layout = row.layout()
            if layout is not None:
                layout.setContentsMargins(px(SPACE[4]), px(SPACE[3]), px(SPACE[4]), px(SPACE[3]))
                layout.setSpacing(px(SPACE[2]))
        self._scroll.setStyleSheet("QScrollArea { background: transparent; border: none; }")


class ContextController:
    """Opens, reloads and closes the drawer; answers for a hit no longer shown are dropped."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        panel: ContextPanel,
        worker: SearchWorker,
        runner: MainThreadRunner,
        needle: Callable[[], str],
    ) -> None:
        self._panel = panel
        self._worker = worker
        self._runner = runner
        self._needle = needle
        self._seq = 0
        self.is_open = False

    def open(self, hit: SearchHit) -> bool:
        """Show the drawer for `hit`; False when it already shows exactly this hit."""
        if self.is_open and self._panel.hit == hit:
            return False
        self.is_open = True
        self._panel.show()
        self.load(hit)
        return True

    def load(self, hit: SearchHit) -> None:
        self._seq += 1
        seq = self._seq
        self._panel.show_loading(hit)
        chat_id, msg_id = hit.chat_id, hit.msg_id
        future = self._worker.run(
            lambda backend: (
                ()
                if backend is None
                else backend.context(chat_id, msg_id, CONTEXT_BEFORE, CONTEXT_AFTER)
            )
        )
        self._runner.watch(future, lambda done: self._arrived(seq, hit, done))

    def _arrived(self, seq: int, hit: SearchHit, done: Future[tuple[ContextMessage, ...]]) -> None:
        if seq != self._seq:
            return
        try:
            messages = done.result()
        except Exception as error:
            log.warning("loading the context failed: %s", type(error).__name__)
            messages = ()
        self._panel.show_messages(hit, messages, self._needle())

    def close(self) -> None:
        self.is_open = False
        self._seq += 1
        self._panel.hide()

    def target(self) -> SearchHit | None:
        return self._panel.hit if self.is_open else None

"""Paints a search result: title, exact moment, age, edited pill and highlighted text."""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Final

from PySide6.QtCore import QModelIndex, QPointF, QRect, QSize, Qt
from PySide6.QtGui import (
    QColor,
    QFont,
    QFontMetrics,
    QPainter,
    QTextCharFormat,
    QTextLayout,
    QTextOption,
)
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QStyle, QStyledItemDelegate, QStyleOptionViewItem

from chatimport.gui.format import format_ago, format_exact
from chatimport.gui.i18n import tr
from chatimport.gui.models.presentation import ChipSpec
from chatimport.gui.models.search_model import HIT_ROLE
from chatimport.gui.models.search_spans import ELLIPSIS, Span, snippet
from chatimport.gui.pages.paint import chip_height, chip_width, draw_chip, token_font
from chatimport.gui.strings import current_language
from chatimport.gui.tokens import SPACE
from chatimport.search_types import SearchHit

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Callable

    from PySide6.QtCore import QPersistentModelIndex

    from chatimport.gui.kit import UiKit

type _Index = QModelIndex | QPersistentModelIndex

MAX_LINES: Final = 4
HIGHLIGHT_ALPHA: Final = 80
MIN_WIDTH: Final = 120


def _formats(spans: tuple[Span, ...], color: QColor) -> list[QTextLayout.FormatRange]:
    ranges: list[QTextLayout.FormatRange] = []
    for start, end in spans:
        fmt = QTextCharFormat()
        fmt.setBackground(color)
        item = QTextLayout.FormatRange()
        item.start = start
        item.length = end - start
        item.format = fmt
        ranges.append(item)
    return ranges


def _lay_out(
    text: str, spans: tuple[Span, ...], font: QFont, width: int, color: QColor
) -> tuple[QTextLayout, int, int]:
    """The layout, its height and how many characters fit in `MAX_LINES` lines."""
    layout = QTextLayout(text, font)
    wrap = QTextOption()
    wrap.setWrapMode(QTextOption.WrapMode.WrapAtWordBoundaryOrAnywhere)
    layout.setTextOption(wrap)
    layout.setFormats(_formats(spans, color))
    layout.beginLayout()
    top = 0.0
    lines = 0
    fitted = 0
    while lines < MAX_LINES:
        line = layout.createLine()
        if not line.isValid():
            break
        line.setLineWidth(width)
        line.setPosition(QPointF(0.0, top))
        top += line.height()
        lines += 1
        fitted = line.textStart() + line.textLength()
    layout.endLayout()
    return layout, int(top + 0.999), fitted


def body_layout(
    text: str, spans: tuple[Span, ...], font: QFont, width: int, color: QColor
) -> tuple[QTextLayout, int]:
    """Lay the text out in at most `MAX_LINES` lines; a longer text ends with an ellipsis."""
    layout, height, fitted = _lay_out(text, spans, font, width, color)
    if fitted >= len(text):
        return layout, height
    cut = max(fitted - 1, 1)
    clipped = text[:cut].rstrip() + ELLIPSIS
    kept = tuple((a, min(b, cut)) for a, b in spans if a < cut)
    layout, height, _ = _lay_out(clipped, kept, font, width, color)
    return layout, height


def utc_now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


class SearchDelegate(QStyledItemDelegate):
    def __init__(self, kit: UiKit, clock: Callable[[], datetime] = utc_now) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.kit = kit
        self.clock = clock
        self.available_width = 0
        self.needle = ""

    def _pad(self) -> int:
        return self.kit.px(SPACE[5])

    def _hit(self, index: _Index) -> SearchHit | None:
        value = index.data(HIT_ROLE)
        return value if isinstance(value, SearchHit) else None

    def _highlight(self) -> QColor:
        color = QColor(self.kit.palette.accent)
        color.setAlpha(HIGHLIGHT_ALPHA)
        return color

    def _fonts(self, base: QFont) -> tuple[QFont, QFont, QFont]:
        return (
            token_font(base, self.kit, "base", "semibold"),
            token_font(base, self.kit, "xs"),
            token_font(base, self.kit, "base"),
        )

    def _body(self, hit: SearchHit, font: QFont, width: int) -> tuple[QTextLayout, int]:
        piece = snippet(hit.text, self.needle)
        return body_layout(piece.text, piece.spans, font, width, self._highlight())

    def _line_height(self, base: QFont) -> int:
        title, meta, _body = self._fonts(base)
        return max(QFontMetrics(title).height(), QFontMetrics(meta).height(), chip_height(self.kit))

    def _edited_spec(self) -> ChipSpec:
        return ChipSpec(tr("find.edited"), "muted", "refresh")

    def _chip_space(self, base: QFont, hit: SearchHit) -> int:
        if not hit.edited:
            return 0
        font = token_font(base, self.kit, "xs", "medium")
        return chip_width(self.kit, self._edited_spec(), font) + self.kit.px(SPACE[4])

    def _is_stacked(self, base: QFont, hit: SearchHit, width: int) -> bool:
        """The exact moment drops to its own line when title, moment and pill do not fit."""
        title, meta, _body = self._fonts(base)
        need = (
            QFontMetrics(title).horizontalAdvance(hit.chat_title)
            + QFontMetrics(meta).horizontalAdvance(self.meta_text(hit))
            + self._chip_space(base, hit)
            + self.kit.px(SPACE[5])
        )
        return need > width

    def _head_height(self, base: QFont, hit: SearchHit, width: int) -> int:
        first = self._line_height(base)
        if not self._is_stacked(base, hit, width):
            return first
        return first + QFontMetrics(self._fonts(base)[1]).height() + self.kit.px(SPACE[1])

    def _inner_width(self, option_width: int) -> int:
        full = self.available_width or option_width
        return max(full - 2 * self._pad(), MIN_WIDTH)

    def sizeHint(self, option: QStyleOptionViewItem, index: _Index) -> QSize:
        hit = self._hit(index)
        width = self.available_width or option.rect.width()
        if hit is None:
            return super().sizeHint(option, index)
        _title, _meta, body_font = self._fonts(option.font)
        inner = self._inner_width(option.rect.width())
        _layout, body = self._body(hit, body_font, inner)
        vertical = self.kit.px(SPACE[4])
        gap = self.kit.px(SPACE[2])
        head = self._head_height(option.font, hit, inner)
        return QSize(width, 2 * vertical + head + gap + body)

    def paint(self, painter: QPainter, option: QStyleOptionViewItem, index: _Index) -> None:
        hit = self._hit(index)
        if hit is None:
            super().paint(painter, option, index)
            return
        background = QStyleOptionViewItem(option)
        self.initStyleOption(background, index)
        background.text = ""
        background.features &= ~QStyleOptionViewItem.ViewItemFeature.HasDisplay
        style = option.widget.style() if option.widget else None
        if style is not None:
            style.drawControl(
                QStyle.ControlElement.CE_ItemViewItem, background, painter, option.widget
            )
        painter.save()
        painter.setClipRect(option.rect)
        pad = self._pad()
        area = option.rect.adjusted(pad, self.kit.px(SPACE[4]), -pad, 0)
        head = self._head_height(option.font, hit, area.width())
        self._paint_head(painter, option, area, head, hit)
        top = area.top() + head + self.kit.px(SPACE[2])
        self._paint_body(painter, option, area, top, hit)
        painter.setPen(QColor(self.kit.palette.border))
        painter.drawLine(
            option.rect.left(), option.rect.bottom(), option.rect.right(), option.rect.bottom()
        )
        painter.restore()

    def meta_text(self, hit: SearchHit) -> str:
        age = (self.clock() - hit.date).total_seconds()
        return f"{format_exact(hit.date)} · {format_ago(max(age, 0.0), current_language())}"

    def _paint_head(
        self,
        painter: QPainter,
        option: QStyleOptionViewItem,
        area: QRect,
        head: int,
        hit: SearchHit,
    ) -> None:
        palette = self.kit.palette
        title_font, meta_font, _body = self._fonts(option.font)
        stacked = self._is_stacked(option.font, hit, area.width())
        first = self._line_height(option.font)
        gap = self.kit.px(SPACE[4])
        right = area.right()
        if hit.edited:
            spec = self._edited_spec()
            chip_font = token_font(option.font, self.kit, "xs", "medium")
            width = chip_width(self.kit, spec, chip_font)
            top = area.top() + (first - chip_height(self.kit)) // 2
            draw_chip(painter, self.kit, spec, right - width + 1, top, option.font)
            right -= width + gap
        meta = self.meta_text(hit)
        meta_metrics = QFontMetrics(meta_font)
        painter.setFont(meta_font)
        painter.setPen(QColor(palette.fg_muted))
        if stacked:
            meta_rect = QRect(area.left(), area.top() + first, area.width(), head - first)
            align = Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft
            shown = meta_metrics.elidedText(meta, Qt.TextElideMode.ElideRight, area.width())
            title_right = right
        else:
            meta_width = meta_metrics.horizontalAdvance(meta)
            meta_rect = QRect(right - meta_width + 1, area.top(), meta_width, first)
            align = Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight
            shown = meta
            title_right = meta_rect.left() - gap
        painter.drawText(meta_rect, int(align | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter), shown)
        title_width = max(title_right - area.left(), 1)
        painter.setFont(title_font)
        painter.setPen(QColor(palette.fg))
        painter.drawText(
            QRect(area.left(), area.top(), title_width, first),
            int(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter),
            QFontMetrics(title_font).elidedText(
                hit.chat_title, Qt.TextElideMode.ElideRight, title_width
            ),
        )

    def _paint_body(
        self, painter: QPainter, option: QStyleOptionViewItem, area: QRect, top: int, hit: SearchHit
    ) -> None:
        _title, _meta, body_font = self._fonts(option.font)
        layout, _height = self._body(hit, body_font, max(area.width(), 1))
        painter.setPen(QColor(self.kit.palette.fg_secondary))
        painter.setFont(body_font)
        layout.draw(painter, QPointF(area.left(), top))

"""Filter and status widgets of the Search page: the chat picker and the index status strip."""

from __future__ import annotations

from functools import partial
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Final

from PySide6.QtCore import QObject, QPoint, Signal
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QHBoxLayout, QLabel, QWidget

from chatimport.gui.format import format_count, format_percent
from chatimport.gui.i18n import plural, tr
from chatimport.gui.pages.search_parts import StickyMenu
from chatimport.gui.strings import current_language
from chatimport.gui.widgets.base import bind_kit, set_role
from chatimport.gui.widgets.button import Button
from chatimport.gui.widgets.progress import ProgressBar
from chatimport.search_types import IndexState

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from PySide6.QtGui import QAction

    from chatimport.gui.kit import UiKit
    from chatimport.search_types import ChatChoice, IndexStatus


PROGRESS_WIDTH: Final = 96


class ChatFilter(QObject):
    """A button with a multi-select menu of chats; nothing selected means every chat."""

    changed = Signal()

    def __init__(self, kit: UiKit, parent: QWidget) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.button = Button(kit, "", icon_name="chevron-down")
        self.menu = StickyMenu(parent)
        self._chats: tuple[ChatChoice, ...] = ()
        self._built: tuple[ChatChoice, ...] | None = None
        self._selected: set[int] = set()
        self._actions: dict[int, QAction] = {}
        self._all: QAction | None = None
        self.button.clicked.connect(self._popup)
        self.refresh()

    @property
    def selected(self) -> frozenset[int]:
        return frozenset(self._selected)

    def set_chats(self, chats: tuple[ChatChoice, ...]) -> None:
        self._chats = chats
        self._selected &= {choice.chat_id for choice in chats}
        self.refresh()

    def retranslate(self) -> None:
        self._built = None
        self.refresh()

    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Rebuild the menu when the chats or the language changed, then show the selection."""
        if self._built != self._chats or self._all is None:
            self._build()
        self._sync()

    def _build(self) -> None:
        self._built = self._chats
        self.menu.clear()
        self._actions.clear()
        language = current_language()
        self._all = self.menu.addAction(tr("find.chats.menu_all"))
        self._all.setCheckable(True)
        self._all.toggled.connect(self._on_all)
        self.menu.addSeparator()
        if not self._chats:
            self.menu.addAction(tr("find.chats.none")).setEnabled(False)
        for choice in self._chats:
            action = self.menu.addAction(
                f"{choice.title}  ({format_count(choice.messages, language)})"
            )
            action.setCheckable(True)
            action.toggled.connect(partial(self._on_chat, choice.chat_id))
            self._actions[choice.chat_id] = action

    def _sync(self) -> None:
        if self._all is not None:
            self._check(self._all, not self._selected)
        for chat_id, action in self._actions.items():
            self._check(action, chat_id in self._selected)
        chosen = [choice for choice in self._chats if choice.chat_id in self._selected]
        if not chosen:
            text = tr("find.chats.all")
        elif len(chosen) == 1:
            text = chosen[0].title
        else:
            text = plural(len(chosen), "find.chats.some")
        self.button.setText(text)
        self.button.setToolTip(tr("find.chats.tip"))
        self.button.setEnabled(bool(self._chats))

    @staticmethod
    def _check(action: QAction, checked: bool) -> None:
        action.blockSignals(True)
        action.setChecked(checked)
        action.blockSignals(False)

    def _on_all(self, _on: bool) -> None:
        self._selected.clear()
        self._sync()
        self.changed.emit()

    def _on_chat(self, chat_id: int, on: bool) -> None:
        if on:
            self._selected.add(chat_id)
        else:
            self._selected.discard(chat_id)
        self._sync()
        self.changed.emit()

    def _popup(self) -> None:
        self.menu.popup(self.button.mapToGlobal(QPoint(0, self.button.height())))


class StatusStrip(QWidget):
    """ "Indexing 47%" with a thin bar while building, otherwise a one-line index summary."""

    def __init__(self, kit: UiKit, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.label = QLabel()
        set_role(self.label, "muted")
        self.progress = ProgressBar(kit, tone="accent")
        self.progress.hide()
        self._kit = kit
        row = QHBoxLayout(self)
        row.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        row.addWidget(self.progress)
        row.addWidget(self.label)
        bind_kit(kit, zoom=self._resize)
        self._resize()

    def _resize(self) -> None:
        self.progress.setFixedWidth(self._kit.px(PROGRESS_WIDTH))

    def show_state(self, state: IndexState | None, status: IndexStatus | None) -> bool:
        """Show the index state; returns whether it is still changing (BUILDING or MISSING)."""
        language = current_language()
        building = state is IndexState.BUILDING and status is not None
        tip = ""
        if state is IndexState.DISABLED:
            text = tr("find.status.disabled")
        elif state is IndexState.MISSING:
            text = tr("find.status.missing")
        elif state is None or status is None:
            text = tr("find.status.unknown")
        elif state is IndexState.BUILDING:
            fraction = status.indexed / status.total if status.total else None
            text = tr("find.status.building", percent=format_percent(fraction or 0.0, language))
            self.progress.set_value(fraction)
            tip = tr(
                "find.status.building_tip",
                indexed=format_count(status.indexed, language),
                total=format_count(status.total, language),
            )
        else:
            count = format_count(status.indexed, language)
            text = plural(status.indexed, "find.status.ready", n=count)
        self.label.setText(text)
        self.label.setToolTip(tip)
        self.progress.setVisible(building)
        return building or state is IndexState.MISSING

def notice_keys(
    error: bool, missing: bool, state: IndexState | None, searching: bool
) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
    """Icon, title key and text key of the block that stands in for the list."""
    if error:
        return "alert", "find.state.error.title", "find.state.error.text"
    if missing:
        return "disk", "find.state.missing.title", "find.state.missing.text"
    if state is IndexState.DISABLED:
        return "ban", "find.state.disabled.title", "find.state.disabled.text"
    if searching:
        return "search", "find.state.nothing.title", "find.state.nothing.text"
    if state is IndexState.BUILDING:
        return "hourglass", "find.state.building.title", "find.state.building.text"
    return "search", "find.state.idle.title", "find.state.idle.text"


class QueryField(SearchField):
    """The search box: Enter and Down go to the next result, Shift+Enter and Up to the previous."""

    next_requested = Signal()
    previous_requested = Signal()

    def keyPressEvent(self, event: QKeyEvent) -> None:
        key = event.key()
        shift = bool(event.modifiers() & Qt.KeyboardModifier.ShiftModifier)
        if key in (Qt.Key.Key_Return, Qt.Key.Key_Enter):
            (self.previous_requested if shift else self.next_requested).emit()
            event.accept()
            return
        if key in (Qt.Key.Key_Down, Qt.Key.Key_Up):
            (self.next_requested if key == Qt.Key.Key_Down else self.previous_requested).emit()
            event.accept()
            return
        super().keyPressEvent(event)

    def _retranslate(self) -> None:
        super()._retranslate()
        self.setPlaceholderText(tr("find.placeholder"))
        self.setAccessibleName(tr("find.placeholder"))


class StickyMenu(QMenu):
    """A menu whose checkable entries toggle without closing it (multi-select)."""

    def mouseReleaseEvent(self, event: QMouseEvent) -> None:
        action = self.activeAction()
        if action is not None and action.isCheckable() and action.isEnabled():  # pyright: ignore[reportUnnecessaryComparison]
            action.trigger()
            event.accept()
            return
        super().mouseReleaseEvent(event)


class Skeleton(QWidget):
    """Grey placeholder rows shown while the first page is on its way."""

    def __init__(self, kit: UiKit, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.kit = kit
        bind_kit(kit, theme=self.update, zoom=self.update)

    def sizeHint(self) -> QSize:
        return QSize(self.kit.px(320), self.kit.px(220))

    def paintEvent(self, event: QPaintEvent) -> None:
        painter = QPainter(self)
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing)
        painter.setPen(Qt.PenStyle.NoPen)
        painter.setBrush(QColor(self.kit.palette.surface_active))
        pad = self.kit.px(SPACE[5])
        bar = self.kit.px(SPACE[4])
        gap = self.kit.px(SPACE[3])
        block = bar * 3 + gap * 4 + self.kit.px(SPACE[5])
        width = max(self.width() - 2 * pad, 1)
        for row in range(SKELETON_ROWS):
            top = row * block + pad
            if top > self.height():
                break
            for line, share in enumerate((0.34, 0.92, 0.7)):
                painter.drawRoundedRect(
                    QRectF(pad, top + line * (bar + gap), width * share, bar), bar / 2, bar / 2
                )
        event.accept()


class ResultsView(QListView):
    """The result list: it tells its delegate how wide a row is and re-lays rows on resize."""

    def __init__(self, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setUniformItemSizes(False)
        self.setVerticalScrollMode(QAbstractItemView.ScrollMode.ScrollPerPixel)
        self.setSelectionMode(QAbstractItemView.SelectionMode.SingleSelection)
        self.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers)
        self.setResizeMode(QListView.ResizeMode.Adjust)
        self.setFrameShape(QListView.Shape.NoFrame)
        self.setMouseTracking(True)
        self._rows: SearchDelegate | None = None
        self._timer = QTimer(self)
        self._timer.setSingleShot(True)
        self._timer.setInterval(RELAYOUT_MS)
        self._timer.timeout.connect(self._relayout)

    def use_delegate(self, delegate: SearchDelegate) -> None:
        self._rows = delegate
        self.setItemDelegate(delegate)

    def _relayout(self) -> None:
        if self._rows is not None:
            self._rows.available_width = self.viewport().width()
        self.doItemsLayout()

    def sync_width(self) -> None:
        self._relayout()

    def resizeEvent(self, event: QResizeEvent) -> None:
        super().resizeEvent(event)
        if self._rows is not None:
            self._rows.available_width = self.viewport().width()
        self._timer.start()

"""The thread the search backend lives on.

SQLite connections belong to the thread that opened them, so one dedicated thread opens, uses
and closes the backend; every job runs there in order. The backend is opened lazily on the
first job, again after the data root changed, and again later when the index file did not exist
yet (the factory then answered `None`).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import importlib
import logging
from concurrent.futures import Future, ThreadPoolExecutor
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Final, cast

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Callable
    from pathlib import Path

    from chatimport.search_types import SearchBackend

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

THREAD_NAME: Final = "gui-search"

type BackendFactory = Callable[[Path], SearchBackend | None]


def default_backend_factory(root: Path) -> SearchBackend | None:
    """Open the read-only index under `root`, or `None` when the module or the file is missing."""
    try:
        module = importlib.import_module("chatimport.search_index")
    except ImportError:
        return None
    opener = getattr(module, "open_reader", None)
    if not callable(opener):
        return None
    return cast("SearchBackend | None", opener(root))


class SearchWorker:
    def __init__(self, root: Callable[[], Path], factory: BackendFactory) -> None:
        self._root = root
        self._factory = factory
        self._pool = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1, thread_name_prefix=THREAD_NAME)
        self._backend: SearchBackend | None = None
        self._opened_for: Path | None = None
        self._closed = False

    def run[T](self, job: Callable[[SearchBackend | None], T]) -> Future[T]:
        """Run `job(backend)` on the worker thread; the backend is `None` without an index."""
        if self._closed:
            dead: Future[T] = Future()
            dead.cancel()
            return dead
        return self._pool.submit(self._call, job)

    def _call[T](self, job: Callable[[SearchBackend | None], T]) -> T:
        return job(self._ensure())

    def _ensure(self) -> SearchBackend | None:
        root = self._root()
        if self._backend is not None and self._opened_for != root:
            self._drop()
        if self._backend is None:
            self._backend = self._factory(root)
            self._opened_for = root
        return self._backend

    def _drop(self) -> None:
        backend, self._backend = self._backend, None
        if backend is None:
            return
        try:
            backend.close()
        except Exception as error:
            log.warning("closing the search index failed: %s", type(error).__name__)

    def close(self) -> None:
        if self._closed:
            return
        self._closed = True
        self._pool.submit(self._drop)
        self._pool.shutdown(wait=False)

"""The Settings page: a section list on the left, one card per section in a scrolling column.

        self._nav_box.setLayout(nav)
        divider = QFrame()
        set_role(divider, "vdivider")

        self._column = QVBoxLayout()
        self._column.addWidget(self._invalid)
        self._column.addWidget(self._restart_note)
        for card in self.cards.values():
            self._column.addWidget(card)
        self._column.addStretch(1)
        self._content = QWidget()
        self._content.setLayout(self._column)
        wrap = QHBoxLayout()
        wrap.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)

        row.setSpacing(0)
        row.addWidget(self._nav_box)
        row.addWidget(divider)
        row.addWidget(self._scroll, 1)

        gui.bridge.snapshot.connect(self._on_snapshot)
        bind_kit(kit, zoom=self._restyle, language=self._retranslate)
        self._restyle()

        super().showEvent(event)
        self.reload()
        self.startup.refresh()
        self.telegram.refresh_session()
        self.about.retranslate()

    def reload(self) -> None:
        """Re-read `config.toml` into every card that has no unsaved edit."""
        try:
            config = load_config(self._config_file)
        except ConfigError:
            log.exception("config.toml is invalid")
            config = Config()
            self._invalid.set_body(tr("settings.invalid_config"))
            self._invalid.show()
        else:
            self._invalid.hide()
        for card in self.config_cards:
            if not card.dirty:
                card.load(config)
        if not self.telegram.dirty:
            self.telegram.load()

    def show_section(self, key: str) -> None:
        card = self.cards.get(key)
        if card is None:
            return
        self._activate(key)
        self._scroll_to(card)
        QTimer.singleShot(0, lambda: self._scroll_to(card))

    def _scroll_to(self, card: SettingsCard) -> None:
        offset = card.mapTo(self._host, card.rect().topLeft()).y()
        self._scroll.verticalScrollBar().setValue(max(offset - self.gui.kit.px(SPACE[5]), 0))

    def _activate(self, key: str) -> None:
        for name, item in self._nav_items.items():
            item.set_active(name == key)

    def _spy(self, value: int) -> None:
        current = next(iter(self.cards))
        limit = value + self.gui.kit.px(SPY_MARGIN)
        host = self._host
        for key, card in self.cards.items():
            if card.mapTo(host, card.rect().topLeft()).y() <= limit:
                current = key
        self._activate(current)

    def _restyle(self) -> None:
        px = self.gui.kit.px
        self._nav_box.setFixedWidth(px(NAV_WIDTH))
        self._nav.setContentsMargins(px(SPACE[4]), px(SPACE[6]), px(SPACE[4]), px(SPACE[4]))  # pyright: ignore[reportOptionalMemberAccess]
        self._content.setMaximumWidth(px(CONTENT_WIDTH))
        pad = px(SPACE[6])
        self._column.setContentsMargins(pad, px(SPACE[7]), pad, px(SPACE[8]))
        self._column.setSpacing(px(SPACE[6]))

    def _retranslate(self) -> None:
        for key, item in self._nav_items.items():
            item.set_label(tr(f"settings.card.{key}.title"))
        self._restart_note.set_title(tr("settings.restart.title"))
        self._restart_note.set_body(tr("settings.restart.body"))
        self._restart_button.setText(tr("settings.restart.action"))

    def _on_snapshot(self, snapshot: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        service = str(snapshot.get("service", ""))
        if service == self._service:
            return
        self._service = service
        self.telegram.set_service_state(service)
        if service not in RUNNING:
            self._restart_note.hide()

    def _on_wizard_finished(self) -> None:
        self.reload()
        self.startup.refresh()
        self.telegram.refresh_session()
        self.about.retranslate()

    def _on_config_saved(self) -> None:
        if self._service in RUNNING and self._control is not None:
            self._restart_note.show()
        else:
            notify(self, "info", tr("settings.saved_next_start"))

    def _restart_service(self) -> None:
        self._restart_note.hide()
        if self._control is not None:
            self._control.restart()
            notify(self, "info", tr("settings.restart.started"))

"""The Appearance card: theme, language, zoom, tray behaviour and the freshness thresholds.

Everything here belongs to the window, not to the archive: changes apply at once and are kept
by `GuiSettingsStore`; nothing touches `config.toml` and no restart is needed.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Final

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QComboBox, QHBoxLayout, QLabel, QSpinBox, QWidget

from chatimport.gui.format import DAY, FreshnessThresholds
from chatimport.gui.i18n import tr

UNITS: Final = (("s", 1), ("min", 60), ("h", 3600), ("d", DAY))
THEME_ICONS: Final = {"light": "sun", "dark": "moon", "system": "monitor"}
THRESHOLD_KEYS: Final = ("fresh_below", "recent_below", "stale_below")
THRESHOLD_WIDTH: Final = 200
THEME_WIDTH: Final = 280


class ThresholdEdit(QWidget):
    """A whole number and a unit (seconds ... days) that together make a number of seconds."""

    def __init__(self, kit: UiKit, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.spin = QSpinBox()
        self.spin.setRange(1, 99_999)
        self.unit = QComboBox()
        row = QHBoxLayout(self)
        row.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        row.setSpacing(kit.px(SPACE[3]))
        row.addWidget(self.spin, 1)
        row.addWidget(self.unit, 1)
        self._fill_units()

    def _fill_units(self) -> None:
        index = self.unit.currentIndex()
        self.unit.blockSignals(True)
        self.unit.clear()
        for name, _ in UNITS:
            self.unit.addItem(tr(f"settings.unit.{name}"), name)
        self.unit.setCurrentIndex(max(index, 0))
        self.unit.blockSignals(False)

    def retranslate(self) -> None:
        self._fill_units()

    def seconds(self) -> int:
        return self.spin.value() * UNITS[self.unit.currentIndex()][1]

    def set_seconds(self, seconds: int) -> None:
        index = 0
        for position, (_, size) in enumerate(UNITS):
            if seconds >= size and seconds % size == 0:
                index = position
        self.spin.blockSignals(True)
        self.unit.blockSignals(True)
        self.unit.setCurrentIndex(index)
        self.spin.setValue(max(seconds // UNITS[index][1], 1))
        self.spin.blockSignals(False)
        self.unit.blockSignals(False)

        zoom_row.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        zoom_row.setSpacing(kit.px(SPACE[3]))
        for part in (self._zoom_out, self._zoom_text, self._zoom_in, self._zoom_auto):
            zoom_row.addWidget(part)
        zoom_row.setStretch(1, 1)

        store = gui.settings
        self._tray = Switch(kit, checked=store.settings.close_to_tray)
        self._tray.toggled.connect(self._set_close_to_tray)
        self._hidden = Switch(kit, checked=store.settings.start_hidden)
        self._hidden.toggled.connect(self._set_start_hidden)

        self._rows = {
            "theme": FieldRow(kit, self._theme, editor_width=THEME_WIDTH),
            "language": FieldRow(kit, self._language, editor_width=THEME_WIDTH),
            "zoom": FieldRow(kit, zoom_box, editor_width=THEME_WIDTH),
            "tray": FieldRow(kit, self._tray, editor_width=None),
            "hidden": FieldRow(kit, self._hidden, editor_width=None),
        }
        for row in self._rows.values():
            self.add_row(row)

        self._edits = {key: ThresholdEdit(kit) for key in THRESHOLD_KEYS}
        self._threshold_rows = {
            key: FieldRow(kit, edit, editor_width=THRESHOLD_WIDTH)
            for key, edit in self._edits.items()
        }
        self._threshold_title = QLabel()
        self._threshold_title.setProperty("role", "section")
        self._reset = Button(kit, variant="ghost", size="sm", icon_name="refresh")
        self._reset.clicked.connect(self._reset_thresholds)
        self.add_plain(self._threshold_title)
        for row in self._threshold_rows.values():
            self.add_plain(row)
        self.add_footer_button(self._reset)
        for edit in self._edits.values():
            edit.spin.valueChanged.connect(self._apply_thresholds)
            edit.unit.currentIndexChanged.connect(self._apply_thresholds)

        bind_kit(kit, language=self.retranslate, zoom=self._show_zoom)
        self.retranslate()
        self._load_thresholds(store.settings.freshness)

    def _pick_theme(self, value: str) -> None:
        if value in THEME_PREFERENCES:
            self.gui.kit.theme.set_preference(value)

    def _pick_language(self, value: str) -> None:
        if value in LANGUAGES:
            self.gui.kit.language.set_language(value)

    def _set_close_to_tray(self, enabled: bool) -> None:
        self.gui.settings.update(close_to_tray=enabled)

    def _set_start_hidden(self, enabled: bool) -> None:
        self.gui.settings.update(start_hidden=enabled)

    def _theme_options(self) -> list[SegmentOption]:
        return [
            SegmentOption(name, tr(f"theme.{name}"), icon=THEME_ICONS[name])
            for name in THEME_PREFERENCES
        ]

    def _language_options(self) -> list[SegmentOption]:
        return [SegmentOption(name, tr(f"language.{name}")) for name in LANGUAGES]

    def retranslate(self) -> None:
        kit = self.gui.kit
        self.set_texts(tr("settings.card.appearance.title"), tr("settings.card.appearance.lede"))
        self._theme.set_options(self._theme_options(), kit.theme.preference)
        self._language.set_options(self._language_options(), kit.language.current)
        for name, row in self._rows.items():
            row.set_texts(tr(f"settings.appearance.{name}"), tr(f"settings.appearance.{name}_hint"))
        self._zoom_out.set_tooltip(tr("settings.appearance.zoom_out"))
        self._zoom_in.set_tooltip(tr("settings.appearance.zoom_in"))
        self._zoom_auto.setText(tr("settings.appearance.zoom_auto"))
        self._threshold_title.setText(tr("settings.appearance.thresholds"))
        for key, row in self._threshold_rows.items():
            row.set_texts(tr(f"settings.appearance.{key}"), tr(f"settings.appearance.{key}_hint"))
        for edit in self._edits.values():
            edit.retranslate()
        self._reset.setText(tr("settings.appearance.thresholds_reset"))
        self._show_zoom()

    def _show_zoom(self, *_: object) -> None:
        zoom = self.gui.kit.zoom
        suffix = f" ({tr('settings.appearance.zoom_auto_tag')})" if zoom.auto else ""
        self._zoom_text.setText(f"{zoom.percent} %{suffix}")
        self._zoom_out.setEnabled(zoom.can_zoom_out)
        self._zoom_in.setEnabled(zoom.can_zoom_in)

    def _load_thresholds(self, thresholds: FreshnessThresholds) -> None:
        for key, edit in self._edits.items():
            edit.set_seconds(getattr(thresholds, key))

    def _apply_thresholds(self, *_: object) -> None:
        candidate = FreshnessThresholds(
            **{key: edit.seconds() for key, edit in self._edits.items()}
        )
        if not candidate.is_ordered():
            self.show_message("warning", tr("settings.appearance.thresholds_order"))
            return
        self.clear_message()
        if candidate != self.gui.settings.settings.freshness:
            self.gui.settings.update(freshness=candidate)

    def _reset_thresholds(self) -> None:
        defaults = FreshnessThresholds()
        self._load_thresholds(defaults)
        self.clear_message()
        self.gui.settings.update(freshness=defaults)

"""Cards over `config.toml`: declared as field specs, saved through `config_edit.update_config`.

A card shows the values of the loaded `Config`, enables Save only while something changed,
validates before writing and never shows raw error text: a rejected value becomes a translated
message, the detail goes to the log.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, Final, Literal

from PySide6.QtCore import Signal
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QCheckBox, QDoubleSpinBox, QGridLayout, QSpinBox, QWidget

from chatimport.config import Config, ConfigError
from chatimport.config_edit import ConfigValue, update_config
from chatimport.gui.i18n import tr
from chatimport.gui.pages.settings_form import (
    EDITOR_WIDTH,
    WIDE_EDITOR_WIDTH,
    FieldRow,
    SettingsCard,
    TimeEdit,
)
from chatimport.gui.strings import has_key
from chatimport.gui.widgets.base import bind_kit
from chatimport.gui.widgets.button import Button
from chatimport.gui.widgets.switch import Switch

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Callable, Sequence
    from pathlib import Path

    from PySide6.QtCore import SignalInstance

    from chatimport.gui.kit import UiKit

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

MEDIA_TYPES: Final = ("photo", "voice", "video_note", "video", "audio", "document", "sticker")
MAX_INT: Final = 1_000_000

type Kind = Literal["int", "float", "bool", "time", "media_types"]
type Values = dict[tuple[str, str], ConfigValue]


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class FieldSpec:
    section: str
    key: str
    kind: Kind
    minimum: float = 0
    maximum: float = MAX_INT
    unit: str = ""
    wide: bool = False

    @property
    def text_key(self) -> str:
        return f"settings.f.{self.section}.{self.key}"


class Editor:
    """One input and the three things a card needs from it."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        widget: QWidget,
        read: Callable[[], ConfigValue],
        write: Callable[[Any], None],
        changed: SignalInstance,
    ) -> None:
        self.widget = widget
        self.read = read
        self.write = write
        self.changed = changed


class MediaTypesEdit(QWidget):
    changed = Signal()

    def __init__(self, kit: UiKit, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._boxes = {name: QCheckBox() for name in MEDIA_TYPES}
        grid = QGridLayout(self)
        grid.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        grid.setHorizontalSpacing(kit.px(16))
        grid.setVerticalSpacing(kit.px(6))
        for index, box in enumerate(self._boxes.values()):
            box.toggled.connect(self.changed)
            grid.addWidget(box, index // 2, index % 2)
        self.retranslate()

    def retranslate(self) -> None:
        for name, box in self._boxes.items():
            box.setText(tr(f"settings.media_type.{name}"))

    def selected(self) -> list[str]:
        return [name for name, box in self._boxes.items() if box.isChecked()]

    def select(self, names: Sequence[str]) -> None:
        for name, box in self._boxes.items():
            box.setChecked(name in names)


def make_editor(kit: UiKit, spec: FieldSpec) -> Editor:
    if spec.kind == "bool":
        switch = Switch(kit)
        return Editor(switch, switch.isChecked, switch.setChecked, switch.toggled)
    if spec.kind == "int":
        spin = QSpinBox()
        spin.setRange(int(spec.minimum), int(spec.maximum))
        return Editor(spin, spin.value, spin.setValue, spin.valueChanged)
    if spec.kind == "float":
        decimal = QDoubleSpinBox()
        decimal.setRange(spec.minimum, spec.maximum)
        decimal.setDecimals(1)
        decimal.setSingleStep(0.5)
        return Editor(decimal, decimal.value, decimal.setValue, decimal.valueChanged)
    if spec.kind == "time":
        clock = TimeEdit(kit)
        return Editor(clock, lambda: clock.text, clock.set_text, clock.changed)
    types = MediaTypesEdit(kit)
    return Editor(types, types.selected, types.select, types.changed)


class ConfigCard(SettingsCard):
    """Fields of one or more `config.toml` sections with a Save button."""

    saved = Signal()

    def __init__(
        self,
        kit: UiKit,
        key: str,
        icon_name: str,
        specs: Sequence[FieldSpec],
        config_file: Path,
        *,
        validate: Callable[[Values], str | None] | None = None,
        parent: QWidget | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(kit, key, icon_name, parent)
        self._specs = tuple(specs)
        self._config_file = config_file
        self._validate = validate
        self._baseline: Values = {}
        self._editors: dict[tuple[str, str], Editor] = {}
        self._rows: dict[tuple[str, str], FieldRow] = {}
        for spec in self._specs:
            editor = make_editor(kit, spec)
            editor.changed.connect(self._on_edited)
            width = (
                None
                if spec.kind == "media_types"
                else (WIDE_EDITOR_WIDTH if spec.wide else EDITOR_WIDTH)
            )
            row = FieldRow(kit, editor.widget, editor_width=width)
            self._editors[spec.section, spec.key] = editor
            self._rows[spec.section, spec.key] = row
            self.add_row(row)
        self._save = Button(kit, variant="primary", icon_name="check")
        self._save.clicked.connect(self.save)
        self.add_footer_button(self._save)
        bind_kit(kit, language=self.retranslate)
        self.retranslate()
        self._baseline = self._current()
        self._save.setEnabled(False)

    @property
    def dirty(self) -> bool:
        return self._current() != self._baseline

    def load(self, config: Config) -> None:
        """Show the values of `config` and treat them as the saved state."""
        for spec in self._specs:
            section: Any = getattr(config, spec.section)
            editor = self._editors[spec.section, spec.key]
            editor.widget.blockSignals(True)
            editor.write(getattr(section, spec.key))
            editor.widget.blockSignals(False)
        self._baseline = self._current()
        self._after_edit()

    def retranslate(self) -> None:
        self.set_texts(tr(f"settings.card.{self.key}.title"), tr(f"settings.card.{self.key}.lede"))
        for spec in self._specs:
            hint_key = f"{spec.text_key}.hint"
            self._rows[spec.section, spec.key].set_texts(
                tr(f"{spec.text_key}.label"), tr(hint_key) if has_key(hint_key) else ""
            )
            widget = self._editors[spec.section, spec.key].widget
            if spec.unit and isinstance(widget, QSpinBox | QDoubleSpinBox):
                widget.setSuffix(" " + tr(f"settings.unit.{spec.unit}"))
            if isinstance(widget, MediaTypesEdit):
                widget.retranslate()
        self._save.setText(tr("common.save"))

    def _current(self) -> Values:
        return {pair: editor.read() for pair, editor in self._editors.items()}

    def _on_edited(self, *_: object) -> None:
        self.clear_message()
        self._after_edit()

    def _after_edit(self) -> None:
        dirty = self.dirty
        self._save.setEnabled(dirty)
        self.set_status(tr("settings.unsaved") if dirty else "")

    def save(self) -> None:
        values = self._current()
        problem = self._validate(values) if self._validate is not None else None
        if problem is not None:
            self.show_message("danger", tr(problem))
            return
        changes: dict[str, dict[str, ConfigValue]] = {}
        for (section, key), value in values.items():
            if value != self._baseline.get((section, key)):
                changes.setdefault(section, {})[key] = value
        try:
            update_config(self._config_file, changes)
        except ConfigError:
            log.exception("settings card %s was rejected", self.key)
            self.show_message("danger", tr("settings.err.rejected"))
            return
        except OSError:
            log.exception("config.toml could not be written")
            self.show_message("danger", tr("settings.err.write"))
            return
        self._baseline = values
        self.show_message("success", tr("settings.saved"))
        self._after_edit()
        self.saved.emit()


def _order(values: Values) -> str | None:
    low, high = values[("disk", "low_watermark_gb")], values[("disk", "high_watermark_gb")]
    if isinstance(low, int) and isinstance(high, int) and high <= low:
        return "settings.err.disk_order"
    return None


COLLECTION: Final = (
    FieldSpec("live", "flush_every_messages", "int", 1, 1000, "messages"),
    FieldSpec("live", "flush_every_seconds", "int", 1, 3600, "seconds"),
    FieldSpec("live", "reconcile_every_minutes", "int", 1, 1440, "minutes"),

    FieldSpec("backfill", "pause_between_requests_sec", "float", 0.5, 60, "seconds"),

DISK: Final = (

    FieldSpec("disk", "high_watermark_gb", "int", 2, 100_000, "gb"),

def build_config_cards(kit: UiKit, config_file: Path) -> list[ConfigCard]:
    return [
        ConfigCard(kit, "collection", "download", COLLECTION, config_file),
        ConfigCard(kit, "recheck", "refresh", RECHECK, config_file),
        ConfigCard(kit, "disk", "disk", DISK, config_file, validate=_order),
        ConfigCard(kit, "media", "package", MEDIA, config_file),
        ConfigCard(kit, "privacy", "shield", PRIVACY, config_file),
    ]
