"""Building blocks of the Settings cards: a card shell, labelled rows and small value editors."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Final

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt, Signal
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QFrame,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QLabel,
    QSizePolicy,
    QSpinBox,
    QVBoxLayout,
    QWidget,
)

from chatimport.gui.icons import icon_pixmap
from chatimport.gui.tokens import LAYOUT, SPACE
from chatimport.gui.widgets.base import Tone, bind_kit, set_role
from chatimport.gui.widgets.callout import Callout
from chatimport.gui.widgets.card import Card
from chatimport.gui.widgets.labels import make_label

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from PySide6.QtGui import QResizeEvent

    from chatimport.gui.kit import UiKit
    from chatimport.gui.widgets.button import Button

EDITOR_WIDTH: Final = 128
WIDE_EDITOR_WIDTH: Final = 220


def divider() -> QFrame:
    line = QFrame()
    set_role(line, "divider")
    return line


class FieldRow(QWidget):
    """Label and hint on the left, the editor on the right."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        kit: UiKit,
        editor: QWidget,
        *,
        label: str = "",
        hint: str = "",
        editor_width: int | None = EDITOR_WIDTH,
        parent: QWidget | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.kit = kit
        self.editor = editor
        self._editor_width = editor_width
        self._label = QLabel(label)
        self._label.setWordWrap(True)
        self._hint = make_label(hint, "caption", wrap=True)
        self._hint.setVisible(bool(hint))
        self._texts = QVBoxLayout()
        self._texts.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        self._texts.addWidget(self._label)
        self._texts.addWidget(self._hint)
        self._row = QHBoxLayout(self)
        self._row.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        self._row.addLayout(self._texts, 1)
        self._row.addWidget(editor, 0, Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignTop)
        bind_kit(kit, zoom=self._restyle)
        self._restyle()

    def resizeEvent(self, event: QResizeEvent) -> None:
        super().resizeEvent(event)
        for label in (self._label, self._hint):
            needed = label.heightForWidth(label.width())
            if needed > 0 and needed != label.minimumHeight():
                label.setMinimumHeight(needed)

    def set_texts(self, label: str, hint: str = "") -> None:
        self._label.setText(label)
        self._hint.setText(hint)
        self._hint.setVisible(bool(hint))
        self.editor.setAccessibleName(label)

    def _restyle(self) -> None:
        self._texts.setSpacing(self.kit.px(SPACE[1]))
        self._row.setSpacing(self.kit.px(SPACE[6]))
        if self._editor_width is not None:
            self.editor.setFixedWidth(self.kit.px(self._editor_width))


class SettingsCard(Card):
    """A titled card: header, rows, an inline message and an optional footer."""

    def __init__(self, kit: UiKit, key: str, icon_name: str, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(kit, parent=parent)
        self.key = key
        self._icon_name = icon_name
        self.setObjectName(f"SettingsCard_{key}")
        self._icon = QLabel()
        self._title = make_label("", "section")
        self._lede = make_label("", "muted", wrap=True)
        self._head = QHBoxLayout()
        self._head.addWidget(self._icon)
        self._head.addWidget(self._title, 1)
        self.body.addLayout(self._head)
        self.body.addWidget(self._lede)
        self._lede.hide()
        self.message = Callout(kit, "info", "")
        self.message.hide()
        self._footer = QHBoxLayout()
        self._status = make_label("", "caption")
        self._footer.addWidget(self._status, 1)
        self.body.addWidget(self.message)
        self.body.addLayout(self._footer)
        self._added: list[QWidget] = []
        bind_kit(kit, theme=self._restyle_icon, zoom=self._restyle_icon)
        self._restyle_icon()

    def set_texts(self, title: str, lede: str = "") -> None:
        self._title.setText(title)
        self._lede.setText(lede)
        self._lede.setVisible(bool(lede))

    def add_row(self, row: QWidget) -> None:
        if self._added:
            self._insert(divider())
        self._insert(row)
        self._added.append(row)

    def add_plain(self, widget: QWidget) -> None:
        self._insert(widget)

    def add_footer_button(self, button: Button) -> None:
        self._footer.addWidget(button)

    def _insert(self, widget: QWidget) -> None:
        self.body.insertWidget(self.body.indexOf(self.message), widget)

    def show_message(self, tone: Tone, body: str, title: str = "") -> None:
        self.message.set_tone(tone)
        self.message.set_title(title)
        self.message.set_body(body)
        self.message.show()

    def clear_message(self) -> None:
        self.message.hide()

    def set_status(self, text: str) -> None:
        self._status.setText(text)

    def _restyle_icon(self) -> None:
        size = self.kit.px(LAYOUT["icon_lg"])
        self._icon.setPixmap(icon_pixmap(self._icon_name, self.kit.palette.accent_fg, size))
        self._head.setSpacing(self.kit.px(SPACE[4]))


class TimeEdit(QWidget):
    """Hours and minutes as two spin boxes; the value is `HH:MM`."""

    changed = Signal()

    def __init__(self, kit: UiKit, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.kit = kit
        self._hours = QSpinBox()
        self._hours.setRange(0, 23)
        self._hours.setWrapping(True)
        self._hours.setAccessibleName("HH")
        self._minutes = QSpinBox()
        self._minutes.setRange(0, 59)
        self._minutes.setWrapping(True)
        self._minutes.setAccessibleName("MM")
        for spin in (self._hours, self._minutes):
            spin.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Policy.Expanding, QSizePolicy.Policy.Fixed)
            spin.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
            spin.valueChanged.connect(self.changed)
        self._colon = QLabel(":")
        row = QHBoxLayout(self)
        row.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        row.setSpacing(kit.px(SPACE[2]))
        row.addWidget(self._hours, 1)
        row.addWidget(self._colon)
        row.addWidget(self._minutes, 1)

    @property
    def text(self) -> str:
        return f"{self._hours.value():02d}:{self._minutes.value():02d}"

    def set_text(self, value: str) -> None:
        hours, _, minutes = value.partition(":")
        self._hours.setValue(int(hours) if hours.isdigit() else 0)
        self._minutes.setValue(int(minutes) if minutes.isdigit() else 0)

    def setAccessibleName(self, name: str) -> None:
        super().setAccessibleName(name)
        self._hours.setAccessibleName(f"{name} (h)")
        self._minutes.setAccessibleName(f"{name} (min)")

"""What the Settings page needs from the outside: service control, probes and test hooks.

The page talks to the service host through `ServiceControl` (the host implements it; the bridge
Protocol of the shell does not know it), and takes its slow or networked collaborators through
`SettingsHooks`, so a demo or a test can replace the Task Scheduler, the session probe and the
Telegram login without touching the real ones.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, Protocol, runtime_checkable

from PySide6.QtCore import QUrl
from PySide6.QtGui import QDesktopServices

from chatimport import autostart

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Awaitable, Callable
    from pathlib import Path

    from chatimport.context import ServiceContext
    from chatimport.gui.context import GuiContext
    from chatimport.telegram.session_probe import SessionInfo


@runtime_checkable
class ServiceControl(Protocol):
    """The part of the service host the Settings page uses."""

    @property
    def context(self) -> ServiceContext: ...

    @property
    def is_alive(self) -> bool: ...

    def start_service(self) -> bool: ...

    def stop_service(self, on_stopped: Callable[[], None] | None = None) -> None: ...

    def restart(self) -> None: ...


type LoginFunc = Callable[..., Awaitable[str]]
type ProbeFunc = Callable[[ServiceContext], SessionInfo | None]


def probe_session_blocking(ctx: ServiceContext) -> SessionInfo | None:
    from chatimport.telegram.session_probe import probe_session

    return asyncio.run(probe_session(ctx.config.telegram, ctx.paths.session_file))


def telegram_login(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Awaitable[str]:
    from chatimport.telegram.client import login

    return login(*args, **kwargs)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SettingsHooks:
    autostart_task: str = autostart.TASK_NAME
    probe: ProbeFunc = probe_session_blocking
    login: LoginFunc = telegram_login
    executable: str | None = None
    control: ServiceControl | None = field(default=None)


def control_of(gui: GuiContext, hooks: SettingsHooks) -> ServiceControl | None:
    if hooks.control is not None:
        return hooks.control
    return gui.bridge if isinstance(gui.bridge, ServiceControl) else None


def context_of(gui: GuiContext, hooks: SettingsHooks) -> ServiceContext:
    control = control_of(gui, hooks)
    return control.context if control is not None else gui.service


def open_path(path: Path) -> None:
    """Open a folder in the file manager (a file's folder for a file)."""
    target = path if path.is_dir() else path.parent
    QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl.fromLocalFile(str(target)))


def open_link(url: str) -> None:
    QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl(url))

"""The Startup card (Windows autostart) and the About card (version and file locations)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import sys
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Final

from PySide6.QtCore import Signal
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication, QHBoxLayout, QVBoxLayout, QWidget

from chatimport import __version__, autostart
from chatimport.gui.i18n import tr
from chatimport.gui.pages.settings_form import FieldRow, SettingsCard
from chatimport.gui.pages.settings_support import SettingsHooks, context_of, open_path
from chatimport.gui.pages.support import MainThreadRunner
from chatimport.gui.tokens import SPACE
from chatimport.gui.widgets.base import bind_kit
from chatimport.gui.widgets.button import Button, IconButton
from chatimport.gui.widgets.chip import Chip
from chatimport.gui.widgets.labels import ElidedLabel, make_label
from chatimport.gui.widgets.switch import Switch

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from concurrent.futures import Future
    from pathlib import Path

    from chatimport.gui.context import GuiContext
    from chatimport.gui.kit import UiKit

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

WINDOWS: Final = sys.platform == "win32"


class StartupCard(SettingsCard):
    """ "Start with Windows", bound to the Task Scheduler task through `autostart`."""

    def __init__(
        self, gui: GuiContext, hooks: SettingsHooks, parent: QWidget | None = None
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(gui.kit, "startup", "play", parent)
        self.gui = gui
        self._hooks = hooks
        self._runner = MainThreadRunner(self)
        self._status: autostart.AutostartStatus | None = None
        self._busy = False
        kit = gui.kit
        self._switch = Switch(kit)
        self._switch.toggled.connect(self._on_toggled)
        self._row = FieldRow(kit, self._switch, editor_width=None)
        self._chip = Chip(kit, "", "muted")
        self._update = Button(kit, variant="secondary", size="sm", icon_name="refresh")
        self._update.clicked.connect(lambda: self._apply(True))
        state_box = QWidget()
        state_row = QHBoxLayout(state_box)
        state_row.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        state_row.setSpacing(kit.px(SPACE[4]))
        state_row.addWidget(self._chip)
        state_row.addWidget(self._update)
        state_row.addStretch(1)
        self.add_row(self._row)
        self.add_plain(state_box)
        bind_kit(kit, language=self.retranslate)
        self.retranslate()
        if not autostart.supported():
            self._switch.setEnabled(False)
            self._render()

    def retranslate(self) -> None:
        self.set_texts(tr("settings.card.startup.title"), tr("settings.card.startup.lede"))
        self._row.set_texts(tr("settings.startup.switch"), tr("settings.startup.switch_hint"))
        self._update.setText(tr("settings.startup.update"))
        self._render()

    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Ask Task Scheduler for the current state (on a worker thread)."""
        if not autostart.supported() or self._busy:
            return
        self._busy = True
        task, executable = self._hooks.autostart_task, self._hooks.executable
        self._runner.submit(lambda: autostart.status(task, executable=executable), self._done)

    def _on_toggled(self, enabled: bool) -> None:
        self._apply(enabled)

    def _apply(self, enabled: bool) -> None:
        if self._busy:
            return
        self._busy = True
        self.clear_message()
        self._switch.setEnabled(False)
        task, executable = self._hooks.autostart_task, self._hooks.executable
        if enabled:
            self._runner.submit(lambda: autostart.enable(task, executable=executable), self._done)
        else:
            self._runner.submit(lambda: autostart.disable(task), self._done)

    def _done(self, done: Future[autostart.AutostartStatus]) -> None:
        self._busy = False
        try:
            self._status = done.result()
        except autostart.AutostartError as error:
            log.warning("autostart failed: %s", error.reason)
            self.show_message("danger", tr(f"settings.startup.err.{error.reason}"))
        except Exception:
            log.exception("autostart failed")
            self.show_message("danger", tr("settings.startup.err.failed"))
        self._render()

    def _render(self) -> None:
        status = self._status
        supported = autostart.supported()
        state = status.state if status is not None else None
        enabled = state in (autostart.AutostartState.ENABLED,)
        self._switch.blockSignals(True)
        self._switch.setChecked(enabled)
        self._switch.blockSignals(False)
        self._switch.setEnabled(supported and not self._busy)
        stale = status is not None and enabled and not status.current
        self._update.setVisible(stale)
        if not supported:
            self._chip.set_text(tr("settings.startup.state.unsupported"))
            self._chip.set_tone("muted")
        elif self._busy and status is None:
            self._chip.set_text(tr("settings.startup.state.checking"))
            self._chip.set_tone("info")
        elif stale:
            self._chip.set_text(tr("settings.startup.state.other"))
            self._chip.set_tone("warning")
        elif enabled:
            self._chip.set_text(tr("settings.startup.state.enabled"))
            self._chip.set_tone("live")
        else:
            self._chip.set_text(tr("settings.startup.state.disabled"))
            self._chip.set_tone("muted")


class PathRow(QWidget):

        from chatimport.gui.setup_wizard import SetupWizard

        if SetupWizard(self.gui, self._hooks, self.window()).exec():
            self.wizard_finished.emit()

"""The Telegram card: API credentials, the session status and the sign-in button."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Final

    @staticmethod
    def _with_error(editor: QWidget, error: QLabel) -> QWidget:
        box = QWidget()
        column = QVBoxLayout(box)
        column.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        column.setSpacing(0)
        column.addWidget(editor)
        column.addWidget(error)
        error.hide()
        return box

    def load(self) -> None:
        """Read the credentials from `config.toml` (the file is the source of truth)."""
        try:
            config = load_config(self.gui.service.paths.config_file).telegram
        except ConfigError:
            config = None
        api_id = "" if config is None or not config.api_id else str(config.api_id)
        api_hash = "" if config is None else config.api_hash
        for edit, value in ((self._api_id, api_id), (self._api_hash, api_hash)):
            edit.blockSignals(True)
            edit.setText(value)
            edit.blockSignals(False)
        self._baseline = (api_id, api_hash)
        self._on_edited()

    def retranslate(self) -> None:
        self.set_texts(tr("settings.card.telegram.title"), tr("settings.card.telegram.lede"))
        self._id_row.set_texts(tr("settings.tg.api_id"), tr("settings.tg.api_id_hint"))
        self._hash_row.set_texts(tr("settings.tg.api_hash"), tr("settings.tg.api_hash_hint"))
        self._session_row.set_texts(tr("settings.tg.session"), tr("settings.tg.session_hint"))
        self._link.setText(tr("settings.tg.get_credentials"))
        self._guide.setText(tr("setup.keys.guide"))
        self._save.setText(tr("common.save"))
        self._recheck.setText(tr("settings.tg.check_again"))
        self._on_reveal(self._reveal.isChecked())
        self._refresh_validation()

    def set_service_state(self, service: str) -> None:
        previous, self._service = self._service, service
        if previous != service:
            self.refresh_session(allow_probe=self.isVisible())

    @property
    def dirty(self) -> bool:
        return (self._api_id.text().strip(), self._api_hash.text().strip()) != self._baseline

    @property
    def credentials_saved(self) -> bool:
        return all(self._baseline) and self._baseline[0].isdigit() and int(self._baseline[0]) > 0

    def refresh_session(self, *, allow_probe: bool = True) -> None:
        if not self.credentials_saved:
            self._set_session("no_credentials")
        elif self._service in BUSY_SERVICE:
            self._set_session("signed_in", self._handle)
        elif not self.gui.service.paths.session_file.is_file():
            self._set_session("signed_out")
        elif allow_probe and not self._probing:
            self._probing = True
            self._set_session("checking")
            ctx = self._fresh_context()
            self._runner.submit(lambda: self._hooks.probe(ctx), self._probed)

    def _fresh_context(self) -> ServiceContext:
        ctx = context_of(self.gui, self._hooks)
        try:
            return replace(ctx, config=load_config(ctx.paths.config_file))
        except ConfigError:
            return ctx

    def _probed(self, done: Future[SessionInfo | None]) -> None:
        self._probing = False
        try:
            info = done.result()
        except Exception:
            log.exception("checking the Telegram session failed")
            self._set_session("unknown")
            return
        if info is None:
            self._set_session("signed_out")
        else:
            self._set_session("signed_in", info.handle)

    def _set_session(self, state: SessionState, handle: str | None = None) -> None:
        self._state = state
        if handle:
            self._handle = handle
        self._render_session()

    def _render_session(self) -> None:
        state = self._state
        text = tr(f"settings.tg.state.{state}")
        if state == "signed_in" and self._handle:
            text = tr("settings.tg.state.signed_in_as", handle=self._handle)
        self._chip.set_text(text)
        self._chip.set_tone(SESSION_TONES[state])
        self._chip.set_icon(
            {"signed_in": "check-circle", "signed_out": "alert", "unknown": "info"}.get(state)
        )
        self._sign_in.setVisible(state in ("signed_out", "unknown", "no_credentials"))
        self._sign_in.setEnabled(state in ("signed_out", "unknown") and self._inputs_ok)
        self._sign_in.setText(tr("settings.tg.sign_in"))
        self._sign_in.setToolTip(
            tr("settings.tg.sign_in_needs_credentials") if state == "no_credentials" else ""
        )
        self._recheck.setVisible(
            state in ("signed_in", "unknown") and self._service not in BUSY_SERVICE
        )

    def _on_reveal(self, shown: bool) -> None:
        self._api_hash.setEchoMode(
            QLineEdit.EchoMode.Normal if shown else QLineEdit.EchoMode.Password
        )
        self._reveal.set_icon_name("lock" if shown else "eye")
        self._reveal.set_tooltip(tr("settings.tg.hide" if shown else "settings.tg.show"))

    def _refresh_validation(self) -> None:
        checks = (
            (self._api_id, self._id_error, validate_api_id(self._api_id.text())),
            (self._api_hash, self._hash_error, validate_api_hash(self._api_hash.text())),
        )
        for edit, label, error in checks:
            shown = bool(error) and bool(edit.text().strip())
            label.setText(tr(error) if error and shown else "")
            label.setVisible(shown)
        self._inputs_ok = not any(error for _, _, error in checks)
        self._save.setEnabled(self.dirty and self._inputs_ok)
        self._render_session()

    def _on_edited(self, *_: object) -> None:
        self.clear_message()
        self.set_status(tr("settings.unsaved") if self.dirty else "")
        self._refresh_validation()

    def _open_guide(self) -> None:
        from chatimport.gui.key_guide import KeyGuideDialog

        KeyGuideDialog(self.gui, self.window()).exec()

    def save(self) -> None:
        api_id, api_hash = self._api_id.text().strip(), self._api_hash.text().strip()
        error = validate_api_id(api_id) or validate_api_hash(api_hash)
        if error is not None:
            self.show_message("danger", tr(error))
            return
        try:
            update_config(
                self.gui.service.paths.config_file,
                {"telegram": {"api_id": int(api_id), "api_hash": api_hash}},
            )
        except ConfigError:
            log.exception("the Telegram credentials were rejected")
            self.show_message("danger", tr("settings.err.rejected"))
            return
        except OSError:
            log.exception("config.toml could not be written")
            self.show_message("danger", tr("settings.err.write"))
            return
        self._baseline = (api_id, api_hash)
        self.show_message("success", tr("settings.saved"))
        self._on_edited()
        self.show_message("success", tr("settings.saved"))
        self.refresh_session()
        self.saved.emit()

    def _open_login(self) -> None:
        dialog = LoginDialog(
            self.gui, self._hooks, control_of(self.gui, self._hooks), self.window()
        )
        dialog.signed_in.connect(self._on_signed_in)
        dialog.exec()

    def _on_signed_in(self, handle: str) -> None:
        self._set_session("signed_in", handle)
        notify(self, "success", tr("settings.tg.signed_in_toast", handle=handle))
        self.signed_in.emit(handle)

"""Plumbing the pages share: the toast host lookup and work that finishes on the main thread.

The service lives on its own thread, so every `Future` it returns completes elsewhere. Qt
objects may only be touched from the main thread, so completion callbacks are posted through a
queued signal and run there.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Final

from PySide6.QtCore import QObject, Signal

from chatimport.gui.widgets.toast import ToastHost

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Callable
    from concurrent.futures import Future

    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QLayout, QWidget

    from chatimport.gui.widgets.base import Tone

THREAD_PREFIX: Final = "gui-task"


def find_toasts(widget: QWidget) -> ToastHost | None:
    return widget.window().findChild(ToastHost)


def clear_layout(layout: QLayout) -> None:
    """Remove every widget at once (`deleteLater` alone leaves them painted until the next loop)."""
    while layout.count():
        item = layout.takeAt(0)
        widget = item.widget() if item is not None else None
        if widget is not None:
            widget.setParent(None)
            widget.deleteLater()


def notify(widget: QWidget, tone: Tone, message: str) -> None:
    host = find_toasts(widget)
    if host is not None:
        host.push(tone, message)


class MainThreadRunner(QObject):
    """`submit` runs `func` on a worker thread; `on_done` gets the finished future on the main one.

    `watch` does the same for a future somebody else created (the service bridge's).
    """

    _post = Signal(object)

    def __init__(self, parent: QObject | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._pool = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2, thread_name_prefix=THREAD_PREFIX)
        self._post.connect(self._invoke)

    def _invoke(self, call: object) -> None:
        if callable(call):
            call()

    def watch[T](self, future: Future[T], on_done: Callable[[Future[T]], None]) -> None:
        future.add_done_callback(lambda done: self._post.emit(lambda: on_done(done)))

    def submit[T](self, func: Callable[[], T], on_done: Callable[[Future[T]], None]) -> Future[T]:
        future = self._pool.submit(func)
        self.watch(future, on_done)
        return future

    def shutdown(self) -> None:
        self._pool.shutdown(wait=False, cancel_futures=True)

"""`ServiceHost`: the archive service on a background asyncio thread, seen from the Qt thread.

The window never touches the service directly. `execute` schedules a command on the service's
loop and returns a `concurrent.futures.Future`; every two seconds the host asks for `status`
and publishes the result as the `snapshot` signal. Whatever happens on the service thread
reaches Qt through an internal signal, so every public signal fires on the main thread.

The service can be stopped and started again (`stop_service`, `start_service`, `restart`): a
new `ChatImportApp` and thread per start, with the configuration reread from disk. Without
Telegram credentials or a session file the service is not started at all and the state is
`needs_setup`.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import logging
import threading
from concurrent.futures import Future
from dataclasses import replace
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, Final, cast

from PySide6.QtCore import QObject, QTimer, Signal, Slot

from chatimport.config import ConfigError, load_config
from chatimport.control import AlreadyRunning
from chatimport.paths import library_path, resolve_root
from chatimport.ports import ChatImportError
from chatimport.status import read_snapshot

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Callable

    from chatimport.app import ChatImportApp
    from chatimport.commands import CommandResult
    from chatimport.context import ServiceContext
    from chatimport.runtime import Notifier

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

POLL_MS: Final = 2000
JOIN_SECONDS: Final = 30.0
NOT_RUNNING: Final = "the service is not running"
NEEDS_SETUP: Final = "needs_setup"

type AppFactory = Callable[[ServiceContext, Notifier], ChatImportApp]


def default_app_factory(ctx: ServiceContext, notifier: Notifier) -> ChatImportApp:
    from chatimport.app import ChatImportApp

    return ChatImportApp(ctx, notifier=notifier)


def _failed_future(message: str) -> Future[CommandResult]:
    future: Future[CommandResult] = Future()
    future.set_exception(ChatImportError(message))
    return future


class ServiceHost(QObject):
    snapshot = Signal(dict)
    already_running = Signal()
    failed = Signal(str)
    stopped = Signal()

    _relay = Signal(str, object)

    def __init__(
        self,
        ctx: ServiceContext,
        notifier: Notifier,
        *,
        app_factory: AppFactory = default_app_factory,
        poll_ms: int = POLL_MS,
        root_override: str | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self._ctx = ctx
        self._notifier = notifier
        self._factory = app_factory
        self._root_override = root_override
        self._app: ChatImportApp | None = None
        self._thread: threading.Thread | None = None
        self._loop: asyncio.AbstractEventLoop | None = None
        self._generation = 0
        self._last: dict[str, Any] | None = None
        self._failed_type: str | None = None
        self._polling = False
        self._closed = False
        self._relay.connect(self._on_relay)
        self._timer = QTimer(self)
        self._timer.setInterval(poll_ms)
        self._timer.timeout.connect(self._poll)

    @property
    def last_snapshot(self) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        return self._last

    @property
    def failed_type(self) -> str | None:
        return self._failed_type

    @property
    def context(self) -> ServiceContext:
        return self._ctx

    @property
    def is_alive(self) -> bool:
        return self._thread is not None and self._thread.is_alive()

    @property
    def needs_setup(self) -> bool:
        """No credentials or no session file: the service cannot start yet."""
        telegram = self._ctx.config.telegram
        return not telegram.is_configured or not self._ctx.paths.session_file.is_file()

    def start(self) -> None:
        self._timer.start()
        if not self.start_service():
            self._publish(None)
        self._poll()

    def start_service(self) -> bool:
        """Start the service on a fresh thread with the configuration reread from disk.

        False when it is already running, the host is closed or Telegram is not set up.
        """
        if self._closed or self.is_alive:
            return False
        self._reload_context()
        if self.needs_setup:
            self._publish(None)
            return False
        self._failed_type = None
        self._generation += 1
        app = self._factory(self._ctx, self._notifier)
        self._app = app
        self._loop = None
        thread = threading.Thread(
            target=self._serve, args=(self._generation, app), name="chatimport-service"
        )
        self._thread = thread
        thread.start()
        return True

    def stop_service(self, on_stopped: Callable[[], None] | None = None) -> None:
        """Ask the service to stop; `on_stopped` runs on the main thread once its thread ended
        (at once when it was not running). The window stays responsive meanwhile."""
        app, thread = self._app, self._thread
        if app is None or thread is None or not thread.is_alive():
            if on_stopped is not None:
                on_stopped()
            return
        app.request_shutdown()
        generation = self._generation

        def join() -> None:
            thread.join(JOIN_SECONDS)
            self._relay.emit("joined", (generation, on_stopped))

        threading.Thread(target=join, name="chatimport-service-join", daemon=True).start()

    def restart(self) -> None:
        def start() -> None:
            self.start_service()

        self.stop_service(start)

    def execute(self, command: str, args: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> Future[CommandResult]:
        loop, app = self._loop, self._app
        if app is None or loop is None or loop.is_closed() or not self.is_alive:
            return _failed_future(NOT_RUNNING)
        coro = app.execute(command, args or {})
        try:
            return asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(coro, loop)
        except RuntimeError:
            coro.close()
            return _failed_future(NOT_RUNNING)

    def request_shutdown(self) -> None:
        if self._app is not None:
            self._app.request_shutdown()

    def shutdown(self, timeout: float = JOIN_SECONDS) -> bool:
        """Stop the service and join its thread; True when the thread ended in time."""
        thread = self._thread
        if self._closed:
            return thread is None or not thread.is_alive()
        self._closed = True
        self._timer.stop()
        if self._app is not None:
            self._app.request_shutdown()
        if thread is not None and thread.is_alive():
            thread.join(timeout)
        alive = thread is not None and thread.is_alive()
        if alive:
            log.warning("the service thread did not stop within %s s", timeout)
        return not alive

    def _reload_context(self) -> None:
        if self._app is not None:
            self._ctx = self._app.ctx
        try:
            config = load_config(self._ctx.paths.config_file)
        except ConfigError:
            log.exception("config.toml is invalid; keeping the previous settings")
            return
        root = self._ctx.root
        if config.output.root_dir != self._ctx.config.output.root_dir:
            root = resolve_root(self._root_override, config.output.root_dir)
        self._ctx = replace(
            self._ctx,
            config=config,
            root=root,
            library_file=library_path(config.library.file, self._ctx.paths),
        )

    def _serve(self, generation: int, app: ChatImportApp) -> None:
        loop = asyncio.new_event_loop()
        if generation == self._generation:
            self._loop = loop
        try:
            loop.run_until_complete(app.run())
        except AlreadyRunning:
            self._relay.emit("already_running", (generation, None))
        except Exception as exc:
            log.exception("the ChatImport service stopped")
            self._relay.emit("failed", (generation, type(exc).__name__))
        else:
            self._relay.emit("stopped", (generation, None))
        finally:
            loop.close()

    @Slot(str, object)
    def _on_relay(self, kind: str, payload: object) -> None:
        generation, value = cast("tuple[int, Any]", payload)
        if kind == "snapshot" and generation != self._generation:
            self._polling = False
        if generation != self._generation:
            return
        if kind == "snapshot":
            self._publish(cast("dict[str, Any]", value) if isinstance(value, dict) else None)
        elif kind == "failed":
            self._failed_type = str(value)
            self.failed.emit(self._failed_type)
            self._publish(None)
        elif kind == "already_running":
            self.already_running.emit()
        elif kind == "joined":
            self._publish(None)
            if callable(value):
                value()
        else:
            self.stopped.emit()
            self._publish(None)

    def _poll(self) -> None:
        if self._polling or self._closed:
            return
        self._polling = True
        generation = self._generation
        future = self.execute("status")
        future.add_done_callback(lambda done: self._status_done(generation, done))

    def _status_done(self, generation: int, future: Future[CommandResult]) -> None:
        data: dict[str, Any] | None = None
        try:
            result = future.result()
        except Exception:
            log.debug("status poll failed", exc_info=True)
        else:
            if result.ok:
                data = result.data
        self._relay.emit("snapshot", (generation, data))

    def _publish(self, live: dict[str, Any] | None) -> None:
        self._polling = False
        data = live if live is not None else self._from_file()
        if data is not None:
            self._last = data
            self.snapshot.emit(data)

    def _from_file(self) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        if self.is_alive and self._failed_type is None:
            service = "starting"
        elif self.needs_setup:
            service = NEEDS_SETUP
        else:
            service = "stopped"
        stored = read_snapshot(self._ctx.root)
        if stored is None:
            return (
                None if service == "starting" else {"service": service, "chats": [], "errors": []}
            )
        return {**stored, "service": service}

"""The window's own preferences: language, theme, zoom, layout and freshness thresholds.

Stored as one small JSON file next to the config (never in the data root). Anything unreadable
or out of range falls back to the default for that field, so a damaged file can never keep the
window from opening; it is only preferences, not archive data.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import locale
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field, replace
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, Final, Literal, cast

from chatimport.gui.format import FreshnessThresholds
from chatimport.gui.strings import LANGUAGES, Language
from chatimport.gui.tokens import ZOOM_MAX, ZOOM_MIN
from chatimport.storage.fileio import atomic_write_bytes

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pathlib import Path

type ThemePreference = Literal["light", "dark", "system"]

THEME_PREFERENCES: Final[tuple[ThemePreference, ...]] = ("light", "dark", "system")
SETTINGS_VERSION: Final = 1


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class WindowGeometry:
    x: int
    y: int
    width: int
    height: int
    maximized: bool = False


def system_language() -> Language:
    name = (locale.getlocale()[0] or "").lower()
    return "ru" if name.startswith(("ru", "russian")) else "en"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class GuiSettings:
    language: Language = field(default_factory=system_language)
    theme: ThemePreference = "system"
    zoom: float | None = None
    sidebar_collapsed: bool = False
    close_to_tray: bool = True
    start_hidden: bool = False
    last_page: str = "overview"
    chats_absolute_time: bool = False
    setup_completed: bool = False
    geometry: WindowGeometry | None = None
    freshness: FreshnessThresholds = field(default_factory=FreshnessThresholds)
    freshness_per_chat: dict[str, FreshnessThresholds] = field(
        default_factory=dict[str, FreshnessThresholds]
    )

    def thresholds_for(self, chat_id: int | str) -> FreshnessThresholds:
        return self.freshness_per_chat.get(str(chat_id), self.freshness)


def _as_int(value: Any, default: int) -> int:
    return value if isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool) else default


def _thresholds(raw: Any, default: FreshnessThresholds) -> FreshnessThresholds:
    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
        return default
    data = cast("dict[str, Any]", raw)
    parsed = FreshnessThresholds(
        fresh_below=_as_int(data.get("fresh_below"), default.fresh_below),
        recent_below=_as_int(data.get("recent_below"), default.recent_below),
        stale_below=_as_int(data.get("stale_below"), default.stale_below),
    )
    return parsed if parsed.is_ordered() else default


def _geometry(raw: Any) -> WindowGeometry | None:
    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
        return None
    data = cast("dict[str, Any]", raw)
    try:
        width, height = int(data["width"]), int(data["height"])
        x, y = int(data["x"]), int(data["y"])
    except KeyError, TypeError, ValueError:
        return None
    if width < 200 or height < 150:
        return None
    return WindowGeometry(x, y, width, height, maximized=data.get("maximized") is True)


def _zoom(raw: Any) -> float | None:
    if isinstance(raw, bool) or not isinstance(raw, int | float):
        return None
    return min(max(float(raw), ZOOM_MIN), ZOOM_MAX)


def settings_from_json(raw: Any) -> GuiSettings:
    defaults = GuiSettings()
    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
        return defaults
    data = cast("dict[str, Any]", raw)
    language = data.get("language")
    theme = data.get("theme")
    last_page = data.get("last_page")
    per_chat_raw = data.get("freshness_per_chat")
    per_chat: dict[str, FreshnessThresholds] = {}
    if isinstance(per_chat_raw, dict):
        for key, value in cast("dict[str, Any]", per_chat_raw).items():
            per_chat[str(key)] = _thresholds(value, defaults.freshness)
    return GuiSettings(
        language=language if language in LANGUAGES else defaults.language,
        theme=theme if theme in THEME_PREFERENCES else defaults.theme,
        zoom=_zoom(data.get("zoom")),
        sidebar_collapsed=data.get("sidebar_collapsed") is True,
        close_to_tray=data.get("close_to_tray") is not False,
        start_hidden=data.get("start_hidden") is True,
        last_page=last_page if isinstance(last_page, str) else defaults.last_page,
        chats_absolute_time=data.get("chats_absolute_time") is True,
        setup_completed=data.get("setup_completed") is True,
        geometry=_geometry(data.get("geometry")),
        freshness=_thresholds(data.get("freshness"), defaults.freshness),
        freshness_per_chat=per_chat,
    )


class GuiSettingsStore:
    """Load once, then `update(...)` replaces fields and writes the file atomically."""

    def __init__(self, path: Path) -> None:
        self.path = path
        self._settings = self._load()

    @property
    def settings(self) -> GuiSettings:
        return self._settings

    def _load(self) -> GuiSettings:
        try:
            raw: Any = json.loads(self.path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        except OSError, ValueError:
            return GuiSettings()
        return settings_from_json(raw)

    def update(self, **changes: Any) -> GuiSettings:
        self._settings = replace(self._settings, **changes)
        self.save()
        return self._settings

    def save(self) -> None:
        payload = {"v": SETTINGS_VERSION, **asdict(self._settings)}
        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        text = json.dumps(payload, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n"
        atomic_write_bytes(self.path, text.encode("utf-8"))

"""Qt-free logic of the first-run wizard: chat links, the data folder and the saved state."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Final, Literal

from chatimport.config import ConfigError, load_config
from chatimport.gui.key_validation import validate_api_hash, validate_api_id
from chatimport.library import LibraryError, add_entry, identity_of, load_library
from chatimport.paths import is_cloud_synced, normalize_root, resolve_root
from chatimport.ports import ChatImportError
from chatimport.refs import RefKind, display_ref, parse_ref
from chatimport.setroot import validate_new_root

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pathlib import Path

type RefStatus = Literal["added", "duplicate", "invalid", "error"]

_SEPARATORS: Final = re.compile(r"[\s,;]+")


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class RefResult:
    ref: str
    status: RefStatus
    detail: str = ""


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class FolderCheck:
    path: Path | None
    error: str = ""
    cloud: bool = False
    changed: bool = False


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SetupState:
    keys_saved: bool
    signed_in: bool
    chats: int
    root: Path


def split_refs(text: str) -> list[str]:
    return [part for part in _SEPARATORS.split(text.strip()) if part]


def add_refs(library_file: Path, text: str) -> list[RefResult]:
    """Add every link or username in `text` to the library; one result per reference.

    Only public usernames, links and numeric ids are accepted: a bare title cannot be told
    from a typo. Invite links are reported in their masked form.
    """
    refs = split_refs(text)
    try:
        known = {identity_of(entry.ref) for entry in load_library(library_file).entries}
    except LibraryError as error:
        return [RefResult(display_ref(ref), "error", str(error)) for ref in refs]
    results: list[RefResult] = []
    for ref in refs:
        shown = display_ref(ref)
        parsed = parse_ref(ref)
        if parsed.kind is RefKind.TITLE:
            results.append(RefResult(shown, "invalid"))
        elif parsed.identity in known:
            results.append(RefResult(shown, "duplicate"))
        else:
            try:
                add_entry(library_file, ref)
            except LibraryError as error:
                results.append(RefResult(shown, "error", str(error)))
            else:
                known.add(parsed.identity)
                results.append(RefResult(shown, "added"))
    return results


def current_root(config_file: Path) -> Path:
    try:
        configured = load_config(config_file).output.root_dir
    except ConfigError:
        configured = ""
    return resolve_root(None, configured)


def check_folder(text: str, current: Path, app_base: Path) -> FolderCheck:
    """Whether the typed folder can hold the archive; an empty text means the current one."""
    typed = text.strip()
    target = normalize_root(typed) if typed else current
    changed = target.expanduser().resolve() != current.expanduser().resolve()
    try:
        if changed:
            validate_new_root(target, current, app_base=app_base, move=False)
        else:
            _require_apart(target, app_base)
    except (ChatImportError, OSError) as error:
        return FolderCheck(None, str(error))
    return FolderCheck(target, cloud=is_cloud_synced(target), changed=changed)


def _require_apart(target: Path, app_base: Path) -> None:
    folder, base = target.expanduser().resolve(), app_base.expanduser().resolve()
    if folder.is_relative_to(base) or base.is_relative_to(folder):
        raise ChatImportError(
            "the data folder must be apart from the application folder, which holds "
            "the Telegram session"
        )


def read_state(config_file: Path, session_file: Path, library_file: Path) -> SetupState:
    try:
        telegram = load_config(config_file).telegram
        keys = (
            validate_api_id(str(telegram.api_id)) is None
            and validate_api_hash(telegram.api_hash) is None
        )
    except ConfigError:
        keys = False
    try:
        chats = len(load_library(library_file).entries)
    except LibraryError:
        chats = 0
    return SetupState(keys, session_file.is_file(), chats, current_root(config_file))

        super().retranslate()
        self._id_label.setText(tr("settings.tg.api_id"))
        self._hash_label.setText(tr("settings.tg.api_hash"))
        self._api_id.setAccessibleName(tr("settings.tg.api_id"))
        self._api_hash.setAccessibleName(tr("settings.tg.api_hash"))
        self._guide.setText(tr("setup.keys.guide"))
        self._on_reveal(self._reveal.isChecked())
        self._validate()

    def enter(self) -> None:
        try:
            telegram = load_config(self.env.context.paths.config_file).telegram
        except ConfigError:
            return
        if telegram.api_id and not self._api_id.text():
            self._api_id.setText(str(telegram.api_id))
        if telegram.api_hash and not self._api_hash.text():
            self._api_hash.setText(telegram.api_hash)

    def can_advance(self) -> bool:
        return self._validate()

    def _validate(self) -> bool:
        checks = (
            (self._api_id, self._id_error, validate_api_id(self._api_id.text())),
            (self._api_hash, self._hash_error, validate_api_hash(self._api_hash.text())),
        )
        for edit, label, error in checks:
            shown = bool(error) and bool(edit.text().strip())
            label.setText(tr(error) if error and shown else "")
            label.setVisible(shown)
        return not any(error for _, _, error in checks)

    def _on_edited(self, *_: object) -> None:
        self._problem.hide()
        self._validate()
        self.changed.emit()

    def _on_reveal(self, shown: bool) -> None:
        self._api_hash.setEchoMode(
            QLineEdit.EchoMode.Normal if shown else QLineEdit.EchoMode.Password
        )
        self._reveal.set_icon_name("lock" if shown else "eye")
        self._reveal.set_tooltip(tr("settings.tg.hide" if shown else "settings.tg.show"))

    def _open_guide(self) -> None:
        KeyGuideDialog(self.env.gui, self.window()).exec()

    def commit(self) -> bool:
        if not self._validate():
            return False
        api_id, api_hash = int(self._api_id.text().strip()), self._api_hash.text().strip()
        path = self.env.context.paths.config_file
        try:
            saved = load_config(path).telegram
        except ConfigError:
            saved = None
        if saved is not None and (saved.api_id, saved.api_hash) == (api_id, api_hash):
            return True
        try:
            update_config(path, {"telegram": {"api_id": api_id, "api_hash": api_hash}})
        except ConfigError:
            log.exception("the Telegram credentials were rejected")
            return self._fail("setup.keys.error.rejected")
        except OSError:
            log.exception("config.toml could not be written")
            return self._fail("setup.keys.error.write")
        return True

    def _fail(self, key: str) -> bool:
        self._problem.set_body(tr(key))
        self._problem.show()
        return False

        self._handle = handle
        self._signed_in = True
        self._render()
        self.changed.emit()

"""Wizard steps three and four: the chats to archive and the archive folder."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Final

from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QFileDialog,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QLineEdit,
    QPlainTextEdit,
    QVBoxLayout,
    QWidget,
)

from chatimport.config import ConfigError
from chatimport.config_edit import set_output_root
from chatimport.gui.i18n import plural, tr
from chatimport.gui.pages.support import clear_layout
from chatimport.gui.setup_logic import (
    FolderCheck,
    RefResult,
    add_refs,
    check_folder,
    current_root,

    split_refs,

    from chatimport.gui.widgets.base import Tone

INPUT_ROWS: Final = 5
RESULT_TONES: Final[dict[str, Tone]] = {
    "added": "success",
    "duplicate": "muted",
    "invalid": "danger",
    "error": "danger",
}
RESULT_ICONS: Final = {
    "added": "check-circle",
    "duplicate": "info",
    "invalid": "x-circle",
    "error": "x-circle",
}


class ChatsStep(WizardStep):
    name = "chats"
    skippable = True

    def __init__(self, env: WizardEnv, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(env, parent)
        self._count = 0
        self._known = make_label("", "caption")
        self._input = QPlainTextEdit()
        self._input.setFixedHeight(self.kit.px(INPUT_ROWS * 24))
        self._add = Button(self.kit, variant="primary", icon_name="plus")
        self._add.clicked.connect(self._on_add)
        self._empty = make_label("", "error", wrap=True)
        self._empty.hide()
        self._results = QVBoxLayout()
        self._results.setSpacing(self.kit.px(SPACE[2]))
        row = QHBoxLayout()
        row.addWidget(self._add)
        row.addStretch(1)
        self.column.addWidget(self._known)
        self.column.addWidget(self._input)
        self.column.addLayout(row)
        self.column.addWidget(self._empty)
        self.column.addLayout(self._results)
        self.column.addStretch(1)
        self._last: list[RefResult] = []
        self.retranslate()

    def retranslate(self) -> None:
        super().retranslate()
        self._input.setPlaceholderText(tr("setup.chats.placeholder"))
        self._input.setAccessibleName(tr("setup.chats.heading"))
        self._add.setText(tr("setup.chats.add"))
        self._empty.setText(tr("setup.chats.empty"))
        self._render_count()
        self._render_results()

    def enter(self) -> None:
        context = self.env.context
        state = read_state(
            context.paths.config_file, context.paths.session_file, context.library_file
        )
        self._count = state.chats
        self._render_count()
        self.changed.emit()

    def can_advance(self) -> bool:
        return self._count > 0

    def _render_count(self) -> None:
        self._known.setText(plural(self._count, "setup.chats.known") if self._count else "")
        self._known.setVisible(self._count > 0)

    def _on_add(self) -> None:
        text = self._input.toPlainText()
        refs = split_refs(text)
        self._empty.setVisible(not refs)
        if not refs:
            return
        self._last = add_refs(self.env.context.library_file, text)
        leftover = [
            ref
            for ref, result in zip(refs, self._last, strict=True)
            if result.status in ("invalid", "error")
        ]
        self._input.setPlainText("\n".join(leftover))
        self._render_results()
        self.enter()

    def _render_results(self) -> None:
        clear_layout(self._results)
        for result in self._last:
            tone = RESULT_TONES[result.status]
            chip = Chip(
                self.kit,
                tr(f"setup.chats.result.{result.status}"),
                tone,
                icon_name=RESULT_ICONS[result.status],
            )
            row = QWidget()
            line = QHBoxLayout(row)
            line.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
            line.setSpacing(self.kit.px(SPACE[4]))
            line.addWidget(chip)
            label = ElidedLabel(result.ref, "mono")
            if result.detail:
                label.setToolTip(result.detail)
            line.addWidget(label, 1)
            self._results.addWidget(row)


class FolderStep(WizardStep):
    name = "folder"

    def __init__(self, env: WizardEnv, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(env, parent)
        self._check = FolderCheck(None)
        self._path_label = make_label("", "caption")
        self._path = QLineEdit()
        self._path.setProperty("role", "mono")
        self._browse = Button(self.kit, icon_name="folder-open")
        self._browse.clicked.connect(self._on_browse)
        self._path.editingFinished.connect(self._validate)
        self._verdict = Callout(self.kit, "info", "")
        self._verdict.hide()
        self._cloud = Callout(self.kit, "warning", "")
        self._cloud.hide()
        self._problem = Callout(self.kit, "danger", "")
        self._problem.hide()
        field = QHBoxLayout()
        field.setSpacing(self.kit.px(SPACE[3]))
        field.addWidget(self._path, 1)
        field.addWidget(self._browse)
        self.column.addWidget(self._path_label)
        self.column.addLayout(field)
        self.column.addWidget(self._verdict)
        self.column.addWidget(self._cloud)
        self.column.addWidget(self._problem)
        self.column.addStretch(1)
        self.retranslate()

    def retranslate(self) -> None:
        super().retranslate()
        self._path_label.setText(tr("setup.folder.path"))
        self._path.setAccessibleName(tr("setup.folder.path"))
        self._browse.setText(tr("setup.folder.browse"))
        self._cloud.set_body(tr("setup.folder.cloud"))
        if self._path.text().strip():
            self._validate()

    def enter(self) -> None:
        if not self._path.text().strip():
            self._path.setText(str(current_root(self.env.context.paths.config_file)))
        self._validate()

    def can_advance(self) -> bool:
        return self._check.path is not None

    def _current(self) -> FolderCheck:
        context = self.env.context
        return check_folder(
            self._path.text(), current_root(context.paths.config_file), context.paths.base
        )

    def _validate(self) -> bool:
        self._problem.hide()
        check = self._current()
        self._check = check
        if check.path is None:
            self._verdict.set_tone("danger")
            self._verdict.set_body(tr("setup.folder.invalid", detail=check.error))
        else:
            self._verdict.set_tone("success")
            self._verdict.set_body(tr("setup.folder.valid", path=str(check.path)))
        self._verdict.show()
        self._cloud.setVisible(check.cloud)
        self.changed.emit()
        return check.path is not None

    def _on_browse(self) -> None:
        start = self._path.text().strip() or str(current_root(self.env.context.paths.config_file))
        picked = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(self, tr("setup.folder.pick"), start)
        if picked:
            self._path.setText(picked)
            self._validate()

    def commit(self) -> bool:
        if not self._validate():
            return False
        check = self._check
        if check.changed and check.path is not None:
            try:
                set_output_root(self.env.context.paths.config_file, check.path)
            except ConfigError, OSError:
                log.exception("the data folder could not be saved")
                self._problem.set_body(tr("setup.folder.error.write"))
                self._problem.show()
                return False
        return True

"""Wizard steps five and six: how the program starts, and the summary before Finish."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from PySide6.QtWidgets import QRadioButton, QWidget

from chatimport import autostart
from chatimport.gui.i18n import tr
from chatimport.gui.pages.support import MainThreadRunner
from chatimport.gui.setup_logic import read_state
from chatimport.gui.setup_steps import WizardEnv, WizardStep
from chatimport.gui.widgets.callout import Callout
from chatimport.gui.widgets.labels import make_label

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Callable
    from concurrent.futures import Future

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class RunModeStep(WizardStep):
    name = "mode"

    def __init__(self, env: WizardEnv, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(env, parent)
        self._runner = MainThreadRunner(self)
        self._auto = QRadioButton()
        self._manual = QRadioButton()
        self._auto_hint = make_label("", "caption", wrap=True)
        self._manual_hint = make_label("", "caption", wrap=True)
        self._unsupported = Callout(self.kit, "info", "")
        self._auto.setChecked(True)
        for widget in (self._auto, self._auto_hint, self._manual, self._manual_hint):
            self.column.addWidget(widget)
        self.column.addWidget(self._unsupported)
        self.column.addStretch(1)
        for radio in (self._auto, self._manual):
            radio.toggled.connect(self.changed)
        if not autostart.supported():
            self._auto.setEnabled(False)
            self._manual.setChecked(True)
        self._unsupported.setVisible(not autostart.supported())
        self.retranslate()

    @property
    def autostart_chosen(self) -> bool:
        return self._auto.isChecked()

    def retranslate(self) -> None:
        super().retranslate()
        self._auto.setText(tr("setup.mode.auto"))
        self._manual.setText(tr("setup.mode.manual"))
        self._auto_hint.setText(tr("setup.mode.auto_hint"))
        self._manual_hint.setText(tr("setup.mode.manual_hint"))
        self._unsupported.set_body(tr("setup.mode.unsupported"))

    def apply(self, done: Callable[[bool], None]) -> None:
        """Create or remove the logon task on a worker thread; `done(ok)` runs on the main one."""
        if not autostart.supported():
            done(True)
            return
        task, executable = self.env.hooks.autostart_task, self.env.hooks.executable
        if self.autostart_chosen:
            self._runner.submit(
                lambda: autostart.enable(task, executable=executable),
                lambda future: done(self._succeeded(future)),
            )
        else:
            self._runner.submit(
                lambda: autostart.disable(task), lambda future: done(self._succeeded(future))
            )

    @staticmethod
    def _succeeded(future: Future[autostart.AutostartStatus]) -> bool:
        try:
            future.result()
        except autostart.AutostartError as error:
            log.warning("autostart failed: %s", error.reason)
            return False
        except Exception:
            log.exception("autostart failed")
            return False
        return True


class SummaryStep(WizardStep):
    name = "summary"
    has_lede = False

    def __init__(
        self,
        env: WizardEnv,
        run_mode: RunModeStep,
        parent: QWidget | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(env, parent)
        self._run_mode = run_mode
        self._lines = [make_label("", "secondary", wrap=True) for _ in range(5)]
        self._incomplete = Callout(self.kit, "warning", "")
        self._hint = make_label("", "caption", wrap=True)
        for line in self._lines:
            self.column.addWidget(line)
        self.column.addWidget(self._incomplete)
        self.column.addWidget(self._hint)
        self.column.addStretch(1)
        self._lede.hide()
        self.retranslate()

    def retranslate(self) -> None:
        super().retranslate()
        self._incomplete.set_body(tr("setup.summary.incomplete"))
        self._hint.setText(tr("setup.summary.finish_hint"))
        self._render()

    def enter(self) -> None:
        self._render()

    def _render(self) -> None:
        context = self.env.context
        state = read_state(
            context.paths.config_file, context.paths.session_file, context.library_file
        )
        mode = "auto" if self._run_mode.autostart_chosen else "manual"
        texts = (
            tr("setup.summary.keys.ok" if state.keys_saved else "setup.summary.keys.missing"),
            tr("setup.summary.signin.ok" if state.signed_in else "setup.summary.signin.missing"),
            tr("setup.summary.chats", n=state.chats),
            tr("setup.summary.folder", path=str(state.root)),
            tr(f"setup.summary.mode.{mode}"),
        )
        for line, text in zip(self._lines, texts, strict=True):
            line.setText(text)
        self._incomplete.setVisible(not (state.keys_saved and state.signed_in))

"""The first-run wizard: API keys, sign-in, chats, folder and run mode, then Finish.

Every step reads the files again when it is shown, so the wizard works the same when it is
started fresh, resumed, or run again later from Settings: finished steps arrive prefilled and
the sign-in step knows the session already exists. Finish applies the run mode, remembers that
the wizard was completed and starts (or restarts) the service.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Final

from PySide6.QtWidgets import QDialog, QHBoxLayout, QStackedWidget, QVBoxLayout, QWidget

from chatimport.gui.i18n import tr
from chatimport.gui.locales import onboarding as _onboarding_strings
from chatimport.gui.pages.settings_support import SettingsHooks, control_of
from chatimport.gui.pages.support import notify
from chatimport.gui.setup_steps import KeysStep, SignInStep, WizardEnv, WizardStep
from chatimport.gui.setup_steps_data import ChatsStep, FolderStep
from chatimport.gui.setup_steps_run import RunModeStep, SummaryStep
from chatimport.gui.tokens import SPACE
from chatimport.gui.widgets.base import Tone, bind_kit
from chatimport.gui.widgets.button import Button
from chatimport.gui.widgets.chip import Chip
from chatimport.gui.widgets.labels import make_label

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from chatimport.gui.context import GuiContext

_ = _onboarding_strings
log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

DIALOG_WIDTH: Final = 700
DIALOG_HEIGHT: Final = 540


class SetupWizard(QDialog):
    def __init__(
        self,
        gui: GuiContext,
        hooks: SettingsHooks | None = None,
        parent: QWidget | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.gui = gui
        kit = gui.kit
        hooks = hooks or SettingsHooks()
        env = WizardEnv(gui, hooks, control_of(gui, hooks))
        self._env = env
        self._index = 0
        self._finishing = False
        self.setModal(True)
        self.setMinimumSize(kit.px(DIALOG_WIDTH), kit.px(DIALOG_HEIGHT))

        self._mode = RunModeStep(env)
        self.steps: list[WizardStep] = [
            KeysStep(env),
            SignInStep(env),
            ChatsStep(env),
            FolderStep(env),
            self._mode,
            SummaryStep(env, self._mode),
        ]
        self._chips = [Chip(kit, "", "muted") for _ in self.steps]
        self._counter = make_label("", "caption")
        self._stack = QStackedWidget()
        for step in self.steps:
            self._stack.addWidget(step)
            step.changed.connect(self._refresh_nav)

        self._cancel = Button(kit)
        self._cancel.clicked.connect(self.reject)
        self._back = Button(kit, icon_name="chevron-left")
        self._back.clicked.connect(self._go_back)
        self._skip = Button(kit)
        self._skip.clicked.connect(self._go_skip)
        self._next = Button(kit, variant="primary")
        self._next.clicked.connect(self._go_next)
        self._finish = Button(kit, variant="primary", icon_name="check")
        self._finish.clicked.connect(self._on_finish)

        chips = QHBoxLayout()
        chips.setSpacing(kit.px(SPACE[3]))
        for chip in self._chips:
            chips.addWidget(chip)
        chips.addStretch(1)
        buttons = QHBoxLayout()
        buttons.setSpacing(kit.px(SPACE[3]))
        buttons.addWidget(self._cancel)
        buttons.addStretch(1)
        for button in (self._back, self._skip, self._next, self._finish):
            buttons.addWidget(button)
        column = QVBoxLayout(self)
        gap = kit.px(SPACE[6])
        column.setContentsMargins(gap, gap, gap, gap)
        column.setSpacing(gap)
        column.addLayout(chips)
        column.addWidget(self._counter)
        column.addWidget(self._stack, 1)
        column.addLayout(buttons)
        bind_kit(kit, language=self._retranslate)
        self._retranslate()
        self._show(0)

    @property
    def index(self) -> int:
        return self._index

    def _retranslate(self) -> None:
        self.setWindowTitle(tr("setup.wizard.title"))
        self._cancel.setText(tr("common.cancel"))
        self._back.setText(tr("setup.wizard.back"))
        self._skip.setText(tr("setup.wizard.skip"))
        self._next.setText(tr("setup.wizard.next"))
        self._finish.setText(tr("setup.wizard.finish"))
        self._refresh_nav()

    def _show(self, index: int) -> None:
        self._index = index
        self._stack.setCurrentIndex(index)
        self.steps[index].enter()
        self._refresh_nav()

    def _refresh_nav(self) -> None:
        last = len(self.steps) - 1
        step = self.steps[self._index]
        for position, (chip, other) in enumerate(zip(self._chips, self.steps, strict=True)):
            tone: Tone = (
                "success"
                if position < self._index
                else "info"
                if position == self._index
                else "muted"
            )
            chip.set_text(f"{position + 1}. {tr(f'setup.step.{other.name}')}")
            chip.set_tone(tone)
        self._counter.setText(tr("setup.wizard.step_of", n=self._index + 1, total=len(self.steps)))
        skipping = step.skippable and not step.can_advance() and self._index < last
        busy = self._finishing
        self._back.setVisible(self._index > 0)
        self._back.setEnabled(not busy)
        self._skip.setVisible(skipping)
        self._next.setVisible(not skipping and self._index < last)
        self._next.setEnabled(step.can_advance())
        self._finish.setVisible(self._index == last)
        self._finish.setEnabled(not busy)

    def _go_back(self) -> None:
        self._show(self._index - 1)

    def _go_skip(self) -> None:
        self._show(self._index + 1)

    def _go_next(self) -> None:
        if self.steps[self._index].commit():
            self._show(self._index + 1)

    def _on_finish(self) -> None:
        self._finishing = True
        self._refresh_nav()
        self._mode.apply(self._applied)

    def _applied(self, ok: bool) -> None:
        if not ok:
            parent = self.parentWidget()
            if parent is not None:
                notify(parent, "warning", tr("setup.finish.autostart_failed"))
        self.gui.settings.update(setup_completed=True)
        control = self._env.control
        if control is not None:
            if control.is_alive:
                control.restart()
            else:
                control.start_service()
        self.accept()

"""Qt-free reading of a status snapshot for the shell: service state and history download."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Final, Literal, cast

type ServiceState = Literal[
    "starting", "running", "paused", "stopping", "stopped", "failed", "needs_setup"
]
type DownloadKind = Literal["active", "queued", "retrying", "disk", "paused", "done", "empty"]

Snapshot = dict[str, Any]

_KNOWN: Final = ("starting", "running", "stopping", "stopped", "needs_setup")
_IDLE_KINDS: Final[tuple[tuple[str, DownloadKind], ...]] = (
    ("retrying", "retrying"),
    ("disk_stopped", "disk"),
    ("paused", "paused"),
)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class DownloadSummary:
    kind: DownloadKind
    chat: str = ""
    extra_active: int = 0
    waiting: int = 0


def _dicts(raw: object) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    if not isinstance(raw, list):
        return []
    return [
        cast("dict[str, Any]", item) for item in cast("list[object]", raw) if isinstance(item, dict)
    ]


def _ints(raw: object) -> list[int]:
    if not isinstance(raw, list):
        return []
    return [item for item in cast("list[object]", raw) if isinstance(item, int)]


def chats_of(snapshot: Snapshot | None) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    return _dicts((snapshot or {}).get("chats"))


def service_state(snapshot: Snapshot | None, failed: bool) -> ServiceState:
    if failed:
        return "failed"
    if snapshot is None:
        return "starting"
    name = str(snapshot.get("service", "stopped"))
    if name not in _KNOWN:
        return "stopped"
    chats = chats_of(snapshot)
    if name == "running" and chats and all(bool(c.get("paused")) for c in chats):
        return "paused"
    return cast("ServiceState", name)


def _title_of(chats: list[dict[str, Any]], chat_id: int) -> str:
    for chat in chats:
        if chat.get("chat_id") == chat_id:
            return str(chat.get("title") or chat_id)
    return str(chat_id)


def _backfill_states(chats: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> set[str]:
    states: set[str] = set()
    for chat in chats:
        info = chat.get("backfill")
        if isinstance(info, dict):
            states.add(str(cast("dict[str, Any]", info).get("state")))
    return states


def download_summary(snapshot: Snapshot | None) -> DownloadSummary:
    chats = chats_of(snapshot)
    raw_block = (snapshot or {}).get("backfill")
    block = cast("dict[str, Any]", raw_block) if isinstance(raw_block, dict) else {}
    active = _ints(block.get("active"))
    waiting = len(_ints(block.get("waiting")))
    if active:
        return DownloadSummary("active", _title_of(chats, active[0]), len(active) - 1, waiting)
    if waiting:
        return DownloadSummary("queued", waiting=waiting)
    states = _backfill_states(chats)
    for state, kind in _IDLE_KINDS:
        if state in states:
            return DownloadSummary(kind)
    return DownloadSummary("done" if chats else "empty")

"""Status bar items of the shell: the service-state chip and the global download indicator."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, Final

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt
from PySide6.QtGui import QFontMetrics
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QFrame, QHBoxLayout, QLabel, QVBoxLayout, QWidget

from chatimport.gui.i18n import plural, tr
from chatimport.gui.icons import icon_pixmap
from chatimport.gui.shell_state import (
    DownloadSummary,
    ServiceState,
    download_summary,
    service_state,
)
from chatimport.gui.tokens import SPACE
from chatimport.gui.widgets.base import Tone, bind_kit

from chatimport.gui.widgets.progress import BusyStripe

    from chatimport.gui.kit import UiKit

STATE_TONES: Final[dict[str, Tone]] = {
    "starting": "info",
    "running": "live",
    "paused": "muted",
    "stopping": "warning",
    "stopped": "muted",
    "failed": "danger",
    "needs_setup": "warning",
}
_MAX_TEXT: Final = 380
_STRIPE_WIDTH: Final = 56
_KIND_ICONS: Final[dict[str, str]] = {
    "retrying": "refresh",
    "disk": "alert",
    "paused": "pause",
    "done": "check-circle",
    "empty": "check-circle",
    "queued": "hourglass",
}


class ServiceChip(Chip):
    def __init__(self, kit: UiKit) -> None:
        super().__init__(kit, "", "muted", dot=True)
        self._state: ServiceState = "starting"
        kit.language.changed.connect(self._retranslate)
        self.apply("starting")

    @property
    def state(self) -> ServiceState:
        return self._state

    def apply(self, state: ServiceState) -> None:
        self._state = state
        self.set_tone(STATE_TONES[state])
        self._retranslate()

    def update_from(self, snapshot: dict[str, Any] | None, failed: bool) -> None:
        self.apply(service_state(snapshot, failed))

    def _retranslate(self) -> None:
        name = tr(f"shell.state.{self._state}")
        self.set_text(name)
        self.setToolTip(tr("shell.state.tip", state=name))
        self.setAccessibleName(tr("shell.state.tip", state=name))


class DownloadIndicator(QFrame):
    """ "Downloading history: <chat> - N waiting" with a running stripe, or a calm "all done"."""

    def __init__(self, kit: UiKit, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.kit = kit
        self.setObjectName("DownloadIndicator")
        self._summary = DownloadSummary("empty")
        self._icon = QLabel()
        self._stripe = BusyStripe(kit)
        self._stripe_box = QWidget()
        box = QVBoxLayout(self._stripe_box)
        box.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        box.addWidget(self._stripe, 0, Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter)
        self._text = QLabel()
        self._full = ""
        self._row = QHBoxLayout(self)
        self._row.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        for part in (self._icon, self._stripe_box, self._text):
            self._row.addWidget(part)
        bind_kit(kit, theme=self._restyle, zoom=self._restyle, language=self._retranslate)
        self._restyle()
        self.set_summary(self._summary)

    @property
    def summary(self) -> DownloadSummary:
        return self._summary

    @property
    def text(self) -> str:
        return self._full

    def update_from(self, snapshot: dict[str, Any] | None) -> None:
        self.set_summary(download_summary(snapshot))

    def set_summary(self, summary: DownloadSummary) -> None:
        self._summary = summary
        active = summary.kind == "active"
        self._stripe_box.setVisible(active)
        self._stripe.set_active(active)
        self._icon.setVisible(not active)
        self._restyle()
        self._retranslate()

    def _compose(self) -> str:
        summary = self._summary
        if summary.kind == "active":
            chat = summary.chat
            if summary.extra_active:
                chat = tr("shell.dl.more", chat=chat, n=summary.extra_active)
            text = tr("shell.dl.active", chat=chat)
            if summary.waiting:
                text = f"{text} - {plural(summary.waiting, 'shell.dl.waiting')}"
            return text
        if summary.kind == "queued":
            return f"{tr('shell.dl.queued')} - {plural(summary.waiting, 'shell.dl.waiting')}"
        return tr(f"shell.dl.{summary.kind}")

    def _retranslate(self) -> None:
        self._full = self._compose()
        self._text.setToolTip(self._full)
        self.setAccessibleName(self._full)
        metrics = QFontMetrics(self._text.font())
        width = self.kit.px(_MAX_TEXT)
        self._text.setText(metrics.elidedText(self._full, Qt.TextElideMode.ElideRight, width))

    def _restyle(self) -> None:
        px = self.kit.px
        palette = self.kit.palette
        self._row.setSpacing(px(SPACE[3]))
        self._stripe_box.setFixedWidth(px(_STRIPE_WIDTH))
        kind = self._summary.kind
        name = _KIND_ICONS.get(kind, "check-circle")
        color = {
            "disk": palette.warning,
            "retrying": palette.warning,
            "done": palette.live,
            "empty": palette.fg_faint,
        }.get(kind, palette.fg_muted)
        self._icon.setPixmap(icon_pixmap(name, color, px(12)))
        self._retranslate_width()

    def _retranslate_width(self) -> None:
        self._text.setMaximumWidth(self.kit.px(_MAX_TEXT) + self.kit.px(8))
