"""The string catalogue behind `i18n`: pure, Qt-free, importable from `format`.

Every page registers its own namespace with `register_strings`; the English and Russian tables
must carry the same keys, the same plural shape and the same placeholders, and a mismatch
raises `LocaleDriftError` at registration, so a missing translation fails on the first run
rather than showing up as a raw key in front of the owner.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Final, Literal

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Mapping

type Language = Literal["en", "ru"]
type Entry = str | tuple[str, ...]

LANGUAGES: Final[tuple[Language, ...]] = ("en", "ru")
PLURAL_FORMS: Final[Mapping[Language, int]] = {"en": 2, "ru": 3}

_PLACEHOLDER: Final = re.compile(r"\{(\w+)\}")

_catalogs: dict[Language, dict[str, Entry]] = {"en": {}, "ru": {}}
_core_loaded = False
_current: Language = "en"


class LocaleDriftError(ValueError):
    pass


def _placeholders(entry: Entry) -> set[str]:
    texts = (entry,) if isinstance(entry, str) else entry
    return {name for text in texts for name in _PLACEHOLDER.findall(text)}


def _tables(
    en: Mapping[str, Entry], ru: Mapping[str, Entry]
) -> tuple[tuple[Language, Mapping[str, Entry]], tuple[Language, Mapping[str, Entry]]]:
    return (("en", en), ("ru", ru))


def _validate(namespace: str, en: Mapping[str, Entry], ru: Mapping[str, Entry]) -> None:
    problems: list[str] = []
    problems += [f"missing in ru: {key}" for key in sorted(en.keys() - ru.keys())]
    problems += [f"missing in en: {key}" for key in sorted(ru.keys() - en.keys())]
    for key in sorted(en.keys() & ru.keys()):
        for language, table in _tables(en, ru):
            entry = table[key]
            if isinstance(entry, tuple) and len(entry) != PLURAL_FORMS[language]:
                problems.append(f"{language} plural {key} needs {PLURAL_FORMS[language]} forms")
        if isinstance(en[key], str) != isinstance(ru[key], str):
            problems.append(f"plural shape differs: {key}")
        elif _placeholders(en[key]) != _placeholders(ru[key]):
            problems.append(f"placeholders differ: {key}")
    if problems:
        listing = "; ".join(problems)
        raise LocaleDriftError(f"locale drift in namespace {namespace!r}: {listing}")


def register_strings(namespace: str, en: Mapping[str, Entry], ru: Mapping[str, Entry]) -> None:
    """Add `namespace.key` entries (an empty namespace adds bare keys, for the core table).

    A tuple value is a plural entry: two forms in English (one, other), three in Russian
    (one, few, many).
    """
    _validate(namespace, en, ru)
    prefix = f"{namespace}." if namespace else ""
    for language, table in _tables(en, ru):
        catalog = _catalogs[language]
        for key, entry in table.items():
            full = prefix + key
            if full in catalog:
                raise LocaleDriftError(f"duplicate string key {full!r}")
            catalog[full] = entry


def _ensure_core() -> None:
    global _core_loaded
    if _core_loaded:
        return
    _core_loaded = True
    from chatimport.gui.locales import en as core_en
    from chatimport.gui.locales import ru as core_ru

    register_strings("", core_en.EN, core_ru.RU)


def current_language() -> Language:
    return _current


def set_current_language(language: Language) -> None:
    global _current
    _current = language


def plural_index(language: Language, n: int) -> int:
    count = abs(n)
    if language == "en":
        return 0 if count == 1 else 1
    if count % 10 == 1 and count % 100 != 11:
        return 0
    if 2 <= count % 10 <= 4 and not 12 <= count % 100 <= 14:
        return 1
    return 2


def _fill(template: str, params: Mapping[str, object]) -> str:
    return _PLACEHOLDER.sub(lambda m: str(params.get(m.group(1), m.group(0))), template)


def translate(language: Language, key: str, **params: object) -> str:
    _ensure_core()
    entry = _catalogs[language].get(key)
    if entry is None:
        return key
    text = entry if isinstance(entry, str) else entry[-1]
    return _fill(text, params)


def translate_plural(language: Language, count: int, key: str, **params: object) -> str:
    _ensure_core()
    entry = _catalogs[language].get(key)
    if entry is None:
        return key
    text = entry if isinstance(entry, str) else entry[plural_index(language, count)]
    return _fill(text, {"n": count, **params})


def has_key(key: str) -> bool:
    _ensure_core()
    return key in _catalogs["en"]


def check_drift() -> None:
    """Re-verify the merged catalogues; raises `LocaleDriftError` on any mismatch."""
    _ensure_core()
    _validate("<all>", _catalogs["en"], _catalogs["ru"])

"""Small SVG files the stylesheet points at (check mark, arrows): QSS can only reference files.

Written once per colour into the user's cache folder; the name carries the colour, so a theme
switch reuses what is already there and an older file is never rewritten.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from functools import lru_cache
from pathlib import Path

from platformdirs import user_cache_dir

from chatimport.gui.icons import DEFAULT_WEIGHT, ICON_PATHS
from chatimport.paths import APP_NAME


def _folder() -> Path:
    return Path(user_cache_dir(APP_NAME)) / "gui-icons"


@lru_cache(maxsize=64)
def asset_url(name: str, color: str, weight: float = 2.2) -> str:
    """A `url(...)` token for QSS; falls back to `none` when the cache folder is not writable."""
    folder = _folder()
    target = folder / f"{name}-{color.lstrip('#')}.svg"
    if not target.exists():
        svg = (
            '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" '
            f'stroke="{color}" stroke-width="{weight or DEFAULT_WEIGHT}" stroke-linecap="round" '
            f'stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="{ICON_PATHS[name]}"/></svg>'
        )
        try:
            folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_text(svg, encoding="utf-8")
        except OSError:
            return "none"
    return f"url({target.as_posix()})"

_TONE_BLOCK: Final = """
QFrame#Callout[tone="@tone"] { background: @tone_bg; border: 1px solid @tone_border; border-radius: @radius_md; }
QLabel#CalloutIcon[tone="@tone"] { color: @tone_fg; }

QFrame#StatCard[tone="@tone"] QLabel#StatLabel { color: @stat_label; }
QFrame#Chip[tone="@tone"] { background: @tone_bg; border: 1px solid @tone_border; }
QFrame#Chip[tone="@tone"] QLabel { color: @tone_fg; }
"""


def tone_colors(palette: Palette, tone: str) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
    """(background, border, foreground) for a tone name."""
    table = {
        "neutral": (palette.surface_sunken, palette.border, palette.fg_secondary),
        "muted": (palette.surface_sunken, palette.border, palette.fg_muted),
        "accent": (palette.accent_soft, palette.accent_soft_border, palette.accent_fg),
        "live": (palette.live_soft, palette.live_soft_border, palette.live),
        "success": (palette.success_soft, palette.success_soft_border, palette.success),
        "warning": (palette.warning_soft, palette.warning_soft_border, palette.warning),
        "danger": (palette.danger_soft, palette.danger_soft_border, palette.danger),
        "info": (palette.info_soft, palette.info_soft_border, palette.info),
    }
    return table[tone]


def _px(value: float, scale: float) -> str:
    return f"{max(round(value * scale), 1)}px"


def _family(names: tuple[str, ...], generic: str) -> str:
    return ", ".join([*(f'"{name}"' for name in names), generic])


def _mapping(palette: Palette, scale: float) -> dict[str, str]:
    values: dict[str, str] = dict(palette.colors())
    for index, size in SPACE.items():
        values[f"space_{index}"] = _px(size, scale)
        values[f"space_{index}_less"] = _px(size - 1, scale)
    values["space_3_less"] = _px(SPACE[3] - 1, scale)
    values.update({f"radius_{name}": _px(size, scale) for name, size in RADIUS.items()})
    values.update({f"text_{name}": _px(size, scale) for name, size in TEXT.items()})
    values.update({f"layout_{name}": _px(size, scale) for name, size in LAYOUT.items()})
    values.update({f"weight_{name}": str(weight) for name, weight in WEIGHT.items()})
    values["icon_sm"] = _px(LAYOUT["icon_sm"], scale)
    values["icon_md"] = _px(LAYOUT["icon_md"], scale)
    values["control_inner"] = _px(LAYOUT["control"] - 2, scale)
    values["button_min"] = _px(72, scale)
    values["scroll"] = _px(10, scale)
    values["scroll_radius"] = _px(3, scale)
    values["font_sans"] = _family(FONT_SANS, "sans-serif")
    values["font_display"] = _family(FONT_DISPLAY, "sans-serif")
    values["font_mono"] = _family(FONT_MONO, "monospace")
    values["arrow_down"] = asset_url("chevron-down", palette.fg_muted)
    values["arrow_up"] = asset_url("chevron-up", palette.fg_muted)
    values["check_on_accent"] = asset_url("check", palette.fg_on_accent)
    return values


def _resolve(template: str, values: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    return _PLACEHOLDER.sub(lambda m: values.get(m.group(1), m.group(0)), template)


def build_stylesheet(palette: Palette, scale: float = 1.0) -> str:
    """The whole application stylesheet for `palette` at zoom `scale`."""
    values = _mapping(palette, scale)
    parts = [_resolve(_BASE, values)]
    for tone in TONES:
        bg, border, fg = tone_colors(palette, tone)
        stat = tone == "neutral"
        tone_values = {
            **values,
            "tone": tone,
            "tone_bg": bg,
            "tone_border": border,
            "tone_fg": fg,
            "stat_bg": palette.surface if stat else bg,
            "stat_border": palette.border if stat else border,
            "stat_fg": palette.fg if stat else fg,
            "stat_label": palette.fg_muted if stat else fg,
        }
        parts.append(_resolve(_TONE_BLOCK, tone_values))
    return "\n".join(parts)

"""Light, dark or follow-the-system theme, applied as one application stylesheet.

`ThemeManager` resolves the preference (asking the OS through Qt's style hints), builds the QSS
for the current palette and zoom, applies it, and emits `changed`. Zoom changes rebuild the
stylesheet too, and the manager is created after the zoom manager so its slot runs before any
widget's own zoom handler.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Literal

from PySide6.QtCore import QObject, Qt, Signal
from PySide6.QtGui import QColor, QGuiApplication, QPalette
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication, QStyleFactory

from chatimport.gui.format import Freshness
from chatimport.gui.stylesheet import build_stylesheet
from chatimport.gui.tokens import DARK, PALETTES, Palette

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Callable

    from chatimport.gui.settings import ThemePreference
    from chatimport.gui.zoom import ZoomManager

type ThemeName = Literal["light", "dark"]

__all__ = [
    "ThemeManager",
    "ThemeName",
    "build_stylesheet",
    "freshness_color",
    "qt_palette",
    "system_theme",
]


def system_theme() -> ThemeName:
    hints = QGuiApplication.styleHints()
    return "dark" if hints.colorScheme() == Qt.ColorScheme.Dark else "light"


def freshness_color(palette: Palette, level: Freshness) -> str:
    return {
        Freshness.FRESH: palette.live,
        Freshness.RECENT: palette.fg_secondary,
        Freshness.STALE: palette.warning,
        Freshness.DORMANT: palette.fg_faint,
        Freshness.UNKNOWN: palette.fg_faint,
    }[level]


def qt_palette(palette: Palette) -> QPalette:
    """The `QPalette` behind native-drawn parts (arrows, selection, disabled text)."""
    result = QPalette()
    roles = {
        QPalette.ColorRole.Window: palette.canvas,
        QPalette.ColorRole.WindowText: palette.fg,
        QPalette.ColorRole.Base: palette.surface,
        QPalette.ColorRole.AlternateBase: palette.surface_sunken,
        QPalette.ColorRole.Text: palette.fg,
        QPalette.ColorRole.Button: palette.surface,
        QPalette.ColorRole.ButtonText: palette.fg_secondary,
        QPalette.ColorRole.ToolTipBase: palette.surface_raised,
        QPalette.ColorRole.ToolTipText: palette.fg,
        QPalette.ColorRole.Highlight: palette.selection,
        QPalette.ColorRole.HighlightedText: palette.fg,
        QPalette.ColorRole.PlaceholderText: palette.fg_faint,
        QPalette.ColorRole.Link: palette.accent,
    }
    for role, color in roles.items():
        result.setColor(role, QColor(color))
    for role in (
        QPalette.ColorRole.WindowText,
        QPalette.ColorRole.Text,
        QPalette.ColorRole.ButtonText,
    ):
        result.setColor(QPalette.ColorGroup.Disabled, role, QColor(palette.fg_faint))
    return result


class ThemeManager(QObject):
    changed = Signal()

    def __init__(
        self,
        zoom: ZoomManager,
        preference: ThemePreference = "system",
        *,
        app: QApplication | None = None,
        detect_system: Callable[[], ThemeName] = system_theme,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self._zoom = zoom
        self._preference: ThemePreference = preference
        self._detect_system = detect_system
        self._app = app
        self._resolved: ThemeName = self._resolve()
        zoom.changed.connect(self._on_zoom)
        if app is not None:
            QApplication.setStyle(QStyleFactory.create("Fusion"))
            app.styleHints().colorSchemeChanged.connect(self._on_system_changed)
            self._apply()

    @property
    def preference(self) -> ThemePreference:
        return self._preference

    @property
    def resolved(self) -> ThemeName:
        return self._resolved

    @property
    def palette(self) -> Palette:
        return PALETTES[self._resolved]

    @property
    def is_dark(self) -> bool:
        return self.palette is DARK

    def set_preference(self, preference: ThemePreference) -> None:
        if preference == self._preference:
            return
        self._preference = preference
        self._refresh()

    def stylesheet(self) -> str:
        return build_stylesheet(self.palette, self._zoom.factor)

    def _resolve(self) -> ThemeName:
        if self._preference == "system":
            return self._detect_system()
        return "dark" if self._preference == "dark" else "light"

    def _refresh(self) -> None:
        self._resolved = self._resolve()
        self._apply()
        self.changed.emit()

    def _apply(self) -> None:
        if self._app is None:
            return
        self._app.setPalette(qt_palette(self.palette))
        self._app.setStyleSheet(self.stylesheet())

    def _on_zoom(self, _factor: float) -> None:
        self._apply()

    def _on_system_changed(self, _scheme: Qt.ColorScheme) -> None:
        if self._preference == "system" and self._resolve() != self._resolved:
            self._refresh()

"""`QtTray`: the system tray icon with a state badge, a tooltip and a small menu.

The tray only emits requests; the window decides what they mean. Without a system tray the
object still exists (`available` is False) and every call is a no-op.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Final, Literal

from PySide6.QtCore import QObject, QPointF, QRectF, Qt, Signal
from PySide6.QtGui import QAction, QBrush, QColor, QIcon, QPainter, QPen, QPixmap
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QMenu, QSystemTrayIcon

from chatimport.gui.i18n import tr
from chatimport.runtime import Level

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from chatimport.gui.kit import UiKit

type TrayState = Literal["running", "paused", "error"]

ICON_SIZE: Final = 64
BADGE_RADIUS: Final = 11

    Level.WARNING: QSystemTrayIcon.MessageIcon.Warning,
    Level.ERROR: QSystemTrayIcon.MessageIcon.Critical,
}


def make_tray_icon(state: str) -> QIcon:
    """The application logo with a state badge: green running, grey paused, red failed."""
    logo = QPixmap(str(ICON_PNG)).scaled(
        ICON_SIZE,
        ICON_SIZE,
        Qt.AspectRatioMode.KeepAspectRatio,
        Qt.TransformationMode.SmoothTransformation,
    )
    canvas = QPixmap(ICON_SIZE, ICON_SIZE)
    canvas.fill(Qt.GlobalColor.transparent)
    painter = QPainter(canvas)
    painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing)
    painter.drawPixmap(0, 0, logo)
    center = QPointF(ICON_SIZE - 14, ICON_SIZE - 14)
    ring = BADGE_RADIUS + BADGE_RING
    painter.setPen(QPen(Qt.PenStyle.NoPen))
    painter.setBrush(QBrush(QColor("#ffffff")))
    painter.drawEllipse(QRectF(center.x() - ring, center.y() - ring, ring * 2, ring * 2))
    painter.setBrush(QBrush(QColor(BADGE_COLORS.get(state, BADGE_COLORS["paused"]))))
    painter.drawEllipse(
        QRectF(
            center.x() - BADGE_RADIUS,
            center.y() - BADGE_RADIUS,
            BADGE_RADIUS * 2,
            BADGE_RADIUS * 2,
        )
    )
    painter.end()
    return QIcon(canvas)


class QtTray(QObject):
    open_requested = Signal()
    toggle_pause_requested = Signal()
    recheck_requested = Signal()
    quit_requested = Signal()

    def __init__(self, kit: UiKit) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.kit = kit
        self.available = QSystemTrayIcon.isSystemTrayAvailable()
        self._state: TrayState = "running"
        self._state_text = ""
        self._paused = False
        self._icon = QSystemTrayIcon(self)
        self._menu = QMenu()
        self._open = QAction(self)
        self._toggle = QAction(self)
        self._recheck = QAction(self)
        self._quit = QAction(self)
        self._open.triggered.connect(self.open_requested)
        self._toggle.triggered.connect(self.toggle_pause_requested)
        self._recheck.triggered.connect(self.recheck_requested)
        self._quit.triggered.connect(self.quit_requested)
        self._menu.addAction(self._open)
        self._menu.addSeparator()
        self._menu.addAction(self._toggle)
        self._menu.addAction(self._recheck)
        self._menu.addSeparator()
        self._menu.addAction(self._quit)
        self._icon.setContextMenu(self._menu)
        self._icon.activated.connect(self._on_activated)
        kit.language.changed.connect(self._retranslate)
        self._retranslate()
        self._icon.setIcon(make_tray_icon(self._state))

    def show(self) -> None:
        if self.available:
            self._icon.show()

    def hide(self) -> None:
        self._icon.hide()

    @property
    def visible(self) -> bool:
        return self.available and self._icon.isVisible()

    def set_status(self, state: TrayState, state_text: str, *, paused: bool) -> None:
        if state != self._state:
            self._state = state
            self._icon.setIcon(make_tray_icon(state))
        self._state_text = state_text
        self._paused = paused
        self._retranslate()

    def show_message(self, level: Level, title: str, message: str) -> None:
        if self.available and self._icon.isVisible():
            self._icon.showMessage(title, message, _LEVEL_ICONS[level])

    def _on_activated(self, reason: QSystemTrayIcon.ActivationReason) -> None:
        if reason == QSystemTrayIcon.ActivationReason.DoubleClick:
            self.open_requested.emit()

    def _retranslate(self) -> None:
        self._open.setText(tr("shell.tray.open"))
        self._toggle.setText(tr("shell.tray.resume" if self._paused else "shell.tray.pause"))
        self._recheck.setText(tr("shell.tray.recheck"))
        self._quit.setText(tr("shell.tray.quit"))
        tip = tr("shell.tray.tip", state=self._state_text) if self._state_text else "ChatImport"
        self._icon.setToolTip(tip[:TOOLTIP_LIMIT])

"""Shared widget plumbing: listening to the managers and re-polishing after property changes."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Final, Literal

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Callable

    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QWidget

    from chatimport.gui.kit import UiKit

type Tone = Literal["neutral", "muted", "accent", "live", "success", "warning", "danger", "info"]

KEYBOARD_REASONS: Final = (
    Qt.FocusReason.TabFocusReason,
    Qt.FocusReason.BacktabFocusReason,
    Qt.FocusReason.ShortcutFocusReason,
)

TONE_ICONS: Final[dict[str, str]] = {
    "neutral": "info",
    "muted": "info",
    "accent": "info",
    "info": "info",
    "live": "radio",
    "success": "check-circle",
    "warning": "alert",
    "danger": "x-circle",
}


def bind_kit(
    kit: UiKit,
    *,
    theme: Callable[[], object] | None = None,
    zoom: Callable[[], object] | None = None,
    language: Callable[[], object] | None = None,
) -> None:
    """Call the given handlers when the theme, zoom or language changes.

    Handlers are bound methods of the widget, so Qt drops the connection with the widget.
    The application stylesheet already re-polishes standard widgets; the handlers exist for
    what is painted or sized by hand.
    """
    if theme is not None:
        kit.theme.changed.connect(theme)
    if zoom is not None:
        kit.zoom.changed.connect(zoom)
    if language is not None:
        kit.language.changed.connect(language)


def set_property(widget: QWidget, name: str, value: object) -> None:
    """Set a dynamic property that a QSS selector reads, and re-evaluate the widget's style."""
    if widget.property(name) == value:
        return
    widget.setProperty(name, value)
    style = widget.style()
    style.unpolish(widget)
    style.polish(widget)
    widget.update()


def set_role(widget: QWidget, role: str) -> None:
    """Pick a QSS text or surface role (`muted`, `caption`, `title`, `card`, ...)."""
    set_property(widget, "role", role)

"""Buttons: primary, secondary, ghost and danger variants, three sizes, optional stroke icon."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Final, Literal

from PySide6.QtCore import QSize, Qt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QPushButton

from chatimport.gui.icons import icon
from chatimport.gui.tokens import LAYOUT
from chatimport.gui.widgets.base import bind_kit, set_property

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QWidget

    from chatimport.gui.kit import UiKit
    from chatimport.gui.tokens import Palette

type Variant = Literal["primary", "secondary", "ghost", "danger"]
type Size = Literal["sm", "md", "lg"]

_HEIGHT: Final[dict[str, str]] = {"sm": "control_sm", "md": "control", "lg": "control_lg"}
_ICON: Final[dict[str, str]] = {"sm": "icon_sm", "md": "icon_md", "lg": "icon_lg"}


def _icon_colors(palette: Palette, variant: Variant) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
    """(normal, hovered, disabled) icon colours for a variant."""
    if variant in ("primary", "danger"):
        return palette.fg_on_accent, palette.fg_on_accent, palette.fg_faint
    return palette.fg_secondary, palette.fg, palette.fg_faint


class Button(QPushButton):
    def __init__(
        self,
        kit: UiKit,
        text: str = "",
        *,
        variant: Variant = "secondary",
        size: Size = "md",
        icon_name: str | None = None,
        parent: QWidget | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(text, parent)
        self.kit = kit
        self._variant: Variant = variant
        self._size: Size = size
        self._icon_name = icon_name
        self.setFocusPolicy(Qt.FocusPolicy.TabFocus)
        self.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor)
        self.setProperty("variant", variant)
        self.setProperty("size", size)
        bind_kit(kit, theme=self._restyle, zoom=self._restyle)
        self._restyle()

    @property
    def variant(self) -> Variant:
        return self._variant

    def set_variant(self, variant: Variant) -> None:
        self._variant = variant
        set_property(self, "variant", variant)
        self._restyle()

    def set_icon_name(self, name: str | None) -> None:
        self._icon_name = name
        self._restyle()

    def _restyle(self) -> None:
        self.setFixedHeight(self.kit.px(LAYOUT[_HEIGHT[self._size]]))
        if self._icon_name is None:
            return
        size = self.kit.px(LAYOUT[_ICON[self._size]])
        normal, active, disabled = _icon_colors(self.kit.palette, self._variant)
        self.setIcon(
            icon(self._icon_name, normal, size, active_color=active, disabled_color=disabled)
        )
        self.setIconSize(QSize(size, size))


class IconButton(Button):
    """A square, icon-only button; `tooltip` doubles as the accessible name."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        kit: UiKit,
        icon_name: str,
        tooltip: str,
        *,
        variant: Variant = "ghost",
        size: Size = "md",
        parent: QWidget | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(kit, "", variant=variant, size=size, icon_name=icon_name, parent=parent)
        self.setProperty("iconOnly", True)
        self.set_tooltip(tooltip)

    def set_tooltip(self, text: str) -> None:
        self.setToolTip(text)
        self.setAccessibleName(text)

    def _restyle(self) -> None:
        super()._restyle()
        self.setFixedWidth(self.height())

"""A small status pill: tone colour, optional leading icon or dot, text that never wraps."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Final

from PySide6.QtCore import QRectF, QSize, Qt
from PySide6.QtGui import QColor, QPainter
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QFrame, QHBoxLayout, QLabel, QSizePolicy, QWidget

from chatimport.gui.icons import icon_pixmap
from chatimport.gui.stylesheet import tone_colors
from chatimport.gui.tokens import LAYOUT, SPACE
from chatimport.gui.widgets.base import Tone, bind_kit, set_property

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from PySide6.QtGui import QPaintEvent

    from chatimport.gui.kit import UiKit

DOT_SIZE: Final = 7


class Dot(QWidget):
    """A filled circle in a tone's foreground colour (a "live" or "error" marker)."""

    def __init__(self, kit: UiKit, tone: Tone = "live", parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.kit = kit
        self._tone: Tone = tone
        bind_kit(kit, theme=self.update, zoom=self._resize)
        self._resize()

    def set_tone(self, tone: Tone) -> None:
        self._tone = tone
        self.update()

    def _resize(self) -> None:
        side = self.kit.px(DOT_SIZE)
        self.setFixedSize(QSize(side, side))

    def paintEvent(self, event: QPaintEvent) -> None:
        painter = QPainter(self)
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing)
        painter.setPen(Qt.PenStyle.NoPen)
        painter.setBrush(QColor(tone_colors(self.kit.palette, self._tone)[2]))
        painter.drawEllipse(QRectF(self.rect()))
        event.accept()

"""Labels: a role-styled factory and a label that elides instead of forcing the layout wider."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from PySide6.QtCore import QEvent, QSize, Qt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QLabel, QSizePolicy

from chatimport.gui.widgets.base import set_role

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from PySide6.QtGui import QResizeEvent
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QWidget


def make_label(
    text: str = "",
    role: str | None = None,
    *,
    wrap: bool = False,
    selectable: bool = False,
    parent: QWidget | None = None,
) -> QLabel:
    label = QLabel(text, parent)
    if role is not None:
        set_role(label, role)
    label.setWordWrap(wrap)
    if selectable:
        label.setTextInteractionFlags(Qt.TextInteractionFlag.TextSelectableByMouse)
    return label


class ElidedLabel(QLabel):
    """Single-line label that ends with an ellipsis when narrow and tooltips the full text."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        text: str = "",
        role: str | None = None,
        *,
        mode: Qt.TextElideMode = Qt.TextElideMode.ElideRight,
        parent: QWidget | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._full = ""
        self._mode = mode
        self._custom_tip = False
        self.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Policy.Ignored, QSizePolicy.Policy.Preferred)
        if role is not None:
            set_role(self, role)
        self.setText(text)

    def setText(self, text: str) -> None:
        self._full = text
        self._refit()

    def full_text(self) -> str:
        return self._full

    def setToolTip(self, text: str) -> None:
        self._custom_tip = bool(text)
        super().setToolTip(text)

    def sizeHint(self) -> QSize:
        metrics = self.fontMetrics()
        margins = self.contentsMargins()
        return QSize(
            metrics.horizontalAdvance(self._full) + margins.left() + margins.right() + 2,
            metrics.height() + margins.top() + margins.bottom(),
        )

    def minimumSizeHint(self) -> QSize:
        return QSize(0, self.sizeHint().height())

    def resizeEvent(self, event: QResizeEvent) -> None:
        super().resizeEvent(event)
        self._refit()

    def changeEvent(self, event: QEvent) -> None:
        super().changeEvent(event)
        if event.type() in (QEvent.Type.FontChange, QEvent.Type.StyleChange):
            self._refit()

    def _refit(self) -> None:
        width = max(self.contentsRect().width(), 0)
        shown = (
            self.fontMetrics().elidedText(self._full, self._mode, width) if width else self._full
        )
        if shown != self.text():
            super().setText(shown)
        if not self._custom_tip:
            super().setToolTip(self._full if shown != self._full else "")

"""One sidebar row, painted by hand: icon, label, optional badge, active bar and focus ring."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from PySide6.QtCore import QEvent, QRectF, QSize, Qt
from PySide6.QtGui import QColor, QFont, QFontMetrics, QPainter, QPen
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QAbstractButton, QSizePolicy

from chatimport.gui.icons import icon_pixmap
from chatimport.gui.tokens import LAYOUT, RADIUS, SPACE, TEXT, WEIGHT
from chatimport.gui.widgets.base import KEYBOARD_REASONS, bind_kit

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from PySide6.QtGui import QEnterEvent, QFocusEvent, QKeyEvent, QPaintEvent
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QWidget

    from chatimport.gui.kit import UiKit
    from chatimport.gui.widgets.sidebar import Sidebar


class NavItem(QAbstractButton):
    def __init__(
        self,
        kit: UiKit,
        key: str,
        icon_name: str,
        label: str,
        *,
        selectable: bool = True,
        owner: Sidebar | None = None,
        parent: QWidget | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._keyboard_focus = False
        self.kit = kit
        self.key = key
        self._owner = owner
        self._icon_name = icon_name
        self._label = label
        self._badge = ""
        self._rail = False
        self._active = False
        self._hover = False
        self.setCheckable(False)
        self._selectable = selectable
        self.setFocusPolicy(Qt.FocusPolicy.TabFocus)
        self.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor)
        self.setMouseTracking(True)
        self.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Policy.Expanding, QSizePolicy.Policy.Fixed)
        self.setAccessibleName(label)
        bind_kit(kit, theme=self.update, zoom=self._resize)
        self._resize()

    def set_label(self, label: str) -> None:
        self._label = label
        self.setAccessibleName(label)
        self._sync_tooltip()
        self.update()

    def set_badge(self, text: str) -> None:
        self._badge = text
        self.update()

    def set_active(self, active: bool) -> None:
        self._active = active
        self.update()

    def set_rail(self, rail: bool) -> None:
        self._rail = rail
        self._sync_tooltip()
        self.update()

    def _sync_tooltip(self) -> None:
        self.setToolTip(self._label if self._rail else "")

    def _resize(self) -> None:
        self.setFixedHeight(self.kit.px(LAYOUT["nav_item"]))
        self.updateGeometry()

    def sizeHint(self) -> QSize:
        return QSize(self.kit.px(LAYOUT["rail"]), self.kit.px(LAYOUT["nav_item"]))

    def enterEvent(self, event: QEnterEvent) -> None:
        self._hover = True
        self.update()
        super().enterEvent(event)

    def leaveEvent(self, event: QEvent) -> None:
        self._hover = False
        self.update()
        super().leaveEvent(event)

    def keyPressEvent(self, event: QKeyEvent) -> None:
        step = {Qt.Key.Key_Down: 1, Qt.Key.Key_Up: -1}.get(Qt.Key(event.key()), 0)
        if step and self._owner is not None:
            self._owner.focus_neighbour(self, step)
            event.accept()
            return
        super().keyPressEvent(event)

    def _font(self, size_key: str, weight_key: str) -> QFont:
        font = QFont(self.font())
        font.setPixelSize(self.kit.px(TEXT[size_key]))
        font.setWeight(QFont.Weight(WEIGHT[weight_key]))
        return font

    def focusInEvent(self, event: QFocusEvent) -> None:
        self._keyboard_focus = event.reason() in KEYBOARD_REASONS
        super().focusInEvent(event)

    def paintEvent(self, event: QPaintEvent) -> None:
        palette = self.kit.palette
        px = self.kit.px
        painter = QPainter(self)
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing)
        box = QRectF(self.rect()).adjusted(
            px(SPACE[1]), px(SPACE[1] / 2), -px(SPACE[1]), -px(SPACE[1] / 2)
        )
        radius = px(RADIUS["sm"])
        if self._active:
            painter.setBrush(QColor(palette.accent_soft))
            painter.setPen(Qt.PenStyle.NoPen)
            painter.drawRoundedRect(box, radius, radius)
            bar = QRectF(box.left(), box.top() + px(8), px(3), box.height() - px(16))
            painter.setBrush(QColor(palette.accent))
            painter.drawRoundedRect(bar, px(1.5), px(1.5))
        elif self._hover:
            painter.setBrush(QColor(palette.surface_hover))
            painter.setPen(Qt.PenStyle.NoPen)
            painter.drawRoundedRect(box, radius, radius)
        fg = (
            palette.accent_fg
            if self._active
            else (palette.fg if self._hover else palette.fg_secondary)
        )
        size = px(LAYOUT["icon_md"] + 2)
        pixmap = icon_pixmap(self._icon_name, fg, size)
        icon_x = (box.width() - size) / 2 + box.left() if self._rail else box.left() + px(SPACE[5])
        painter.drawPixmap(round(icon_x), round(box.center().y() - size / 2), pixmap)
        if self._rail:
            self._paint_focus(painter, box, radius)
            return
        text_left = icon_x + size + px(SPACE[4])
        right = box.right() - px(SPACE[4])
        if self._badge:
            right = self._paint_badge(painter, box, right) - px(SPACE[3])
        font = self._font("base", "medium")
        painter.setFont(font)
        painter.setPen(QColor(fg))
        metrics = QFontMetrics(font)
        text = metrics.elidedText(
            self._label, Qt.TextElideMode.ElideRight, max(round(right - text_left), 0)
        )
        text_box = QRectF(text_left, box.top(), max(right - text_left, 0), box.height())
        painter.drawText(
            text_box, int(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft), text
        )
        self._paint_focus(painter, box, radius)
        event.accept()

    def _paint_badge(self, painter: QPainter, box: QRectF, right: float) -> float:
        palette = self.kit.palette
        px = self.kit.px
        font = self._font("2xs", "semibold")
        metrics = QFontMetrics(font)
        width = metrics.horizontalAdvance(self._badge) + 2 * px(SPACE[3])
        height = metrics.height() + px(SPACE[1])
        pill = QRectF(right - width, box.center().y() - height / 2, width, height)
        painter.setBrush(QColor(palette.surface_sunken))
        painter.setPen(QPen(QColor(palette.border), 1))
        painter.drawRoundedRect(pill, height / 2, height / 2)
        painter.setFont(font)
        painter.setPen(QColor(palette.fg_muted))
        painter.drawText(pill, int(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter), self._badge)
        return pill.left()

    def _paint_focus(self, painter: QPainter, box: QRectF, radius: int) -> None:
        if not (self.hasFocus() and self._keyboard_focus):
            return
        painter.setBrush(Qt.BrushStyle.NoBrush)
        painter.setPen(QPen(QColor(self.kit.palette.border_focus), max(self.kit.px(2), 2)))
        painter.drawRoundedRect(box.adjusted(1, 1, -1, -1), radius, radius)

"""Progress: a determinate or indeterminate bar, and a thin busy stripe for page tops.

Both are painted from the palette. An indeterminate bar only runs its animation while visible,
so a hidden page costs nothing.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Final

from PySide6.QtCore import QEasingCurve, QRectF, Qt, QVariantAnimation
from PySide6.QtGui import QColor, QPainter, QPainterPath
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QSizePolicy, QWidget

from chatimport.gui.stylesheet import tone_colors
from chatimport.gui.tokens import DURATION, SPACE
from chatimport.gui.widgets.base import Tone, bind_kit

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from PySide6.QtGui import QHideEvent, QPaintEvent, QShowEvent

    from chatimport.gui.kit import UiKit

_SWEEP_MS: Final = 1400
_BLOCK: Final = 0.38


class ProgressBar(QWidget):
    """`set_value(0..1)` for a fraction, `set_value(None)` for "working, no estimate"."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        kit: UiKit,
        *,
        tone: Tone = "accent",
        height: int = SPACE[3],
        parent: QWidget | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.kit = kit
        self._tone: Tone = tone
        self._height = height
        self._value: float | None = None
        self._shown: float = 0.0
        self._phase = 0.0
        self._fill = QVariantAnimation(self)
        self._fill.setEasingCurve(QEasingCurve.Type.OutCubic)
        self._fill.valueChanged.connect(self._on_fill)
        self._sweep = QVariantAnimation(self)
        self._sweep.setStartValue(0.0)
        self._sweep.setEndValue(1.0)
        self._sweep.setDuration(_SWEEP_MS)
        self._sweep.setLoopCount(-1)
        self._sweep.valueChanged.connect(self._on_sweep)
        self.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Policy.Expanding, QSizePolicy.Policy.Fixed)
        bind_kit(kit, theme=self.update, zoom=self._resize)
        self._resize()

    @property
    def value(self) -> float | None:
        return self._value

    def set_tone(self, tone: Tone) -> None:
        self._tone = tone
        self.update()

    def set_value(self, value: float | None) -> None:
        self._value = None if value is None else min(max(value, 0.0), 1.0)
        if self._value is None:
            self._fill.stop()
            self._sync_sweep()
        else:
            self._sweep.stop()
            self._fill.stop()
            self._fill.setStartValue(self._shown)
            self._fill.setEndValue(self._value)
            self._fill.setDuration(DURATION["slow"])
            self._fill.start()
        self.update()

    def _resize(self) -> None:
        self.setFixedHeight(self.kit.px(self._height))

    def _on_fill(self, value: object) -> None:
        self._shown = float(value) if isinstance(value, float | int) else self._shown
        self.update()

    def _on_sweep(self, value: object) -> None:
        self._phase = float(value) if isinstance(value, float | int) else 0.0
        self.update()

    def _sync_sweep(self) -> None:
        running = self._sweep.state() == QVariantAnimation.State.Running
        if self._value is None and self.isVisible():
            if not running:
                self._sweep.start()
        elif running:
            self._sweep.stop()

    def showEvent(self, event: QShowEvent) -> None:
        super().showEvent(event)
        self._sync_sweep()

    def hideEvent(self, event: QHideEvent) -> None:
        super().hideEvent(event)
        self._sweep.stop()

    def _track_color(self) -> QColor:
        return QColor(self.kit.palette.surface_active)

    def paintEvent(self, event: QPaintEvent) -> None:
        painter = QPainter(self)
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing)
        rect = QRectF(self.rect())
        radius = rect.height() / 2
        clip = QPainterPath()
        clip.addRoundedRect(rect, radius, radius)
        painter.setClipPath(clip)
        painter.fillRect(rect, self._track_color())
        fill = QColor(tone_colors(self.kit.palette, self._tone)[2])
        if self._tone == "accent":
            fill = QColor(self.kit.palette.accent)
        if self._value is None:
            width = rect.width() * _BLOCK
            left = -width + (rect.width() + width) * self._phase
            painter.fillRect(QRectF(left, 0, width, rect.height()), fill)
        else:
            painter.fillRect(QRectF(0, 0, rect.width() * self._shown, rect.height()), fill)
        event.accept()


class BusyStripe(ProgressBar):
    """A 2 px indeterminate line on a transparent track, shown while something is loading."""

    def __init__(self, kit: UiKit, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(kit, tone="accent", height=SPACE[1], parent=parent)
        self.set_active(False)

    def set_active(self, active: bool) -> None:
        self.setVisible(active)
        self.set_value(None)

    def _track_color(self) -> QColor:
        return QColor(Qt.GlobalColor.transparent)

"""A search box: leading icon, clear button, debounced query signal, Esc clears."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Final

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt, QTimer, Signal
from PySide6.QtGui import QAction
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QLineEdit

from chatimport.gui.i18n import tr
from chatimport.gui.icons import icon
from chatimport.gui.tokens import LAYOUT
from chatimport.gui.widgets.base import bind_kit

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from PySide6.QtGui import QKeyEvent
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QWidget

    from chatimport.gui.kit import UiKit

DEBOUNCE_MS: Final = 150


class SearchField(QLineEdit):
    """`query_changed` fires after typing pauses; `text()` is always the live value."""

    query_changed = Signal(str)

    def __init__(self, kit: UiKit, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.kit = kit
        self._lead = QAction(self)
        self._clear = QAction(self)
        self.addAction(self._lead, QLineEdit.ActionPosition.LeadingPosition)
        self.addAction(self._clear, QLineEdit.ActionPosition.TrailingPosition)
        self._clear.setVisible(False)
        self._clear.triggered.connect(self.clear)
        self._timer = QTimer(self)
        self._timer.setSingleShot(True)
        self._timer.setInterval(DEBOUNCE_MS)
        self._timer.timeout.connect(self._emit)
        self.textChanged.connect(self._on_text)
        bind_kit(kit, theme=self._restyle, zoom=self._restyle, language=self._retranslate)
        self._restyle()
        self._retranslate()

    def _on_text(self, text: str) -> None:
        self._clear.setVisible(bool(text))
        self._timer.start()

    def _emit(self) -> None:
        self.query_changed.emit(self.text())

    def keyPressEvent(self, event: QKeyEvent) -> None:
        if event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_Escape and self.text():
            self.clear()
            event.accept()
            return
        super().keyPressEvent(event)

    def _retranslate(self) -> None:
        self.setPlaceholderText(tr("search.placeholder"))
        self._clear.setToolTip(tr("search.clear"))
        self.setAccessibleName(tr("search.placeholder"))

    def _restyle(self) -> None:
        palette = self.kit.palette
        size = self.kit.px(LAYOUT["icon_md"])
        self._lead.setIcon(icon("search", palette.fg_faint, size))
        self._clear.setIcon(icon("x", palette.fg_muted, size))
        self.setFixedHeight(self.kit.px(LAYOUT["control"]))

"""A segmented control: one choice from a few options, arrow-key navigable.

An option can be marked unavailable: it stays clickable and focusable, dimmed, and clicking it
explains why instead of selecting it. The active option's hint (or that explanation) shows
under the track.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from PySide6.QtCore import QSize, Qt, Signal
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QFrame, QHBoxLayout, QLabel, QPushButton, QVBoxLayout, QWidget

from chatimport.gui.icons import icon
from chatimport.gui.tokens import LAYOUT, SPACE
from chatimport.gui.widgets.base import bind_kit, set_property

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from PySide6.QtGui import QKeyEvent

    from chatimport.gui.kit import UiKit


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SegmentOption:
    value: str
    label: str
    hint: str = ""
    unavailable: str = ""
    icon: str | None = None
    tooltip: str = ""


class _OptionButton(QPushButton):
    def __init__(self, owner: Segmented, index: int, option: SegmentOption) -> None:
        super().__init__(option.label)
        self._owner = owner
        self._index = index
        self.setObjectName("SegmentedOption")
        self.setCheckable(True)
        self.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor)
        self.setFocusPolicy(Qt.FocusPolicy.NoFocus)
        self.clicked.connect(lambda: owner.choose(index))

    def keyPressEvent(self, event: QKeyEvent) -> None:
        step = {
            Qt.Key.Key_Right: 1,
            Qt.Key.Key_Down: 1,
            Qt.Key.Key_Left: -1,
            Qt.Key.Key_Up: -1,
        }.get(Qt.Key(event.key()), 0)
        if step:
            self._owner.step_focus(self._index, step)
            event.accept()
        else:
            super().keyPressEvent(event)


class Segmented(QWidget):
    selected = Signal(str)

    def __init__(
        self,
        kit: UiKit,
        options: list[SegmentOption],
        value: str,
        *,
        label: str = "",
        compact: bool = False,
        parent: QWidget | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.kit = kit
        self._compact = compact
        self._options: list[SegmentOption] = []
        self._buttons: list[_OptionButton] = []
        self._value = value
        self._note = ""
        self._label = QLabel(label)
        self._label.setVisible(bool(label))
        self._track = QFrame()
        self._track.setObjectName("SegmentedTrack")
        self._row = QHBoxLayout(self._track)
        self._caption = QLabel()
        self._caption.setObjectName("SegmentedNote")
        self._caption.setWordWrap(True)
        self._column = QVBoxLayout(self)
        self._column.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        self._column.addWidget(self._label)
        self._column.addWidget(self._track)
        self._column.addWidget(self._caption)
        self.setAccessibleName(label)
        bind_kit(kit, theme=self._restyle, zoom=self._restyle)
        self.set_options(options, value)

    @property
    def value(self) -> str:
        return self._value

    def set_label(self, label: str) -> None:
        self._label.setText(label)
        self._label.setVisible(bool(label))
        self.setAccessibleName(label)

    def set_options(self, options: list[SegmentOption], value: str | None = None) -> None:
        """Replace the options (for example after a language change); keeps the value."""
        for button in self._buttons:
            self._row.removeWidget(button)
            button.deleteLater()
        self._options = options
        if value is not None:
            self._value = value
        self._buttons = [_OptionButton(self, i, option) for i, option in enumerate(options)]
        for button in self._buttons:
            self._row.addWidget(button, 1)
        self._note = ""
        self._restyle()

    def set_value(self, value: str) -> None:
        self._value = value
        self._note = ""
        self._restyle()

    def choose(self, index: int) -> None:
        option = self._options[index]
        if option.unavailable:
            self._note = option.unavailable
            self._restyle()
            self._buttons[index].setFocus()
            return
        self._note = ""
        changed = option.value != self._value
        self._value = option.value
        self._restyle()
        if changed:
            self.selected.emit(option.value)

    def step_focus(self, index: int, step: int) -> None:
        target = (index + step) % len(self._buttons)
        self.choose(target)
        self._buttons[target].setFocus(Qt.FocusReason.TabFocusReason)

    def _restyle(self) -> None:
        px = self.kit.px
        pad = px(3)
        self._row.setContentsMargins(pad, pad, pad, pad)
        self._row.setSpacing(px(SPACE[1]))
        self._column.setSpacing(px(SPACE[3]))
        height = px(LAYOUT["control"] - 8 if self._compact else LAYOUT["control"] - 6)
        palette = self.kit.palette
        size = px(LAYOUT["icon_md"] - (2 if self._compact else 0))
        active = self._value
        for option, button in zip(self._options, self._buttons, strict=True):
            is_active = option.value == active
            button.setFixedHeight(height)
            button.setChecked(is_active)
            button.setFocusPolicy(Qt.FocusPolicy.TabFocus if is_active else Qt.FocusPolicy.NoFocus)
            set_property(button, "unavailable", bool(option.unavailable))
            set_property(button, "compact", self._compact)
            tip = option.tooltip or option.unavailable
            button.setToolTip(tip)
            button.setAccessibleName(option.label or option.tooltip)
            button.setText(option.label)
            if option.icon:
                color = palette.fg if is_active else palette.fg_muted
                button.setIcon(icon(option.icon, color, size))
                button.setIconSize(QSize(size, size))
            if not option.label:
                button.setFixedWidth(px(LAYOUT["control"] + 2))
        active_option = next((o for o in self._options if o.value == active), None)
        text = self._note or (active_option.hint if active_option else "")
        self._caption.setText(text)
        self._caption.setVisible(bool(text))

"""The collapsible sidebar: brand, sectioned navigation, collapse toggle (full width or icon rail).

Entries carry translation keys, so a language change relabels everything. An entry may show a
badge ("Soon") and may be locked: clicking a locked entry emits `locked` with the reason
instead of navigating, so a locked item explains itself rather than doing nothing.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from PySide6.QtCore import QEasingCurve, Qt, QVariantAnimation, Signal
from PySide6.QtGui import QPixmap
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QFrame, QHBoxLayout, QLabel, QVBoxLayout, QWidget

from chatimport.assets import ICON_PNG
from chatimport.gui.i18n import tr
from chatimport.gui.tokens import DURATION, LAYOUT, SPACE
from chatimport.gui.widgets.base import bind_kit
from chatimport.gui.widgets.nav_item import NavItem

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Sequence

    from chatimport.gui.kit import UiKit

COLLAPSE_KEY = "__collapse__"
LOGO_SIZE = 28


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class NavEntry:
    key: str
    label_key: str
    icon: str
    badge_key: str | None = None
    locked_key: str | None = None


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class NavSection:
    label_key: str
    entries: tuple[NavEntry, ...]


class Sidebar(QFrame):
    navigate = Signal(str)
    locked = Signal(str, str)
    collapsed_changed = Signal(bool)

    def __init__(
        self,
        kit: UiKit,
        sections: Sequence[NavSection],
        *,
        current: str | None = None,
        collapsed: bool = False,
        parent: QWidget | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.kit = kit
        self.setObjectName("Sidebar")
        self._sections = list(sections)
        self._collapsed = collapsed
        self._current = current
        self._items: dict[str, NavItem] = {}
        self._entries: dict[str, NavEntry] = {}
        self._headings: list[tuple[str, QLabel]] = []
        self._badges: dict[str, str] = {}
        self._build()
        self._anim = QVariantAnimation(self)
        self._anim.setEasingCurve(QEasingCurve.Type.OutCubic)
        self._anim.setDuration(DURATION["base"])
        self._anim.valueChanged.connect(self._on_width)
        self._anim.finished.connect(self._after_animation)
        bind_kit(kit, theme=self._restyle, zoom=self._on_zoom, language=self._retranslate)
        self._retranslate()
        self._restyle()
        self._apply_collapsed()
        self.set_current(current)
        self.setFixedWidth(self._target_width())

    @property
    def is_collapsed(self) -> bool:
        return self._collapsed

    @property
    def current(self) -> str | None:
        return self._current

    def _build(self) -> None:
        self._column = QVBoxLayout(self)
        self._column.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        self._column.setSpacing(0)
        self._brand = QWidget()
        self._brand_row = QHBoxLayout(self._brand)
        self._logo = QLabel()
        self._logo.setAccessibleName(tr("app.title"))
        self._brand_texts = QWidget()
        texts = QVBoxLayout(self._brand_texts)
        texts.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        texts.setSpacing(0)
        self._name = QLabel()
        self._name.setObjectName("BrandName")
        self._tagline = QLabel()
        self._tagline.setObjectName("BrandTagline")
        texts.addWidget(self._name)
        texts.addWidget(self._tagline)
        self._brand_row.addWidget(self._logo)
        self._brand_row.addWidget(self._brand_texts, 1)
        self._column.addWidget(self._brand)
        self._nav = QVBoxLayout()
        self._nav.setSpacing(0)
        for section in self._sections:
            heading = QLabel()
            heading.setObjectName("NavHeading")
            self._headings.append((section.label_key, heading))
            self._nav.addWidget(heading)
            for entry in section.entries:
                item = NavItem(self.kit, entry.key, entry.icon, "", owner=self)
                item.clicked.connect(lambda _=False, key=entry.key: self._activate(key))
                self._items[entry.key] = item
                self._entries[entry.key] = entry
                self._nav.addWidget(item)
        self._column.addLayout(self._nav)
        self._column.addStretch(1)
        self._toggle = NavItem(self.kit, COLLAPSE_KEY, "panel-left", "", owner=self)
        self._toggle.clicked.connect(self.toggle)
        self._bottom = QVBoxLayout()
        self._bottom.addWidget(self._toggle)
        self._column.addLayout(self._bottom)

    def focus_neighbour(self, item: NavItem, step: int) -> None:
        order = [*self._items.values(), self._toggle]
        target = order[(order.index(item) + step) % len(order)]
        target.setFocus(Qt.FocusReason.TabFocusReason)

    def _activate(self, key: str) -> None:
        entry = self._entries[key]
        if entry.locked_key:
            self.locked.emit(key, tr(entry.locked_key))
            return
        self.set_current(key)
        self.navigate.emit(key)

    def set_current(self, key: str | None) -> None:
        self._current = key
        for item_key, item in self._items.items():
            item.set_active(item_key == key)

    def set_badge(self, key: str, text: str | None) -> None:
        """Override an entry's badge (for example a count); `None` restores the default."""
        if text is None:
            self._badges.pop(key, None)
        else:
            self._badges[key] = text
        self._retranslate()

    def toggle(self) -> None:
        self.set_collapsed(not self._collapsed)

    def set_collapsed(self, collapsed: bool, *, animate: bool = True) -> None:
        if collapsed == self._collapsed:
            return
        self._collapsed = collapsed
        self._retranslate()
        if collapsed:
            self._hide_texts(True)
        else:
            self._apply_collapsed()
        if animate:
            self._anim.stop()
            self._anim.setStartValue(self.width())
            self._anim.setEndValue(self._target_width())
            self._anim.start()
        else:
            self.setFixedWidth(self._target_width())
            self._apply_collapsed()
        self.collapsed_changed.emit(collapsed)

    def _target_width(self) -> int:
        return self.kit.px(LAYOUT["rail"] if self._collapsed else LAYOUT["sidebar"])

    def _on_width(self, value: object) -> None:
        if isinstance(value, int | float):
            self.setFixedWidth(round(value))

    def _after_animation(self) -> None:
        self.setFixedWidth(self._target_width())
        self._apply_collapsed()

    def _hide_texts(self, hidden: bool) -> None:
        self._brand_texts.setVisible(not hidden)
        for _key, heading in self._headings:
            heading.setVisible(not hidden)

    def _apply_collapsed(self) -> None:
        self._hide_texts(self._collapsed)
        for item in (*self._items.values(), self._toggle):
            item.set_rail(self._collapsed)
        self._restyle()

    def _on_zoom(self) -> None:
        self.setFixedWidth(self._target_width())
        self._restyle()

    def _retranslate(self) -> None:
        self._name.setText(tr("app.title"))
        self._tagline.setText(tr("app.tagline"))
        self._logo.setAccessibleName(tr("app.title"))
        for label_key, heading in self._headings:
            heading.setText(tr(label_key).upper())
        for key, item in self._items.items():
            entry = self._entries[key]
            item.set_label(tr(entry.label_key))
            badge = self._badges.get(key) or (tr(entry.badge_key) if entry.badge_key else "")
            item.set_badge(badge)
        toggle_text = tr("nav.expand" if self._collapsed else "nav.collapse")
        self._toggle.set_label(toggle_text)
        self._toggle.setToolTip(toggle_text)
        self.setAccessibleName(tr("nav.label"))

    def _restyle(self) -> None:
        px = self.kit.px
        pad = px(SPACE[4])
        self._brand.setFixedHeight(px(LAYOUT["header"]))
        self._brand_row.setContentsMargins(px(SPACE[5]) if not self._collapsed else 0, 0, pad, 0)
        self._brand_row.setSpacing(px(SPACE[4]))
        self._brand_row.setAlignment(
            Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter if self._collapsed else Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter
        )
        self._nav.setContentsMargins(pad, px(SPACE[2]), pad, 0)
        self._bottom.setContentsMargins(pad, 0, pad, 0)
        self._column.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, px(SPACE[4]))
        for _key, heading in self._headings:
            heading.setContentsMargins(px(SPACE[4]), px(SPACE[5]), 0, px(SPACE[2]))
        logo_size = px(LOGO_SIZE)
        dpr = self.devicePixelRatioF() or 1.0
        pixmap = QPixmap(str(ICON_PNG)).scaled(
            round(logo_size * dpr),
            round(logo_size * dpr),
            Qt.AspectRatioMode.KeepAspectRatio,
            Qt.TransformationMode.SmoothTransformation,
        )
        pixmap.setDevicePixelRatio(dpr)
        self._logo.setPixmap(pixmap)
        self._logo.setFixedSize(logo_size, logo_size)

        self.kit = kit

        self._lock = QLabel()

        self._zoom_in.clicked.connect(kit.zoom.zoom_in)

        self._restyle()
        self._retranslate()

        """Dynamic items (service state, disk) go between the statement and the zoom."""
        self._extras.addWidget(widget)

        self._privacy.setText(tr("status.local"))
        self._privacy.setToolTip(tr("status.local_tip"))

        self._zoom_out.setToolTip(tr("status.zoom.out"))
        self._zoom_out.setAccessibleName(tr("status.zoom.out"))
        self._zoom_in.setToolTip(tr("status.zoom.in"))
        self._zoom_in.setAccessibleName(tr("status.zoom.in"))
        self._sync_zoom()

    def _sync_zoom(self) -> None:
        zoom = self.kit.zoom
        mark = f" {tr('status.zoom.auto_mark')}" if zoom.auto else ""
        self._zoom_value.setText(f"{zoom.percent}%{mark}")
        tip = tr("status.zoom.auto") if zoom.auto else tr("status.zoom.reset")
        self._zoom_value.setToolTip(tip)
        self._zoom_value.setAccessibleName(f"{tr('status.zoom.label')} {zoom.percent}%")
        self._zoom_out.setEnabled(zoom.can_zoom_out)
        self._zoom_in.setEnabled(zoom.can_zoom_in)

    def _restyle(self) -> None:
        px = self.kit.px
        palette = self.kit.palette
        self.setFixedHeight(px(LAYOUT["statusbar"]))
        self._row.setContentsMargins(px(SPACE[6]), 0, px(SPACE[6]), 0)
        self._row.setSpacing(px(SPACE[4]))
        self._extras.setSpacing(px(SPACE[6]))
        size = px(_ICON_SIZE)
        self._lock.setPixmap(icon_pixmap("lock", palette.live, size))
        side = px(18)
        for button in (self._zoom_out, self._zoom_in):
            button.setFixedSize(side, side)
        button_icons = ((self._zoom_out, "minus"), (self._zoom_in, "plus"))
        for button, name in button_icons:
            button.setIcon(
                icon(
                    name,
                    palette.fg_muted,
                    size,
                    active_color=palette.fg,
                    disabled_color=palette.fg_faint,
                )
            )
            button.setIconSize(QSize(size, size))
        self._zoom_value.setFixedHeight(side)
        self._zoom_value.setMinimumWidth(px(44))
        self._sync_zoom()

"""A toggle switch, and a settings row that pairs it with a label and an explanation."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Final

from PySide6.QtCore import QEasingCurve, QPointF, QRectF, QSize, Qt, QVariantAnimation, Signal
from PySide6.QtGui import QColor, QPainter, QPen
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QAbstractButton,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QLabel,
    QSizePolicy,
    QVBoxLayout,
    QWidget,
)

from chatimport.gui.tokens import DURATION, SPACE
from chatimport.gui.widgets.base import KEYBOARD_REASONS, bind_kit, set_role

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from PySide6.QtGui import QFocusEvent, QMouseEvent, QPaintEvent

    from chatimport.gui.kit import UiKit

_TRACK_W: Final = 36
_TRACK_H: Final = 20
_KNOB_GAP: Final = 3


class Switch(QAbstractButton):
    def __init__(self, kit: UiKit, *, checked: bool = False, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._keyboard_focus = False
        self.kit = kit
        self.setCheckable(True)
        self.setChecked(checked)
        self.setFocusPolicy(Qt.FocusPolicy.TabFocus)
        self.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor)
        self.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Policy.Fixed, QSizePolicy.Policy.Fixed)
        self._position = 1.0 if checked else 0.0
        self._slide = QVariantAnimation(self)
        self._slide.setEasingCurve(QEasingCurve.Type.OutCubic)
        self._slide.setDuration(DURATION["base"])
        self._slide.valueChanged.connect(self._on_slide)
        self.toggled.connect(self._animate)
        bind_kit(kit, theme=self.update, zoom=self.updateGeometry)

    def sizeHint(self) -> QSize:
        return QSize(self.kit.px(_TRACK_W + 4), self.kit.px(_TRACK_H + 4))

    def minimumSizeHint(self) -> QSize:
        return self.sizeHint()

    def _animate(self, checked: bool) -> None:
        self._slide.stop()
        self._slide.setStartValue(self._position)
        self._slide.setEndValue(1.0 if checked else 0.0)
        self._slide.start()

    def _on_slide(self, value: object) -> None:
        if isinstance(value, float | int):
            self._position = float(value)
        self.update()

    def focusInEvent(self, event: QFocusEvent) -> None:
        self._keyboard_focus = event.reason() in KEYBOARD_REASONS
        super().focusInEvent(event)

    def paintEvent(self, event: QPaintEvent) -> None:
        palette = self.kit.palette
        px = self.kit.px
        painter = QPainter(self)
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing)
        track = QRectF(
            (self.width() - px(_TRACK_W)) / 2,
            (self.height() - px(_TRACK_H)) / 2,
            px(_TRACK_W),
            px(_TRACK_H),
        )
        off, on = QColor(palette.border_strong), QColor(palette.accent)
        mix = self._position
        fill = QColor(
            round(off.red() + (on.red() - off.red()) * mix),
            round(off.green() + (on.green() - off.green()) * mix),
            round(off.blue() + (on.blue() - off.blue()) * mix),
        )
        if not self.isEnabled():
            fill = QColor(palette.surface_active)
        painter.setPen(Qt.PenStyle.NoPen)
        painter.setBrush(fill)
        painter.drawRoundedRect(track, track.height() / 2, track.height() / 2)
        knob = track.height() - 2 * px(_KNOB_GAP) + 2
        left = track.left() + px(_KNOB_GAP) - 1
        travel = track.width() - knob - 2 * (px(_KNOB_GAP) - 1)
        painter.setBrush(QColor(palette.fg_faint if not self.isEnabled() else "#ffffff"))
        painter.drawEllipse(
            QPointF(left + travel * mix + knob / 2, track.center().y()), knob / 2, knob / 2
        )
        if self.hasFocus() and self._keyboard_focus:
            ring = QPen(QColor(palette.border_focus), max(px(2), 2))
            painter.setPen(ring)
            painter.setBrush(Qt.BrushStyle.NoBrush)
            outer = track.adjusted(-px(2), -px(2), px(2), px(2))
            painter.drawRoundedRect(outer, outer.height() / 2, outer.height() / 2)
        event.accept()


class SwitchRow(QWidget):
    """Label and hint on the left, the switch on the right; clicking the text toggles too."""

    toggled = Signal(bool)

    def __init__(
        self,
        kit: UiKit,
        label: str,
        hint: str = "",
        *,
        checked: bool = False,
        parent: QWidget | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.kit = kit
        self.switch = Switch(kit, checked=checked)
        self._label = QLabel(label)
        self._hint = QLabel(hint)
        set_role(self._hint, "muted")
        self._hint.setWordWrap(True)
        self._hint.setVisible(bool(hint))
        self._texts = QVBoxLayout()
        self._texts.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        self._texts.addWidget(self._label)
        self._texts.addWidget(self._hint)
        self._row = QHBoxLayout(self)
        self._row.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        self._row.addLayout(self._texts, 1)
        self._row.addWidget(self.switch, 0, Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignTop)
        self.switch.setAccessibleName(label)
        self.switch.toggled.connect(self.toggled)
        bind_kit(kit, zoom=self._restyle)
        self._restyle()

    def is_checked(self) -> bool:
        return self.switch.isChecked()

    def set_checked(self, checked: bool) -> None:
        self.switch.setChecked(checked)

    def set_texts(self, label: str, hint: str = "") -> None:
        self._label.setText(label)
        self._hint.setText(hint)
        self._hint.setVisible(bool(hint))
        self.switch.setAccessibleName(label)

    def mouseReleaseEvent(self, event: QMouseEvent) -> None:
        if event.button() == Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton and self.switch.isEnabled():
            self.switch.toggle()
        super().mouseReleaseEvent(event)

    def _restyle(self) -> None:
        self._texts.setSpacing(self.kit.px(SPACE[1]))
        self._row.setSpacing(self.kit.px(SPACE[6]))

"""House settings for a `QTableView`: left-aligned header, token row height, no grid or numbers."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QAbstractItemView, QHeaderView, QTableView

from chatimport.gui.widgets.base import bind_kit

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from chatimport.gui.kit import UiKit

ROW_HEIGHT = 36
HEADER_HEIGHT = 32


def configure_table(view: QTableView, kit: UiKit) -> None:
    """Apply the table look; row and header heights follow the zoom."""
    view.setShowGrid(False)
    view.setAlternatingRowColors(False)
    view.setSelectionBehavior(QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
    view.setSelectionMode(QAbstractItemView.SelectionMode.SingleSelection)
    view.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers)
    view.setVerticalScrollMode(QAbstractItemView.ScrollMode.ScrollPerPixel)
    view.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
    header = view.horizontalHeader()
    header.setDefaultAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter)
    header.setHighlightSections(False)
    header.setSectionResizeMode(QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Interactive)
    header.setStretchLastSection(True)

    def apply() -> None:
        view.verticalHeader().setDefaultSectionSize(kit.px(ROW_HEIGHT))
        header.setFixedHeight(kit.px(HEADER_HEIGHT))

    bind_kit(kit, zoom=apply)
    apply()

from chatimport.gui.stylesheet import tone_colors
from chatimport.gui.tokens import DURATION, LAYOUT, SPACE

        self._message.setObjectName("ToastMessage")
        self._message.setWordWrap(True)
        self._message.setTextInteractionFlags(Qt.TextInteractionFlag.TextSelectableByMouse)
        self._close = IconButton(self.kit, "x", tr("toast.dismiss"), size="sm")
        self._close.clicked.connect(self.dismiss)
        self._text = QVBoxLayout()
        self._text.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        self._text.addWidget(self._title)
        self._text.addWidget(self._message)
        self._row = QHBoxLayout(self)
        self._row.addWidget(self._icon, 0, Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignTop)
        self._row.addLayout(self._text, 1)
        self._row.addWidget(self._close, 0, Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignTop)
        self._effect = QGraphicsOpacityEffect(self)
        self._effect.setOpacity(0.0)
        self.setGraphicsEffect(self._effect)
        self._fade = QVariantAnimation(self)
        self._fade.setDuration(DURATION["base"])
        self._fade.valueChanged.connect(self._on_fade)
        self._timer = QTimer(self)
        self._timer.setSingleShot(True)
        self._timer.setInterval(timeout_ms)
        self._timer.timeout.connect(self.dismiss)
        self._leaving = False
        self.setAccessibleName(f"{title} {message}".strip())
        bind_kit(self.kit, theme=self._restyle, zoom=self._restyle)
        self._restyle()
        self._fade_to(1.0)
        self._timer.start()

    def _restyle(self) -> None:
        px = self.kit.px
        self.setFixedWidth(px(LAYOUT["toast_width"]))
        self._row.setContentsMargins(px(SPACE[5]), px(SPACE[5]), px(SPACE[4]), px(SPACE[5]))
        self._row.setSpacing(px(SPACE[4]))
        self._text.setSpacing(px(SPACE[1]))
        color = tone_colors(self.kit.palette, self._tone)[2]
        if self._tone in ("neutral", "muted"):
            color = self.kit.palette.accent
        self._icon.setPixmap(icon_pixmap(TONE_ICONS[self._tone], color, px(LAYOUT["icon_lg"])))

    def _fade_to(self, target: float) -> None:
        self._fade.stop()
        self._fade.setStartValue(self._effect.opacity())
        self._fade.setEndValue(target)
        self._fade.start()

    def _on_fade(self, value: object) -> None:
        opacity = float(value) if isinstance(value, float | int) else 1.0
        self._effect.setOpacity(opacity)
        if self._leaving and opacity <= 0.0:
            self._host.remove(self)

    def dismiss(self) -> None:
        if self._leaving:
            return
        self._leaving = True
        self._timer.stop()
        self._fade_to(0.0)

    def enterEvent(self, event: QEnterEvent) -> None:
        self._timer.stop()
        super().enterEvent(event)

    def leaveEvent(self, event: QEvent) -> None:
        if not self._leaving:
            self._timer.start()
        super().leaveEvent(event)


class _ResizeWatcher(QObject):
    def __init__(self, host: ToastHost) -> None:
        super().__init__(host)
        self._host = host

    def eventFilter(self, watched: QObject, event: QEvent) -> bool:
        if event.type() in (QEvent.Type.Resize, QEvent.Type.Show):
            self._host.follow_window()
        return False


class ToastHost(QWidget):
    def __init__(self, kit: UiKit, window: QWidget) -> None:
        super().__init__(window)
        self.kit = kit
        self._window = window
        self.setAttribute(Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents)
        self._column = QVBoxLayout(self)
        self._column.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignBottom | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight)
        self._toasts: list[Toast] = []
        window.installEventFilter(_ResizeWatcher(self))
        bind_kit(kit, zoom=self._restyle)
        self._restyle()
        self.follow_window()
        self.show()

    def _restyle(self) -> None:
        px = self.kit.px
        gap = px(SPACE[6])
        self._column.setContentsMargins(gap, gap, gap, px(LAYOUT["statusbar"]) + gap)
        self._column.setSpacing(px(SPACE[4]))

    def follow_window(self) -> None:
        self.setGeometry(self._window.rect())
        self.raise_()

    def push(
        self, tone: Tone, message: str, *, title: str = "", timeout_ms: int | None = None
    ) -> Toast:
        limit = timeout_ms if timeout_ms is not None else TIMEOUT_MS.get(tone, DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS)
        toast = Toast(self, tone, message, title, limit)
        while len(self._toasts) >= MAX_VISIBLE:
            self.remove(self._toasts[0])
        self._toasts.append(toast)
        self._column.addWidget(toast, 0, Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight)
        toast.show()
        self.raise_()
        return toast

    def push_key(self, tone: Tone, key: str, **params: object) -> Toast:
        """Translate `key` now (in the current language) and show it."""
        return self.push(tone, tr(key, **params))

    def remove(self, toast: Toast) -> None:
        if toast in self._toasts:
            self._toasts.remove(toast)
            self._column.removeWidget(toast)
            toast.hide()
            toast.deleteLater()

    def clear(self) -> None:
        for toast in list(self._toasts):
            self.remove(toast)

    @property
    def count(self) -> int:
        return len(self._toasts)

class ThemeSwitcher(Segmented):
    """Three icon segments (light, dark, follow the system) wired to the theme manager."""

    def __init__(self, kit: UiKit, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(
            kit, self._build_options(), kit.theme.preference, compact=True, parent=parent
        )
        self.setAccessibleName(tr("theme.label"))
        self.selected.connect(self._choose)
        kit.theme.changed.connect(self._sync)
        kit.language.changed.connect(self._retranslate)

    @staticmethod
    def _build_options() -> list[SegmentOption]:
        return [
            SegmentOption(
                value=name,
                label="",
                icon=_THEME_ICONS[name],
                tooltip=tr("theme.tip", mode=tr(f"theme.{name}")),
            )
            for name in THEME_PREFERENCES
        ]

    def _choose(self, value: str) -> None:
        preference: ThemePreference = "light" if value == "light" else "dark"
        self.kit.theme.set_preference("system" if value == "system" else preference)

    def _sync(self) -> None:
        self.set_value(self.kit.theme.preference)

    def _retranslate(self) -> None:
        self.set_options(self._build_options(), self.kit.theme.preference)
        self.setAccessibleName(tr("theme.label"))


class LanguageSwitcher(Segmented):
