"""The one parser of library refs (`@name`, `t.me` links, invites, ids, exact titles).

Pure and Telethon-free: the library, the offline selector and the Telegram resolver all read a
ref through `parse_ref`, so they agree on which refs name the same chat.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import re
import unicodedata
from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import StrEnum
from typing import Final

CHANNEL_ID_BASE: Final = 10**12
INVITE_VISIBLE_CHARS: Final = 3

_URL: Final = re.compile(r"^(?:https?://)?(?:www\.)?(?:t|telegram)\.me/(.+)$", re.IGNORECASE)
_USERNAME: Final = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{2,31}$")
_NUMBER: Final = re.compile(r"^-?\d+$")


class RefKind(StrEnum):
    PUBLIC = "public"
    INVITE = "invite"
    NUMERIC = "numeric"
    TITLE = "title"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ParsedRef:
    kind: RefKind
    value: str
    number: int | None = None

    @property
    def identity(self) -> str:
        """Equal for refs that name the same chat: usernames ignore case, ids are numbers,
        titles are compared in NFC so composed and decomposed accents agree."""
        match self.kind:
            case RefKind.PUBLIC:
                return "@" + self.value.casefold()
            case RefKind.INVITE:
                return "invite:" + self.value
            case RefKind.NUMERIC:
                return str(self.number)
            case _:
                return unicodedata.normalize("NFC", self.value)

    @property
    def username(self) -> str | None:
        """The case-folded username of a public ref, else None."""
        return self.value.casefold() if self.kind is RefKind.PUBLIC else None


def parse_ref(ref: str) -> ParsedRef:
    text = ref.strip()
    url = _URL.match(text)
    if url:
        return _parse_path(url.group(1), text)
    if text.startswith("@") and _USERNAME.match(text[1:]):
        return ParsedRef(RefKind.PUBLIC, text[1:])
    if _NUMBER.match(text):
        return ParsedRef(RefKind.NUMERIC, text, int(text))
    return ParsedRef(RefKind.TITLE, text)


def _parse_path(path: str, original: str) -> ParsedRef:
    segments = path.split("?", 1)[0].split("#", 1)[0].strip("/").split("/")
    first = segments[0]
    if first.startswith("+") and len(first) > 1:
        return ParsedRef(RefKind.INVITE, first[1:])
    if first.lower() == "joinchat":
        if len(segments) > 1 and segments[1]:
            return ParsedRef(RefKind.INVITE, segments[1])
        return ParsedRef(RefKind.TITLE, original)
    if first == "c" and len(segments) > 1 and segments[1].isdigit():
        return ParsedRef(RefKind.NUMERIC, segments[1], -(CHANNEL_ID_BASE + int(segments[1])))
    if _USERNAME.match(first):
        return ParsedRef(RefKind.PUBLIC, first)
    return ParsedRef(RefKind.TITLE, original)


def display_ref(ref: str, *, digest: bool = False) -> str:
    """The ref as it may be shown or stored outside `chats.toml`: an invite link is a secret
    join token, so only its first characters are kept; `digest` adds a short hash that tells
    two invites apart without revealing either."""
    parsed = parse_ref(ref)
    if parsed.kind is not RefKind.INVITE:
        return ref.strip()
    shown = f"t.me/+{parsed.value[:INVITE_VISIBLE_CHARS]}..."
    if digest:
        shown += "#" + hashlib.sha256(parsed.value.encode()).hexdigest()[:6]
    return shown

"""Library entries to chats: resolving them, and the book of which entries are running,
which wait for a retry, and which errors the status file shows."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Final, NamedTuple, Protocol

from chatimport import refs
from chatimport.ports import ChatImportError, ResolvedChat, ResolveStatus, SessionRevoked
from chatimport.runtime import TrackedChat
from chatimport.storage.layout import chat_folder_name
from chatimport.textnorm import fold

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Iterable

    from chatimport.library import ChatEntry, Library
    from chatimport.ports import TelegramGateway

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

RETRYABLE: Final = (ResolveStatus.NEED_TO_JOIN, ResolveStatus.NOT_FOUND)
LIBRARY_ERROR: Final = "library"


class ResolvedEntry(NamedTuple):
    entry: ChatEntry
    resolved: ResolvedChat

    @property
    def found(self) -> bool:
        return self.resolved.status is ResolveStatus.FOUND and self.resolved.chat_id is not None


async def resolve_entries(
    gateway: TelegramGateway, entries: Iterable[ChatEntry]
) -> list[ResolvedEntry]:
    results: list[ResolvedEntry] = []
    for entry in entries:
        try:
            resolved = await gateway.resolve(entry.key)
        except SessionRevoked:
            raise
        except ChatImportError as error:
            resolved = ResolvedChat(entry.key, ResolveStatus.NOT_FOUND, detail=type(error).__name__)
        results.append(ResolvedEntry(entry, resolved))
    return results


async def resolve_library(gateway: TelegramGateway, library: Library) -> list[ResolvedEntry]:
    return await resolve_entries(gateway, library.enabled_entries())


async def select_for_once(
    gateway: TelegramGateway, library: Library, chat: str
) -> list[ResolvedEntry]:
    """The entries `run --once --chat X` syncs: by ref or name, else by chat id or username."""
    entry = library.find(chat)
    if entry is not None:
        return await resolve_entries(gateway, [entry])
    needle = fold(chat)
    username = needle.removeprefix("@")
    matched = [
        item
        for item in await resolve_library(gateway, library)
        if str(item.resolved.chat_id) == needle
        or (item.resolved.username is not None and fold(item.resolved.username) == username)
        or (item.resolved.title is not None and fold(item.resolved.title) == needle)
    ]
    if not matched:
        raise ChatImportError(f"no library chat matches {chat.strip()!r}")
    return matched


def tracked_chat(entry: ChatEntry, resolved: ResolvedChat) -> TrackedChat:
    if resolved.chat_id is None:
        raise ChatImportError("the library entry is not resolved to a chat")
    title = resolved.title or entry.name or str(resolved.chat_id)
    return TrackedChat(
        chat_id=resolved.chat_id,
        title=title,
        username=resolved.username,
        folder_name=chat_folder_name(entry.name or title, resolved.chat_id),
    )


def display_ref(ref: str) -> str:
    """The ref as status files and toasts may show it: an invite link is a secret join token,
    so only its first characters and a short digest (to tell two invites apart) remain."""
    return refs.display_ref(ref, digest=True)


def resolve_error_key(entry: ChatEntry) -> str:
    return f"resolve:{display_ref(entry.key)}"


class ErrorSink(Protocol):
    def add_error(self, key: str, text: str) -> None: ...

    def clear_error(self, key: str) -> None: ...


class ErrorBook:
    """Service-level errors (library, resolving) that outlive a runtime restart; the attached
    sink (the status writer of the current runtime) always mirrors them."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._errors: dict[str, str] = {}
        self._sink: ErrorSink | None = None

    def attach(self, sink: ErrorSink | None) -> None:
        self._sink = sink
        if sink is not None:
            for key, text in self._errors.items():
                sink.add_error(key, text)

    def set(self, key: str, text: str) -> None:
        self._errors[key] = text
        if self._sink is not None:
            self._sink.add_error(key, text)

    def clear(self, key: str) -> None:
        self._errors.pop(key, None)
        if self._sink is not None:
            self._sink.clear_error(key)

    def items(self) -> dict[str, str]:
        return dict(self._errors)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Absorbed:
    found: list[ResolvedEntry]
    failed: int
    total: int


class ActiveChats:
    """Which library entries run (keyed by `entry.key`) and which wait to be resolved again.
    Two entries may name one chat; it stops only when the last of them goes."""

    def __init__(self, errors: ErrorBook) -> None:
        self.errors = errors
        self._active: dict[str, ResolvedEntry] = {}
        self._unresolved: dict[str, ChatEntry] = {}

    def __len__(self) -> int:
        return len(self._active)

    def entries(self) -> list[ResolvedEntry]:
        return list(self._active.values())

    @property
    def has_unresolved(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self._unresolved)

    def absorb(self, results: Iterable[ResolvedEntry]) -> Absorbed:
        found: list[ResolvedEntry] = []
        failed = total = 0
        for item in results:
            total += 1
            entry, resolved = item
            key = resolve_error_key(entry)
            if item.found:
                self.errors.clear(key)
                self._unresolved.pop(entry.key, None)
                self._active[entry.key] = item
                found.append(item)
                continue
            failed += 1
            detail = f" ({resolved.detail})" if resolved.detail else ""
            self.errors.set(key, f"{display_ref(entry.key)}: {resolved.status.value}{detail}")
            if resolved.status in RETRYABLE:
                self._unresolved[entry.key] = entry
            log.warning("library entry unresolved: %s", resolved.status.value)
        return Absorbed(found, failed, total)

    def release(self, entry: ChatEntry) -> int | None:
        """Forget the entry; the chat id to stop, unless another entry still uses that chat."""
        self._unresolved.pop(entry.key, None)
        self.errors.clear(resolve_error_key(entry))
        item = self._active.pop(entry.key, None)
        if item is None or item.resolved.chat_id is None:
            return None
        chat_id = item.resolved.chat_id
        if any(other.resolved.chat_id == chat_id for other in self._active.values()):
            return None
        return chat_id

    def retry_candidates(self, library: Library) -> list[ChatEntry]:
        """Unresolved entries still enabled in `library`; the waiting list starts over."""
        entries = [
            entry
            for entry in self._unresolved.values()
            if (current := library.find(entry.key)) is not None and current.enabled
        ]
        self._unresolved.clear()
        return entries

"""Routes Telegram events to chat workers by `chat_id`; the rest is dropped.

Deletions in basic groups and private dialogs arrive without a chat id. Their ids (nothing
else) go to `_unrouted_deletes.jsonl`, which is capped: past `UNROUTED_MAX_BYTES` only the
newest `UNROUTED_KEEP_BYTES` are kept. The file is written in a worker thread, so its fsync
never stalls the event loop.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import logging
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Final

from chatimport.ports import DeletedMessagesEvent
from chatimport.records import (
    DETECTED_EVENT,
    KIND_DELETE,
    SCHEMA_VERSION,
    format_dt,
    json_line_bytes,
)
from chatimport.storage.fileio import append_line, atomic_write_bytes

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pathlib import Path

    from chatimport.ports import ChatEvent, Clock
    from chatimport.runtime import ChatRegistry

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

UNROUTED_DELETES_FILE: Final = "_unrouted_deletes.jsonl"
UNROUTED_MAX_BYTES: Final = 2 * 1024 * 1024
UNROUTED_KEEP_BYTES: Final = 1024 * 1024


def cap_jsonl(path: Path, max_bytes: int, keep_bytes: int) -> bool:
    """Once `path` is larger than `max_bytes`, keep only its newest whole lines that fit in
    `keep_bytes` (`keep_bytes` < `max_bytes`); True when the file was shortened."""
    if path.stat().st_size <= max_bytes:
        return False
    data = path.read_bytes()
    first_line = data.find(b"\n", len(data) - keep_bytes - 1) + 1
    atomic_write_bytes(path, data[first_line:])
    return True


class Router:
    def __init__(self, registry: ChatRegistry, root: Path, *, clock: Clock) -> None:
        self._registry = registry
        self._root = root
        self._clock = clock

    async def handle(self, event: ChatEvent) -> None:
        try:
            if isinstance(event, DeletedMessagesEvent):
                if event.chat_id is None:
                    await asyncio.to_thread(self._append_unrouted, event.msg_ids)
                    return
                chat_id = event.chat_id
            else:
                chat_id = event.record.chat_id
            controller = self._registry.get(chat_id)
            if controller is not None:
                controller.submit(event)
        except Exception:
            log.exception("router failed on %s", type(event).__name__)

    def _append_unrouted(self, msg_ids: tuple[int, ...]) -> None:
        line = {
            "v": SCHEMA_VERSION,
            "kind": KIND_DELETE,
            "chat_id": None,
            "msg_ids": list(msg_ids),
            "detected_by": DETECTED_EVENT,
            "fetched_at": format_dt(self._clock.now()),
        }
        path = self._root / UNROUTED_DELETES_FILE
        append_line(path, json_line_bytes(line))
        if cap_jsonl(path, UNROUTED_MAX_BYTES, UNROUTED_KEEP_BYTES):
            log.info("unrouted deletes file capped", extra={"bytes": UNROUTED_KEEP_BYTES})
        log.info("unrouted delete stored: %d ids", len(msg_ids))

class BackfillSlots:
    """At most `limit` chats download history at once; waiting chats get a slot in arrival
    order. A chat that already holds a slot may enter again without waiting."""

    def __init__(self, limit: int) -> None:
        if limit < 1:
            raise ValueError(f"limit must be at least 1, got {limit}")
        self._limit = limit
        self._depth: dict[int, int] = {}
        self._waiters: deque[tuple[int, asyncio.Future[None]]] = deque()

    @property
    def limit(self) -> int:
        return self._limit

    @property
    def holders(self) -> tuple[int, ...]:
        return tuple(self._depth)

    @property
    def waiting(self) -> tuple[int, ...]:
        return tuple(chat_id for chat_id, future in self._waiters if not future.done())

    @contextlib.asynccontextmanager
    async def acquire(self, chat_id: int) -> AsyncGenerator[None]:
        await self._enter(chat_id)
        try:
            yield
        finally:
            self._leave(chat_id)

    async def _enter(self, chat_id: int) -> None:
        if chat_id in self._depth:
            self._depth[chat_id] += 1
            return
        if len(self._depth) < self._limit and not self.waiting:
            self._depth[chat_id] = 1
            return
        future: asyncio.Future[None] = asyncio.get_running_loop().create_future()
        self._waiters.append((chat_id, future))
        try:
            await future
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            if future.done() and not future.cancelled():
                self._leave(chat_id)
            raise

    def _leave(self, chat_id: int) -> None:
        depth = self._depth[chat_id] - 1
        if depth:
            self._depth[chat_id] = depth
            return
        del self._depth[chat_id]
        while self._waiters and len(self._depth) < self._limit:
            waiter, future = self._waiters.popleft()
            if future.done():
                continue
            self._depth[waiter] = self._depth.get(waiter, 0) + 1
            future.set_result(None)

"""The SQLite file behind search: schema, connections and recovery.

Design (why this shape):

- `messages` is an ordinary table holding the original text next to its folded key
  (`search_fold.search_key`). `fts` is an FTS5 *external-content* table over `messages.folded`
  with the `trigram` tokenizer, so it stores only the index, never a second copy of the text,
  and a hit is a case-, accent- and yo-insensitive substring match in any language. The
  folded column also serves the bounded scan for queries too short for trigrams.
- Triggers keep `fts` in step with `messages`; the writer never touches `fts` directly.
- The file is a derived cache of the JSONL parts (like `state.json`): any version mismatch or
  corruption throws it away and it is rebuilt, never repaired.
- WAL mode: the service writes while the CLI and the window read through `mode=ro`
  connections of their own.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import contextlib
import sqlite3
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Final

from chatimport.ports import ChatImportError
from chatimport.storage.fileio import unlink_file

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pathlib import Path

SEARCH_DB: Final = "_search.db"
SCHEMA_VERSION: Final = 1
MIN_SQLITE: Final = (3, 34, 0)
BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS: Final = 5000

SCHEMA: Final = """
CREATE TABLE meta (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL) WITHOUT ROWID;
CREATE TABLE chats (
    chat_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    username TEXT,
    folder TEXT NOT NULL,
    gen INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    reconciling INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    messages INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
);
CREATE TABLE marks (
    chat_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    part TEXT NOT NULL,
    offset INTEGER NOT NULL,
    size INTEGER NOT NULL,
    mtime_ns INTEGER NOT NULL,
    head_crc INTEGER NOT NULL,
    tail_crc INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (chat_id, part)
) WITHOUT ROWID;
CREATE TABLE messages (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    chat_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    msg_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    date INTEGER NOT NULL,
    text TEXT NOT NULL,
    folded TEXT NOT NULL,
    ver INTEGER NOT NULL,
    edited INTEGER NOT NULL,
    gen INTEGER NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (chat_id, msg_id)
);
CREATE INDEX messages_newest ON messages (date DESC, msg_id DESC);
CREATE TABLE pending (
    chat_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    msg_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    ver INTEGER NOT NULL,
    text TEXT NOT NULL,
    gen INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (chat_id, msg_id)
) WITHOUT ROWID;
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE fts USING fts5(
    folded, content='messages', content_rowid='id', tokenize='trigram'
);
CREATE TRIGGER messages_after_insert AFTER INSERT ON messages BEGIN
    INSERT INTO fts (rowid, folded) VALUES (new.id, new.folded);
END;
CREATE TRIGGER messages_after_delete AFTER DELETE ON messages BEGIN
    INSERT INTO fts (fts, rowid, folded) VALUES ('delete', old.id, old.folded);
END;
CREATE TRIGGER messages_after_update AFTER UPDATE OF folded ON messages BEGIN
    INSERT INTO fts (fts, rowid, folded) VALUES ('delete', old.id, old.folded);
    INSERT INTO fts (rowid, folded) VALUES (new.id, new.folded);
END;
"""


class SearchError(ChatImportError):
    """The search index cannot be used right now; the message never carries a query."""


def fts5_trigram_available() -> bool:
    """True when this SQLite is new enough and was built with FTS5 and the trigram tokenizer."""
    if sqlite3.sqlite_version_info < MIN_SQLITE:
        return False
    probe = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    try:
        probe.execute("CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE probe USING fts5(x, tokenize='trigram')")
    except sqlite3.Error:
        return False
    finally:
        probe.close()
    return True


def database_path(root: Path) -> Path:
    return root / SEARCH_DB


def _quote(name: str) -> str:
    return '"' + name.replace('"', '""') + '"'


def _drop_everything(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
    rows = conn.execute(
        "SELECT type, name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%'"
    ).fetchall()
    for kind, name, _sql in rows:
        if kind == "trigger":
            conn.execute(f"DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS {_quote(name)}")
    for kind, name, sql in rows:
        if kind == "table" and sql.upper().startswith("CREATE VIRTUAL"):
            conn.execute(f"DROP TABLE IF EXISTS {_quote(name)}")
    for kind, name, _sql in rows:
        if kind == "table":
            conn.execute(f"DROP TABLE IF EXISTS {_quote(name)}")
        elif kind == "index":
            conn.execute(f"DROP INDEX IF EXISTS {_quote(name)}")


def _create_schema(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
    conn.executescript(SCHEMA)
    conn.execute(f"PRAGMA user_version = {SCHEMA_VERSION}")


def _open_checked(path: Path) -> sqlite3.Connection:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(path, isolation_level=None, check_same_thread=False)
    try:
        conn.execute(f"PRAGMA busy_timeout = {BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS}")
        conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL")
        conn.execute("PRAGMA synchronous = NORMAL")
        version = conn.execute("PRAGMA user_version").fetchone()[0]
        if version != SCHEMA_VERSION:
            _drop_everything(conn)
            _create_schema(conn)
        conn.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM chats").fetchone()
    except BaseException:
        conn.close()
        raise
    return conn


def delete_database(path: Path) -> None:
    """Remove the file and its WAL side files; raises `SearchError` when one cannot go."""
    for target in (path, path.with_name(path.name + "-wal"), path.with_name(path.name + "-shm")):
        try:
            unlink_file(target, missing_ok=True)
        except OSError as error:
            raise SearchError(f"cannot remove {target.name}: {error.strerror}") from error


def connect_writer(path: Path) -> sqlite3.Connection:
    """Open (or create) the index for writing. A file of another version is rebuilt in place;
    a file SQLite cannot read at all is deleted and created again."""
    try:
        return _open_checked(path)
    except sqlite3.DatabaseError as error:
        if isinstance(error, sqlite3.OperationalError) and "locked" in str(error):
            raise SearchError("the search index is busy") from error
    delete_database(path)
    try:
        return _open_checked(path)
    except sqlite3.Error as error:
        raise SearchError("cannot create the search index") from error


def connect_reader(path: Path) -> sqlite3.Connection | None:
    """A read-only connection, or None when the file is missing, of another version or
    unreadable. Several readers may be open next to the one writer."""
    if not path.is_file():
        return None
    conn: sqlite3.Connection | None = None
    try:
        conn = sqlite3.connect(
            f"{path.resolve().as_uri()}?mode=ro", uri=True, check_same_thread=False
        )
        conn.execute(f"PRAGMA busy_timeout = {BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS}")
        if conn.execute("PRAGMA user_version").fetchone()[0] != SCHEMA_VERSION:
            conn.close()
            return None
        conn.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM chats").fetchone()
    except sqlite3.Error:
        if conn is not None:
            with contextlib.suppress(sqlite3.Error):
                conn.close()
        return None
    return conn

"""Matching keys for search: the one function that turns text and queries into comparable form."""

from __future__ import annotations

import unicodedata
from typing import Final

from chatimport.textnorm import fold

_CYRILLIC_FIRST: Final = 0x0400
_CYRILLIC_LAST: Final = 0x052F
_YO: Final = {0x451: chr(0x435)}


def _is_cyrillic(char: str) -> bool:
    return bool(char) and _CYRILLIC_FIRST <= ord(char) <= _CYRILLIC_LAST


def clean_text(text: str) -> str:
    """Text SQLite can store: NUL is dropped and lone surrogates become a question mark."""
    return text.replace("\x00", "").encode("utf-8", "replace").decode("utf-8")


def search_key(text: str) -> str:
    """Case-folded, accent-free, yo-as-ye key with collapsed spaces.

    Combining marks are dropped from Latin and other scripts, so `cafe` finds an accented e;
    after a Cyrillic letter they are kept, so the short i with a breve stays distinct from
    plain i. Both the stored text and the typed query go through this one function.
    """
    folded = fold(clean_text(text)).translate(_YO)
    kept: list[str] = []
    base = ""
    for char in unicodedata.normalize("NFD", folded):
        if unicodedata.category(char) == "Mn":
            if _is_cyrillic(base):
                kept.append(char)
            continue
        base = char
        kept.append(char)
    return fold("".join(kept))

"""The writing side of the search index (the service is the one writer).

A batch is applied in one transaction together with the watermarks of the parts it came from,
so a crash leaves either both or neither, and every operation is idempotent by
`(chat_id, msg_id)`. Edit and delete records may be seen before their message (a month
backfilled later), so they wait in `pending` until the message arrives; a delete is final.

A *reconcile* (a part was rewritten) re-reads a whole chat without a gap in the results: the
chat's generation is bumped, rows are re-stamped as the scan meets them, and only rows of the
older generation are swept when the scan finishes.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import contextlib
import logging
import sqlite3
import threading
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from chatimport.records import DeleteRecord, EditRecord, MessageRecord, format_dt
from chatimport.search_db import (
    SearchError,
    connect_writer,
    database_path,
    delete_database,
    fts5_trigram_available,
)
from chatimport.search_fold import clean_text, search_key
from chatimport.search_reader import SearchReader, open_reader

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Generator, Iterable, Sequence
    from datetime import datetime
    from pathlib import Path

    from chatimport.records import Record
    from chatimport.search_types import IndexState

__all__ = [
    "ChatRow",
    "PartMark",
    "SearchIndex",
    "SearchReader",

    "open_reader",

    "reset_index",
]

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class PartMark:
    """How far one part has been indexed: `offset` bytes (whole lines only), the size and
    mtime seen before reading, and checksums of the first and last bytes before `offset`."""

    part: str
    offset: int
    size: int
    mtime_ns: int
    head_crc: int
    tail_crc: int


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ChatRow:
    chat_id: int
    title: str
    username: str | None
    folder: str
    gen: int
    reconciling: bool
    messages: int


def _epoch(value: datetime) -> int:
    return int(value.timestamp())


class SearchIndex:
    def __init__(self, conn: sqlite3.Connection, path: Path) -> None:
        self._conn = conn
        self._path = path
        self._lock = threading.RLock()

    def close(self) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._conn.close()

    @contextlib.contextmanager
    def _transaction(self) -> Generator[sqlite3.Connection]:
        with self._lock:
            self._conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
            try:
                yield self._conn
                self._conn.execute("COMMIT")
            except BaseException:
                with contextlib.suppress(sqlite3.Error):
                    self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
                raise

    def _gen(self, chat_id: int) -> int:
        row = self._conn.execute("SELECT gen FROM chats WHERE chat_id = ?", (chat_id,)).fetchone()
        return int(row[0]) if row is not None else 0

    def chat_rows(self) -> dict[int, ChatRow]:
        with self._lock:
            rows = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT chat_id, title, username, folder, gen, reconciling, messages FROM chats"
            ).fetchall()
        return {r[0]: ChatRow(r[0], r[1], r[2], r[3], r[4], bool(r[5]), r[6]) for r in rows}

    def marks(self, chat_id: int) -> dict[str, PartMark]:
        with self._lock:
            rows = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT part, offset, size, mtime_ns, head_crc, tail_crc FROM marks "
                "WHERE chat_id = ?",
                (chat_id,),
            ).fetchall()
        return {r[0]: PartMark(*r) for r in rows}

    def indexed_count(self) -> int:
        with self._lock:
            row = self._conn.execute("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(messages), 0) FROM chats").fetchone()
        return int(row[0])

    def upsert_chat(self, chat_id: int, title: str, username: str | None, folder: str) -> None:
        with self._transaction() as conn:
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO chats (chat_id, title, username, folder) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?) "
                "ON CONFLICT (chat_id) DO UPDATE SET title = excluded.title, "
                "username = excluded.username, folder = excluded.folder",
                (chat_id, clean_text(title), username, folder),
            )

    def set_status(self, state: IndexState, total: int, now: datetime) -> None:
        values = {"state": state.value, "total": str(total), "updated_at": format_dt(now)}
        with self._transaction() as conn:
            conn.executemany(
                "INSERT INTO meta (key, value) VALUES (?, ?) "
                "ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET value = excluded.value",
                values.items(),
            )

    def apply(self, chat_id: int, records: Iterable[Record], marks: Sequence[PartMark] = ()) -> int:
        """Apply records and watermarks in one transaction; returns the change in messages."""
        with self._transaction() as conn:
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO chats (chat_id, title, folder) VALUES (?, '', '')",
                (chat_id,),
            )
            gen = self._gen(chat_id)
            delta = 0
            for record in records:
                if isinstance(record, MessageRecord):
                    delta += _apply_message(conn, chat_id, gen, record)
                elif isinstance(record, EditRecord):
                    _apply_edit(conn, chat_id, gen, record)
                elif isinstance(record, DeleteRecord):
                    delta -= _apply_delete(conn, chat_id, gen, record)
            conn.executemany(
                "INSERT INTO marks (chat_id, part, offset, size, mtime_ns, head_crc, tail_crc) "
                "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT (chat_id, part) DO UPDATE SET "
                "offset = excluded.offset, size = excluded.size, mtime_ns = excluded.mtime_ns, "
                "head_crc = excluded.head_crc, tail_crc = excluded.tail_crc",
                [
                    (chat_id, m.part, m.offset, m.size, m.mtime_ns, m.head_crc, m.tail_crc)
                    for m in marks
                ],
            )
            _add_messages(conn, chat_id, delta)
        return delta

    def remove_below(self, chat_id: int, floor_id: int) -> int:
        """Forget messages with `msg_id < floor_id` (their parts were trimmed away)."""
        with self._transaction() as conn:
            removed = conn.execute(
                "DELETE FROM messages WHERE chat_id = ? AND msg_id < ?", (chat_id, floor_id)
            ).rowcount
            conn.execute(
                "DELETE FROM pending WHERE chat_id = ? AND msg_id < ?", (chat_id, floor_id)
            )
            _add_messages(conn, chat_id, -removed)
        return removed

    def forget_parts(self, chat_id: int, parts: Iterable[str]) -> None:
        with self._transaction() as conn:
            conn.executemany(
                "DELETE FROM marks WHERE chat_id = ? AND part = ?", [(chat_id, p) for p in parts]
            )

    def drop_chat(self, chat_id: int) -> None:
        with self._transaction() as conn:
            for table in ("messages", "pending", "marks", "chats"):
                conn.execute(f"DELETE FROM {table} WHERE chat_id = ?", (chat_id,))  # noqa: S608 - fixed names

    def begin_reconcile(self, chat_id: int) -> None:
        """Start a full re-read of the chat: the next generation, no watermarks."""
        with self._transaction() as conn:
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE chats SET gen = gen + 1, reconciling = 1 WHERE chat_id = ?", (chat_id,)
            )
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM marks WHERE chat_id = ?", (chat_id,))

    def finish_reconcile(self, chat_id: int) -> None:
        """Sweep everything the finished re-read did not meet again."""
        with self._transaction() as conn:
            gen = self._gen(chat_id)
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM messages WHERE chat_id = ? AND gen <> ?", (chat_id, gen))
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM pending WHERE chat_id = ? AND gen <> ?", (chat_id, gen))
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE chats SET reconciling = 0, messages = "
                "(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE chat_id = ?) WHERE chat_id = ?",
                (chat_id, chat_id),
            )


def _add_messages(conn: sqlite3.Connection, chat_id: int, delta: int) -> None:
    if delta:
        conn.execute("UPDATE chats SET messages = messages + ? WHERE chat_id = ?", (delta, chat_id))


def _tombstoned(conn: sqlite3.Connection, chat_id: int, gen: int, msg_id: int) -> bool:
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT 1 FROM pending WHERE chat_id = ? AND msg_id = ? AND kind = 'delete' AND gen = ?",
        (chat_id, msg_id, gen),
    ).fetchone()
    return row is not None


def _apply_message(conn: sqlite3.Connection, chat_id: int, gen: int, record: MessageRecord) -> int:
    if record.service is not None or _tombstoned(conn, chat_id, gen, record.msg_id):
        return 0
    text = clean_text(record.text)
    folded = search_key(text)
    ver = _epoch(record.edit_date) if record.edit_date is not None else 0
    edited = 1 if record.edit_date is not None else 0
    inserted = conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO messages (chat_id, msg_id, date, text, folded, ver, edited, gen) "
        "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT (chat_id, msg_id) DO NOTHING",
        (chat_id, record.msg_id, _epoch(record.date), text, folded, ver, edited, gen),
    ).rowcount
    if not inserted:
        conn.execute(
            "UPDATE messages SET text = ?, folded = ?, ver = ?, edited = ?, gen = ? "
            "WHERE chat_id = ? AND msg_id = ? AND (gen <> ? OR ver < ?)",
            (text, folded, ver, edited, gen, chat_id, record.msg_id, gen, ver),
        )
    _consume_pending_edit(conn, chat_id, gen, record.msg_id)
    return inserted


def _consume_pending_edit(conn: sqlite3.Connection, chat_id: int, gen: int, msg_id: int) -> None:
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT ver, text FROM pending "
        "WHERE chat_id = ? AND msg_id = ? AND kind = 'edit' AND gen = ?",
        (chat_id, msg_id, gen),
    ).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        return
    conn.execute(
        "UPDATE messages SET text = ?, folded = ?, ver = ?, edited = 1 "
        "WHERE chat_id = ? AND msg_id = ? AND ver <= ?",
        (row[1], search_key(row[1]), row[0], chat_id, msg_id, row[0]),
    )
    conn.execute("DELETE FROM pending WHERE chat_id = ? AND msg_id = ?", (chat_id, msg_id))


def _apply_edit(conn: sqlite3.Connection, chat_id: int, gen: int, record: EditRecord) -> None:
    text = clean_text(record.text)
    ver = _epoch(record.edit_date)
    changed = conn.execute(
        "UPDATE messages SET text = ?, folded = ?, ver = ?, edited = 1 "
        "WHERE chat_id = ? AND msg_id = ? AND gen = ? AND ver <= ?",
        (text, search_key(text), ver, chat_id, record.msg_id, gen, ver),
    ).rowcount
    if changed:
        return
    known = conn.execute(
        "SELECT 1 FROM messages WHERE chat_id = ? AND msg_id = ? AND gen = ?",
        (chat_id, record.msg_id, gen),
    ).fetchone()
    if known is not None or _tombstoned(conn, chat_id, gen, record.msg_id):
        return
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO pending (chat_id, msg_id, kind, ver, text, gen) "
        "VALUES (?, ?, 'edit', ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT (chat_id, msg_id) DO UPDATE SET "
        "ver = excluded.ver, text = excluded.text, gen = excluded.gen "
        "WHERE pending.kind = 'edit' "
        "AND (pending.gen <> excluded.gen OR pending.ver <= excluded.ver)",
        (chat_id, record.msg_id, ver, text, gen),
    )


def _apply_delete(conn: sqlite3.Connection, chat_id: int, gen: int, record: DeleteRecord) -> int:
    removed = 0
    for msg_id in record.msg_ids:
        removed += conn.execute(
            "DELETE FROM messages WHERE chat_id = ? AND msg_id = ?", (chat_id, msg_id)
        ).rowcount
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO pending (chat_id, msg_id, kind, ver, text, gen) "
            "VALUES (?, ?, 'delete', 0, '', ?) ON CONFLICT (chat_id, msg_id) DO UPDATE SET "
            "kind = 'delete', ver = 0, text = '', gen = excluded.gen",
            (chat_id, msg_id, gen),
        )
    return removed


def open_writer(root: Path) -> SearchIndex:
    """The index of `root`, created or rebuilt as needed; raises `SearchError` when it cannot
    be opened and FTS5 with the trigram tokenizer is missing."""
    if not fts5_trigram_available():
        raise SearchError("this SQLite has no FTS5 trigram tokenizer")
    path = database_path(root)
    return SearchIndex(connect_writer(path), path)


def reset_index(root: Path) -> None:
    """Delete the index file; the next `open_writer` builds it again from scratch."""
    delete_database(database_path(root))
    log.warning("search index deleted for a rebuild")

"""The incremental scanner that feeds the search index from the stored parts.

One *pass* lists every chat folder and compares each part's size and mtime with its watermark
(`PartMark`: bytes consumed, checksums of the first and last bytes before that point). A part
that only grew is read from its watermark; a part that is new is read from the start; a part
that is gone (a trim) drops the messages below the oldest retained one; a part whose consumed
prefix no longer matches (rewritten or cut) makes the whole chat *reconcile*. Work happens in
`step()` calls of at most `BATCH_RECORDS` records, one transaction each, chat by chat, so the
first searches work on the finished part of a long initial build.

A chat with a `.<month>.commit.json` journal is mid-rewrite and is left for a later pass.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import os
import zlib
from collections import deque
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Final

from chatimport.search_fold import clean_text
from chatimport.search_index import ChatRow, PartMark, SearchIndex
from chatimport.search_types import IndexState
from chatimport.storage.layout import iter_chat_folders, parse_part_name
from chatimport.storage.month_commit import JOURNAL_SUFFIX
from chatimport.storage.reader import decode_line, first_message
from chatimport.storage.state import ChatState, StateUnreadable, load_state

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Callable
    from datetime import datetime
    from pathlib import Path

    from chatimport.records import Record

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

BATCH_RECORDS: Final = 2000
BLOCK_BYTES: Final = 1024 * 1024
WINDOW: Final = 4096
EVERYTHING: Final = 2**63 - 1
UNFINISHED: Final = -1


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class StepResult:
    more: bool
    state: IndexState
    indexed: int
    total: int
    updated_at: datetime | None


def _crc(data: bytes) -> int:
    return zlib.crc32(data)


@dataclass(slots=True)
class PartCursor:
    """A read position in one part with the first and last bytes seen, for the fingerprint."""

    path: Path
    size: int
    mtime_ns: int
    offset: int = 0
    head: bytes = b""
    tail: bytes = b""

    @classmethod
    def resume(cls, path: Path, size: int, mtime_ns: int, mark: PartMark) -> PartCursor | None:
        """The cursor at `mark.offset`, or None when the part no longer starts and ends (at
        that point) with the bytes that were indexed."""
        if size < mark.offset:
            return None
        with path.open("rb") as handle:
            head = handle.read(min(mark.offset, WINDOW))
            handle.seek(max(0, mark.offset - WINDOW))
            tail = handle.read(min(mark.offset, WINDOW))
        if _crc(head) != mark.head_crc or _crc(tail) != mark.tail_crc:
            return None
        return cls(path, size, mtime_ns, mark.offset, head, tail)

    def read_lines(self, limit: int) -> list[bytes] | None:
        """The non-empty lines among the complete lines from the offset on (about `limit`
        bytes); None when no complete line is left (a line still being written stays unread)."""
        with self.path.open("rb") as handle:
            handle.seek(self.offset)
            data = handle.read(limit)
            end = data.rfind(b"\n") + 1
            if end == 0 and len(data) == limit:
                data += handle.read()
                end = data.rfind(b"\n") + 1
        if end == 0:
            return None
        chunk = data[:end]
        self.offset += end
        if len(self.head) < WINDOW:
            self.head = (self.head + chunk)[:WINDOW]
        self.tail = (self.tail + chunk)[-WINDOW:]
        return [line for line in chunk.split(b"\n") if line.strip()]

    def mark(self, *, complete: bool) -> PartMark:
        """The watermark; `size` is only recorded once the part was read to its last complete
        line, so a part left half read never looks up to date after a restart."""
        size = self.size if complete else UNFINISHED
        return PartMark(
            self.path.name, self.offset, size, self.mtime_ns, _crc(self.head), _crc(self.tail)
        )


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class _PartInfo:
    path: Path
    size: int
    mtime_ns: int


@dataclass(slots=True)
class _Item:
    chat_id: int
    todo: list[_PartInfo]
    all_parts: list[_PartInfo]
    reconcile: bool
    marks: dict[str, PartMark]
    cursor: PartCursor | None = None


def _listing(folder: Path) -> list[_PartInfo] | None:
    """The parts of a folder with size and mtime; None while a month rewrite is journalled."""
    parts: list[_PartInfo] = []
    with os.scandir(folder) as entries:
        for entry in entries:
            if entry.name.endswith(JOURNAL_SUFFIX):
                return None
            if parse_part_name(entry.name) is not None and entry.is_file():
                info = entry.stat()
                parts.append(_PartInfo(folder / entry.name, info.st_size, info.st_mtime_ns))
    return sorted(parts, key=lambda p: p.path.name)


class IndexBuilder:
    """Drives passes over the data root. Not thread-safe: one thread at a time."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        index: SearchIndex,
        root: Path,
        now: Callable[[], datetime],
        batch: int = BATCH_RECORDS,
    ) -> None:
        self._index = index
        self._root = root
        self._now = now
        self._batch = batch
        self._queue: deque[_Item] | None = None
        self._ready = False
        self._changed = False
        self._incomplete = False
        self._total = 0
        self._updated: datetime | None = None

    def step(self) -> StepResult:
        """One bounded unit of work; `more` says whether another call has work to do."""
        try:
            return self._step()
        except BaseException:
            self._queue = None
            self._incomplete = False
            raise

    def _step(self) -> StepResult:
        if self._queue is None:
            self._queue = self._plan_pass()
        if self._queue:
            if self._advance(self._queue[0]):
                self._queue.popleft()
            self._changed = True
            if not self._ready:
                self._status(IndexState.BUILDING)
            return self._result(more=True)
        self._queue = None
        incomplete, self._incomplete = self._incomplete, False
        if not incomplete and (self._changed or not self._ready):
            self._ready = True
            self._changed = False
            self._status(IndexState.READY)
        return self._result(more=False)

    def _figures(self) -> tuple[IndexState, int, int]:
        indexed = self._index.indexed_count()
        if self._ready:
            return IndexState.READY, indexed, indexed
        return IndexState.BUILDING, indexed, max(self._total, indexed)

    def _status(self, state: IndexState) -> None:
        _, _, total = self._figures()
        self._updated = self._now()
        self._index.set_status(state, total, self._updated)

    def _result(self, *, more: bool) -> StepResult:
        state, indexed, total = self._figures()
        return StepResult(more, state, indexed, total, self._updated)

    def _plan_pass(self) -> deque[_Item]:
        queue: deque[_Item] = deque()
        rows = self._index.chat_rows()
        seen: set[int] = set()
        total = 0
        if not self._root.is_dir():
            return queue
        try:
            for folder in iter_chat_folders(self._root):
                try:
                    state = load_state(folder)
                except StateUnreadable:
                    self._incomplete = True
                    continue
                if state is None or state.chat_id in seen:
                    continue
                seen.add(state.chat_id)
                total += state.total_records
                item = self._plan_chat(folder, state, rows.get(state.chat_id))
                if item is not None:
                    queue.append(item)
        except OSError:
            log.warning("search index could not list the data folder")
            self._incomplete = True
            return queue
        for chat_id, row in rows.items():
            if chat_id not in seen and not (self._root / row.folder).is_dir():
                self._index.drop_chat(chat_id)
                self._changed = True
        self._total = total
        return queue

    def _plan_chat(self, folder: Path, state: ChatState, row: ChatRow | None) -> _Item | None:
        try:
            parts = _listing(folder)
        except OSError:
            parts = None
        if parts is None:
            self._incomplete = True
            return None
        identity = (clean_text(state.title), state.username, folder.name)
        if row is None or (row.title, row.username, row.folder) != identity:
            self._index.upsert_chat(state.chat_id, state.title, state.username, folder.name)
        marks = self._index.marks(state.chat_id)
        removed = sorted(set(marks) - {p.path.name for p in parts})
        if removed and not self._forget(state, parts, removed):
            return None
        todo = [
            p
            for p in parts
            if (mark := marks.get(p.path.name)) is None
            or (mark.size, mark.mtime_ns) != (p.size, p.mtime_ns)
        ]
        reconciling = row is not None and row.reconciling
        if not todo and not reconciling:
            return None
        return _Item(state.chat_id, todo, parts, reconciling, marks)

    def _forget(self, state: ChatState, parts: list[_PartInfo], removed: list[str]) -> bool:
        try:
            first = first_message(p.path for p in parts)
        except OSError:
            self._incomplete = True
            return False
        floor = EVERYTHING if first is None else max(state.floor_id, first.msg_id)
        self._index.remove_below(state.chat_id, floor)
        self._index.forget_parts(state.chat_id, removed)
        self._changed = True
        log.info(
            "search index dropped trimmed history",
            extra={"chat_id": state.chat_id, "parts": len(removed)},
        )
        return True

    def _restart(self, item: _Item) -> None:
        log.info("search index re-reads a rewritten chat", extra={"chat_id": item.chat_id})
        self._index.begin_reconcile(item.chat_id)
        item.todo = list(item.all_parts)
        item.marks = {}
        item.cursor = None
        item.reconcile = True

    def _cursor(self, item: _Item, info: _PartInfo) -> PartCursor | None:
        if item.cursor is not None:
            return item.cursor
        mark = item.marks.get(info.path.name)
        if mark is None:
            return PartCursor(info.path, info.size, info.mtime_ns)
        return PartCursor.resume(info.path, info.size, info.mtime_ns, mark)

    def _advance(self, item: _Item) -> bool:
        """Index up to one batch of `item`; True when the chat is finished for this pass."""
        records: list[Record] = []
        marks: list[PartMark] = []
        budget = self._batch
        try:
            while item.todo and budget > 0:
                cursor = self._cursor(item, item.todo[0])
                if cursor is None:
                    self._restart(item)
                    return False
                item.cursor = cursor
                lines = cursor.read_lines(BLOCK_BYTES)
                if lines is None:
                    marks.append(cursor.mark(complete=True))
                    item.todo.pop(0)
                    item.cursor = None
                    continue
                budget -= max(len(lines), 1)
                records.extend(r for line in lines if (r := decode_line(line.strip())) is not None)
        except OSError:
            log.warning("search index could not read a part", extra={"chat_id": item.chat_id})
            self._incomplete = True
            return True
        if item.cursor is not None:
            marks.append(item.cursor.mark(complete=False))
        if records or marks:
            self._index.apply(item.chat_id, records, marks)
        done = not item.todo
        if done and item.reconcile:
            self._index.finish_reconcile(item.chat_id)
        return done

"""The read-only side of the search index: queries over `_search.db`.

Every query value travels as a bound parameter. The typed text becomes one quoted FTS5 phrase
(quotes doubled), so `AND`, `OR`, `NEAR`, `*`, `%` and `_` are plain characters. A reader has
a connection of its own and a lock, so a window may call it from whichever worker thread it
likes, one call at a time.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import contextlib
import sqlite3
import threading
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, Final

from chatimport.records import parse_dt
from chatimport.search_db import SearchError, connect_reader, database_path
from chatimport.search_fold import search_key
from chatimport.search_types import (
    MIN_INDEXED_LENGTH,
    ChatChoice,
    ContextMessage,
    IndexState,
    IndexStatus,
    SearchHit,
    SearchPage,
    SearchQuery,
)
from chatimport.telegram.mapper import message_link
from chatimport.textnorm import fold

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Generator
    from pathlib import Path

    from chatimport.search_types import SearchBackend

MAX_LIMIT: Final = 1000
SHORT_SCAN_CAP: Final = 20000
MAX_CONTEXT: Final = 100

_HIT_COLUMNS: Final = "m.chat_id, m.msg_id, m.date, m.text, m.edited, c.title, c.username, c.folder"
_NEWEST_FIRST: Final = "ORDER BY m.date DESC, m.msg_id DESC, m.chat_id DESC"


def _moment(epoch: int) -> datetime:
    return datetime.fromtimestamp(epoch, UTC)


def _stamp(value: datetime) -> int:
    return int((value if value.tzinfo is not None else value.replace(tzinfo=UTC)).timestamp())


def fts_phrase(key: str) -> str:
    return '"' + key.replace('"', '""') + '"'


def _filters(query: SearchQuery) -> tuple[list[str], list[Any]]:
    clauses: list[str] = []
    params: list[Any] = []
    if query.chat_ids is not None:
        ids = sorted(query.chat_ids)
        clauses.append(f"m.chat_id IN ({', '.join('?' * len(ids))})")
        params.extend(ids)
    if query.since is not None:
        clauses.append("m.date >= ?")
        params.append(_stamp(query.since))
    if query.until is not None:
        clauses.append("m.date < ?")
        params.append(_stamp(query.until))
    return clauses, params


class SearchReader:
    def __init__(self, conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
        self._conn = conn
        self._lock = threading.Lock()

    @contextlib.contextmanager
    def _guard(self) -> Generator[sqlite3.Connection]:
        with self._lock:
            try:
                yield self._conn
            except sqlite3.Error as error:
                raise SearchError("the search index cannot be read right now") from error

    def close(self) -> None:
        with self._lock, contextlib.suppress(sqlite3.Error):
            self._conn.close()

    def search(self, query: SearchQuery) -> SearchPage:
        key = search_key(query.text)
        if not key or (query.chat_ids is not None and not query.chat_ids):
            return SearchPage((), 0, query)
        clauses, params = _filters(query)
        limit = min(max(query.limit, 0), MAX_LIMIT)
        offset = max(query.offset, 0)
        with self._guard() as conn:
            if len(key) >= MIN_INDEXED_LENGTH:
                where = " AND ".join(["fts MATCH ?", *clauses])
                source = "fts JOIN messages m ON m.id = fts.rowid"
                args = [fts_phrase(key), *params]
                total_sql = f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {source} WHERE {where}"  # noqa: S608
                total_args = args
            else:
                inner = (
                    f"(SELECT * FROM messages m WHERE {' AND '.join(clauses or ['1'])} "  # noqa: S608
                    f"{_NEWEST_FIRST} LIMIT ?)"
                )
                source = inner + " m"
                where = "instr(m.folded, ?) > 0"
                args = [*params, SHORT_SCAN_CAP, key]
                total_sql = f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {source} WHERE {where}"  # noqa: S608
                total_args = args
            total = int(conn.execute(total_sql, total_args).fetchone()[0])
            rows = (
                conn.execute(
                    f"SELECT {_HIT_COLUMNS} FROM {source} "  # noqa: S608
                    f"JOIN chats c ON c.chat_id = m.chat_id WHERE {where} "
                    f"{_NEWEST_FIRST} LIMIT ? OFFSET ?",
                    [*args, limit, offset],
                ).fetchall()
                if limit
                else []
            )
        hits = tuple(
            SearchHit(
                chat_id=row[0],
                chat_title=row[5] or row[7],
                msg_id=row[1],
                date=_moment(row[2]),
                text=row[3],
                edited=bool(row[4]),
                link=message_link(row[0], row[6], row[1]),
            )
            for row in rows
        )
        return SearchPage(hits, total, query)

    def context(
        self, chat_id: int, msg_id: int, before: int = 3, after: int = 3
    ) -> tuple[ContextMessage, ...]:
        before = min(max(before, 0), MAX_CONTEXT)
        after = min(max(after, 0), MAX_CONTEXT)
        columns = "msg_id, date, text, edited"
        with self._guard() as conn:
            target = conn.execute(
                f"SELECT {columns} FROM messages WHERE chat_id = ? AND msg_id = ?",  # noqa: S608
                (chat_id, msg_id),
            ).fetchone()
            if target is None:
                return ()
            older = conn.execute(
                f"SELECT {columns} FROM messages WHERE chat_id = ? AND msg_id < ? "  # noqa: S608
                "ORDER BY msg_id DESC LIMIT ?",
                (chat_id, msg_id, before),
            ).fetchall()
            newer = conn.execute(
                f"SELECT {columns} FROM messages WHERE chat_id = ? AND msg_id > ? "  # noqa: S608
                "ORDER BY msg_id ASC LIMIT ?",
                (chat_id, msg_id, after),
            ).fetchall()
        rows = [*reversed(older), target, *newer]
        return tuple(
            ContextMessage(
                msg_id=row[0],
                date=_moment(row[1]),
                text=row[2],
                edited=bool(row[3]),
                is_target=row[0] == msg_id,
            )
            for row in rows
        )

    def chats(self) -> tuple[ChatChoice, ...]:
        with self._guard() as conn:
            rows = conn.execute(
                "SELECT chat_id, title, folder, messages FROM chats WHERE messages > 0"
            ).fetchall()
        choices = [ChatChoice(row[0], row[1] or row[2], row[3]) for row in rows]
        return tuple(sorted(choices, key=lambda c: (fold(c.title), c.chat_id)))

    def status(self) -> IndexStatus:
        with self._guard() as conn:
            meta = dict(conn.execute("SELECT key, value FROM meta").fetchall())
            indexed = int(
                conn.execute("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(messages), 0) FROM chats").fetchone()[0]
            )
        try:
            state = IndexState(meta.get("state", IndexState.BUILDING.value))
        except ValueError:
            state = IndexState.BUILDING
        try:
            total = int(meta.get("total", "0"))
        except ValueError:
            total = 0
        stamp = meta.get("updated_at")
        try:
            updated = parse_dt(stamp) if stamp else None
        except ValueError:
            updated = None
        total = indexed if state is IndexState.READY else max(total, indexed)
        return IndexStatus(state, indexed, total, updated)


def open_reader(root: Path) -> SearchBackend | None:
    """A read-only view of `<root>/_search.db`, or None when there is no usable index."""
    conn = connect_reader(database_path(root))
    return SearchReader(conn) if conn is not None else None

"""The service task that keeps the search index current.

The index is a derived cache of the stored parts, written only here. A timer wakes every
`[search] interval_seconds`; each wake runs bounded `IndexBuilder.step()` calls in a worker
thread (the event loop never waits on SQLite) and continues straight away while there is work,
so a long initial build leaves short pauses between batches. Repeated failures delete the file
and rebuild it. The config is read through a callable, so a reloaded `config.toml` takes effect
without a restart.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, Final

from chatimport.commands import in_thread
from chatimport.records import format_dt
from chatimport.search_db import fts5_trigram_available
from chatimport.search_index import SearchIndex, open_writer, reset_index
from chatimport.search_indexer import IndexBuilder, StepResult
from chatimport.search_types import IndexState

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Callable
    from datetime import datetime
    from pathlib import Path

    from chatimport.config import SearchConfig
    from chatimport.ports import Clock

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

BUSY_PAUSE_SECONDS: Final = 0.05
FAILURES_BEFORE_REBUILD: Final = 3


class SearchIndexer:
    def __init__(self, root: Path, config: Callable[[], SearchConfig], clock: Clock) -> None:
        self._root = root
        self._config = config
        self._clock = clock
        self._index: SearchIndex | None = None
        self._builder: IndexBuilder | None = None
        self._state = IndexState.BUILDING
        self._indexed = 0
        self._total = 0
        self._updated: datetime | None = None
        self._failures = 0
        self._unavailable = False

    def snapshot(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        enabled = self._config().enabled
        active = enabled and not self._unavailable
        return {
            "enabled": enabled,
            "state": (self._state if active else IndexState.DISABLED).value,
            "indexed": self._indexed,
            "total": self._total,
            "updated_at": format_dt(self._updated) if self._updated is not None else None,
        }

    def _work(self) -> StepResult:
        if self._builder is None:
            if not self._root.is_dir():
                return StepResult(False, self._state, 0, 0, None)
            self._index = open_writer(self._root)
            self._builder = IndexBuilder(self._index, self._root, self._clock.now)
        return self._builder.step()

    def close(self) -> None:
        index, self._index, self._builder = self._index, None, None
        if index is not None:
            index.close()

    def _rebuild(self) -> None:
        self.close()
        reset_index(self._root)
        self._state = IndexState.BUILDING
        self._indexed = self._total = 0
        self._updated = None

    async def tick(self) -> bool:
        """One step of work; True when another step is waiting."""
        if not self._config().enabled:
            self.close()
            return False
        if not fts5_trigram_available():
            if not self._unavailable:
                log.warning("search is off: this SQLite has no FTS5 trigram tokenizer")
            self._unavailable = True
            return False
        self._unavailable = False
        try:
            result = await in_thread(self._work)
        except Exception:
            self._failures += 1
            if self._failures >= FAILURES_BEFORE_REBUILD:
                self._failures = 0
                await in_thread(self._rebuild)
            raise
        self._failures = 0
        self._state = result.state
        self._indexed = result.indexed
        self._total = result.total
        self._updated = result.updated_at
        return result.more

    async def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            while True:
                more = False
                try:
                    more = await self.tick()
                except Exception:
                    log.exception("search index update failed")
                pause = BUSY_PAUSE_SECONDS if more else max(1, self._config().interval_seconds)
                await self._clock.sleep(pause)
        finally:
            self.close()

"""The search contract: what the index returns and what the window asks for.

The index (`search_index`) and the desktop page both build on these types, so neither depends
on the other. Everything here is plain data; sender names are never part of it.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import StrEnum
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Protocol

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from datetime import datetime

MIN_INDEXED_LENGTH = 3
DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE = 100


class IndexState(StrEnum):
    DISABLED = "disabled"
    BUILDING = "building"
    READY = "ready"
    MISSING = "missing"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SearchQuery:
    """`text` is what the person typed (matched as a case-, accent- and yo-insensitive
    substring). `chat_ids` of None means every chat; `since` is inclusive, `until` exclusive.
    """

    text: str
    chat_ids: frozenset[int] | None = None
    since: datetime | None = None
    until: datetime | None = None
    limit: int = DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE
    offset: int = 0


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SearchHit:
    chat_id: int
    chat_title: str
    msg_id: int
    date: datetime
    text: str
    edited: bool
    link: str | None


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SearchPage:
    """`total` counts every match of the query (not only this page); newest first."""

    hits: tuple[SearchHit, ...]
    total: int
    query: SearchQuery


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ContextMessage:
    msg_id: int
    date: datetime
    text: str
    edited: bool
    is_target: bool


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class IndexStatus:
    """`indexed` and `total` count messages; progress is `indexed / total` while building."""

    state: IndexState
    indexed: int
    total: int
    updated_at: datetime | None


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ChatChoice:
    chat_id: int
    title: str
    messages: int


class SearchBackend(Protocol):
    """A read-only view of the index; safe to use from a worker thread of its own."""

    def search(self, query: SearchQuery) -> SearchPage: ...

    def context(
        self, chat_id: int, msg_id: int, before: int = 3, after: int = 3
    ) -> tuple[ContextMessage, ...]: ...

    def chats(self) -> tuple[ChatChoice, ...]: ...

    def status(self) -> IndexStatus: ...

    def close(self) -> None: ...

"""Everything that runs against one data root: the chat workers and the helper tasks around
them. A root change stops this runtime and starts a new one on the new root."""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import logging
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from chatimport.guards.disk import DiskGuard, MediaDiskGate
from chatimport.guards.folders import FolderWatcher
from chatimport.media import MediaDownloader
from chatimport.merged_service import MergedExporter
from chatimport.recheck import RecheckScheduler, compute_recheck
from chatimport.resolution import tracked_chat
from chatimport.router import Router
from chatimport.runtime import BackfillSlots, ChatRegistry
from chatimport.search_service import SearchIndexer
from chatimport.status import StatusWriter
from chatimport.storage.state import StateUnreadable, load_state
from chatimport.supervisor import Supervisor
from chatimport.trim import Trimmer
from chatimport.worker import ChatWorker

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Awaitable, Callable, Iterable
    from datetime import datetime
    from pathlib import Path

    from chatimport.config import Config
    from chatimport.ports import Clock, DiskUsage, TelegramGateway
    from chatimport.resolution import ErrorBook, ResolvedEntry
    from chatimport.runtime import ChatController, Notifier, TrackedChat

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def make_worker(
    chat: TrackedChat,
    *,
    root: Path,
    gateway: TelegramGateway,
    config: Config,
    clock: Clock,
    notifier: Notifier,
    slots: BackfillSlots,
) -> ChatWorker:
    return ChatWorker(
        chat,
        root=root,
        gateway=gateway,
        config=config,
        clock=clock,
        notifier=notifier,
        recheck=compute_recheck,
        slots=slots,
    )


def _last_recheck_at(controller: ChatController) -> datetime | None:
    try:
        state = load_state(controller.folder)
    except StateUnreadable:
        log.warning("state unreadable; recheck age unknown", extra={"chat_id": controller.chat_id})
        return None
    return state.last_recheck_at if state is not None else None


def _backfill_done(worker: ChatWorker) -> bool:
    try:
        state = load_state(worker.folder)
    except StateUnreadable:
        log.warning("state unreadable; launch staggered", extra={"chat_id": worker.chat_id})
        return False
    return state is not None and state.backfill.done


class ServiceRuntime:
    def __init__(
        self,
        root: Path,
        *,
        config: Config,
        gateway: TelegramGateway,
        clock: Clock,
        notifier: Notifier,
        disk: DiskUsage,
        errors: ErrorBook,
        service_state: Callable[[], str],
    ) -> None:
        self.root = root
        self.config = config
        self.gateway = gateway
        self._clock = clock
        self._notifier = notifier
        self._disk = disk
        self._errors = errors
        self.registry = ChatRegistry()
        self.supervisor = Supervisor(clock, notifier)
        self.slots = BackfillSlots(config.backfill.max_parallel_chats)
        self.router = Router(self.registry, root, clock=clock)
        self.trimmer = Trimmer(
            root, self.registry, clock=clock, max_chunk_bytes=config.output.max_chunk_bytes
        )
        self.merged = MergedExporter(root, lambda: self.config.merged, clock)
        self.search = SearchIndexer(root, lambda: self.config.search, clock)
        self.status = StatusWriter(
            root,
            self.registry,
            self.supervisor,
            clock=clock,
            disk=disk,
            low_watermark_gb=config.disk.low_watermark_gb,
            service_state=service_state,
            slots=self.slots,
            merged=self.merged.snapshot,
            search=self.search.snapshot,
        )
        self.scheduler = RecheckScheduler(self.registry, config.recheck, clock, _last_recheck_at)
        self._aux_tasks: list[asyncio.Task[None]] = []
        self._launches = 0

    def start(self, entries: Iterable[ResolvedEntry], on_fatal: Callable[[], None]) -> None:
        self._errors.attach(self.status)
        self.add(entries)
        config = self.config
        guard = DiskGuard(
            self.root,
            self.registry,
            self.trimmer,
            config.disk,
            clock=self._clock,
            disk=self._disk,
            notifier=self._notifier,
        )
        watcher = FolderWatcher(
            self.root, self.registry, config.watch, clock=self._clock, notifier=self._notifier
        )
        self._spawn_aux("folder-watcher", watcher.run)
        self._spawn_aux("disk-guard", guard.run)
        self._spawn_aux("recheck", self.scheduler.run)
        self._spawn_aux("status", self.status.run)
        self._spawn_aux("merged", self.merged.run)
        self._spawn_aux("search", self.search.run)
        if config.media.enabled:
            downloader = MediaDownloader(
                self.registry,
                self.gateway,
                config.media,
                clock=self._clock,
                max_chunk_bytes=config.output.max_chunk_bytes,
            )
            gate = MediaDiskGate(
                self.root, downloader, config.disk, disk=self._disk, clock=self._clock
            )
            self._spawn_aux("media", downloader.run)
            self._spawn_aux("media-guard", gate.run)
        self._aux_tasks.append(asyncio.create_task(self._watch_fatal(on_fatal)))

    def add(self, entries: Iterable[ResolvedEntry]) -> None:
        """Register a worker for every chat not yet running and launch them."""
        workers = [worker for item in entries if (worker := self._register(item)) is not None]
        self._launch(workers)

    async def remove(self, chat_id: int) -> None:
        controller = self.registry.remove(chat_id)
        if controller is not None:
            await controller.stop()

    async def stop(self) -> None:
        self._errors.attach(None)
        for task in self._aux_tasks:
            task.cancel()
        await asyncio.gather(*self._aux_tasks, return_exceptions=True)
        results = await asyncio.gather(
            *(controller.stop() for controller in self.registry.all()), return_exceptions=True
        )
        for result in results:
            if isinstance(result, BaseException):
                log.error("a worker did not stop cleanly: %s", type(result).__name__)
        await self.supervisor.stop_all()

    async def _watch_fatal(self, on_fatal: Callable[[], None]) -> None:
        await self.supervisor.wait_fatal()
        log.error("fatal task failure, shutting down")
        on_fatal()

    def _spawn_aux(self, name: str, factory: Callable[[], Awaitable[None]]) -> None:
        self._aux_tasks.append(self.supervisor.spawn(name, factory))

    def _register(self, item: ResolvedEntry) -> ChatWorker | None:
        chat_id = item.resolved.chat_id
        if chat_id is None or self.registry.get(chat_id) is not None:
            return None
        worker = make_worker(
            tracked_chat(*item),
            root=self.root,
            gateway=self.gateway,
            config=self.config,
            clock=self._clock,
            notifier=self._notifier,
            slots=self.slots,
        )
        self.registry.add(worker)
        return worker

    def _launch(self, workers: list[ChatWorker]) -> None:
        fresh: list[ChatWorker] = []
        for worker in workers:
            if _backfill_done(worker):
                self._spawn_worker(worker)
            else:
                fresh.append(worker)
        if fresh:
            self._launches += 1
            self.supervisor.spawn(
                f"launch-{self._launches}", lambda: self._stagger(fresh), restart=False
            )

    async def _stagger(self, workers: list[ChatWorker]) -> None:
        pause = self.config.backfill.pause_between_chats_sec
        for index, worker in enumerate(workers):
            if index:
                await self._clock.sleep(pause)
            if self.registry.get(worker.chat_id) is worker:
                self._spawn_worker(worker)

    def _spawn_worker(self, worker: ChatWorker) -> None:
        self.supervisor.spawn(f"worker-{worker.chat_id}", worker.run)

"""Changing the output folder (spec §7.3): validation and moving the data."""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import contextlib
import errno
import logging
import shutil
import uuid
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Final

from chatimport.paths import is_cloud_synced
from chatimport.ports import ChatImportError
from chatimport.storage.fileio import walk_files
from chatimport.storage.layout import STATE_FILE, iter_chat_folders

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pathlib import Path

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

STATUS_FILE: Final = "_status.json"


def _looks_like_data_root(folder: Path) -> bool:
    return (folder / STATUS_FILE).exists() or any(
        (chat / STATE_FILE).exists() for chat in iter_chat_folders(folder)
    )


def validate_new_root(
    new: Path, old: Path, *, app_base: Path | None = None, move: bool = True
) -> list[str]:
    """Raise when `new` cannot be used; return warnings for a usable one.

    `app_base` (the folder with the session and config) must neither be nor contain nor sit
    inside the data folder. Without `move`, an existing non-empty folder is accepted only
    when it already holds ChatImport data.
    """
    target = new.expanduser().resolve()
    source = old.expanduser().resolve()
    if target == source:
        raise ChatImportError("the new folder is the current folder")
    if target.is_relative_to(source):
        raise ChatImportError("the new folder must not be inside the current folder")
    if source.is_relative_to(target):
        raise ChatImportError("the current folder must not be inside the new folder")
    if app_base is not None:
        base = app_base.expanduser().resolve()
        if target.is_relative_to(base) or base.is_relative_to(target):
            raise ChatImportError(
                "the data folder must be apart from the application folder, which holds "
                "the Telegram session"
            )
    if not move and target.is_dir() and any(target.iterdir()) and not _looks_like_data_root(target):
        raise ChatImportError(f"{target} is not empty and holds no ChatImport data")
    probe = target / f".chatimport-probe-{uuid.uuid4().hex}"
    try:
        target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        probe.write_bytes(b"")
    except OSError as error:
        raise ChatImportError(f"cannot write to {target}: {error}") from error
    finally:
        with contextlib.suppress(OSError):
            probe.unlink()
    warnings: list[str] = []
    if is_cloud_synced(target):
        warnings.append(
            "the folder is inside OneDrive; sync may lock or duplicate data files, "
            "and it uploads sender names"
        )
    return warnings


def _tree_stats(path: Path) -> tuple[int, int]:
    """Files (links counted as files, never followed) and their total size."""
    files = 0
    size = 0
    for entry in walk_files(path):
        files += 1
        size += entry.stat(follow_symlinks=False).st_size
    return files, size


def _refuse_junctions(path: Path) -> None:
    """A directory junction cannot be copied as a link: refuse before copying anything."""
    for entry in walk_files(path):
        if entry.is_junction():
            raise ChatImportError(
                f"{entry.path} is a directory junction; remove it before moving the data folder"
            )


def _clear_empty_target(new: Path) -> None:
    if not new.exists():
        return
    if not new.is_dir() or any(new.iterdir()):
        raise ChatImportError(f"{new} already exists and is not empty")
    new.rmdir()


def _same_volume(old: Path, new: Path) -> bool:
    return old.stat().st_dev == new.parent.stat().st_dev


def _move_sync(old: Path, new: Path) -> None:
    if not old.is_dir():
        return
    new.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    _clear_empty_target(new)
    if _same_volume(old, new):
        try:
            old.replace(new)
        except OSError as error:
            if error.errno != errno.EXDEV:
                raise
        else:
            return
    _refuse_junctions(old)
    try:
        shutil.copytree(old, new, symlinks=True)
        if _tree_stats(old) != _tree_stats(new):
            raise ChatImportError("the copy does not match the original; the old folder is kept")
    except BaseException:
        shutil.rmtree(new, ignore_errors=True)
        raise
    try:
        shutil.rmtree(old)
    except OSError:
        log.warning("the old data folder could not be fully deleted")


async def move_root(old: Path, new: Path, *, move: bool) -> None:
    """Move the data folder; with `move=False` the data is left where it is."""
    if not move:
        return
    await asyncio.to_thread(_move_sync, old, new)
