"""The worker's view of its chat folder. Heavy file work (a month rewrite, a recover, a big
append) runs in a thread, so it never stalls the event loop (Telethon, the other chats);
reading or saving the small `state.json` and a live batch stay on the loop."""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import contextlib
from functools import partial
from itertools import groupby
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Final

from chatimport.storage.layout import list_parts, month_key
from chatimport.worker_buffer import split_late

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Callable, Sequence
    from datetime import datetime
    from pathlib import Path

    from chatimport.records import MessageRecord, Record
    from chatimport.storage.chat_store import ChatStore
    from chatimport.storage.state import ChatState

INLINE_APPEND_RECORDS: Final = 100


async def run_blocking[T](call: Callable[[], T]) -> T:
    """Run `call` in a thread. A cancelled caller still waits for the thread to end, so a
    chat lock held around this call is never released while the thread writes."""
    future = asyncio.ensure_future(asyncio.to_thread(call))
    try:
        return await asyncio.shield(future)
    except asyncio.CancelledError:
        while not future.done():
            with contextlib.suppress(asyncio.CancelledError):
                await asyncio.wait({future})
        future.exception()
        raise


class WorkerStore:
    def __init__(self, store: ChatStore) -> None:
        self._store = store

    @property
    def folder(self) -> Path:
        return self._store.folder

    def resolve_folder(self) -> Path:
        return self._store.resolve_folder()

    def load(self) -> ChatState | None:
        return self._store.load()

    def require(self) -> ChatState:
        return self._store.require()

    def has_parts(self) -> bool:
        return bool(list_parts(self._store.resolve_folder()))

    def save(self, state: ChatState) -> ChatState:
        return self._store.save(state)

    def oldest_message_date(self, state: ChatState) -> datetime | None:
        """Reads only up to the first message of the oldest part."""
        return self._store.oldest_message_date(state)

    async def append(self, state: ChatState, records: Sequence[Record]) -> ChatState:
        if len(records) < INLINE_APPEND_RECORDS:
            return self._store.append(state, records)
        return await run_blocking(partial(self._store.append, state, records))

    async def merge_month(
        self, state: ChatState, month: str, messages: Sequence[MessageRecord]
    ) -> ChatState:
        """Like `ChatStore.merge_month`, which returns `state` unsaved when every message is
        already stored."""
        return await run_blocking(partial(self._store.merge_month, state, month, messages))

    async def write_live(self, state: ChatState, records: Sequence[Record]) -> ChatState:
        """Append new records; merge messages at or below `last_id` (late deliveries, recheck
        gap fills) into their month in `msg_id` order, where ids already stored are dropped.
        Returns `state` itself when nothing was written."""
        append, late = split_late(records, state.last_id)
        if append:
            state = await self.append(state, append)
        late.sort(key=lambda r: month_key(r.date))
        for month, group in groupby(late, key=lambda r: month_key(r.date)):
            state = await self.merge_month(state, month, list(group))
        return state

    async def recover(self, title: str) -> ChatState:
        return await run_blocking(partial(self._store.recover, title=title))


class OldestDate:
    """Date of the chat's oldest stored message, re-read only when the oldest part changes
    (a trim or a recover by another component)."""

    def __init__(self, store: WorkerStore) -> None:
        self._store = store
        self.value: datetime | None = None
        self._key: str | None = None

    def reset(self) -> None:
        self.value = self._key = None

    def refresh(self, state: ChatState) -> None:
        found = self._store.oldest_message_date(state)
        if found is not None:
            self.value = found
            self._key = min(state.chunks)

    def refresh_if_moved(self, state: ChatState) -> None:
        if self.value is not None and state.chunks and min(state.chunks) != self._key:
            self.refresh(state)

"""Shared test doubles: a deterministic clock, a scripted Telegram gateway and a recording
notifier. Telegram is never called from tests; everything goes through these."""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any

from chatimport.ports import (
    ChatEvent,
    DialogInfo,
    EventHandler,
    ResolvedChat,
    ResolveStatus,
)
from chatimport.records import MessageRecord

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import AsyncIterator, Callable
    from pathlib import Path

    from chatimport.records import MediaInfo
    from chatimport.runtime import Level

NOW = datetime(2026, 10, 29, 12, 0, 0, tzinfo=UTC)
CHAT_ID = -1001234567890


def msg(
    msg_id: int,
    *,
    chat_id: int = CHAT_ID,
    date: datetime | None = None,
    text: str | None = None,
    edit_date: datetime | None = None,
    media: MediaInfo | None = None,
    fetched_at: datetime = NOW,
    **extra: Any,
) -> MessageRecord:
    """A message dated `1000 - msg_id` hours before NOW unless a date is given."""
    return MessageRecord(
        chat_id=chat_id,
        msg_id=msg_id,
        date=date if date is not None else NOW - timedelta(hours=1000 - msg_id),
        fetched_at=fetched_at,
        text=f"text {msg_id}" if text is None else text,
        edit_date=edit_date,
        media=media,
        **extra,
    )


class FakeClock:
    """`sleep` never waits: it advances `now` and records the request."""

    def __init__(self, start: datetime = NOW) -> None:
        self._now = start
        self.sleeps: list[float] = []
        self.on_sleep: Callable[[float], None] | None = None

    def now(self) -> datetime:
        return self._now

    def advance(self, **kwargs: float) -> None:
        self._now += timedelta(**kwargs)

    async def sleep(self, seconds: float) -> None:
        self.sleeps.append(seconds)
        self._now += timedelta(seconds=seconds)
        if self.on_sleep is not None:
            self.on_sleep(seconds)
        await asyncio.sleep(0)


class FakeDisk:
    """`free_bytes` returns scripted values; the last one repeats."""

    def __init__(self, *free: int) -> None:
        self.values = list(free) or [10**15]
        self.calls = 0

    def free_bytes(self, path: Path) -> int:
        value = self.values[min(self.calls, len(self.values) - 1)]
        self.calls += 1
        return value


@dataclass
class Note:
    level: Level
    title: str
    message: str


class RecordingNotifier:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.notes: list[Note] = []

    def notify(self, level: Level, title: str, message: str) -> None:
        self.notes.append(Note(level, title, message))

    def titles(self) -> list[str]:
        return [n.title for n in self.notes]


@dataclass
class FakeGateway:
    """A scripted `TelegramGateway`.

    - `chats[chat_id]` holds `{msg_id: MessageRecord}`; iteration follows ports.py semantics.
    - `fail[method]` is a list of exceptions raised (and consumed) by the next calls of that method.
    - `calls` logs `(method, args)` for assertions; `fire(event)` feeds registered handlers.
    """

    chats: dict[int, dict[int, MessageRecord]] = field(
        default_factory=dict[int, dict[int, MessageRecord]]
    )
    dialogs: list[DialogInfo] = field(default_factory=list[DialogInfo])
    refs: dict[str, ResolvedChat] = field(default_factory=dict[str, ResolvedChat])
    media: dict[tuple[int, int], bytes] = field(default_factory=dict[tuple[int, int], bytes])
    fail: dict[str, list[BaseException]] = field(default_factory=dict[str, list[BaseException]])
    calls: list[tuple[str, tuple[Any, ...]]] = field(
        default_factory=list[tuple[str, tuple[Any, ...]]]
    )
    handlers: list[EventHandler] = field(default_factory=list[EventHandler])
    connected: bool = False
    page_hook: Callable[[], None] | None = None

    def add_chat(self, chat_id: int, ids: range | list[int], **kw: Any) -> None:
        self.chats[chat_id] = {i: msg(i, chat_id=chat_id, **kw) for i in ids}

    def _maybe_fail(self, method: str) -> None:
        queue = self.fail.get(method)
        if queue:
            raise queue.pop(0)

    async def connect(self) -> None:
        self.calls.append(("connect", ()))
        self._maybe_fail("connect")
        self.connected = True

    async def disconnect(self) -> None:
        self.calls.append(("disconnect", ()))
        self.connected = False

    async def list_dialogs(self) -> list[DialogInfo]:
        self.calls.append(("list_dialogs", ()))
        self._maybe_fail("list_dialogs")
        return list(self.dialogs)

    async def resolve(self, ref: str) -> ResolvedChat:
        self.calls.append(("resolve", (ref,)))
        self._maybe_fail("resolve")
        return self.refs.get(ref, ResolvedChat(ref, ResolveStatus.NOT_FOUND))

    async def newest_id(self, chat_id: int) -> int:
        self.calls.append(("newest_id", (chat_id,)))
        self._maybe_fail("newest_id")
        return max(self.chats.get(chat_id, {}), default=0)

    async def iter_history(
        self, chat_id: int, *, offset_id: int = 0, min_id: int = 0
    ) -> AsyncIterator[MessageRecord]:
        self.calls.append(("iter_history", (chat_id, offset_id, min_id)))
        self._maybe_fail("iter_history")
        for i in sorted(self.chats.get(chat_id, {}), reverse=True):
            if (offset_id and i >= offset_id) or i <= min_id:
                continue
            if self.page_hook:
                self.page_hook()
            self._maybe_fail("iter_history_item")
            yield self.chats[chat_id][i]

    async def iter_since(self, chat_id: int, min_id: int) -> AsyncIterator[MessageRecord]:
        self.calls.append(("iter_since", (chat_id, min_id)))
        self._maybe_fail("iter_since")
        for i in sorted(self.chats.get(chat_id, {})):
            if i > min_id:
                if self.page_hook:
                    self.page_hook()
                yield self.chats[chat_id][i]

    async def iter_window(
        self, chat_id: int, since: datetime, max_id: int
    ) -> AsyncIterator[MessageRecord]:
        self.calls.append(("iter_window", (chat_id, since, max_id)))
        self._maybe_fail("iter_window")
        for i in sorted(self.chats.get(chat_id, {})):
            record = self.chats[chat_id][i]
            if i <= max_id and record.date >= since:
                yield record

    def add_event_handler(self, handler: EventHandler) -> None:
        self.handlers.append(handler)

    async def fire(self, event: ChatEvent) -> None:
        for handler in list(self.handlers):
            await handler(event)

    async def download_media(self, chat_id: int, msg_id: int, target_dir: Path) -> Path | None:
        self.calls.append(("download_media", (chat_id, msg_id)))
        self._maybe_fail("download_media")
        data = self.media.get((chat_id, msg_id))
        if data is None:
            return None
        target_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)  # noqa: ASYNC240
        path = target_dir / f"tg_{chat_id}_{msg_id}.bin"
        path.write_bytes(data)
        return path

    def count(self, method: str) -> int:
        return sum(1 for name, _ in self.calls if name == method)

"""End-to-end scenarios: several workers over one scripted Telegram, the real router, folder
watcher, trimmer and recheck, with kills and restarts. Deterministic and free of real sleeps."""

from __future__ import annotations

import contextlib
import json
import shutil
from dataclasses import dataclass, replace
from datetime import timedelta
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any

import pytest

import chatimport.storage.writer as writer
from chatimport.config import WatchConfig
from chatimport.guards.folders import FolderWatcher
from chatimport.offline import lower_floor_state
from chatimport.records import DETECTED_RECHECK, DeleteRecord, EditRecord
from chatimport.router import UNROUTED_DELETES_FILE, Router
from chatimport.runtime import ChatRegistry
from chatimport.storage.writer import iter_records
from chatimport.trim import Trimmer
from tests.fakes import CHAT_ID, NOW, FakeClock, FakeGateway, RecordingNotifier, msg

    Rig,

    from pathlib import Path

ALPHA, BETA, GAMMA = CHAT_ID, -1009999999991, -1009999999992


@dataclass
class World:
    gateway: FakeGateway
    clock: FakeClock
    notifier: RecordingNotifier
    rigs: dict[int, Rig]
    registry: ChatRegistry
    router: Router
    root: Path

    def trimmer(self) -> Trimmer:
        return Trimmer(self.root, self.registry, clock=self.clock, max_chunk_bytes=10**9)

    def watcher(self) -> FolderWatcher:
        return FolderWatcher(
            self.root,
            self.registry,
            WatchConfig(check_every_seconds=10, confirm_checks=2),
            clock=self.clock,
            notifier=self.notifier,
        )


def build_world(make_rig: RigFactory) -> World:
    gateway = FakeGateway()
    clock = FakeClock()
    notifier = RecordingNotifier()
    gateway.add_chat(ALPHA, range(1, 1001))
    gateway.add_chat(BETA, range(1, 51))
    gateway.add_chat(GAMMA, [])
    rigs = {
        chat_id: make_rig(
            chat_id=chat_id, title=title, gateway=gateway, clock=clock, notifier=notifier
        )
        for chat_id, title in ((ALPHA, "Alpha"), (BETA, "Beta"), (GAMMA, "Gamma"))
    }
    registry = ChatRegistry()
    for rig in rigs.values():
        registry.add(rig.worker)
    router = Router(registry, make_rig.root, clock=clock)
    gateway.add_event_handler(router.handle)
    return World(gateway, clock, notifier, rigs, registry, router, make_rig.root)


async def start_all(world: World) -> None:
    for rig in world.rigs.values():
        rig.start()
    for rig in world.rigs.values():
        await rig.until_complete()


async def test_three_chats_through_backfill_live_deletion_trim_deeper_and_recheck(
    make_rig: RigFactory,
) -> None:
    world = build_world(make_rig)
    alpha, beta, gamma = (world.rigs[c] for c in (ALPHA, BETA, GAMMA))

    await start_all(world)
    assert_disk_consistent(alpha.folder, expect_ids=range(1, 1001))
    assert_disk_consistent(beta.folder, expect_ids=range(1, 51))
    assert_disk_consistent(gamma.folder, expect_ids=[])
    assert world.gateway.handlers

    for i in range(1001, 1006):
        world.gateway.chats[ALPHA][i] = msg(i, chat_id=ALPHA)
        await world.gateway.fire(new_event(i, chat_id=ALPHA))
    for i in (51, 52):
        world.gateway.chats[BETA][i] = msg(i, chat_id=BETA)
        await world.gateway.fire(new_event(i, chat_id=BETA))
    await world.gateway.fire(new_event(1, chat_id=-777))
    await world.gateway.fire(delete_event([4, 5], None))
    await alpha.until(lambda: max(alpha.ids()) == 1005, "alpha flushed by count")
    await beta.settle()
    assert max(beta.ids()) == 50
    world.clock.advance(seconds=31)
    beta.worker.resume()
    await beta.until(lambda: max(beta.ids()) == 52, "beta flushed by time")

    unrouted = (world.root / UNROUTED_DELETES_FILE).read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
    assert [json.loads(line)["msg_ids"] for line in unrouted] == [[4, 5]]
    assert not (world.root / "-777").exists()

    watcher = world.watcher()
    await watcher.check_once()
    shutil.rmtree(beta.folder)
    assert beta.load() is None
    await watcher.check_once()
    await beta.settle()
    assert beta.load() is None
    await watcher.check_once()
    await beta.until(
        lambda: beta.is_live() and beta.backfill_done() and beta.ids() == list(range(1, 53)),
        "beta refetched after its folder was deleted",
    )
    assert beta.state().floor_id == 0
    assert any("deleted" in n.message for n in world.notifier.notes)
    assert_disk_consistent(beta.folder, expect_ids=range(1, 53))

    report = await world.trimmer().trim_percent(50, ALPHA)
    assert report.per_chat == {ALPHA: 502}
    trimmed = alpha.state()
    assert (trimmed.floor_id, trimmed.floor_reason) == (503, "manual_trim_50")
    assert_disk_consistent(alpha.folder, expect_ids=range(503, 1006))
    assert_disk_consistent(beta.folder, expect_ids=range(1, 53))

    async with alpha.worker.lock:
        assert lower_floor_state(alpha.folder, world.clock.now())
    world.clock.advance(seconds=601)
    alpha.worker.resume()
    await alpha.until(
        lambda: alpha.is_live() and alpha.backfill_done() and alpha.ids() == list(range(1, 1006)),
        "alpha refilled below the old floor",
    )
    assert alpha.state().floor_id == 0
    assert_disk_consistent(alpha.folder, expect_ids=range(1, 1006))

    edited = world.gateway.chats[ALPHA][10]
    world.gateway.chats[ALPHA][10] = replace(
        edited, text="edited later", edit_date=NOW + timedelta(hours=2)
    )
    del world.gateway.chats[ALPHA][20]
    alpha.worker.request_recheck(60)
    await alpha.until(lambda: alpha.state().last_recheck_at is not None, "recheck recorded")

    found = [r for r in iter_records(alpha.folder) if isinstance(r, EditRecord | DeleteRecord)]
    assert [(type(r).__name__, r.detected_by) for r in found] == [
        ("EditRecord", DETECTED_RECHECK),
        ("DeleteRecord", DETECTED_RECHECK),
    ]
    assert isinstance(found[0], EditRecord)
    assert (found[0].msg_id, found[0].text) == (10, "edited later")
    assert isinstance(found[1], DeleteRecord)
    assert found[1].msg_ids == (20,)

    before = sum(1 for _ in iter_records(alpha.folder))
    alpha.worker.request_recheck(60)
    await alpha.until(lambda: alpha.state().last_recheck_at == world.clock.now(), "second recheck")
    assert sum(1 for _ in iter_records(alpha.folder)) == before

    for rig in world.rigs.values():
        await rig.worker.stop()
    assert_disk_consistent(gamma.folder, expect_ids=[])


async def test_a_deleted_data_root_is_recreated_and_every_chat_is_fetched_again(

class Lcg:
    def __init__(self, seed: int) -> None:
        self.value = seed * 7919 + 12345

    def below(self, bound: int) -> int:
        self.value = (self.value * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2**31
        return (self.value >> 8) % bound


@pytest.mark.parametrize("seed", range(10))
async def test_kill_and_restart_sequences_never_leave_gaps_or_duplicates(
    make_rig: RigFactory, small_parts: int, seed: int
) -> None:
    rng = Lcg(seed)
    gateway = FakeGateway()
    clock = FakeClock()
    gateway.add_chat(CHAT_ID, range(1, 301))
    next_id = 301

    for _ in range(6):
        for _ in range(rng.below(45)):
            gateway.chats[CHAT_ID][next_id] = msg(next_id)
            next_id += 1
        rig = make_rig(gateway=gateway, clock=clock)
        budget = 1 + rng.below(260)
        seen = 0

        def hook(rig: Rig = rig, budget: int = budget) -> None:
            nonlocal seen
            seen += 1
            if seen == budget and rig.task is not None:
                rig.task.cancel()

        gateway.page_hook = hook
        rig.start()
        for _ in range(60):
            await rig.settle(5)
            if rig.task is not None and rig.task.done():
                break
        else:
            for i in range(next_id - rng.below(6) - 1, next_id):
                if i in gateway.chats[CHAT_ID]:
                    rig.worker.submit(new_event(i))
            await rig.settle(rng.below(40))
        await rig.kill()
        gateway.page_hook = None
        if rig.load() is not None:
            assert_disk_consistent(rig.folder)

    final = make_rig(gateway=gateway, clock=clock)
    final.start()
    await final.until(
        lambda: (
            final.is_live()
            and final.backfill_done()
            and set(final.ids()) == set(gateway.chats[CHAT_ID])
        ),
        "everything stored",
    )
    assert_disk_consistent(final.folder, expect_ids=gateway.chats[CHAT_ID])


@pytest.mark.parametrize("target", ["atomic_write_bytes", "save_state"])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("nth", range(1, 17))
async def test_a_failure_at_any_single_write_loses_and_duplicates_nothing(
    make_rig: RigFactory,
    small_parts: int,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
    target: str,
    nth: int,
) -> None:

    real = getattr(writer, target)
    calls = 0

    def flaky(*args: Any) -> Any:
        nonlocal calls
        calls += 1
        if calls == nth:
            raise OSError("simulated crash")
        return real(*args)

    monkeypatch.setattr(f"chatimport.storage.writer.{target}", flaky)
    first = make_rig(range(1, 301))
    for attempt in range(2):
        with contextlib.suppress(OSError):
            await first.worker.sync_once()
        if attempt == 0:
            for i in range(301, 401):
                first.gateway.chats[CHAT_ID][i] = msg(i)

    second = make_rig(gateway=first.gateway, clock=first.clock)
    await second.worker.sync_once()
    await second.worker.sync_once()

    assert_disk_consistent(second.folder, expect_ids=range(1, 401))
    assert second.state().backfill.done

from __future__ import annotations

import os
from pathlib import Path, PureWindowsPath

import pytest

from chatimport.config import ConfigError, load_config
from chatimport.config_edit import set_output_root


def write(path: Path, text: str) -> None:
    path.write_bytes(text.encode("utf-8"))


def read(path: Path) -> str:
    return path.read_bytes().decode("utf-8")


@pytest.fixture
def config_file(tmp_path: Path) -> Path:
    return tmp_path / "config.toml"


def leftovers(folder: Path) -> list[str]:
    return sorted(p.name for p in folder.iterdir())


def test_missing_file_is_created_with_the_section(config_file: Path) -> None:
    set_output_root(config_file, "D:/Data")
    assert read(config_file) == '[output]\nroot_dir = "D:/Data"\n'
    assert load_config(config_file).output.root_dir == "D:/Data"


def test_missing_parent_folder_is_created(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    target = tmp_path / "a" / "b" / "config.toml"
    set_output_root(target, "x")
    assert load_config(target).output.root_dir == "x"
    assert leftovers(target.parent) == ["config.toml"]


def test_empty_file_gets_the_section_without_a_leading_blank_line(config_file: Path) -> None:
    write(config_file, "")
    set_output_root(config_file, "x")
    assert read(config_file) == '[output]\nroot_dir = "x"\n'


def test_whitespace_only_file(config_file: Path) -> None:
    write(config_file, "\n\n")
    set_output_root(config_file, "x")
    assert load_config(config_file).output.root_dir == "x"


def test_section_is_appended_after_other_sections_with_a_blank_line(config_file: Path) -> None:
    write(config_file, "[telegram]\napi_id = 5\n")
    set_output_root(config_file, "x")
    assert read(config_file) == '[telegram]\napi_id = 5\n\n[output]\nroot_dir = "x"\n'


def test_last_line_without_newline_is_terminated_first(config_file: Path) -> None:
    write(config_file, "[telegram]\napi_id = 5")
    set_output_root(config_file, "x")
    assert read(config_file) == '[telegram]\napi_id = 5\n\n[output]\nroot_dir = "x"\n'


def test_trailing_blank_line_is_not_doubled(config_file: Path) -> None:
    write(config_file, "[telegram]\napi_id = 5\n\n")
    set_output_root(config_file, "x")
    assert read(config_file) == '[telegram]\napi_id = 5\n\n[output]\nroot_dir = "x"\n'


def test_existing_root_dir_is_replaced_and_neighbours_survive(config_file: Path) -> None:
    text = (
        "# my settings\n"
        "[telegram]\n"
        "api_id = 5  # id\n"
        "\n"
        "[output]\n"
        "# where to write\n"
        'root_dir = "old"\n'
        "include_raw = true  # big\n"
        "\n"
        "[live]\n"
        "flush_every_messages = 7\n"
    )
    write(config_file, text)
    set_output_root(config_file, "new")
    assert read(config_file) == text.replace('"old"', '"new"')
    config = load_config(config_file)
    assert config.output.root_dir == "new"
    assert config.output.include_raw is True
    assert config.live.flush_every_messages == 7


def test_output_section_without_root_dir_gets_the_key_after_its_last_key(
    config_file: Path,
) -> None:
    text = (
        "[output]\ninclude_raw = true\nmax_chunk_mb = 5  # c\n\n[live]\nflush_every_seconds = 9\n"
    )
    write(config_file, text)
    set_output_root(config_file, "x")
    assert read(config_file) == (
        '[output]\ninclude_raw = true\nmax_chunk_mb = 5  # c\nroot_dir = "x"\n\n'
        "[live]\nflush_every_seconds = 9\n"
    )


def test_empty_output_section_gets_the_key_right_below_the_header(config_file: Path) -> None:
    write(config_file, "[output]\n[live]\nflush_every_seconds = 9\n")
    set_output_root(config_file, "x")
    assert read(config_file) == '[output]\nroot_dir = "x"\n[live]\nflush_every_seconds = 9\n'


def test_output_section_as_last_block_without_trailing_newline(config_file: Path) -> None:
    write(config_file, "[output]\ninclude_raw = true")
    set_output_root(config_file, "x")
    assert read(config_file) == '[output]\ninclude_raw = true\nroot_dir = "x"\n'


@pytest.mark.parametrize("header", ["[output]", "  [output]", "[ output ]", "[output]   # c"])
def test_header_spellings_are_recognised(config_file: Path, header: str) -> None:
    write(config_file, f"{header}\ninclude_raw = true\n")
    set_output_root(config_file, "x")
    text = read(config_file)
    assert text.count("[output") + text.count("[ output") == 1
    assert load_config(config_file).output.root_dir == "x"


def test_commented_out_header_and_key_are_ignored(config_file: Path) -> None:
    write(config_file, '# [output]\n# root_dir = "no"\n[live]\nflush_every_seconds = 9\n')
    set_output_root(config_file, "x")
    config = load_config(config_file)
    assert config.output.root_dir == "x"
    assert config.live.flush_every_seconds == 9
    assert read(config_file).startswith('# [output]\n# root_dir = "no"\n')


def test_key_that_merely_starts_with_root_dir_is_not_replaced(config_file: Path) -> None:
    write(config_file, "[output]\ninclude_raw = false\n")
    set_output_root(config_file, "a")
    set_output_root(config_file, "b")
    assert read(config_file).count("root_dir") == 1


def test_second_call_replaces_the_first_and_is_idempotent(config_file: Path) -> None:
    set_output_root(config_file, "one")
    set_output_root(config_file, "two")
    after_two = read(config_file)
    set_output_root(config_file, "two")
    assert read(config_file) == after_two
    assert load_config(config_file).output.root_dir == "two"


def test_other_sections_are_never_touched_when_output_is_in_the_middle(config_file: Path) -> None:
    text = (
        '[telegram]\napi_hash = "abc"\n\n[output]\nroot_dir = "old"\n\n'
        "[live]\nflush_every_seconds = 3\n"
    )
    write(config_file, text)
    set_output_root(config_file, "new")
    config = load_config(config_file)
    assert config.telegram.api_hash == "abc"
    assert config.live.flush_every_seconds == 3


def test_crlf_file_stays_crlf_when_replacing(config_file: Path) -> None:
    text = '[output]\r\nroot_dir = "old"\r\ninclude_raw = true\r\n'
    write(config_file, text)
    set_output_root(config_file, "new")
    assert read(config_file) == text.replace("old", "new")


def test_crlf_file_stays_crlf_when_inserting(config_file: Path) -> None:
    write(config_file, "[output]\r\ninclude_raw = true\r\n[live]\r\nflush_every_seconds = 4\r\n")
    set_output_root(config_file, "x")
    text = read(config_file)
    assert text.replace("\r\n", "").count("\n") == 0
    assert load_config(config_file).output.root_dir == "x"


def test_crlf_file_stays_crlf_when_appending_a_section(config_file: Path) -> None:
    write(config_file, "[live]\r\nflush_every_seconds = 4")
    set_output_root(config_file, "x")
    text = read(config_file)
    assert text.replace("\r\n", "").count("\n") == 0
    assert load_config(config_file).output.root_dir == "x"


def test_bom_is_accepted_and_dropped(config_file: Path) -> None:
    config_file.write_bytes(b"\xef\xbb\xbf[live]\nflush_every_seconds = 4\n")
    set_output_root(config_file, "x")
    assert not config_file.read_bytes().startswith(b"\xef\xbb\xbf")
    config = load_config(config_file)
    assert (config.live.flush_every_seconds, config.output.root_dir) == (4, "x")

def test_atomic_failure_keeps_the_original(
    config_file: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    text = '[output]\nroot_dir = "old"\n'
    write(config_file, text)

    def boom(src: object, dst: object) -> None:
        raise OSError("disk full")

    monkeypatch.setattr(os, "replace", boom)
    with pytest.raises(OSError, match="disk full"):
        set_output_root(config_file, "new")
    assert read(config_file) == text
    assert leftovers(config_file.parent) == ["config.toml"]

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import pytest

from chatimport.config import ConfigError, load_config
from chatimport.config_edit import update_config

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pathlib import Path


@pytest.fixture
def config_file(tmp_path: Path) -> Path:
    return tmp_path / "config.toml"


def test_every_literal_kind_is_written_and_parsed(config_file: Path) -> None:
    update_config(
        config_file,
        {
            "media": {"enabled": True, "types": ["photo", "video"], "max_file_mb": 7},
            "backfill": {"use_takeout": False, "pause_between_requests_sec": 0.25},
            "output": {"root_dir": "D:/Data"},
        },
    )
    config = load_config(config_file)
    assert config.media.enabled is True
    assert config.media.types == ("photo", "video")
    assert config.media.max_file_mb == 7
    assert config.backfill.use_takeout is False
    assert config.backfill.pause_between_requests_sec == 0.25
    assert config.output.root_dir == "D:/Data"


def test_bool_false_and_empty_list_literals(config_file: Path) -> None:
    update_config(config_file, {"media": {"enabled": False, "types": []}})
    text = config_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "enabled = false" in text
    assert "types = []" in text


@pytest.mark.parametrize("value", [float("nan"), float("inf"), float("-inf")])
def test_non_finite_numbers_are_refused(config_file: Path, value: float) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ConfigError, match="finite"):
        update_config(config_file, {"backfill": {"pause_between_requests_sec": value}})
    assert not config_file.exists()

def test_invalid_section_names_are_refused(config_file: Path, section: str) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ConfigError, match="invalid section name"):
        update_config(config_file, {section: {"key": 1}})

def test_invalid_key_names_are_refused(config_file: Path, key: str) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ConfigError, match="invalid key name"):
        update_config(config_file, {"output": {key: 1}})


def test_a_section_without_values_changes_nothing(config_file: Path) -> None:

    update_config(config_file, {"output": {}, "media": {}})
    assert config_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8") == "[output]\nmax_chunk_mb = 5\n"

    config_file.write_text("[output]\nmax_chunk_mb = 5\n", encoding="utf-8")

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from chatimport.config import Config, ConfigError, SearchConfig, load_config, parse_config

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]


def test_search_is_on_by_default_and_checks_every_five_seconds() -> None:
    assert Config().search == SearchConfig(True, 5)


def test_a_search_section_is_parsed() -> None:
    config = parse_config({"search": {"enabled": False, "interval_seconds": 30}})
    assert config.search == SearchConfig(False, 30)


def test_a_partial_section_keeps_the_other_default() -> None:
    assert parse_config({"search": {"enabled": False}}).search == SearchConfig(False, 5)
    assert parse_config({"search": {"interval_seconds": 1}}).search == SearchConfig(True, 1)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("value", [0, -1, -60])
def test_an_interval_below_one_second_is_rejected(value: int) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ConfigError, match=r"\[search\] interval_seconds must be at least 1"):
        parse_config({"search": {"interval_seconds": value}})


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "section",
    [
        {"enabled": "yes"},
        {"enabled": 1},
        {"interval_seconds": "5"},
        {"interval_seconds": 2.5},
        {"interval_seconds": True},
        {"nope": 1},
    ],
)
def test_wrong_types_and_keys_are_rejected(section: dict[str, object]) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ConfigError):
        parse_config({"search": section})


def test_a_search_section_must_be_a_table() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ConfigError, match=r"\[search\] must be a table"):
        parse_config({"search": 3})


def test_the_example_file_documents_the_defaults() -> None:
    text = (REPO / "config.example.toml").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "[search]" in text
    assert load_config(REPO / "config.example.toml").search == SearchConfig()

from __future__ import annotations

from chatimport.config import GIB, MIB, DiskConfig, MediaConfig, OutputConfig, parse_config


def test_units_are_binary() -> None:
    assert MIB == 1024 * 1024
    assert GIB == 1024 * MIB


def test_derived_byte_sizes_follow_the_configured_values() -> None:
    config = parse_config(
        {
            "output": {"max_chunk_mb": 3},
            "disk": {"low_watermark_gb": 2, "high_watermark_gb": 4},
            "media": {"max_file_mb": 7},
        }
    )
    assert config.output.max_chunk_bytes == 3 * MIB
    assert config.disk.low_bytes == 2 * GIB
    assert config.disk.high_bytes == 4 * GIB
    assert config.media.max_file_bytes == 7 * MIB


def test_derived_sizes_of_the_defaults() -> None:
    assert OutputConfig().max_chunk_bytes == 20 * MIB
    assert (DiskConfig().low_bytes, DiskConfig().high_bytes) == (15 * GIB, 17 * GIB)
    assert MediaConfig().max_file_bytes == 50 * MIB

"""Branches of recently fixed code that the area suites do not reach on their own."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import pytest

from chatimport.config import ConfigError, parse_config
from chatimport.library import add_entry, load_library, set_enabled
from chatimport.media import _identity  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pathlib import Path

BACKSLASH = chr(92)


def test_negative_pause_between_chats_is_rejected() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ConfigError, match="pause_between_chats_sec"):
        parse_config({"backfill": {"pause_between_chats_sec": -1}})


def test_identity_of_a_missing_file_has_size_minus_one(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    assert _identity(tmp_path / "missing.jsonl") == (-1, 0)


def test_set_enabled_survives_escapes_and_quotes_inside_other_strings(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    path = tmp_path / "chats.toml"
    lines = [
        "[[chat]]",
        'ref = "@first"',
        'name = "a ' + BACKSLASH + '" b' + BACKSLASH + 'n"',
        "note_like = 'single # not a comment'",
        "",
        "[[chat]]",
        'ref = "@second"',
    ]
    path.write_text(chr(10).join(lines) + chr(10), encoding="utf-8")
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").replace("note_like = 'single # not a comment'", "")
    path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")

    set_enabled(path, "@second", False)

    entries = load_library(path).entries
    assert [(e.ref, e.enabled) for e in entries] == [("@first", True), ("@second", False)]


def test_set_enabled_handles_single_quoted_literal_strings(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    path = tmp_path / "chats.toml"
    body = chr(10).join(["[[chat]]", "ref = '@lit'", "name = 'plain # not a comment'"])
    path.write_text(body + chr(10), encoding="utf-8")

    set_enabled(path, "@lit", False)

    entry = load_library(path).entries[0]
    assert (entry.name, entry.enabled) == ("plain # not a comment", False)


def test_set_enabled_ignores_keys_that_live_inside_a_multiline_string(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    path = tmp_path / "chats.toml"
    body = chr(10).join(
        [
            "[[chat]]",
            'ref = "@only"',
            'name = """',
            "enabled = false",
            "text with " + BACKSLASH + 'u0041 escape and ""',
            '"""',
        ]
    )
    path.write_text(body + chr(10), encoding="utf-8")

    set_enabled(path, "@only", False)

    entry = load_library(path).entries[0]
    assert entry.enabled is False
    assert "enabled = false" in (entry.name or "")


def test_multiline_literal_string_with_a_header_lookalike_is_skipped(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    path = tmp_path / "chats.toml"
    add_entry(path, "@a", "x")
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    path.write_text(
        text.replace('name = "x"', "name = '''" + chr(10) + "[[chat]]" + chr(10) + "'''"),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    add_entry(path, "@b")

    set_enabled(path, "@b", False)

    assert [(e.ref, e.enabled) for e in load_library(path).entries] == [
        ("@a", True),
        ("@b", False),
    ]

from __future__ import annotations

import os
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pytest

from chatimport.library import (
    ChatEntry,
    Library,
    LibraryChange,
    LibraryError,
    LibraryWatcher,
    diff_libraries,
    load_library,
    parse_library,
)

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]


def lib(*entries: ChatEntry) -> Library:
    return Library(entries=tuple(entries))


def bump_mtime(path: Path, seconds: int = 5) -> None:
    stat = path.stat()
    os.utime(path, ns=(stat.st_atime_ns, stat.st_mtime_ns + seconds * 1_000_000_000))


def test_empty_text_is_an_empty_library() -> None:
    assert parse_library("") == Library()


def test_comments_only_is_an_empty_library() -> None:
    assert parse_library("# only a comment\n") == Library()


def test_example_template_parses() -> None:
    parse_library((REPO / "chats.example.toml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def test_entries_keep_file_order_and_defaults() -> None:
    library = parse_library(
        '[[chat]]\nref = "b"\n[[chat]]\nref = "a"\nname = "N"\nenabled = false\n'
    )
    assert library.entries == (ChatEntry("b"), ChatEntry("a", "N", False))


def test_ref_and_name_are_stripped() -> None:
    library = parse_library('[[chat]]\nref = "  @x  "\nname = "  My name \\t"\n')
    assert library.entries == (ChatEntry("@x", "My name"),)


def test_inline_array_of_tables_is_accepted() -> None:
    library = parse_library('chat = [{ref = "a"}, {ref = "b", enabled = false}]\n')
    assert [e.ref for e in library.entries] == ["a", "b"]


def test_unicode_ref_and_name() -> None:
    library = parse_library(
        '[[chat]]\nref = "\u0427\u0430\u0442 \U0001f600"\nname = "\u540d\u524d"\n'
    )
    assert library.entries[0].ref == "\u0427\u0430\u0442 \U0001f600"
    assert library.entries[0].name == "\u540d\u524d"


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "text",
    [
        "[[chat]\nref = 'a'\n",
        'ref = "unterminated\n',
        "[[chat]]\nref = a\n",
        '[[chat]]\nref = "a"\nref = "b"\n',
        "\x00",
    ],
)
def test_invalid_toml_is_a_library_error(text: str) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(LibraryError, match="invalid TOML"):
        parse_library(text)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "text", ['title = "x"\n', "chats = []\n", "[other]\na = 1\n", "Chat = []\n"]
)
def test_unknown_top_level_keys_are_rejected(text: str) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(LibraryError, match="unknown top-level"):
        parse_library(text)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "text", ["chat = 1\n", 'chat = "x"\n', "[chat]\nref = 'a'\n", "chat = true\n"]
)
def test_chat_must_be_an_array_of_tables(text: str) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(LibraryError, match="array of tables"):
        parse_library(text)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("text", ["chat = [1]\n", 'chat = ["a"]\n', "chat = [[1]]\n"])
def test_entries_must_be_tables(text: str) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(LibraryError, match="expected a table"):
        parse_library(text)


def test_unknown_entry_keys_are_listed_with_the_entry_label() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(LibraryError, match=r"chat entry #1 \(a\): unknown key\(s\) colour, size"):
        parse_library('[[chat]]\nref = "a"\nsize = 1\ncolour = 2\n')


@pytest.mark.parametrize(

        "name = 'x'\n",

def test_ref_must_be_a_non_empty_string(block: str) -> None:

def test_name_must_be_a_non_empty_string_when_present(name: str) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(LibraryError, match="'name' must be a non-empty string"):
        parse_library(f'[[chat]]\nref = "a"\nname = {name}\n')

        parse_library(text)


def test_same_ref_even_if_one_copy_is_disabled_is_a_duplicate() -> None:

    first: str, second: str
) -> None:
    text = f'[[chat]]\nref = "{first}"\n[[chat]]\nref = "{second}"\n'

def test_enabled_entries_filters_disabled_ones_in_order() -> None:
    library = lib(ChatEntry("a"), ChatEntry("b", enabled=False), ChatEntry("c"))
    assert [e.ref for e in library.enabled_entries()] == ["a", "c"]


def test_find_by_ref_strips_and_matches_the_same_chat_in_any_case() -> None:
    library = lib(ChatEntry("@Name", "Alpha"), ChatEntry("other"))
    assert library.find("  @Name ") is library.entries[0]
    assert library.find("@name") is library.entries[0]
    assert library.find("https://t.me/NAME") is library.entries[0]
    assert library.find("@other") is None
    assert library.find("") is None


def test_find_by_name_is_case_insensitive_and_unicode_aware() -> None:
    library = lib(ChatEntry("r1", "Stra\u00dfe"), ChatEntry("r2", "\u0427\u0430\u0442"))
    assert library.find("STRASSE") is library.entries[0]
    assert library.find("\u0447\u0430\u0442") is library.entries[1]


def test_find_prefers_ref_match_over_name_match() -> None:
    library = lib(ChatEntry("r1", "x"), ChatEntry("x", "other"))
    assert library.find("x") is library.entries[1]


def test_find_returns_first_of_equal_names() -> None:
    library = lib(ChatEntry("r1", "Same"), ChatEntry("r2", "same"))
    assert library.find("SAME") is library.entries[0]


def test_find_does_not_match_entries_without_a_name_by_none() -> None:
    assert lib(ChatEntry("r1")).find("none") is None

    path.write_bytes(b'\xef\xbb\xbf[[chat]]\r\nref = "a"\r\nname = "N"\r\n')

def test_diff_of_identical_libraries_is_empty() -> None:
    library = lib(ChatEntry("a", "A"), ChatEntry("b", enabled=False))
    change = diff_libraries(library, library)
    assert change.is_empty
    assert change == LibraryChange()


def test_diff_empty_to_empty() -> None:
    assert diff_libraries(Library(), Library()).is_empty


def test_diff_reports_added_enabled_entries() -> None:
    change = diff_libraries(lib(ChatEntry("a")), lib(ChatEntry("a"), ChatEntry("b")))
    assert change.added == (ChatEntry("b"),)
    assert not change.removed


def test_diff_ignores_added_disabled_entries() -> None:
    change = diff_libraries(Library(), lib(ChatEntry("b", enabled=False)))
    assert change.is_empty


def test_diff_reports_removed_enabled_entries() -> None:
    change = diff_libraries(lib(ChatEntry("a"), ChatEntry("b")), lib(ChatEntry("a")))
    assert change.removed == (ChatEntry("b"),)


def test_diff_ignores_removed_disabled_entries() -> None:
    change = diff_libraries(lib(ChatEntry("a", enabled=False)), Library())
    assert change.is_empty


def test_diff_reports_disable_and_enable() -> None:
    old = lib(ChatEntry("a"), ChatEntry("b", enabled=False))
    new = lib(ChatEntry("a", enabled=False), ChatEntry("b"))
    change = diff_libraries(old, new)
    assert change.disabled == (ChatEntry("a", enabled=False),)
    assert change.enabled == (ChatEntry("b"),)
    assert not change.added
    assert not change.removed
    assert not change.renamed


def test_diff_reports_rename_from_none_to_a_name_and_back() -> None:
    assert diff_libraries(lib(ChatEntry("a")), lib(ChatEntry("a", "N"))).renamed == (
        ChatEntry("a", "N"),
    )
    assert diff_libraries(lib(ChatEntry("a", "N")), lib(ChatEntry("a"))).renamed == (
        ChatEntry("a"),
    )


def test_diff_rename_with_only_a_case_change_is_a_rename() -> None:
    change = diff_libraries(lib(ChatEntry("a", "N")), lib(ChatEntry("a", "n")))
    assert len(change.renamed) == 1


def test_diff_reenable_and_rename_are_both_reported() -> None:
    old = lib(ChatEntry("a", "Old", enabled=False))
    new = lib(ChatEntry("a", "New"))
    change = diff_libraries(old, new)
    assert change.enabled == (ChatEntry("a", "New"),)
    assert change.renamed == (ChatEntry("a", "New"),)
    assert not change.added


def test_diff_disable_and_rename_are_both_reported() -> None:
    old = lib(ChatEntry("a", "Old"))
    new = lib(ChatEntry("a", "New", enabled=False))
    change = diff_libraries(old, new)
    assert change.disabled == (ChatEntry("a", "New", enabled=False),)
    assert change.renamed == (ChatEntry("a", "New", enabled=False),)


def test_diff_rename_of_a_disabled_entry_is_still_reported() -> None:
    old = lib(ChatEntry("a", "Old", enabled=False))
    new = lib(ChatEntry("a", "New", enabled=False))
    change = diff_libraries(old, new)
    assert change.renamed == (ChatEntry("a", "New", enabled=False),)
    assert not change.enabled
    assert not change.disabled


def test_diff_matches_entries_by_stripped_ref_not_position() -> None:
    old = lib(ChatEntry("a"), ChatEntry("b"))
    new = lib(ChatEntry("b"), ChatEntry("a"))
    assert diff_libraries(old, new).is_empty


def test_diff_combined_changes_are_all_present() -> None:
    old = lib(
        ChatEntry("keep"), ChatEntry("gone"), ChatEntry("off"), ChatEntry("on", enabled=False)
    )
    new = lib(ChatEntry("keep"), ChatEntry("off", enabled=False), ChatEntry("on"), ChatEntry("new"))
    change = diff_libraries(old, new)
    assert [e.ref for e in change.added] == ["new"]
    assert [e.ref for e in change.removed] == ["gone"]
    assert [e.ref for e in change.disabled] == ["off"]
    assert [e.ref for e in change.enabled] == ["on"]
    assert not change.is_empty

    entry = (ChatEntry("a"),)
    for field in ("added", "removed", "disabled", "enabled", "renamed"):
        kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {field: entry}
        assert not LibraryChange(**kwargs).is_empty


def test_chat_entry_key_is_the_stripped_ref() -> None:

def test_watcher_does_not_reread_when_signature_is_unchanged(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    path = tmp_path / "chats.toml"
    write(path, '[[chat]]\nref = "a"\n')
    watcher = LibraryWatcher(path)
    watcher.load_initial()
    reads: list[Path] = []

    def spy(p: Path) -> Library:
        reads.append(p)
        return Library()

    monkeypatch.setattr("chatimport.library.load_library", spy)
    watcher.check()
    assert reads == []


def test_watcher_detects_replacement_by_equal_size_content(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    path = tmp_path / "chats.toml"
    write(path, '[[chat]]\nref = "aaa"\n')
    watcher = LibraryWatcher(path)
    watcher.load_initial()
    write(path, '[[chat]]\nref = "bbb"\n')
    bump_mtime(path)
    change = watcher.check()
    assert change is not None
    assert [e.ref for e in change.added] == ["bbb"]
    assert [e.ref for e in change.removed] == ["aaa"]


def test_watcher_detects_a_size_change_with_same_mtime(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    path = tmp_path / "chats.toml"
    write(path, '[[chat]]\nref = "a"\n')
    watcher = LibraryWatcher(path)
    watcher.load_initial()
    before = path.stat()
    write(path, '[[chat]]\nref = "a"\n[[chat]]\nref = "b"\n')
    os.utime(path, ns=(before.st_atime_ns, before.st_mtime_ns))
    change = watcher.check()
    assert change is not None
    assert [e.ref for e in change.added] == ["b"]

    watcher = LibraryWatcher(path)
    watcher.load_initial()
    bump_mtime(path)
    assert watcher.check() is None
    assert watcher.check() is None


def test_watcher_keeps_previous_library_on_syntax_error_and_reports_it(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    path = tmp_path / "chats.toml"
    write(path, '[[chat]]\nref = "a"\n')
    watcher = LibraryWatcher(path)
    watcher.load_initial()
    write(path, '[[chat]]\nref = "a\n')
    bump_mtime(path)
    assert watcher.check() is None
    assert watcher.last_error is not None
    assert watcher.current.entries == (ChatEntry("a"),)
    assert watcher.check() is None
    assert watcher.last_error is not None


def test_watcher_recovers_after_error_when_fixed(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    path = tmp_path / "chats.toml"
    write(path, '[[chat]]\nref = "a"\n')
    watcher = LibraryWatcher(path)
    watcher.load_initial()
    write(path, "garbage [[[")
    bump_mtime(path, 5)
    assert watcher.check() is None
    write(path, '[[chat]]\nref = "a"\n[[chat]]\nref = "b"\n')
    bump_mtime(path, 10)
    change = watcher.check()
    assert change is not None
    assert [e.ref for e in change.added] == ["b"]

class UnstatablePath(type(Path())):
    def stat(self, *, follow_symlinks: bool = True) -> os.stat_result:
        raise PermissionError("denied")


def test_watcher_stat_failure_is_reported_not_raised_by_check(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    watcher = LibraryWatcher(UnstatablePath(tmp_path / "chats.toml"))
    assert watcher.check() is None
    assert watcher.last_error is not None
    assert "cannot stat" in watcher.last_error


def test_watcher_initial_stat_failure_raises_library_error(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    watcher = LibraryWatcher(UnstatablePath(tmp_path / "chats.toml"))
    with pytest.raises(LibraryError, match="cannot stat"):
        watcher.load_initial()
    assert watcher.last_error is not None


def test_watcher_reports_rename_and_disable_in_one_change(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    path = tmp_path / "chats.toml"
    write(path, '[[chat]]\nref = "a"\nname = "Old"\n')
    watcher = LibraryWatcher(path)
    watcher.load_initial()
    write(path, '[[chat]]\nref = "a"\nname = "New"\nenabled = false\n')
    bump_mtime(path)
    change = watcher.check()
    assert change is not None
    assert len(change.disabled) == 1
    assert len(change.renamed) == 1

    add_entry(path, link)
    with pytest.raises(LibraryError) as again:
        add_entry(path, link)
    with pytest.raises(LibraryError) as missing:
        set_enabled(path, f"https://t.me/+{SECRET}X", False)
    for error in (again.value, missing.value):
        assert SECRET not in str(error)


def test_unlocatable_block_error_masks_the_invite_hash(path: Path) -> None:
    path.write_text(f'chat = [{{ref = "https://t.me/+{SECRET}"}}]\n', encoding="utf-8")
    with pytest.raises(LibraryError, match="cannot locate") as error:
        set_enabled(path, f"https://t.me/+{SECRET}", False)
    assert SECRET not in str(error.value)

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import logging.handlers
import sys
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import pytest

from chatimport.logging_setup import (
    BACKUP_COUNT,
    LOG_FILE,
    MAX_BYTES,
    ExtraFormatter,
    configure_logging,
)

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Iterator
    from pathlib import Path

CYRILLIC = "".join(map(chr, (0x41F, 0x440, 0x438, 0x432, 0x435, 0x442)))


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def restore_logging() -> Iterator[None]:
    root = logging.getLogger()
    handlers, level = list(root.handlers), root.level
    quiet = {name: logging.getLogger(name).level for name in ("telethon", "asyncio")}
    yield
    for handler in list(root.handlers):
        if handler not in handlers:
            root.removeHandler(handler)
            handler.close()
    root.setLevel(level)
    for name, value in quiet.items():
        logging.getLogger(name).setLevel(value)


def owned(kind: type[logging.Handler]) -> list[logging.Handler]:
    """Handlers installed by `configure_logging`; a file handler is not counted as a stream."""
    return [
        h
        for h in logging.getLogger().handlers
        if type(h).__module__ == "chatimport.logging_setup"
        and isinstance(h, kind)
        and (kind is not logging.StreamHandler or not isinstance(h, logging.FileHandler))
    ]


def test_file_log_rotates_is_utf8_and_carries_the_extras(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    configure_logging(tmp_path / "logs", console=False)
    logging.getLogger("chatimport.test").warning(
        "x %s", CYRILLIC, extra={"chat_id": 5, "part": "2026-10_001"}
    )
    (handler,) = owned(logging.handlers.RotatingFileHandler)
    assert isinstance(handler, logging.handlers.RotatingFileHandler)
    handler.flush()
    assert handler.maxBytes == MAX_BYTES > 0
    assert handler.backupCount == BACKUP_COUNT
    text = (tmp_path / "logs" / LOG_FILE).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert f"WARNING chatimport.test: x {CYRILLIC} chat_id=5 part=2026-10_001" in text
    assert "Z WARNING" in text


def test_calling_twice_replaces_the_handlers_instead_of_adding(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    configure_logging(tmp_path, console=True)
    configure_logging(tmp_path, console=True, level="debug")
    assert len(owned(logging.handlers.RotatingFileHandler)) == 1
    assert len(owned(logging.StreamHandler)) == 1
    assert logging.getLogger().level == logging.DEBUG
    assert logging.getLogger("telethon").level == logging.WARNING


def test_console_only_and_no_console_under_pythonw(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    configure_logging(None, console=True)
    assert owned(logging.handlers.RotatingFileHandler) == []
    assert len(owned(logging.StreamHandler)) == 1
    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "stderr", None)
    configure_logging(None, console=True)
    assert owned(logging.StreamHandler) == []
    assert not (tmp_path / LOG_FILE).exists()


def test_formatter_without_extras_and_with_a_traceback() -> None:
    formatter = ExtraFormatter()
    plain = logging.makeLogRecord({"msg": "hello", "levelname": "INFO", "name": "n"})
    assert formatter.format(plain).endswith("INFO n: hello")
    try:
        raise ValueError("boom")
    except ValueError:
        failed = logging.makeLogRecord(
            {"msg": "bad", "levelname": "ERROR", "name": "n", "exc_info": sys.exc_info(), "x": 1}
        )
    head, _, rest = formatter.format(failed).partition("\n")
    assert head.endswith("ERROR n: bad x=1")
    assert "ValueError: boom" in rest

    assert "set-root" in warning


def test_the_environment_defaults_to_the_process_environment(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.setenv("OneDrive", str(tmp_path / "cloud"))
    monkeypatch.delenv("OneDriveConsumer", raising=False)
    monkeypatch.delenv("OneDriveCommercial", raising=False)
    assert is_cloud_synced(tmp_path / "cloud" / "x")
    assert not is_cloud_synced(tmp_path / "local" / "x")


@pytest.mark.skipif(sys.platform == "win32", reason="POSIX permission bits")
def test_app_folders_are_private_on_posix(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    base = tmp_path / "app"
    base.mkdir(mode=0o755)
    app = app_paths(base)
    app.ensure()
    for folder in (app.base, app.session_file.parent):
        assert stat.S_IMODE(folder.stat().st_mode) & 0o077 == 0


def test_posix_branch_restricts_base_and_session_and_tolerates_chmod_errors(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    from pathlib import Path as RealPath

    changed: list[tuple[str, int]] = []

    def chmod(self: RealPath, mode: int, *, follow_symlinks: bool = True) -> None:
        changed.append((self.name, mode))
        if self.name == "session":
            raise PermissionError("not the owner")

    monkeypatch.setattr(paths.sys, "platform", "linux")
    monkeypatch.setattr(RealPath, "chmod", chmod)
    app = app_paths(tmp_path / "app")
    app.ensure()
    assert changed == [("app", 0o700), ("session", 0o700)]


@pytest.mark.skipif(sys.platform != "win32", reason="Windows keeps the inherited ACL")
def test_app_folders_are_created_on_windows(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    app = app_paths(tmp_path / "app")
    app.ensure()
    assert all(p.is_dir() for p in (app.base, app.session_file.parent, app.log_dir))

from __future__ import annotations

    KIND_EDIT,

T0 = datetime(2026, 10, 29, 21, 3, 11, tzinfo=UTC)
T1 = datetime(2026, 10, 29, 21, 10, 2, tzinfo=UTC)
T2 = datetime(2026, 10, 29, 21, 11, 0, tzinfo=UTC)

FULL_MEDIA = MediaInfo(
    type="video",
    mime="video/mp4",
    size=2**40,
    duration=12,
    width=640,
    height=480,
    file_name="\u0432\u0438\u0434\u0435\u043e.mp4",
    file="2026-10/42.mp4",
)


def full_message(**overrides: Any) -> MessageRecord:
    base: dict[str, Any] = {
        "chat_id": -1001234567890,
        "msg_id": 4512,
        "date": T0,
        "fetched_at": T1,
        "text": "hello",
        "edit_date": T1,
        "sender_id": 777000111,
        "sender_name": "Example Person",
        "sender_username": "example_user",
        "reply_to_msg_id": 4507,
        "topic_id": 12,
        "grouped_id": 2**62,
        "forwarded": True,
        "service": "pin",
        "link": "https://t.me/c/1234567890/4512",
        "media": FULL_MEDIA,
    }
    base.update(overrides)
    return MessageRecord(**base)


ALL_RECORDS: list[Record] = [
    full_message(),
    MessageRecord(chat_id=1, msg_id=1, date=T0, fetched_at=T0),

]

@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "text",
    [
        "",
        " ",
        "line1\nline2",
        "crlf\r\nline",
        "lone\rcr",
        "\n",

        "nul\x00inside",
        "esc\x1b[0m",
        "\x7fdel",
        'quote" and \\ backslash',
        "\u0420\u0443\u0441\u0441\u043a\u0438\u0439 \u0442\u0435\u043a\u0441\u0442",
        "\U0001f600 emoji \U0001f468\u200d\U0001f469\u200d\U0001f467",

        "\u4e2d\u6587",

    ],

def test_text_survives_and_never_breaks_the_line(text: str) -> None:
    record = full_message(text=text)
    line = record_to_line(record)
    assert "\n" not in line
    assert "\r" not in line
    assert line.encode("utf-8").decode("utf-8") == line
    restored = record_from_line(line)
    assert isinstance(restored, MessageRecord)
    assert restored.text == text


def test_line_written_as_text_file_reads_back_as_exactly_one_line(tmp_path: Any) -> None:
    text = "a\nb\r\nc\u2028d\x00"
    path = tmp_path / "x.jsonl"
    with path.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as handle:
        handle.write(record_to_line(full_message(text=text)) + "\n")
    with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        lines = list(handle)
    assert len(lines) == 1
    restored = record_from_line(lines[0])
    assert isinstance(restored, MessageRecord)
    assert restored.text == text

def test_format_dt_always_uses_z_suffix() -> None:
    assert format_dt(T0) == "2026-10-29T21:03:11Z"
    assert "+00:00" not in format_dt(T0)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("offset_hours", "offset_minutes"), [(5, 30), (-3, 0), (14, 0), (-12, 0), (0, 45)]
)
def test_non_utc_offsets_are_normalised_to_the_same_instant(
    offset_hours: int, offset_minutes: int
) -> None:
    zone = timezone(timedelta(hours=offset_hours, minutes=offset_minutes))
    local = T0.astimezone(zone)
    assert local.utcoffset() != timedelta(0) or offset_hours == 0
    text = format_dt(local)
    assert text.endswith("Z")
    assert parse_dt(text) == T0


def test_day_boundary_is_decided_in_utc() -> None:
    zone = timezone(timedelta(hours=-3))
    local = datetime(2026, 1, 31, 22, 0, 0, tzinfo=zone)
    assert format_dt(local) == "2026-02-01T01:00:00Z"

    zone = timezone(timedelta(hours=9))

    restored = record_from_line(record_to_line(record))
    assert isinstance(restored, MessageRecord)
    assert restored.date == record.date
    assert restored.date.utcoffset() == timedelta(0)

    assert format_dt(naive) == format_dt(naive.astimezone(UTC))

from __future__ import annotations

import json

import pytest

from chatimport.records import (
    DECODE_ERRORS,
    MessageRecord,
    escape_line_breaks,
    json_line,
    json_line_bytes,
    record_from_line,
    record_to_bytes,
    record_to_line,
)
from tests.fakes import msg

LINE_BREAKS = chr(0x2028) + chr(0x2029) + chr(0x85)
CYRILLIC = "".join(map(chr, (0x41F, 0x440, 0x438, 0x432, 0x435, 0x442)))


def test_record_line_has_no_unicode_line_breaks_and_round_trips() -> None:
    record = msg(1, text=f"a{chr(0x2028)}b{chr(0x2029)}c{chr(0x85)}d {CYRILLIC}")
    line = record_to_line(record)
    assert len(line.splitlines()) == 1
    assert not set(LINE_BREAKS) & set(line)
    assert CYRILLIC in line
    decoded = record_from_line(line)
    assert isinstance(decoded, MessageRecord)
    assert decoded.text == record.text


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "text",
    ["plain", CYRILLIC, "emoji \U0001f600", f"breaks {LINE_BREAKS}", "lone \ud800 surrogate"],
)
def test_record_to_bytes_equals_the_encoded_line(text: str) -> None:
    record = msg(7, text=text)
    assert record_to_bytes(record) == (record_to_line(record) + "\n").encode("utf-8")


def test_lone_surrogates_become_the_replacement_character_only_when_present() -> None:
    assert json_line({"t": "a\ud800b"}) == '{"t":"a' + chr(0xFFFD) + 'b"}'
    assert json_line({"t": "ab"}) == '{"t":"ab"}'


def test_json_line_bytes_ends_with_exactly_one_newline() -> None:
    data = json_line_bytes({"k": [1, 2]})
    assert data == b'{"k":[1,2]}\n'


def test_escape_line_breaks_keeps_the_json_value() -> None:
    text = json.dumps({"t": LINE_BREAKS}, ensure_ascii=False)
    escaped = escape_line_breaks(text)
    assert escaped != text
    assert json.loads(escaped) == json.loads(text)
    assert escape_line_breaks("{}") == "{}"


def test_deeply_nested_line_raises_one_of_the_decode_errors() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(DECODE_ERRORS):
        record_from_line("[" * 100_000 + "]" * 100_000)

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from chatimport.refs import ParsedRef, RefKind, display_ref, parse_ref
from chatimport.telegram import resolve

CAFE_NFC = "Caf\u00e9 Espa\u00f1a"
CAFE_NFD = "Cafe\u0301 Espan\u0303a"


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "ref",
    ["@Foo_bar", "t.me/foo_bar", "https://telegram.me/FOO_BAR", "https://t.me/foo_bar?x=1"],
)
def test_public_refs_of_one_chat_share_one_identity(ref: str) -> None:
    assert parse_ref(ref).identity == "@foo_bar"
    assert parse_ref(ref).username == "foo_bar"


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("ref", "identity"),
    [
        ("https://t.me/+AbCdEf", "invite:AbCdEf"),
        ("t.me/joinchat/AbCdEf", "invite:AbCdEf"),
        ("-1001234567890", "-1001234567890"),
        ("https://t.me/c/1234567890/5", "-1001234567890"),
        ("  Book Club ", "Book Club"),
        ("@ab", "@ab"),
    ],
)
def test_identity_of_other_kinds(ref: str, identity: str) -> None:
    assert parse_ref(ref).identity == identity


def test_invite_hashes_keep_their_case() -> None:
    assert parse_ref("t.me/+AbC").identity != parse_ref("t.me/+abc").identity


def test_title_identity_ignores_the_unicode_form_of_accents() -> None:
    assert CAFE_NFC != CAFE_NFD
    assert parse_ref(CAFE_NFC).identity == parse_ref(CAFE_NFD).identity


def test_only_public_refs_have_a_username() -> None:
    assert parse_ref("Some title").username is None
    assert parse_ref("-5").username is None


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("ref", "shown"),
    [
        ("https://t.me/+SECRETHASH123", "t.me/+SEC..."),
        ("  t.me/joinchat/SECRETHASH123 ", "t.me/+SEC..."),
        ("@public_name", "@public_name"),
        (" -100555 ", "-100555"),
        ("Plain title", "Plain title"),
    ],
)
def test_display_ref_masks_only_invite_hashes(ref: str, shown: str) -> None:
    assert display_ref(ref) == shown


def test_resolve_module_re_exports_the_parser() -> None:
    assert resolve.parse_ref is parse_ref
    assert resolve.ParsedRef is ParsedRef
    assert resolve.RefKind is RefKind

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import importlib
import importlib.metadata
import logging
import shutil
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any

import pytest

import chatimport
from chatimport.ports import (
    AccessLost,
    ChatImportError,
    FloodWait,
    ResolvedChat,
    ResolveStatus,
    SessionRevoked,
)
from chatimport.runtime import (
    ChatRegistry,
    Level,
    LogNotifier,
    SystemClock,
    SystemDiskUsage,
)

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Callable


class StubController:
    def __init__(self, chat_id: int) -> None:
        self._chat_id = chat_id
        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()

    @property
    def chat_id(self) -> int:
        return self._chat_id

    @property
    def lock(self) -> asyncio.Lock:
        return self._lock


def recorder(asked: list[Path], free: int) -> Callable[[Path], Any]:
    def disk_usage(path: Path) -> Any:
        asked.append(Path(path))
        return SimpleNamespace(free=free)

    return disk_usage


def never_exists(self: Path) -> bool:
    return False


def registry_with(*ids: int) -> tuple[ChatRegistry, dict[int, StubController]]:
    registry = ChatRegistry()
    controllers = {i: StubController(i) for i in ids}
    for controller in controllers.values():
        registry.add(controller)  # type: ignore[arg-type]  # pyright: ignore[reportArgumentType]
    return registry, controllers


def test_flood_wait_carries_seconds_and_message() -> None:

    assert error.seconds == 754
    assert "754" in str(error)
    assert isinstance(error, ChatImportError)


def test_access_lost_carries_chat_id_and_message() -> None:

    assert error.chat_id == -1001
    assert "-1001" in str(error)
    assert isinstance(error, ChatImportError)


def test_session_revoked_is_a_handled_error() -> None:
    assert issubclass(SessionRevoked, ChatImportError)
    assert not issubclass(SessionRevoked, FloodWait)
    assert not issubclass(AccessLost, FloodWait)


def test_ports_errors_are_distinguishable_by_except_clauses() -> None:
    caught: list[str] = []
    for error in (FloodWait(1), AccessLost(1), SessionRevoked("x")):
        try:
            raise error
        except FloodWait:
            caught.append("flood")
        except AccessLost:
            caught.append("access")
        except SessionRevoked:
            caught.append("session")
    assert caught == ["flood", "access", "session"]

def test_registry_add_get_len_and_order() -> None:
    registry, controllers = registry_with(5, -3, 9)
    assert len(registry) == 3
    assert registry.get(-3) is controllers[-3]
    assert [c.chat_id for c in registry] == [5, -3, 9]
    assert [c.chat_id for c in registry.all()] == [5, -3, 9]


def test_registry_add_with_same_id_replaces_in_place() -> None:
    registry, controllers = registry_with(1, 2, 3)
    replacement = StubController(2)
    registry.add(replacement)  # type: ignore[arg-type]  # pyright: ignore[reportArgumentType]
    assert len(registry) == 3
    assert registry.get(2) is replacement
    assert registry.get(2) is not controllers[2]
    assert [c.chat_id for c in registry] == [1, 2, 3]

    assert registry.remove(1) is controllers[1]
    assert registry.get(1) is None
    assert len(registry) == 1

    assert registry.remove(99) is None
    assert registry.remove(1) is not None
    assert registry.remove(1) is None
    assert len(registry) == 0


def test_registry_iteration_is_a_snapshot_safe_against_removal() -> None:
    registry, _ = registry_with(1, 2, 3)
    seen: list[int] = []
    for controller in registry:
        seen.append(controller.chat_id)
        registry.remove(controller.chat_id)
    assert seen == [1, 2, 3]
    assert len(registry) == 0


def test_registry_all_returns_a_copy() -> None:
    registry, _ = registry_with(1)
    registry.all().clear()
    assert len(registry) == 1


def test_registry_distinguishes_huge_and_negative_ids() -> None:
    registry, controllers = registry_with(-(2**63), 2**63, 0)
    assert registry.get(-(2**63)) is controllers[-(2**63)]
    assert registry.get(2**63) is controllers[2**63]
    assert registry.get(0) is controllers[0]


def test_disk_usage_reports_free_bytes_of_existing_path(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    expected = shutil.disk_usage(tmp_path).free
    reported = SystemDiskUsage().free_bytes(tmp_path)
    assert reported > 0
    assert abs(reported - expected) < 50 * 1024 * 1024


def test_disk_usage_walks_up_from_a_missing_path(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    asked: list[Path] = []

    def fake(path: Path) -> Any:
        asked.append(Path(path))
        return SimpleNamespace(free=123)

    monkeypatch.setattr("chatimport.runtime.shutil.disk_usage", fake)
    missing = tmp_path / "a" / "b" / "c" / "d"
    assert SystemDiskUsage().free_bytes(missing) == 123
    assert asked == [tmp_path]


def test_disk_usage_of_a_file_path_uses_the_file(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    target = tmp_path / "f.txt"
    target.write_text("x", encoding="utf-8")
    asked: list[Path] = []
    monkeypatch.setattr("chatimport.runtime.shutil.disk_usage", recorder(asked, 1))
    assert SystemDiskUsage().free_bytes(target) == 1
    assert asked == [target]


def test_disk_usage_terminates_when_nothing_on_the_way_exists(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "exists", never_exists)
    asked: list[Path] = []
    monkeypatch.setattr("chatimport.runtime.shutil.disk_usage", recorder(asked, 7))
    start = Path("nowhere") / "deeper"
    assert SystemDiskUsage().free_bytes(start) == 7
    assert asked == [Path()]


def test_system_clock_now_is_aware_utc_and_current() -> None:
    before = datetime.now(UTC)
    now = SystemClock().now()
    after = datetime.now(UTC)
    assert now.utcoffset() == timedelta(0)
    assert before <= now <= after


async def test_system_clock_sleep_really_awaits(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    calls: list[float] = []
    real_sleep = asyncio.sleep

    async def fake_sleep(seconds: float) -> None:
        calls.append(seconds)
        await real_sleep(0)

    monkeypatch.setattr("chatimport.runtime.asyncio.sleep", fake_sleep)
    await SystemClock().sleep(12.5)
    assert calls == [12.5]

        (numeric, "chatimport.notify", "Title: body text")
    ]


def test_log_notifier_does_not_interpret_percent_signs(caplog: pytest.LogCaptureFixture) -> None:
    with caplog.at_level(logging.DEBUG, logger="chatimport.notify"):
        LogNotifier().notify(Level.INFO, "100%", "%s %d {x}")
    assert caplog.records[0].getMessage() == "100%: %s %d {x}"


def test_level_values() -> None:
    assert [level.value for level in Level] == ["info", "warning", "error"]


def test_version_falls_back_when_package_metadata_is_missing(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    def missing(name: str) -> str:
        raise importlib.metadata.PackageNotFoundError(name)

    original = chatimport.__version__
    monkeypatch.setattr(importlib.metadata, "version", missing)
    try:
        importlib.reload(chatimport)
        assert chatimport.__version__ == "0.0.0"
    finally:
        monkeypatch.undo()
        importlib.reload(chatimport)
    assert chatimport.__version__ == original


def test_version_comes_from_the_installed_metadata() -> None:
    assert chatimport.__version__ == importlib.metadata.version("chatimport")

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import logging

import pytest

from chatimport.runtime import BackfillSlots, Level, LogNotifier


async def settle() -> None:
    for _ in range(10):
        await asyncio.sleep(0)


def test_limit_must_be_positive() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="at least 1"):
        BackfillSlots(0)
    assert BackfillSlots(3).limit == 3


async def run_chats(limit: int, chats: int) -> tuple[int, list[int]]:
    slots = BackfillSlots(limit)
    active = 0
    peak = 0
    order: list[int] = []
    release = asyncio.Event()

    async def backfill(chat_id: int) -> None:
        nonlocal active, peak
        async with slots.acquire(chat_id):
            order.append(chat_id)
            active += 1
            peak = max(peak, active)
            await release.wait()
            active -= 1

    tasks = [asyncio.create_task(backfill(chat_id)) for chat_id in range(chats)]
    await settle()
    assert active == min(limit, chats)
    release.set()
    await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
    return peak, order


@pytest.mark.parametrize(("limit", "expected_peak"), [(1, 1), (2, 2), (5, 3)])
async def test_at_most_limit_chats_hold_a_slot(limit: int, expected_peak: int) -> None:
    peak, order = await run_chats(limit, 3)
    assert peak == expected_peak
    assert order == [0, 1, 2]


async def test_waiting_chats_get_the_slot_in_arrival_order() -> None:
    slots = BackfillSlots(1)
    entered: list[int] = []
    gate = asyncio.Event()

    async def chat(chat_id: int) -> None:
        async with slots.acquire(chat_id):
            entered.append(chat_id)
            await gate.wait()

    first = asyncio.create_task(chat(1))
    await settle()
    waiters = [asyncio.create_task(chat(n)) for n in (5, 3, 4)]
    await settle()
    assert slots.holders == (1,)
    assert slots.waiting == (5, 3, 4)
    gate.set()
    await asyncio.gather(first, *waiters)
    assert entered == [1, 5, 3, 4]
    assert slots.holders == ()


async def test_a_chat_holding_a_slot_may_enter_again_without_waiting() -> None:
    slots = BackfillSlots(1)
    async with slots.acquire(7), slots.acquire(7):
        assert slots.holders == (7,)
    assert slots.holders == ()


async def test_a_cancelled_waiter_gives_up_its_place() -> None:
    slots = BackfillSlots(1)
    gate = asyncio.Event()
    entered: list[int] = []

    async def chat(chat_id: int) -> None:
        async with slots.acquire(chat_id):
            entered.append(chat_id)
            await gate.wait()

    holder = asyncio.create_task(chat(1))
    await settle()
    cancelled = asyncio.create_task(chat(2))
    later = asyncio.create_task(chat(3))
    await settle()
    cancelled.cancel()
    await settle()
    assert slots.waiting == (3,)
    gate.set()
    await asyncio.gather(holder, later)
    assert cancelled.cancelled()
    assert entered == [1, 3]


async def test_cancel_after_the_slot_was_handed_over_passes_it_on() -> None:
    slots = BackfillSlots(1)
    entered: list[int] = []

    async def chat(chat_id: int) -> None:
        async with slots.acquire(chat_id):
            entered.append(chat_id)

    holding = slots.acquire(1)
    await holding.__aenter__()
    second = asyncio.create_task(chat(2))
    third = asyncio.create_task(chat(3))
    await settle()
    await holding.__aexit__(None, None, None)
    assert slots.holders == (2,)
    second.cancel()
    await asyncio.gather(second, third, return_exceptions=True)
    assert second.cancelled()
    assert entered == [3]
    assert slots.holders == ()


async def test_a_second_waiter_of_a_chat_that_got_a_slot_joins_that_slot() -> None:
    slots = BackfillSlots(2)
    gates = {chat_id: asyncio.Event() for chat_id in (1, 9, 2)}
    inside: list[tuple[int, ...]] = []

    async def chat(chat_id: int) -> None:
        async with slots.acquire(chat_id):
            inside.append(slots.holders)
            await gates[chat_id].wait()

    holders = [asyncio.create_task(chat(1)), asyncio.create_task(chat(9))]
    await settle()
    twins = [asyncio.create_task(chat(2)), asyncio.create_task(chat(2))]
    await settle()
    gates[1].set()
    await settle()
    gates[9].set()
    await settle()
    assert slots.holders == (2,)
    assert inside[-2:] == [(9, 2), (2,)]
    gates[2].set()
    await asyncio.gather(*holders, *twins)
    assert slots.holders == ()


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("level", "expected"),
    [(Level.INFO, logging.INFO), (Level.WARNING, logging.WARNING), (Level.ERROR, logging.ERROR)],
)
def test_level_maps_to_the_logging_level(
    level: Level, expected: int, caplog: pytest.LogCaptureFixture
) -> None:
    assert level.logging_level == expected
    with caplog.at_level(logging.DEBUG, logger="chatimport.notify"):
        LogNotifier().notify(level, "Title", "body")
    assert [(r.levelno, r.getMessage()) for r in caplog.records] == [(expected, "Title: body")]

def u(*codepoints: int) -> str:
    """Spell non-ASCII test data by code point (the repository forbids Cyrillic text)."""
    return "".join(map(chr, codepoints))

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import tomllib
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import pytest

from chatimport.toml_edit import TomlDocument, split_lines, toml_string, write_validated

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pathlib import Path

SECTION = re.compile(r"^\s*\[\s*s\s*\]\s*(#.*)?$")


def edited(text: str, key: str = "k", value: str = '"new"') -> str:
    document = TomlDocument(text)
    tables = document.find_tables(SECTION)
    if tables:
        document.set_value(tables[0], key, value)
    else:
        document.append_block(["[s]", f"{key} = {value}"])
    return document.text()


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("before", "after"),
    [
        ('[s]\nk = "old"\n', '[s]\nk = "new"\n'),
        ('[s]\r\nk = "old"\r\n', '[s]\r\nk = "new"\r\n'),
        ('[s]\nk = "old"  # keep me\n', '[s]\nk = "new"  # keep me\n'),
        ('[s]\nk = "a#b"  # c\n', '[s]\nk = "new"  # c\n'),
        ("[s]\nk = 'a#b'# c\n", '[s]\nk = "new"# c\n'),
        ('[s]\nk="old"', '[s]\nk="new"'),
        ("[s]\nother = 1\n", '[s]\nother = 1\nk = "new"\n'),
        ("[s]\nother = 1\n# note\n\n[t]\n", '[s]\nother = 1\nk = "new"\n# note\n\n[t]\n'),
        ("[s]\nother = 1", '[s]\nother = 1\nk = "new"\n'),
        ("[s]\n[t]\n", '[s]\nk = "new"\n[t]\n'),
        ("", '[s]\nk = "new"\n'),
        ("[t]\nx = 1", '[t]\nx = 1\n\n[s]\nk = "new"\n'),
        ("[t]\nx = 1\n\n", '[t]\nx = 1\n\n[s]\nk = "new"\n'),
        ("[t]\r\nx = 1\r\n", '[t]\r\nx = 1\r\n\r\n[s]\r\nk = "new"\r\n'),
    ],
)
def test_set_value_table(before: str, after: str) -> None:
    assert edited(before) == after


def test_a_header_inside_a_multiline_string_is_ignored() -> None:
    text = '[t]\nx = """\n[s]\nk = "trap"\n"""\n[s]\nk = "old"\n'
    result = edited(text)
    assert tomllib.loads(result) == {"t": {"x": '[s]\nk = "trap"\n'}, "s": {"k": "new"}}


def test_a_missing_key_goes_below_a_multiline_value_not_into_it() -> None:
    text = '[s]\nx = """\nline\n# not a comment\n"""\n'
    result = edited(text)
    assert tomllib.loads(result) == {"s": {"x": "line\n# not a comment\n", "k": "new"}}


def test_unicode_line_separator_inside_a_string_is_not_a_line_break() -> None:
    text = '[s]\nk = "a\u2028b"\nz = 1\n'
    assert split_lines(text) == ["[s]\n", 'k = "a\u2028b"\n', "z = 1\n"]
    assert tomllib.loads(edited(text)) == {"s": {"k": "new", "z": 1}}


def test_a_key_with_a_longer_name_is_not_taken_for_the_key() -> None:
    assert edited("[s]\nkk = 1\n") == '[s]\nkk = 1\nk = "new"\n'


@pytest.mark.parametrize("value", ['a"b', "back\\slash", "del\x7f", "\u0427\u0430\u0442", "\x00"])
def test_toml_string_round_trips(value: str) -> None:
    assert tomllib.loads(f"k = {toml_string(value)}") == {"k": value}


def test_write_validated_refuses_before_touching_the_file(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    target = tmp_path / "x.toml"
    target.write_text("old", encoding="utf-8")

    def refuse(_text: str) -> None:
        raise ValueError("bad")

    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="bad"):
        write_validated(target, "new", refuse)
    assert target.read_text(encoding="utf-8") == "old"
    assert sorted(p.name for p in tmp_path.iterdir()) == ["x.toml"]


def test_write_validated_creates_the_folder(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    target = tmp_path / "a" / "x.toml"
    write_validated(target, "k = 1\n", tomllib.loads)
    assert target.read_bytes() == b"k = 1\n"
