"""Qt tests run offscreen on one shared application; settings and files live in `tmp_path`."""

from __future__ import annotations

import os

os.environ.setdefault("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen")

from concurrent.futures import Future
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any

import pytest
from PySide6.QtCore import QObject, Signal
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication

from chatimport.commands import CommandResult
from chatimport.context import ServiceContext, load_context
from chatimport.gui.context import GuiContext
from chatimport.gui.kit import UiKit, build_kit
from chatimport.gui.settings import GuiSettingsStore

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Iterator
    from pathlib import Path


class FakeBridge(QObject):
    """The service bridge without a service: records commands, answers from `replies`."""

    snapshot = Signal(dict)

    def __init__(self, snapshot: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.last_snapshot = snapshot
        self.calls: list[tuple[str, dict[str, Any]]] = []
        self.replies: dict[str, CommandResult] = {}

    def execute(self, command: str, args: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> Future[CommandResult]:
        self.calls.append((command, args or {}))
        future: Future[CommandResult] = Future()
        future.set_result(self.replies.get(command, CommandResult(True)))
        return future


@pytest.fixture(scope="session")
def qapp() -> QApplication:
    app = QApplication.instance()
    return app if isinstance(app, QApplication) else QApplication([])


@pytest.fixture
def service_context(tmp_path: Path) -> ServiceContext:
    return load_context(str(tmp_path / "data"), base=tmp_path / "app")


@pytest.fixture
def store(tmp_path: Path) -> GuiSettingsStore:
    return GuiSettingsStore(tmp_path / "gui.json")


@pytest.fixture
def kit(qapp: QApplication, store: GuiSettingsStore) -> Iterator[UiKit]:
    built = build_kit(store, qapp)
    yield built
    built.language.set_language("en")


@pytest.fixture
def bridge() -> FakeBridge:
    return FakeBridge()


@pytest.fixture

    kit: UiKit, store: GuiSettingsStore, bridge: FakeBridge, service_context: ServiceContext
) -> GuiContext:
    return GuiContext(
        service=service_context,
        theme=kit.theme,
        language=kit.language,
        zoom=kit.zoom,
        settings=store,
        bridge=bridge,  # type: ignore[arg-type]  # a structural stand-in
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from PySide6.QtCore import SignalInstance


def record(signal: SignalInstance, log: list[Any], tag: object = None) -> None:
    """Append `tag` (or the emitted arguments when no tag is given) on every emission."""

    def slot(*args: Any) -> None:
        log.append(args if tag is None else tag)

    signal.connect(slot)

def test_age_and_freshness() -> None:
    assert age_seconds(row(), NOW) is None
    assert freshness_of(row(), NOW, THRESHOLDS) is Freshness.UNKNOWN
    recent = row(newest_date=NOW - timedelta(seconds=30))
    assert age_seconds(recent, NOW) == 30
    assert freshness_of(recent, NOW, THRESHOLDS) is Freshness.FRESH
    future = row(newest_date=NOW + timedelta(hours=1))
    assert age_seconds(future, NOW) == 0.0
    old = row(newest_date=NOW - timedelta(days=3))
    assert freshness_of(old, NOW, THRESHOLDS) is Freshness.DORMANT


def test_last_message_text() -> None:
    moment = NOW - timedelta(minutes=5)
    assert last_message_text(row(), NOW, False, "en") == "never"
    assert last_message_text(row(), NOW, True, "en") == "never"
    chat = row(newest_date=moment)
    assert last_message_text(chat, NOW, False, "en") == "5 min ago"
    assert last_message_text(chat, NOW, True, "en") == moment.astimezone().strftime(
        "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"
    )


def test_last_message_tooltip() -> None:
    empty = last_message_tooltip(row(), NOW, "en").splitlines()
    assert empty == [translate("en", "chats.tip.no_messages"), translate("en", "chats.tip.toggle")]
    moment = NOW - timedelta(hours=1)
    chat = row(newest_date=moment, last_contact_at=NOW - timedelta(seconds=30))
    lines = last_message_tooltip(chat, NOW, "en").splitlines()
    assert lines == [
        format_exact(moment),
        "1 h ago",
        "Last contact: 30 s ago",
        translate("en", "chats.tip.toggle"),
    ]


def test_history_tooltip() -> None:
    plain = history_tooltip(row(), NOW, "en").splitlines()
    assert plain == [translate("en", "chats.history_tip.idle")]
    retry_at = NOW + timedelta(minutes=1)
    full = backfill(
        BackfillState.RETRYING, month="2026-03", progress=0.4, retry_at=retry_at, detail="Flood"
    )
    lines = history_tooltip(row(backfill=full), NOW, "en").splitlines()
    assert lines == [
        translate("en", "chats.history_tip.retrying"),
        "Fetching 2026-03",
        translate("en", "chats.tip.approx"),
        format_exact(retry_at),
        "Last error type: Flood",
    ]
    done = backfill(BackfillState.DONE, progress=1.0, retry_at=retry_at)
    assert history_tooltip(row(backfill=done), NOW, "en").splitlines() == [
        translate("en", "chats.history_tip.done")
    ]


def test_span_text() -> None:
    assert span_text(row()) == "—"
    assert span_text(row(oldest_date=NOW)) == "—"
    same = row(oldest_date=NOW, newest_date=NOW)
    month = NOW.astimezone().strftime("%Y-%m")
    assert span_text(same) == month
    wide = row(oldest_date=NOW - timedelta(days=400), newest_date=NOW)
    first = wide.oldest_date.astimezone().strftime("%Y-%m")  # type: ignore[union-attr]
    assert span_text(wide) == f"{first} → {month}"

def make_model(absolute: bool = False) -> ChatsTableModel:
    return ChatsTableModel(lambda: NOW, lambda _id: THRESHOLDS, absolute_time=absolute)


def display(model: ChatsTableModel, r: int, column: Column, role: int = 0) -> object:
    return model.data(model.index(r, column), role or Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole)


def test_set_rows_adds_changes_and_removes_in_place(qapp: object) -> None:
    model = make_model()
    log: list[str] = []
    record(model.rowsInserted, log, "insert")
    record(model.rowsRemoved, log, "remove")
    record(model.dataChanged, log, "data")
    model.set_rows([row(1), row(2), row(3)])
    assert model.chat_ids() == [1, 2, 3]
    assert log == ["insert"]
    log.clear()
    model.set_rows([row(1), row(2), row(3)])
    assert log == []
    model.set_rows([row(1), row(2, records=5), row(4)])
    assert model.chat_ids() == [1, 2, 4]
    assert log == ["remove", "data", "insert"]
    assert model.row_at(1).records == 5
    assert model.now() == NOW


def test_absolute_time_toggle_touches_only_its_column(qapp: object) -> None:
    model = make_model()
    model.set_absolute_time(False)
    model.set_rows([row(1, newest_date=NOW)])
    emitted: list[Any] = []
    record(model.dataChanged, emitted)
    model.set_absolute_time(True)
    assert model.absolute_time
    touched = [(first.column(), last.column()) for first, last, *_ in emitted]
    assert touched == [(Column.LAST_MESSAGE, Column.LAST_MESSAGE)]
    empty = make_model()
    empty.set_absolute_time(True)


def test_tick_and_retranslate_signals(qapp: object) -> None:
    model = make_model()
    model.tick()
    model.retranslate()
    model.set_rows(
        [
            row(1, newest_date=NOW),
            row(2, backfill=backfill(BackfillState.RETRYING, retry_at=NOW)),
        ]
    )
    emitted: list[Any] = []
    record(model.dataChanged, emitted)
    headers: list[Any] = []
    record(model.headerDataChanged, headers, 1)
    model.tick()
    cells = [(first.row(), first.column()) for first, *_ in emitted]
    assert cells == [(0, Column.LAST_MESSAGE), (1, Column.HISTORY)]
    emitted.clear()
    model.retranslate()
    assert [(first.row(), first.column()) for first, *_ in emitted] == [(0, 0)]
    assert headers == [1]

    assert model.headerData(0, Qt.Orientation.Vertical) is None
    assert model.headerData(99, horizontal) is None
    assert model.headerData(-1, horizontal) is None


def test_cell_data(qapp: object) -> None:
    newest = NOW - timedelta(minutes=5)
    chat = row(
        7,
        "Example group",
        records=12_345,
        newest_date=newest,
        oldest_date=newest - timedelta(days=400),
        backfill=backfill(BackfillState.RETRYING, retry_at=NOW + timedelta(seconds=30)),
    )
    model = make_model()
    model.set_rows([chat])
    assert display(model, 0, Column.CHAT) == "Example group"
    assert display(model, 0, Column.STATUS) == "Live"
    assert display(model, 0, Column.HISTORY) == "Retrying"
    assert display(model, 0, Column.LAST_MESSAGE) == "5 min ago"
    assert display(model, 0, Column.MESSAGES) == "12,345"
    assert display(model, 0, Column.SPAN) == span_text(chat)
    tip = Qt.ItemDataRole.ToolTipRole
    assert display(model, 0, Column.CHAT, tip) == "Example group\n7"
    assert display(model, 0, Column.LAST_MESSAGE, tip) == last_message_tooltip(chat, NOW, "en")
    assert display(model, 0, Column.HISTORY, tip) == history_tooltip(chat, NOW, "en")
    assert display(model, 0, Column.STATUS, tip) is None
    right = int(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter)
    assert display(model, 0, Column.MESSAGES, Qt.ItemDataRole.TextAlignmentRole) == right
    assert display(model, 0, Column.CHAT, Qt.ItemDataRole.TextAlignmentRole) is None
    assert display(model, 0, Column.CHAT, Qt.ItemDataRole.AccessibleTextRole) == (
        "Example group: Retrying"
    )
    assert display(model, 0, Column.CHAT, Qt.ItemDataRole.DecorationRole) is None
    assert display(model, 0, Column.CHAT, ROW_ROLE) is chat
    assert display(model, 0, Column.CHAT, SORT_ROLE) == "example group"
    assert model.data(QModelIndex()) is None
    assert model.data(model.createIndex(3, 0)) is None

def make_proxy(rows: list[ChatRow]) -> tuple[ChatsTableModel, ChatsFilterProxy]:
    model = make_model()
    model.set_rows(rows)
    return model, ChatsFilterProxy(model, lambda: NOW)


def titles(proxy: ChatsFilterProxy) -> list[object]:
    return [proxy.index(r, Column.CHAT).data() for r in range(proxy.rowCount())]


def test_proxy_query_and_mode(qapp: object) -> None:
    _, proxy = make_proxy(
        [
            row(101, "Alpha club"),
            row(202, "Beta Club", paused=True),
            row(303, "gamma", newest_date=NOW),
        ]
    )
    assert proxy.mode is FilterMode.ALL
    assert proxy.rowCount() == 3
    proxy.set_query("CLUB")
    assert sorted(str(title) for title in titles(proxy)) == ["Alpha club", "Beta Club"]
    proxy.set_query("club")
    proxy.set_query("303")
    assert titles(proxy) == ["gamma"]
    proxy.set_query("")
    proxy.set_mode(FilterMode.PAUSED)
    proxy.set_mode(FilterMode.PAUSED)
    assert proxy.mode is FilterMode.PAUSED
    assert titles(proxy) == ["Beta Club"]


def test_proxy_sorts_by_the_sort_role(qapp: object) -> None:
    _, proxy = make_proxy([row(1, "b"), row(2, "A"), row(3, "c")])
    proxy.sort(Column.CHAT, Qt.SortOrder.AscendingOrder)
    assert titles(proxy) == ["A", "b", "c"]
    proxy.sort(Column.CHAT, Qt.SortOrder.DescendingOrder)
    assert titles(proxy) == ["c", "b", "A"]


def test_proxy_refresh_time_only_matters_for_silence_modes(qapp: object) -> None:
    clock = {"now": NOW}
    model = make_model()
    model.set_rows([row(1, "x", newest_date=NOW)])
    proxy = ChatsFilterProxy(model, lambda: clock["now"])
    proxy.set_mode(FilterMode.SILENT_1H)
    assert proxy.rowCount() == 0
    clock["now"] = NOW + timedelta(hours=2)
    assert proxy.rowCount() == 0
    proxy.refresh_time()
    assert proxy.rowCount() == 1
    proxy.set_mode(FilterMode.ALL)
    proxy.refresh_time()
    assert proxy.rowCount() == 1


def test_proxy_over_a_foreign_model_accepts_everything(qapp: object) -> None:
    from PySide6.QtGui import QStandardItemModel

    proxy = ChatsFilterProxy(make_model(), lambda: NOW)
    foreign = QStandardItemModel()
    foreign.appendRow([])
    proxy.setSourceModel(foreign)
    assert proxy.filterAcceptsRow(0, QModelIndex())

def test_parse_issues() -> None:
    assert parse_issues({}) == []
    assert parse_issues({"issues": "nope"}) == []
    rows = parse_issues(
        {
            "issues": [
                {"severity": "error", "folder": "f", "message": "m"},
                {"severity": "info"},
                "junk",
                {"folder": 5, "message": None},
            ]
        }
    )
    assert rows == [
        IssueRow("error", "f", "m"),
        IssueRow("info", "", ""),
        IssueRow("", "5", "None"),
    ]

    assert humanize_age(seconds, "ru") != humanize_age(seconds, "en") or seconds is None

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta

import pytest
from PySide6.QtCore import QModelIndex, Qt

from chatimport.gui.format import format_exact
from chatimport.gui.models.log_model import (
    COLUMN_KEYS,
    MAX_ROWS,
    RECORD_ROLE,
    Column,
    LogFilterProxy,
    LogModel,
    local_time_text,
)
from chatimport.gui.models.log_parser import Level, LogRecord
from chatimport.gui.strings import translate
from tests.unit.gui.logic.spy import record

BASE = datetime(2026, 10, 31, 20, 0, 0, tzinfo=UTC)


def rec(
    n: int, level: Level = Level.INFO, logger: str = "chatimport.worker", detail: str = ""
) -> LogRecord:
    return LogRecord(BASE + timedelta(seconds=n), level, logger, f"message {n}", detail)


def cell(
    model: LogModel, row: int, column: Column, role: int = Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole
) -> object:
    return model.data(model.index(row, column), role)


def test_basic_shape_and_headers(qapp: object) -> None:
    model = LogModel("en")
    assert model.rowCount() == 0
    assert model.columnCount() == len(Column)
    assert model.limit == MAX_ROWS
    model.append([rec(0)])
    parent = model.index(0, 0)
    assert model.rowCount(parent) == 0
    assert model.columnCount(parent) == 0
    for column, key in COLUMN_KEYS.items():
        assert model.headerData(column, Qt.Orientation.Horizontal) == translate("en", key)
    assert model.headerData(0, Qt.Orientation.Vertical) is None
    assert model.headerData(0, Qt.Orientation.Horizontal, Qt.ItemDataRole.ToolTipRole) is None


def test_data_roles(qapp: object) -> None:
    model = LogModel("en")
    record = rec(1, Level.WARNING, "chatimport.worker_backfill")
    model.append([record])
    assert cell(model, 0, Column.TIME) == local_time_text(record)
    assert cell(model, 0, Column.LEVEL) == translate("en", "log.level.warning")
    assert cell(model, 0, Column.SOURCE) == "worker_backfill"
    assert cell(model, 0, Column.MESSAGE) == "message 1"
    assert cell(model, 0, Column.TIME, RECORD_ROLE) is record
    assert cell(model, 0, Column.TIME, Qt.ItemDataRole.ToolTipRole) == format_exact(record.time)
    assert cell(model, 0, Column.SOURCE, Qt.ItemDataRole.ToolTipRole) == record.logger
    assert cell(model, 0, Column.LEVEL, Qt.ItemDataRole.ToolTipRole) is None
    assert cell(model, 0, Column.MESSAGE, Qt.ItemDataRole.DecorationRole) is None
    assert model.data(QModelIndex()) is None
    assert model.data(model.createIndex(5, 0)) is None
    assert model.record_at(0) is record
    assert model.records() == [record]


def test_counts_follow_appends_overflow_and_clear(qapp: object) -> None:
    model = LogModel("en", limit=5)
    model.append([])
    model.append([rec(0, Level.WARNING), rec(1, Level.ERROR), rec(2, Level.CRITICAL)])
    assert (model.warnings, model.errors) == (1, 2)
    model.append([rec(3), rec(4), rec(5)])
    assert model.rowCount() == 5
    assert (model.warnings, model.errors) == (0, 2)
    assert model.record_at(0).message == "message 1"
    model.append([rec(n) for n in range(10, 20)])
    assert [r.message for r in model.records()] == [f"message {n}" for n in range(15, 20)]
    assert (model.warnings, model.errors) == (0, 0)
    model.append([rec(30, Level.ERROR)])
    model.clear()
    assert model.rowCount() == 0
    assert model.errors == 0


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("existing", "older", "taken", "first_after"),
    [
        (5, [], 0, None),
        (10, [1], 0, None),
        (7, [1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 3, "message 3"),
        (0, [1, 2], 2, "message 1"),
        (5, [1, 2, 3], 3, "message 1"),
    ],
)
def test_prepend(
    qapp: object, existing: int, older: list[int], taken: int, first_after: str | None
) -> None:
    model = LogModel("en", limit=10)
    model.append([rec(100 + n) for n in range(existing)])
    assert model.prepend([rec(n) for n in older]) == taken
    if first_after is not None:
        assert model.record_at(0).message == first_after
    assert model.rowCount() == existing + taken


def test_set_language_retranslates_only_with_rows(qapp: object) -> None:
    model = LogModel("en")
    signals: list[str] = []
    record(model.dataChanged, signals, "data")
    record(model.headerDataChanged, signals, "header")
    model.set_language("ru")
    assert signals == []
    model.append([rec(1)])
    model.set_language("en")
    assert signals == ["header", "data"]
    assert cell(model, 0, Column.LEVEL) == translate("en", "log.level.info")


def make_proxy() -> tuple[LogModel, LogFilterProxy]:
    model = LogModel("en")
    model.append(
        [
            rec(0, Level.DEBUG, "chatimport.router"),
            rec(1, Level.INFO, "chatimport.worker"),
            rec(2, Level.ERROR, "chatimport.worker", "Traceback (most recent call last):\nboom"),
            rec(3, Level.WARNING, "other.lib"),
        ]
    )
    return model, LogFilterProxy(model)


def shown(proxy: LogFilterProxy) -> list[str]:
    return [proxy.record_at(row).message for row in range(proxy.rowCount())]


def test_proxy_accepts_everything_by_default(qapp: object) -> None:
    _, proxy = make_proxy()
    assert proxy.level is Level.DEBUG
    assert proxy.rowCount() == 4


def test_proxy_filters(qapp: object) -> None:
    _, proxy = make_proxy()
    proxy.set_level(Level.WARNING)
    assert shown(proxy) == ["message 2", "message 3"]
    proxy.set_level(Level.DEBUG)
    proxy.set_show_tracebacks(False)
    assert shown(proxy) == ["message 0", "message 1", "message 3"]
    proxy.set_show_tracebacks(True)
    proxy.set_logger_prefix("chatimport.w")
    assert shown(proxy) == ["message 1", "message 2"]
    proxy.set_logger_prefix("")
    proxy.set_query("BOOM  traceback")
    assert shown(proxy) == ["message 2"]
    proxy.set_query("worker 3")
    assert shown(proxy) == []
    proxy.set_query("")
    assert proxy.rowCount() == 4


def test_proxy_maps_rows_back_to_records(qapp: object) -> None:
    model, proxy = make_proxy()
    proxy.set_level(Level.ERROR)
    assert proxy.record_at(0) is model.record_at(2)

    assert not is_record_start("Traceback (most recent call last):")
    assert is_record_start("2026-13-45T25:61:61Z INFO app: matches shape only")


def test_record_properties() -> None:
    plain = LogRecord(datetime(2026, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6000, tzinfo=UTC), Level.ERROR, "app", "Msg")
    assert plain.source == "app"
    assert not plain.has_traceback
    assert plain.line_count == 1
    assert plain.header() == "2026-01-02T03:04:05.006Z ERROR app: Msg"
    assert plain.as_text() == plain.header()
    assert plain.folded == "app msg"
    detailed = LogRecord(plain.time, Level.ERROR, "chatimport.x", "Msg", TRACEBACK)
    assert detailed.has_traceback
    assert detailed.line_count == 4
    assert detailed.source == "x"
    assert detailed.as_text() == f"{detailed.header()}\n{TRACEBACK}"
    assert "valueerror" in detailed.folded


def test_parser_groups_traceback_into_detail() -> None:
    lines = [
        "stray line before any header",
        "",
        f"{STAMP} INFO chatimport.a: first",
        f"{STAMP} ERROR chatimport.b: failed",
        *TRACEBACK.splitlines(),
        "",
        f"{STAMP} INFO chatimport.c: last\r\n",
    ]
    parser = LogParser()
    done = parser.feed(lines)
    assert [record.message for record in done] == ["first", "failed"]
    assert done[1].detail == TRACEBACK
    assert parser.orphans == ["stray line before any header"]
    last = parser.flush()
    assert last is not None
    assert last.message == "last"
    assert parser.flush() is None


def test_parser_holds_back_the_last_record_until_flush() -> None:
    parser = LogParser()
    assert parser.feed([f"{STAMP} INFO a: one"]) == []
    assert parser.feed(["   wrapped continuation"]) == []
    flushed = parser.flush()
    assert flushed is not None
    assert flushed.detail == "   wrapped continuation"


def test_parse_text_returns_orphans_and_records() -> None:
    text = f"tail of an earlier record\n{STAMP} INFO a: one\n{STAMP} INFO a: two\n  more\n"
    orphans, records = parse_text(text)
    assert orphans == ["tail of an earlier record"]
    assert [record.message for record in records] == ["one", "two"]
    assert records[1].detail == "  more"
    assert parse_text("") == ([], [])
    assert parse_text("only garbage\n") == (["only garbage"], [])

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import pytest

from chatimport.gui.models import log_tail
from chatimport.gui.models.log_tail import (
    LogTail,
    OlderBatch,
    PollResult,
    _complete_end,  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
    _signature,  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
    read_back,
)

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pathlib import Path

    from chatimport.gui.models.log_parser import LogRecord

NAME = "chatimport.log"


def line(n: int, text: str = "") -> str:
    return f"2026-10-31T20:{n // 60:02d}:{n % 60:02d}.000Z INFO t.x: msg{n}{text}\n"


def lines(numbers: range) -> str:
    return "".join(line(n) for n in numbers)


def messages(records: list[LogRecord]) -> list[str]:
    return [record.message for record in records]


def write(path: Path, text: str) -> None:
    path.write_bytes(text.encode("utf-8"))


def append(path: Path, text: str) -> None:
    with path.open("ab") as handle:
        handle.write(text.encode("utf-8"))


@pytest.fixture
def log(tmp_path: Path) -> Path:
    return tmp_path / NAME


def test_signature_variants(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    path = tmp_path / "s.txt"
    cases = [
        (b"first\nsecond", b"first\n"),
        (b"no newline", None),
        (b"x" * 300, b"x" * 256),
        (b"", None),
    ]
    for data, expected in cases:
        path.write_bytes(data)
        with path.open("rb") as handle:
            assert _signature(handle) == expected


def test_complete_end(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    path = tmp_path / "e.txt"
    path.write_bytes(b"abc")
    assert _complete_end(path) == 0
    path.write_bytes(b"abc\ndef")
    assert _complete_end(path) == 4
    path.write_bytes(b"")
    assert _complete_end(path) == 0
    monkeypatch.setattr(log_tail, "CHUNK_BYTES", 8)
    path.write_bytes(b"0123456789\nabc")
    assert _complete_end(path) == 11
    path.write_bytes(b"0123456789abcdefghij")
    assert _complete_end(path) == 0


def test_read_back_returns_everything_for_a_small_file(log: Path) -> None:
    write(log, lines(range(5)))
    records, start = read_back(log, log.stat().st_size, 100)
    assert messages(records) == [f"msg{n}" for n in range(5)]
    assert start == 0


def test_read_back_stops_after_enough_records_and_reports_the_offset(
    log: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.setattr(log_tail, "CHUNK_BYTES", 200)
    write(log, lines(range(40)))
    size = log.stat().st_size
    records, start = read_back(log, size, 3)
    assert len(records) > 3
    assert messages(records)[-1] == "msg39"
    assert 0 < start < size
    with log.open("rb") as handle:
        handle.seek(start)
        assert handle.read(4) == b"2026"
    older, older_start = read_back(log, start, 3)
    assert messages(older)[-1] == f"msg{40 - len(records) - 1}"
    assert older_start < start

    monkeypatch.setattr(log_tail, "CHUNK_BYTES", 50)
    write(log, lines(range(10)))
    records, start = read_back(log, log.stat().st_size, 1)
    assert messages(records)[0].startswith("msg")
    assert start > 0

def test_load_tail_whole_file_marks_the_rest_as_older(log: Path) -> None:
    write(log, lines(range(5)))
    tail = LogTail(log.parent, backups=2)
    assert messages(tail.load_tail(100)) == [f"msg{n}" for n in range(5)]
    assert tail.has_older
    batch = tail.load_older(10)
    assert batch == OlderBatch([], True)
    assert not tail.has_older


def test_load_older_walks_backwards_through_rotated_files(
    log: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.setattr(log_tail, "CHUNK_BYTES", 200)
    write(log.with_name(NAME + ".2"), lines(range(0, 10)))
    write(log.with_name(NAME + ".1"), lines(range(10, 20)))
    write(log, lines(range(20, 60)))
    tail = LogTail(log.parent, backups=3)
    current = tail.load_tail(5)
    assert messages(current)[-1] == "msg59"
    gathered: list[str] = []
    exhausted = False
    for _ in range(50):
        batch = tail.load_older(5)
        gathered = messages(batch.records) + gathered
        exhausted = batch.exhausted
        if exhausted:
            break
    assert exhausted
    everything = gathered + messages(current)
    assert everything == [f"msg{n}" for n in range(60)]
    assert tail.load_older(5) == OlderBatch([], True)


def test_load_older_skips_missing_backups(log: Path) -> None:
    write(log, lines(range(3)))
    write(log.with_name(NAME + ".2"), lines(range(10, 13)))

    tail.load_tail(100)
    batch = tail.load_older(100)
    assert messages(batch.records) == ["msg10", "msg11", "msg12"]
    assert batch.exhausted

    write(log, lines(range(3)))
    tail = LogTail(log.parent, backups=3)
    tail.load_tail(100)

    assert not tail.has_older
    assert tail.load_older(10) == OlderBatch([], True)

    write(log, line(0))

    assert tail._parser.orphans == []  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]

def wheel(delta: int, modifiers: Qt.KeyboardModifier) -> QWheelEvent:
    return QWheelEvent(
        QPointF(1, 1),
        QPointF(1, 1),
        QPoint(0, 0),
        QPoint(0, delta),
        Qt.MouseButton.NoButton,
        modifiers,
        Qt.ScrollPhase.NoScrollPhase,
        False,
    )


def test_wheel_filter(qapp: QApplication) -> None:
    host = QWidget()
    manager = ZoomManager(1.0)
    wheel_filter = _CtrlWheelFilter(manager, host)
    ctrl = Qt.KeyboardModifier.ControlModifier
    assert wheel_filter.eventFilter(host, wheel(120, ctrl))
    assert manager.factor == pytest.approx(1.05)
    assert wheel_filter.eventFilter(host, wheel(-120, ctrl))
    assert manager.factor == pytest.approx(1.0)
    assert wheel_filter.eventFilter(host, wheel(0, ctrl))
    assert manager.factor == pytest.approx(1.0)
    assert not wheel_filter.eventFilter(host, wheel(120, Qt.KeyboardModifier.NoModifier))
    assert not wheel_filter.eventFilter(host, QEvent(QEvent.Type.Wheel))
    assert not wheel_filter.eventFilter(host, QEvent(QEvent.Type.Show))
    host.deleteLater()


def test_install_zoom_inputs_binds_shortcuts(qapp: QApplication) -> None:
    window = QWidget()
    manager = ZoomManager(1.0)
    install_zoom_inputs(manager, window)
    from PySide6.QtGui import QShortcut

    shortcuts = {s.key().toString(): s for s in window.findChildren(QShortcut)}
    assert set(shortcuts) >= {"Ctrl+=", "Ctrl++", "Ctrl+-", "Ctrl+0"}
    shortcuts["Ctrl+="].activated.emit()
    assert manager.factor == pytest.approx(1.05)
    shortcuts["Ctrl+-"].activated.emit()
    shortcuts["Ctrl+0"].activated.emit()
    assert manager.auto
    window.deleteLater()
    qapp.processEvents()

HASH = "0123456789abcdef0123456789ABCDEF"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("text", ["1", " 12345678 ", "999999999999"])
def test_api_id_accepts_positive_numbers(text: str) -> None:
    assert validate_api_id(text) is None

def test_api_hash_is_exactly_32_hex_characters() -> None:
    assert validate_api_hash(HASH) is None
    assert validate_api_hash(f"  {HASH}  ") is None
    for bad in ("", HASH[:-1], HASH + "0", "g" * 32, HASH[:-1] + "-"):
        assert validate_api_hash(bad) == "settings.tg.err.api_hash"


def test_split_refs_takes_lines_commas_and_spaces() -> None:
    text = " https://t.me/a\n@b, @c;\t\n\n@d "
    assert split_refs(text) == ["https://t.me/a", "@b", "@c", "@d"]
    assert split_refs("   ") == []


def test_add_refs_reports_every_line(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    library = tmp_path / "chats.toml"
    invite = "https://t.me/+SecretInviteHash123"
    first = add_refs(library, f"@alpha_chat\nhello\n{invite}")
    assert [(r.ref, r.status) for r in first] == [
        ("@alpha_chat", "added"),
        ("hello", "invalid"),
        (display_ref(invite), "added"),
    ]
    assert "SecretInviteHash123" not in "".join(r.ref for r in first)
    assert len(load_library(library).entries) == 2
    second = add_refs(library, "https://t.me/Alpha_Chat\n@beta_chat\n@beta_chat\n12345")
    assert [r.status for r in second] == ["duplicate", "added", "duplicate", "added"]
    assert len(load_library(library).entries) == 4

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import replace
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta, timezone
from typing import Any

import pytest

from chatimport.gui.models.feed import MAX_EVENTS, EventFeed
from chatimport.gui.models.snapshot import (
    PHASE_LIVE,
    PHASE_NO_ACCESS,
    PHASE_PAUSED,
    BackfillView,
    ChatRow,
    GlobalBackfill,
    ServiceError,
    SnapshotView,
    parse_chat,
    parse_dt,
    parse_snapshot,
)
from chatimport.runtime import BackfillState

NOW = datetime(2026, 10, 31, 20, 0, 0, tzinfo=UTC)


def chat(chat_id: int = 1, **changes: Any) -> ChatRow:
    return replace(ChatRow(chat_id, f"Chat {chat_id}", PHASE_LIVE), **changes)


def view(*chats: ChatRow, errors: tuple[ServiceError, ...] = ()) -> SnapshotView:
    return SnapshotView(chats=chats, errors=errors)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("value", "expected"),
    [
        (None, None),
        (5, None),
        ("not a date", None),
        ("2026-10-31T20:00:00Z", NOW),
        ("2026-10-31T23:00:00+03:00", NOW),
        ("2026-10-31T20:00:00", NOW),
        ("2026-10-31T19:00:00-01:00", NOW),
    ],
)
def test_parse_dt(value: object, expected: datetime | None) -> None:
    assert parse_dt(value) == expected
    if expected is not None:
        assert parse_dt(value).tzinfo is UTC  # type: ignore[union-attr]


def test_parse_chat_rejects_a_bad_id() -> None:
    assert parse_chat({}) is None
    assert parse_chat({"chat_id": "5"}) is None
    assert parse_chat({"chat_id": True}) is None


def test_parse_chat_defaults() -> None:
    row = parse_chat({"chat_id": 42})
    assert row == ChatRow(42, "42", "")
    assert row is not None
    assert row.backfill == BackfillView()


def test_parse_chat_full_and_tolerant() -> None:
    row = parse_chat(
        {
            "chat_id": 7,
            "title": "Example group",
            "phase": "live",
            "last_id": 99,
            "records": 1234,
            "paused": True,
            "backfill_done": True,
            "oldest_date": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
            "newest_date": "2026-10-31T20:00:00Z",
            "last_contact_at": "garbage",
            "error": "",
            "backfill": {
                "state": "retrying",
                "progress": 0.5,
                "month": "2026-03",
                "retry_at": "2026-10-31T20:05:00Z",
                "detail": "flood wait",
            },
        }
    )
    assert row is not None
    assert (row.title, row.phase, row.last_id, row.records) == ("Example group", "live", 99, 1234)
    assert row.paused
    assert row.backfill_done
    assert row.oldest_date == datetime(2026, 1, 1, tzinfo=UTC)
    assert row.last_contact_at is None
    assert row.error is None
    assert row.backfill == BackfillView(
        BackfillState.RETRYING, 0.5, "2026-03", NOW + timedelta(minutes=5), "flood wait"
    )

    assert row.backfill.progress is None
    assert (row.last_id, row.records) == (0, 0)


def test_chat_row_flags() -> None:
    assert chat().has_access
    assert not chat().is_paused
    assert not chat().has_problem
    assert not chat(phase=PHASE_NO_ACCESS).has_access
    assert not chat(backfill=BackfillView(BackfillState.NO_ACCESS)).has_access
    assert chat(paused=True).is_paused
    assert chat(phase=PHASE_PAUSED).is_paused
    assert chat(phase=PHASE_NO_ACCESS).has_problem
    assert chat(error="boom").has_problem
    assert chat(backfill=BackfillView(BackfillState.RETRYING)).has_problem

    assert ServiceError("resolve:abc", "x").is_resolve
    assert not ServiceError("worker:1", "x").is_resolve


def test_parse_snapshot_empty() -> None:
    assert parse_snapshot(None) == SnapshotView()
    assert parse_snapshot({}) == SnapshotView()


def test_parse_snapshot_full() -> None:
    snapshot = parse_snapshot(
        {
            "service": "running",
            "updated_at": "2026-10-31T20:00:00Z",
            "disk": {"path": "D:/data", "free_gb": 12.5, "low_watermark_gb": 5},
            "total_bytes": 4096,
            "backfill": {"limit": 0, "active": [1, 2], "waiting": [3, "x", 4]},
            "chats": [{"chat_id": 1, "title": "A"}, {"chat_id": "bad"}, "junk", {"chat_id": 2}],
            "errors": [
                {"source": "resolve:x", "message": "no such chat"},
                {"source": 5},
                "junk",
            ],
        }
    )
    assert snapshot.service == "running"
    assert snapshot.updated_at == NOW
    assert (snapshot.disk_path, snapshot.free_gb, snapshot.low_watermark_gb) == (
        "D:/data",
        12.5,
        5.0,
    )
    assert snapshot.total_bytes == 4096
    assert snapshot.backfill == GlobalBackfill(limit=1, active=(1, 2), waiting=(3, 4))
    assert [row.chat_id for row in snapshot.chats] == [1, 2]
    assert snapshot.errors == (ServiceError("resolve:x", "no such chat"), ServiceError("", ""))
    assert snapshot.chat(2) is snapshot.chats[1]
    assert snapshot.chat(99) is None


def test_parse_snapshot_with_wrong_container_types() -> None:
    snapshot = parse_snapshot(
        {"disk": [], "backfill": 3, "chats": "x", "errors": {}, "service": ""}
    )
    assert snapshot == SnapshotView()


def test_first_snapshot_is_only_a_baseline() -> None:
    feed = EventFeed()
    assert feed.observe(view(chat(1)), NOW) == []
    assert feed.events == ()


def test_chat_added_and_removed() -> None:
    feed = EventFeed()
    feed.observe(view(chat(1), chat(2)), NOW)
    found = feed.observe(view(chat(1), chat(3)), NOW)
    assert [(e.key, e.title, e.tone, e.icon) for e in found] == [
        ("feed.chat_added", "Chat 3", "info", "plus"),
        ("feed.chat_removed", "Chat 2", "muted", "minus"),
    ]
    assert feed.events == tuple(reversed(found))


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("phase", "key"),
    [
        (PHASE_PAUSED, "feed.paused"),
        (PHASE_NO_ACCESS, "feed.no_access"),
        ("starting", None),
    ],
)
def test_phase_changes(phase: str, key: str | None) -> None:
    feed = EventFeed()
    start = "starting" if phase != "starting" else PHASE_LIVE
    feed.observe(view(chat(phase=start)), NOW)
    found = feed.observe(view(chat(phase=phase)), NOW)
    assert [e.key for e in found] == ([key] if key else [])


def test_going_live_is_news() -> None:
    feed = EventFeed()
    feed.observe(view(chat(phase="starting")), NOW)
    assert [e.key for e in feed.observe(view(chat(phase=PHASE_LIVE)), NOW)] == ["feed.live"]


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("state", "key"),
    [
        (BackfillState.RUNNING, "feed.backfill_running"),
        (BackfillState.DONE, "feed.backfill_done"),
        (BackfillState.PAUSED, "feed.backfill_paused"),
        (BackfillState.DISK_STOPPED, "feed.backfill_disk"),
        (BackfillState.RETRYING, "feed.backfill_retrying"),
        (BackfillState.NO_ACCESS, "feed.no_access"),
        (BackfillState.WAITING, None),
    ],
)
def test_backfill_state_changes(state: BackfillState, key: str | None) -> None:
    feed = EventFeed()
    feed.observe(view(chat()), NOW)
    found = feed.observe(view(chat(backfill=BackfillView(state))), NOW)
    assert [e.key for e in found] == ([key] if key else [])


def test_same_state_is_not_repeated() -> None:
    feed = EventFeed()
    running = chat(backfill=BackfillView(BackfillState.RUNNING))
    feed.observe(view(running), NOW)
    assert feed.observe(view(running), NOW) == []


def test_no_access_is_reported_once_when_phase_and_backfill_agree() -> None:
    feed = EventFeed()
    feed.observe(view(chat()), NOW)
    both = chat(phase=PHASE_NO_ACCESS, backfill=BackfillView(BackfillState.NO_ACCESS))
    assert [e.key for e in feed.observe(view(both), NOW)] == ["feed.no_access"]


def test_phase_and_backfill_events_can_both_fire() -> None:
    feed = EventFeed()
    feed.observe(view(chat(phase="starting")), NOW)
    both = chat(phase=PHASE_LIVE, backfill=BackfillView(BackfillState.RUNNING))
    assert [e.key for e in feed.observe(view(both), NOW)] == [
        "feed.live",
        "feed.backfill_running",
    ]


def test_error_events() -> None:
    feed = EventFeed()
    feed.observe(view(), NOW)
    errors = (ServiceError("worker:1", "x"), ServiceError("resolve:a", "y"))
    found = feed.observe(view(errors=errors), NOW)
    assert [e.key for e in found] == ["feed.error_resolve", "feed.error"]
    assert feed.observe(view(errors=errors), NOW) == []
    cleared = feed.observe(view(errors=errors[1:]), NOW)
    assert [e.key for e in cleared] == ["feed.error_cleared"]
    assert cleared[0].tone == "success"


def test_feed_keeps_only_the_newest_events() -> None:
    feed = EventFeed(limit=3)
    feed.observe(view(), NOW)
    for number in range(1, 6):
        feed.observe(view(*(chat(n) for n in range(1, number + 1))), NOW)
    assert [event.title for event in feed.events] == ["Chat 5", "Chat 4", "Chat 3"]
    assert MAX_EVENTS == 50


def test_timezone_is_irrelevant_to_events() -> None:
    feed = EventFeed()
    moment = datetime(2026, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone(timedelta(hours=3)))
    feed.observe(view(), moment)
    assert feed.observe(view(chat()), moment)[0].at == moment

def _tables(name: str) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
    module = importlib.import_module(f"chatimport.gui.locales.{name}")
    return module.EN, module.RU


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", LOCALE_MODULES)
def test_locale_module_tables_agree(name: str) -> None:
    en, ru = _tables(name)
    assert en
    assert en.keys() == ru.keys()
    _validate(name, en, ru)
    for key in en:
        entry = cast("str | tuple[str, ...]", en[key])
        ru_entry = cast("str | tuple[str, ...]", ru[key])
        if isinstance(entry, tuple):
            assert len(entry) == 2, key
            assert len(ru_entry) == 3, key
        assert _placeholders(entry) == _placeholders(ru_entry), key


def test_core_locale_tables_agree() -> None:
    from chatimport.gui.locales import en, ru

    _validate("core", en.EN, ru.RU)
    assert en.EN.keys() == ru.RU.keys()
    plurals = [key for key, entry in en.EN.items() if isinstance(entry, tuple)]
    assert plurals
    for key in plurals:
        assert len(en.EN[key]) == 2
        assert len(ru.RU[key]) == 3


def test_every_locale_module_registers_without_drift() -> None:
    for name in LOCALE_MODULES:
        importlib.import_module(f"chatimport.gui.locales.{name}")
    check_drift()

def test_theme_without_an_application(qapp: QApplication) -> None:
    zoom = ZoomManager(1.0)
    seen: list[bool] = []
    manager = ThemeManager(zoom, "system", detect_system=lambda: "dark")
    manager.changed.connect(lambda: seen.append(True))
    assert manager.resolved == "dark"
    assert manager.is_dark
    assert manager.preference == "system"
    manager.set_preference("system")
    assert seen == []
    manager.set_preference("light")
    assert manager.resolved == "light"
    assert manager.palette is LIGHT
    assert not manager.is_dark
    manager.set_preference("dark")
    assert manager.palette is DARK
    assert seen == [True, True]
    zoom.zoom_in()
    assert manager.stylesheet() == build_stylesheet(DARK, zoom.factor)


def test_theme_with_an_application_applies_and_follows_the_system(
    qapp: QApplication,
) -> None:
    original_sheet = qapp.styleSheet()
    original_palette = qapp.palette()
    scheme = {"value": "light"}
    zoom = ZoomManager(1.0)
    manager = ThemeManager(
        zoom,
        "system",
        app=qapp,
        detect_system=lambda: scheme["value"],  # type: ignore[arg-type,return-value]
    )
    try:
        seen: list[bool] = []
        manager.changed.connect(lambda: seen.append(True))
        assert qapp.styleSheet() == build_stylesheet(LIGHT, 1.0)
        assert qapp.palette().color(QPalette.ColorRole.Window).name() == LIGHT.canvas
        scheme["value"] = "dark"
        manager._on_system_changed(Qt.ColorScheme.Dark)  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
        assert manager.resolved == "dark"
        assert qapp.styleSheet() == build_stylesheet(DARK, 1.0)
        manager._on_system_changed(Qt.ColorScheme.Dark)  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
        assert seen == [True]
        zoom.zoom_in()
        assert qapp.styleSheet() == build_stylesheet(DARK, zoom.factor)
        manager.set_preference("light")
        manager._on_system_changed(Qt.ColorScheme.Light)  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
        assert manager.resolved == "light"
    finally:
        zoom.changed.disconnect(manager._on_zoom)  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
        qapp.setStyleSheet(original_sheet)
        qapp.setPalette(original_palette)

class InlineRunner:
    def __init__(self, parent: QObject | None = None) -> None:
        self.parent = parent

    def submit(self, func: Callable[[], Any], on_done: Callable[[Future[Any]], None]) -> None:
        future: Future[Any] = Future()
        try:
            future.set_result(func())
        except Exception as error:
            future.set_exception(error)
        on_done(future)


class Recorder(QObject):
    def __init__(self, source: LogSource) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.events: list[tuple[str, tuple[Any, ...]]] = []
        for name in ("loaded", "appended", "older", "exists_changed", "rotated", "busy_changed"):
            getattr(source, name).connect(self._make(name))
        source.failed.connect(self._make("failed"))

    def _make(self, name: str) -> Callable[..., None]:
        def record(*args: Any) -> None:
            self.events.append((name, args))

        return record

    def names(self) -> list[str]:
        return [name for name, _ in self.events]

def clock(qapp: QApplication, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> Iterator[SecondTicker]:

    monkeypatch.setattr(log_source, "MainThreadRunner", InlineRunner)
    yield fake
    fake.deleteLater()


def line(n: int) -> str:
    return f"2026-10-31T20:00:{n:02d}.000Z INFO t.x: msg{n}\n"


def make_source(tmp_path: Path, text: str | None = None) -> tuple[LogSource, Recorder]:
    if text is not None:
        (tmp_path / "chatimport.log").write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    source = LogSource(tmp_path)
    return source, Recorder(source)


def test_start_loads_the_tail(clock: SecondTicker, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    source, recorder = make_source(tmp_path, line(1) + line(2))
    assert not source.ready
    assert not source.exists
    assert not source.busy
    source.start()
    assert source.ready
    assert source.exists
    assert source.has_older
    assert recorder.names() == ["busy_changed", "busy_changed", "exists_changed", "loaded"]
    records, has_older = recorder.events[-1][1]
    assert [r.message for r in records] == ["msg1", "msg2"]
    assert has_older is True
    assert source.tail.has_older


def test_start_failure_and_cancel(clock: SecondTicker, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    source, recorder = make_source(tmp_path)

    def boom(_target: int) -> list[LogRecord]:
        raise RuntimeError

    source.tail.load_tail = boom  # type: ignore[method-assign]
    source.start()
    assert recorder.names() == ["busy_changed", "busy_changed", "failed"]
    assert not source.ready
    cancelled: Future[list[LogRecord]] = Future()
    cancelled.cancel()
    source._on_loaded(cancelled)  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
    assert recorder.names()[-1] == "failed"


def test_initial_and_older_sizes(clock: SecondTicker, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    source, _ = make_source(tmp_path)
    seen: list[int] = []
    source.tail.load_tail = lambda target: seen.append(target) or []  # type: ignore[method-assign,func-returns-value]
    source.start()
    source.tail.load_older = lambda target: seen.append(target) or OlderBatch([], False)  # type: ignore[method-assign]
    source.load_older()
    assert seen == [INITIAL_RECORDS, OLDER_RECORDS]


def test_load_older_flow(clock: SecondTicker, tmp_path: Path) -> None:

def test_following_polls_on_the_tick_and_stops(clock: SecondTicker, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    source, recorder = make_source(tmp_path, line(1))
    source.start()
    recorder.events.clear()
    source.set_following(False)
    source.set_following(True)
    source.set_following(True)
    with (tmp_path / "chatimport.log").open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        handle.write(line(2))
    clock.second.emit()
    assert recorder.names() == ["appended"]
    assert [r.message for r in recorder.events[0][1][0]] == ["msg2"]
    source.set_following(False)
    with (tmp_path / "chatimport.log").open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        handle.write(line(3))
    clock.second.emit()
    assert recorder.names() == ["appended"]

def test_poll_reports_existence_changes_and_rotation(clock: SecondTicker, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    source, recorder = make_source(tmp_path, line(1))
    source.start()
    recorder.events.clear()
    (tmp_path / "chatimport.log").unlink()
    source._poll()  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
    assert recorder.events == [("exists_changed", (False,))]
    assert not source.exists
    (tmp_path / "chatimport.log").write_text(line(9), encoding="utf-8")
    recorder.events.clear()
    source._poll()  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
    assert recorder.names() == ["exists_changed", "appended"]
    source.tail.poll = lambda: PollResult(rotated=True)  # type: ignore[method-assign]
    recorder.events.clear()
    source._poll()  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
    assert recorder.names() == ["rotated"]


def test_poll_schedules_another_read_when_more_is_waiting(
    clock: SecondTicker, tmp_path: Path, qapp: QApplication
) -> None:
    source, _ = make_source(tmp_path, line(1))
    source.start()
    results = iter([PollResult(more=True), PollResult()])
    calls: list[int] = []

    def fake_poll() -> PollResult:
        calls.append(1)
        return next(results)

    source.tail.poll = fake_poll  # type: ignore[method-assign]
    source._poll()  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
    qapp.processEvents()
    assert len(calls) == 2

HASH = "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"


def env_of(gui: GuiContext, control: FakeControl | None = None) -> WizardEnv:
    return WizardEnv(gui, SettingsHooks(autostart_task="T", executable="x.exe"), control)


def config_file(gui: GuiContext) -> Path:
    return gui.service.paths.config_file


def test_base_step_defaults(gui: GuiContext) -> None:
    class Plain(WizardStep):
        name = "keys"

    step = Plain(env_of(gui))
    step.retranslate()
    step.enter()
    assert step.can_advance()
    assert step.commit()
    assert not step.skippable
    assert step.env.context is gui.service


def test_keys_step_validates_and_saves(gui: GuiContext) -> None:
    step = KeysStep(env_of(gui))
    changes: list[None] = []
    step.changed.connect(lambda: changes.append(None))
    assert not step.can_advance()
    assert not step.commit()
    step._api_id.setText("42")
    step._api_hash.setText("xyz")
    assert changes
    assert not step._hash_error.isHidden()
    assert not step.can_advance()
    step._api_hash.setText(HASH)
    assert step._hash_error.isHidden()
    assert step.can_advance()
    assert step.commit()
    telegram = load_config(config_file(gui)).telegram
    assert (telegram.api_id, telegram.api_hash) == (42, HASH)


def test_keys_step_skips_the_write_when_nothing_changed(
    gui: GuiContext, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    config_file(gui).write_text(f'[telegram]\napi_id = 7\napi_hash = "{HASH}"\n', encoding="utf-8")
    step = KeysStep(env_of(gui))
    step.enter()
    assert step._api_id.text() == "7"
    assert step._api_hash.text() == HASH

    def refuse(*_: object) -> None:
        raise AssertionError("must not write")

    monkeypatch.setattr(setup_steps, "update_config", refuse)
    assert step.commit()


def test_keys_step_enter_keeps_what_was_typed_and_survives_a_broken_file(
    gui: GuiContext,
) -> None:
    config_file(gui).write_text(f'[telegram]\napi_id = 7\napi_hash = "{HASH}"\n', encoding="utf-8")
    step = KeysStep(env_of(gui))
    step._api_id.setText("99")
    step.enter()
    assert step._api_id.text() == "99"
    assert step._api_hash.text() == HASH
    config_file(gui).write_text("[telegram\n", encoding="utf-8")
    other = KeysStep(env_of(gui))
    other.enter()
    assert other._api_id.text() == ""
    other._api_id.setText("5")
    other._api_hash.setText(HASH)
    assert not other.commit()
    assert not other._problem.isHidden()


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("error", "key"),
    [
        (ConfigError("bad"), "setup.keys.error.rejected"),
        (OSError("disk"), "setup.keys.error.write"),
    ],
)
def test_keys_step_reports_write_failures(
    gui: GuiContext, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, error: Exception, key: str
) -> None:
    def refuse(*_: object) -> None:
        raise error

    monkeypatch.setattr(setup_steps, "update_config", refuse)
    step = KeysStep(env_of(gui))
    step._api_id.setText("5")
    step._api_hash.setText(HASH)
    assert not step.commit()
    assert not step._problem.isHidden()
    assert step._problem._body.text() == tr(key)
    step._api_id.setText("6")
    assert step._problem.isHidden()


def test_keys_step_reveal_guide_and_language(
    gui: GuiContext, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, kit: UiKit
) -> None:
    opened: list[object] = []

    def fake_exec(self: key_guide.KeyGuideDialog) -> int:
        opened.append(self)
        return 0

    monkeypatch.setattr(key_guide.KeyGuideDialog, "exec", fake_exec)
    step = KeysStep(env_of(gui))
    assert step._api_hash.echoMode().name == "Password"
    step._reveal.click()
    assert step._api_hash.echoMode().name == "Normal"
    step._reveal.click()
    step._guide.click()
    assert len(opened) == 1
    step._api_hash.setText("bad")
    before = step._hash_error.text()
    kit.language.set_language("ru")
    assert step._hash_error.text() != before

def test_chats_step_adds_links_and_reports_each_line(gui: GuiContext) -> None:
    step = ChatsStep(env_of(gui))
    step.enter()
    assert not step.can_advance()
    assert step._known.isHidden()
    step._add.click()
    assert not step._empty.isHidden()
    step._input.setPlainText("@alpha_chat\nhello\nhttps://t.me/beta_chat")
    step._add.click()
    assert step._empty.isHidden()
    assert step._input.toPlainText() == "hello"
    assert len(load_library(gui.service.library_file).entries) == 2
    assert step.can_advance()
    assert not step._known.isHidden()
    assert step._results.count() == 3
    step._input.setPlainText("@alpha_chat")
    step._add.click()
    assert step._results.count() == 1
    step.retranslate()


def test_chats_step_keeps_failed_lines_for_a_retry(gui: GuiContext) -> None:
    gui.service.library_file.write_text("[[chat]\n", encoding="utf-8")
    step = ChatsStep(env_of(gui))
    step._input.setPlainText("@alpha_chat")
    step._add.click()
    assert step._input.toPlainText() == "@alpha_chat"
    assert not step.can_advance()


def test_folder_step_defaults_and_saves_a_new_folder(gui: GuiContext, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    step = FolderStep(env_of(gui))
    step.enter()
    assert step._path.text() == str(tmp_path / "ChatImport")
    assert step.can_advance()
    assert step.commit()
    assert not config_file(gui).exists()
    target = tmp_path / "elsewhere"
    step._path.setText(str(target))
    step._path.editingFinished.emit()
    assert step._check.changed
    assert step.commit()
    assert load_config(config_file(gui)).output.root_dir == str(target / "ChatImport")
    step.retranslate()
    assert "elsewhere" in step._verdict._body.text()


def test_folder_step_rejects_the_application_folder(gui: GuiContext) -> None:
    step = FolderStep(env_of(gui))
    step.enter()
    step._path.setText(str(gui.service.paths.base))
    step._path.editingFinished.emit()
    assert not step.can_advance()
    assert not step.commit()
    assert step._verdict._body.text().startswith(tr("setup.folder.invalid", detail="")[:10])


def test_folder_step_warns_about_cloud_folders(gui: GuiContext, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    step = FolderStep(env_of(gui))
    step.enter()
    step._path.setText(str(tmp_path / "OneDrive" / "Archive"))
    step._path.editingFinished.emit()
    assert not step._cloud.isHidden()
    assert step.can_advance()
    step._path.setText(str(tmp_path / "plain"))
    step._path.editingFinished.emit()
    assert step._cloud.isHidden()


def test_folder_step_browse(
    gui: GuiContext, tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    starts: list[str] = []
    answers = [str(tmp_path / "picked"), ""]

    def fake_pick(parent: object, caption: str, start: str) -> str:
        starts.append(start)
        return answers.pop(0)

    monkeypatch.setattr(QFileDialog, "getExistingDirectory", staticmethod(fake_pick))
    step = FolderStep(env_of(gui))
    step._browse.click()
    assert starts == [str(tmp_path / "ChatImport")]
    assert step._path.text() == str(tmp_path / "picked")
    assert step._check.path == tmp_path / "picked" / "ChatImport"
    step._browse.click()
    assert starts[1] == str(tmp_path / "picked")
    assert step._path.text() == str(tmp_path / "picked")


def test_folder_step_reports_a_failed_save(
    gui: GuiContext, tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    def refuse(*_: object) -> None:

    step = FolderStep(env_of(gui))
    step.enter()
    step._path.setText(str(tmp_path / "elsewhere"))
    assert not step.commit()
    assert not step._problem.isHidden()
    step._path.editingFinished.emit()
    assert step._problem.isHidden()


def test_run_mode_default_and_apply(gui: GuiContext, fake_autostart: FakeAutostart) -> None:
    step = RunModeStep(env_of(gui))
    runner: DeferredRunner = step._runner  # type: ignore[assignment]
    assert step.autostart_chosen
    results: list[bool] = []
    step.apply(results.append)
    runner.flush()
    assert fake_autostart.calls == ["enable"]
    assert results == [True]
    step._manual.setChecked(True)
    assert not step.autostart_chosen
    step.apply(results.append)
    runner.flush()
    assert fake_autostart.calls == ["enable", "disable"]
    assert results == [True, True]
    step.retranslate()


@pytest.mark.parametrize("error", [autostart.AutostartError("denied", "no"), RuntimeError("boom")])
def test_run_mode_reports_failures(
    gui: GuiContext, fake_autostart: FakeAutostart, error: Exception
) -> None:
    fake_autostart.status_result = error
    step = RunModeStep(env_of(gui))
    runner: DeferredRunner = step._runner  # type: ignore[assignment]
    results: list[bool] = []
    step.apply(results.append)
    runner.flush()
    assert results == [False]


def test_run_mode_without_autostart_support(gui: GuiContext, fake_autostart: FakeAutostart) -> None:
    fake_autostart.supported = False
    step = RunModeStep(env_of(gui))
    assert not step._auto.isEnabled()
    assert not step.autostart_chosen
    assert not step._unsupported.isHidden()
    results: list[bool] = []
    step.apply(results.append)
    assert results == [True]
    assert fake_autostart.calls == []


def test_summary_reflects_the_saved_state(gui: GuiContext, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    mode = RunModeStep(env_of(gui))
    step = SummaryStep(env_of(gui), mode)
    step.enter()
    texts = [line.text() for line in step._lines]
    assert texts[0] == tr("setup.summary.keys.missing")
    assert texts[1] == tr("setup.summary.signin.missing")
    assert texts[4] == tr("setup.summary.mode.auto")
    assert not step._incomplete.isHidden()
    config_file(gui).write_text(f'[telegram]\napi_id = 7\napi_hash = "{HASH}"\n', encoding="utf-8")
    gui.service.paths.session_file.write_bytes(b"x")
    mode._manual.setChecked(True)
    step.enter()
    texts = [line.text() for line in step._lines]
    assert texts[0] == tr("setup.summary.keys.ok")
    assert texts[1] == tr("setup.summary.signin.ok")
    assert texts[4] == tr("setup.summary.mode.manual")
    assert step._incomplete.isHidden()
    assert str(tmp_path / "ChatImport") in texts[3]
    step.retranslate()


def test_folder_step_enter_keeps_a_typed_path(gui: GuiContext, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    step = FolderStep(env_of(gui))
    step._path.setText(str(tmp_path / "typed"))
    step.enter()
    assert step._path.text() == str(tmp_path / "typed")

def runner_of(wizard: SetupWizard) -> DeferredRunner:
    return wizard._mode._runner  # type: ignore[return-value]  # replaced by the fixture


def test_a_fresh_run_through_every_step(
    control_gui: GuiContext,
    control: FakeControl,
    fake_autostart: FakeAutostart,
    tmp_path: Path,
) -> None:
    wizard = SetupWizard(control_gui, SettingsHooks(autostart_task="T"))
    assert wizard.index == 0
    assert wizard._back.isHidden()
    assert not wizard._next.isEnabled()
    assert wizard._skip.isHidden()
    keys = wizard.steps[0]
    keys._api_id.setText("42")  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    keys._api_hash.setText(HASH)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    assert wizard._next.isEnabled()
    wizard._next.click()
    assert load_config(control_gui.service.paths.config_file).telegram.api_id == 42

    assert wizard.index == 1
    assert not wizard._back.isHidden()
    assert not wizard._skip.isHidden()
    assert wizard._next.isHidden()
    wizard.steps[1]._button.click()  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    assert FakeLoginDialog.created
    assert wizard._skip.isHidden()
    wizard._next.click()

    assert wizard.index == 2
    assert not wizard._skip.isHidden()
    wizard.steps[2]._input.setPlainText("@alpha_chat")  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    wizard.steps[2]._add.click()  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    assert wizard._skip.isHidden()
    wizard._next.click()

    assert wizard.index == 3
    wizard.steps[3]._path.setText(str(tmp_path / "elsewhere"))  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    wizard._next.click()
    assert load_config(control_gui.service.paths.config_file).output.root_dir.endswith("ChatImport")

    assert wizard.index == 4
    wizard._mode._manual.setChecked(True)
    wizard._next.click()

    assert wizard.index == 5
    assert wizard._next.isHidden()
    assert not wizard._finish.isHidden()
    assert wizard._counter.text() == tr("setup.wizard.step_of", n=6, total=6)
    wizard._finish.click()
    assert not wizard._finish.isEnabled()
    runner_of(wizard).flush()
    assert fake_autostart.calls == ["disable"]
    assert control_gui.settings.settings.setup_completed
    assert control.alive
    assert wizard.result() == 1


def test_finish_restarts_a_running_service(
    control_gui: GuiContext, control: FakeControl, fake_autostart: FakeAutostart

    control.alive = True

    runner_of(wizard).flush()

    assert fake_autostart.calls == ["enable"]

    wizard._finish.click()
    runner_of(wizard).flush()

def test_every_step_works_when_earlier_ones_were_done(gui: GuiContext, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    gui.service.paths.config_file.write_text(
        f'[telegram]\napi_id = 7\napi_hash = "{HASH}"\n', encoding="utf-8"
    )
    gui.service.paths.session_file.write_bytes(b"x")
    gui.service.library_file.write_text('[[chat]]\nref = "@alpha_chat"\n', encoding="utf-8")
    wizard = SetupWizard(gui)
    assert wizard._next.isEnabled()
    wizard._next.click()
    assert wizard.index == 1
    assert wizard._next.isEnabled()
    wizard._next.click()
    assert wizard._next.isEnabled()
    wizard._next.click()
    assert wizard.steps[3]._path.text() == str(tmp_path / "ChatImport")  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    wizard._next.click()
    wizard._next.click()
    assert wizard.index == 5
    assert wizard.steps[5]._incomplete.isHidden()  # type: ignore[attr-defined]


def test_back_skip_and_cancel(gui: GuiContext) -> None:
    wizard = SetupWizard(gui)
    wizard._show(1)
    wizard._skip.click()
    assert wizard.index == 2
    wizard._back.click()
    assert wizard.index == 1
    wizard._show(0)
    wizard._next.click()
    assert wizard.index == 0
    wizard.show()
    wizard._cancel.click()
    assert wizard.result() == 0
    assert not gui.settings.settings.setup_completed

    assert wizard._chips[0].text.startswith("1. ")

"""Shared helpers for the Overview and Chats page tests: a frozen clock and sample snapshots."""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any

import pytest

from chatimport.gui.models.ticker import shared_ticker

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Iterator

    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication

NOW = datetime(2026, 5, 1, 12, 0, 0, tzinfo=UTC)


def iso(seconds_ago: float) -> str:
    return (NOW - timedelta(seconds=seconds_ago)).isoformat()


def chat(
    chat_id: int,
    title: str | None = None,
    *,
    phase: str = "live",
    state: str | None = None,
    progress: float | None = None,
    age: float | None = 30.0,
    records: int = 10,
    retry_at: str | None = None,
    month: str | None = None,
    **extra: Any,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    info: dict[str, Any] = {}
    if state is not None:
        info["state"] = state
    if progress is not None:
        info["progress"] = progress
    if retry_at is not None:
        info["retry_at"] = retry_at
    if month is not None:
        info["month"] = month
    row: dict[str, Any] = {
        "chat_id": chat_id,
        "title": title if title is not None else f"Chat {chat_id}",
        "phase": phase,
        "records": records,
        "backfill": info,
    }
    if age is not None:
        row["newest_date"] = iso(age)
        row["oldest_date"] = iso(age + 86_400 * 40)
        row["last_contact_at"] = iso(age)
    row.update(extra)
    return row


def snapshot(
    chats: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
    *,
    service: str = "running",
    free_gb: float | None = 200.0,
    low_gb: float | None = 10.0,
    errors: list[dict[str, str]] | None = None,
    active: list[int] | None = None,
    waiting: list[int] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    disk: dict[str, Any] = {"path": "D:/x"}
    if free_gb is not None:
        disk["free_gb"] = free_gb
    if low_gb is not None:
        disk["low_watermark_gb"] = low_gb
    return {
        "service": service,
        "updated_at": iso(5),
        "disk": disk,
        "total_bytes": 5_000_000,
        "backfill": {"limit": 1, "active": active or [], "waiting": waiting or []},
        "chats": chats or [],
        "errors": errors or [],
    }


def everything() -> dict[str, Any]:
    return snapshot(
        [
            chat(1, "Alpha", state="running", progress=0.4, age=5, month="2026-04"),
            chat(2, "Bravo", state="running", age=120),
            chat(3, "Charlie", state="waiting", age=4_000),
            chat(4, "Delta", state="retrying", age=90_000, retry_at=iso(-30), error="boom"),
            chat(12, "Lima", state="retrying", age=100, retry_at=iso(60)),
            chat(5, "Echo", state="done", age=500_000),
            chat(6, "Foxtrot", phase="paused", paused=True, state="paused", age=None),
            chat(7, "Golf", phase="no_access", state="no_access", age=None),
            chat(8, "Hotel", state="disk_stopped", age=3_000_000),
            chat(9, "India", state="idle", age=60),
            chat(10, "Juliet", phase="starting", state="done", age=None),
            chat(11, "Kilo", state="retrying", age=100, retry_at=iso(-30)),
        ],
        active=[1],
        waiting=[3],
    )


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def frozen_clock(qapp: QApplication) -> Iterator[None]:
    ticker = shared_ticker()
    original = ticker.clock
    ticker.clock = lambda: NOW
    yield
    ticker.clock = original
    while ticker.animating:
        ticker.release_animation()

class RecordingMenu(QMenu):
    opened: list[RecordingMenu] = []  # noqa: RUF012

    def exec(self, *_args: object) -> None:  # type: ignore[override]
        RecordingMenu.opened.append(self)

        real(rows, parent).deleteLater()
        return RecordingMenu(parent or page)

def answer_dialog(index: int) -> None:
    def click() -> None:
        box = QApplication.activeModalWidget()
        assert isinstance(box, QMessageBox)
        box.buttons()[index].click()

    QTimer.singleShot(0, click)


def found(folder: Path | None) -> Callable[[Path, int], Path | None]:
    def finder(_root: Path, _chat_id: int) -> Path | None:
        return folder

    return finder


def pump(condition: Callable[[], bool]) -> None:
    for _ in range(100):
        if condition():
            return
        QTest.qWait(20)
    raise AssertionError("condition not reached")

def test_mixed_results_report_success(
    actions: ChatActions, bridge: FakeBridge, toasts: Toasts, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    results = iter([CommandResult(True), CommandResult(False)])

    def execute(command: str, args: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> Future[CommandResult]:
        future: Future[CommandResult] = Future()
        future.set_result(next(results))
        return future

    monkeypatch.setattr(bridge, "execute", execute)
    actions.recheck([row(1), row(2)])
    assert [t[0] for t in toasts] == ["success"]

def test_menu_actions_trigger_commands(
    actions: ChatActions, bridge: FakeBridge, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    folder_calls: list[int] = []
    export_calls: list[int] = []

    def fake_open(target: ChatRow) -> None:
        folder_calls.append(target.chat_id)

    def fake_export(target: ChatRow) -> None:
        export_calls.append(target.chat_id)

    monkeypatch.setattr(actions, "open_folder", fake_open)
    monkeypatch.setattr(actions, "export", fake_export)
    answer_dialog(0)
    menu = actions.build_menu([row(5)])
    for item in menu.actions():
        if item.isSeparator():
            continue
        sub = item.menu()
        if not isinstance(sub, QMenu):
            if item.text() == actions_module.tr("chats.act.refetch"):
                answer_dialog(0)
            item.trigger()
        else:
            answer_dialog(0)
            sub.actions()[0].trigger()
    sent = {call[0] for call in bridge.calls}
    assert {"pause", "resume", "recheck", "deeper", "refetch", "trim"} <= sent
    assert folder_calls == [5]
    assert export_calls == [5]

def painted(page: ChatsPage) -> QImage:
    page.show()
    QApplication.processEvents()
    return page.table.viewport().grab().toImage()


def non_blank(image: QImage) -> bool:
    background = image.pixel(0, 0)
    return any(
        image.pixel(x, y) != background
        for x in range(0, image.width(), 7)
        for y in range(0, image.height(), 5)
    )


def test_every_column_and_state_paints(page: ChatsPage) -> None:
    page.set_snapshot(everything())
    image = painted(page)
    assert image.width() > 0
    assert non_blank(image)

def test_cell_without_a_chat_row_falls_back_to_the_base_painter(page: ChatsPage) -> None:

    image = QImage(120, 30, QImage.Format.Format_ARGB32)

    page.set_snapshot(everything())
    delegate = ChatsDelegate(page.gui.kit, page.model)
    image = QImage(400, 60, QImage.Format.Format_ARGB32)
    image.fill(0)
    painter = QPainter(image)
    for column in Column:
        option = QStyleOptionViewItem()
        option.rect = QRect(0, 0, 400, 60)

def write_library(path: Path) -> None:

        '[[chat]]\nref = "@alpha_group"\nname = "alpha"\n\n'
        f'[[chat]]\nref = "{INVITE}"\nenabled = false\n',
        encoding="utf-8",
    )


def rows(dialog: LibraryDialog) -> list[_EntryRow]:
    return dialog.findChildren(_EntryRow)


def labels(dialog: LibraryDialog) -> list[str]:
    return [label.text() for label in dialog.findChildren(QLabel)]


def test_empty_library_shows_the_hint(gui: GuiContext, library_file: Path) -> None:
    dialog = LibraryDialog(gui)
    assert rows(dialog) == []
    assert any("chats.lib.empty" not in text and text for text in labels(dialog))
    assert dialog._problem.isHidden()

    write_library(library_file)
    dialog = LibraryDialog(gui)
    shown = labels(dialog)
    assert len(rows(dialog)) == 2
    assert "alpha" in shown
    assert "@alpha_group" in shown
    assert all("AbCdEfGhIjKlMnOp" not in text for text in shown)


def test_unresolved_entry_gets_a_chip(gui: GuiContext, library_file: Path) -> None:
    write_library(library_file)
    dialog = LibraryDialog(gui)
    baseline = len(dialog.findChildren(QLabel))
    failing = resolve_error_key(ChatEntry("@alpha_group"))
    dialog.set_errors(
        [ServiceError(failing, "nope"), ServiceError("worker:1", "other")],
    )
    assert len(dialog.findChildren(QLabel)) > baseline - 1
    assert len(rows(dialog)) == 2


def test_toggle_writes_the_file(gui: GuiContext, library_file: Path) -> None:
    write_library(library_file)
    dialog = LibraryDialog(gui)
    first = next(row for row in rows(dialog) if row._entry.ref == "@alpha_group")
    first._switch.setChecked(False)
    entries = {entry.ref: entry for entry in load_library(library_file).entries}
    assert entries["@alpha_group"].enabled is False
    assert dialog._problem.isHidden()
    second = next(row for row in rows(dialog) if row._entry.ref == INVITE)
    second._switch.setChecked(True)
    assert load_library(library_file).find(INVITE) is not None
    assert next(e for e in load_library(library_file).entries if e.ref == INVITE).enabled is True

"""Builds a small ChatImport folder with the real storage writer."""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from chatimport.storage.layout import chat_folder_name
from chatimport.storage.state import new_state
from chatimport.storage.writer import ChunkWriter
from tests.fakes import NOW, msg

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pathlib import Path

ALPHA_ID = -1001000000001
BETA_ID = -1001000000002


def build_chat(
    root: Path, chat_id: int, title: str, days: list[int], *, media: bool = False
) -> Path:
    folder = root / chat_folder_name(title, chat_id)
    writer = ChunkWriter(folder, 1, lambda: NOW)
    state = writer.update_state(new_state(chat_id, title, None, NOW))
    for number, day in enumerate(days, start=1):
        date = datetime(2026, 9, day, 10, 0, 0, tzinfo=UTC)
        state = writer.append(state, [msg(number, chat_id=chat_id, date=date)])
    if media:
        (folder / "media").mkdir()
        (folder / "media" / "1.bin").write_bytes(b"x" * 100)
    return folder


def build_archive(root: Path) -> None:
    build_chat(root, ALPHA_ID, "Alpha", [1, 2, 3, 4])
    build_chat(root, BETA_ID, "Beta", [5, 6], media=True)
    (root / "_status.json").write_text("{}", encoding="utf-8")

from __future__ import annotations

TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 5.0


class Toasts:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.items: list[tuple[str, str]] = []

    def __call__(self, widget: QObject, tone: str, message: str) -> None:
        self.items.append((tone, message))

    def tones(self) -> list[str]:
        return [tone for tone, _message in self.items]

    def last(self) -> tuple[str, str]:
        return self.items[-1]


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def runners(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> Iterator[list[support.MainThreadRunner]]:
    created: list[support.MainThreadRunner] = []
    original = support.MainThreadRunner.__init__

    def tracked(self: support.MainThreadRunner, parent: QObject | None = None) -> None:
        original(self, parent)
        created.append(self)

    monkeypatch.setattr(support.MainThreadRunner, "__init__", tracked)
    yield created
    for runner in created:
        runner._pool.shutdown(wait=True)  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]


@pytest.fixture
def toasts(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> Toasts:
    recorder = Toasts()
    monkeypatch.setattr(log, "notify", recorder)
    monkeypatch.setattr(data_common, "notify", recorder)
    return recorder


@pytest.fixture
def settle(qapp: QApplication) -> Callable[[Callable[[], bool]], None]:
    def wait(condition: Callable[[], bool]) -> None:
        deadline = time.monotonic() + TIMEOUT_SECONDS
        while not condition():
            qapp.processEvents()
            if time.monotonic() > deadline:
                raise AssertionError("condition not reached")
            time.sleep(0.002)
        qapp.processEvents()

    return wait

        self.asked: list[str] = []

    monkeypatch.setattr(QMessageBox, "exec", fake_exec)
    monkeypatch.setattr(QMessageBox, "clickedButton", fake_clicked)

from __future__ import annotations

from concurrent.futures import Future
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any

from chatimport.commands import CommandResult
from chatimport.gui.pages import data_cleanup
from chatimport.trim import TrimPreview
from tests.unit.gui.pages_b.archive import ALPHA_ID, BETA_ID

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Callable

    import pytest

    from chatimport.gui.pages.data import DataPage
    from tests.unit.gui.conftest import FakeBridge
    from tests.unit.gui.pages_b.conftest import Answers, Toasts

type Settle = Callable[[Callable[[], bool]], None]


def loaded(page: DataPage, settle: Settle) -> None:
    page.calculate()
    settle(lambda: page.env.usage is not None and not page._calculating)  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]


def previewed(page: DataPage, settle: Settle) -> None:
    page.cleanup.preview()
    settle(lambda: not page.cleanup._busy)  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]


def failing(bridge: FakeBridge) -> None:
    def execute(command: str, args: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> Future[CommandResult]:
        future: Future[CommandResult] = Future()
        future.set_exception(RuntimeError("down"))
        return future

    bridge.execute = execute  # type: ignore[method-assign]


def test_preview_then_cancel_and_confirm(
    data_page: DataPage, settle: Settle, bridge: FakeBridge, answers: Answers, toasts: Toasts
) -> None:
    card = data_page.cleanup
    loaded(data_page, settle)
    assert card.chat.count() == 3
    assert card.selected_pct() == 50
    assert not card.run_button.isEnabled()
    card.run()
    assert bridge.calls == []
    previewed(data_page, settle)
    assert card.model.rowCount() == 2
    assert card.run_button.isEnabled()
    card.preview_button.click()
    settle(lambda: not card._busy)  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
    answers.accept = False
    card.run_button.click()
    assert answers.asked
    assert bridge.calls == []
    answers.accept = True
    bridge.replies["trim"] = CommandResult(True, data={"records": 3, "bytes": 2048})
    card.run()
    assert bridge.calls == [("trim", {"pct": 50})]
    assert toasts.tones() == ["success"]
    assert card.model.rowCount() == 0
    assert not card.run_button.isEnabled()

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from PySide6.QtWidgets import QFileDialog

from chatimport.gui.pages import data_export
from chatimport.usage import ArchiveUsage
from tests.unit.gui.pages_b.archive import ALPHA_ID

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Callable
    from pathlib import Path

    import pytest

    from chatimport.gui.pages.data import DataPage
    from tests.unit.gui.pages_b.conftest import Opened, Toasts

type Settle = Callable[[Callable[[], bool]], None]


def loaded(page: DataPage, settle: Settle) -> None:
    page.calculate()
    settle(lambda: page.env.usage is not None and not page._calculating)  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]


def exported(page: DataPage, settle: Settle) -> None:
    page.export.export()
    settle(lambda: not page.export._busy)  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]


def pick(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, value: str) -> None:
    monkeypatch.setattr(QFileDialog, "getExistingDirectory", staticmethod(lambda *_a: value))


def test_export_without_chats_does_nothing(data_page: DataPage, toasts: Toasts) -> None:
    card = data_page.export
    card.export()
    assert toasts.items == []
    data_page.env.set_usage(ArchiveUsage((), 0, 0, 0, None))
    data_page.show()
    assert card.empty.isVisibleTo(data_page)
    assert not card.run_button.isEnabled()


def test_export_default_destination(
    data_page: DataPage, settle: Settle, toasts: Toasts, opened: Opened
) -> None:
    card = data_page.export
    loaded(data_page, settle)
    assert card.run_button.isEnabled()
    card.chat.setCurrentIndex(card.chat.findData(ALPHA_ID))
    data_page.show()
    exported(data_page, settle)
    assert toasts.tones() == ["success"]
    assert card.done_row.isVisibleTo(data_page)
    out = next((data_page.env.root / "_exports").glob("*.json"))
    rows = json.loads(out.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert len(rows) == 4
    card.open_button.click()
    assert opened.urls == [str(out.parent)]
    card.retranslate()


def test_export_to_chosen_folder_with_names(
    data_page: DataPage, settle: Settle, tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    card = data_page.export
    loaded(data_page, settle)
    target = tmp_path / "out"
    target.mkdir()
    pick(monkeypatch, str(target))
    card.browse.click()
    assert card._destination == target  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
    card.names.set_checked(True)
    exported(data_page, settle)
    assert list(target.glob("*.json"))
    pick(monkeypatch, "")
    card.browse.click()
    assert card._destination == target  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
    card.reset.click()
    assert card._destination is None  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]


def test_export_failure(
    data_page: DataPage, settle: Settle, toasts: Toasts, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    loaded(data_page, settle)

    def boom(*_a: object, **_k: object) -> Path:
        raise OSError("disk")

    monkeypatch.setattr(data_export, "export_chat_json", boom)
    exported(data_page, settle)
    assert toasts.tones() == ["danger"]


def test_export_folder_vanished(
    data_page: DataPage, settle: Settle, toasts: Toasts, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    loaded(data_page, settle)

    def nothing(*_args: object) -> None:
        return None

    monkeypatch.setattr(data_export, "find_chat_folder", nothing)
    exported(data_page, settle)
    assert toasts.tones() == ["warning"]


def test_export_busy_and_open_without_result(data_page: DataPage, settle: Settle) -> None:
    card = data_page.export
    loaded(data_page, settle)
    card._busy = True  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
    card.export()
    card._busy = False  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
    card._open()  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
    card.names.toggled.emit(True)
    assert not card.names_warning.isHidden()
