from __future__ import annotations

from concurrent.futures import Future
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any

import pytest
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QDialog, QFileDialog

from chatimport.commands import CommandResult
from chatimport.gui.pages import data_folder, data_folder_dialog
from chatimport.gui.pages.data_folder_dialog import FolderDialog

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pathlib import Path

    from chatimport.gui.context import GuiContext
    from chatimport.gui.pages.data import DataPage
    from tests.unit.gui.conftest import FakeBridge
    from tests.unit.gui.pages_b.conftest import Answers, Clipboard, Opened, Toasts


def always(_path: object) -> bool:
    return True


def scripted_dialog(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, text: str, *, move: bool = True, accept: bool = True
) -> None:
    class Scripted(FolderDialog):
        def exec(self) -> int:
            self.path.setText(text)
            self.move_box.setChecked(move)
            self.validate()
            if accept:
                self.apply.click()
                return QDialog.DialogCode.Accepted
            return QDialog.DialogCode.Rejected

    monkeypatch.setattr(data_folder, "FolderDialog", Scripted)


def test_card_renders_root(
    data_page: DataPage, clipboard: Clipboard, opened: Opened, toasts: Toasts
) -> None:
    card = data_page.folder
    assert card.path_label.toolTip() == str(data_page.env.root)
    card.copy_button.click()
    assert clipboard.text == str(data_page.env.root)
    card.open_button.click()
    assert opened.urls == [str(data_page.env.root)]
    assert toasts.tones() == ["info"]


def test_cloud_and_missing_flags(
    data_page: DataPage, tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    card = data_page.folder
    data_page.show()
    monkeypatch.setattr(data_folder, "is_cloud_synced", always)
    data_page.env.set_root(tmp_path / "nowhere")
    assert card.missing.isVisibleTo(data_page)
    assert card.cloud.isVisibleTo(data_page)


def test_change_moves_data(
    data_page: DataPage,
    gui: GuiContext,
    bridge: FakeBridge,
    answers: Answers,
    toasts: Toasts,
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    new = tmp_path / "elsewhere" / "ChatImport"
    scripted_dialog(monkeypatch, str(new))
    bridge.replies["set_root"] = CommandResult(True, data={"path": str(new)})
    data_page.folder.change()
    assert bridge.calls == [("set_root", {"path": str(new), "move": True})]
    assert data_page.env.root == new
    assert toasts.tones() == ["success"]


def test_change_fresh_without_path_in_reply(
    data_page: DataPage,
    bridge: FakeBridge,
    answers: Answers,
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    old = data_page.env.root
    scripted_dialog(monkeypatch, str(tmp_path / "fresh"), move=False)
    data_page.folder.change()
    assert bridge.calls[0][1]["move"] is False
    assert data_page.env.root == old


def test_change_rejected_or_declined(
    data_page: DataPage,
    bridge: FakeBridge,
    answers: Answers,
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    card = data_page.folder
    scripted_dialog(monkeypatch, str(tmp_path / "x"), accept=False)
    card.change()
    scripted_dialog(monkeypatch, "")
    card.change()
    scripted_dialog(monkeypatch, str(tmp_path / "y"))
    answers.accept = False
    card.change()
    card._busy = True  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
    card.change()
    assert bridge.calls == []


def test_change_failed_and_unavailable(
    data_page: DataPage,
    bridge: FakeBridge,
    answers: Answers,
    toasts: Toasts,
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    scripted_dialog(monkeypatch, str(tmp_path / "z"))
    bridge.replies["set_root"] = CommandResult(False, "no")
    data_page.folder.change()

    def execute(command: str, args: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> Future[CommandResult]:
        future: Future[CommandResult] = Future()
        future.set_exception(RuntimeError("down"))
        return future

    bridge.execute = execute  # type: ignore[method-assign]
    data_page.folder.change()
    assert toasts.tones() == ["danger", "warning"]
    data_page.folder.retranslate()


@pytest.fixture
def dialog(gui: GuiContext, qapp: object, tmp_path: Path) -> FolderDialog:

def test_dialog_validates_on_commit(dialog: FolderDialog, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    assert not dialog.validate()
    assert not dialog.apply.isEnabled()
    dialog.path.setText(str(tmp_path / "good"))
    dialog.path.editingFinished.emit()
    assert dialog.apply.isEnabled()
    assert dialog.chosen_path is not None
    assert dialog.move_data
    dialog.move_box.setChecked(False)
    assert dialog.apply.isEnabled()
    dialog.path.setText("  ")
    assert not dialog.validate()

    dialog.path.setText(str(gui.current.root))
    assert not dialog.validate()
    assert dialog.chosen_path is None
    assert not dialog.apply.isEnabled()


def test_dialog_oserror_is_a_verdict(
    dialog: FolderDialog, tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    def boom(*_a: object, **_k: object) -> list[str]:
        raise OSError("denied")

    monkeypatch.setattr(data_folder_dialog, "validate_new_root", boom)
    dialog.path.setText(str(tmp_path / "w"))
    assert not dialog.validate()


def test_dialog_cloud_warning_and_retranslate(
    dialog: FolderDialog, tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, gui: GuiContext
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.setattr(data_folder_dialog, "is_cloud_synced", always)
    dialog.path.setText(str(tmp_path / "cloudy"))
    assert dialog.validate()
    gui.language.set_language("ru")
    gui.language.set_language("en")
    assert dialog.apply.isEnabled()


def test_dialog_browse(
    dialog: FolderDialog, tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    chosen = str(tmp_path / "picked")
    monkeypatch.setattr(QFileDialog, "getExistingDirectory", staticmethod(lambda *_a: chosen))
    dialog.browse.click()
    assert dialog.path.text() == chosen
    assert dialog.apply.isEnabled()
    monkeypatch.setattr(QFileDialog, "getExistingDirectory", staticmethod(lambda *_a: ""))
    dialog.browse.click()
    assert dialog.path.text() == chosen
    dialog.path.clear()
    dialog.browse.click()
    dialog.cancel.click()
    assert dialog.result() == QDialog.DialogCode.Rejected

from __future__ import annotations

from concurrent.futures import Future
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any

from chatimport.commands import CommandResult

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from chatimport.gui.pages.data import DataPage
    from tests.unit.gui.conftest import FakeBridge
    from tests.unit.gui.pages_b.conftest import Answers, Toasts

ISSUES = {
    "issues": [
        {"severity": "error", "folder": "alpha", "message": "bad part"},
        {"severity": "warning", "folder": "beta", "message": "stale temp"},
        "junk",
    ]
}


def test_check_lists_issues_then_repairs(
    data_page: DataPage, bridge: FakeBridge, answers: Answers, toasts: Toasts
) -> None:
    card = data_page.integrity
    assert not card.repair_button.isEnabled()
    card.repair()
    assert bridge.calls == []
    bridge.replies["check"] = CommandResult(True, data=ISSUES)
    card.run_button.click()
    assert bridge.calls == [("check", {"repair": False})]
    assert card.model.rowCount() == 2
    assert card.repair_button.isEnabled()
    answers.accept = False
    card.repair_button.click()
    assert len(bridge.calls) == 1
    answers.accept = True
    bridge.replies["check"] = CommandResult(True, data={"issues": []})
    card.repair()
    assert bridge.calls[-1] == ("check", {"repair": True})
    assert toasts.tones() == ["success"]
    data_page.show()
    assert card.ok.isVisibleTo(data_page)
    assert not card.repair_button.isEnabled()


def test_check_failure_modes(data_page: DataPage, bridge: FakeBridge, toasts: Toasts) -> None:
    card = data_page.integrity
    bridge.replies["check"] = CommandResult(False, "no")
    card.run_check()
    assert toasts.tones() == ["danger"]

    def execute(command: str, args: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> Future[CommandResult]:
        future: Future[CommandResult] = Future()
        future.set_exception(RuntimeError("down"))
        return future

    bridge.execute = execute  # type: ignore[method-assign]
    card.run_check()
    assert toasts.tones() == ["danger", "warning"]


def test_busy_blocks_new_checks(data_page: DataPage, bridge: FakeBridge) -> None:
    card = data_page.integrity
    card._busy = True  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
    card.run_check()
    card._rows = []  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
    card.repair()
    card._rows = [object()]  # type: ignore[list-item]  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
    card.repair()
    assert bridge.calls == []
    card._rows = None  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
    card._busy = False  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
    card.retranslate()


def test_repair_from_real_check_report(
    data_page: DataPage, bridge: FakeBridge, answers: Answers
) -> None:
    from datetime import UTC, datetime

    from chatimport.integrity import check_root

    folder = next(data_page.env.root.glob("alpha_*"))
    next(folder.glob("*.jsonl")).write_text("not json\n", encoding="utf-8")
    found = check_root(data_page.env.root, repair=False, now=datetime.now(UTC))
    rows = [{"severity": i.severity, "folder": i.folder, "message": i.message} for i in found]
    assert rows
    bridge.replies["check"] = CommandResult(True, data={"issues": rows})
    data_page.integrity.run_check()
    assert data_page.integrity.model.rowCount() == len(rows)

from __future__ import annotations

from concurrent.futures import Future
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import pytest

from chatimport.commands import CommandResult
from chatimport.config import ConfigError, load_config
from chatimport.gui.pages import data_merged
from chatimport.merged_export import build_merged, merged_path

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Callable
    from pathlib import Path

    from chatimport.gui.pages.data import DataPage
    from tests.unit.gui.conftest import FakeBridge
    from tests.unit.gui.pages_b.conftest import Clipboard, Opened, Toasts

type Settle = Callable[[Callable[[], bool]], None]


def config_file(page: DataPage) -> Path:
    return page.gui.current.paths.config_file


def built(page: DataPage, *, ago: timedelta = timedelta(minutes=5)) -> None:
    build_merged(page.env.root, now=datetime.now(UTC) - ago)
    page.merged.refresh()


def test_defaults_show_a_switched_off_card_without_a_build(data_page: DataPage) -> None:
    card = data_page.merged
    assert not card.enabled.is_checked()
    assert card.format.value == "json"
    assert not card.names.is_checked()
    assert card.state_label.text() == "Switched off"
    assert card.last_label.text() == "Not built yet"
    assert not card.copy_button.isEnabled()
    assert not card.show_button.isEnabled()
    assert card.path_label.toolTip().endswith("all_chats.json")


def test_last_build_shows_exact_moment_age_records_and_size(data_page: DataPage) -> None:
    built(data_page)
    card = data_page.merged
    assert "UTC" in card.last_label.text()
    assert "ago" in card.last_label.text()
    assert card.last_label.toolTip() in card.last_label.text()
    assert card.size_label.text().startswith("6 records")
    assert card.copy_button.isEnabled()


def test_switching_on_saves_the_config_and_reloads_the_service(
    data_page: DataPage, bridge: FakeBridge, toasts: Toasts, settle: Settle
) -> None:
    card = data_page.merged
    card.enabled.set_checked(True)
    settle(lambda: bool(toasts.items))
    assert load_config(config_file(data_page)).merged.enabled is True
    assert bridge.calls == [("reload_config", {})]
    assert toasts.last() == ("success", "Saved")
    assert card.state_label.text() == "Switched on"


def test_format_and_names_are_saved_and_the_warning_follows_names(
    data_page: DataPage, toasts: Toasts, settle: Settle
) -> None:
    card = data_page.merged
    data_page.show()
    card.format.choose(1)
    settle(lambda: len(toasts.items) == 1)
    card.names.set_checked(True)
    settle(lambda: len(toasts.items) == 2)
    merged = load_config(config_file(data_page)).merged
    assert (merged.format, merged.include_names) == ("jsonl", True)
    assert card.names_warning.isVisibleTo(data_page)
    card.names.set_checked(False)
    settle(lambda: len(toasts.items) == 3)
    assert not card.names_warning.isVisibleTo(data_page)

def test_build_now_calls_the_service_and_toasts(
    data_page: DataPage, bridge: FakeBridge, toasts: Toasts, settle: Settle
) -> None:
    card = data_page.merged
    build_merged(data_page.env.root, now=datetime.now(UTC))
    bridge.replies["export_all"] = CommandResult(True, data={"records": 6})
    card._busy = True  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
    card.build()
    assert bridge.calls == []
    card._busy = False  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
    card.build()
    settle(lambda: bool(toasts.items))
    assert bridge.calls == [("export_all", {"format": "json", "names": False})]
    assert toasts.last() == ("success", "Combined file is ready: 6 records")
    assert card.build_button.isEnabled()
    assert card.build_button.text() == "Build now"
    assert card.size_label.text().startswith("6 records")

def test_snapshots_track_the_building_flag_and_new_builds(
    data_page: DataPage, bridge: FakeBridge
) -> None:
    card = data_page.merged
    bridge.snapshot.emit({"merged": {"building": True, "last_built_at": None}})
    assert card.state_label.text() == "Building now..."
    built_at = datetime.now(UTC).replace(microsecond=0)
    build_merged(data_page.env.root, now=built_at)
    stamp = built_at.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
    bridge.snapshot.emit({"merged": {"building": False, "last_built_at": stamp}})
    assert card.state_label.text() == "Switched off"
    assert card.size_label.text().startswith("6 records")
    bridge.snapshot.emit({"merged": {"building": False, "last_built_at": stamp}})
    bridge.snapshot.emit({})

    data_page: DataPage, bridge: FakeBridge
) -> None:
    card = data_page.merged
    card._busy = True  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
    build_merged(data_page.env.root, now=datetime.now(UTC))
    bridge.snapshot.emit({"merged": {"building": False, "last_built_at": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"}})
    assert card._result is None  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]

def test_language_switch_retranslates(data_page: DataPage) -> None:
    built(data_page)

from __future__ import annotations

type Settle = Callable[[Callable[[], bool]], None]

TRACE = "Traceback (most recent call last):\n  File x\nValueError: boom"


def line(second: int, level: str, logger: str, message: str, minute: int = 0) -> str:
    return f"2026-10-31T20:{minute:02d}:{second:02d}.001Z {level} {logger}: {message}\n"


def sample() -> str:
    return (
        line(1, "DEBUG", "chatimport.worker", "quiet detail")
        + line(2, "INFO", "chatimport.worker", "backfill started")
        + line(3, "WARNING", "chatimport.router", "slow down")
        + line(4, "ERROR", "chatimport.worker", "failed hard")
        + TRACE
        + "\n"
        + line(5, "CRITICAL", "chatimport.app", "fatal stop")
    )


@pytest.fixture

    return gui.service.paths.log_dir / LOG_FILE


def open_page(gui: GuiContext, settle: Settle) -> LogPage:
    page = LogPage(gui)
    page.resize(1000, 700)
    page.show()
    settle(lambda: page.source.ready)
    return page

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import pytest
from PySide6.QtCore import QEvent, QPointF, QRect, Qt
from PySide6.QtGui import QImage, QMouseEvent, QPainter, QStandardItemModel

from chatimport.gui.widgets.button import Button

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from chatimport.gui.context import GuiContext

MOMENT = datetime(2026, 10, 31, 20, 0, 0, tzinfo=UTC)


def record(level: Level, message: str = "hello", detail: str = "") -> LogRecord:
    return LogRecord(MOMENT, level, "chatimport.worker", message, detail)


def release(widget: QWidget, button: Qt.MouseButton) -> QMouseEvent:
    return QMouseEvent(
        QEvent.Type.MouseButtonRelease,
        QPointF(1, 1),
        QPointF(1, 1),
        button,
        button,
        Qt.KeyboardModifier.NoModifier,
    )


def test_inline_switch_label_click(gui: GuiContext, qapp: object) -> None:
    inline = InlineSwitch(gui.kit, "label")
    seen: list[bool] = []
    inline.toggled.connect(seen.append)
    label = inline._label  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
    assert inline.eventFilter(label, release(label, Qt.MouseButton.RightButton)) is False
    assert inline.eventFilter(label, release(label, Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton)) is True
    assert seen == [True]
    assert inline.eventFilter(inline, QEvent(QEvent.Type.Show)) is False
    inline.set_text("other", "tip")
    inline.set_checked(False)
    assert not inline.is_checked()

        delegate.wrap = wrap
        for row in range(5):
            for column in Column:
                paint(delegate, view, row, column)
    selected = QStyleOptionViewItem()
    selected.rect = QRect(0, 0, 100, 30)
    selected.state |= QStyle.StateFlag.State_Selected
    selected.widget = view
    image = QImage(100, 30, QImage.Format.Format_ARGB32)
    painter = QPainter(image)
    delegate.paint(painter, selected, model.index(2, 0))
    detached = QStyleOptionViewItem()
    detached.rect = QRect(0, 0, 100, 30)
    delegate.paint(painter, detached, model.index(3, 0))
    painter.end()

"""Settings page fakes: a synchronous-on-demand runner, a fake Task Scheduler and a fake host."""

from __future__ import annotations

from concurrent.futures import Future
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any

import pytest

from chatimport import autostart
from chatimport.gui.context import GuiContext
from chatimport.gui.pages import settings_system, settings_telegram
from tests.unit.gui.conftest import FakeBridge

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Callable

    from chatimport.context import ServiceContext
    from chatimport.gui.kit import UiKit
    from chatimport.gui.settings import GuiSettingsStore


class DeferredRunner:
    """Runs submitted work inline but delivers the finished future only on `flush`."""

    def __init__(self, parent: object = None) -> None:
        self.pending: list[tuple[Future[Any], Callable[[Future[Any]], None]]] = []

    def submit(
        self, func: Callable[[], Any], on_done: Callable[[Future[Any]], None]
    ) -> Future[Any]:
        future: Future[Any] = Future()
        try:
            future.set_result(func())
        except Exception as error:
            future.set_exception(error)
        self.pending.append((future, on_done))
        return future

    def flush(self) -> None:
        pending, self.pending = self.pending, []
        for future, on_done in pending:
            on_done(future)


class FakeControl(FakeBridge):
    """A bridge that also implements `ServiceControl`."""

    def __init__(self, context: ServiceContext, snapshot: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(snapshot)
        self._context = context
        self.alive = False
        self.restarts = 0

    @property
    def context(self) -> ServiceContext:
        return self._context

    @property
    def is_alive(self) -> bool:
        return self.alive

    def start_service(self) -> bool:
        self.alive = True
        return True

    def stop_service(self, on_stopped: Callable[[], None] | None = None) -> None:
        self.alive = False
        if on_stopped is not None:
            on_stopped()

    def restart(self) -> None:
        self.restarts += 1


class FakeAutostart:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.supported = True
        self.status_result: autostart.AutostartStatus | Exception = autostart.AutostartStatus(
            autostart.AutostartState.ABSENT
        )
        self.calls: list[str] = []

    def status(self, task: str = "", *, executable: str | None = None) -> Any:
        self.calls.append("status")
        return self._result()

    def enable(self, task: str = "", *, executable: str | None = None) -> Any:
        self.calls.append("enable")
        self._result()
        self.status_result = autostart.AutostartStatus(autostart.AutostartState.ENABLED)
        return self.status_result

    def disable(self, task: str = "") -> Any:
        self.calls.append("disable")
        self._result()
        self.status_result = autostart.AutostartStatus(autostart.AutostartState.ABSENT)
        return self.status_result

    def _result(self) -> Any:
        if isinstance(self.status_result, Exception):
            raise self.status_result
        return self.status_result


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def fake_autostart(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> FakeAutostart:

    monkeypatch.setattr(autostart, "status", fake.status)
    monkeypatch.setattr(autostart, "enable", fake.enable)
    monkeypatch.setattr(autostart, "disable", fake.disable)
    monkeypatch.setattr(settings_system, "MainThreadRunner", DeferredRunner)
    monkeypatch.setattr(settings_telegram, "MainThreadRunner", DeferredRunner)
    return fake

def test_about_offers_the_wizard_again(gui: GuiContext, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    calls: list[object] = []
    result = [1]

    def fake_exec(self: object) -> int:
        calls.append(self)
        return result[0]

    monkeypatch.setattr(setup_wizard.SetupWizard, "exec", fake_exec)
    card = ss.AboutCard(gui, SettingsHooks())
    finished: list[None] = []
    card.wizard_finished.connect(lambda: finished.append(None))
    assert card._rerun.text() == tr("setup.about.rerun")
    card._rerun.click()
    assert len(calls) == 1
    assert finished == [None]
    result[0] = 0
    card._rerun.click()
    assert len(calls) == 2
    assert finished == [None]

    page.about.wizard_finished.emit()

def card_of(kit: UiKit, config_file: Path, key: str) -> sc.ConfigCard:
    card = next(c for c in sc.build_config_cards(kit, config_file) if c.key == key)
    card.load(Config())

def test_make_editor_kinds(kit: UiKit) -> None:
    flag = sc.make_editor(kit, sc.FieldSpec("a", "b", "bool"))
    assert isinstance(flag.widget, Switch)
    flag.write(True)
    assert flag.read() is True

    number.write(5)
    assert number.read() == 5
    assert isinstance(number.widget, QSpinBox)

    decimal = sc.make_editor(kit, sc.FieldSpec("a", "b", "float", 0.5, 9))
    decimal.write(1.5)
    assert decimal.read() == 1.5
    assert isinstance(decimal.widget, QDoubleSpinBox)

    clock = sc.make_editor(kit, sc.FieldSpec("a", "b", "time"))
    clock.write("06:30")
    assert clock.read() == "06:30"

    types = sc.make_editor(kit, sc.FieldSpec("a", "b", "media_types"))
    seen: list[None] = []
    types.changed.connect(lambda: seen.append(None))
    types.write(["photo", "audio"])

    assert seen

def test_every_card_saves_a_change(kit: UiKit, config_file: Path) -> None:
    recheck = card_of(kit, config_file, "recheck")
    recheck._editors["recheck", "daily_at"].write("03:15")
    recheck._editors["recheck", "enabled"].write(False)
    recheck.save()
    media = card_of(kit, config_file, "media")
    media._editors["media", "types"].write(["photo"])
    media.save()
    privacy = card_of(kit, config_file, "privacy")
    privacy._editors["output", "include_raw"].write(True)
    privacy.save()
    loaded = load_config(config_file)
    assert loaded.recheck.daily_at == "03:15"
    assert not loaded.recheck.enabled
    assert list(loaded.media.types) == ["photo"]
    assert loaded.output.include_raw


def test_disk_order_is_validated_before_writing(kit: UiKit, config_file: Path) -> None:
    card = card_of(kit, config_file, "disk")
    low = card._editors["disk", "low_watermark_gb"].widget
    high = card._editors["disk", "high_watermark_gb"].widget
    assert isinstance(low, QSpinBox)
    assert isinstance(high, QSpinBox)
    low.setValue(20)
    high.setValue(10)
    saved: list[None] = []
    card.saved.connect(lambda: saved.append(None))
    card.save()
    assert not card.message.isHidden()
    assert not config_file.exists()
    assert not saved
    high.setValue(30)
    card.save()
    assert load_config(config_file).disk.high_watermark_gb == 30
    assert saved == [None]


def test_order_ignores_non_integers() -> None:
    assert (
        sc._order({("disk", "low_watermark_gb"): 1.0, ("disk", "high_watermark_gb"): 0.5}) is None
    )
    assert sc._order({("disk", "low_watermark_gb"): 1, ("disk", "high_watermark_gb"): 2}) is None
    assert (
        sc._order({("disk", "low_watermark_gb"): 2, ("disk", "high_watermark_gb"): 2})
        == "settings.err.disk_order"
    )

def test_write_failures_become_messages(

def test_unsupported_platform_disables_the_switch(
    gui: GuiContext, fake_autostart: FakeAutostart
) -> None:
    fake_autostart.supported = False
    card = startup(gui)
    assert not card._switch.isEnabled()
    assert card._chip.text == tr("settings.startup.state.unsupported")
    card.refresh()
    assert fake_autostart.calls == []
    assert not card._busy


def test_refresh_shows_each_state(gui: GuiContext, fake_autostart: FakeAutostart) -> None:
    card = startup(gui)
    runner = runner_of(card)

    card.refresh()
    assert card._busy
    card.retranslate()
    checking = card._chip.text
    assert checking == tr("settings.startup.state.checking")
    card.refresh()
    assert len(runner.pending) == 1
    runner.flush()
    assert fake_autostart.calls == ["status"]
    disabled = card._chip.text
    assert disabled != checking
    assert not card._switch.isChecked()

    fake_autostart.status_result = autostart.AutostartStatus(STATE.ENABLED, "cmd", True)
    card.refresh()
    runner.flush()
    assert card._switch.isChecked()
    assert card._chip.text not in (disabled, checking)
    assert card._update.isHidden()

    fake_autostart.status_result = autostart.AutostartStatus(STATE.ENABLED, "cmd", False)
    card.refresh()
    runner.flush()
    assert not card._update.isHidden()
    assert card._chip.text not in (disabled, checking)


def test_toggle_enables_then_disables(gui: GuiContext, fake_autostart: FakeAutostart) -> None:
    card = startup(gui)
    runner = runner_of(card)
    card._switch.click()
    assert fake_autostart.calls == ["enable"]
    assert not card._switch.isEnabled()
    card._apply(False)
    assert fake_autostart.calls == ["enable"]
    runner.flush()
    assert card._switch.isChecked()
    assert card._switch.isEnabled()

    card._switch.click()
    runner.flush()
    assert fake_autostart.calls == ["enable", "disable"]
    assert not card._switch.isChecked()


def test_update_button_reapplies(gui: GuiContext, fake_autostart: FakeAutostart) -> None:
    card = startup(gui)
    card._update.click()
    runner_of(card).flush()
    assert fake_autostart.calls == ["enable"]

HASH = "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"
CREDENTIALS = f'[telegram]\napi_id = 4242\napi_hash = "{HASH}"\n'


class Probe:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.result: SessionInfo | Exception | None = SessionInfo("@someone")
        self.contexts: list[ServiceContext] = []

    def __call__(self, ctx: ServiceContext) -> SessionInfo | None:
        self.contexts.append(ctx)
        if isinstance(self.result, Exception):
            raise self.result
        return self.result


@pytest.fixture
def probe() -> Probe:
    return Probe()


def card_of(gui: GuiContext, probe: Probe, *, saved: bool = False) -> st.TelegramCard:
    if saved:
        gui.service.paths.config_file.write_text(CREDENTIALS, encoding="utf-8")
    return st.TelegramCard(gui, SettingsHooks(probe=probe))


def runner_of(card: st.TelegramCard) -> DeferredRunner:
    return card._runner  # type: ignore[return-value]  # replaced by the fixture

class FakeLoginDialog(QObject):
    signed_in = Signal(str)
    created: ClassVar[list[FakeLoginDialog]] = []

    def __init__(self, gui: Any, hooks: Any, control: Any, parent: Any) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.args = (gui, hooks, control, parent)
        self.executed = False
        FakeLoginDialog.created.append(self)

    def exec(self) -> int:
        self.executed = True
        self.signed_in.emit("@newcomer")
        return 1


def test_sign_in_opens_the_dialog_and_reports(
    gui: GuiContext, probe: Probe, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    FakeLoginDialog.created.clear()
    monkeypatch.setattr(st, "LoginDialog", FakeLoginDialog)
    card = card_of(gui, probe, saved=True)
    toasts = ToastHost(gui.kit, card)
    heard: list[str] = []
    card.signed_in.connect(heard.append)
    card._set_session("signed_out")
    card._sign_in.click()
    (dialog,) = FakeLoginDialog.created
    assert dialog.executed
    assert dialog.args[0] is gui
    assert heard == ["@newcomer"]
    assert card._state == "signed_in"
    assert "@newcomer" in card._chip.text
    assert toasts.count == 1

    assert card._save.text() != before

"""Search page tests: widgets are dropped after each test, and the worker thread is scripted."""

from __future__ import annotations

from concurrent.futures import Future
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any

import pytest
import shiboken6
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication

from chatimport.gui.pages import search as search_module
from chatimport.gui.pages.search import SearchPage
from tests.unit.gui.search.fakes import NOW, FakeBackend

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Callable, Iterator
    from pathlib import Path

    from chatimport.gui.context import GuiContext
    from chatimport.search_types import SearchBackend


class ScriptedWorker:
    """Stands in for `SearchWorker`: jobs run at once, or wait until the test resolves them."""

    last: ScriptedWorker | None = None
    manual = False

    def __init__(self, root: Callable[[], Path], factory: Callable[[Path], SearchBackend | None]):
        self._root = root
        self._factory = factory
        self.pending: list[tuple[Callable[[SearchBackend | None], Any], Future[Any]]] = []
        self.closed = False
        ScriptedWorker.last = self

    def run(self, job: Callable[[SearchBackend | None], Any]) -> Future[Any]:
        future: Future[Any] = Future()
        if self.manual:
            self.pending.append((job, future))
        else:
            self._execute(job, future)
        return future

    def _execute(self, job: Callable[[SearchBackend | None], Any], future: Future[Any]) -> None:
        try:
            future.set_result(job(self._factory(self._root())))
        except Exception as error:
            future.set_exception(error)

    def resolve(self, index: int) -> None:
        job, future = self.pending[index]
        self._execute(job, future)

    def close(self) -> None:
        self.closed = True


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def drop_top_level_widgets(qapp: QApplication) -> Iterator[None]:
    yield
    for widget in QApplication.topLevelWidgets():
        if shiboken6.isValid(widget):
            widget.hide()
            shiboken6.delete(widget)
    qapp.processEvents()


@pytest.fixture
def backend() -> FakeBackend:
    return FakeBackend()


@pytest.fixture
def make_page(
    gui: GuiContext, backend: FakeBackend, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> Callable[..., SearchPage]:
    monkeypatch.setattr(search_module, "SearchWorker", ScriptedWorker)

    def build(*, manual: bool = False, present: bool = True) -> SearchPage:
        ScriptedWorker.manual = manual
        page = SearchPage(
            gui, backend_factory=lambda _root: backend if present else None, clock=lambda: NOW
        )
        return page

    return build


def worker_of(page: SearchPage) -> ScriptedWorker:
    worker = page._worker  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
    assert isinstance(worker, ScriptedWorker)
    return worker

"""A scripted `SearchBackend` for the Search page tests: no SQLite, no threads of its own."""

from __future__ import annotations

import threading
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from chatimport.gui.models.search_spans import find_spans
from chatimport.search_types import (
    ChatChoice,
    ContextMessage,
    IndexState,
    IndexStatus,
    SearchHit,
    SearchPage,
    SearchQuery,
)

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Sequence

NOW = datetime(2026, 5, 1, 12, 0, 0, tzinfo=UTC)


def make_hit(
    msg_id: int,
    text: str = "hello world",
    *,
    chat_id: int = 1,
    title: str = "Chat one",
    age_hours: float = 1.0,
    edited: bool = False,
    link: str | None = "https://t.me/c/1/1",
) -> SearchHit:
    return SearchHit(
        chat_id=chat_id,
        chat_title=title,
        msg_id=msg_id,
        date=NOW - timedelta(hours=age_hours),
        text=text,
        edited=edited,
        link=link,
    )


def ready_status(indexed: int = 10) -> IndexStatus:
    return IndexStatus(IndexState.READY, indexed, indexed, NOW)


@dataclass
class FakeBackend:
    hits: Sequence[SearchHit] = ()
    chat_list: Sequence[ChatChoice] = ()
    index_status: IndexStatus = field(default_factory=ready_status)
    neighbours: Sequence[ContextMessage] | None = None
    fail_search: bool = False
    fail_status: bool = False
    fail_context: bool = False
    queries: list[SearchQuery] = field(default_factory=list[SearchQuery])
    context_calls: list[tuple[int, int, int, int]] = field(
        default_factory=list[tuple[int, int, int, int]]
    )
    threads: set[int] = field(default_factory=set[int])
    status_calls: int = 0
    closed: bool = False

    def search(self, query: SearchQuery) -> SearchPage:
        self.threads.add(threading.get_ident())
        self.queries.append(query)
        if self.fail_search:
            raise RuntimeError("scripted failure")
        matching = [
            hit
            for hit in self.hits
            if find_spans(hit.text, query.text)
            and (query.chat_ids is None or hit.chat_id in query.chat_ids)
            and (query.since is None or hit.date >= query.since)
            and (query.until is None or hit.date < query.until)
        ]
        matching.sort(key=lambda hit: (hit.date, hit.msg_id), reverse=True)
        window = matching[query.offset : query.offset + query.limit]
        return SearchPage(tuple(window), len(matching), query)

    def context(
        self, chat_id: int, msg_id: int, before: int = 3, after: int = 3
    ) -> tuple[ContextMessage, ...]:
        self.threads.add(threading.get_ident())
        self.context_calls.append((chat_id, msg_id, before, after))
        if self.fail_context:
            raise RuntimeError("scripted failure")
        if self.neighbours is not None:
            return tuple(self.neighbours)
        return tuple(
            ContextMessage(hit.msg_id, hit.date, hit.text, hit.edited, hit.msg_id == msg_id)
            for hit in sorted(self.hits, key=lambda h: h.msg_id)
            if hit.chat_id == chat_id and abs(hit.msg_id - msg_id) <= max(before, after)
        )

    def chats(self) -> tuple[ChatChoice, ...]:
        self.threads.add(threading.get_ident())
        return tuple(self.chat_list)

    def status(self) -> IndexStatus:
        self.threads.add(threading.get_ident())
        self.status_calls += 1
        if self.fail_status:
            raise RuntimeError("scripted failure")
        return self.index_status

    def close(self) -> None:
        self.closed = True

    )
    assert panel.message_count == 3
    assert panel.note == ""

    assert any(format_exact(NOW) in text for text in texts)
    assert any("background-color" in text and "review" in text for text in texts)

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import timedelta
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from PySide6.QtCore import QRect
from PySide6.QtGui import (
    QColor,
    QFont,
    QImage,
    QPainter,
    QPixmap,
    QStandardItem,
    QStandardItemModel,
)
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QStyleOptionViewItem

from chatimport.gui.format import format_ago, format_exact
from chatimport.gui.models.search_model import SearchResultsModel
from chatimport.gui.models.search_spans import ELLIPSIS
from chatimport.gui.pages.search_delegate import MAX_LINES, SearchDelegate, body_layout, utc_now
from chatimport.gui.pages.search_parts import ResultsView
from chatimport.search_types import SearchHit, SearchPage, SearchQuery
from tests.unit.gui.search.fakes import NOW, make_hit

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from chatimport.gui.kit import UiKit

WHITE = QColor("white")


def build(
    kit: UiKit, hits: list[SearchHit], needle: str = "rev", width: int = 400
) -> tuple[SearchResultsModel, SearchDelegate]:
    model = SearchResultsModel()
    model.reset(SearchPage(tuple(hits), len(hits), SearchQuery(text=needle)))
    delegate = SearchDelegate(kit, clock=lambda: NOW)
    delegate.needle = needle
    delegate.available_width = width
    return model, delegate


def option(width: int = 400, height: int = 120) -> QStyleOptionViewItem:
    item = QStyleOptionViewItem()
    item.rect = QRect(0, 0, width, height)
    item.font = QFont()
    return item


def painted(delegate: SearchDelegate, model: SearchResultsModel, width: int = 400) -> QImage:
    pixmap = QPixmap(width, 120)
    pixmap.fill(WHITE)
    painter = QPainter(pixmap)
    delegate.paint(painter, option(width), model.index(0, 0))
    painter.end()
    return pixmap.toImage()


def colors(image: QImage) -> set[int]:
    return {image.pixel(x, y) for x in range(0, image.width(), 2) for y in range(image.height())}


def test_a_hit_is_painted(kit: UiKit) -> None:
    model, delegate = build(kit, [make_hit(1, "a review of the plan")])
    assert len(colors(painted(delegate, model))) > 2


def test_matches_are_highlighted(kit: UiKit) -> None:
    hits = [make_hit(1, "a review of the plan")]
    model, delegate = build(kit, hits)
    with_match = painted(delegate, model)
    delegate.needle = "zzz"
    assert painted(delegate, model) != with_match


def test_edited_pill_is_painted(kit: UiKit) -> None:
    plain_model, plain = build(kit, [make_hit(1, "a review", edited=False)])
    edited_model, edited = build(kit, [make_hit(1, "a review", edited=True)])
    assert painted(edited, edited_model) != painted(plain, plain_model)


def test_head_stacks_when_it_does_not_fit(kit: UiKit) -> None:
    hit = make_hit(1, "a review", title="A rather long chat title for this row", edited=True)
    _model, delegate = build(kit, [hit])
    font = QFont()
    assert delegate._is_stacked(font, hit, 200)  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
    assert not delegate._is_stacked(font, hit, 2000)  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
    wide = delegate._head_height(font, hit, 2000)  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
    narrow = delegate._head_height(font, hit, 200)  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
    assert narrow > wide


def test_stacked_head_paints(kit: UiKit) -> None:
    hit = make_hit(1, "a review", title="A rather long chat title for this row", edited=True)
    model, delegate = build(kit, [hit], width=220)
    assert len(colors(painted(delegate, model, 220))) > 2

    long = make_hit(2, "review " + "word " * 80)

# pyright: reportUnknownLambdaType=false, reportUnknownArgumentType=false
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from PySide6.QtWidgets import QWidget

from chatimport.gui.i18n import plural
from chatimport.gui.pages.search_filters import ChatFilter, StatusStrip
from chatimport.gui.strings import translate
from chatimport.search_types import ChatChoice, IndexState, IndexStatus
from tests.unit.gui.search.fakes import NOW

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    import pytest

    from chatimport.gui.kit import UiKit

CHATS = (ChatChoice(1, "Alpha", 1200), ChatChoice(2, "Beta", 30), ChatChoice(3, "Gamma", 5))


def make_filter(kit: UiKit) -> tuple[ChatFilter, QWidget, list[bool]]:
    owner = QWidget()
    chat_filter = ChatFilter(kit, owner)
    changes: list[bool] = []
    chat_filter.changed.connect(lambda: changes.append(True))
    return chat_filter, owner, changes


def checkable(chat_filter: ChatFilter) -> list[tuple[str, bool]]:
    return [(a.text(), a.isChecked()) for a in chat_filter.menu.actions() if a.isCheckable()]


def test_without_chats_the_button_is_disabled(kit: UiKit) -> None:
    chat_filter, _owner, _changes = make_filter(kit)
    assert not chat_filter.button.isEnabled()
    assert chat_filter.button.text() == "All chats"
    labels = [a.text() for a in chat_filter.menu.actions() if not a.isSeparator()]
    assert labels == ["All chats", "No chats in the index yet"]
    assert chat_filter.selected == frozenset()


def test_menu_lists_every_chat_with_its_size(kit: UiKit) -> None:
    chat_filter, _owner, _changes = make_filter(kit)
    chat_filter.set_chats(CHATS)
    assert chat_filter.button.isEnabled()
    assert checkable(chat_filter) == [
        ("All chats", True),
        ("Alpha  (1,200)", False),
        ("Beta  (30)", False),
        ("Gamma  (5)", False),
    ]


def test_choosing_chats_updates_the_selection_and_the_button(kit: UiKit) -> None:
    chat_filter, _owner, changes = make_filter(kit)
    chat_filter.set_chats(CHATS)
    actions = [a for a in chat_filter.menu.actions() if a.isCheckable()]
    actions[2].trigger()
    assert chat_filter.selected == frozenset({2})
    assert chat_filter.button.text() == "Beta"
    assert not actions[0].isChecked()
    assert actions[2].isChecked()
    assert changes == [True]
    actions[3].trigger()
    assert chat_filter.selected == frozenset({2, 3})
    assert chat_filter.button.text() == plural(2, "find.chats.some")
    actions[2].trigger()
    assert chat_filter.selected == frozenset({3})
    assert chat_filter.button.text() == "Gamma"
    assert len(changes) == 3


def test_all_chats_clears_the_selection(kit: UiKit) -> None:
    chat_filter, _owner, changes = make_filter(kit)
    chat_filter.set_chats(CHATS)
    actions = [a for a in chat_filter.menu.actions() if a.isCheckable()]
    actions[1].trigger()
    actions[0].trigger()
    assert chat_filter.selected == frozenset()
    assert chat_filter.button.text() == "All chats"
    assert actions[0].isChecked()
    assert not actions[1].isChecked()
    assert len(changes) == 2

def strip_text(strip: StatusStrip) -> str:
    return strip.label.text()


def test_strip_for_a_ready_index(kit: UiKit) -> None:
    strip = StatusStrip(kit)
    changing = strip.show_state(IndexState.READY, IndexStatus(IndexState.READY, 1500, 1500, NOW))
    assert not changing
    assert strip_text(strip) == "1,500 messages in the index"
    assert strip.progress.isHidden()
    one = strip.show_state(IndexState.READY, IndexStatus(IndexState.READY, 1, 1, NOW))
    assert not one
    assert strip_text(strip) == "1 message in the index"


def test_strip_while_building(kit: UiKit) -> None:
    strip = StatusStrip(kit)
    changing = strip.show_state(IndexState.BUILDING, IndexStatus(IndexState.BUILDING, 47, 100, NOW))
    assert changing
    assert strip_text(strip) == "Indexing 47%"
    assert not strip.progress.isHidden()
    assert strip.progress.value == 0.47
    assert "47" in strip.label.toolTip()
    assert "100" in strip.label.toolTip()


def test_strip_while_building_an_empty_archive(kit: UiKit) -> None:

    assert strip_text(strip) == "Indexing 0%"
    assert strip.progress.value is None


def test_strip_for_the_other_states(kit: UiKit) -> None:
    strip = StatusStrip(kit)
    disabled = IndexStatus(IndexState.DISABLED, 0, 0, None)
    assert not strip.show_state(IndexState.DISABLED, disabled)
    assert strip_text(strip) == "Search is off"
    assert strip.show_state(IndexState.MISSING, None)
    assert strip_text(strip) == "No search index yet"
    assert not strip.show_state(None, None)
    assert strip_text(strip) == "Checking the index"
    assert not strip.show_state(IndexState.READY, None)
    assert strip_text(strip) == "Checking the index"
    assert strip.label.toolTip() == ""
    assert strip.progress.isHidden()


def test_strip_follows_the_zoom(kit: UiKit) -> None:
    strip = StatusStrip(kit)
    before = strip.progress.maximumWidth()
    kit.zoom.set_factor(1.5)
    assert strip.progress.maximumWidth() > before

# pyright: reportUnknownLambdaType=false, reportUnknownArgumentType=false
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import replace

from PySide6.QtCore import QModelIndex, Qt

from chatimport.gui.format import format_exact
from chatimport.gui.models.search_model import HIT_ROLE, SearchResultsModel, same_search
from chatimport.search_types import SearchPage, SearchQuery
from tests.unit.gui.search.fakes import make_hit


def page_of(
    first: int, count: int, total: int, *, text: str = "abc", offset: int = 0
) -> SearchPage:
    hits = tuple(make_hit(first + n) for n in range(count))
    return SearchPage(hits, total, SearchQuery(text=text, offset=offset))


def test_new_model_is_empty() -> None:
    model = SearchResultsModel()
    assert model.rowCount() == 0
    assert model.total == 0
    assert model.loaded == 0
    assert not model.fetching
    assert model.needle == ""
    assert not model.canFetchMore()
    assert model.hit_at(0) is None
    assert model.hit_at(-1) is None


def test_reset_takes_the_first_page_and_the_real_total() -> None:
    model = SearchResultsModel()
    resets: list[bool] = []
    model.modelReset.connect(lambda: resets.append(True))
    model.reset(page_of(1, 3, 250))
    assert resets == [True]
    assert model.rowCount() == 3
    assert model.total == 250
    assert model.loaded == 3
    assert model.needle == "abc"
    assert model.canFetchMore()


def test_data_roles() -> None:
    model = SearchResultsModel()
    hit = make_hit(1, "some text")
    model.reset(SearchPage((hit,), 1, SearchQuery(text="some")))
    index = model.index(0, 0)
    assert index.data(HIT_ROLE) == hit
    assert index.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole) == "some text"
    assert index.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.ToolTipRole) == format_exact(hit.date)
    assert index.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.DecorationRole) is None
    assert model.data(QModelIndex(), HIT_ROLE) is None
    assert model.data(model.index(5, 0), HIT_ROLE) is None


def test_children_of_a_row_do_not_exist() -> None:
    model = SearchResultsModel()
    model.reset(page_of(1, 2, 2))
    parent = model.index(0, 0)
    assert model.rowCount(parent) == 0
    assert not model.canFetchMore(parent)
    model.fetchMore(parent)
    assert not model.fetching


def test_fetch_more_asks_for_the_next_offset_once() -> None:
    model = SearchResultsModel()
    model.reset(page_of(1, 100, 250))
    asked: list[int] = []
    model.more_requested.connect(asked.append)
    model.fetchMore()
    assert asked == [100]
    assert model.fetching
    assert not model.canFetchMore()
    model.fetchMore()
    assert asked == [100]


def test_fetch_more_does_nothing_when_everything_is_loaded() -> None:
    model = SearchResultsModel()
    model.reset(page_of(1, 3, 3))
    asked: list[int] = []
    model.more_requested.connect(asked.append)
    model.fetchMore()
    assert asked == []


def test_append_continues_the_list() -> None:
    model = SearchResultsModel()
    model.reset(page_of(1, 100, 250))
    inserted: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
    model.rowsInserted.connect(lambda _parent, first, last: inserted.append((first, last)))
    model.fetchMore()
    assert model.append(page_of(101, 100, 250, offset=100))
    assert inserted == [(100, 199)]
    assert model.loaded == 200
    assert not model.fetching
    assert model.canFetchMore()
    assert model.hit_at(150) is not None


def test_append_raises_the_total_when_the_index_grew() -> None:
    model = SearchResultsModel()
    model.reset(page_of(1, 2, 2))
    assert model.append(page_of(3, 2, 7, offset=2))
    assert model.total == 7
    assert model.loaded == 4


def test_append_of_an_empty_page_settles_the_total() -> None:
    model = SearchResultsModel()
    model.reset(page_of(1, 2, 5))
    model.fetchMore()
    assert model.append(page_of(3, 0, 5, offset=2))
    assert model.total == 2
    assert not model.canFetchMore()
    assert not model.fetching


def test_append_refuses_a_page_of_another_search() -> None:
    model = SearchResultsModel()
    model.reset(page_of(1, 2, 9, text="abc"))
    assert not model.append(page_of(3, 2, 9, text="abd", offset=2))
    assert model.loaded == 2


def test_append_refuses_a_page_with_the_wrong_offset() -> None:
    model = SearchResultsModel()
    model.reset(page_of(1, 2, 9))
    assert not model.append(page_of(5, 2, 9, offset=4))
    assert not model.append(page_of(1, 2, 9, offset=0))
    assert model.loaded == 2


def test_append_without_a_first_page_is_refused() -> None:
    model = SearchResultsModel()
    assert not model.append(page_of(1, 2, 2, offset=0))


def test_fetch_failed_allows_another_attempt() -> None:
    model = SearchResultsModel()
    model.reset(page_of(1, 2, 9))
    model.fetchMore()
    model.fetch_failed()
    assert not model.fetching
    assert model.canFetchMore()


def test_clear_empties_everything() -> None:
    model = SearchResultsModel()
    model.reset(page_of(1, 2, 9))
    model.fetchMore()
    model.clear()
    assert model.rowCount() == 0
    assert model.total == 0
    assert model.needle == ""
    assert not model.fetching


def test_same_search_ignores_only_the_offset() -> None:
    base = SearchQuery(text="a", limit=10)
    assert same_search(base, replace(base, offset=30))
    assert not same_search(base, replace(base, text="b"))
    assert not same_search(base, replace(base, limit=20))
    assert not same_search(base, replace(base, chat_ids=frozenset({1})))

def reviews(count: int, *, chat_id: int = 1, title: str = "Chat one") -> list[SearchHit]:
    return [
        make_hit(n, f"review number {n}", chat_id=chat_id, title=title, age_hours=n / 100)
        for n in range(count)
    ]


def search_for(page: SearchPage, text: str) -> None:
    page.field.setText(text)
    page.run_query()


def row(page: SearchPage) -> int:
    return page.results.currentIndex().row()

    assert page.strip.label.text() == "Checking the index"
    assert page.previous_button.isHidden()
    assert page.next_button.isHidden()
    assert page.context.isHidden()
    assert page.state is None
    assert backend.queries == []
    assert worker_of(page).pending == []

    make_page: Maker, backend: FakeBackend
) -> None:

    assert backend.queries == []

    assert page.delegate.needle == "rev"
    assert page.busy.isHidden()
    assert not page.previous_button.isHidden()

def test_an_older_answer_never_replaces_a_newer_one(make_page: Maker, backend: FakeBackend) -> None:
    backend.hits = [make_hit(1, "alpha beta"), make_hit(2, "alpha")]
    page = make_page(manual=True)
    worker = worker_of(page)
    search_for(page, "alph")
    search_for(page, "alpha b")
    assert len(worker.pending) == 2
    assert not page.busy.isHidden()
    worker.resolve(1)
    assert page.model.loaded == 1
    assert page.model.needle == "alpha b"
    assert page.busy.isHidden()
    worker.resolve(0)
    assert page.model.loaded == 1
    assert page.model.needle == "alpha b"
    assert page.stack.currentIndex() == RESULTS

def test_a_failing_extra_page_can_be_retried(
    make_page: Maker, backend: FakeBackend, caplog: pytest.LogCaptureFixture
) -> None:
    backend.hits = reviews(250)
    page = make_page()
    search_for(page, "review")
    backend.fail_search = True
    with caplog.at_level(logging.WARNING):
        page.model.fetchMore()
    assert not page.model.fetching
    assert page.model.loaded == 100
    assert "loading more results failed" in caplog.text
    backend.fail_search = False
    page.model.fetchMore()
    assert page.model.loaded == 200


def test_unusable_extra_pages_are_refused(make_page: Maker, backend: FakeBackend) -> None:
    backend.hits = reviews(250)
    page = make_page()
    search_for(page, "review")
    done: Future[Page | None] = Future()
    done.set_result(None)
    page._advance_after_fetch = True
    page._on_more_page(page._seq, done)
    assert not page._advance_after_fetch
    other: Future[Page | None] = Future()
    other.set_result(Page(tuple(reviews(2)), 250, SearchQuery(text="other", offset=100)))
    page._on_more_page(page._seq, other)
    assert page.model.loaded == 100
    assert not page.model.fetching

class FakeDesktop:
    urls: list[str] = []  # noqa: RUF012
    accept = True

    @staticmethod
    def openUrl(url: QUrl) -> bool:
        FakeDesktop.urls.append(url.toString())
        return FakeDesktop.accept


def reviews(count: int, *, link: str | None = "https://t.me/c/1/1") -> list[SearchHit]:
    return [make_hit(n, f"review number {n}", age_hours=n / 100, link=link) for n in range(count)]


def search_for(page: SearchPage, text: str) -> None:
    page.field.setText(text)
    page.run_query()


def opened(make_page: Maker, backend: FakeBackend, count: int = 5) -> SearchPage:
    backend.hits = reviews(count)
    page = make_page()
    search_for(page, "review")
    page._select_row(1)
    page.open_context()
    return page

def test_a_late_context_answer_is_dropped(make_page: Maker, backend: FakeBackend) -> None:

    assert len(worker.pending) == 3
    worker.resolve(2)

    assert page.context.message_count == 5
    worker.resolve(1)

    assert page.context.message_count == 5

class Notes:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.items: list[tuple[str, str]] = []

    def __call__(self, _widget: object, tone: str, message: str) -> None:
        self.items.append((tone, message))


def patched(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, *, accept: bool = True) -> Notes:
    notes = Notes()
    monkeypatch.setattr(search_actions, "notify", notes)
    monkeypatch.setattr(search_actions, "QDesktopServices", FakeDesktop)
    FakeDesktop.urls = []
    FakeDesktop.accept = accept
    QGuiApplication.clipboard().setText("")
    return notes


def test_copy_text_and_link(
    make_page: Maker, backend: FakeBackend, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    notes = patched(monkeypatch)
    page = opened(make_page, backend)
    hit = page.selected_hit()
    assert hit is not None
    page.copy_text()
    assert QGuiApplication.clipboard().text() == hit.text
    page.copy_link()
    assert QGuiApplication.clipboard().text() == "https://t.me/c/1/1"
    assert notes.items == [
        ("success", "The message text is copied."),
        ("success", "The link is copied."),
    ]

def test_the_period_becomes_a_lower_bound(make_page: Maker, backend: FakeBackend) -> None:
    backend.hits = reviews(3)
    page = make_page()
    assert PERIODS == ("any", "today", "week", "month", "year")
    assert page.since is None
    search_for(page, "review")
    expected = {2: timedelta(days=7), 3: timedelta(days=30), 4: timedelta(days=365)}
    for index, delta in expected.items():
        page.period.choose(index)
        assert page._debounce.isActive()
        page.run_query()
        assert backend.queries[-1].since == NOW - delta
    page.period.choose(0)
    page.run_query()
    assert backend.queries[-1].since is None


def test_today_starts_at_local_midnight(make_page: Maker, backend: FakeBackend) -> None:
    backend.hits = reviews(3)
    page = make_page()
    search_for(page, "review")
    page.period.choose(1)
    page.run_query()
    since = backend.queries[-1].since
    assert since is not None
    assert since.utcoffset() == timedelta(0)
    assert since.tzinfo is UTC
    local = since.astimezone()
    assert (local.hour, local.minute, local.second) == (0, 0, 0)
    assert timedelta(0) <= NOW - since < timedelta(days=2)

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from PySide6.QtCore import QEvent, QPointF, Qt
from PySide6.QtGui import QImage, QMouseEvent
from PySide6.QtTest import QTest

from chatimport.gui.pages.search_delegate import SearchDelegate
from chatimport.gui.pages.search_parts import QueryField, ResultsView, Skeleton, StickyMenu
from chatimport.gui.strings import translate

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from chatimport.gui.kit import UiKit


def release() -> QMouseEvent:
    return QMouseEvent(
        QEvent.Type.MouseButtonRelease,
        QPointF(2, 2),
        QPointF(2, 2),
        Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton,
        Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton,
        Qt.KeyboardModifier.NoModifier,
    )


def test_query_field_navigation_keys(kit: UiKit) -> None:
    field = QueryField(kit)
    nxt: list[bool] = []
    prev: list[bool] = []
    field.next_requested.connect(lambda: nxt.append(True))
    field.previous_requested.connect(lambda: prev.append(True))
    QTest.keyClick(field, Qt.Key.Key_Return)
    QTest.keyClick(field, Qt.Key.Key_Enter)
    QTest.keyClick(field, Qt.Key.Key_Down)
    assert len(nxt) == 3
    QTest.keyClick(field, Qt.Key.Key_Return, Qt.KeyboardModifier.ShiftModifier)
    QTest.keyClick(field, Qt.Key.Key_Up)
    assert len(prev) == 2
    assert len(nxt) == 3


def test_query_field_still_types_and_clears(kit: UiKit) -> None:
    field = QueryField(kit)
    QTest.keyClicks(field, "abc")
    assert field.text() == "abc"
    QTest.keyClick(field, Qt.Key.Key_Escape)
    assert field.text() == ""


def test_query_field_placeholder_shows_the_shortcut_and_follows_the_language(kit: UiKit) -> None:
    field = QueryField(kit)
    assert "Ctrl+F" in field.placeholderText()
    assert field.accessibleName() == field.placeholderText()
    kit.language.set_language("ru")
    assert field.placeholderText() == translate("ru", "find.placeholder")
    assert "Ctrl+F" in field.placeholderText()


def test_sticky_menu_toggles_without_closing() -> None:
    menu = StickyMenu()
    action = menu.addAction("chat")
    action.setCheckable(True)
    menu.show()
    menu.setActiveAction(action)
    menu.mouseReleaseEvent(release())
    assert action.isChecked()
    assert menu.isVisible()
    menu.mouseReleaseEvent(release())
    assert not action.isChecked()
    assert menu.isVisible()


def test_sticky_menu_leaves_other_entries_to_qt() -> None:
    menu = StickyMenu()
    disabled = menu.addAction("disabled")
    disabled.setCheckable(True)
    disabled.setEnabled(False)
    menu.show()
    menu.setActiveAction(disabled)
    menu.mouseReleaseEvent(release())
    assert not disabled.isChecked()
    menu.setActiveAction(None)  # pyright: ignore[reportArgumentType]
    menu.mouseReleaseEvent(release())
    assert not disabled.isChecked()


def test_skeleton_paints_rows(kit: UiKit) -> None:
    skeleton = Skeleton(kit)
    assert skeleton.sizeHint().width() > 0
    skeleton.resize(300, 400)
    image = QImage(300, 400, QImage.Format.Format_ARGB32)
    skeleton.render(image)
    assert image.pixelColor(30, 25) != image.pixelColor(290, 390)


def test_skeleton_stops_at_the_bottom_edge(kit: UiKit) -> None:
    skeleton = Skeleton(kit)
    skeleton.resize(300, 40)
    image = QImage(300, 40, QImage.Format.Format_ARGB32)
    image.fill(Qt.GlobalColor.white)
    skeleton.render(image)
    assert image.height() == 40


def test_results_view_tells_the_delegate_its_width(kit: UiKit) -> None:
    view = ResultsView()
    delegate = SearchDelegate(kit)
    view.use_delegate(delegate)
    view.show()
    view.resize(360, 200)
    assert delegate.available_width == view.viewport().width()
    view.sync_width()
    assert delegate.available_width == view.viewport().width()

    find_spans,
    fold_needle,
    highlight_html,
    snippet,
)

YO_CAPITAL = "\u0401"
YO = "\u0451"
YE = "\u0435"
ZH = "\u0436"
I_SHORT = "\u0439"
CYR_I = "\u0438"
SHARP_S = "ß"
ACUTE = "́"


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("text", "needle", "expected"),
    [
        ("Hello World", "world", [(6, 11)]),
        ("Hello World", "WORLD", [(6, 11)]),
        ("abcabc", "bc", [(1, 3), (4, 6)]),
        ("aaaa", "aa", [(0, 4)]),
        ("abab", "ab", [(0, 4)]),
        ("abc", "zz", []),
        ("", "a", []),
        ("abc", "", []),
        ("abc", "   ", []),
        ("a   b", "a b", [(0, 5)]),
        ("a \n b", "a b", [(0, 5)]),
        ("xx a yy", " a ", [(3, 4)]),
        (" a", "a", [(1, 2)]),
        ("\u041f\u0440\u0418\u0412\u0435\u0422", "\u043f\u0440\u0438\u0432\u0435\u0442", [(0, 6)]),
    ],
)
def test_plain_matches(text: str, needle: str, expected: list[tuple[int, int]]) -> None:
    assert find_spans(text, needle) == expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("text", "needle", "expected"),
    [
        (f"Stra{SHARP_S}e", "strasse", [(0, 6)]),
        (f"Stra{SHARP_S}e", "ss", [(4, 5)]),
        (f"a{SHARP_S}b", "s", [(1, 2)]),
        (f"a{SHARP_S}b", "b", [(2, 3)]),
        (f"cafe{ACUTE}", "cafe", [(0, 5)]),
        ("café", "cafe", [(0, 4)]),
        (f"CAFE{ACUTE}", "café", [(0, 5)]),
        (f"e{ACUTE}x", "x", [(2, 3)]),
        (f"{ACUTE}a", "a", [(1, 2)]),
        (f"{YO_CAPITAL}{ZH}\u0438\u043a", f"{YE}{ZH}", [(0, 2)]),
        (f"{YE}{ZH}\u0438\u043a", f"{YO}{ZH}", [(0, 2)]),
        (f"{I_SHORT}", f"{CYR_I}", []),
        (f"{CYR_I}", f"{I_SHORT}", []),
        (f"{I_SHORT.upper()}\u043e\u0433\u0443\u0440\u0442", f"{I_SHORT}", [(0, 1)]),
        ("Ñandú", "nandu", [(0, 5)]),
    ],
)
def test_folding_keeps_spans_valid_for_the_original(
    text: str, needle: str, expected: list[tuple[int, int]]
) -> None:
    assert find_spans(text, needle) == expected


def test_spans_are_sorted_and_never_overlap() -> None:
    spans = find_spans("ababab xx abab", "ab")
    assert spans == sorted(spans)
    assert all(a[1] < b[0] for a, b in pairwise(spans))
    assert spans == [(0, 6), (10, 14)]


def test_every_span_folds_to_text_containing_the_needle() -> None:
    text = f"Stra{SHARP_S}e and café cafe{ACUTE} {YO_CAPITAL}{ZH} {YE}{ZH}"
    for needle in ("stra", "cafe", f"{YE}{ZH}", "e a"):
        for start, end in find_spans(text, needle):
            assert fold_needle(needle) in fold_needle(text[start:end])


def test_fold_needle() -> None:
    assert fold_needle("  Ab" + ACUTE + "C  d ") == "abc d"
    assert fold_needle("") == ""
    assert fold_needle(" \n ") == ""
    assert fold_needle(f"Stra{SHARP_S}e") == "strasse"


def test_short_text_is_returned_whole() -> None:
    assert snippet("hello world", "WORLD") == Snippet("hello world", ((6, 11),), False)


def test_snippet_flattens_line_breaks_one_to_one() -> None:
    result = snippet("a\nb\r\nc", "b")
    assert result.text == "a b  c"
    assert result.spans == ((2, 3),)
    assert not result.truncated


def test_long_text_is_cut_around_the_first_match_on_both_sides() -> None:
    long = "word " * 200 + "needle" + " tail" * 200
    result = snippet(long, "needle")
    assert result.truncated
    assert result.text.startswith(ELLIPSIS)
    assert result.text.endswith(ELLIPSIS)
    assert len(result.text) <= 322
    assert [result.text[a:b] for a, b in result.spans] == ["needle"]


def test_match_at_the_start_has_no_leading_ellipsis() -> None:
    result = snippet("needle " + "word " * 200, "needle")
    assert result.truncated
    assert result.text.startswith("needle")
    assert result.text.endswith(ELLIPSIS)
    assert result.spans == ((0, 6),)


def test_match_at_the_end_has_no_trailing_ellipsis() -> None:
    result = snippet("word " * 200 + "needle", "needle")
    assert result.truncated
    assert result.text.startswith(ELLIPSIS)
    assert result.text.endswith("needle")
    assert [result.text[a:b] for a, b in result.spans] == ["needle"]


def test_no_needle_keeps_the_start() -> None:
    result = snippet("word " * 200, "")
    assert result.truncated
    assert not result.text.startswith(ELLIPSIS)
    assert result.text.endswith(ELLIPSIS)
    assert result.spans == ()
    assert len(result.text) == 320


def test_text_without_spaces_is_cut_hard() -> None:
    result = snippet("x" * 1000 + "needle" + "y" * 1000, "needle")
    assert result.text[0] == ELLIPSIS
    assert result.text[-1] == ELLIPSIS
    assert [result.text[a:b] for a, b in result.spans] == ["needle"]


def test_a_span_cut_by_the_end_is_clipped() -> None:
    result = snippet("aaaa bbbb cccc dddd eeee", "bbbb cccc", limit=12)
    assert result == Snippet("aaaa bbbb" + ELLIPSIS, ((5, 9),), True)


def test_a_match_outside_the_window_is_dropped() -> None:
    result = snippet("aaaa bbbb cccc dddd eeee", "cccc dddd", limit=12)
    assert result.spans == ()
    assert result.text == "aaaa bbbb" + ELLIPSIS


def test_highlight_html_escapes_and_marks_spans() -> None:
    html = highlight_html("a<b>&\nc", [(0, 1), (2, 5)], "#fff")
    assert html == (
        '<span style="background-color:#fff">a</span>&lt;'
        '<span style="background-color:#fff">b&gt;&amp;</span><br>c'
    )


def test_highlight_html_without_spans() -> None:
    assert highlight_html("plain <x>", [], "#fff") == "plain &lt;x&gt;"

# pyright: reportUnknownLambdaType=false, reportUnknownArgumentType=false
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import threading
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any

import pytest

from chatimport.gui.pages import search_worker
from chatimport.gui.pages.search_worker import THREAD_NAME, SearchWorker, default_backend_factory
from tests.unit.gui.search.fakes import FakeBackend

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Iterator


@pytest.fixture
def workers() -> Iterator[list[SearchWorker]]:
    created: list[SearchWorker] = []
    yield created
    for worker in created:
        worker.close()
        worker._pool.shutdown(wait=True)  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]


def make(workers: list[SearchWorker], root: Path, factory: Any) -> SearchWorker:
    worker = SearchWorker(lambda: root, factory)
    workers.append(worker)
    return worker


def test_default_factory_without_the_module(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    def missing(_name: str) -> Any:
        raise ImportError("no module")

    monkeypatch.setattr(search_worker, "importlib", SimpleNamespace(import_module=missing))
    assert default_backend_factory(Path("data")) is None


def test_default_factory_without_an_opener(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    fake = SimpleNamespace(import_module=lambda _name: SimpleNamespace(open_reader=None))
    monkeypatch.setattr(search_worker, "importlib", fake)
    assert default_backend_factory(Path("data")) is None


def test_default_factory_opens_the_reader(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    backend = FakeBackend()
    roots: list[Path] = []

    def open_reader(root: Path) -> FakeBackend:
        roots.append(root)
        return backend

    module = SimpleNamespace(open_reader=open_reader)
    fake = SimpleNamespace(import_module=lambda _name: module)
    monkeypatch.setattr(search_worker, "importlib", fake)
    assert default_backend_factory(Path("data")) is backend
    assert roots == [Path("data")]


def test_jobs_run_on_one_dedicated_thread(workers: list[SearchWorker], tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    backend = FakeBackend()
    opened: list[int] = []

    def factory(_root: Path) -> FakeBackend:
        opened.append(threading.get_ident())
        return backend

    worker = make(workers, tmp_path, factory)
    first = worker.run(lambda b: threading.get_ident() if b is not None else 0).result(timeout=5)
    second = worker.run(lambda b: threading.get_ident() if b is not None else 0).result(timeout=5)
    assert first == second != threading.get_ident()
    assert opened == [first]


def test_the_thread_has_a_name(workers: list[SearchWorker], tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    worker = make(workers, tmp_path, lambda _root: None)
    name = worker.run(lambda _b: threading.current_thread().name).result(timeout=5)
    assert name.startswith(THREAD_NAME)


def test_the_backend_is_opened_once_and_passed_to_jobs(
    workers: list[SearchWorker], tmp_path: Path
) -> None:
    backend = FakeBackend()
    calls: list[Path] = []

    def factory(root: Path) -> FakeBackend:
        calls.append(root)
        return backend

    worker = make(workers, tmp_path, factory)
    assert worker.run(lambda b: b).result(timeout=5) is backend
    assert worker.run(lambda b: b).result(timeout=5) is backend
    assert calls == [tmp_path]


def test_a_missing_index_is_retried(workers: list[SearchWorker], tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    backend = FakeBackend()
    answers: list[FakeBackend | None] = [None, backend]
    worker = make(workers, tmp_path, lambda _root: answers.pop(0))
    assert worker.run(lambda b: b).result(timeout=5) is None
    assert worker.run(lambda b: b).result(timeout=5) is backend


def test_a_new_root_reopens_the_backend(workers: list[SearchWorker], tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    roots = [tmp_path / "one", tmp_path / "two"]
    current = [roots[0]]
    backends: dict[Path, FakeBackend] = {root: FakeBackend() for root in roots}
    worker = SearchWorker(lambda: current[0], lambda root: backends[root])
    workers.append(worker)
    assert worker.run(lambda b: b).result(timeout=5) is backends[roots[0]]
    current[0] = roots[1]
    assert worker.run(lambda b: b).result(timeout=5) is backends[roots[1]]
    assert backends[roots[0]].closed
    assert not backends[roots[1]].closed


def test_job_errors_travel_in_the_future(workers: list[SearchWorker], tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    worker = make(workers, tmp_path, lambda _root: None)

    def boom(_backend: object) -> None:
        raise ValueError("boom")

    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="boom"):
        worker.run(boom).result(timeout=5)


def test_close_drops_the_backend_on_the_worker_thread(
    workers: list[SearchWorker], tmp_path: Path
) -> None:
    backend = FakeBackend()
    worker = make(workers, tmp_path, lambda _root: backend)
    worker.run(lambda b: b).result(timeout=5)
    worker.close()
    worker._pool.shutdown(wait=True)  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
    assert backend.closed
    late = worker.run(lambda b: b)
    assert late.cancelled()
    worker.close()


def test_close_before_any_use_is_harmless(workers: list[SearchWorker], tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    worker = make(workers, tmp_path, lambda _root: None)
    worker.close()
    worker._pool.shutdown(wait=True)  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
    assert worker.run(lambda b: b).cancelled()


def test_a_failing_close_is_logged_without_details(
    workers: list[SearchWorker], tmp_path: Path, caplog: pytest.LogCaptureFixture
) -> None:
    class Broken(FakeBackend):
        def close(self) -> None:
            raise OSError("secret detail")

    worker = make(workers, tmp_path, lambda _root: Broken())
    worker.run(lambda b: b).result(timeout=5)
    with caplog.at_level(logging.WARNING, logger=search_worker.__name__):
        worker.close()
        worker._pool.shutdown(wait=True)  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
    assert "OSError" in caplog.text
    assert "secret detail" not in caplog.text

def set_exec(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, captured: Captured, action: Callable[[], None] | None = None
) -> None:
    def fake_exec(self: QApplication) -> int:
        captured.exec_calls += 1
        if action is not None:
            action()
        return 0

    monkeypatch.setattr(QApplication, "exec", fake_exec)

def test_application_creates_one_when_missing(
    qapp: QApplication, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    policies: list[object] = []

    class Missing:
        def __new__(cls, argv: list[str]) -> QApplication:
            return qapp

        @staticmethod
        def instance() -> None:
            return None

    monkeypatch.setattr(launch, "QApplication", Missing)
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        launch.QGuiApplication,
        "setHighDpiScaleFactorRoundingPolicy",
        staticmethod(policies.append),
    )
    assert launch._application() is qapp
    assert len(policies) == 1
    monkeypatch.undo()
    assert launch._application() is qapp

    def __init__(self, error: BaseException | None) -> None:
        self.error = error
        self.ids: list[str] = []

    def SetCurrentProcessExplicitAppUserModelID(self, value: str) -> None:
        if self.error is not None:

        self.ids.append(value)

    def __init__(self, error: BaseException | None) -> None:
        self.shell32 = FakeShell32(error)

    launch._set_app_user_model_id()
    assert ok.shell32.ids == [launch.APP_USER_MODEL_ID]
    for error in (AttributeError("x"), OSError("y")):
        monkeypatch.setattr(ctypes, "windll", FakeWindll(error), raising=False)
        with caplog.at_level(logging.WARNING, logger=launch.__name__):
            launch._set_app_user_model_id()
    assert caplog.text.count("could not set") == 2
    monkeypatch.setattr(launch.sys, "platform", "linux")
    launch._set_app_user_model_id()
    assert ok.shell32.ids == [launch.APP_USER_MODEL_ID]

@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def join_login_threads() -> Iterator[None]:
    gc.collect()
    gc.disable()
    yield
    gc.enable()

def named(name: str, base: type[BaseException] = Exception) -> type[BaseException]:
    return type(name, (base,), {})


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("name", "kind"),
    [
        ("PhoneNumberInvalidError", "invalid_phone"),
        ("PhoneCodeExpiredError", "wrong_code"),
        ("PasswordHashInvalidError", "wrong_password"),
        ("ApiIdInvalidError", "api"),
        ("TimeoutError", "network"),
        ("AlreadyRunning", "busy"),
    ],
)
def test_classify_by_class_name(name: str, kind: str) -> None:
    assert classify_failure(named(name)("x")) == Failure(kind)


def test_classify_special_cases() -> None:
    flood = named("FloodWaitError")("x")
    flood.seconds = 30  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    assert classify_failure(flood) == Failure("flood", 30)
    odd = named("FloodWaitError")("x")
    odd.seconds = "soon"  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    assert classify_failure(odd) == Failure("flood", None)
    assert classify_failure(LoginCancelled()).kind == "cancelled"
    assert classify_failure(named("Mine", RuntimeError)("x")).kind == "too_many"
    assert classify_failure(ChatImportError("x")).kind == "generic"
    assert classify_failure(ValueError("x")).kind == "generic"
    wrapped = ChatImportError("outer")
    wrapped.__cause__ = named("PhoneNumberBannedError")("inner")
    assert classify_failure(wrapped).kind == "banned"
    cancelled = ValueError("outer")
    cancelled.__cause__ = LoginCancelled()
    assert classify_failure(cancelled).kind == "cancelled"


def make_session(
    ctx: ServiceContext,
    login: Callable[..., Awaitable[str]],
    phone: str = PHONE,
) -> LoginSession:
    return LoginSession(
        ctx.config.telegram, ctx.paths.session_file, ctx.paths.lock_file, login, phone
    )


def run_session(session: LoginSession, qapp: QApplication) -> list[tuple[str, str, int]]:
    finished: list[tuple[str, str, int]] = []
    session.finished.connect(lambda h, f, s: finished.append((h, f, s)))
    session.start()
    session._thread.join(5)
    assert not session.running
    qapp.processEvents()
    return finished


def test_session_success_with_queued_answers(
    service_context: ServiceContext, qapp: QApplication
) -> None:
    seen: list[tuple[str, str, str]] = []

    async def login(
        config: Any,
        path: Any,
        *,
        prompt_phone: Prompt,
        prompt_code: Prompt,
        prompt_password: <REDACTED>
    ) -> str:
        seen.append((prompt_phone(), prompt_code(), prompt_password()))
        return "@someone"

    session = make_session(service_context, login)
    prompts: list[tuple[str, int]] = []
    session.prompted.connect(lambda kind, attempt: prompts.append((kind, attempt)))
    session.answer("111")
    session.answer("secret")
    assert run_session(session, qapp) == [("@someone", "", 0)]
    assert seen == [(PHONE, "111", "secret")]
    assert prompts == [("code", 1), ("password", 1)]


def test_session_asks_phone_when_none_given(

        return prompt_phone()

    session = make_session(service_context, login, phone="")
