from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import replace
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import pytest

from chatimport.config import MediaConfig
from chatimport.media import DOWNLOAD_PAUSE_SECONDS, IDLE_SECONDS, MAX_ATTEMPTS, MediaDownloader
from chatimport.ports import AccessLost, FloodWait
from chatimport.records import MediaInfo, MediaSavedRecord, MessageRecord, Record
from chatimport.runtime import ChatRegistry
from chatimport.storage.layout import STATE_FILE, list_parts
from chatimport.storage.state import save_state
from chatimport.storage.writer import ChunkWriter, iter_records
from tests.fakes import NOW, FakeClock, FakeGateway
from tests.unit.maintenance.helpers import FakeController, at, build_chat, drive, read_state

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pathlib import Path

MIB = 1024 * 1024
CHAT = -100


def photo(size: int | None = 100, kind: str = "photo") -> MediaInfo:
    return MediaInfo(type=kind, size=size)


def media_msg(
    msg_id: int, info: MediaInfo | None = None, *, chat_id: int = CHAT, month: int = 9
) -> MessageRecord:
    return MessageRecord(
        chat_id=chat_id,
        msg_id=msg_id,
        date=at(2026, month, 10, msg_id % 24),
        fetched_at=NOW,
        text="m",
        media=info or photo(),
    )


def drop_file(target_dir: Path, name: str, data: bytes) -> Path:
    target_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path = target_dir / name
    path.write_bytes(data)
    return path


def saved(chat: FakeController) -> list[MediaSavedRecord]:
    return [r for r in iter_records(chat.folder) if isinstance(r, MediaSavedRecord)]


def setup(
    root: Path,
    batches: list[list[Record]],
    *,
    chat_id: int = CHAT,
    types: tuple[str, ...] = ("photo",),
    max_file_mb: int = 50,
    enabled: bool = True,
    title: str = "Chat",
) -> tuple[MediaDownloader, FakeController, FakeGateway, FakeClock, ChatRegistry]:
    chat = build_chat(root, chat_id, batches, title=title)
    registry = ChatRegistry()
    registry.add(chat)
    gateway = FakeGateway()
    clock = FakeClock()
    config = MediaConfig(enabled=enabled, types=types, max_file_mb=max_file_mb)
    downloader = MediaDownloader(registry, gateway, config, clock=clock, max_chunk_bytes=1)
    return downloader, chat, gateway, clock, registry


def provide(gateway: FakeGateway, chat_id: int, *ids: int) -> None:
    for msg_id in ids:
        gateway.media[(chat_id, msg_id)] = f"bytes {msg_id}".encode()


async def test_every_pending_media_is_downloaded_in_id_order_and_recorded_once(
    tmp_path: Path,
) -> None:
    root = tmp_path / "root"
    dl, chat, gateway, clock, _ = setup(root, [[media_msg(3), media_msg(1), media_msg(2)]])
    provide(gateway, CHAT, 1, 2, 3)

    await drive(dl.run, clock, cycles=6)

    assert [c[1][1] for c in gateway.calls if c[0] == "download_media"] == [1, 2, 3]
    records = saved(chat)
    assert [r.msg_id for r in records] == [1, 2, 3]
    assert [r.file for r in records] == [
        "media/2026-09/1.bin",
        "media/2026-09/2.bin",
        "media/2026-09/3.bin",
    ]
    month_dir = chat.folder / "media" / "2026-09"
    assert sorted(p.name for p in month_dir.iterdir()) == ["1.bin", "2.bin", "3.bin"]
    assert (month_dir / "2.bin").read_bytes() == b"bytes 2"
    assert all(r.fetched_at >= NOW for r in records)

async def test_a_second_downloader_does_not_download_again(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    root = tmp_path / "root"
    dl, chat, gateway, clock, registry = setup(root, [[media_msg(1), media_msg(2)]])
    provide(gateway, CHAT, 1, 2)
    await drive(dl.run, clock, cycles=4)
    assert gateway.count("download_media") == 2

    gateway2 = FakeGateway(media=dict(gateway.media))
    clock2 = FakeClock()
    other = MediaDownloader(
        registry,
        gateway2,
        MediaConfig(enabled=True, types=("photo",)),
        clock=clock2,
        max_chunk_bytes=1,
    )
    await drive(other.run, clock2, cycles=3)

    assert gateway2.count("download_media") == 0
    assert len(saved(chat)) == 2

async def test_generic_failures_are_retried_at_most_three_times_per_message(
    tmp_path: Path, caplog: pytest.LogCaptureFixture
) -> None:

    dl, chat, gateway, clock, _ = setup(root, [[media_msg(1), media_msg(2)]])
    provide(gateway, CHAT, 1, 2)
    gateway.fail["download_media"] = [RuntimeError("boom")] * 20

    with caplog.at_level("WARNING"):
        await drive(dl.run, clock, cycles=15)

    calls = [c[1][1] for c in gateway.calls if c[0] == "download_media"]
    assert calls == [1] * MAX_ATTEMPTS + [2] * MAX_ATTEMPTS
    assert saved(chat) == []
    assert caplog.text.count("media download failed") == 2 * MAX_ATTEMPTS

async def test_pausing_during_a_round_robin_stops_before_the_next_chat(
    tmp_path: Path,
) -> None:
    root = tmp_path / "root"
    holder: list[MediaDownloader] = []

    class PausingController(FakeController):
        @property
        def folder(self) -> Path:
            holder[0].pause()
            return super().folder

    dl, real, gateway, clock, registry = setup(root, [[media_msg(2, chat_id=-2)]], chat_id=-2)
    quiet_folder = build_chat(root, -1, [[]], title="A").folder

    registry.add(PausingController(-1, quiet_folder, "A"))
    registry.add(real)
    holder.append(dl)
    provide(gateway, -2, 2)

    assert await dl._download_next() is False  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]

    assert gateway.count("download_media") == 0
    assert saved(real) == []
    assert clock.sleeps == []

async def test_deleting_the_oldest_part_resets_the_scan_without_redownloading(
    tmp_path: Path,
) -> None:
    root = tmp_path / "root"
    dl, chat, gateway, clock, _ = setup(
        root, [[media_msg(1, month=7)], [media_msg(2, month=8)], [media_msg(3, month=9)]]
    )
    provide(gateway, CHAT, 1, 2, 3, 4)
    await drive(dl.run, clock, cycles=7)
    assert gateway.count("download_media") == 3

    list_parts(chat.folder)[0].unlink()
    state = read_state(chat)
    save_state(chat.folder, replace(state, floor_id=2))
    ChunkWriter(chat.folder, 1).append(read_state(chat), [media_msg(4, month=10)])
    clock.sleeps.clear()
    await drive(dl.run, clock, cycles=4)

    calls = [c[1][1] for c in gateway.calls if c[0] == "download_media"]
    assert calls == [1, 2, 3, 4]

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from chatimport import media as media_module
from chatimport.records import MediaInfo, Record
from chatimport.storage.layout import STATE_FILE, list_parts
from chatimport.storage.writer import ChunkWriter

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pathlib import Path

async def test_media_executable_suffix_is_neutralised(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    class ExeGateway(FakeGateway):
        async def download_media(self, chat_id: int, msg_id: int, target_dir: Path) -> Path | None:
            return drop_file(target_dir, "x.exe", b"MZ")

    dl, chat, _, clock, _ = setup(
        tmp_path / "root", [[media_msg(4, MediaInfo(type="document", size=2))]], types=("document",)
    )
    dl._gateway = ExeGateway()  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
    await drive(dl.run, clock, cycles=2)
    (record,) = saved(chat)
    assert record.file == "media/2026-09/4.exe.bin"
    assert (chat.folder / record.file).read_bytes() == b"MZ"


def count_reads(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> list[tuple[str, int]]:
    reads: list[tuple[str, int]] = []
    real = media_module.read_appended

    def spy(path: Path, start: int) -> tuple[list[Record], int]:
        reads.append((path.name, start))
        return real(path, start)

    monkeypatch.setattr(media_module, "read_appended", spy)
    return reads


async def test_media_scan_reads_only_appended_bytes(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    dl, chat, gateway, clock, _ = setup(tmp_path / "root", [[media_msg(1)]])
    provide(gateway, CHAT, 1, 2)
    reads = count_reads(monkeypatch)
    await drive(dl.run, clock, cycles=3)
    assert [r.msg_id for r in saved(chat)] == [1]

    reads.clear()
    part = list_parts(chat.folder)[-1]
    size = part.stat().st_size
    ChunkWriter(chat.folder, 10**9).append(read_state(chat), [media_msg(2, month=10)])
    clock.sleeps.clear()
    await drive(dl.run, clock, cycles=3)

    assert [r.msg_id for r in saved(chat)] == [1, 2]
    assert reads[0] == (part.name, size)


async def test_a_rewrite_of_the_last_part_triggers_a_full_rescan(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    dl, chat, gateway, clock, _ = setup(tmp_path / "root", [[media_msg(1)], [media_msg(2)]])
    provide(gateway, CHAT, 1, 2, 3)
    await drive(dl.run, clock, cycles=4)
    assert [r.msg_id for r in saved(chat)] == [1, 2]

    reads = count_reads(monkeypatch)
    last = list_parts(chat.folder)[-1]
    replacement = last.with_name(".rewrite.tmp")
    replacement.write_bytes(last.read_bytes())
    replacement.replace(last)
    clock.sleeps.clear()
    await drive(dl.run, clock, cycles=2)

    assert reads[0][1] == 0
    assert {name for name, _ in reads} == {p.name for p in list_parts(chat.folder)}
    assert gateway.count("download_media") == 2


async def test_an_unreadable_state_skips_the_chat_for_now(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    from pathlib import Path as RealPath

    dl, _, gateway, clock, _ = setup(tmp_path / "root", [[media_msg(1)]])
    provide(gateway, CHAT, 1)
    real = RealPath.read_bytes

    def locked(self: RealPath) -> bytes:
        if self.name == STATE_FILE:
            raise PermissionError("busy")
        return real(self)

    monkeypatch.setattr(RealPath, "read_bytes", locked)
    await drive(dl.run, clock, cycles=3)
    assert gateway.count("download_media") == 0

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import replace
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import pytest

from chatimport.app import ServiceContext
from chatimport.config import Config
from chatimport.offline import (
    lower_floor,
    lower_floor_state,
    offline_trim,
    resolve_chat_selector,
)
from chatimport.paths import AppPaths
from chatimport.ports import ChatImportError
from chatimport.storage.layout import STATE_FILE, chat_folder_name
from chatimport.storage.state import BackfillState, save_state
from tests.fakes import NOW
from tests.unit.maintenance.helpers import (
    at,
    build_chat,
    message_ids,
    mmsg,
    read_state,
)

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pathlib import Path


def context(tmp_path: Path, library: str | None = None) -> ServiceContext:
    base = tmp_path / "app"
    base.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    library_file = base / "chats.toml"
    if library is not None:
        library_file.write_text(library, encoding="utf-8")
    return ServiceContext(
        config=Config(), paths=AppPaths(base), root=tmp_path / "root", library_file=library_file
    )


def named_chat(
    ctx: ServiceContext,
    chat_id: int,
    title: str,
    username: str | None = None,
    folder_title: str | None = None,
) -> Path:
    chat = build_chat(ctx.root, chat_id, [[mmsg(1, chat_id=chat_id)]], title=folder_title or title)
    state = read_state(chat)
    save_state(chat.folder, replace(state, title=title, username=username))
    return chat.folder


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- offline trim


async def test_offline_trim_works_on_the_data_folder_without_a_service(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    ctx = context(tmp_path)
    a = build_chat(ctx.root, -1, [[mmsg(i, chat_id=-1) for i in range(1, 9)]], title="A")
    b = build_chat(ctx.root, -2, [[mmsg(i, chat_id=-2) for i in range(1, 5)]], title="B")

    report = await offline_trim(ctx, 50, None)

    assert report.per_chat == {-1: 4, -2: 2}
    assert message_ids(a) == [5, 6, 7, 8]
    assert message_ids(b) == [3, 4]
    assert (ctx.root / "_trim_log.jsonl").exists()


async def test_offline_trim_of_one_chat_leaves_the_rest(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    ctx = context(tmp_path)
    a = build_chat(ctx.root, -1, [[mmsg(i, chat_id=-1) for i in range(1, 5)]], title="A")
    b = build_chat(ctx.root, -2, [[mmsg(i, chat_id=-2) for i in range(1, 5)]], title="B")

    report = await offline_trim(ctx, 50, -2)

    assert report.per_chat == {-2: 2}
    assert message_ids(a) == [1, 2, 3, 4]
    assert message_ids(b) == [3, 4]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- lower floor


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("floor", "oldest_done", "expected_oldest"),
    [
        (500, 0, 500),
        (500, 200, 500),
        (500, 800, 800),
        (0, 0, 0),
        (0, 40, 40),
    ],
)
def test_lower_floor_reopens_the_tail_below_the_old_floor(
    tmp_path: Path, floor: int, oldest_done: int, expected_oldest: int
) -> None:
    chat = build_chat(tmp_path / "root", -1, [[mmsg(600, chat_id=-1)]])
    save_state(
        chat.folder,
        replace(
            read_state(chat),
            floor_id=floor,
            floor_reason="manual_trim_50",
            backfill=BackfillState(done=True, head_id=900, oldest_done_id=oldest_done),
            last_id=900,
        ),
    )

    assert lower_floor_state(chat.folder, at(2026, 10, 29, 1, 2, 3)) is True

    state = read_state(chat)
    assert state.floor_id == 0
    assert state.floor_reason is None
    assert state.backfill.done is False
    assert state.backfill.oldest_done_id == expected_oldest
    assert state.backfill.head_id == 900
    assert state.last_id == 900
    assert state.updated_at == at(2026, 10, 29, 1, 2, 3)
    assert state.chunks

def test_lower_floor_selects_chats_and_skips_unreadable_ones(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    root = tmp_path / "root"
    a = build_chat(root, -1, [[mmsg(1, chat_id=-1)]], title="A")
    b = build_chat(root, -2, [[mmsg(1, chat_id=-2)]], title="B")
    broken = build_chat(root, -3, [[mmsg(1, chat_id=-3)]], title="C")
    for chat in (a, b):
        save_state(chat.folder, replace(read_state(chat), floor_id=7))
    (broken.folder / STATE_FILE).write_text("junk", encoding="utf-8")

    assert lower_floor(root, -2) == [-2]
    assert read_state(a).floor_id == 7
    assert read_state(b).floor_id == 0
    assert lower_floor(root, 12345) == []
    assert sorted(lower_floor(root, None)) == [-2, -1]
    assert read_state(a).floor_id == 0

def unreadable_for(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, folder: Path) -> None:
    from chatimport import offline
    from chatimport.storage.state import StateUnreadable, load_state

    def flaky(path: Path) -> object:
        if path == folder:
            raise StateUnreadable(path, PermissionError("locked"))
        return load_state(path)

    monkeypatch.setattr(offline, "load_state", flaky)


def test_selector_refuses_while_a_state_is_unreadable(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    ctx = context(tmp_path)
    locked = named_chat(ctx, -10, "Twin")
    named_chat(ctx, -20, "Twin")
    unreadable_for(monkeypatch, locked)

    with pytest.raises(ChatImportError, match="cannot be read right now"):
        resolve_chat_selector(ctx, "Twin")
    assert resolve_chat_selector(ctx, "-20") == -20


def test_lower_floor_skips_an_unreadable_state(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    root = tmp_path / "root"
    locked = build_chat(root, -1, [[mmsg(1, chat_id=-1)]], title="Locked").folder
    build_chat(root, -2, [[mmsg(1, chat_id=-2)]], title="Fine")
    unreadable_for(monkeypatch, locked)

    assert lower_floor(root, None) == [-2]

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from chatimport import router as router_module
from chatimport.ports import DeletedMessagesEvent
from chatimport.router import UNROUTED_DELETES_FILE, Router, cap_jsonl
from chatimport.runtime import ChatRegistry
from tests.fakes import FakeClock

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pathlib import Path

    import pytest


def test_cap_keeps_only_whole_newest_lines(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    path = tmp_path / "x.jsonl"
    path.write_bytes(b"".join(f"line {i:03d}\n".encode() for i in range(100)))
    assert not cap_jsonl(path, 10_000, 50)
    assert cap_jsonl(path, 500, 50)
    data = path.read_bytes()
    assert len(data) <= 50
    assert data.endswith(b"line 099\n")
    assert all(line.startswith(b"line ") for line in data.splitlines())


def test_cap_on_an_exact_line_boundary_keeps_that_line(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    path = tmp_path / "x.jsonl"
    path.write_bytes(b"aaaa\nbbbb\ncccc\n")
    assert cap_jsonl(path, 10, 10)
    assert path.read_bytes() == b"bbbb\ncccc\n"


async def test_unrouted_deletes_file_is_capped(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.setattr(router_module, "UNROUTED_MAX_BYTES", 2_000)
    monkeypatch.setattr(router_module, "UNROUTED_KEEP_BYTES", 1_000)
    router = Router(ChatRegistry(), tmp_path, clock=FakeClock())
    for i in range(100):
        await router.handle(DeletedMessagesEvent(None, (i, i + 1000)))
    path = tmp_path / UNROUTED_DELETES_FILE
    assert path.stat().st_size <= 2_000
    lines = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
    assert json.loads(lines[-1])["msg_ids"] == [99, 1099]
    assert all(json.loads(line)["chat_id"] is None for line in lines)

from __future__ import annotations

import shutil
import sys
import types
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from chatimport import setroot
from chatimport.ports import ChatImportError
from chatimport.setroot import move_root, validate_new_root

ON_WINDOWS = sys.platform == "win32"


def populate(root: Path) -> dict[str, bytes]:
    files = {
        "chat_-1/2026-09_001.jsonl": b'{"a": 1}\n',
        "chat_-1/state.json": b"{}\n",
        "chat_-1/media/2026-09/5.jpg": b"\xff\xd8binary\x00",
        "_trim_log.jsonl": b"{}\n",
        "unicode_" + chr(0x436) + "/" + chr(0x444) + ".txt": (
            chr(0x444) + chr(0x430) + chr(0x439) + chr(0x43B)
        ).encode(),
    }
    for name, data in files.items():
        path = root / name
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_bytes(data)
    (root / "empty_dir").mkdir()
    return files


def snapshot(root: Path) -> dict[str, bytes]:
    return {p.relative_to(root).as_posix(): p.read_bytes() for p in root.rglob("*") if p.is_file()}

def test_a_probe_that_cannot_be_removed_does_not_mask_success(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    old = tmp_path / "old"
    old.mkdir()
    real_unlink = Path.unlink

    def stubborn(self: Path, missing_ok: bool = False) -> None:
        if self.name.startswith(".chatimport-probe-"):
            raise PermissionError("antivirus holds it")
        real_unlink(self, missing_ok=missing_ok)

    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "unlink", stubborn)

    assert validate_new_root(tmp_path / "new", old) == []

@pytest.mark.usefixtures("other_volume")
async def test_failing_to_delete_the_old_tree_only_logs(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, caplog: pytest.LogCaptureFixture
) -> None:
    old = tmp_path / "old"
    expected = populate(old)
    new = tmp_path / "new"
    real_rmtree = shutil.rmtree

    def selective(path: str | Path, *args: object, **kwargs: object) -> None:
        if Path(path) == old:
            raise PermissionError("a file is open")
        real_rmtree(path, *args, **kwargs)  # type: ignore[arg-type]  # pyright: ignore[reportArgumentType, reportCallIssue]

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        setroot, "shutil", types.SimpleNamespace(copytree=shutil.copytree, rmtree=selective)
    )

    with caplog.at_level("WARNING"):
        await move_root(old, new, move=True)

    assert "could not be fully deleted" in caplog.text
    assert snapshot(new) == expected
    assert old.exists()

        raise KeyboardInterrupt

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        setroot, "shutil", types.SimpleNamespace(copytree=interrupted, rmtree=shutil.rmtree)
    )

    with pytest.raises(KeyboardInterrupt):
        await move_root(old, new, move=True)

    assert not new.exists()
    assert old.exists()


async def test_rename_across_devices_falls_back_to_copy_and_delete(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    """The spec (set-root --move) requires a verified copy when a rename cannot work."""
    old = tmp_path / "old"
    expected = populate(old)
    new = tmp_path / "new"

    def cross_device(self: Path, target: object) -> Path:
        raise OSError(18, "Invalid cross-device link")

    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "replace", cross_device)

    await move_root(old, new, move=True)

    assert snapshot(new) == expected
    assert not old.exists()

from __future__ import annotations

import sys

import pytest

from chatimport import setroot
from chatimport.ports import ChatImportError

if TYPE_CHECKING:

def test_set_root_refuses_app_data_folder(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    old = tmp_path / "Desktop" / "ChatImport"
    old.mkdir(parents=True)
    base = tmp_path / "AppData" / "ChatImport"
    base.mkdir(parents=True)
    for target in (base, base / "data" / "ChatImport", tmp_path / "AppData"):
        with pytest.raises(ChatImportError, match="application folder"):
            validate_new_root(target, old, app_base=base)
    assert validate_new_root(tmp_path / "Data" / "ChatImport", old, app_base=base) == []


def test_set_root_refuses_foreign_non_empty_folder_without_move(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    old = tmp_path / "old"
    old.mkdir()
    foreign = tmp_path / "foreign" / "ChatImport"
    (foreign / "holiday").mkdir(parents=True)
    (foreign / "holiday" / "photo.jpg").write_bytes(b"x")
    with pytest.raises(ChatImportError, match="holds no ChatImport data"):
        validate_new_root(foreign, old, move=False)
    assert validate_new_root(foreign / ".." / "empty", old, move=False) == []


@pytest.mark.parametrize("marker", ["_status.json", "chat_-1/state.json"])
def test_an_existing_data_root_is_accepted_without_move(tmp_path: Path, marker: str) -> None:
    old = tmp_path / "old"
    old.mkdir()
    data = tmp_path / "data" / "ChatImport"
    (data / marker).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (data / marker).write_bytes(b"{}")
    assert validate_new_root(data, old, move=False) == []


def cross_volume(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    def never(old: Path, new: Path) -> bool:
        return False

    monkeypatch.setattr(setroot, "_same_volume", never)


async def test_move_root_with_symlink_inside_preserves_link(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    outside = tmp_path / "outside"
    outside.mkdir()
    (outside / "big.bin").write_bytes(b"x" * 1000)
    old = tmp_path / "old" / "ChatImport"
    (old / "chat_-1").mkdir(parents=True)
    (old / "chat_-1" / "state.json").write_bytes(b"{}")
    try:
        (old / "chat_-1" / "media").symlink_to(outside, target_is_directory=True)
    except OSError:
        pytest.skip("symbolic links are not available")
    new = tmp_path / "new" / "ChatImport"
    cross_volume(monkeypatch)

    await move_root(old, new, move=True)

    link = new / "chat_-1" / "media"
    assert link.is_symlink()
    assert not old.exists()
    assert (outside / "big.bin").exists()


@pytest.mark.skipif(sys.platform != "win32", reason="directory junctions are a Windows feature")
async def test_move_root_with_a_junction_inside_is_refused_before_copying(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    assert sys.platform == "win32"
    import _winapi

    outside = tmp_path / "outside"
    outside.mkdir()
    old = tmp_path / "old" / "ChatImport"
    (old / "chat_-1").mkdir(parents=True)
    _winapi.CreateJunction(str(outside), str(old / "chat_-1" / "media"))

        await move_root(old, new, move=True)
    assert not new.exists()
    assert (old / "chat_-1").is_dir()

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
from dataclasses import replace
from datetime import timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Literal

import pytest

from chatimport.ports import ChatImportError
from chatimport.records import DeleteRecord, EditRecord, MediaSavedRecord, MessageRecord, Record
from chatimport.runtime import ChatRegistry
from chatimport.storage.layout import STATE_FILE, list_parts
from chatimport.storage.recover import recover_chat
from chatimport.storage.state import load_state, save_state
from chatimport.storage.writer import iter_records
from chatimport.trim import TRIM_LOG, Trimmer
from tests.fakes import NOW, FakeClock
from tests.unit.maintenance.helpers import (
    FakeController,
    assert_state_matches_files,
    at,
    build_chat,
    message_ids,
    mmsg,
    read_state,
)

CHAT = -1001


def make_trimmer(
    root: Path, *controllers: FakeController, clock: FakeClock | None = None
) -> Trimmer:
    registry = ChatRegistry()
    for controller in controllers:
        registry.add(controller)
    return Trimmer(root, registry, clock=clock or FakeClock(), max_chunk_bytes=1)


def layout(records: list[Record], style: str) -> list[list[Record]]:
    if style == "single":
        return [records]
    size = 1 if style == "each" else 2
    return [records[i : i + size] for i in range(0, len(records), size)]


def messages(count: int, chat_id: int = CHAT) -> list[Record]:
    return [mmsg(i, chat_id=chat_id) for i in range(1, count + 1)]


def trim_log_lines(root: Path) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
    path = root / TRIM_LOG
    if not path.exists():
        return []
    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]


def media_folder(chat: FakeController, month: str, names: list[str]) -> Path:
    month_dir = chat.folder / "media" / month
    month_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
    for name in names:
        (month_dir / name).write_bytes(b"x")
    return month_dir


def old_chat(
    root: Path, chat_id: int, title: str, month_days: list[tuple[int, int]]
) -> FakeController:
    batches: list[list[Record]] = [
        [MessageRecord(chat_id, number, at(2026, month, day, 12), NOW, text="t")]
        for number, (month, day) in enumerate(month_days, start=1)
    ]
    return build_chat(root, chat_id, batches, title=title)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("style", ["single", "each", "pairs"])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("count", [1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 100])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("pct", [25, 50, 75])
async def test_trim_removes_exactly_floor_of_the_share_of_records(
    tmp_path: Path, count: int, pct: int, style: str
) -> None:
    root = tmp_path / "root"
    chat = build_chat(root, CHAT, layout(messages(count), style))

    report = await make_trimmer(root, chat).trim_percent(pct)

    removed = count * pct // 100
    assert report.trimmed_records == removed
    remaining = list(range(1, count + 1))[removed:]
    assert message_ids(chat) == remaining
    state = read_state(chat)
    assert state.last_id == count
    assert sum(c.records for c in state.chunks.values()) == len(remaining)
    assert_state_matches_files(chat)
    if removed:
        assert state.floor_id == removed + 1
        assert state.floor_reason == f"manual_trim_{pct}"
        assert report.per_chat == {CHAT: removed}
    else:
        assert state.floor_id == 0
        assert report.per_chat == {}


async def test_target_zero_leaves_every_byte_and_writes_no_log(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    root = tmp_path / "root"
    chat = build_chat(root, CHAT, layout(messages(3), "each"))
    before = {p.name: p.read_bytes() for p in chat.folder.iterdir()}

    report = await make_trimmer(root, chat).trim_percent(25)

    assert report.trimmed_records == 0
    assert report.deleted_parts == []
    assert {p.name: p.read_bytes() for p in chat.folder.iterdir()} == before
    assert not (root / TRIM_LOG).exists()

async def test_a_media_file_that_cannot_be_deleted_does_not_abort_the_trim(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, caplog: pytest.LogCaptureFixture
) -> None:
    root = tmp_path / "root"
    chat = build_chat(root, CHAT, [[mmsg(1, chat_id=CHAT)], [mmsg(2, chat_id=CHAT)]])
    media_folder(chat, "2026-09", ["1.jpg"])
    real_unlink = Path.unlink

    def guarded(self: Path, missing_ok: bool = False) -> None:
        if self.name == "1.jpg":
            raise PermissionError("locked")
        real_unlink(self, missing_ok=missing_ok)

    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "unlink", guarded)

    with caplog.at_level("WARNING"):
        await make_trimmer(root, chat).trim_percent(50)

    assert message_ids(chat) == [2]
    assert "cannot delete a media file" in caplog.text
    assert "cannot remove an empty media folder" not in caplog.text

        raise PermissionError("busy")

async def test_trim_waits_for_a_holder_of_the_controller_lock(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    root = tmp_path / "root"
    chat = build_chat(root, CHAT, layout(messages(4), "each"))
    trimmer = make_trimmer(root, chat)

    async with chat.lock:
        task = asyncio.create_task(trimmer.trim_percent(50))
        for _ in range(20):
            await asyncio.sleep(0)
        assert not task.done()
        assert message_ids(chat) == [1, 2, 3, 4]

    report = await task
    assert report.trimmed_records == 2
    assert not chat.lock.locked()


async def test_crash_while_cutting_the_boundary_part_recovers_consistently(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    root = tmp_path / "root"
    tail: list[Record] = [mmsg(i, chat_id=CHAT) for i in (2, 3, 4, 5)]

    monkeypatch.setattr("chatimport.trim.atomic_write_bytes", explode)

async def test_disk_trim_waits_for_the_lock(tmp_path: Path) -> None:

    trimmer = make_trimmer(root, chat)

        task = asyncio.create_task(trimmer.delete_oldest_part(30))
        for _ in range(20):
            await asyncio.sleep(0)
        assert not task.done()

    assert await task is not None


class _HookLock(asyncio.Lock):
    """Runs a callback right before its second acquisition."""

    def __init__(self, hook: object) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self._hook = hook
        self._count = 0

    async def acquire(self) -> Literal[True]:
        self._count += 1
        if self._count == 2 and callable(self._hook):
            self._hook()
        return await super().acquire()


async def test_candidate_that_lost_its_eligibility_before_the_lock_is_skipped(
    tmp_path: Path,
) -> None:
    root = tmp_path / "root"
    victim = old_chat(root, -1, "A", [(5, 3), (6, 3)])
    other = old_chat(root, -2, "B", [(7, 3), (8, 3)])
    hooked = FakeController(
        -1, victim.folder, "A", _HookLock(lambda: (victim.folder / STATE_FILE).unlink())
    )

    part = await make_trimmer(root, hooked, other).delete_oldest_part(30)

    assert part is not None
    assert part.chat_id == -2
    assert load_state(victim.folder) is None
    assert len(list_parts(victim.folder)) == 2


async def test_candidate_whose_state_vanishes_inside_the_final_step_gives_the_next_one(
    tmp_path: Path,
) -> None:

    assert part.chat_id == -2

def trimmer(root: Path, *controllers: FakeController) -> Trimmer:
    registry = ChatRegistry()
    for controller in controllers:
        registry.add(controller)
    return Trimmer(root, registry, clock=FakeClock(), max_chunk_bytes=1)


def each(*ids: int, month: int = 9) -> list[list[Record]]:
    return [[mmsg(i, month, chat_id=CHAT)] for i in ids]


def log_entries(root: Path) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
    path = root / TRIM_LOG
    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]


def poison_state(chat: FakeController, key: str) -> None:
    data = json.loads((chat.folder / "state.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    data["chunks"][key] = {"records": 5, "first_id": 1, "last_id": 5, "bytes": 10}
    (chat.folder / "state.json").write_text(json.dumps(data), encoding="utf-8")

async def test_trim_partial_failure_keeps_state_consistent(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    root = tmp_path / "root"
    chat = build_chat(root, CHAT, each(1, 2, 3, 4))
    real = trim_module.unlink_file
    calls = 0

    def second_fails(path: Path, *, missing_ok: bool = False) -> None:
        nonlocal calls
        calls += 1
        if calls == 2:
            raise PermissionError("locked by a reader")
        real(path, missing_ok=missing_ok)

    monkeypatch.setattr(trim_module, "unlink_file", second_fails)
    with pytest.raises(PermissionError, match="locked"):
        await trimmer(root, chat).trim_percent(75)

    state = read_state(chat)
    assert sorted(state.chunks) == ["2026-09_002", "2026-09_003", "2026-09_004"]
    assert state.floor_id == 2
    assert_state_matches_files(chat)
    (entry,) = log_entries(root)
    assert entry["parts"] == ["2026-09_001"]
    assert entry["records"] == 1

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import pytest

from chatimport import trim
from chatimport.records import EditRecord, MessageRecord, Record

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pathlib import Path

CHAT = -1001


def info(records: int) -> ChunkInfo:
    return ChunkInfo(records=records, first_id=1, last_id=records, bytes=100)


def dated(chat_id: int, ids: range, month: int) -> list[Record]:
    return [
        MessageRecord(chat_id, i, at(2026, month, 1 + i % 20, 12), at(2026, 10, 30), text="t")
        for i in ids
    ]


def test_plan_trim_with_nothing_to_remove_is_none() -> None:
    assert _plan_trim({"a": info(3)}, 25) is None
    assert _plan_trim({}, 50) is None


def test_plan_trim_cuts_a_boundary_part() -> None:
    plan = _plan_trim({"a": info(4), "b": info(4), "c": info(4)}, 50)
    assert plan is not None
    assert (plan.target, plan.whole, plan.boundary, plan.skip) == (6, ("a",), "b", 2)


def test_plan_trim_on_a_part_edge_removes_whole_parts_only() -> None:
    plan = _plan_trim({"a": info(4), "b": info(4)}, 50)
    assert plan is not None
    assert (plan.whole, plan.boundary, plan.skip) == (("a",), None, 0)


def test_plan_trim_that_consumes_every_part() -> None:
    plan = _plan_trim({"a": info(2), "b": info(2)}, 100)
    assert plan is not None
    assert (plan.whole, plan.boundary, plan.skip) == (("a", "b"), None, 0)


def test_preview_matches_a_real_trim(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    chat = build_chat(
        tmp_path,
        CHAT,
        [dated(CHAT, range(1, 5), 7), dated(CHAT, range(5, 9), 8), dated(CHAT, range(9, 13), 9)],
    )
    preview = preview_percent(tmp_path, 50)
    (only,) = preview.chats
    assert preview.pct == 50
    assert (only.chat_id, only.title, only.records_total) == (CHAT, "Chat", 12)
    assert (only.records_deleted, only.parts_deleted) == (6, 1)
    assert only.oldest_after is not None
    assert only.oldest_after.month == 8
    assert (preview.records_deleted, preview.parts_deleted) == (6, 1)
    before = sum(p.stat().st_size for p in chat.folder.glob("*.jsonl"))
    assert 0 < preview.bytes_freed == only.bytes_freed < before


async def test_preview_agrees_with_the_real_trim(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    chat = build_chat(tmp_path, CHAT, [dated(CHAT, range(1, 5), 7), dated(CHAT, range(5, 9), 8)])

    (preview,) = preview_percent(tmp_path, 75).chats
    await make_trimmer(tmp_path, chat).trim_percent(75)

    assert preview.bytes_freed == pytest.approx(before - after, abs=before // 4)
    assert preview.records_deleted == 6

def part_bytes(folder: Path) -> int:
    return sum(p.stat().st_size for p in folder.glob("*.jsonl"))


def test_sizes_are_split_into_parts_media_and_other(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    chat = build_chat(tmp_path, -1001, [[mmsg(1, chat_id=-1001)], [mmsg(2, chat_id=-1001)]])
    (chat.folder / "media" / "2026-09").mkdir(parents=True)
    (chat.folder / "media" / "2026-09" / "a.bin").write_bytes(b"x" * 10)
    (chat.folder / "extra").mkdir()
    (chat.folder / "extra" / "b.bin").write_bytes(b"y" * 5)
    (chat.folder / "notes.txt").write_bytes(b"z" * 3)
    (tmp_path / "_status.json").write_bytes(b"s" * 7)
    (tmp_path / "_exports").mkdir()
    (tmp_path / "_exports" / "e.json").write_bytes(b"e" * 4)

    result = archive_usage(tmp_path)

    (only,) = result.chats
    assert (only.chat_id, only.title, only.parts, only.records) == (-1001, "Chat", 2, 2)
    assert only.jsonl_bytes == part_bytes(chat.folder)
    assert only.media_bytes == 10
    assert only.total_bytes == only.jsonl_bytes + 10
    assert result.jsonl_total == only.jsonl_bytes
    assert result.media_total == 10
    state_size = (chat.folder / STATE_FILE).stat().st_size
    assert result.service_files_total == 7 + 4 + 5 + 3 + state_size
    assert result.total_bytes == result.jsonl_total + 10 + result.service_files_total
    assert result.free_bytes is not None

class Entry:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        *,
        is_dir: bool = False,
        junction: bool = False,
        size: int = 0,
        stat_error: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.path = f"root/{name}"
        self._is_dir = is_dir
        self._junction = junction
        self._size = size
        self._stat_error = stat_error

    def is_dir(self, *, follow_symlinks: bool = True) -> bool:
        return self._is_dir

    def is_junction(self) -> bool:
        return self._junction

    def stat(self, *, follow_symlinks: bool = True) -> Any:
        if self._stat_error:
            raise OSError("gone")
        return SimpleNamespace(st_size=self._size)


class Listing:
    def __init__(self, entries: list[Entry] | None) -> None:
        self._entries = entries

    def __enter__(self) -> Iterator[Entry]:
        if self._entries is None:
            raise OSError("vanished")
        return iter(self._entries)

    def __exit__(self, *exc: object) -> None:
        return None


def fake_scandir(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, tree: dict[str, list[Entry] | None]) -> None:
    def scandir(path: str) -> Listing:
        return Listing(tree.get(str(path).replace(os.sep, "/")))

    monkeypatch.setattr(usage.os, "scandir", scandir)


def test_tree_bytes_counts_files_follows_folders_and_skips_the_unreadable(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    fake_scandir(
        monkeypatch,
        {
            "root": [
                Entry("a", size=5),
                Entry("sub", is_dir=True),
                Entry("link", is_dir=True, junction=True, size=2),
                Entry("bad", stat_error=True),
                Entry("gone", is_dir=True),
            ],
            "root/sub": [Entry("b", size=11)],
            "root/gone": None,
        },
    )
    assert usage._tree_bytes("root") == 5 + 11 + 2


def test_measure_folder_survives_vanishing_entries_and_folders(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    fake_scandir(
        monkeypatch,
        {
            "root": [
                Entry("media", is_dir=True),

            "root/media": [Entry("m", size=6)],

    )

    assert (sizes.jsonl, sizes.parts, sizes.media, sizes.other) == (4, 1, 6, 8 + 3)
    fake_scandir(monkeypatch, {})
    empty = usage._measure_folder(Path("root"))
    assert (empty.jsonl, empty.media, empty.other, empty.parts) == (0, 0, 0, 0)

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import itertools
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any

from chatimport.app import ChatImportApp, ServiceContext
from chatimport.config import parse_config
from chatimport.paths import AppPaths
from chatimport.ports import ResolvedChat, ResolveStatus
from tests.fakes import NOW, FakeDisk, RecordingNotifier
from tests.fakes import FakeGateway as BaseGateway

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Callable
    from pathlib import Path

    from chatimport.control import CommandResult
    from chatimport.ports import ChatEvent


class ManualClock:
    """`sleep` parks the caller until the test advances time past its wake-up moment."""

    def __init__(self, start: datetime = NOW) -> None:
        self._now = start
        self._ids = itertools.count()
        self._waiters: list[tuple[datetime, int, asyncio.Future[None]]] = []
        self.sleeps: list[float] = []

    def now(self) -> datetime:
        return self._now

    async def sleep(self, seconds: float) -> None:
        self.sleeps.append(seconds)
        waiter: asyncio.Future[None] = asyncio.get_running_loop().create_future()
        self._waiters.append((self._now + timedelta(seconds=seconds), next(self._ids), waiter))
        await waiter

    async def advance(self, seconds: float) -> None:
        target = self._now + timedelta(seconds=seconds)
        for _ in range(100_000):
            due = sorted((w for w in self._waiters if w[0] <= target), key=lambda w: (w[0], w[1]))
            if not due:
                break
            first = due[0]
            self._waiters.remove(first)
            self._now = max(self._now, first[0])
            if not first[2].done():
                first[2].set_result(None)
            for _ in range(4):
                await asyncio.sleep(0)
        self._now = target
        await asyncio.sleep(0)


class SpyGateway(BaseGateway):
    """A fake gateway that notes how many event handlers were registered at each call."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.handlers_at: list[tuple[str, int]] = []

    async def newest_id(self, chat_id: int) -> int:
        self.handlers_at.append(("newest_id", len(self.handlers)))
        return await super().newest_id(chat_id)


FAST_CONFIG: dict[str, Any] = {
    "backfill": {"pause_between_requests_sec": 0.0, "pause_between_chats_sec": 0},
    "recheck": {"enabled": False},
}


@dataclass
class Env:
    tmp: Path
    ctx: ServiceContext
    gateway: SpyGateway
    clock: ManualClock
    notifier: RecordingNotifier
    disk: FakeDisk
    app: ChatImportApp
    task: asyncio.Task[None] | None = None
    extra: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict[str, Any])

    @property
    def root(self) -> Path:
        return self.ctx.root

    def write_library(self, text: str) -> None:
        self.ctx.library_file.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")

    def start(self) -> asyncio.Task[None]:
        self.task = asyncio.create_task(self.app.run())
        return self.task

    async def until(
        self, predicate: Callable[[], bool], *, step: float = 1.0, real_seconds: float = 10.0
    ) -> None:
        loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
        deadline = loop.time() + real_seconds
        while not predicate():
            if loop.time() > deadline:
                raise AssertionError("condition not reached in time")
            await self.clock.advance(step)
            await asyncio.sleep(0.003)

    async def until_async(self, check: Callable[[], Any], *, step: float = 1.0) -> None:
        loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
        deadline = loop.time() + 10
        while not await check():
            if loop.time() > deadline:
                raise AssertionError("condition not reached in time")
            await self.clock.advance(step)
            await asyncio.sleep(0.003)

    async def status(self) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        result = await self.app.execute("status", {})
        return result.data if result.ok else None

    async def chats(self) -> dict[int, dict[str, Any]]:
        data = await self.status()
        return {} if data is None else {c["chat_id"]: c for c in data["chats"]}

    async def wait_running(self) -> None:
        async def ready() -> bool:
            return await self.status() is not None

        await self.until_async(ready)

    async def wait_live(self, *chat_ids: int) -> None:
        async def ready() -> bool:
            chats = await self.chats()
            return all(
                cid in chats and chats[cid]["phase"] == "live" and chats[cid]["backfill_done"]
                for cid in chat_ids
            )

        await self.until_async(ready)

    async def stop(self) -> None:
        assert self.task is not None
        self.app.request_shutdown()
        await asyncio.wait_for(self.task, 15)

    async def run_command(self, name: str, **args: Any) -> CommandResult:
        return await self.app.execute(name, args)

    async def call(self, name: str, **args: Any) -> CommandResult:
        """Run a command while the manual clock is pumped, for commands that sleep."""
        task = asyncio.create_task(self.app.execute(name, args))
        loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
        deadline = loop.time() + 10
        while not task.done():
            if loop.time() > deadline:
                task.cancel()
                raise AssertionError("command did not finish")
            await self.clock.advance(1)
            await asyncio.sleep(0.003)
        return task.result()

    async def fire(self, event: ChatEvent) -> None:
        await self.gateway.fire(event)


def make_env(
    tmp: Path,
    *,
    config: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    library: str | None = "",
    chats: dict[str, tuple[int, str]] | None = None,
    messages: dict[int, int] | None = None,
    free_bytes: int = 10**15,
) -> Env:
    """`chats` maps a ref to `(chat_id, title)`; `messages` maps chat_id to a message count."""
    base = tmp / "appdata"
    paths = AppPaths(base)
    paths.ensure()
    merged: dict[str, Any] = {k: dict(v) for k, v in FAST_CONFIG.items()}
    for section, values in (config or {}).items():
        merged.setdefault(section, {}).update(values)
    cfg = parse_config(merged)
    ctx = ServiceContext(
        config=cfg, paths=paths, root=tmp / "ChatImport", library_file=base / "chats.toml"
    )
    gateway = SpyGateway()
    for ref, (chat_id, title) in (chats or {}).items():
        gateway.refs[ref] = ResolvedChat(
            ref, ResolveStatus.FOUND, chat_id=chat_id, title=title, username=ref.removeprefix("@")
        )
        gateway.add_chat(chat_id, range(1, (messages or {}).get(chat_id, 3) + 1))
    if library is not None:
        ctx.library_file.write_text(library, encoding="utf-8")
    clock, notifier, disk = ManualClock(), RecordingNotifier(), FakeDisk(free_bytes)
    app = ChatImportApp(ctx, notifier=notifier, gateway=gateway, clock=clock, disk=disk)
    return Env(tmp, ctx, gateway, clock, notifier, disk, app)


def library_text(*entries: tuple[str, str | None, bool]) -> str:
    out: list[str] = []
    for ref, name, enabled in entries:
        out.append("[[chat]]")
        out.append(f'ref = "{ref}"')
        if name is not None:
            out.append(f'name = "{name}"')
        out.append(f"enabled = {'true' if enabled else 'false'}")
        out.append("")
    return "\n".join(out)

class StubController:
    """A `ChatController` that records what it was asked to do."""

    def __init__(self, chat_id: int, folder: Path | None = None, *, title: str = "Chat") -> None:
        self._chat_id = chat_id
        self._folder = folder
        self.title = title
        self.lock_obj = asyncio.Lock()
        self.events: list[ChatEvent] = []
        self.calls: list[str] = []
        self.fail_submit: BaseException | None = None
        self.last_id = 0
        self.records = 0
        self.error: str | None = None

    @property
    def chat_id(self) -> int:
        return self._chat_id

    @property
    def folder(self) -> Path:
        assert self._folder is not None
        return self._folder

    @property
    def lock(self) -> asyncio.Lock:
        return self.lock_obj

    def submit(self, event: ChatEvent) -> None:
        if self.fail_submit is not None:
            raise self.fail_submit
        self.events.append(event)

    def pause(self) -> None:
        self.calls.append("pause")

    def resume(self) -> None:
        self.calls.append("resume")

    def pause_backfill(self) -> None:
        self.calls.append("pause_backfill")

    def resume_backfill(self) -> None:
        self.calls.append("resume_backfill")

    def request_refetch(self) -> None:
        self.calls.append("refetch")

    def request_recheck(self, days: int | None = None) -> None:
        self.calls.append(f"recheck:{days}")

    def status(self) -> ChatStatus:
        return ChatStatus(
            chat_id=self._chat_id,
            title=self.title,
            phase=PHASE_LIVE,
            last_id=self.last_id,
            backfill_done=True,
            oldest_date=None,
            records=self.records,
            paused=False,
            error=self.error,
        )

    async def stop(self) -> None:
        self.calls.append("stop")

    await live.until(finished, step=60)
    assert result.ok
    assert result.data == {"chats": 1}
    assert result.message == "lowered the floor of 1 chats"
    after = load_state(folder)
    assert after is not None
    assert after.floor_id == 0
    assert after.backfill.done

def corrupt_tail(folder: Path) -> None:
    part = list_parts(folder)[-1]
    with part.open("ab") as handle:
        handle.write(b'{"v":1,"kind":"mess')


async def test_check_finds_a_torn_line_and_repair_fixes_it(live: Env) -> None:
    folder = live.root / chat_folder_name("Alpha", A)
    corrupt_tail(folder)

    found = await live.run_command("check")
    repaired = await live.run_command("check", repair=True)
    again = await live.run_command("check")

    assert found.data["count"] >= 1
    assert all(issue["chat_id"] == A or issue["chat_id"] is None for issue in found.data["issues"])
    assert set(found.data["issues"][0]) == {"chat_id", "folder", "severity", "message"}
    assert repaired.ok
    assert again.data["count"] == 0
    assert again.message == "no issues found"


async def test_check_with_repair_waits_for_the_chat_lock(live: Env) -> None:
    controller = live.app._runtime().registry.get(A)  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
    assert controller is not None

    async with controller.lock:
        task = asyncio.create_task(live.run_command("check", repair=True))
        await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
        assert not task.done()
    result = await asyncio.wait_for(task, 10)

    assert result.ok


async def test_check_without_repair_reads_each_chat_under_its_own_lock_only(live: Env) -> None:
    registry = live.app.runtime().registry
    alpha, beta = registry.get(A), registry.get(B)
    assert alpha is not None
    assert beta is not None

    async with beta.lock:
        task = asyncio.create_task(live.run_command("check"))
        for _ in range(200):
            await asyncio.sleep(0.01)
            if not alpha.lock.locked():
                break
        assert not task.done()
        assert not alpha.lock.locked()
    result = await asyncio.wait_for(task, 10)

    assert result.ok

def two_chats(tmp_path: Path, **kwargs: object) -> Env:
    return make_env(
        tmp_path,
        library=library_text(("@a", "Alpha", True), ("@b", "Beta", True), ("@c", "Gamma", False)),
        chats={"@a": (A, "Alpha chat"), "@b": (B, "Beta chat"), "@c": (C, "Gamma chat")},
        messages={A: 4, B: 3, C: 2},
        **kwargs,  # type: ignore[arg-type]

def folder_ids(env: Env) -> list[int]:
    ids: list[int] = []
    for folder in iter_chat_folders(env.root):
        state = load_state(folder)
        assert state is not None
        ids.append(state.chat_id)
    return sorted(ids)


async def test_run_connects_starts_one_worker_per_enabled_chat_and_stops_cleanly(
    tmp_path: Path,
) -> None:
    env = two_chats(tmp_path)
    task = env.start()

    await env.wait_live(A, B)
    chats = await env.chats()
    assert set(chats) == {A, B}
    assert env.gateway.connected
    await env.stop()

    assert task.done()
    assert not env.gateway.connected
    assert env.gateway.calls[-1] == ("disconnect", ())
    assert folder_ids(env) == sorted([A, B])
    assert not service_running(env.ctx.paths.lock_file)

async def test_hot_reload_adds_disables_reenables_and_removes_chats(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    env = make_env(
        tmp_path,
        library=library_text(("@a", "Alpha", True)),
        chats={"@a": (A, "Alpha chat"), "@b": (B, "Beta chat")},
        messages={A: 3, B: 3},
    )
    env.start()
    await env.wait_live(A)

    env.write_library(library_text(("@a", "Alpha", True), ("@b", "Beta", True)))
    await env.wait_live(A, B)
    assert set(await env.chats()) == {A, B}

    env.write_library(library_text(("@a", "Alpha", True), ("@b", "Beta", False)))
    await env.until_async(lambda: _only(env, {A}))
    assert folder_ids(env) == sorted([A, B])

    env.write_library(library_text(("@a", "Alpha", True), ("@b", "Beta", True)))
    await env.wait_live(A, B)
    state_b = load_state(env.root / chat_folder_name("Beta", B))
    assert state_b is not None
    assert state_b.last_id == 3

    env.write_library(library_text(("@a", "Alpha", True)))
    await env.until_async(lambda: _only(env, {A}))
    await env.stop()

    assert folder_ids(env) == sorted([A, B])


async def _only(env: Env, expected: set[int]) -> bool:
    return set(await env.chats()) == expected


async def test_hot_reload_does_not_disturb_untouched_chats(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    env = two_chats(tmp_path)
    env.start()

    calls_before = env.gateway.count("newest_id")

    env.write_library(library_text(("@a", "Alpha", True), ("@b", "Beta", True), ("@c", "G", False)))
    await env.clock.advance(30)
    await env.stop()

    assert env.gateway.count("newest_id") == calls_before

async def test_shutdown_from_another_thread_flushes_buffered_messages(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    env = two_chats(tmp_path)
    task = env.start()
    await env.wait_live(A, B)
    await env.gateway.fire(NewMessageEvent(msg(500, chat_id=A, date=NOW, text="late news")))
    await asyncio.sleep(0.05)

    worker = threading.Thread(target=env.app.request_shutdown)
    worker.start()
    await asyncio.wait_for(task, 15)
    worker.join()

    lines = [
        json.loads(line)
        for path in (env.root / chat_folder_name("Alpha", A)).glob("*.jsonl")
        for line in path.read_text("utf-8").splitlines()
    ]
    assert 500 in {line.get("msg_id") for line in lines}
    state = load_state(env.root / chat_folder_name("Alpha", A))
    assert state is not None
    assert state.last_id == 500

        "merged",
        "search",
    }


async def _boom(*args: object, **kwargs: object) -> None:
    raise RuntimeError("cannot schedule new futures after shutdown")


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("owner", "method"),
    [
        (StatusWriter, "write"),
        (Supervisor, "stop_all"),
        (ChatImportApp, "_stop_runtime"),
    ],
)
async def test_a_failing_shutdown_step_still_disconnects_and_frees_the_lock(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, owner: type, method: str
) -> None:
    env = two_chats(tmp_path)
    task = env.start()
    await env.wait_live(A, B)
    monkeypatch.setattr(owner, method, _boom)

    env.app.request_shutdown()
    await asyncio.wait_for(task, 10)

    assert env.gateway.calls[-1] == ("disconnect", ())
    assert not service_running(env.ctx.paths.lock_file)

def found(
    ref: str, chat_id: int, title: str | None = "T", username: str | None = None
) -> ResolvedChat:
    return ResolvedChat(ref, ResolveStatus.FOUND, chat_id=chat_id, title=title, username=username)


async def test_resolve_entries_keeps_order_and_turns_handled_errors_into_not_found() -> None:
    gateway = BaseGateway()
    gateway.refs = {"@a": found("@a", A), "@c": found("@c", -3)}
    entries = [ChatEntry("@a"), ChatEntry("@b"), ChatEntry("@c")]
    gateway.fail["resolve"] = [ChatImportError("x")]

    results = await resolve_entries(gateway, entries)

    assert [e.ref for e, _ in results] == ["@a", "@b", "@c"]
    assert results[0][1].status is ResolveStatus.NOT_FOUND
    assert results[0][1].detail == "ChatImportError"
    assert results[1][1].status is ResolveStatus.NOT_FOUND
    assert results[2][1].status is ResolveStatus.FOUND

def write_config(base: Path, text: str) -> None:
    base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (base / "config.toml").write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")

    assert ctx.paths.session_file.parent.is_dir()
    assert ctx.library_file == tmp_path / "base" / "chats.toml"
    assert ctx.config == parse_config({})


def test_load_context_root_priority_cli_then_env_then_config_then_desktop(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    base = tmp_path / "base"
    write_config(base, f'[output]\nroot_dir = "{(tmp_path / "from_config").as_posix()}"\n')
    monkeypatch.setattr("chatimport.paths.user_desktop_dir", lambda: str(tmp_path / "desk"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("CHATIMPORT_ROOT", str(tmp_path / "from_env"))

    cli = load_context(str(tmp_path / "from_cli"), base)
    env = load_context(None, base)
    monkeypatch.delenv("CHATIMPORT_ROOT")
    config = load_context(None, base)
    write_config(base, "")
    desktop = load_context(None, base)

    assert cli.root == tmp_path / "from_cli" / "ChatImport"
    assert env.root == tmp_path / "from_env" / "ChatImport"
    assert config.root == tmp_path / "from_config" / "ChatImport"
    assert desktop.root == tmp_path / "desk" / "ChatImport"

def test_build_gateway_passes_configuration_to_the_telethon_gateway(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    captured: dict[str, Any] = {}

    class Recorder:
        def __init__(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
            captured["args"] = args
            captured["kwargs"] = kwargs

    monkeypatch.setattr(context_module, "TelethonGateway", Recorder)
    base_ctx = make_env(tmp_path).ctx
    config = parse_config(
        {
            "telegram": {"api_id": 7, "api_hash": "hash"},
            "output": {"include_sender_names": False, "include_raw": True},
        }
    )
    ctx = replace(base_ctx, config=config)
    clock = FakeClock()

    build_gateway(ctx, clock)

    assert captured["args"] == (config.telegram, ctx.paths.session_file)
    assert captured["kwargs"] == {
        "include_sender_names": False,
        "include_raw": True,
        "clock": clock,
    }


def one_shot(tmp_path: Path, *, library: str | None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> tuple[Env, FakeClock]:
    env = make_env(
        tmp_path,
        config={"backfill": {"pause_between_chats_sec": 5}},
        library=library
        if library is not None
        else library_text(("@a", "Alpha", True), ("@b", "Beta", True), ("@off", None, False)),
        chats={"@a": (A, "Alpha chat"), "@b": (B, "Beta chat")},
        messages={A: 5, B: 3},
        **kwargs,
    )
    clock = FakeClock()
    env.app._clock = clock  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
    return env, clock


def stored(env: Env, chat_id: int) -> list[int]:
    state_folder = [
        f for f in iter_chat_folders(env.root) if (s := load_state(f)) and s.chat_id == chat_id
    ]
    if not state_folder:
        return []
    state = load_state(state_folder[0])
    assert state is not None
    return sorted(
        {
            int(line.split('"msg_id":')[1].split(",")[0])
            for part in state_folder[0].glob("*.jsonl")
            for line in part.read_text("utf-8").splitlines()
            if '"kind":"message"' in line
        }
    )


async def test_run_once_for_every_enabled_chat_syncs_full_history_and_cleans_up(
    tmp_path: Path,
) -> None:
    env, clock = one_shot(tmp_path)

    await env.app.run_once()

    assert stored(env, A) == [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
    assert stored(env, B) == [1, 2, 3]
    assert ("resolve", ("@off",)) not in env.gateway.calls
    assert env.gateway.handlers == []
    assert not env.gateway.connected
    assert not service_running(env.ctx.paths.lock_file)
    assert clock.sleeps.count(5) == 1

class StubDownloader:
    instances: list[StubDownloader] = []  # noqa: RUF012

    def __init__(self, registry: object, gateway: object, config: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
        self.gateway = gateway
        self.config = config
        self.kwargs = kwargs
        self.calls: list[str] = []
        StubDownloader.instances.append(self)

    def pause(self) -> None:
        self.calls.append("pause")

    def resume(self) -> None:
        self.calls.append("resume")

    async def run(self) -> None:
        await asyncio.Event().wait()

async def test_media_guard_follows_the_disk_over_time(
    tmp_path: Path, stub_downloader: type[StubDownloader]
) -> None:
    gib = 1024**3
    env = make_env(
        tmp_path,
        config={"media": {"enabled": True, "types": ["photo"]}},
        library=library_text(("@a", "Alpha", True)),
        chats={"@a": (A, "A")},
        free_bytes=10 * gib,
    )
    env.start()
    await env.wait_live(A)
    (downloader,) = stub_downloader.instances
    assert downloader.calls[:1] == ["pause"]
    assert "resume" not in downloader.calls

    await env.clock.advance(300)
    assert "resume" not in downloader.calls

    env.disk.values = [20 * gib]
    await env.clock.advance(300)
    await env.stop()

    assert downloader.calls[-1] == "resume"


async def test_a_crashing_worker_is_restarted_and_reported(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    env = make_env(
        tmp_path, library=library_text(("@a", "Alpha", True)), chats={"@a": (A, "Alpha")}
    )
    env.gateway.fail["newest_id"] = [RuntimeError("boom")]
    env.start()

    async def reported() -> bool:
        data = await env.status()
        return data is not None and any(e["source"] == f"worker-{A}" for e in data["errors"])

    await env.until_async(reported, step=0.01)
    await env.wait_live(A)
    await env.stop()

    assert stored(env, A) == [1, 2, 3]

def blocking(started: threading.Event, release: threading.Event) -> Any:
    def wait(*_args: Any, **_kwargs: Any) -> list[Any]:
        started.set()
        release.wait(10)
        return []

    return wait


def rename_into_place(old: Path, new: Path) -> None:
    new.rmdir()
    old.replace(new)


async def test_cancel_set_root_during_move_does_not_restart_old_root(
    live: Env, tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    started, release = threading.Event(), threading.Event()
    new_root = normalize_root(str(tmp_path / "moved"))

    async def slow_move(old: Path, new: Path, *, move: bool) -> None:
        await asyncio.to_thread(blocking(started, release))
        await asyncio.to_thread(rename_into_place, old, new)

    monkeypatch.setattr("chatimport.app.move_root", slow_move)
    task = asyncio.create_task(live.app.execute("set_root", {"path": str(new_root), "move": True}))
    await asyncio.to_thread(started.wait, 5)

    task.cancel()
    await asyncio.sleep(0.02)
    assert not task.done()
    release.set()
    with pytest.raises(asyncio.CancelledError):
        await task

    with pytest.raises(ChatImportError, match="not running"):
        live.app.runtime()
    assert not live.root.exists()
    assert new_root.is_dir()
    assert load_config(live.ctx.paths.config_file).output.root_dir == str(new_root)
    assert live.app.ctx.root == new_root


async def test_cancel_set_root_whose_move_fails_keeps_the_config(
    live: Env, tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    started, release = threading.Event(), threading.Event()

    async def failing_move(old: Path, new: Path, *, move: bool) -> None:
        await asyncio.to_thread(blocking(started, release))
        raise OSError("disk unplugged")

    monkeypatch.setattr("chatimport.app.move_root", failing_move)
    task = asyncio.create_task(
        live.app.execute("set_root", {"path": str(tmp_path / "x"), "move": True})
    )
    await asyncio.to_thread(started.wait, 5)
    task.cancel()
    release.set()

    with pytest.raises(asyncio.CancelledError):
        await task
    assert live.app.ctx.root == live.root
    assert not live.ctx.paths.config_file.exists()


async def test_config_write_failure_after_a_cancelled_move_is_logged(
    live: Env, tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, caplog: pytest.LogCaptureFixture
) -> None:
    started, release = threading.Event(), threading.Event()

    async def slow_move(old: Path, new: Path, *, move: bool) -> None:
        await asyncio.to_thread(blocking(started, release))

    def read_only(path: Path, root: Path) -> None:
        raise OSError("read-only config")

    monkeypatch.setattr("chatimport.app.move_root", slow_move)
    monkeypatch.setattr("chatimport.app.set_output_root", read_only)
    task = asyncio.create_task(
        live.app.execute("set_root", {"path": str(tmp_path / "y"), "move": True})
    )
    await asyncio.to_thread(started.wait, 5)

    release.set()

        await task
    assert "config.toml was not updated" in caplog.text


async def test_cancelled_check_repair_keeps_the_lock_until_the_thread_ends(
    live: Env, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    started, release = threading.Event(), threading.Event()
    monkeypatch.setattr(commands_module, "check_folder", blocking(started, release))

    assert alpha is not None

    task = asyncio.create_task(live.app.execute("check", {"repair": True}))
    await asyncio.to_thread(started.wait, 5)
    task.cancel()
    await asyncio.sleep(0.02)

async def test_every_worker_shares_the_runtime_backfill_slots(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    seen: list[BackfillSlots | None] = []

    class Recording(ChatWorker):
        def __init__(self, *args: Any, slots: BackfillSlots | None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
            seen.append(slots)
            super().__init__(*args, slots=slots, **kwargs)

    monkeypatch.setattr(service_runtime_module, "ChatWorker", Recording)
    env = make_env(
        tmp_path,
        config={"backfill": {"max_parallel_chats": 2}},
        library=library_text(("@a", "Alpha", True), ("@b", "Beta", True)),
        chats={"@a": (A, "Alpha"), "@b": (B, "Beta")},
    )
    env.start()
    await env.wait_live(A, B)
    slots = env.app.runtime().slots
    await env.stop()

    assert slots.limit == 2
    assert seen == [slots, slots]

async def test_unreadable_state_launches_the_worker_staggered(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    env = make_env(
        tmp_path,
        library=library_text(("@a", "Alpha", True)),
        chats={"@a": (A, "Alpha")},
    )
    calls = 0
    real = service_runtime_module.load_state

    def flaky(folder: Path) -> Any:
        nonlocal calls
        calls += 1
        if calls == 1:
            unreadable(folder)
        return real(folder)

    monkeypatch.setattr(service_runtime_module, "load_state", flaky)
    env.start()
    await env.wait_live(A)
    await env.stop()

    assert calls >= 1

def stored_ids(root: Path, chat_id: int) -> list[int]:
    ids: list[int] = []
    folder = root / chat_folder_name("Alpha" if chat_id == A else "Beta", chat_id)
    for part in sorted(folder.glob("*.jsonl")):
        for line in part.read_text("utf-8").splitlines():
            record: dict[str, Any] = json.loads(line)
            if record["kind"] == "message":
                ids.append(record["msg_id"])
    return ids

    await live.stop()

    data = json.loads((tmp_path / "again" / "ChatImport" / "_status.json").read_text("utf-8"))
    assert data["service"] == "stopped"

async def test_cancelled_finish_waits_for_the_thread_before_reraising() -> None:
    started, release = threading.Event(), threading.Event()
    done: list[str] = []

    def work() -> None:
        started.set()
        release.wait(5)
        done.append("finished")

    task = asyncio.create_task(in_thread(work))
    await asyncio.to_thread(started.wait, 5)
    task.cancel()
    await asyncio.sleep(0.02)
    assert not task.done()
    task.cancel()
    await asyncio.sleep(0.02)
    assert not task.done()

    release.set()
    with pytest.raises(asyncio.CancelledError):
        await task
    assert done == ["finished"]


async def test_cancelled_finish_reraises_even_if_the_work_failed() -> None:
    gate = asyncio.Event()

    async def failing() -> None:
        await gate.wait()
        raise OSError("boom")

    inner = asyncio.ensure_future(failing())
    outer = asyncio.create_task(finish(inner))
    await asyncio.sleep(0)
    outer.cancel()
    await asyncio.sleep(0)
    gate.set()

    with pytest.raises(asyncio.CancelledError):
        await outer
    assert isinstance(inner.exception(), OSError)


async def test_cancelled_finish_of_a_cancelled_task() -> None:
    inner: asyncio.Future[None] = asyncio.get_running_loop().create_future()
    outer = asyncio.create_task(finish(inner))
    await asyncio.sleep(0)
    outer.cancel()
    await asyncio.sleep(0)
    inner.cancel()

    with pytest.raises(asyncio.CancelledError):
        await outer

    with pytest.raises(TypeError):

    assert tuple(COMMANDS) == commands.COMMAND_NAMES

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any

@pytest.fixture
def service(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> ServiceCommands:
    async def refuse(_: ServiceCommands, __: Mapping[str, Any]) -> CommandResult:
        raise ChatImportError("not tracked")

    async def crash(_: ServiceCommands, __: Mapping[str, Any]) -> CommandResult:
        raise RuntimeError("boom")

    async def fine(_: ServiceCommands, __: Mapping[str, Any]) -> CommandResult:
        return CommandResult(True, "fine")

    monkeypatch.setitem(commands._REGISTRY, "t_refuse", refuse)
    monkeypatch.setitem(commands._REGISTRY, "t_crash", crash)
    monkeypatch.setitem(commands._REGISTRY, "t_fine", fine)
    return ServiceCommands(None)  # pyright: ignore[reportArgumentType]


async def test_a_refusal_is_one_info_line_without_a_traceback(
    service: ServiceCommands, caplog: pytest.LogCaptureFixture
) -> None:
    with caplog.at_level(logging.DEBUG, logger=commands.log.name):
        result = await service.execute("t_refuse", {})

    assert result == CommandResult(False, "ChatImportError: not tracked")
    (record,) = caplog.records
    assert record.levelno == logging.INFO
    assert record.exc_info is None
    assert "t_refuse" in record.getMessage()


async def test_an_unexpected_error_is_logged_with_its_traceback(
    service: ServiceCommands, caplog: pytest.LogCaptureFixture
) -> None:
    with caplog.at_level(logging.DEBUG, logger=commands.log.name):
        result = await service.execute("t_crash", {})

    assert result == CommandResult(False, "RuntimeError: boom")
    (record,) = caplog.records
    assert record.levelno == logging.ERROR
    assert record.exc_info is not None

    service: ServiceCommands, caplog: pytest.LogCaptureFixture
) -> None:
    with caplog.at_level(logging.DEBUG, logger=commands.log.name):
        assert (await service.execute("t_fine", {})).ok is True
        unknown = await service.execute("nope", {})

    assert unknown == CommandResult(False, "unknown command: 'nope'")
    assert caplog.records == []

@pytest.fixture
def ctl(tmp_path: Path) -> Path:
    """The scratch path is deep: use the extended-length form so temp names fit MAX_PATH."""
    folder = tmp_path / "c"
    folder.mkdir()
    return Path("\\\\?\\" + str(folder)) if sys.platform == "win32" else folder


class RealtimeFakeClock(FakeClock):
    """Wall-clock `now` (file mtimes are real) but sleeps only yield."""

    def now(self) -> datetime:
        return datetime.now(UTC)

    async def sleep(self, seconds: float) -> None:
        self.sleeps.append(seconds)
        if self.on_sleep is not None:
            self.on_sleep(seconds)
        await asyncio.sleep(0.005)


def names(folder: Path) -> list[str]:
    return sorted(p.name for p in folder.iterdir())


def write_command(folder: Path, name: str, payload: object, *, mtime_ns: int | None = None) -> Path:
    path = folder / name
    path.write_text(payload if isinstance(payload, str) else json.dumps(payload), "utf-8")
    if mtime_ns is not None:
        os.utime(path, ns=(mtime_ns, mtime_ns))
    return path


def read_result(folder: Path, stem: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    value: dict[str, Any] = json.loads((folder / f"{stem}{RESULT_SUFFIX}").read_text("utf-8"))
    return value


def make_server(
    folder: Path, handlers: dict[str, Handler] | None = None
) -> tuple[ControlServer, RealtimeFakeClock]:
    clock = RealtimeFakeClock()
    return ControlServer(folder, handlers or {}, clock=clock), clock


def echo_handler(calls: list[tuple[str, dict[str, Any]]], name: str) -> Handler:
    async def handler(args: dict[str, Any]) -> CommandResult:
        calls.append((name, args))
        return CommandResult(True, f"done {name}", {"args": args})

    return handler


async def test_command_runs_result_is_written_and_command_removed(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    calls: list[tuple[str, dict[str, Any]]] = []
    server, _ = make_server(tmp_path, {"trim": echo_handler(calls, "trim")})
    write_command(tmp_path, "trim-1.json", {"id": "abc", "command": "trim", "args": {"pct": 50}})

    processed = await server.process_pending()

    assert processed == 1
    assert calls == [("trim", {"pct": 50})]
    assert not (tmp_path / "trim-1.json").exists()
    assert read_result(tmp_path, "trim-1") == {
        "id": "abc",
        "ok": True,
        "message": "done trim",
        "data": {"args": {"pct": 50}},
    }

    async def record(args: dict[str, Any]) -> CommandResult:
        order.append(args["n"])
        return CommandResult(True)

    server, _ = make_server(tmp_path, {"c": record})
    base = time.time_ns()
    write_command(tmp_path, "z.json", {"command": "c", "args": {"n": "z"}}, mtime_ns=base)
    write_command(tmp_path, "b.json", {"command": "c", "args": {"n": "b"}}, mtime_ns=base + 10**9)
    write_command(tmp_path, "a.json", {"command": "c", "args": {"n": "a"}}, mtime_ns=base + 10**9)
    write_command(tmp_path, "m.json", {"command": "c", "args": {"n": "m"}}, mtime_ns=base - 10**9)

    await server.process_pending()

    assert order == ["m", "z", "a", "b"]

async def test_run_creates_the_folder_polls_and_survives_oserror(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    folder = tmp_path / "control" / "nested"
    server, clock = make_server(folder)
    attempts = 0
    real = server.process_pending

    async def flaky() -> int:
        nonlocal attempts
        attempts += 1
        if attempts == 1:
            raise OSError("scan failed")
        return await real()

    monkeypatch.setattr(server, "process_pending", flaky)

    def stop_after_three(_seconds: float) -> None:
        if attempts >= 3:
            raise asyncio.CancelledError

    clock.on_sleep = stop_after_three

    with pytest.raises(asyncio.CancelledError):
        await server.run()

    assert folder.is_dir()
    assert attempts == 3
    assert clock.sleeps == [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]

    assert result == CommandResult(True, "done trim", {"args": {"pct": 25}})
    assert calls == [("trim", {"pct": 25})]
    assert names(ctl) == []

async def test_two_concurrent_clients_get_their_own_answers(ctl: Path) -> None:
    async def echo(args: dict[str, Any]) -> CommandResult:
        return CommandResult(True, str(args["n"]))

    server, _ = make_server(ctl, {"c": echo})
    task = asyncio.create_task(server.run())
    try:
        results = await asyncio.wait_for(
            asyncio.gather(
                *(
                    asyncio.to_thread(send_command, ctl, "c", {"n": n}, timeout=10, poll=0.005)
                    for n in range(5)
                )
            ),
            15,
        )
    finally:
        task.cancel()
        with pytest.raises(asyncio.CancelledError):
            await task

    assert sorted(r.message for r in results) == ["0", "1", "2", "3", "4"]

def test_send_command_writes_the_documented_request_format(
    ctl: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    holder: dict[str, Any] = {}

    def spy_sleep(_seconds: float) -> None:
        for path in ctl.glob("*.json"):
            holder["name"] = path.name
            holder["body"] = json.loads(path.read_text("utf-8"))

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        "chatimport.control.time", SimpleNamespace(monotonic=time.monotonic, sleep=spy_sleep)
    )
    with pytest.raises(TimeoutError):
        send_command(ctl, "trim", {"pct": 50, "chat": None}, timeout=0.02, poll=0.001)

    assert holder["name"].startswith("trim-")
    assert holder["body"]["command"] == "trim"
    assert holder["body"]["args"] == {"pct": 50, "chat": None}
    assert holder["name"] == f"trim-{holder['body']['id']}.json"

"""At-most-once command execution: claims, malformed files and timeouts (S1, S2, C9)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio

import pytest

from chatimport import control
from chatimport.control import (
    CLAIM_SUFFIX,

@pytest.fixture
def folder(tmp_path: Path) -> Path:
    """Extended-length form on Windows: request and temp names do not fit MAX_PATH here."""
    return Path("\\\\?\\" + str(tmp_path)) if sys.platform == "win32" else tmp_path


def counting(calls: list[dict[str, Any]], result: CommandResult | None = None) -> Handler:
    async def handler(args: dict[str, Any]) -> CommandResult:
        calls.append(args)
        return result or CommandResult(True, "done")

    return handler


def server_for(folder: Path, handlers: dict[str, Handler]) -> ControlServer:
    return ControlServer(folder, handlers, clock=RealtimeFakeClock())


async def test_control_command_runs_once_when_file_cannot_be_deleted(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    server = server_for(tmp_path, {"trim": counting(calls)})
    write_command(tmp_path, "trim-x.json", {"id": "x", "command": "trim", "args": {"pct": 25}})
    real_unlink = Path.unlink

    def stubborn(self: Path, missing_ok: bool = False) -> None:
        if self.name.endswith(CLAIM_SUFFIX) or self.name == "trim-x.json":
            raise PermissionError("held open by a scanner")
        real_unlink(self, missing_ok=missing_ok)

    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "unlink", stubborn)

    for _ in range(3):
        await server.process_pending()

    assert calls == [{"pct": 25}]
    assert read_result(tmp_path, "trim-x")["ok"] is True


async def test_command_runs_once_when_result_write_fails(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, caplog: pytest.LogCaptureFixture
) -> None:
    calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    server = server_for(tmp_path, {"trim": counting(calls)})
    write_command(tmp_path, "trim-y.json", {"command": "trim", "args": {"pct": 25}})
    real_write = control._write_json_atomic  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
    failures = [OSError("disk full")]

    def flaky(path: Path, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        if failures:
            raise failures.pop()
        real_write(path, payload)

    monkeypatch.setattr(control, "_write_json_atomic", flaky)

    with caplog.at_level(logging.ERROR, logger="chatimport.control"):
        await server.process_pending()
        await server.process_pending()

    assert len(calls) == 1
    assert "could not write a command result" in caplog.text
    assert names(tmp_path) == []


async def test_leftover_claimed_command_is_not_rerun_on_start(tmp_path: Path) -> None:

    assert not (tmp_path / f".trim-z{CLAIM_SUFFIX}").exists()

async def test_a_busy_command_file_waits_for_the_next_poll(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    server = server_for(tmp_path, {"trim": counting(calls)})
    write_command(tmp_path, "busy.json", {"command": "trim"})
    real_replace = Path.replace
    refusals = [PermissionError("sharing violation")]

    def once_busy(self: Path, target: Path) -> Path:
        if self.name == "busy.json" and refusals:
            raise refusals.pop()
        return real_replace(self, target)

    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "replace", once_busy)

    await server.process_pending()
    assert calls == []
    assert (tmp_path / "busy.json").exists()

    await server.process_pending()
    assert calls == [{}]
