class TestIterHistory:
    async def test_defaults_and_arguments_reach_telethon(self, clock: FakeClock) -> None:
        gateway, fake = await ready(clock)
        fake.history = [tg_message(9), tg_message(8)]
        records = await collect(gateway.iter_history(CHAT_ID))
        assert [r.msg_id for r in records] == [9, 8]
        assert fake.names("iter_messages") == [{"offset_id": 0, "min_id": 0}]
        await collect(gateway.iter_history(CHAT_ID, offset_id=50, min_id=10))
        assert fake.names("iter_messages")[-1] == {"offset_id": 50, "min_id": 10}

    async def test_empty_messages_are_skipped(self, clock: FakeClock) -> None:
        gateway, fake = await ready(clock)
        fake.history = [tg_message(9), empty(8), empty(7), tg_message(6)]
        assert [r.msg_id for r in await collect(gateway.iter_history(CHAT_ID))] == [9, 6]

    async def test_records_carry_clock_username_and_flags(self, clock: FakeClock) -> None:
        gateway, fake = make_gateway(clock, names=False, raw=True)
        fake.entities[CHAT_ID] = channel(username="pub")
        sender = SimpleNamespace(first_name="Ann", last_name=None, username="ann")
        fake.history = [tg_message(9, sender=sender, sender_id=4)]
        clock.advance(hours=5)
        (record,) = await collect(gateway.iter_history(CHAT_ID))
        assert record.fetched_at == NOW + timedelta(hours=5)
        assert record.link == "https://t.me/pub/9"
        assert record.chat_id == CHAT_ID
        assert (record.sender_id, record.sender_name, record.sender_username) == (4, None, None)
        assert record.raw == {"id": 9}

    async def test_private_chat_link_without_username(self, clock: FakeClock) -> None:
        gateway, fake = make_gateway(clock)
        fake.entities[CHAT_ID] = channel()
        fake.history = [tg_message(9)]
        (record,) = await collect(gateway.iter_history(CHAT_ID))
        assert record.link == "https://t.me/c/1234567890/9"

    async def test_empty_history(self, clock: FakeClock) -> None:
        gateway, _ = await ready(clock)
        assert await collect(gateway.iter_history(CHAT_ID)) == []

    async def test_access_lost_mid_stream_keeps_earlier_records(self, clock: FakeClock) -> None:
        gateway, fake = await ready(clock)
        fake.history = [tg_message(9), tg_message(8), tg_message(7)]
        fake.history_error = errors.ChannelPrivateError(request=None)
        fake.history_error_after = 2
        seen: list[int] = []

        async def drain() -> None:
            async for record in gateway.iter_history(CHAT_ID):
                seen.append(record.msg_id)

        with pytest.raises(AccessLost):
            await drain()
        assert seen == [9, 8]

    async def test_flood_wait_mid_stream(self, clock: FakeClock) -> None:
        gateway, fake = await ready(clock)
        fake.history = [tg_message(9)]
        fake.history_error = errors.FloodWaitError(request=None, capture=300)
        fake.history_error_after = 1
        with pytest.raises(FloodWait) as info:
            await collect(gateway.iter_history(CHAT_ID))
        assert info.value.seconds == 300

    async def test_unknown_chat_raises_on_first_item(self, clock: FakeClock) -> None:
        gateway, _ = make_gateway(clock)
        with pytest.raises(AccessLost):
            await collect(gateway.iter_history(CHAT_ID))

    async def test_closing_the_stream_early_is_clean(self, clock: FakeClock) -> None:
        gateway, fake = await ready(clock)
        fake.history = [tg_message(9), tg_message(8)]
        stream: Any = gateway.iter_history(CHAT_ID)
        first = await anext(stream)
        assert first.msg_id == 9
        await stream.aclose()

class TestIterWindow:
    SINCE = datetime(2026, 10, 25, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=UTC)

    def window_history(self) -> list[Any]:
        return [
            tg_message(1, self.SINCE - timedelta(seconds=1)),
            tg_message(2, self.SINCE),
            tg_message(3, self.SINCE + timedelta(seconds=1)),
            tg_message(4, self.SINCE + timedelta(hours=1)),
            tg_message(5, self.SINCE + timedelta(hours=2)),
        ]

    async def test_offset_is_one_second_early_and_reversed(self, clock: FakeClock) -> None:
        gateway, fake = await ready(clock)
        await collect(gateway.iter_window(CHAT_ID, self.SINCE, 10))
        assert fake.names("iter_messages") == [
            {"offset_date": self.SINCE - timedelta(seconds=1), "reverse": True}
        ]

    async def test_messages_before_since_are_cut_and_since_itself_is_kept(
        self, clock: FakeClock
    ) -> None:
        gateway, fake = await ready(clock)
        fake.history = self.window_history()
        records = await collect(gateway.iter_window(CHAT_ID, self.SINCE, 99))
        assert [r.msg_id for r in records] == [2, 3, 4, 5]

    async def test_stops_after_max_id_inclusive(self, clock: FakeClock) -> None:
        gateway, fake = await ready(clock)
        fake.history = self.window_history()
        records = await collect(gateway.iter_window(CHAT_ID, self.SINCE, 4))
        assert [r.msg_id for r in records] == [2, 3, 4]

    async def test_max_id_below_everything_yields_nothing(self, clock: FakeClock) -> None:
        gateway, fake = await ready(clock)
        fake.history = self.window_history()
        assert await collect(gateway.iter_window(CHAT_ID, self.SINCE, 0)) == []

    async def test_empty_messages_are_skipped_even_beyond_max_id(self, clock: FakeClock) -> None:
        gateway, fake = await ready(clock)
        fake.history = [empty(1), tg_message(2, self.SINCE), empty(50), tg_message(3, self.SINCE)]
        records = await collect(gateway.iter_window(CHAT_ID, self.SINCE, 10))
        assert [r.msg_id for r in records] == [2, 3]

    async def test_non_utc_since_is_compared_as_an_instant(self, clock: FakeClock) -> None:
        gateway, fake = await ready(clock)
        fake.history = self.window_history()
        since = self.SINCE.astimezone(timezone_plus(3))
        records = await collect(gateway.iter_window(CHAT_ID, since, 99))
        assert [r.msg_id for r in records] == [2, 3, 4, 5]

    async def test_naive_telegram_dates_are_treated_as_utc(self, clock: FakeClock) -> None:
        gateway, fake = await ready(clock)
        fake.history = [
            tg_message(1, datetime(2026, 10, 25, 0, 0, 1)),  # noqa: DTZ001 naive on purpose
            tg_message(2, datetime(2026, 10, 24, 23, 0, 0)),  # noqa: DTZ001 naive on purpose
        ]
        records = await collect(gateway.iter_window(CHAT_ID, self.SINCE, 99))
        assert [r.msg_id for r in records] == [1]

    async def test_access_lost(self, clock: FakeClock) -> None:
        gateway, fake = await ready(clock)
        fake.history_error = errors.ChannelPrivateError(request=None)
        with pytest.raises(AccessLost):
            await collect(gateway.iter_window(CHAT_ID, self.SINCE, 99))


def timezone_plus(hours: int) -> timezone:
    return timezone(timedelta(hours=hours))


class TestEvents:
    def message_event(
        self,
        *,
        peer: Any | None = None,
        private: bool = False,
        chat: Any = None,
        sender_error: BaseException | None = None,
        chat_error: BaseException | None = None,
    ) -> SimpleNamespace:
        sender_calls: list[int] = []

        async def get_sender() -> Any:
            sender_calls.append(1)
            if sender_error:
                raise sender_error
            return None

        async def get_chat() -> Any:
            if chat_error:
                raise chat_error
            return chat

        message = tg_message(9, peer_id=peer or tl.PeerChannel(CHANNEL_ID), get_sender=get_sender)
        event = SimpleNamespace(
            message=message, is_private=private, get_chat=get_chat, sender_calls=sender_calls
        )
        return event

    def callbacks(self, fake: FakeTelegramClient) -> dict[str, Callable[..., Any]]:
        return {type(event).__name__: callback for callback, event in fake.handlers}

    async def recorder(
        self, gateway: TelethonGateway, fake: FakeTelegramClient
    ) -> tuple[list[ChatEvent], dict[str, Callable[..., Any]]]:
        seen: list[ChatEvent] = []

        async def handler(event: ChatEvent) -> None:
            seen.append(event)

        gateway.add_event_handler(handler)
        return seen, self.callbacks(fake)

    async def test_telethon_handlers_are_registered_once(self, clock: FakeClock) -> None:
        gateway, fake = make_gateway(clock)

        async def handler(event: ChatEvent) -> None:
            return None

        gateway.add_event_handler(handler)
        gateway.add_event_handler(handler)
        gateway.add_event_handler(handler)
        kinds: list[Any] = [type(event) for _, event in fake.handlers]
        assert kinds == [events.NewMessage, events.MessageEdited, events.MessageDeleted]

    async def test_no_registration_without_handlers(self, clock: FakeClock) -> None:
        _, fake = make_gateway(clock)
        assert fake.handlers == []

    async def test_new_message_reaches_every_handler_in_order(self, clock: FakeClock) -> None:
        gateway, fake = await ready(clock)
        order: list[str] = []

        async def first(event: ChatEvent) -> None:
            order.append(f"first:{type(event).__name__}")

        async def second(event: ChatEvent) -> None:
            order.append("second")

        gateway.add_event_handler(first)
        gateway.add_event_handler(second)
        await self.callbacks(fake)["NewMessage"](self.message_event(chat=channel(username="pub")))
        assert order == ["first:NewMessageEvent", "second"]

    async def test_new_message_is_mapped_with_chat_username(self, clock: FakeClock) -> None:
        gateway, fake = make_gateway(clock)
        seen, callbacks = await self.recorder(gateway, fake)
        await callbacks["NewMessage"](self.message_event(chat=channel(username="pub")))
        (event,) = seen
        assert isinstance(event, NewMessageEvent)
        assert (event.record.chat_id, event.record.msg_id) == (CHAT_ID, 9)
        assert event.record.link == "https://t.me/pub/9"
        assert event.record.fetched_at == NOW

    async def test_known_chat_is_not_fetched_again(self, clock: FakeClock) -> None:
        gateway, fake = make_gateway(clock)
        fake.dialogs = [channel(username="pub")]
        await gateway.list_dialogs()
        seen, callbacks = await self.recorder(gateway, fake)

        def forbidden() -> Any:
            raise AssertionError("get_chat must not be called for a cached chat")

        event = self.message_event()
        event.get_chat = forbidden
        await callbacks["NewMessage"](event)
        assert len(seen) == 1

    async def test_edited_message_event(self, clock: FakeClock) -> None:
        gateway, fake = make_gateway(clock)
        seen, callbacks = await self.recorder(gateway, fake)
        event = self.message_event(chat=channel())
        event.message.edit_date = NOW
        await callbacks["MessageEdited"](event)
        (edited,) = seen
        assert isinstance(edited, EditedMessageEvent)
        assert edited.record.edit_date == NOW

    async def test_private_chats_are_dropped(self, clock: FakeClock) -> None:
        gateway, fake = make_gateway(clock)
        seen, callbacks = await self.recorder(gateway, fake)
        event = self.message_event(peer=tl.PeerUser(5), private=True)
        await callbacks["NewMessage"](event)
        await callbacks["MessageEdited"](event)
        assert seen == []
        assert event.sender_calls == []

    async def test_chat_lookup_failures_are_logged_not_raised(
        self, clock: FakeClock, caplog: pytest.LogCaptureFixture
    ) -> None:
        gateway, fake = make_gateway(clock)
        seen, callbacks = await self.recorder(gateway, fake)
        for error in (errors.ChannelPrivateError(request=None), ValueError("gone")):
            await callbacks["NewMessage"](self.message_event(chat_error=error))
        assert len(seen) == 2
        assert all(isinstance(e, NewMessageEvent) and e.record.link for e in seen)
        warnings = [r for r in caplog.records if r.levelno == logging.WARNING]
        assert len(warnings) == 2
        assert str(CHAT_ID) in warnings[0].getMessage()
        assert "text 9" not in caplog.text

    async def test_sender_lookup_failure_is_logged_not_raised(
        self, clock: FakeClock, caplog: pytest.LogCaptureFixture
    ) -> None:
        gateway, fake = make_gateway(clock)
        seen, callbacks = await self.recorder(gateway, fake)
        event = self.message_event(
            chat=channel(), sender_error=errors.FloodWaitError(request=None, capture=1)
        )
        await callbacks["NewMessage"](event)
        assert len(seen) == 1
        assert any("sender" in r.getMessage() for r in caplog.records)
        assert "text 9" not in caplog.text

    async def test_sender_is_not_loaded_when_names_are_off(self, clock: FakeClock) -> None:
        gateway, fake = make_gateway(clock, names=False)
        seen, callbacks = await self.recorder(gateway, fake)
        event = self.message_event(chat=channel())
        await callbacks["NewMessage"](event)
        assert len(seen) == 1
        assert event.sender_calls == []

    async def test_sender_is_loaded_when_names_are_on(self, clock: FakeClock) -> None:
        gateway, fake = make_gateway(clock)
        _, callbacks = await self.recorder(gateway, fake)
        event = self.message_event(chat=channel())
        await callbacks["NewMessage"](event)
        assert event.sender_calls == [1]

    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
        ("chat_id", "ids", "expected_chat"),
        [(None, [4, 2, 3], None), (CHAT_ID, [1], CHAT_ID), (-5, [], -5)],
    )
    async def test_deleted_messages_event(
        self, clock: FakeClock, chat_id: int | None, ids: list[int], expected_chat: int | None
    ) -> None:
        gateway, fake = make_gateway(clock)
        seen, callbacks = await self.recorder(gateway, fake)
        await callbacks["MessageDeleted"](SimpleNamespace(chat_id=chat_id, deleted_ids=ids))
        assert seen == [DeletedMessagesEvent(expected_chat, tuple(ids))]

    async def test_deleted_ids_may_be_any_integer_like(self, clock: FakeClock) -> None:
        gateway, fake = make_gateway(clock)
        seen, callbacks = await self.recorder(gateway, fake)
        await callbacks["MessageDeleted"](SimpleNamespace(chat_id="-5", deleted_ids=("7", 2**40)))
        assert seen == [DeletedMessagesEvent(-5, (7, 2**40))]

    async def test_handler_added_during_dispatch_does_not_break_it(self, clock: FakeClock) -> None:
        gateway, fake = make_gateway(clock)
        calls: list[str] = []

        async def late(event: ChatEvent) -> None:
            calls.append("late")

        async def early(event: ChatEvent) -> None:
            calls.append("early")
            gateway.add_event_handler(late)

        gateway.add_event_handler(early)
        callbacks = self.callbacks(fake)
        await callbacks["MessageDeleted"](SimpleNamespace(chat_id=None, deleted_ids=[1]))
        assert calls == ["early"]
        await callbacks["MessageDeleted"](SimpleNamespace(chat_id=None, deleted_ids=[1]))
        assert calls == ["early", "early", "late"]


class TestDownloadMedia:
    async def test_downloads_into_a_created_directory(
        self, clock: FakeClock, tmp_path: Path
    ) -> None:
        gateway, fake = await ready(clock)
        fake.by_id[7] = tg_message(7, media=object())
        target = tmp_path / "nested" / "media" / "2026-10"
        fake.downloaded = str(target / "7.jpg")
        result = await gateway.download_media(CHAT_ID, 7, target)
        assert result == target / "7.jpg"
        assert isinstance(result, Path)
        assert target.is_dir()
        assert fake.names("download_media")[0]["file"] == str(target)
        assert fake.names("get_messages") == [{"limit": None, "ids": 7}]

    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
        "message",
        [None, tl.MessageEmpty(id=7, peer_id=None), SimpleNamespace(id=7, media=None)],
    )
    async def test_nothing_to_download_gives_none(
        self, clock: FakeClock, tmp_path: Path, message: Any
    ) -> None:
        gateway, fake = await ready(clock)
        fake.by_id[7] = message
        assert await gateway.download_media(CHAT_ID, 7, tmp_path / "m") is None
        assert fake.names("download_media") == []
        assert not (tmp_path / "m").exists()

    async def test_download_that_saves_nothing_gives_none(
        self, clock: FakeClock, tmp_path: Path
    ) -> None:
        gateway, fake = await ready(clock)
        fake.by_id[7] = tg_message(7, media=object())
        fake.downloaded = None
        assert await gateway.download_media(CHAT_ID, 7, tmp_path / "m") is None

    async def test_access_lost_and_flood_wait(self, clock: FakeClock, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
        gateway, fake = await ready(clock)
        fake.latest_error = errors.ChannelPrivateError(request=None)
        with pytest.raises(AccessLost):
            await gateway.download_media(CHAT_ID, 7, tmp_path / "m")
        fake.latest_error = errors.FloodWaitError(request=None, capture=20)
        with pytest.raises(FloodWait):
            await gateway.download_media(CHAT_ID, 7, tmp_path / "m")


class TestLogin:
    def prompts(self, log: list[str]) -> dict[str, Callable[[], str]]:
        def remember(label: str, value: str) -> Callable[[], str]:
            def prompt() -> str:
                log.append(label)
                return value

            return prompt

        return {
            "prompt_phone": remember("phone", "+598000111222"),
            "prompt_code": remember("code", "13579"),
            "prompt_password": remember("password", "hunter2"),
        }

    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
        "config",
        [
            TelegramConfig(),
            TelegramConfig(api_id=1),
            TelegramConfig(api_hash="h"),
            TelegramConfig(api_id=0, api_hash="h"),
        ],
    )
    async def test_missing_credentials(self, config: TelegramConfig, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
        with pytest.raises(ChatImportError, match="api_id"):
            await login(config, tmp_path / "s" / "x.session", **self.prompts([]))
        assert FakeTelegramClient.created == []
        assert not (tmp_path / "s").exists()

    async def test_returns_username_and_never_the_phone(
        self, tmp_path: Path, caplog: pytest.LogCaptureFixture
    ) -> None:
        log: list[str] = []
        session = tmp_path / "deep" / "session" / "chatimport.session"
        with caplog.at_level(logging.DEBUG):
            who = await login(CONFIG, session, **self.prompts(log))
        assert who == "@owner"
        assert "+598" not in who
        assert "+598" not in caplog.text
        assert session.parent.is_dir()
        (client,) = FakeTelegramClient.created
        assert client.session == str(session)
        assert client.kwargs == {"flood_sleep_threshold": 77}
        assert client.disconnects == 1
        assert log == ["phone", "code", "password"]

    async def test_account_without_username_is_shown_by_id(
        self, tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
    ) -> None:
        me = SimpleNamespace(id=4242, username=None, phone="+598000111222")
        monkeypatch.setattr(FakeTelegramClient, "default_me", me)
        assert await login(CONFIG, tmp_path / "s.session", **self.prompts([])) == "id 4242"

    async def test_passes_the_callables_to_telethon(self, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
        log: list[str] = []
        prompts = self.prompts(log)
        await login(CONFIG, tmp_path / "s.session", **prompts)
        (client,) = FakeTelegramClient.created
        (kwargs,) = client.names("start")
        assert kwargs["phone"] is prompts["prompt_phone"]
        assert kwargs["code_callback"] is prompts["prompt_code"]
        assert kwargs["password"] is prompts["prompt_password"]

    async def test_client_is_disconnected_when_login_fails(
        self, tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
    ) -> None:
        monkeypatch.setattr(FakeTelegramClient, "default_start_error", RuntimeError("boom"))
        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="boom"):
            await login(CONFIG, tmp_path / "s.session", **self.prompts([]))
        assert FakeTelegramClient.created[-1].disconnects == 1

    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
        ("error", "expected"),
        [
            (errors.FloodWaitError(request=None, capture=99), FloodWait),
            (errors.AuthKeyUnregisteredError(request=None), SessionRevoked),
        ],
    )
    async def test_telegram_errors_are_translated_and_the_client_closed(
        self,
        tmp_path: Path,
        monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
        error: BaseException,
        expected: type[Exception],
    ) -> None:
        monkeypatch.setattr(FakeTelegramClient, "default_start_error", error)
        with pytest.raises(expected):
            await login(CONFIG, tmp_path / "s.session", **self.prompts([]))
        assert FakeTelegramClient.created[-1].disconnects == 1

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta, timezone

from chatimport.records import MessageRecord

from tests.fakes import NOW

FETCHED = NOW
PRIVATE_CHAT = -1001234567890


def fake_message(**kw: Any) -> SimpleNamespace:
    base: dict[str, Any] = {
        "id": 10,
        "date": datetime(2026, 10, 1, 8, 30, 15, tzinfo=UTC),
        "message": "hello",
        "to_dict": dict,
    }
    base.update(kw)
    return SimpleNamespace(**base)


def do_map(
    message: Any,
    *,
    chat_id: int = PRIVATE_CHAT,
    username: str | None = None,
    names: bool = True,
    raw: bool = False,
) -> MessageRecord:
    return mapper.map_message(
        message,
        chat_id=chat_id,
        chat_username=username,
        fetched_at=FETCHED,
        include_sender_names=names,
        include_raw=raw,
    )


def action(name: str) -> Any:
    return type(name, (), {})()

def test_raw_is_converted_to_json_types() -> None:
    class Opaque:
        def __str__(self) -> str:
            return "opaque!"

    payload: dict[Any, Any] = {
        "_": "Message",
        "date": datetime(2026, 10, 1, 8, 0, 0, 123456),  # noqa: DTZ001 naive on purpose
        "aware": datetime(2026, 10, 1, 11, 0, 0, tzinfo=timezone(timedelta(hours=3))),
        "blob": b"\x00\xff\x10",
        "nested": {"list": [1, (2, 3), {"deep": b"a"}], 5: "int key"},
        "flag": True,
        "none": None,
        "float": 1.5,
        "text": "\u043f\u0440\u0438\u0432\u0435\u0442 \U0001f600",
        "opaque": Opaque(),
        "big": 2**70,
    }
    record = do_map(fake_message(to_dict=lambda: payload), raw=True)
    assert record.raw == {
        "_": "Message",
        "date": "2026-10-01T08:00:00Z",
        "aware": "2026-10-01T08:00:00Z",
        "blob": "AP8Q",
        "nested": {"list": [1, [2, 3], {"deep": "YQ=="}], "5": "int key"},
        "flag": True,
        "none": None,
        "float": 1.5,
        "text": "\u043f\u0440\u0438\u0432\u0435\u0442 \U0001f600",
        "opaque": "opaque!",
        "big": 2**70,
    }
    assert json.loads(json.dumps(record.to_dict()))["raw"] == record.raw

def tl_message(media: Any = None, **kw: Any) -> TlMessage:
    return TlMessage(
        id=5,
        peer_id=tl.PeerChannel(1),
        date=datetime(2026, 10, 1, tzinfo=UTC),
        message=kw.pop("message", ""),
        media=media,
        **kw,
    )


def document(attributes: list[Any], mime: str, size: int) -> tl.MessageMediaDocument:
    doc = tl.Document(
        id=1,
        access_hash=2,
        file_reference=b"",
        date=datetime(2026, 10, 1, tzinfo=UTC),
        mime_type=mime,
        size=size,
        dc_id=1,
        attributes=attributes,
    )
    return tl.MessageMediaDocument(document=doc)


def photo_object() -> tl.Photo:
    return tl.Photo(
        id=1,
        access_hash=2,
        file_reference=b"x",
        date=datetime(2026, 10, 1, tzinfo=UTC),
        sizes=[tl.PhotoSize(type="x", w=10, h=10, size=1)],
        dc_id=1,
    )


def test_real_telethon_voice_message() -> None:
    media_obj = document([tl.DocumentAttributeAudio(duration=14, voice=True)], "audio/ogg", 48213)
    media = do_map(tl_message(media_obj)).media
    assert media is not None
    assert (media.type, media.mime, media.size, media.duration) == ("voice", "audio/ogg", 48213, 14)


def test_real_telethon_video_note_and_video() -> None:

    video = do_map(tl_message(document([plain], "video/mp4", 5))).media

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import sys
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any

from chatimport.ports import ResolveStatus
from chatimport.telegram import client as client_mod
from chatimport.telegram import mapper
from chatimport.telegram.resolve import resolve_ref
from tests.fakes import NOW

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    import pytest

CAFE_NFC = "Caf\u00e9 Espa\u00f1a"
CAFE_NFD = "Cafe\u0301 Espan\u0303a"


def message_with_personal_raw() -> SimpleNamespace:
    raw: dict[str, Any] = {
        "_": "Message",
        "id": 10,
        "message": "hello",
        "post_author": "Signature Person",
        "fwd_from": {"_": "MessageFwdHeader", "from_name": "Hidden Author", "date": NOW},
        "media": {
            "_": "MessageMediaContact",
            "phone_number": "+000111222",
            "first_name": "Contact",
            "last_name": "Person",
            "vcard": "BEGIN:VCARD",
            "user_id": 5,
        },
        "entities": [{"_": "MessageEntityMentionName", "user_id": 5, "username": "someone"}],
    }
    return SimpleNamespace(
        id=10,
        date=datetime(2026, 10, 1, 8, 30, 15, tzinfo=UTC),
        message="hello",
        to_dict=lambda: raw,
    )


def keys_at_any_depth(value: Any) -> set[str]:
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        mapping: dict[str, Any] = value  # pyright: ignore[reportUnknownVariableType]
        found = set(mapping)
        for item in mapping.values():
            found |= keys_at_any_depth(item)
        return found
    if isinstance(value, list):
        items: list[Any] = value  # pyright: ignore[reportUnknownVariableType]
        found: set[str] = set()
        for item in items:
            found |= keys_at_any_depth(item)
        return found
    return set()


def mapped(*, names: bool) -> Any:
    return mapper.map_message(
        message_with_personal_raw(),
        chat_id=-1001,
        chat_username=None,
        fetched_at=NOW,
        include_sender_names=names,
        include_raw=True,
    ).raw


def test_raw_is_scrubbed_without_sender_names() -> None:
    raw = mapped(names=False)
    assert keys_at_any_depth(raw).isdisjoint(mapper.PERSONAL_RAW_KEYS)
    text = json.dumps(raw)
    for secret in ("Hidden Author", "Signature Person", "+000111222", "someone", "VCARD"):
        assert secret not in text
    assert raw["media"]["user_id"] == 5
    assert set(raw["fwd_from"]) == {"_", "date"}


def test_raw_keeps_everything_when_sender_names_are_on() -> None:
    raw = mapped(names=True)
    assert raw["fwd_from"]["from_name"] == "Hidden Author"
    assert raw["media"]["phone_number"] == "+000111222"


async def test_resolve_title_matches_nfd_ref() -> None:
    entity = type("Channel", (), {"title": CAFE_NFC, "megagroup": True, "pid": -1001})()

    class Lookup:
        async def get_entity_by_username(self, username: str) -> Any:
            return None

        async def check_invite(self, invite_hash: str) -> Any:
            return None

        async def dialog_entities(self) -> list[Any]:
            return [entity, type("Channel", (), {"title": None, "pid": -2})()]

        def peer_id(self, entity: Any) -> int:
            return entity.pid

    result = await resolve_ref(CAFE_NFD, Lookup())
    assert (result.status, result.chat_id) == (ResolveStatus.FOUND, -1001)
    upper = await resolve_ref(CAFE_NFD.upper(), Lookup())
    assert upper.status is ResolveStatus.NOT_FOUND


def session_files(tmp_path: Path) -> list[Path]:
    session = tmp_path / "chatimport.session"
    companions = [session, tmp_path / "chatimport.session-journal"]
    for path in companions:
        path.write_bytes(b"")
    return companions


def test_protect_session_makes_the_session_owner_only_on_posix(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    files = session_files(tmp_path)
    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "platform", "linux")
    client_mod.protect_session(files[0])
    if os.name != "nt":
        for path in files:
            assert path.stat().st_mode & 0o077 == 0


def test_protect_session_leaves_windows_acls_alone(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    files = session_files(tmp_path)
    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "platform", "win32")

    def refuse(*_args: object, **_kwargs: object) -> None:
        raise AssertionError("chmod on Windows")

    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "chmod", refuse)
    client_mod.protect_session(files[0])

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any

import pytest

from chatimport.ports import ResolvedChat, ResolveStatus
from chatimport.telegram.resolve import (
    InviteInfo,
    ParsedRef,
    RefKind,
    entity_kind,
    parse_ref,
    resolve_ref,
)


@dataclass
class Chat:
    pid: int
    title: str = ""
    deactivated: bool = False
    username: str | None = None


@dataclass
class Channel:
    pid: int
    title: str = ""
    megagroup: bool = False
    username: str | None = None


@dataclass
class User:
    pid: int
    first_name: str = "Person"
    bot: bool = False
    username: str | None = None


@dataclass
class ChannelForbidden:
    pid: int
    title: str = "Forbidden"


@dataclass
class ChatForbidden:
    pid: int
    title: str = "Forbidden"


@dataclass
class FakeLookup:
    usernames: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict[str, Any])
    invites: dict[str, InviteInfo] = field(default_factory=dict[str, InviteInfo])
    dialogs: list[Any] = field(default_factory=list[Any])
    error: BaseException | None = None
    calls: list[tuple[str, str]] = field(default_factory=list[tuple[str, str]])

    async def get_entity_by_username(self, username: str) -> Any | None:
        self.calls.append(("username", username))
        if self.error:
            raise self.error
        return self.usernames.get(username)

    async def check_invite(self, invite_hash: str) -> InviteInfo | None:
        self.calls.append(("invite", invite_hash))
        if self.error:
            raise self.error
        return self.invites.get(invite_hash)

    async def dialog_entities(self) -> list[Any]:
        self.calls.append(("dialogs", ""))
        if self.error:
            raise self.error
        return list(self.dialogs)

    def peer_id(self, entity: Any) -> int:
        return entity.pid

    "\U0001f1fa\U0001f1fe"
)

def title(value: str) -> ParsedRef:
    return ParsedRef(RefKind.TITLE, value)

from types import SimpleNamespace
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any

import pytest
from telethon import errors

from chatimport.config import TelegramConfig
from chatimport.ports import ChatImportError
from chatimport.telegram import session_probe
from chatimport.telegram.session_probe import SessionInfo, probe_session

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pathlib import Path


class FakeClient:
    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        authorized: bool = True,
        me: Any = None,
        connect_error: BaseException | None = None,
        authorized_error: BaseException | None = None,
        me_error: BaseException | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.authorized = authorized
        self.me = me if me is not None else SimpleNamespace(username="owner", id=42)
        self.connect_error = connect_error
        self.authorized_error = authorized_error
        self.me_error = me_error
        self.calls: list[str] = []

    async def connect(self) -> None:
        self.calls.append("connect")
        if self.connect_error:
            raise self.connect_error

    async def is_user_authorized(self) -> bool:
        self.calls.append("is_user_authorized")
        if self.authorized_error:
            raise self.authorized_error
        return self.authorized

    async def get_me(self) -> Any:
        self.calls.append("get_me")
        if self.me_error:
            raise self.me_error
        return self.me

    async def disconnect(self) -> None:
        self.calls.append("disconnect")


class Rig:
    def __init__(self, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
        self.session = tmp_path / "chatimport.session"
        self.session.write_bytes(b"x")
        self.client = FakeClient()
        self.protected: list[Path] = []
        self.made: list[Path] = []
        monkeypatch.setattr(session_probe, "_make_client", self._make)
        monkeypatch.setattr(session_probe, "protect_session", self.protected.append)

    def _make(self, config: TelegramConfig, path: Path) -> FakeClient:
        self.made.append(path)
        return self.client


@pytest.fixture
def rig(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, tmp_path: Path) -> Rig:
    return Rig(monkeypatch, tmp_path)


CONFIGURED = TelegramConfig(api_id=12345, api_hash="abcdef")


async def test_signed_in_session_reports_the_username(rig: Rig) -> None:
    info = await probe_session(CONFIGURED, rig.session)

    assert info == SessionInfo("@owner")
    assert rig.client.calls == ["connect", "is_user_authorized", "get_me", "disconnect"]
    assert rig.protected == [rig.session]
    assert rig.made == [rig.session]


async def test_account_without_username_reports_its_id(rig: Rig) -> None:
    rig.client.me = SimpleNamespace(username=None, id=42)
    assert await probe_session(CONFIGURED, rig.session) == SessionInfo("id 42")


async def test_missing_credentials_never_touch_the_client(rig: Rig) -> None:
    assert await probe_session(TelegramConfig(), rig.session) is None
    assert rig.made == []


async def test_missing_session_file_never_touches_the_client(rig: Rig, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    assert await probe_session(CONFIGURED, tmp_path / "absent.session") is None
    assert rig.made == []


async def test_unauthorised_session_gives_none_and_disconnects(rig: Rig) -> None:
    rig.client.authorized = False
    assert await probe_session(CONFIGURED, rig.session) is None
    assert rig.client.calls == ["connect", "is_user_authorized", "disconnect"]


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "error",
    [
        errors.AuthKeyError(request=None, message="x"),
        errors.UnauthorizedError(request=None, message="x"),
    ],
)
async def test_revoked_session_gives_none(rig: Rig, error: BaseException) -> None:
    rig.client.authorized_error = error
    assert await probe_session(CONFIGURED, rig.session) is None
    assert rig.client.calls[-1] == "disconnect"


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "error", [errors.RPCError(None, "x", 500), OSError("down"), TimeoutError("slow")]
)
async def test_other_failures_become_a_chat_import_error(rig: Rig, error: BaseException) -> None:
    rig.client.me_error = error
    with pytest.raises(ChatImportError, match=type(error).__name__):
        await probe_session(CONFIGURED, rig.session)
    assert rig.client.calls[-1] == "disconnect"


async def test_connect_failure_is_reported_and_disconnects(rig: Rig) -> None:
    rig.client.connect_error = OSError("no route")
    with pytest.raises(ChatImportError, match="OSError"):
        await probe_session(CONFIGURED, rig.session)
    assert rig.client.calls == ["connect", "disconnect"]

from __future__ import annotations

name: demo-agent
description: Demo agent.
tools: Read
---

Body of the agent.
"""

SKILL = """---
name: demo-skill
description: Demo skill.
---

# Demo
"""


def _write(path: Path, text: str) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")


@pytest.fixture
def rules_repo(tmp_path: Path) -> Path:
    _write(tmp_path / ".ai/universal/01-alpha.md", "# Alpha\n\nAlways inline.\n")
    _write(
        tmp_path / ".ai/project/10-beta.md",
        "# Beta\n\n<!-- tier: extended -->\n\n> **Essence.** Beta in one line.\n\nLong text.\n",
    )
    _write(tmp_path / ".claude/agents/demo-agent.md", AGENT)
    _write(tmp_path / ".claude/skills/demo-skill/SKILL.md", SKILL)
    return tmp_path


def test_sync_writes_agents_md_and_codex_mirror(rules_repo: Path) -> None:
    assert sync_agents.main([], root=rules_repo) == 0

    agents_md = (rules_repo / "AGENTS.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "GENERATED FILE - DO NOT EDIT." in agents_md
    assert "Always inline." in agents_md
    assert "Long text." not in agents_md
    assert "Beta in one line." in agents_md

    toml = (rules_repo / ".codex/agents/demo-agent.toml").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert 'name = "demo-agent"' in toml
    assert "Body of the agent." in toml
    skill = (rules_repo / ".codex/skills/demo-skill/SKILL.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert skill.startswith("---\n# GENERATED from .claude/skills/demo-skill/SKILL.md")


def test_check_detects_drift_and_stale_files(rules_repo: Path) -> None:
    sync_agents.main([], root=rules_repo)
    assert sync_agents.main(["--check"], root=rules_repo) == 0

    _write(rules_repo / ".ai/universal/01-alpha.md", "# Alpha\n\nChanged.\n")
    assert sync_agents.main(["--check"], root=rules_repo) == 1

    sync_agents.main([], root=rules_repo)
    _write(rules_repo / ".codex/agents/orphan.toml", "name = 'orphan'\n")
    assert sync_agents.main(["--check"], root=rules_repo) == 1
    sync_agents.main([], root=rules_repo)
    assert not (rules_repo / ".codex/agents/orphan.toml").exists()

"""Harness for worker tests: a real `ChatWorker` over a scripted gateway and a fake clock.

Nothing here sleeps for real. The worker is driven by yielding to the event loop until a
condition on the disk or the state file holds.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import contextlib
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any

import pytest

from chatimport.config import Config, parse_config
from chatimport.ports import (
    DeletedMessagesEvent,
    EditedMessageEvent,
    NewMessageEvent,
)
from chatimport.recheck import compute_recheck
from chatimport.records import MessageRecord
from chatimport.runtime import TrackedChat
from chatimport.storage.layout import chat_folder_name, list_parts
from chatimport.storage.state import PHASE_LIVE, ChatState, load_state
from chatimport.storage.writer import iter_part_records, iter_records, scan_part
from chatimport.worker import ChatWorker, RecheckFn
from tests.fakes import CHAT_ID, NOW, FakeClock, FakeGateway, RecordingNotifier, msg

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import AsyncIterator, Callable, Iterable
    from pathlib import Path

    from chatimport.runtime import BackfillSlots

TITLE = "Example Chat"
TURNS = 30000


def make_config(**sections: dict[str, Any]) -> Config:
    return parse_config(dict(sections))


@dataclass
class Rig:
    root: Path
    gateway: FakeGateway
    clock: FakeClock
    notifier: RecordingNotifier
    config: Config
    chat: TrackedChat
    worker: ChatWorker
    task: asyncio.Task[None] | None = None

    @property
    def folder(self) -> Path:
        return self.worker.folder

    def start(self) -> asyncio.Task[None]:
        self.task = asyncio.create_task(self.worker.run())
        return self.task

    async def until(self, predicate: Callable[[], bool], what: str = "condition") -> None:
        for _ in range(TURNS):
            if predicate():
                return
            task = self.task
            if task is not None and task.done():
                outcome = "cancelled" if task.cancelled() else repr(task.exception())
                raise AssertionError(f"worker ended ({outcome}) before: {what}")
            await asyncio.sleep(0)
        raise AssertionError(f"not reached: {what}")

    async def settle(self, turns: int = 400) -> None:
        for _ in range(turns):
            await asyncio.sleep(0)

    def load(self) -> ChatState | None:
        return load_state(self.folder)

    def state(self) -> ChatState:
        state = self.load()
        assert state is not None, "state.json is missing"
        return state

    def phase(self) -> str | None:
        state = self.load()
        return state.phase if state is not None else None

    def is_live(self) -> bool:
        return self.phase() == PHASE_LIVE

    def backfill_done(self) -> bool:
        state = self.load()
        return state is not None and state.backfill.done

    async def until_live(self) -> None:
        await self.until(self.is_live, "phase live")

    async def until_complete(self) -> None:
        await self.until(lambda: self.is_live() and self.backfill_done(), "live and backfilled")

    def ids(self) -> list[int]:
        return disk_ids(self.folder)

    async def shutdown(self) -> None:
        with contextlib.suppress(asyncio.CancelledError, Exception):
            await asyncio.wait_for(self.worker.stop(), 3)
        task = self.task
        if task is None:
            return
        if not task.done():
            task.cancel()
        with contextlib.suppress(asyncio.CancelledError, Exception):
            await task

    async def kill(self) -> None:
        """A hard stop: cancel the run task without any graceful flush request."""
        task = self.task
        assert task is not None
        task.cancel()
        with contextlib.suppress(asyncio.CancelledError):
            await task


class RigFactory:
    def __init__(self, root: Path) -> None:
        self.root = root
        self.rigs: list[Rig] = []

    def __call__(
        self,
        ids: Iterable[int] | None = None,
        *,
        chat_id: int = CHAT_ID,
        title: str = TITLE,
        config: Config | None = None,
        gateway: FakeGateway | None = None,
        clock: FakeClock | None = None,
        notifier: RecordingNotifier | None = None,
        recheck: RecheckFn | None = None,
        slots: BackfillSlots | None = None,
    ) -> Rig:
        gateway = gateway if gateway is not None else FakeGateway()
        if ids is not None:
            gateway.add_chat(chat_id, list(ids))
        clock = clock if clock is not None else FakeClock()
        notifier = notifier if notifier is not None else RecordingNotifier()
        config = config if config is not None else make_config()
        chat = TrackedChat(chat_id, title, None, chat_folder_name(title, chat_id))
        worker = ChatWorker(
            chat,
            root=self.root,
            gateway=gateway,
            config=config,
            clock=clock,
            notifier=notifier,
            recheck=recheck if recheck is not None else compute_recheck,
            slots=slots,
        )
        rig = Rig(self.root, gateway, clock, notifier, config, chat, worker)
        self.rigs.append(rig)
        return rig


async def run_inline[T](call: Callable[[], T]) -> T:
    return call()


@pytest.fixture
async def make_rig(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> AsyncIterator[RigFactory]:
    """File work runs inline instead of in threads, so yielding to the loop is enough to see
    its effect (the thread path has its own tests)."""
    monkeypatch.setattr("chatimport.worker_store.run_blocking", run_inline)
    factory = RigFactory(tmp_path / "ChatImport")
    yield factory
    for rig in factory.rigs:
        await rig.shutdown()


@pytest.fixture
def small_parts(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> int:
    """Parts of 2 KiB instead of megabytes, so a few hundred messages span many parts."""
    monkeypatch.setattr("chatimport.worker._BYTES_PER_MB", 2048)
    return 2048


def disk_ids(folder: Path) -> list[int]:
    return [r.msg_id for r in iter_records(folder) if isinstance(r, MessageRecord)]


def assert_disk_consistent(
    folder: Path, *, expect_ids: Iterable[int] | None = None, ordered: bool = True
) -> list[int]:
    """The files and `state.json` agree, no message appears twice, nothing is half-written."""
    state = load_state(folder)
    assert state is not None, "state.json is missing or unreadable"
    parts = list_parts(folder)
    ids = disk_ids(folder)
    duplicates = sorted({i for i in ids if ids.count(i) > 1})
    assert not duplicates, f"duplicated message ids: {duplicates[:10]}"
    assert {p.stem for p in parts} == set(state.chunks), "chunks do not match the part files"
    for part in parts:
        assert scan_part(part) == state.chunks[part.stem], f"chunk accounting off for {part.name}"
        assert part.read_bytes().endswith(b"\n"), f"{part.name} does not end with a newline"
    assert not list(folder.glob(".*.tmp")), "temp files left behind"
    if ordered:
        assert ids == sorted(ids), "messages are not in ascending id order"
        for part in parts:
            part_ids = [r.msg_id for r in iter_part_records(part) if isinstance(r, MessageRecord)]
            assert part_ids == sorted(part_ids)
    assert state.last_id >= max(ids, default=0)
    if expect_ids is not None:
        assert set(ids) == set(expect_ids)
    return ids


def new_event(msg_id: int, **kwargs: Any) -> NewMessageEvent:
    return NewMessageEvent(msg(msg_id, **kwargs))


def edit_event(
    msg_id: int, text: str, edit_date: datetime | None = None, **kwargs: Any
) -> EditedMessageEvent:
    when = edit_date if edit_date is not None else NOW + timedelta(minutes=1)
    return EditedMessageEvent(msg(msg_id, text=text, edit_date=when, **kwargs))


def delete_event(ids: Iterable[int], chat_id: int | None = CHAT_ID) -> DeletedMessagesEvent:
    return DeletedMessagesEvent(chat_id, tuple(ids))


def future_message(msg_id: int, hours: float = 0.0, **kwargs: Any) -> MessageRecord:
    """A message after the pre-built history (which ends at NOW)."""
    return msg(msg_id, date=NOW + timedelta(hours=hours + (msg_id - 1000) / 100), **kwargs)

"""Head backfill, tail backfill and catch-up of the chat worker, checked against the disk."""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any

import pytest

from chatimport.ports import FloodWait
from chatimport.records import MessageRecord
from chatimport.storage.layout import list_parts, month_key, parse_part_name
from chatimport.storage.state import PHASE_HEAD_BACKFILL
from chatimport.storage.writer import iter_part_records
from tests.fakes import CHAT_ID, NOW, FakeGateway, msg
from tests.unit.worker.rig import (
    RigFactory,
    assert_disk_consistent,
    make_config,
    make_rig,
    small_parts,
)

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pathlib import Path

__all__ = ["make_rig", "small_parts"]

OCTOBER_FIRST_ID = 316  # msg(316) is dated exactly 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z


def at(msg_id: int, iso: str, **kwargs: Any) -> MessageRecord:
    return msg(msg_id, date=datetime.fromisoformat(iso), **kwargs)


def put(gateway: FakeGateway, records: list[MessageRecord], chat_id: int = CHAT_ID) -> None:
    gateway.chats.setdefault(chat_id, {}).update({r.msg_id: r for r in records})


def tail_calls(gateway: FakeGateway) -> list[tuple[Any, ...]]:
    return [args for name, args in gateway.calls if name == "iter_history" and args[1]]


def ids_by_part(folder: Path) -> dict[str, list[int]]:
    return {
        p.stem: [r.msg_id for r in iter_part_records(p) if isinstance(r, MessageRecord)]
        for p in list_parts(folder)
    }


def test_fixture_dates_put_message_316_exactly_at_midnight() -> None:
    assert msg(OCTOBER_FIRST_ID).date == datetime(2026, 10, 1, tzinfo=UTC)
    assert msg(OCTOBER_FIRST_ID - 1).date == datetime(2026, 9, 30, 23, tzinfo=UTC)


async def test_empty_chat_finishes_without_reading_history(make_rig: RigFactory) -> None:
    rig = make_rig()
    rig.start()

    await rig.until_complete()

    state = rig.state()
    assert (state.last_id, state.chunks) == (0, {})
    assert state.backfill.head_id == 0
    assert rig.gateway.count("iter_history") == 0
    assert rig.ids() == []
    assert_disk_consistent(rig.folder)


async def test_restart_of_an_empty_chat_does_not_repeat_the_head_backfill(
    make_rig: RigFactory,
) -> None:
    first = make_rig()
    first.start()
    await first.until_complete()
    await first.shutdown()

    second = make_rig(gateway=first.gateway, clock=first.clock)
    second.gateway.chats[CHAT_ID] = {5: msg(5)}
    second.start()
    await second.until(lambda: second.ids() == [5], "message 5 caught up")

    assert second.gateway.count("newest_id") == 1
    assert second.gateway.count("iter_history") == 0
    assert second.state().last_id == 5
    assert_disk_consistent(second.folder, expect_ids=[5])


async def test_single_message_chat_is_stored_and_backfill_completes(make_rig: RigFactory) -> None:
    rig = make_rig([7])
    rig.start()

    await rig.until_complete()

    state = rig.state()
    assert (state.last_id, state.backfill.head_id, state.backfill.oldest_done_id) == (7, 7, 7)
    assert_disk_consistent(rig.folder, expect_ids=[7])
    assert len(list_parts(rig.folder)) == 1


async def test_chat_with_only_old_messages_never_creates_a_current_month_file(
    make_rig: RigFactory,
) -> None:
    rig = make_rig(range(1, 200))
    rig.start()

    await rig.until_complete()

    assert list(ids_by_part(rig.folder)) == ["2026-09_001"]
    assert_disk_consistent(rig.folder, expect_ids=range(1, 200))


async def test_newest_message_from_a_sparse_old_month_pulls_in_the_gaps_below(
    make_rig: RigFactory,
) -> None:
    rig = make_rig()
    put(
        rig.gateway,
        [
            at(1, "2025-01-15T10:00:00+00:00"),
            at(2, "2025-06-30T10:00:00+00:00"),
            at(3, "2026-08-01T00:00:00+00:00"),
            at(4, "2026-08-31T23:59:59+00:00"),
        ],
    )
    rig.start()

    await rig.until_complete()

    assert ids_by_part(rig.folder) == {
        "2025-01_001": [1],
        "2025-06_001": [2],
        "2026-08_001": [3, 4],
    }
    assert_disk_consistent(rig.folder, expect_ids=[1, 2, 3, 4])


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("records", "expected"),
    [
        pytest.param(
            [
                (1, "2026-09-30T23:59:59+00:00"),
                (2, "2026-10-01T00:00:00+00:00"),
                (3, "2026-10-01T00:00:01+00:00"),
            ],
            {"2026-09_001": [1], "2026-10_001": [2, 3]},
            id="utc-midnight",
        ),
        pytest.param(
            [(1, "2026-10-01T02:59:59+03:00"), (2, "2026-10-01T03:00:00+03:00")],
            {"2026-09_001": [1], "2026-10_001": [2]},
            id="positive-offset",
        ),
        pytest.param(
            [(1, "2026-09-30T18:59:59-05:00"), (2, "2026-09-30T19:00:00-05:00")],
            {"2026-09_001": [1], "2026-10_001": [2]},
            id="negative-offset",
        ),
        pytest.param(
            [(1, "2025-12-31T23:59:59+00:00"), (2, "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00")],
            {"2025-12_001": [1], "2026-01_001": [2]},
            id="year-boundary",
        ),
        pytest.param(
            [(1, "2028-02-29T23:59:59+00:00"), (2, "2028-03-01T00:00:00+00:00")],
            {"2028-02_001": [1], "2028-03_001": [2]},
            id="leap-day",
        ),

async def test_stop_during_head_backfill_leaves_no_partial_data_and_restart_completes(
    make_rig: RigFactory,
) -> None:
    config = make_config(backfill={"batch_size": 3})
    rig = make_rig(range(1, 11), config=config)
    stops: list[asyncio.Task[None]] = []
    seen = 0

    def hook() -> None:
        nonlocal seen
        seen += 1
        if seen == 5:
            stops.append(asyncio.get_running_loop().create_task(rig.worker.stop()))

    rig.gateway.page_hook = hook
    task = rig.start()
    await asyncio.wait_for(task, 3)
    await asyncio.gather(*stops)

    assert list_parts(rig.folder) == []
    state = rig.state()
    assert (state.phase, state.backfill.done, state.chunks) == (PHASE_HEAD_BACKFILL, False, {})

    rig.gateway.page_hook = None
    second = make_rig(gateway=rig.gateway, clock=rig.clock, config=config)
    second.start()
    await second.until_complete()
    assert_disk_consistent(second.folder, expect_ids=range(1, 11))

async def test_thousands_of_messages_over_many_months_in_tiny_parts(
    make_rig: RigFactory, small_parts: int
) -> None:
    start = datetime(2024, 11, 1, tzinfo=UTC)
    rig = make_rig(config=make_config(backfill={"batch_size": 50}))
    total = 2400
    put(
        rig.gateway,
        [
            msg(i, date=start + timedelta(hours=8 * i), text=f"{'x' * 100} {i}")
            for i in range(1, total + 1)
        ],
    )
    rig.start()

    await rig.until_complete()

    assert_disk_consistent(rig.folder, expect_ids=range(1, total + 1))
    by_month: dict[str, list[int]] = {}
    for part in list_parts(rig.folder):
        parsed = parse_part_name(part.name)
        assert parsed is not None
        by_month.setdefault(parsed[0], []).append(parsed[1])
        for record in iter_part_records(part):
            assert month_key(record.date if isinstance(record, MessageRecord) else NOW) == parsed[0]
    assert len(by_month) >= 26
    for month, numbers in by_month.items():
        assert numbers == list(range(1, len(numbers) + 1)), month
        for number in numbers[:-1]:
            path = rig.folder / f"{month}_{number:03d}.jsonl"
            assert path.stat().st_size >= small_parts
    assert rig.clock.sleeps.count(1.0) >= total // 50 - 2


@pytest.mark.parametrize("cut", [1, 7, 150, 299, 315])
async def test_interrupted_tail_resumes_from_oldest_done_id_without_gaps_or_duplicates(
    make_rig: RigFactory, cut: int
) -> None:
    first = make_rig(range(1, 1001))
    seen = 0

    def hook() -> None:
        nonlocal seen
        if not tail_calls(first.gateway):
            return
        seen += 1
        if seen == cut:
            assert first.task is not None
            first.task.cancel()
            raise asyncio.CancelledError

    first.gateway.page_hook = hook
    task = first.start()
    with pytest.raises(asyncio.CancelledError):
        await asyncio.wait_for(task, 5)

    interrupted = first.state()
    assert not interrupted.backfill.done
    stored = set(assert_disk_consistent(first.folder))
    assert set(range(interrupted.backfill.oldest_done_id, 1001)) <= stored

    first.gateway.page_hook = None
    mark = len(first.gateway.calls)
    second = make_rig(gateway=first.gateway, clock=first.clock)
    second.start()
    await second.until_complete()

    resumed = [args for name, args in second.gateway.calls[mark:] if name == "iter_history"]
    assert resumed[0][1] == interrupted.backfill.oldest_done_id
    assert_disk_consistent(second.folder, expect_ids=range(1, 1001))


@pytest.mark.parametrize("cut", [1, 7, 150, 299, 315])
async def test_a_failing_tail_retries_alone_from_oldest_done_id(
    make_rig: RigFactory, cut: int
) -> None:
    rig = make_rig(range(1, 1001))
    seen = 0
    done_at_failure: list[int] = []

    def hook() -> None:
        nonlocal seen
        if not tail_calls(rig.gateway):
            return
        seen += 1
        if seen == cut:
            done_at_failure.append(rig.state().backfill.oldest_done_id)
            raise RuntimeError("simulated crash")

    rig.gateway.page_hook = hook
    rig.start()
    await rig.until_complete()

    tails = tail_calls(rig.gateway)
    assert len(tails) == 2
    assert tails[1][1] == done_at_failure[0]
    assert rig.task is not None
    assert not rig.task.done()
    assert 60.0 in rig.clock.sleeps
    assert rig.worker.status().error is None
    assert_disk_consistent(rig.folder, expect_ids=range(1, 1001))

async def test_catch_up_after_offline_growth_crosses_a_month_boundary(
    make_rig: RigFactory,
) -> None:
    first = make_rig(range(1, 401))
    first.start()
    await first.until_complete()
    await first.shutdown()

    put(

    assert 651 in ids_by_part(second.folder)["2026-10_001"]
    assert second.state().last_id == 653
    assert_disk_consistent(second.folder, expect_ids=range(1, 654))


async def test_catch_up_retries_after_a_flood_wait_without_duplicates(
    make_rig: RigFactory,
) -> None:
    first = make_rig(range(1, 11))
    first.start()
    await first.until_complete()
    await first.shutdown()
    for i in range(11, 18):
        first.gateway.chats[CHAT_ID][i] = msg(i)
    calls = 0

    def hook() -> None:
        nonlocal calls
        calls += 1
        if calls == 5:
            raise FloodWait(4)

    first.gateway.page_hook = hook
    mark = len(first.gateway.calls)
    second = make_rig(
        gateway=first.gateway, clock=first.clock, config=make_config(backfill={"batch_size": 2})
    )
    second.start()
    await second.until(lambda: second.is_live() and 17 in second.ids(), "caught up")

    assert 4 in second.clock.sleeps
    since_calls = [a for n, a in second.gateway.calls[mark:] if n == "iter_since"]
    assert since_calls == [(CHAT_ID, 10), (CHAT_ID, 14)]
    assert_disk_consistent(second.folder, expect_ids=range(1, 18))


async def test_pause_during_catch_up_is_honoured_at_the_next_batch_boundary(
    make_rig: RigFactory,
) -> None:
    first = make_rig(range(1, 11))
    first.start()
    await first.until_complete()
    await first.shutdown()
    for i in range(11, 18):
        first.gateway.chats[CHAT_ID][i] = msg(i)
    config = make_config(backfill={"batch_size": 2})
    second = make_rig(gateway=first.gateway, clock=first.clock, config=config)
    calls = 0

    def hook() -> None:
        nonlocal calls
        calls += 1
        if calls == 3:
            second.worker.pause()

    first.gateway.page_hook = hook
    second.start()
    await second.until(lambda: second.phase() == "paused", "parked")

    assert second.state().last_id == 14
    assert max(second.ids()) == 14
    assert second.worker.status().paused

    second.worker.resume()
    await second.until(lambda: second.is_live() and 17 in second.ids(), "caught up after resume")
    assert_disk_consistent(second.folder, expect_ids=range(1, 18))

"""History downloads share `BackfillSlots`: at most `max_parallel_chats` chats at once."""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import pytest

from chatimport.runtime import BackfillSlots
from chatimport.worker_backfill import SlotHolder
from tests.fakes import CHAT_ID, FakeClock, FakeGateway
from tests.unit.worker.rig import RigFactory, assert_disk_consistent, make_rig

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import AsyncIterator

    from chatimport.records import MessageRecord

__all__ = ["make_rig"]

OTHER = CHAT_ID + 7


class SlotCheckingGateway(FakeGateway):
    """Notes, at every history message it hands out, which chats hold a slot."""

    def __init__(self, slots: BackfillSlots) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.slots = slots
        self.outside: list[int] = []
        self.most_holders = 0

    async def iter_history(
        self, chat_id: int, *, offset_id: int = 0, min_id: int = 0
    ) -> AsyncIterator[MessageRecord]:
        async for record in super().iter_history(chat_id, offset_id=offset_id, min_id=min_id):
            holders = self.slots.holders
            if chat_id not in holders:
                self.outside.append(chat_id)
            self.most_holders = max(self.most_holders, len(holders))
            yield record
            await asyncio.sleep(0)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("limit", [1, 2])
async def test_history_downloads_run_at_most_max_parallel_chats_at_once(
    make_rig: RigFactory, limit: int
) -> None:
    slots = BackfillSlots(limit)
    gateway = SlotCheckingGateway(slots)
    clock = FakeClock()
    rigs = [
        make_rig(
            range(1, 1001),
            chat_id=chat_id,
            title=f"Chat {n}",
            gateway=gateway,
            clock=clock,
            slots=slots,
        )
        for n, chat_id in enumerate((CHAT_ID, OTHER))
    ]
    for rig in rigs:
        rig.start()
    for rig in rigs:
        await rig.until_complete()

    assert gateway.outside == []
    assert gateway.most_holders == limit
    for rig in rigs:
        assert_disk_consistent(rig.folder, expect_ids=range(1, 1001))
    assert slots.holders == ()


async def test_a_chat_with_a_paused_backfill_lets_the_others_download(
    make_rig: RigFactory,
) -> None:
    slots = BackfillSlots(1)
    gateway = FakeGateway()
    clock = FakeClock()
    paused = make_rig(range(1, 1001), gateway=gateway, clock=clock, slots=slots)
    other = make_rig(
        range(1, 1001), chat_id=OTHER, title="Other", gateway=gateway, clock=clock, slots=slots
    )
    paused.worker.pause_backfill()
    paused.start()
    await paused.until_live()
    other.start()

    await other.until_complete()
    assert not paused.backfill_done()

    paused.worker.resume_backfill()
    await paused.until_complete()
    assert_disk_consistent(paused.folder, expect_ids=range(1, 1001))


async def test_a_paused_head_backfill_gives_its_slot_back(make_rig: RigFactory) -> None:
    slots = BackfillSlots(1)
    gateway = FakeGateway()
    clock = FakeClock()
    rig = make_rig(
        range(1, 401),
        gateway=gateway,
        clock=clock,
        slots=slots,
    )
    seen = 0

    def hook() -> None:
        nonlocal seen
        seen += 1
        if seen == 150:
            rig.worker.pause()

    gateway.page_hook = hook
    rig.start()
    await rig.until(lambda: rig.phase() == "paused", "parked inside the head backfill")

    assert slots.holders == ()
    gateway.page_hook = None
    rig.worker.resume()
    await rig.until_complete()
    assert_disk_consistent(rig.folder, expect_ids=range(1, 401))


async def test_a_slot_holder_without_slots_does_nothing() -> None:
    holder = SlotHolder(None, CHAT_ID)

    async with holder.holding():
        assert not holder.held
        async with holder.suspended():
            assert not holder.held


async def test_a_slot_holder_takes_its_slot_back_after_a_suspension() -> None:
    slots = BackfillSlots(1)
    holder = SlotHolder(slots, CHAT_ID)

    async with holder.holding():
        await holder.acquire()
        assert slots.holders == (CHAT_ID,)
        async with holder.suspended():
            assert slots.holders == ()
        assert holder.held
    assert slots.holders == ()


async def test_a_slot_is_not_taken_back_when_the_suspended_body_fails() -> None:
    slots = BackfillSlots(1)
    holder = SlotHolder(slots, CHAT_ID)

    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
        async with holder.holding(), holder.suspended():
            raise RuntimeError("stop")

    assert not holder.held
    assert slots.holders == ()

"""The live buffer and the pure mapping from live events to records."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import replace
from datetime import timedelta
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import pytest

from chatimport.config import EventsConfig, LiveConfig
from chatimport.ports import NewMessageEvent
from chatimport.records import DETECTED_EVENT, DeleteRecord, EditRecord, MessageRecord
from chatimport.storage.state import new_state
from chatimport.worker_buffer import LiveBuffer, RecentIds, events_to_records, split_late
from tests.fakes import CHAT_ID, NOW, msg
from tests.unit.worker.rig import delete_event, edit_event, new_event

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from chatimport.ports import ChatEvent
    from chatimport.records import Record

STATE = replace(new_state(CHAT_ID, "t", None, NOW), last_id=100, floor_id=10)


def kinds(records: list[Record]) -> list[tuple[str, object]]:
    out: list[tuple[str, object]] = []
    for record in records:
        if isinstance(record, MessageRecord):
            out.append(("message", record.msg_id))
        elif isinstance(record, EditRecord):
            out.append(("edit", record.msg_id))
        elif isinstance(record, DeleteRecord):
            out.append(("delete", record.msg_ids))
    return out


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("events", "recent", "config", "expected"),
    [
        pytest.param([new_event(101)], [], EventsConfig(), [("message", 101)], id="new"),
        pytest.param(
            [new_event(101), new_event(101)],
            [],
            EventsConfig(),
            [("message", 101)],
            id="duplicate-in-batch",
        ),
        pytest.param([new_event(10)], [], EventsConfig(), [], id="at-floor"),
        pytest.param([new_event(5)], [], EventsConfig(), [], id="below-floor"),
        pytest.param([new_event(99)], [], EventsConfig(), [("message", 99)], id="late-unknown"),
        pytest.param([new_event(99)], [99], EventsConfig(), [], id="late-recently-written"),
        pytest.param([new_event(100)], [100], EventsConfig(), [], id="last-id-replay"),
        pytest.param([edit_event(10, "x")], [], EventsConfig(), [("edit", 10)], id="edit-at-floor"),
        pytest.param([edit_event(9, "x")], [], EventsConfig(), [], id="edit-below-floor"),
        pytest.param(
            [edit_event(50, "x")], [], EventsConfig(track_edits=False), [], id="edits-off"
        ),
        pytest.param(
            [delete_event([5, 10, 50])],
            [],
            EventsConfig(),
            [("delete", (10, 50))],
            id="delete-trimmed-to-floor",
        ),
        pytest.param([delete_event([5])], [], EventsConfig(), [], id="delete-only-below-floor"),
        pytest.param(
            [delete_event([50])], [], EventsConfig(track_deletes=False), [], id="deletes-off"
        ),
        pytest.param(
            [delete_event([50], CHAT_ID + 1)], [], EventsConfig(), [], id="foreign-chat-delete"
        ),
        pytest.param([delete_event([50], None)], [], EventsConfig(), [], id="delete-without-chat"),
    ],
)
def test_events_to_records(
    events: list[ChatEvent],
    recent: list[int],
    config: EventsConfig,
    expected: list[tuple[str, object]],
) -> None:
    known = RecentIds()
    known.add(recent)

    records = events_to_records(events, STATE, config, chat_id=CHAT_ID, now=NOW, recent=known)

    assert kinds(records) == expected


def test_mapped_edits_and_deletes_carry_their_dates_and_source() -> None:
    later = NOW + timedelta(hours=2)
    records = events_to_records(
        [edit_event(50, "new", later), delete_event([60])],
        STATE,
        EventsConfig(),
        chat_id=CHAT_ID,
        now=later,
        recent=RecentIds(),
    )

    edit, delete = records
    assert isinstance(edit, EditRecord)
    assert isinstance(delete, DeleteRecord)
    assert (edit.edit_date, edit.text, edit.detected_by) == (later, "new", DETECTED_EVENT)
    assert (delete.fetched_at, delete.detected_by) == (later, DETECTED_EVENT)


def test_split_late_separates_messages_at_or_below_last_id() -> None:
    edit = EditRecord(CHAT_ID, 5, NOW, NOW, "x", None)
    append, late = split_late([msg(99), msg(100), msg(101), edit], 100)

    assert [getattr(r, "msg_id", None) for r in append] == [101, 5]
    assert [r.msg_id for r in late] == [99, 100]


def test_recent_ids_forget_the_oldest_beyond_capacity() -> None:
    recent = RecentIds(capacity=3)
    recent.add([1, 2, 2, 3])
    recent.add([4])

    assert [i in recent for i in (1, 2, 3, 4)] == [False, True, True, True]


def test_buffer_flushes_by_count_or_by_time_from_the_first_event() -> None:
    live = LiveConfig(flush_every_messages=3, flush_every_seconds=30)
    buffer = LiveBuffer(capacity=10)
    assert buffer.deadline(live) is None
    assert not buffer.due(NOW, live)

    buffer.take(None, NOW)
    buffer.take(new_event(1), NOW)
    buffer.take(new_event(2), NOW + timedelta(seconds=20))

    assert buffer.deadline(live) == NOW + timedelta(seconds=30)
    assert not buffer.due(NOW + timedelta(seconds=29), live)
    assert buffer.due(NOW + timedelta(seconds=30), live)
    buffer.take(new_event(3), NOW)
    assert buffer.due(NOW, live)
    assert len(buffer.pop_all()) == 3
    assert len(buffer) == 0
    assert buffer.deadline(live) is None


def test_buffer_counts_what_it_cannot_hold() -> None:
    buffer = LiveBuffer(capacity=2)
    for i in range(5):
        buffer.take(new_event(i + 1), NOW)
    buffer.note_dropped(4)

    assert len(buffer) == 2
    assert buffer.take_dropped() == 7
    assert buffer.take_dropped() == 0


def test_requeued_events_go_first_and_the_oldest_overflow_is_dropped() -> None:
    buffer = LiveBuffer(capacity=3)
    buffer.take(new_event(10), NOW)
    failed: list[ChatEvent] = [new_event(1), new_event(2), new_event(3)]

    buffer.requeue(failed, NOW + timedelta(seconds=5))

    kept = buffer.pop_all()
    assert [e.record.msg_id for e in kept if isinstance(e, NewMessageEvent)] == [2, 3, 10]
    assert buffer.take_dropped() == 1
    buffer.requeue([], NOW)
    assert buffer.deadline(LiveConfig()) is None

)

__all__ = ["make_rig"]


class GatedClock(FakeClock):
    """A clock whose sleeps of exactly `blocked` seconds wait until `gate` is set."""

    def __init__(self, blocked: float) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.blocked = blocked
        self.gate = asyncio.Event()
        self.gated: list[float] = []

    async def sleep(self, seconds: float) -> None:
        if seconds == self.blocked:
            self.gated.append(seconds)
            await self.gate.wait()
            return
        await super().sleep(seconds)


def tail_started(rig: Rig) -> bool:
    return any(name == "iter_history" and args[1] for name, args in rig.gateway.calls)


def fail_once_in_tail(rig: Rig, error: BaseException, after: int = 1) -> None:
    seen = 0
    fired = False

    def hook() -> None:
        nonlocal seen, fired
        if tail_started(rig) and not fired:
            seen += 1
            if seen == after:
                fired = True
                raise error

    rig.gateway.page_hook = hook


async def prepare_site(make_rig: RigFactory, site: str, error: BaseException) -> Rig:
    """A rig that will hit `error` once at `site`; the matching history is on the gateway."""
    if site == "catch_up":
        first = make_rig(range(1, 51))
        first.start()
        await first.until_complete()
        await first.shutdown()
        for i in range(51, 61):
            first.gateway.chats[CHAT_ID][i] = msg(i)
        first.gateway.fail["iter_since"] = [error]
        return make_rig(gateway=first.gateway, clock=first.clock)
    rig = make_rig(range(1, 1001) if site == "tail" else range(1, 51))
    if site == "head_newest":
        rig.gateway.fail["newest_id"] = [error]
    elif site == "head_history":
        rig.gateway.fail["iter_history"] = [error]
    else:
        fail_once_in_tail(rig, error, after=3)
    return rig


SITES = ["head_newest", "head_history", "tail", "catch_up"]


def expected_ids(site: str) -> range:
    return {"tail": range(1, 1001), "catch_up": range(1, 61)}.get(site, range(1, 51))


@pytest.mark.parametrize("site", SITES)
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("seconds", "notified"), [(1, False), (600, False), (601, True), (86400, True)]
)
async def test_flood_wait_sleeps_through_the_clock_and_notifies_only_above_ten_minutes(
    make_rig: RigFactory, site: str, seconds: int, notified: bool
) -> None:
    rig = await prepare_site(make_rig, site, FloodWait(seconds))
    mark = len(rig.clock.sleeps)
    rig.start()

    await rig.until(
        lambda: rig.is_live() and rig.backfill_done() and set(rig.ids()) == set(expected_ids(site)),
        "stored after the flood wait",
    )

    assert seconds in rig.clock.sleeps[mark:]
    warnings = [n for n in rig.notifier.notes if n.level is Level.WARNING]
    assert len(warnings) == int(notified)
    if notified:
        assert warnings[0].title == TITLE
        assert str(seconds) in warnings[0].message
    assert not [n for n in rig.notifier.notes if n.level is Level.ERROR]
    assert rig.worker.status().error is None
    assert_disk_consistent(rig.folder, expect_ids=expected_ids(site))


async def test_consecutive_flood_waits_are_all_served_in_order(make_rig: RigFactory) -> None:
    rig = make_rig(range(1, 51))
    rig.gateway.fail["newest_id"] = [FloodWait(1), FloodWait(2), FloodWait(3)]
    rig.start()

    await rig.until_complete()

    assert rig.clock.sleeps == [1, 2, 3]
    assert rig.gateway.count("newest_id") == 4


async def test_a_flood_wait_in_the_middle_of_a_stream_resumes_without_gaps(
    make_rig: RigFactory,
) -> None:
    rig = make_rig(range(1, 1001))
    fail_once_in_tail(rig, FloodWait(9), after=40)
    rig.start()

    await rig.until_complete()

    assert 9 in rig.clock.sleeps
    assert_disk_consistent(rig.folder, expect_ids=range(1, 1001))


async def test_a_flood_wait_in_one_worker_does_not_block_another(make_rig: RigFactory) -> None:
    clock = GatedClock(1000)
    slow = make_rig(range(1, 51), title="Slow", clock=clock)
    fast = make_rig(range(1, 51), chat_id=CHAT_ID - 1, title="Fast", clock=clock)
    slow.gateway.fail["newest_id"] = [FloodWait(1000)]

    slow.start()
    fast.start()
    await fast.until_complete()

    assert clock.gated == [1000]
    assert not slow.is_live()
    clock.gate.set()
    await slow.until_complete()
    assert_disk_consistent(slow.folder, expect_ids=range(1, 51))


async def test_lost_access_during_the_head_backfill_keeps_state_and_drops_events(
    make_rig: RigFactory,
) -> None:
    rig = make_rig(range(1, 51))
    rig.gateway.fail["newest_id"] = [AccessLost(CHAT_ID)]
    task = rig.start()
    await rig.until(lambda: rig.phase() == PHASE_NO_ACCESS, "no access")

    for i in range(51, 71):
        rig.worker.submit(new_event(i))
    rig.worker.resume()
    await rig.settle()

    status = rig.worker.status()
    assert (status.phase, status.error) == (PHASE_NO_ACCESS, "no access")
    errors = [n for n in rig.notifier.notes if n.level is Level.ERROR]
    assert [(n.title, n.message) for n in errors] == [(TITLE, "No access to the chat; data kept")]
    assert rig.ids() == []

    await rig.worker.stop()
    assert task.done()
    assert task.exception() is None
    assert rig.ids() == []


async def test_lost_access_keeps_the_data_that_is_already_stored(make_rig: RigFactory) -> None:

async def test_a_refetch_request_brings_a_chat_back_from_lost_access(
    make_rig: RigFactory,
) -> None:
    rig = make_rig(range(1, 51))
    rig.gateway.fail["newest_id"] = [AccessLost(CHAT_ID)]

@pytest.mark.parametrize("site", ["head_newest", "catch_up", "tail"])
async def test_a_revoked_session_ends_the_run_and_notifies_without_details(
    make_rig: RigFactory, site: str
) -> None:
    rig = await prepare_site(make_rig, site, SessionRevoked("gone"))
    task = rig.start()

    assert rig.worker.status().error == "session revoked"
    errors = [n for n in rig.notifier.notes if n.level is Level.ERROR]
    assert [(n.title, n.message) for n in errors] == [

    ]
    assert rig.worker.lock.locked() is False


@pytest.mark.parametrize("site", ["head_newest", "catch_up"])
async def test_an_unexpected_error_ends_the_run_and_a_new_run_recovers(
    make_rig: RigFactory, site: str
) -> None:
    rig = await prepare_site(make_rig, site, RuntimeError("boom"))
    task = rig.start()

    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="boom"):
        await asyncio.wait_for(task, 3)

    assert rig.worker.status().error == "RuntimeError"
    assert rig.worker.lock.locked() is False
    rig.start()
    await rig.until_complete()
    assert_disk_consistent(rig.folder, expect_ids=expected_ids(site))


async def test_a_tail_error_does_not_stop_live_and_the_tail_retries_alone(
    make_rig: RigFactory,
) -> None:
    clock = GatedClock(blocked=60)
    rig = make_rig(range(1, 1001), clock=clock)
    fail_once_in_tail(rig, RuntimeError("boom"), after=3)
    task = rig.start()
    await rig.until(lambda: clock.gated == [60], "tail waits for its retry")

    assert rig.worker.status().error == "tail: RuntimeError"
    for i in range(1001, 1006):
        rig.worker.submit(new_event(i, date=NOW))
    await rig.until(lambda: max(rig.ids()) == 1005, "live flush while the tail is failing")
    assert not task.done()

    clock.gate.set()
    await rig.until_complete()
    assert rig.worker.status().error is None
    assert_disk_consistent(rig.folder, expect_ids=range(1, 1006), ordered=False)

"""Live phase of the chat worker: buffering, flushing, events, reconcile, pause, stop."""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import shutil
from dataclasses import replace
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any

import pytest

from chatimport.ports import ChatEvent, EditedMessageEvent

    DETECTED_EVENT,
    DeleteRecord,

    MessageRecord,
    Record,
)
